e.bevis-training-shield.name: Bevis' Training Shield
e.bevis-training-shield.description: VII. Acting without thought Bevis tore off the cover-rimmed wheel from the wagon and rushed up to the highest point of the path, planting his feet and facing the oncoming deluge of stone and earth despite his father crying out for him to get to safety. As the rocks poured down Bevis' father expected the worst... up until the whole avalanche seemed to inexplicably stop entirely. Seemingly beyond comprehension, Bevis was holding back the largest of the stones, bracing his makeshift shield against them, and it took his father a moment to realize that Bevis was calling out for him to hurry the flock across to safety. After several long moments Bevis released the rocks and ran back, rejoining his father and the flock, leaving only a semi-supported wagon and broken wheel to be crushed beneath the flow.

e.hatuumin-camel.description:
IX. Kontar cradled his bloodied left arm, feeling a wave of relief stave off the impending exhaustion as they stepped towards the small dais. Looking up at Sennie and Sinyu both, Kontar felt secure knowing that they would be able to overcome this, and likely any obstacle, with their combined talents and strength.

Taking a deep breath, and a hand from each of the men, Kontar stepped forward through the portal...

... And into a brilliantly coloured land, adorned with plants and insects, birds and life. Kontar was stunned by the scene, as he had never experienced so many colours, sounds nor seen so many living things in one area for as long as he could remember. After a few moments, Kontar caught his breath, and equally caught himself grinning ear to ear. He turned to look at his companions' expressions... Only to realize that they were not with him. Spinning around, Kontar realized that they were nowhere to be seen, nor was the portal that he had just stepped through.

He was completely, and utterly, alone.

Frantic to learn more, Sinyu demanded what details he could wring from anyone he could speak with, but there were precious few details: The Nomarch was gone, presumably killed, and a new line of royalty had been established. Sinyu wanted to weep, but turned to seek out his young ward, still unsure of what his next steps would be.

Cenius' thirst for power and destruction had led to his rapid and pronounced growth in his arts, and it was all Helci could do to stave him off. Helci could see that everything she threw at Cenius would have its essence drained and the magicks manevolently returned to her, and it was only when she was at her wits' ends did she realize that the darkest magic, that which she had refused to learn, held the key.... For what was death but the final stage of life?

I(c). Kontar grimaced as he looked up into the ever-present sun, before looking back down to the street below and throwing the large stone he held. He dropped to his stomach as he did so, feeling the warmth of the stone roof under him as he heard a boy's voice call out in pain, then anger. He suspected he would pay a sharp price for the jest once he returned to the Alaytam, and no doubt the Denmother would see through his feigned innocence, but it was worth it in his eyes. He had little else to do, these days, especially when it wasn't a day he was scheduled to assist the old mage-

Kontar paused as he heard a blast, followed by a scream, a block or two away. Knowing, or at least fearing he knew where it originated, Kontar took off running towards the residence, wondering what he would find.

He was barely capable of taking notice of a newcomer to the area, clad in broad, heavy armor, wielding a large shield and hammer.

c.stormchimes.name: Stormchimes

e.velvet-fur.description: XVIII. Brath's mother approached the great creature, who slowly rose, almost in a bow, before she nodded, raising her hands to the sky, and casting them down before her, causing a great blaze of flame to erupt between them. Brath could hear a strange sound, and realized his mother was chanting some kind of song, before she started swaying and moving, before prancing in a circle, mimicked by the stag. Whimsically,

e.lumina-flash-ring.name: Lumina Flash Ring
e.lumina-flash-ring.effects:
By the Light (Ring): 12% chance to proc 1,000 Lightning damage; +125 damage per Lumina Flash set item worn; +1% Evasion; +30 HP

 9+: +2% Evasion and +1 Tiers of 'Advanced Evasive Maneuvers'
e.lumina-flash-ring.description:
"The Thunderbeak is related to the Thunderbird, but is still a distinct creature. In terms of dietary differences, you'll need to make sure that you're not-"
-Conversations with Janagud

u.yellow-swiftness-tonic.name: Yellow Swiftness Tonic
u.yellow-swiftness-tonic.description:
An old legend tells of two colleagues exploring a dense forest, before happening upon a bear. When the bear gives chase, they both flee as swiftly as their feet will carry them. One of the colleagues pauses to quaff a draught from a small glass beaker. "You'll never be able to evade the bear forever, so why waste time with a last drink?!" His partner questioned incredulously.

"I need not escape the bear forever, ol' chum! I need only dodge its advances longer than you!"
u.yellow-swiftness-tonic.effects: Increases Evasion equivalent to +2,000 Agility for 4 hours

ba.mystic-trickster-banner.name: Mystic Trickster Banner
ba.mystic-trickster-banner.description: Obtained with the Mystic Trickster Class

u.stormy-sack.name: Stormy Sack
u.stormy-sack.description: It may not be much, but if it can help with your frayed nerves - and frayed, sporadically clinging hair - you'll not turn it down.
u.stormy-sack.effects: Open to obtain its contents (two of the chance drops)

e.zaratans-gauntlets.name: Zaratan's Gauntlets
e.zaratans-gauntlets.effects:
Debris Volley (Gauntlets): 15% chance to proc 800 Nature damage; +40 damage per Zaratan set item worn; +40 Health
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.zaratans-gauntlets.description:
"The broad, clawed feet of the Zaratan are equally capable of carrying its massive frame great strides on land, or propelling them in the water. Watching one swim along the surface can be disorienting, as it looks like an island is on the move."
-Janagud

c.red-squidlet.name: Red Squidlet
c.red-squidlet.description: As cute as this colourful creature may seem, Alanis has assured you that the bright tones are indicative of highly potent venom.

u.parchment-of-holy-hacking.name: Parchment of Holy Hacking
u.parchment-of-holy-hacking.description: A tattered scroll, showcasing a divine method of wielding one's weapon!

k.mounts-potential-expert-handling.effects: While riding an Inorganic Mount, you expertly take the reins and skillfully maneuver it, improving your combat abilities. For the next 3 attacks your Crit Rate increases by +x%, and your Formation Power increases by +y%.

e.alchemical-artisan-wand.effects:

e.alchemical-artisan-wand.description: I. As a young child, Nahla Amytus loved watching the world around her, from the current pulling debris through channels in the cracked stone, to the way the clouds rose from and raced by the waters upon the surface. Her mothers had often instructed her to keep her mouth closed, as she was prone to gaping while she was entranced by the beauty of everything surrounding her. That innocence and wonder was lost, however, when tragedy struck.

e.bevis-vambraces.name: Bevis' Vambraces
e.bevis-vambraces.effects:

Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.bevis-vambraces.description: III. This lackadaisical attitude made Bevis fun to be around, but few ever wanted to truly befriend the lad, as untrustworthy and half-cocked as he was, resulting in Bevis oftentimes feeling quite lonely, even when surrounded by his peers.

c.red-snakeweed.name: Red Snakeweed
c.red-snakeweed.description: In spite of Seksehsa's explanation that Naga can consume this to settle an uneasy stomach, the strange look of the eyes after consuming it, and the eagerness to chew on it, leaves room for suspicion.

c.raw-nepyres-citrine.name: Raw Nepyres Citrine
c.raw-nepyres-citrine.description: The visible chunks of ore in this stone are beyond your wildest imagination. Alanis has already started on about what a high quality jeweler could create using it.

a.glasha-brunbruk.name: Glasha Brunbruk
a.glasha-brunbruk.description:
"It was only a matter of time before another of His legions came forward to challenge the living, but I never expected one of His generals to arise. Well, there's fighting to be done, so let's be about it."
-Glasha Brunbruk
a.glasha-brunbruk.effects: Given His Due: 26% chance to proc 400 Holy damage; +400 damage vs Demon raids; Adds +2 Attack to each Dwarven Demoguard and Orcish Dispeller in the Formation

e.cumberworld-benefactors-regal-mare.description: "Are you sure this isn't the same steed as before, just dressed up in different regalia...?"

"In all my years of study I have never seen a Zaratan feeding, so it would seem strange to me that it would choose to feast upon something as comparatively small as a bushel of elderberries. Perhaps the quality of the berries holds more than I initially gave credit..."
-Janagud

a.reodai-acolyte.name: Reodai Acolyte
a.reodai-acolyte.description:
"The greatessst benefitsss are the hardessst to attain. Perhapsss you could do with sssome hard work and ssself growth."
-Lokakshi Coilbreaker

c.mastru-flatfish.name: Mastru Flatfish

c.blue-fallen-headstone.name: Blue Fallen Headstone
c.blue-fallen-headstone.description: It's unclear whether the headstone was originally this colour when it fell, or something turned it after the fact. Either way, you would prefer something a little more... plain.

c.green-rattler.name: Green Rattler
c.green-rattler.description: You didn't realize that the tail of a snake would stay in one piece, even after death. Plus, it makes such a fun sound!

-Apui

u.naven-merchants-bargain-bag.description: According to the local Naven merchants this bag is a spectacular deal, containing items rarely seen in the area. Of course, they only have one available for purchase.

a.veedsamin-trainee-overseer.name: Veedsamin Trainee Overseer
a.veedsamin-trainee-overseer.description:
"Looking after the next generation of Veedsamin is no small task, and it takes a hearty overseer to both keep them safe, and in-line."
-Tietha Holyrood

c.doiryns-inspection.name: Do'iryn's Inspection
c.doiryns-inspection.description: "The people roaming the lands offer one viewpoint, but the powers deep below the surface are rarely seen to offer theirs. Nebekinessur ventured into the darkened tunnels, far beyond what most considered safe, to seek out the infamous Molarra Do'iryn, in the hopes of distracting her from her study of the magics of killing and war with his own, latest research."

c.violet-dragonslayer-gem.name: Violet Dragonslayer Gem
c.violet-dragonslayer-gem.description: This fine, magical, violet gem resonates in proximity to the Blade of Mestari. What could the connection be between these two artifacts?

a.kornere-warmbelt.name: Kornere Warmbelt
a.kornere-warmbelt.description:
"The teachings of Vozotl are quite clear. If you want His blessings, you must purge yourself of your sins, and be cleansed in His holy fires."
-Kornere Warmbelt

c.green-thurlam-blowfish.name: Green Thurlam Blowfish
c.green-thurlam-blowfish.description: You are hesitant to touch such a prickly, soggy creature, until you see Mauritio put one to his mouth and blow hard, inflating it to comical proportions.

e.gipantan-dockhand-bottles.name: Gipantan Dockhand Bottles

e.gipantan-dockhand-bottles.description:
"Wait, why would we want these lit on fire? I'm not in the business of damaging any ships, or their cargo, and my job is worth more to me than your flights of flaming fancy."
-Broff Keghaul

e.fiddler-boots.description: VII(b). The Fiddler Knight would attempt to prevent the guardsmen from collecting tariffs through show of force, but when that ultimately failed he slayed the oppressive force in order to protect the townsfolk. The judgement appeared to be made anew with every encounter, though the trail of blood may have led some to question that. The killing slowed, however, when the Fiddler Knight came face to face with the champion hired by the merchants.

u.ghastly-sack.name: Ghastly Sack
u.ghastly-sack.description: You hesitate to even lay hands upon this ethereal bag, but overcome your fears when you saw Alanis rolling her eyes in your general direction.

e.granite-blessers-gauntlets.name: Granite-Blesser's Gauntlets

Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion

You were quite surprised to learn that the orders of Orimneni do not devote themselves specifically to healing, despite their leader being labeled a cleric; Dondomra seemed almost insulted at the suggestion, given how she was garbed in heavy plate-mail and wielded a rod that looked suspiciously like a mace.

e.derzis-thunderclap-ring.name: Derzis' Thunderclap Ring
e.derzis-thunderclap-ring.effects:

 7+: +1 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Lightning
 8+: +1 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Lightning'
e.derzis-thunderclap-ring.description: This strange, unfinished band tickles your fingers as you hold it. As you attempt to don it, a sharp, electrical bolt shoots up you, seizing your arm in spasms for a few moments.

e.rusted-leoegan-linothorax.name: Rusted Leoegan Linothorax

Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.rusted-leoegan-linothorax.description: II. Like many tales of old, it is not uncommon for it to begin with one of the Gods straying from their righteous seats and choosing a mortal favourite. Vozotl was no exception to this, in many respects, and it is said that Paython was born of that union.

a.vrandas-beastrider.name: Vranda's Beastrider
a.vrandas-beastrider.description:
"Sssometimesss it isss vital to command the highessst degree of ressspect from the beassst in order to bessst control it. Only the mossst talented can claim the ability to ride any beassst in the world."
-Vranda

e.natures-revolt-boots.effects:

c.sinnamurgh-feather.name: Sinnamurgh Feather
c.sinnamurgh-feather.description: The legendary Sinnamurgh is said to have impossible regenerative capabilities, while being large enough to carry off a hundred men in its talons. It is also said to be generous, bestowing strips of delicious, scented foods to the impoverished. Whatever the case, the feathers of one of these birds is sure to contain incredible mystic energies.

e.plain-leather-armor.name: Plain Leather Armor
e.plain-leather-armor.description: Body armor made of overlapping leathers may seem plain, but at least it's light.

a.ludy.name: Ludy
a.ludy.description: "We back against will, but we will make better than who brought us back."
a.ludy.effects: Penance Push: 6% chance to proc 300 Dark damage; Restores 4 Health daily

c.soured-talc.name: Soured Talc
c.soured-talc.description: A concoction developed by Viscount Thorne himself, it would apparently only take a small amount of acidic essence to turn this into a thick, acidic mess of deadly potential.

e.waveblessed-porpoise.name: Waveblessed Porpoise
e.waveblessed-porpoise.effects:

m.duskfall.name: Duskfall
m.duskfall.description:
"My order has mandated strict requirements for our mages, focusing primarily on their alignment with our goals. Pedigree is not considered, whereas excellence in their craft is necessary. This is the culmination of their studies and ambitions."
-Sir Tybalt

 6+: +5% Lightning Resistance

It is said that this copperhead Naga personally assailed Thotssaken during the ensuing bloodshed, and while she drew his life energies from his body to galvanize her electrical offence against him, he grounded himself while grasping her, ensuring she took the brunt of her own attack, resulting in both dropping dead in that fatal embrace.

u.dilute-vitality-potion.name: Dilute Vitality Potion
u.dilute-vitality-potion.description: Contrary to tales spun by back-alley vendors, these dilute potions are not merely watered-down vitality potions. The off-yellow alternatives they are attempting to sell, however...

u.jingse-bhow.name: Jingse Bhow
u.jingse-bhow.description: A sizable sack for a sizable amount of aid to this rural village.

e.mikoko-wabawa.name: Mikoko Wabawa

e.mikoko-wabawa.description: Settling the raging, restless spirits of the fallen requires a calm mind and serene control of the arcane.

c.yellow-repentant-dusk-mark.name: Yellow Repentant Dusk Mark
c.yellow-repentant-dusk-mark.description: A rare and chilling mark, symbolizing the sworn pledge offered by the Knights of the Repentant Dusk.

e.snowdrake-slaughterer-pants.name: Snowdrake Slaughterer Pants
e.snowdrake-slaughterer-pants.effects:
Wandering in a Winter Wasteland (Pants): 10% chance to proc 600 Physical damage; +100 damage per Snowdrake Slaughterer set item worn; +2,000 damage vs Winter raids; +1,000 damage vs Dragon raids; +5% Ice Resistance
Set Bonus (Snowdrake Slaughterer Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +2% Crit Rate and +30% Crit Damage
 9+: +10% Ice Resistance
e.snowdrake-slaughterer-pants.description: Why, in the name of any deity or eternal being, would anyone think that adding a persistently-radiating source of cold to one's pants was a good idea?!

u.yellow-green-repentant-dusk-chest.name: Yellow-Green Repentant Dusk Chest
u.yellow-green-repentant-dusk-chest.description: Dusk’s chill falls upon all foes caught in its shadows.

e.ranging-scouts-longbow.name: Ranging Scout's Longbow
e.ranging-scouts-longbow.effects: Scout's Honor (Longbow): 16% chance to proc 75 Physical damage; +25 damage per Ranging Scout's set item worn; +1% Crit Rate; +5% Crit Damage
e.ranging-scouts-longbow.description:
"The key to using a longbow is, predictably, your eyes. However, to truly master it, you have to see not only where your target is, but where they are going to be."

You nod your head, unsure if the Marksman has the gift of prophetic vision, or is pulling your leg.

e.elven-rangers-horse.name: Elven Ranger's Horse
e.elven-rangers-horse.description: Trained by the Elves of the western forests, these mounts are accustomed to dense forest and thick foliage, trekking through either with amazingly quiet ease.

e.hatuumin-shooter.name: Hatuumin Shooter
e.hatuumin-shooter.effects:
Sight of the Eye (Shooter): 10% chance to proc 600 Psychic damage; +125 damage per Hatuumin set item worn; +0.25% Crit Rate
Set Bonus (Hatuumin Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +2% Evasion
e.hatuumin-shooter.description:
II(c). The scene was beyond description, and Kontar rushed through the decimated quarters, where he found his master in front of a body. Calling out to him, Kontar was able to usher him outside, seeing the man's shock turn to grief and disbelief as he did so.

"There must be a way... I... I can fix this!" Sennie was gasping for air, before he looked down at his palms, and saw the dark stars spreading outwards from under his skin. Seeing the obvious signs of the curse in his master, Kontar realized that he couldn't leave him alone, nor could he do this alone. He would have to call on an old friend in order to see these wrongs righted.

e.nakanos-pants.name: Nakano's Pants
e.nakanos-pants.effects:
Set Bonus (Nakano Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +75 Offence, +2% Evasion and +2% Crit Rate
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.nakanos-pants.description: IV. Years later, while she could not be formally named as a samurai, it was a well-known 'secret' in the Hitsugi clan that Nakano was the premier - if inaptly titled - swordsman on the premises. Nakano was even willing to forego her inheritance of the estate, despite being the eldest child, in order to continue her mastery of the blade. To that end she took steps to ensure the safety of her younger brother and her house, as rumours had begun spreading of a thief who could decimate a house's fortunes in a single night, if they did not slaughter all the occupants out of hand.

e.paresthisy-boots.name: Paresthisy Boots
e.paresthisy-boots.effects:
Existential Experiencing (Boots): 16% chance to proc 475 Psychic damage, giving +10% Crit Damage on proc; +200 damage per Paresthisy set item worn; +10 HP; +4% Psychic Resistance
Set Bonus (Paresthisy Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +1 Tiers of 'Eye for Beauty'
 8+: +1 Tiers of 'Eye for Beauty'
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.paresthisy-boots.description: With all the explosive insects around here, you can only hope that the footwear worn by these nomadic peoples will keep all your toes attached.

c.blue-frigidara-defence-banner.name: Blue Frigidara Defence Banner
c.blue-frigidara-defence-banner.description: A banner intended to both rally troops to stave off Frigidara’s invasion, and to announce details about her horde’s locations. Aegyr truly seems to have thought of everything in this never-ending watch of his.

a.keylsa.name: Keylsa
a.keylsa.description: A wandering cartographer, you are surprised to hear of the events Keylsa has endured in his travels. Despite all of that, he seems unusually positive, and ever-willing to lend a hand, especially if you're willing to lend him an ear in return.
a.keylsa.effects: Cartographic Crush: 6% chance to proc 6,000 Physical damage

e.plain-cloth-pants.name: Plain Cloth Pants
e.plain-cloth-pants.description: You've learned better than to go for a nightly stroll without pants on.

c.red-demon-bindings.name: Red Demon Bindings
c.red-demon-bindings.description: Once used to bind demonic armor to its owner, you've heard some notions that the local orcs may be able to make use of these.

c.thiadoran-flour.name: Thiadoran Flour
c.thiadoran-flour.description: Some of the densest flour by-weight, Thiadoran grain is processed down into this increadibly nutritious fuel, which is later used to prepare a variety of delicious products.

e.demonsbanes-cursed-armor.name: Demonsbane's Cursed Armor
e.demonsbanes-cursed-armor.effects:
Darker Deterrence (Armor): 6% chance to proc 1,750 Physical damage; +1,250 Physical damage vs Demon raids; +1% Crit Rate vs Demon raids
Set Bonus (Demonsbane's Cursed Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +100% Crit Damage
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.demonsbanes-cursed-armor.description: The blood-red stains on her dark plate left observers wondering if Ciri simply failed to clean her equipment, or if something more sinister lay underneath.

u.crusaders-elixir.name: Crusader's Elixir
u.crusaders-elixir.description: The essence of the crusader, distilled and purified, empowers this elixir. You can only imagine the power it is able to bestow.
u.crusaders-elixir.effects: Open to obtain its contents (two of the chance drops)

c.robust-brew-of-magics.name: Robust Brew of Magics
c.robust-brew-of-magics.description: This story of mine cannot be shared, regarding my precious freedom, though it describes the days of old when magic filled the air.

u.blizzarding-hordes-leavings.name: Blizzarding Horde's Leavings
u.blizzarding-hordes-leavings.description: The Defenders have brought along some interesting provisions to keep their strength up against the Blizzarding Horde. It seems some of them are willing to trade for some of the souvenirs you've picked up during battle.
u.blizzarding-hordes-leavings.effects: Open to obtain its contents (two of the chance drops)

c.greater-healer-token.name: Greater Healer Token
c.greater-healer-token.description: Healers carrying these tokens appear to enter a trance when they begin curing others, moving in an almost automated fashion as they complete their work.

e.gastonia-shield.name: Gastonia Shield
e.gastonia-shield.effects:
Scutum Smash (Shield): 20% chance to proc 800 Physical damage; +7,500 damage vs Guild Raids; +200 damage per Gastonia set item worn
Set Bonus (Gastonia Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +50 Honor, +30 Energy and +30 Vitality
e.gastonia-shield.description: II(a). "Play 'The Molly Maid'!" Yelled one drunken patron, followed by an unremorseful belch. Leoben couldn't stifle his sigh as he sat on the small stool with his lyre in his lap, glancing at his cap at the edge of the platform still containing a single copper piece. Gathering his wits, he stood with a flourish, put on a wide grin, and leaned in to the meagre crowd as he asked "How about I play the one your sister wanted to hear last night? Or perhaps the request from your mother?"

e.acheralan-cap.name: Acheralan Cap
e.acheralan-cap.effects:
+0.1% Evasion
Set Bonus (Acheralan Attire Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +2 Tiers of 'Spare Change'
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.acheralan-cap.description: A simple cap, for a simple folk, the Acheralans still seem to be considerably trendier than what you've grown accustomed to.

c.green-devils-artifact.name: Green Devil's Artifact
c.green-devils-artifact.description: A powerful artifact from the belt of one of Skliros' followers, clearly demonstrating your capability and courage.

e.baron-aureus-fowl.name: Baron Aureus' Fowl
e.baron-aureus-fowl.effects:
Golden Noble (Fowl): 45% chance to proc 200 Holy damage and adding +15% Acid Resistance and +5% Holy Resistance and -10% Fire Resistance and -10% Dark Resistance on this proc; +175 damage per Baron Aureus' set item worn
Set Bonus (Baron Aureus' Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +175 HP and +25% Crit Damage
 6+: +1.5% Crit Rate
 7+: +5% All Resistances
 8+: +1 Tiers of 'Keen Eyes'
 9+: +25% Acid Resistance, +10% Holy Resistance, -10% Fire Resistance and -35% Dark Resistance
e.baron-aureus-fowl.description: An absolutely divine creature, you almost feel bad fitting a saddle onto this willing, noble beast. At the very least, the quality of the saddle seems to do its benevolence justice.

a.yagnatz.name: Yagnatz
a.yagnatz.description:
"Be strong, like lightning. Not loud, like thunder."
-Yagnatz
a.yagnatz.effects: Conducive Powers: 4% chance to proc 50,000 Lightning damage; 6% chance to proc 10,000 Lightning damage and give the Player +5% Evasion on that proc; +10 Attack to Knimbag Glasser in the active Formation; Adds +5 Attack and +0.3 Defence to each Capricious Carter in the Formation

u.blue-brewmasters-satchel.name: Blue Brewmaster's Satchel
u.blue-brewmasters-satchel.description: An incredibly well-stocked satchel, clearly belonging to a brewmaster, and containing a mystery potion.
u.blue-brewmasters-satchel.effects: Open to obtain its contents (three of the chance drops)

c.yellow-explosive-stinger.name: Yellow Explosive Stinger
c.yellow-explosive-stinger.description: Notwithstanding the size and colour of this appendage, the fact that it can deliver both venom and an explosive blast leaves you hesitant about handling it!

u.mystery-troop-draft-poster-ii.name: Mystery Troop Draft Poster II
u.mystery-troop-draft-poster-ii.description: Used to draft Troops to your cause.

e.leoegan-greaves.name: Leoegan Greaves
e.leoegan-greaves.effects:
By the Gods (Greaves): 6% chance to proc 500 Physical damage
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.leoegan-greaves.description: IX. Disheartened, Paython left the temple, bitter in his being scorned by the Gods, and questioning his worth when his father still refused to even acknowledge his existence.

m.distracting-charm.name: Distracting Charm
m.distracting-charm.description:
"You can't honestly expect me to believe that pulling that thing out in the middle of a fight, and chanting some unintelligible garble, is going to help me defeat these monstrosities...."
-Incredulous conversations with Alanis
m.distracting-charm.effects: Distracting Charm: 4% chance to proc [4-40]% Psychic damage

a.throng-footman.name: Throng Footman
a.throng-footman.description:
"Workwork and pushpush, just sendsend us to the frontfront."
-Throng Footman

m.lesser-sanctuary.name: Lesser Sanctuary
m.lesser-sanctuary.description:
"Blessings upon the earth, the waters and the skies, for all are bathed in the warm, morning light of Dhoesis. May his protections extend to you and yours alike."
-Prayer of Protection to the Morning Sun
m.lesser-sanctuary.effects: Lesser Sanctuary: 25% chance to proc [up-to-12]% Holy damage; 100% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 16%

c.thinned-brew-of-toxins.name: Thinned Brew of Toxins
c.thinned-brew-of-toxins.description: You patiently wait, letting death's pitch wings, bearing endless sleep, spread over you.

c.acheralan-skull.name: Acheralan Skull
c.acheralan-skull.description: The damaged skull of a poor Acheralan citizen, kept as a trophy by a hungry Hill Troll.

c.violet-gargouille-horn.name: Violet Gargouille Horn
c.violet-gargouille-horn.description: You have several questions about the colouration of these horns, but no-one seems to have heard any good justification for it. Perhaps it's just as well, with the creature already being dispatched and all.

e.cave-cragsman-boots.name: Cave Cragsman Boots
e.cave-cragsman-boots.effects:
+18 Max HP
Set Bonus (Cave Cragsman Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +2 Tiers of 'Defensive Rider - Terrestrial' and +2 Tiers of 'Mount Proficiency - Terrestrial'
e.cave-cragsman-boots.description: If the aim of the game is speed, these boots are not going to be seeing you onto the winner's podium... But if you ever need to scale that podium, these could certainly do the trick.

e.chiffon-staff.name: Chiffon Staff
e.chiffon-staff.effects:
Downy Delight (Staff): 40% chance to proc 255 Holy damage; +3,750 damage vs Guild Raids; +90 damage per Chiffon set item worn; 1% chance to heal the Player 5 HP
Set Bonus (Chiffon Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +4% All Resistances; 1% chance to heal the Player 3 HP
e.chiffon-staff.description: I(b). Helci Kindspan had always felt some connection with nature, but in recognition that she needed to live her life had repressed those feelings for many years. She felt largely contented, with a caring, supporting husband who could provide for her, and an inquisitive, if odd, son, she thought she had everything she would need in life... Until The Calling returned, stronger than ever before.

e.griphornis-beak.name: Griphornis Beak
e.griphornis-beak.effects:
Pennaceous Plumage (Helm): 8% chance to proc 2900 Physical damage; +18750 damage vs Guild Raids; +450 damage per Griphornis set item worn
Set Bonus (Griphornis Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +70% Crit Damage
e.griphornis-beak.description: III(b). "You'll get what you're owed, but not by cheating me out of it. I've said I'll pay ya', and I make good on my word, ya' flamin' goat-skinned milksop." Helmo took a step back, opposed only by the slightly-slenderer male dwarf, but a swift kick of his chair into the dwarf's chest left him enough room to weave by him and back onto the street.

e.plain-leather-gloves.name: Plain Leather Gloves
e.plain-leather-gloves.description: Simple leather gloves may not offer the best protection, but at least it helps keep out the cold.

u.tedupevair-bag.name: Tedupevair Bag
u.tedupevair-bag.description: A seemingly simple pouch, but upon closer inspection the ornate stitching suggests a masterfully intricate pattern. Clearly there is more value to this bag than a casual glance would suggest.

e.capricious-conducer-shield.name: Capricious Conducer Shield
e.capricious-conducer-shield.effects:
Conducive Conductivity (Shield): 10% chance to proc 1,100 Lightning damage; +550 damage per Capricious Conducer set item worn; +3% All Resistances; +50 HP
Set Bonus (Capricious Conducer Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1% Evasion
 6: +1.5% Crit Rate and +15% Crit Damage
 7+: +6% All Resistances
 8+: 2% chance to proc 10,000 Lightning damage and give +50% Evasion on that proc
 9+: +8% All Resistances and 6% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 50%
e.capricious-conducer-shield.description:
"See, the energy from the attack will flow through these... 'glass bits', as you call them, and use the energy from that attack to protect you from the next. It's very technical, but I made it as simple for you to use as I could manage."
-Knimbag Glasser

e.bolting-fiddler-carapace.name: Bolting Fiddler Carapace
e.bolting-fiddler-carapace.effects:
Shock and Slice (Carapace): 4% chance to proc 4900 Physical damage; +62500 damage vs Guild Raids; +950 damage per Bolting Fiddler set item worn; 40% chance to proc 625 Physical damage; +125 damage per Bolting Fiddler set item worn; 25% chance to proc 400 Lightning damage; +150 damage per Bolting Fiddler set item worn
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion

a.mending-guild-guardian.name: Mending Guild Guardian
a.mending-guild-guardian.description: Despite one's best efforts, every battle is bound to have some casualties and wounded; this guardian focuses upon assisting the injured, allowing them to rejoin combat all the sooner.

a.morth-longtrek.name: Morth Longtrek
a.morth-longtrek.description: A citizen of the Slathage Empire, Morth has considerable experience ranging into these foothills, and through a number of forested areas, where he brings wealthier nobles' relatives and sons to play at adventuring... For a steep price. He has not expressed any strong opinions about you, though you suspect he is considering how to earn the most money through your shared dealings.
a.morth-longtrek.effects: Gaudy Guiding: 5% chance to proc 10,000 Physical damage; +2,000 damage vs Beast raids; Adds +5 Attack and +0.2 Defence to each Haleahn Cicerone in the Formation

e.raid-crossbow.name: Raid Crossbow
e.raid-crossbow.effects: Allethrin Assault: 12% chance to proc 90 Acid damage; +1% Crit Rate; +2% Crit Damage
e.raid-crossbow.description:
"Ah, yes, that weapon should fare well in annihilating the arthropodic menace; it'll kill the bug right dead."
-Ailmar Perjeon

a.fungus-finder.name: Fungus Finder
a.fungus-finder.description: Capable of sniffing out the tastiest fungi, these Goblins have enough endurance to travel a whole day in search of the ripest produce.

cp.rogue-starter-pack-i.name: Rogue Starter Pack I
cp.rogue-starter-pack-i.description: A pack providing the necessary goods for every budding rogue.

e.mirgoda-fur-helm.name: Mirgoda Fur Helm
e.mirgoda-fur-helm.effects:
Fetid Furs (Helm): 25% chance to proc 200 Physical damage; +150 damage per Mirgoda Fur set item worn; +20 HP; +5% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Mirgoda Fur Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +2% Crit Rate
 6+: +5% All Resistances
 8+: +80 HP and +10% Ice Resistance
 9+: +5% All Resistances and -10% Formation Bonus
e.mirgoda-fur-helm.description: Perhaps the warmest helm you've ever worn, and one that doesn't deafen you, getting past the smell will take some work.

u.nobles-appreciation.name: Noble's Appreciation
u.nobles-appreciation.description: Earning the favour of the nobles can yield lavish rewards.

c.firestone.name: Firestone
c.firestone.description: This stone radiates an enormous degree of magical heat. Even in these northern wastes, it could keep a small batallion warm for weeks!

e.frostwarden-armament.name: Frostwarden Armament
e.frostwarden-armament.effects:
Arctic Aegis (Armament): 10% chance to proc 600 Ice damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 18%; +50 Ice damage per Frostwarden set item worn
Set Bonus (Frostwarden Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: 20% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 25%
e.frostwarden-armament.description: You can't help but admire the simplicity of the Frostwarden's sigil... Well, at least you thought you couldn't, up until you mentioned it to Aisi and got an earful about how wrong your assumptions about that sigil were. Your only relief came when you noticed Alanis was not around to hear you get chewed out.

c.tedupevair-insignia.name: Tedupevair Insignia
c.tedupevair-insignia.description: The insignia of the Tedupevair is likely worth a lot, to the right buyer.

a.repentant-dusk-blade.name: Repentant Dusk Blade
a.repentant-dusk-blade.description:
"Sir Tybalt was a great leader and a noble man, but his refusal to seek supplication or to atone for the wrongs he had committed - not that he had done great wrongs! - was weakening both his position and his faith."
-Sar Qina
a.repentant-dusk-blade.effects: Adds +9 Attack to Sar Qina of the Repentant Dusk in the active Formation

e.cultists-runic-mark.name: Cultists' Runic Mark
e.cultists-runic-mark.effects:
Dark Ritual (Mark): 5% chance to proc 400 Dark damage; +100 Dark damage vs Human raids; +6% Dark Resistance
Set Bonus (Cultist's Runic Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +1 Tiers of 'Arcane Defence - Venom'
e.cultists-runic-mark.description:
VI. "Well, this isn't the first time we've seen one of those creatures, nor is it the first time they seem to be involved with dragons. If you're willing to listen, as gratitude for your aid, and as apology for my behaviour, I'd like to explain what little we know."

-Conversations with Seksehsa

a.cryomancers-novice.name: Cryomancer's Novice
a.cryomancers-novice.description: Having spent years of study under Glaciver, his Novice pupils are sent out into the world to further hone their skills, before returning for further tutelage.

e.zaratans-shell.name: Zaratan's Shell
e.zaratans-shell.effects:
Debris Volley (Shell): 15% chance to proc 800 Nature damage; +40 damage per Zaratan set item worn; +40 Health
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.zaratans-shell.description:
"It may come as a surprise to someone as calloused as you, but the impenetrable carapace of a Zaratan is actually part of its body, and not simply a removable frame."
-Janagud

e.byramaster-crafter-gloves.name: Byramaster Crafter Gloves
e.byramaster-crafter-gloves.effects:
Legendary Lager (Gloves): 24% chance to proc 450 Nature damage; +100 damage per Byramaster Crafter set item worn; +30 HP; 2% chance to proc 2,000 Nature damage and add +5% Evasion and +2.5% Crit Rate to that attack
Set Bonus (Byramaster Crafter Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +50 HP
 7+: 4% chance to proc 5,000 Nature damage and add +10% Evasion and add +10% Crit Rate
 9+: +15% Nature Resistance and +15% Psychic Resistance
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.byramaster-crafter-gloves.description:
"You are free to try tasting the product, but between the yeast and the heat, don't expect your finger to survive the folly."
-Varna Heartybrewer

e.viscous-viscount-shield.name: Viscous Viscount Shield
e.viscous-viscount-shield.effects:
Eccentric Ennoblement (Shield): 12% chance to proc 700 Acid damage; +350 damage per Viscous Viscount set item worn; 4% chance to proc 3,300 Acid damage; +400 damage per Viscous Viscount set item worn; +50 HP; +100 Magic
Set Bonus (Viscous Viscount Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1.5% Crit Rate
 6+: +10% Crit Damage
 8+: +150 HP
 9+: Additional Bonuses depending on Mount equipped
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.viscous-viscount-shield.description: The acid burns on this otherwise-ornate shield leave you wondering whether this has actually been used as a combat tool, or whether it has only seen use as a placeholder in Aelric's laboratory.

u.foaming-potion-of-valour.name: Foaming Potion of Valour
u.foaming-potion-of-valour.description: V. With the assistance of Shou Royce's concoction, Guraldo would go on to become one of the finest Paladins of his Order, never feeling shame in starting his days off with a small sip of elixir to steel his nerves.
u.foaming-potion-of-valour.effects: +15% Offence vs Guild Raids for 8 hours

a.natures-revenge.name: Nature's Revenge
a.natures-revenge.description: It is perhaps fitting that a being of the sea is available to seek revenge on behalf of the land, but you quickly realize that nature would include the oceans, as well.
a.natures-revenge.effects: Adds +10 Attack to Brocck of the Revolt in the active Formation

a.sir-tybalt-of-the-heroic-dusk.name: Sir Tybalt of the Heroic Dusk
a.sir-tybalt-of-the-heroic-dusk.description: A true-and-anointed knight, Sir Tybalt's deeds have led to him gathering quite a significant following, which he in turn drafted into his Order of the Heroic Dusk. By his claims, he aims to bring evil and injustice to its dusk, and he has agreed to follow your command in seeing his mission through.
a.sir-tybalt-of-the-heroic-dusk.effects: Blade of the Heroic Dusk: 25% chance to proc 4,700 Physical damage; +500 damage per Heroic Dusk set item, Magic and Formation owned; Adds +6 Attack and +0.7 Defence to each Heroic Dusk Striker and Heroic Dusk Mage in the Formation; Gains +3.5 Attack and +0.1 Defence per distinct Heroic Dusk set item and Formation owned

a.luminarara.name: Luminarara
a.luminarara.description: You thought you had met eccentric individuals before, but nothing could have prepared you for this 'Rara'. Speaking in a commanding tone, and apparently expecting everyone around her to follow her directions immediately and precisely, Luminarara's directives feel utterly scattered and without sense, and you fear that she is simply speaking the first things that come into her mind at any moment. However, as you gaze upon her attire, and of her prized 'shell collection', you suppose that there might actually be some inkling of genius behind those piercing eyes and upturned nose.
a.luminarara.effects: Trendmaker: 18% chance to proc 2,000 Magic damage; +500 damage per Gipantan Poser in the active Formation; 14% chance to proc 2,000 Physical damage; +500 damage per Gipantan Couturier in the active Formation; Adds +7 Attack to each Gipantan Poser or Gipantan Couturier in the Formation

e.song-of-radiance-pants.name: Song of Radiance Pants
e.song-of-radiance-pants.effects:
Brilliant Song (Pants): 24% chance to proc 400 Magic damage; +75 damage per Song of Radiance set item worn; +40 Magic; +2% Magic Resistance
Set Bonus (Song of Radiance Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +1500 Magic and +1 Tiers of 'Arcane Unveiling'
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.song-of-radiance-pants.description: The ornate workings on these pants appear to mimic the Songbird of Radiance's splendor, though you'd agree that it falls short of the living creature.

c.rhona-hewson-attack-boost-i.name: Rhona Hewson Attack Boost I
c.rhona-hewson-attack-boost-i.description: A demonstration of her passion - and of her newfound self-control - goes a long way. Passively boosts Rhona's Attack by +10 (Max 2).

e.rara-shell-collection-rod.name: Rara Shell Collection Rod
e.rara-shell-collection-rod.effects:
Fabulous, Darling! (Rod): 5% chance to proc 3,000 Nature damage; +1,000 damage per Rara Shell Collection set item worn; +1% Crit Rate; +15% Crit Damage; 20% chance to proc 200 Physical damage and add +5% Crit Rate
Set Bonus (Rara Shell Collection Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1% Evasion and +300 Magic
 6+: +5 Tiers of 'Nimble Defensive Training'
 7+: +4 Tiers of 'Evasive Maneuvers' and +1 Tier of 'Advanced Evasive Maneuvers'
 8+: +1% Evasion and 24% chance to proc 2,000 Nature damage vs Aquatic raids
e.rara-shell-collection-rod.description:
"Project strength. No, stronger. Stro-onger. Nope, too strong, reel it back, darling."
-Luminarara

c.retractable-spyglass.name: Retractable Spyglass
c.retractable-spyglass.description: The ability to see great distances at sea is vital in terms of both navigation, and avoiding problematic encounters. An extra hour's notice of coming storm clouds, or of an enemy vessel, can be the difference of life, or watery death.

e.chaunaths-warpriests-pact.name: Chaunath's Warpriests Pact
e.chaunaths-warpriests-pact.effects:
Shield of Deities (Pact): 16% chance to proc 1,000 Magic damage and add +10% Crit Damage on that proc; +375 damage per Chaunath's Warpriests set item worn; +0.5% Crit Rate
Sanctified

 5+: 5% chance on 20x attacks to heal each active Troop +1 Reserve
 6+: +2% Crit Rate and +15% Crit Damage

e.chaunaths-warpriests-pact.description: You're finding more and more ways to commit yourself to various deities, though at least the cause championed by Chaunath is one of the noblest you've heard.

e.burnet-tights.name: Burnet Tights
e.burnet-tights.effects:
Pixie Soot (Tights): 24% chance to proc 400 Magic damage; +60 Magic
Set Bonus (Burnet Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +7% Evasion
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.burnet-tights.description: It is not particularly common for Burnet Pixies to enthrall mortal beings, but those that are enslaved are often the most strongly devoted to their captors; whether this is our of fear, adoration or another emotion isn't entirely clear.

u.snake-whistle.name: Snake Whistle
u.snake-whistle.description: A strange whistle, producing frequencies beyond human hearing, but devastating to serpents in close proximity.
u.snake-whistle.effects: Deals 6,000 Physical damage to Naga Risaldar

e.praetoran-gloves.name: Praetoran Gloves
e.praetoran-gloves.effects:
Praetoran Modesty (Gloves): 16% chance to proc 650 Nature damage; +50 damage per Praetoran set item worn
Set Bonus (Praetoran Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +40% Crit Damage and +1 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Fire'
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.praetoran-gloves.description: When you're spending days grabbing slippery, spine-covered and wet fish, you need to have gloves that are up to the task.

e.servids-tail-rod.name: Servid's Tail Rod
e.servids-tail-rod.effects: Servid's Service (Tail Rod): 32% chance to proc 45 Magic damage; +625 damage vs Guild Raids; +10 damage per Servid set item worn
e.servids-tail-rod.description: VI. His father granted Brath exceptional leeway when it came to his forays into the woods, but still insisted that Brath spend a period of time each day learning how to read and write, though this often resulted in full-blown fits by Brath, knocking items over and breaking small objects. Fortunately,

e.nakanos-kabuto.name: Nakano's Kabuto
e.nakanos-kabuto.effects:
Set Bonus (Nakano Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +75 Offence, +2% Evasion and +2% Crit Rate
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.nakanos-kabuto.description: I. Nakano, raised in the illustrious Hitsugi household, knew her upbringing was different from the girls of other households. Despite her father strictly adhering to tradition in virtually every other aspect of his life, he could never turn down a heartfelt request from his daughter, and when she declared that she intended to take up the blade and train as the other samurai students would.

e.shudder-sailors-breeches.name: Shudder Sailor's Breeches
e.shudder-sailors-breeches.effects:
Clooney's Consent (Breeches): 20% chance to proc 125 Dark damage; +25 damage per Shudder Sailor's set item worn; +7% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Shudder Sailor's Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: 20% chance to proc 500 Physical damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 20%
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.shudder-sailors-breeches.description:
"Alas, what good is it to be a famous sailor if I cannot pursue the love of my life?"

"Really, Captain? Firstly, you probably mean 'infamous pirate'. Secondly, you pursue whatever you seem to please. Thirdly, you have a new love of your life every other week!"

-Conversations with the crew of the Vengeance

c.violet-horsebrush.name: Violet Horsebrush
c.violet-horsebrush.description: The fine handle and strong bristles on this brush are clearly intended for use with an equally fine stallion.

a.scolfield-footman.name: Scolfield Footman
a.scolfield-footman.description: While they may wear the guise of a proper lady's retainer, these strapping servants need to attend to all of their mistress' needs, ranging from laundering soiled clothes to laming another would-be assassin.
a.scolfield-footman.effects: Adds +2 to Player Energy per occupied Troop slot

c.golden-goblet.name: Golden Goblet
c.golden-goblet.description: The symbolism of the goblet has expanded, particularly in the Republic, to signify status and value, and is viewed by some to have been co-opted by the upper classes. However, for one to not only earn a goblet of this caliber, but to proudly display it, is the mark of a true master in their craft... Or a heady fool who has little idea of what they are doing.

dy.gold-dye-vial.name: Gold Dye Vial
dy.gold-dye-vial.description: A vial of colourful dye that can magically improve the appeal of your equipment!

e.laurentian-mask.name: Laurentian Mask
e.laurentian-mask.effects: Powerless Prey (Mask): 45% chance to proc 120 Dark damage; +850 damage versus Human raids; +4% Psychic Resistance
e.laurentian-mask.description:
"I'm the thing these monsters have nightmares about, and you and I are about to show 'em why."
-Corovar

a.ailmar-perjeon.name: Ailmar Perjeon
a.ailmar-perjeon.description: Despite his somewhat alien appearance behind that hooded mask, Ailmar's tone of voice is quite calming and soothing. You can even hear the pain in his voice when discussing tactics relating to the giant, explosive insects, barely suppressing his resolve to euthanize a problematic brood.
a.ailmar-perjeon.effects: Keeper's Solution: 25% chance to proc 320 Acid damage vs Insect raids

a.numees-ranger.name: Numees Ranger
a.numees-ranger.description:
"We know this land well, but like each of us she grows and changes over times. Ranging to uncover her latest secrets is a sacred tradition."
-Kitchi Wayguard
a.numees-ranger.effects: Adds +5 Attack to Kitchi Wayguard and Takhi Wawetseka in the active Formation

a.stone-spinner.name: Stone Spinner
a.stone-spinner.description: Of all the artificial beings one could create, you've no idea why someone would decide to make giant arachnids capable of weaving stone thread.

e.vildmand-platefur-chestpiece.name: Vildmand Platefur Chestpiece
e.vildmand-platefur-chestpiece.effects:
Armored And Algid (Chestpiece): 10% chance to proc 300 Physical damage; +400 damage per Vildmand Platefur set item worn; +4% Ice Resistance; 5% chance to proc 400 Physical damage and add +2,000 Defence
Set Bonus (Vildmand Platefur Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1.5% Crit Rate and +10% Crit Damage
 6+: +10% Ice Resistance
 7+: +100 HP and +2,000 Defence
 8+: 5% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 20%
 9+: +30% Crit Damage and 75% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 5%
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.vildmand-platefur-chestpiece.description: Surprisingly well constructed, you lose virtually no range of motion in this armor, and it seems capable of keeping you warm, too.

u.jug-of-mystery-elixir.name: Jug of Mystery Elixir
u.jug-of-mystery-elixir.description:
"Please, I understand why you'd think that drinking this strange mixture would be good, but I implore you, let me at least chec-"

"Nonsense! You go ahead, good hero, and be sure to drink it all down, yes? The burning means it's working, n'est-ce pas?"
-Conversations with Nphireo and Mamaloll.
u.jug-of-mystery-elixir.effects: Open to obtain its contents (three of the following)

e.medzeh-hinderer.name: Medzeh Hinderer
e.medzeh-hinderer.effects:
Jackal Watcher (Hinderer): 20% chance to proc 1,250 Physical damage; 4% chance to proc 5,000 Holy damage; +2.5% Crit Rate; +40% Crit Damage; +10% Dark Resistance
Consecrated
Set Bonus (Medzeh Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +2% Crit Rate and +25% Crit Damage
 8+: +4% Evasion and a 1% chance to heal the Player 2 HP
e.medzeh-hinderer.description:
"Ever since his passing, I have striven to follow in his footsteps... With you at our side, I believe we can, once more, successfully push back the demon."
-Apui

u.red-brewers-satchel.name: Red Brewer's Satchel
u.red-brewers-satchel.description: A satchel from a talented brewer, containing a mystery potion.

c.blue-xaphegorgh-claws.name: Blue Xaphegorgh Claws
c.blue-xaphegorgh-claws.description: You can almost feel the evil of the commander within its harvested claws, and the essences of the lives it had taken. Hopefully you can use this to find a way to stop this demonic incursion.

ba.daring-corsair-banner.name: Daring Corsair Banner
ba.daring-corsair-banner.description: Obtained with the Daring Corsair Class

e.onishaygu-seedling-pants.name: Onishaygu Seedling Pants
e.onishaygu-seedling-pants.effects:
Young Sprout (Pants): 12% chance to proc 100 Nature damage; +50 Nature damage per Onishaygu Seedling set item worn; +30 Energy; +10 HP
Set Bonus (Onishaygu Seedling Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 8+: +30 Vitality and +30 Honour
 9+: +50 Energy
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.onishaygu-seedling-pants.description:
"Safeguarding the future meansss granting it the freedom it requiresss to grow."
-Aaja Orisha

e.zaratans-guard.name: Zaratan's Guard
e.zaratans-guard.effects: Debris Volley (Guard): 15% chance to proc 800 Nature damage; +40 damage per Zaratan set item worn
e.zaratans-guard.description:
"It has been said that the defence of the Zaratan is utterly impregnable. Given that you have that shield, this could not be the case."
-Janagud

m.atonedusk.name: Atonedusk
m.atonedusk.description:
"Proper form and emotion are as important to crafting and casting magics as academic study. Owing to the purity of our repentance, I have been able to far surpass what we could perform under Sir Tybalt. I pray we may be of aid to you in your quest."
-Sar Qina
m.atonedusk.effects: Atonedusk: 6% chance to proc [up-to-130]% Ice damage, plus 1,250 Ice damage; +5% Ice damage for each distinct Repentant Dusk set item, Commander, or Troop owned; 20% chance to proc 2,000 Ice damage and give +10% damage from any Ice damage on that proc

e.snowdrake-slayer-boots.name: Snowdrake Slayer Boots
e.snowdrake-slayer-boots.effects:
Walking in a Winter Wasteland (Boots): 10% chance to proc 400 Physical damage; +1,250 damage vs Winter raids; +750 damage vs Dragon raids; +5% Ice Resistance; +75 damage per Snowdrake Slayer set item worn
Set Bonus (Snowdrake Slayer Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +2% Crit Rate and +30% Crit Damage
e.snowdrake-slayer-boots.description: Boots thick enough to provide warms, and sturdy enough to traipse through the snow and sleet.

c.thick-bound-cloth.name: Thick-bound Cloth
c.thick-bound-cloth.description: Cloth thick enough to insulate the body, but thin enough to remain streamlined and sleek.

e.scolfields-ruby.name: Scolfield's Ruby
e.scolfields-ruby.effects:
+30 Vitality; +30 Energy; +30 Honor
Set Bonus (Scolfield Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1 Tiers of 'Discerning Vision', 'Astute Observation' and 'Precise Inspection'
 9+: +1 Tiers of 'Discerning Vision', 'Astute Observation' and 'Precise Inspection'
e.scolfields-ruby.description:
"Oh, this bauble? It is a family heirloom, and that is the only reason I still wear something of such lowborn value and tastes."
-Lady Josian Scolfield

c.macoli-peppers.name: Macoli Peppers
c.macoli-peppers.description: You thought these vegetables seemed a little odd, and noticed Alanis and Araceli both smirking slightly when you bit into one. After a few moments, you understood why.

u.platinum-third-eye-tonic.name: Platinum Third Eye Tonic
u.platinum-third-eye-tonic.description: It is said that all perception starts not with the eyes on your face, but by the concentration of energy forming your innate third eye. Whether the Gods would agree with such a self-serving explanation or not remains to be seen, but you do enjoy the prospect of noticing those minute details of the world around you.
u.platinum-third-eye-tonic.effects: Increases Attentive Perception and Eye for Beauty tiers by +3 for 2 hours

c.frigidara-defenders-frigidara-defence-.name: Frigidara Defenders Frigidara Defence Boost I
c.frigidara-defenders-frigidara-defence-.description: A longtime veteran in pushing back the snowdrake queen, and this experience shines through. Passively boosts all Veteran Frigidara Defenders’ Attack by +5 and Defence by +0.5 (Max 1).

e.valley-verdure-chest.name: Valley Verdure Chest
e.valley-verdure-chest.effects:

Set Bonus (Valley Verdure Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +500 Magic
 6+: +2% Crit Rate and +10% Crit Damage
e.valley-verdure-chest.description:
"Camo-what now? I just thought it looked pretty..."
-Murrlix

e.crestaceo-claws.name: Crestaceo Claws
e.crestaceo-claws.effects:

Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.crestaceo-claws.description: III. The boys' father was a stoic man, but a hard working one, who would spend long hours at sea fishing to make ends meet for the family, and to put dinner on the table. It wasn't unusual for him to be away for days at a time, but he would always return, if somewhat weary and worn.

u.parchment-of-primeval-fear.name: Parchment of Primeval Fear
u.parchment-of-primeval-fear.description: A scroll that contains a wedge of fear, waiting for you to drive it into your unsuspecting foes.

u.diplomat-starter-pack-ii.name: Diplomat Starter Pack II
u.diplomat-starter-pack-ii.description: A pack providing the necessary tools for every budding diplomat.

c.violet-vildmand-champions-mark.name: Violet Vildmand Champion's Mark
c.violet-vildmand-champions-mark.description: While you initially thought these marks would be collected by the tribal leaders, it seems the champions of various battles or feats are distinctly honoured amongst these hill tribes.

a.chandler-deacon.name: Chandler Deacon
a.chandler-deacon.description:
"Notwithstanding this... interesting fellowship, you haven't seen a brightly coloured cornucopia of heretics come by recently, have you?"
-Chandler Deacon
a.chandler-deacon.effects: Adds +0.1 Defence to Raurous Fourfury and Gagran Blightsbane in the active Formation

c.gold-silked-chrysalis.name: Gold-Silked Chrysalis
c.gold-silked-chrysalis.description: If it isn't snakes and spiders, it's bugs and other crawly things. And then they leave behind these sticky- Oooh, that is shiny. Maybe it's not so bad.

m.psychic-repulse.name: Psychic Repulse
m.psychic-repulse.description: After observing Banefre's slow, shuddering movements, coupled with his weak frame, you were curious about his stated role as a front-line fighter capable of protecting his allies. However, when you approached him unannounced to inquire and were knocked back several feet by a seemingly-automated, invisible shield, you realized you had your answer.
m.psychic-repulse.effects: Psychic Repulse: 50% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by [up-to-40]% and deal 47 Psychic damage

u.orange-fury-tonic.name: Orange Fury Tonic
u.orange-fury-tonic.description: There is something soothingly simple about a potion that fires up your fervor and titillates your temper...

e.serpents-eye.name: Serpent's Eye
e.serpents-eye.effects: Ringhals Spray: 5% chance to proc 140 Poison damage
e.serpents-eye.description: Glaring in its poignant, green way, this ring demonstrates that looks can, in fact, potentially kill....

e.blazebrand-garnet.name: Blazebrand Garnet
e.blazebrand-garnet.effects:
