e.blazebrand-garnet.description: A brilliant gem, if not particularly large. The way the light dances through it looks similar to flames burning within it.

u.green-guild-kit-iv.name: Green Guild Kit IV
u.green-guild-kit-iv.description: A small, tidy sack, purporting to carry goods from the same source Slygse gets her alchemical wares.
u.green-guild-kit-iv.effects: Open to obtain its contents (two of the chance drops)

u.platinum-guard-tonic.name: Platinum Guard Tonic
u.platinum-guard-tonic.description: Originally concocted to keep him safe during his forays into the forest, Nphireo was oblivious to his creation's market-potential until a friend saw an ogre break a club harmlessly over Nphireo's head.

e.crusherclaw-warhammer.name: Crusherclaw Warhammer
e.crusherclaw-warhammer.effects:
Pressure Crush (Warhammer): 5% chance to proc 2,200 Physical damage; +30,000 damage vs Guild Raids; +700 damage per Crusherclaw set item worn; +200 HP
Set Bonus (Crusherclaw Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +0.5 Formation Protection Value
e.crusherclaw-warhammer.description: I(a). The Hero of Hammerclaw was the title given to a traveling stranger who voyaged along the Dolmtaalian coastline, protecting the people and staving off various monsters. Little was known about his origin, and save for some recurring issues he had with Laetrie church he was known to receive universal acceptance in whatever land he found himself.

e.friskfingers-stone.name: Friskfingers Stone
e.friskfingers-stone.effects:
Rapid Robbery (Stone): 5% chance to proc 2,000 Physical damage; +1,250 damage per Friskfingers set item worn; +10 HP; +10% Crit Damage; +30 Honor
Set Bonus (Friskfingers Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1.5% Crit Rate, +30 Honor and +2 Tiers of 'Spare Change'
 6+: +3 Tiers of 'Spare Change' and +60 Vitality
 7+: +10% Crit Damage and +1 Tiers of 'Keen Eyes'
 8+: +50 Vitality, +3 Tiers of 'Vulnerability Spotter - Pursuer' and +3 Tiers of 'Vulnerability Spotter - Elusive'
 9+: +50 Vitality, +1 Tiers of 'Keen Eyes' and +5 Tiers of 'Spare Change'
e.friskfingers-stone.description:
"As tempting though it may seem, please refrain from trying to throw that magical item at your foe's head."
-Heren Luckyboot

e.cumberworld-benefactors-wand.name: Cumberworld Benefactor's Wand
e.cumberworld-benefactors-wand.effects:
+50 Vitality; +50 Energy; +50 Honor
Set Bonus (Cumberworld Benefactor Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1 Tiers of 'Discerning Vision', 'Astute Observation' and 'Precise Inspection'
 7+: +1 Tiers of 'Keen Eyes'
 8+: +100 Energy
 9+: +1 Tiers of 'Discerning Vision', 'Astute Observation' and 'Precise Inspection'
e.cumberworld-benefactors-wand.description: It seems the Lady's magical powers extend beyond the basics, and at least encompass the brilliant and illuminative.

c.red-fen-seedpod.name: Red Fen Seedpod
c.red-fen-seedpod.description: It is said that Fen Lure plants only produce seeds in the dead of night. You can't say whether this is true, but this is a rare find, indeed!

c.levitating-stone.name: Levitating Stone
c.levitating-stone.description: This strangely marked stone seems to slowly float out of your palm as you hold it. You wonder if it is trying to go somewhere, or simply attempting to escape you.

u.script-of-acid-rain.name: Script of Acid Rain
u.script-of-acid-rain.description: "Let your emotions flow and shed your tears! Acid Rain!"

s.scroll-greater-ent.name: Greater Tree Ent Scroll
s.scroll-greater-ent.description: Much quicker to rouse to anger than its smaller cousins, this massive arbor will frenzy if you mess around with smaller Ents.

u.thiadoran-mixed-barrel.name: Thiadoran Mixed Barrel
u.thiadoran-mixed-barrel.description: It seems someone was careless when adding bottles to this batch. You've no idea how the flavours mix, but you hope it doesn't ruin your taste for the fine vintages.

c.green-undamaged-retina.name: Green Undamaged Retina
c.green-undamaged-retina.description: Removing this thin membrane from the Watcher, undamaged, was terribly exacting. You can only hope it pays off.

e.byhew-helm.name: Byhew Helm
e.byhew-helm.effects:
Springtime Renewal (Helm): 7% chance to proc 700 Nature damage; +1,500 damage vs Winter raids
Set Bonus (Byhew Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 8+: +3% Crit Rate and +30% Crit Damage
e.byhew-helm.description: Those honoured with the armor of Byhew are minded to turn their sights to the west.

e.yotinpekew-thunderball.name: Yotinpekew Thunderball
e.yotinpekew-thunderball.effects:
Storm Scalping (Thunderball): 12% chance to proc 150 Lightning damage; +200 damage per Yotinpekew set item worn; +1% Crit Rate; +15% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Yotinpekew Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +1.5% Crit Rate
 8+: +35% Crit Damage and +0.75% Crit Rate
 9+: +1 Tiers of 'Arcane Defence - Flamebreath'
e.yotinpekew-thunderball.description: So long as this is raining down magics upon your foes, and these aren't raining down upon you, everything should be fine.

u.tricksters-elixir.name: Trickster's Elixir
u.tricksters-elixir.description: An elixir possessing the prowess of the most elusive tricksters, capable of expanding your mind to new horizons.

c.green-cannoneers-treasure-map.name: Green Cannoneer's Treasure Map
c.green-cannoneers-treasure-map.description: A map indicating buried treasure at a specific location. Maybe it's time for a detour in your adventuring path?

e.crestaceo-loop.name: Crestaceo Loop
e.crestaceo-loop.effects:
+40% Crit Damage; +1% Evasion
Set Bonus (Crusherclaw Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +0.5 Formation Protection Value
e.crestaceo-loop.description: VIII. The ensuing battle between the first Fiddler Knight and the Hero of Hammerclaw is said to have lasted for days. Despite the difference in temperaments, both were driven to enforce justice as they saw fit, and as such neither could back away from this particular combat. Some say that the original reason for the fight was forgotten minutes after the first blow was struck.

e.stevedores-trousers.name: Stevedore's Trousers
e.stevedores-trousers.effects:
+20 HP
Set Bonus (Stevedore's Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +5% All Resistances
 8+: +5% All Resistances
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.stevedores-trousers.description: Practical and lightweight, these pants seem to be both water-resistant and comfortable.

k.polycapitation.name: Polycapitation
k.polycapitation.description: Your talent for hewing down multiple limbs, necks and tentacles have coalesced into this radical skill.
k.polycapitation.effects: An attack designed to target many-limbed creatures. Deals a 20x Nature-type attack to the Raid, but deals 4x the damage, and a bonus (10x Strength) damage if the Raid has the Multistrike Raid Ability.

e.derangement-darts.name: Derangement Darts
e.derangement-darts.effects: Destructive Distraction: 100% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 20% during this attack
e.derangement-darts.description: The resourceful mercenary plans for the unexpected, and knows that not every raid will go as they expect. Having a backup plan, and the tools to carry it out (even when it involves backing out entirely) is a necessity in that line of work.

e.mestari-dragonslayer-red.name: Mestari Dragonslayer - Red
e.mestari-dragonslayer-red.effects: Divine Red Empowerment: 40% chance to proc 200 Holy damage
e.mestari-dragonslayer-red.description: The divine radiance of this blade glows even more brilliantly after you had that Dragonslayer gem forged into it. While it still feels somehow incomplete, it somehow still leaves you feeling… whole.

e.torn-snakeskin-breeches.name: Torn Snakeskin Breeches
e.torn-snakeskin-breeches.description: These pants are easy to put on, but not as concealing as you'd typically prefer... and that's before you consider that they are already torn!

c.green-snakeweed.name: Green Snakeweed
c.green-snakeweed.description: In spite of Seksehsa's explanation that Naga can consume this to settle an uneasy stomach, the strange look of the eyes after consuming it, and the eagerness to chew on it, leaves room for suspicion.

e.duty-collectors-shield.name: Duty Collector's Shield
e.duty-collectors-shield.effects:
Duties Owed (Shield): 22% chance to proc 140 Psychic damage
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.duty-collectors-shield.description:
"Surely there is no need to walk around with a shield of that size! Are you expecting to block cannon fire?!"

"If you've spent any time on these docks, adventurer, you'd know there are far worse things to fear than mere cannons."
-Conversations with a Wharf Duty Collector

u.parchment-of-branch-strike.name: Parchment of Branch Strike
u.parchment-of-branch-strike.description: A bristled scroll, sporting several grass stains!

p.stat-leadership.name: Leadership Stat Point
p.stat-leadership.description: Stat Point for the Leadership Stat

c.arcane-dust.name: Arcane Dust
c.arcane-dust.description: You aren't sure what the mage was intending to use this for, but you can sure find some use for it.

a.gagran-blightsbane.name: Gagran Blightsbane
a.gagran-blightsbane.description:
"Ah, the church is great! Spreading the word of Laetrie and purifying the land, what more could you ask for? Scrawny though you may be, you'd probably do well with us... I'd even be willing to give you some one-on-one lessons, to bring you up to speed..."
-Gagran Blightsbane
a.gagran-blightsbane.effects: Divine Domineering: 4% chance to proc 8,000 Holy damage; +7,000 damage vs Undead raids; 30% chance to proc 2,000 Dark damage vs Easy raids and proc 3,000 Dark damage vs raids with Breath of Death; Adds +1 Attack to each Chandler Lightbringer and Chandler Deacon in the Formation

c.ailmar-perjeon-attack-boost-i.name: Ailmar Perjeon Attack Boost I
c.ailmar-perjeon-attack-boost-i.description: A badge of merit, awarded to Ailmar for his exemplary skills as an offensive Commander. Passively boosts Ailmar's Attack by +10 (Max 2).

u.green-guild-kit-ii.name: Green Guild Kit II
u.green-guild-kit-ii.description: A small, tidy sack, purporting to carry goods from the same source Slygse gets her alchemical wares.
u.green-guild-kit-ii.effects: Open to obtain its contents (two of the chance drops)

u.parchment-of-mindscorch.name: Parchment of Mindscorch
u.parchment-of-mindscorch.description: A tattered scroll, locking away dreadfully dark secrets!

a.titanslayer-tosser.name: Titanslayer Tosser
a.titanslayer-tosser.description:
"I can' be runnin' down every critter tha' flees after being beaten down. Just send the Kylie flyin' and get back t'the battle at hand!"
-Krozana Titanslayer
a.titanslayer-tosser.effects: Adds +8 Attack to Krozana Titanslayer in the active Formation

e.bolting-fiddler-blade.name: Bolting Fiddler Blade
e.bolting-fiddler-blade.effects: Shock and Slice (Blade): 4% chance to proc 4,900 Physical damage; +62,500 damage vs Guild Raids; +950 damage per Bolting Fiddler set item worn; 40% chance to proc 625 Physical damage; +125 damage per Bolting Fiddler set item worn; 25% chance to proc 400 Lightning damage; +150 damage per Bolting Fiddler set item worn; +2% Evasion

a.dwarven-honorbound.name: Dwarven Honorbound
a.dwarven-honorbound.description: Criminals and outlaws exist amongst every race, but in dwarven culture those who have committed serious crimes are shunned by their communities and families alike, effectively banished until their honour is restored. The Honorbound are veiled to cover their shame, garbed in cloth robes that offer little protection, and wield a curved dagger alongside a weapon of their choice. They must fight to regain their honour, often relegated to menial guard tasks for years before retribution is earned, but it is worth every minute to most of them.

c.mushy-slime-brain.name: Mushy Slime Brain
c.mushy-slime-brain.description: Somehow, the brain floating within the slimy mass is even more disgusting than the slime, itself.

e.stormshapers-guide.name: Stormshapers' Guide
e.stormshapers-guide.effects:
Stormfury (Guide): 12% chance to proc 300 Lightning damage; +150 damage per Stormshapers' set item worn; 5% chance to proc 1,200 Lightning damage; +200 damage per Stormshapers' set item worn; +1% Crit Rate
Set Bonus (Stormshapers' Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: 50% chance to proc 120 Lightning damage, +5 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Lightning' and +20% Lightning Resistance
e.stormshapers-guide.description:
"Direct the storm with your mind's eye... though it can't hurt to use one of these, either."
-Thundreag Stormchest

e.mirgoda-fur-hand-crossbow.name: Mirgoda Fur Hand Crossbow
e.mirgoda-fur-hand-crossbow.effects:
Fetid Furs (Hand Crossbow): 12% chance to proc 1,000 Physical damage; +375 damage per Mirgoda Fur set item worn; +1% Crit Rate; +20% Crit Damage; 10% chance to proc 400 Physical damage and add +15% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Mirgoda Fur Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +2% Crit Rate
 6+: +5% All Resistances
 8+: +80 HP and +10% Ice Resistance
 9+: +5% All Resistances and -10% Formation Bonus
e.mirgoda-fur-hand-crossbow.description: Calling forth the powers of the mountain blizzard from the flesh and fur of the fallen beast... Maybe you'll be able to use these against those orchestrating the current events.

c.green-pickaxe.name: Green Pickaxe
c.green-pickaxe.description: A remnant of when the Dwarves actively mined near the surface of Mihr, this axe has been creatively coloured in honour of the ancestral miners.

u.script-of-flame-strike.name: Script of Flame Strike
u.script-of-flame-strike.description: "Infernal radiance, awaken and deliver your judgement! Flame Strike!"

e.fogcreeks-leather-gloves.name: Fogcreek's Leather Gloves
e.fogcreeks-leather-gloves.effects:
Set Bonus (Fogcreek Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +100 Offence and +12% Crit Damage
e.fogcreeks-leather-gloves.description: III. Tessa's father was a sinewy man, and not well adapted to the wilderness, had been unable to teach Tessa how to use a bow and arrow when she asked at a young age, so after she found a discarded crossbow she had to teach herself how to shoot on that style of weapon. While it was certainly slower and had less range than a conventional bow, Tessa took an immediate liking to the tool and honed her skills over the next few years.

c.red-nepyren-tulip.name: Red Nepyren Tulip
c.red-nepyren-tulip.description: A rare beauty, growing only on the lower slopes of the Nepyres Mountains, you can't help but wonder at the colourful petals.

e.plain-leather-boots.name: Plain Leather Boots
e.plain-leather-boots.description: Form fitted leather boots may not be fancy, but somehow it reminds you of your humble beginnings.

c.mortiday-vigil.name: Mortiday Vigil
c.mortiday-vigil.description: Apparently the celebration centers around honouring those who have passed, despite the gruesome displays.

e.tromos-latria-robes.name: Tromos Latria Robes
e.tromos-latria-robes.effects:
Returning the Damners (Robes): 25% chance to proc 200 Dark damage; +100 damage per Tromos Latria set item worn; 2% chance to proc 650 Holy damage; +700 damage per Tromos Latria set item worn; +75 Magic; +3% Holy Resistance
Set Bonus (Tromos Latria Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +5% Crit Damage, +500 Magic and -5% Formation Bonus
 7+: +1 Tiers of 'Magic Meditation' and -5% Formation Bonus
 8+: +1 Tiers of 'Protective Guardian' and -10% Formation Bonus
 9+: +3% Crit Rate and -10% Formation Bonus
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.tromos-latria-robes.description:
"Bad clothes. Bad mojo. Not enough pockets. You can keep'm."
-Weeg

e.sungreed-bullwhip.name: Sungreed Bullwhip
e.sungreed-bullwhip.effects: Sungwood Symphony (Bullwhip): 16% chance to proc 180 Physical damage; +50 damage per Sung Leather set item worn
e.sungreed-bullwhip.description: II. The Songs were said to be wordless, but rather were deep, thrumming tones, simultaneously overlaid with baritone and soprano pitches in their mellifluous ballads.

s.scroll-elven-rangers.name: Elven Rangers Scroll
s.scroll-elven-rangers.description: Some practice against an experienced group of elven trackers is never unwarranted.

c.basic-elixir-kits.name: Basic Elixir Kits
c.basic-elixir-kits.description:
"Magic isn't all about flashy fireballs and lightning bolts, and much of it comes from much humbler beginnings. Acolytes need to learn some basic skills before they can attempt the more potent skills."
-Alanis

c.red-xaphegorgh-claws.name: Red Xaphegorgh Claws
c.red-xaphegorgh-claws.description: You can almost feel the evil of the commander within its harvested claws, and the essences of the lives it had taken. Hopefully you can use this to find a way to stop this demonic incursion.

e.crusherclaw-carapace.name: Crusherclaw Carapace
e.crusherclaw-carapace.effects:
Pressure Crush (Carapace): 5% chance to proc 2200 Physical damage; +30000 damage vs Guild Raids; +700 damage per Crusherclaw set item worn
Set Bonus (Crusherclaw Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +0.5 Formation Protection Value
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.crusherclaw-carapace.description: IV(a). In the stories of his travels, most tales tell of how the Hero of Hammerclaw faced off against monstrous beasts, often originating from the sea, though occasionally from the mountains or forests surrounding rural population. That being said, it wasn't too uncommon to hear stories of how the Hero of Hammerclaw would take on bandits, or uncouth guardsmen, or even local political figures in order to enact justice for the people.

e.valley-verdure-helm.name: Valley Verdure Helm
e.valley-verdure-helm.effects:
Verdant Volley (Helm): 8% chance to proc 1,000 Nature damage; +800 damage per Valley Verdure set item worn; +50 Magic; +2% All Resistances
Set Bonus (Valley Verdure Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +500 Magic
 6+: +2% Crit Rate and +10% Crit Damage
e.valley-verdure-helm.description:
"Gotta keep the sun off your head when you're out adventuring. Oh, and don't bump it on hard things. That can hurt."
-Murrlix

a.dumvan-defender.name: Dumvan Defender
a.dumvan-defender.description: Putting on a brave face, these hardy Dumvans have put their lives on the line to protect their homes.

ru.inguruz-rune-6.name: Inguruz (inU) Rune Lv. 6
ru.inguruz-rune-6.effects:
Can provide one of the following boosts:
-+10-12 Energy (70%)
-+1-2% Formation Bonus (15%)
-+7-8% Crit Damage (10%)
-+1% Crit Rate (5%)

e.swamp-nomad-shirt.name: Swamp Nomad Shirt
e.swamp-nomad-shirt.effects:
Swamp's Thing (Shirt): 4% chance to proc 1600 Nature damage; +200 damage per Swamp Nomad's set item worn; +30 Magic; +3% Nature Resistance; +3% Poison Resistance
Set Bonus (Swamp Nomad Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +1 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Nature'
e.swamp-nomad-shirt.description: Your first impressions of the swamp nomads with their magical capabilities was that they would be adorned in lengthy robes. Having walked through the mucky terrain of the swamp, however, you can understand why they have opted for slightly more modest attire.

a.mementus.name: Mementus
a.mementus.description: A gladiator of incredible renown, Mementus has pledged that every victory he attains is at the behest of Miray, the ancient legend of the fighting pits. Even you have heard stories of Miray's heroic deeds, but had always discounted her as a legend... Until meeting Mementus, and his endless tales of her valour and fortitude.

c.whitecap-shroom.name: Whitecap Shroom
c.whitecap-shroom.description: This mushroom has a spongey feel and a grainy texture, but the flavour isn't altogether unpleasant.

e.mikoko-nokway.name: Mikoko Nokway
e.mikoko-nokway.effects:
Land's Rest (Nokway): 8% chance to proc 450 Magic damage; +1,500 damage vs Undead raids; +225 damage per Mikoko set item worn; +3% Dark Resistance
Set Bonus (Mikoko Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +25% Crit Damage
 7+: +2% Crit Rate
 8+: +10% Dark Resistance
 9+: +1 Tiers of 'Inspirational Command: Horrifying'
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.mikoko-nokway.description: Thick enough to prevent the underbrush scratching up your legs as you run, but light enough to avoid hindering you as you travel your path.

u.gold-entrancement-tonic.name: Gold Entrancement Tonic
u.gold-entrancement-tonic.description:
"It'll feel like you're in a trance, and you'll-"

"Trance? Aye, what good is a potion if it knocks you out on the battlefield for drinking it?!"

"Err, no, you'll retain full control of your faculties, and your aptitude for magic should increase several fol-"

"Maybe we can hurl'm at the enemy, and see if we can knock them all into trances!"
-A conversation between Nphireo and Rarsik

a.niek-mira.name: Niek Mira
a.niek-mira.description:
"You'd like my help? Well, that all depends... Have you been behaving well? Or have you continued disobeying your mother and behaving poorly?"
-Niek Mira
a.niek-mira.effects: Festive Cheer: 40% chance to proc 1,800 Magic damage; Adds +20 Energy to the Player; Adds +2 Attack and +1 Defence to each Sinderklaz Dwerg and Sinderklaz Arbeider in the Formation; Restores 8 Health daily

a.thorne-hollowgorge.name: Thorne Hollowgorge
a.thorne-hollowgorge.description: You were taken aback by the strange, four-legged creature of bone when you first saw it, but after having your hand stayed when you attempted to slay it, you learned that its loyalty, while not cheap, was invaluable. Despite communicating in mere grunts, growls and snaps, it seems fully capable of leading your people into the harshest fights on the battlefield, and bringing them safely out the other side.
a.thorne-hollowgorge.effects: Barefanged Bite: 20% chance to proc 3,000 Dark damage ; 4% chance to proc 10,000 Dark damage and add +15% Crit Damage; Adds +6 Attack and +1 Defence to each Undead Troop in the Formation; Restores 25 Health daily

c.fractured-sword-guard.name: Fractured Sword Guard
c.fractured-sword-guard.description: A mysterious guard from an ancient blade, brimming with divine energies...

a.vranda-stadium-manager.name: Vranda, Stadium Manager
a.vranda-stadium-manager.description:
"The diverse beastiary we've been able to build up is certainly thanks to you and your efforts. I hope the practice has honed some of your... more questionable skills..."
-Vranda
a.vranda-stadium-manager.effects: Still Fangful: 50% chance to proc 50,000 Poison damage; +50,000 Poison damage vs Human raids; Adds +6 Attack to Vranda's Beastrider troops in the active Formation; Adds +2 Attack and +2 Defence to Vranda's Beastwhisperer troops in the active Formation

e.oresnatchs-green-ring.name: Oresnatch's Green Ring
e.oresnatchs-green-ring.effects: Vazz's Treasure: 100% chance to proc 250 Magic damage and give +600 Defence on that proc
e.oresnatchs-green-ring.description: You've seen few rings anywhere near this fine, despite the simplicity in the band. The ring's green hue shines luminescently in the light.

e.paresthisy-armor.name: Paresthisy Armor
e.paresthisy-armor.effects:
Existential Experiencing (Armor): 16% chance to proc 475 Psychic damage, giving +10% Crit Damage on proc; +200 damage per Paresthisy set item worn; +10 HP; +4% Psychic Resistance
Set Bonus (Paresthisy Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +1 Tiers of 'Eye for Beauty'
 8+: +1 Tiers of 'Eye for Beauty'
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.paresthisy-armor.description: You have the sneaking suspicion that this armor is more like to make you a target than actually protect you in battle.

a.elian-greysky.name: Elian Greysky
a.elian-greysky.description: A surprisingly talkative individual, Elian doesn't appear to share the reservations the Dumvan elders have of you and your party, and he openly praises your assistance with the barbarians, and your bravery in taking on this beast in the mountains. You only hope he is smart enough to keep his voice down as you get closer to the beast's lair.
a.elian-greysky.effects: Mountaineering Man: 15% chance to proc 3,000 Physical damage; +1,000 damage vs Winter raids; Adds +2 Attack and +0.4 Defence to each Dumvan Mountain Guide in the Formation

u.warriors-elixir.name: Warrior's Elixir
u.warriors-elixir.description: An elixir possessing the prowess of the greatest warriors, capable of expanding your mind to new horizons.

u.blue-codex-of-wisdom.name: Blue Codex of Wisdom
u.blue-codex-of-wisdom.description: Every now and again a rare gem among literature appears, conveying experience beyond its ken, capable of both inspiring future generations to greatness and reminding them of the lessons of history. The wisdom delivered by such works is invaluable, and should never be taken for granted.

e.legacy-ring.name: Legacy Ring
e.legacy-ring.description: You recall seeing this ring on your father’s finger the last time he hugged you and your mother. Why did it end up in Gipanta, so far from home?

a.psyguard-kinetic.name: Psyguard Kinetic
a.psyguard-kinetic.description: Born with latent psychic abilities, Morah seems to have taken a liking to these individuals, and has trained them in the use of their psionic powers.
a.psyguard-kinetic.effects: Adds +5 Attack to Alaion Torris and Morah Psyguard in the active Formation

e.red-dragonhunters-gloves.name: Red Dragonhunter's Gloves
e.red-dragonhunters-gloves.effects: Red Drake Stalker (Gloves): 16% chance to proc 200 Ice damage; +340 damage vs Dragon raids; +60 damage per Red Dragonhunter set item worn
e.red-dragonhunters-gloves.description: V. Qusasper, simply wanting to retrieve his kettle, made every effort to avoid combat with the lumbering beast, but whether by accident or by malicious spite the beast crushed the kettle beneath its scaled foot.

e.natures-revolt-demi-gaunt.name: Nature's Revolt Demi-Gaunt
e.natures-revolt-demi-gaunt.effects:
Scenic Uprising (Demi-Gaunt): 19% chance to proc 800 Nature damage; +2,000 damage vs Legendary raids; +525 damage per Nature's Revolt set item worn; +0.5% Evasion; +1% All Resistances; +20% Crit Damage; +25 HP
Set Bonus (Nature's Revolt Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +25% Crit Damage and +2% Crit Rate
 6+: 30% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 10%; +30% vs Easy Raids, and +1% Evasion; +3% Evasion vs Easy Raids
 7+: +5% All Resistances and +150 HP
 8+: 25% chance to reduce incoming damage to your Armies by 20%; +30% vs Legendary Raids, and +1% Crit Rate; +2% Crit Rate vs Legendary Raids
 9+: 3% chance to heal the Player 2 HP; +4 HP healed vs Hard Raids, and +15% Crit Damage; +25% Crit Damage vs Hard Raids
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.natures-revolt-demi-gaunt.description:
"These hands, that once tilled and scarred the land, can now be used to enact its revenge."
-Brocck of the Revolt

e.sloughed-naga-body.name: Sloughed Naga Body
e.sloughed-naga-body.effects:
Residual Residue (Body): 5% chance to proc 30 Poison damage; +5 damage per Sloughed Naga set item worn
Set Bonus (Sloughed Naga Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +2 Tiers of 'Critical Gaze'
e.sloughed-naga-body.description:
"The owner of that ssshedding may not ssstill have need of it, but you ssstill need to be ressspectful while wearing it."
-Bujangha Darpoek

cp.rogue-starter-pack-iii.name: Rogue Starter Pack III
cp.rogue-starter-pack-iii.description: A pack providing the necessary equipment for every budding rogue.

e.psyguard-bulwark-ring.name: Psyguard Bulwark Ring
e.psyguard-bulwark-ring.effects:
Guardian's Mind (Ring): 20% chance to proc 900 Psychic damage; +200 damage per Psyguard Bulwark set item worn; +5% All Resistances; +500 Magic
Set Bonus (Psyguard Bulwark Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +10 Max HP on all Commanders and +10 Reserve Cap on all Troops
6: +1% Crit Rate and +15% Crit Damage
 7+: +10 Reserve Cap on all Troops and +1,000 Defence
 8+: 10% chance to reduce damage to your Armies by 50%
 9+: +1 Formation Protection Value
e.psyguard-bulwark-ring.description: You were warned that this ring would significantly enhance your psychic powers, but even that undersold the awakening that occurred once you slipped it over your finger.

e.diamond-sabatons.name: Diamond Sabatons
e.diamond-sabatons.effects:
Diamond Kick: 4% chance to proc 1,875 Physical damage; 1% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 50%
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.diamond-sabatons.description: A modest design, the clear diamonds placed over these sabatons appear capable of absorbing the shock of incoming damage.

c.red-frigidara-defence-banner.name: Red Frigidara Defence Banner
c.red-frigidara-defence-banner.description: A banner intended to both rally troops to stave off Frigidara’s invasion, and to announce details about her horde’s locations. Aegyr truly seems to have thought of everything in this never-ending watch of his.

a.rhona-hewson.name: Rhona Hewson
a.rhona-hewson.description:
"Ah'ament sure whit cam ower me, bit th' neist time ah see yin o' they winged bastards, they'll be whit gets cut."
-Rhona Hewson
a.rhona-hewson.effects: Fire-touched Fury: 12% chance to proc 3,750 Physical damage; 1% chance to proc 30,000 Physical damage

e.claws-of-justice-legs.name: Claws of Justice Legs
e.claws-of-justice-legs.effects:
Hooked Hearing (Legs): 10% chance to proc 600 Holy damage; +300 damage per Claws of Justice set item worn; +2% Formation Bonus; +2% Holy Resistance
Set Bonus (Claws of Justice Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +25% Formation Bonus and +1 Tiers of 'Experienced Leader'
e.claws-of-justice-legs.description: You can appreciate the extra layer of padding on these pants, as riding your noble mount can certainly take a toll on your inner thighs.

c.jingse-grub.name: Jingse Grub
c.jingse-grub.description: A wriggling grub harvested during the maelstrom, it is sufficiently plump to be of value to the locals.

u.greater-agliata-potion.name: Greater Agliata Potion
u.greater-agliata-potion.description:
"Three Crowns may get you to the bastion, but a swig of this will guarantee you entrance."
-Corovar
u.greater-agliata-potion.effects: +5% Crit Rate and +15% Offence vs Lord Kaspar for 12 hours

a.naitour-patrol-officer.name: Naitour Patrol Officer
a.naitour-patrol-officer.description: As much as some may mock their exorbitant rations and their relaxed demeanour, these hardened officers are used to their twenty-four hour patrol shifts, and keep the citizens of Fort Naitour safe from wandering trolls and bandits.
a.naitour-patrol-officer.effects: Adds +1 Attack to Clyburn Softshadow and Avri Stidig in the active Formation

e.hearthkeepers-helm.name: Hearthkeeper's Helm
e.hearthkeepers-helm.effects:
Set Bonus (Hearthkeeper Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +80 Magic and +45 Max HP
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.hearthkeepers-helm.description: I. Vesta Hearthkeeper, head of the Hearthkeeper clan at Stronghold Vergon, was known as an exceedingly patient woman, even by dwarven standards, and was careful when it came to making even daily decisions. Some joked - though certainly not where Vesta could hear them - that by the time Vesta had decided what she wanted for breakfast, the supper dishes would already be cleaned and the children put to bed.

c.red-decorative-gloves.name: Red Decorative Gloves
c.red-decorative-gloves.description: You're not sure why someone would want to wear these colourful gloves, but there must be a use for them.

c.green-overlord-assegai.name: Green Overlord Assegai
c.green-overlord-assegai.description: Surely there must be a collector of strange, demonic things - aside from your insatiable companion... - who would be willing to take these used-weapons in exchange for something you can utilize.

a.melaphin-suncomber.name: Melaphin Suncomber
a.melaphin-suncomber.description: A characteristically quiet hunter, Melaphin is used to spending her days ranging the mountainside for prey to bring back to the village. While she seems willing to share that she has seen significant losses due to this new creature, she is wary of newcomers to her home... Even those that arrive in time to save the village.
a.melaphin-suncomber.effects: Snowstalker: 3% chance to proc 18,000 Physical damage; Adds +5 to Player Vitality

e.reverent-titanslayer-hafted-club.name: Reverent Titanslayer Hafted Club
e.reverent-titanslayer-hafted-club.effects:
Behemoth Bouldery Bash (Hafted Club): 15% chance to proc 1,300 Holy damage; +2,700 damage vs Legendary raids; +550 damage per Reverent Titanslayer set item worn; +1.5% Crit Rate; +25% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Reverent Titanslayer Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +2% Crit Rate and +25% Crit Damage
 6+: +100 HP and +6% All Resistances
 7+: 6% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 80%, and 4% chance to reduce damage to Armies by 75%
 8+: 8% chance to proc 2,400 Holy damage and protect the Player and their Armies from Breath of Death
 9+: +30% Formation Bonus
e.reverent-titanslayer-hafted-club.description: Your first impression of this impressively large 'club' was that it appeared far more axe-like than like any club you know of. After closer inspection, the lack of a sharp edge suggested the name may well be appropriate, even if you've no idea how you're supposed to wield this with only one hand.

e.mestari-dragonslayer-orange.name: Mestari Dragonslayer - Orange
e.mestari-dragonslayer-orange.effects: Divine Orange Empowerment: 40% chance to proc 250 Holy damage
e.mestari-dragonslayer-orange.description: The divine radiance of this blade glows even more brilliantly after you had that Dragonslayer gem forged into it. While it still feels somehow incomplete, it somehow still leaves you feeling… whole.

c.violet-broken-gipantan-amphora.name: Violet Broken Gipantan Amphora
c.violet-broken-gipantan-amphora.description: A once-beautiful construct, likely intended to contain delicious beverage, seems to have been damaged in the chaos.

e.rara-shell-collection-stiletto.name: Rara Shell Collection Stiletto
e.rara-shell-collection-stiletto.effects:
Fabulous, Darling! (Stiletto): 5% chance to proc 3,000 Nature damage; +1,000 damage per Rara Shell Collection set item worn; +1% Crit Rate; +15% Crit Damage; 20% chance to proc 200 Physical damage and add +5% Crit Rate
Set Bonus (Rara Shell Collection Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1% Evasion and +300 Magic
 6+: +5 Tiers of 'Nimble Defensive Training'
 7+: +4 Tiers of 'Evasive Maneuvers' and +1 Tier of 'Advanced Evasive Maneuvers'
 8+: +1% Evasion and 24% chance to proc 2,000 Nature damage vs Aquatic raids
e.rara-shell-collection-stiletto.description:
"And that is when you swoop in and vwap! Hyah! Or whatever it is you adventuring-types are wont to do."
-Luminarara

c.atas-the-purifier-boost-i.name: Atas the Purifier Boost I
c.atas-the-purifier-boost-i.description: The rejuvenating power of the Spring rebirth provides guidance to wholesome healers. Passively boosts Atas' Attack by +15 and Defence by +0.75 (Max 2).

e.frostwarden-katar.name: Frostwarden Katar
e.frostwarden-katar.effects:
Arctic Aegis (Katar): 8% chance to proc 450 Ice damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 10%; +100 Ice damage per Frostwarden set item worn
Set Bonus (Frostwarden Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: 20% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 25%
e.frostwarden-katar.description: This unusual blade is cold to the touch, though Aisi has assured you that this will not result it in being brittle. Apparently, it is even colder when on the receiving end of it.

c.lost-saddle.name: Lost Saddle
c.lost-saddle.description: A saddle left alongside the path, in surprisingly fair condition. Perhaps it wasn't properly attached to the beast wearing it?

c.gnarled-roots.name: Gnarled Roots
c.gnarled-roots.description: The roots of the Greater Ent are gnarled and worn, but utterly devoid of rot or wear.

e.yaomori-boots.name: Yaomori Boots
e.yaomori-boots.effects:
Working Chorafia (Boots): 15% chance to proc 60 Physical damage; +30 damage per Yaomori set item worn; +2 Vitality
Set Bonus (Yaomori Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +2 Raid Cap
 7+: +2 Raid Cap, +75 HP and +25 Vitality
e.yaomori-boots.description:
"You can tell how good a boot is by how muddy it is. If it's not muddy, it ain't being used for hard work!"
-Tansy Croftfield

c.robust-brew-of-shadow.name: Robust Brew of Shadow
c.robust-brew-of-shadow.description: The sea-green of the ocean will no longer turn a deeper blue, as I was unable to predict this unfortunate event befalling you. If I stare intensely into the setting sun, I realize my love with laugh with me, prior to the morning's arrival.

a.thiadoran-smithy.name: Thiadoran Smithy
a.thiadoran-smithy.description: Having forged for many hours in Thiador, this smithy has valuable skills that can aid your quest, even though their country is lost.
a.thiadoran-smithy.effects: Adds +5 Attack and +0.2 Defence to Ursinus Hardhammer in the active Formation

a.tanya-amethyst.name: Tanya Amethyst
a.tanya-amethyst.description: Hailing from a house of lower-nobility, Tanya abandoned her family when it became clear her aptitudes ran contrary to those expected by her parents and tutours. Now, she efficiently wields an extremely ungainly maul, and pounds her foes into paste with all the grace of a butcher in a pastry shop.
a.tanya-amethyst.effects: Feminine Force Fatale: 4% chance to proc 1600 Physical damage

c.green-cave-mushroom.name: Green Cave Mushroom
c.green-cave-mushroom.description: Certainly the strangest form of mushroom you have ever seen, both Fagli and Vinqa assure you it is safe for consumption.

ba.glorious-hierophant-banner.name: Glorious Hierophant Banner
ba.glorious-hierophant-banner.description: Obtained with the Glorious Hierophant Class

e.moswas-wand.name: Moswa's Wand
e.moswas-wand.effects: Palmate Overpower (Wand): 25% chance to proc 480 Magic damage; +6,000 damage vs Guild Raids; +120 damage per Moswa set item worn; 6% chance to proc 2400 Nature damage; +200 damage per Moswa set item worn; +140 Magic
e.moswas-wand.description: I(a). Cenius Morgabick was born to a privileged house, as the sole heir to two bright physicians, and whose childhood left him wanting for naught. He always had the best tutours to train his academic mind, and free reign to practice various weapon and martial skills, and whatever toys he could fathom. All of that did little to provide him appropriate guidance, tutelage and oversight, however.

c.red-shed-snakeskin.name: Red Shed Snakeskin
c.red-shed-snakeskin.description: You don't know what colour of serpent would have shed this, but it is certainly a strange article to come across.

c.blue-horsewhistle.name: Blue Horsewhistle
c.blue-horsewhistle.description: Would a whistle of this colour call a specific horse, or a specific colour of horse?

e.consecrated-leoegan-wand.name: Consecrated Leoegan Wand
e.consecrated-leoegan-wand.effectName: At the Please of the Gods (Wand)
e.consecrated-leoegan-wand.effects:
At the Please of the Gods (Wand): 14% chance to proc 750 Holy damage; +250 damage per Consecrated Leoegan set item worn; +1% Crit Rate; +40 HP
Consecrated
e.consecrated-leoegan-wand.description: XIX. Stepping closer to the chariot, Paython's hopes of speaking with Amera - and, in turn, getting in touch with his father - dwindled, but he hardly noticed as something stirred inside of him. The great stallions, each more than half-again his own height, watched him curiously as he passed, and before he knew it Paython was standing in the chariot, the reins in his hands.

c.green-heroic-dusk-mark.name: Green Heroic Dusk Mark
c.green-heroic-dusk-mark.description: A rare and valuable mark, demonstrating your allegiance owed by the Knights of the Heroic Dusk.

a.marley.name: Marley
a.marley.description: You've seen Marley a few times while living on the farm, and almost always with amazing game slung over his shoulder or carried behind him. You've no doubt this skilled Navenian hunter will be a great asset in your armies!
a.marley.effects: Hunter's Finesse: 15% chance to proc 20 Physical damage

e.lumina-flash-head.name: Lumina Flash Head
e.lumina-flash-head.effects:
By the Light (Head): 12% chance to proc 1,000 Lightning damage; +125 damage per Lumina Flash set item worn; +1% Evasion; +2% Lightning Resistance
Set Bonus (Lumina Flash Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +2% Evasion and +1 Tiers of 'Advanced Evasive Maneuvers'
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.lumina-flash-head.description: The fabric lining this helmet leaves it feeling comfortable and snug, while the armored plating offers both standard protection, and illuminative protection.

c.violet-infernal-bracer.name: Violet Infernal Bracer
c.violet-infernal-bracer.description: As disgusted as you are to handle this ichor-encrusted piece, it serves as proof to the locals that you were able to clear their fields of the demons plaguing them.

a.reliable-guild-servant.name: Reliable Guild Servant
a.reliable-guild-servant.description: Slow and methodical, this servant is capable of seeing to various tasks without supervision or minders.

c.thinned-brew-of-physicality.name: Thinned Brew of Physicality
c.thinned-brew-of-physicality.description: Facing off, out in the heat, you have to hang tough and remain hungry.

a.dumvan-mountain-guide.name: Dumvan Mountain Guide
a.dumvan-mountain-guide.description: Unlike forests, mountains are unforgiving when it comes to traversing through them, and having a guide who knows the way can prove invaluable.
a.dumvan-mountain-guide.effects: Adds +2 Attack and +0.2 Defence to Elian Greysky in the active Formation

c.potash-powder.name: Potash Powder
c.potash-powder.description: A particularly potent mix, seemingly equally useful at setting things ablaze as growing the things you'd want to set ablaze.

k.bloodcurdle.name: Bloodcurdle
k.bloodcurdle.description: When your foes thirst for the taste of blood, you intend to sate them with a mouthful something else.
k.bloodcurdle.effects: An attack designed to target bloodsucking creatures. Deals a 20x Magic-type attack to the Raid, but deals 4x the damage, and a bonus (12x Intellect) damage if the Raid has the Thirst Quench Raid Ability.

s.scroll-rotting-fen-lure.name: Rotting Fen Lure Scroll
s.scroll-rotting-fen-lure.description: Fen Lures aren't uncommon to find in marshy regions and swamps, but the rot emanating from this one speaks to a supernatural affliction.

cp.void-crystals-fifty-special.name: Void Crystals x500
cp.void-crystals-fifty-special.description: A special large pack containing the premium currency of the realms.

dy.orchid-dye-tub.name: Orchid Dye Tub
dy.orchid-dye-tub.description: A tub of colourful dye that can magically improve the appeal of your equipment!

e.diamond-cuisses.name: Diamond Cuisses
e.diamond-cuisses.effects:
Diamond Kick: 4% chance to proc 2,750 Physical damage; 2% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 50%
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.diamond-cuisses.description: Surprisingly elegant, the shimmering diamonds adorning these boots magically draw in any concussive impacts, and help redirect them into the ensuing counterblow.

e.demonsbanes-helm.name: Demonsbane's Helm
e.demonsbanes-helm.effects:
Dark Deterrence (Helm): 6% chance to proc 1300 Physical damage; +0.75% Crit Rate vs Demon raids
Set Bonus (Demonsbane's Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +80% Crit Damage
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.demonsbanes-helm.description: Little is said about Ciri Demonsbane, save that she supposedly saved a region from a rampaging demon. Those that do mention her name do so in hushed voices, and for good reason: It is well known that Ciri, and her name, are cursed.

e.blazen-swiftslicer-pants.name: Blazen Swiftslicer Pants
e.blazen-swiftslicer-pants.effects:
Glorious Flaming Blades (Pants): 24% chance to proc 900 Fire damage vs Winter raids; +200 Fire damage per Blazen Swiftslicer set item worn; +1.2% Evasion
Set Bonus (Blazen Swiftslicer Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +0.25% Evasion
 9+: +1.75% Evasion
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.blazen-swiftslicer-pants.description: Of all the pants you've tried on in recent times, ones covered with blades were never your favourite. However, adding extra heat to them might help with that.

m.might-makes-right.name: Might Makes Right
m.might-makes-right.description:
When you took a moment to ask Thephis about how he was so capable at identifying and recognizing everything around him, he simply stood up, nodded and began flexing his arm in your general direction. When you slowly turned to leave, figuring you were not about to get an answer, you heard him grumble and grunt once more before striking another muscular pose. After seeing your confusion, he simply pointed at you, as though gesturing for you to try the same. Sheepishly looking around, you tried flexing your considerably-smaller muscles briefly, and he chortled an enormous laugh, slapping you on the back.

It may not have been particularly instructive, but somehow you felt better than when you had originally approached him.
m.might-makes-right.effects: Might Makes Right: 7% chance to proc [up-to-37]% Physical damage; +2% Physical damage for each distinct Tedupevair set item owned; [up-to-5]% chance, based upon Strength, to heal the Player 1 HP; +1% chance [rate and cap] to heal vs Hard Raids; +2% chance [rate and cap] to heal vs Legendary Raids; +1 HP of healing vs Legendary Raids

u.samurai-starter-pack-iii.name: Samurai Starter Pack III
u.samurai-starter-pack-iii.description: A pack providing the necessary equipment for every budding samurai.

c.violet-xaphegorgh-wing.name: Violet Xaphegorgh Wing
c.violet-xaphegorgh-wing.description:
"Phermis demands an offering after a successful hunt, as our plates and bellies would be empty but for her wisdom and aid."
-Meropi Demide

cp.sentinel-starter-pack-iv.name: Sentinel Starter Pack IV
cp.sentinel-starter-pack-iv.description: A pack providing the necessary materials for every budding sentinel.

u.script-of-evoked-rampage.name: Script of Evoked Rampage
u.script-of-evoked-rampage.description: "Enforce the lesson in blood and power! Evoked Rampage!"

e.pioneering-pixie-bladder.name: Pioneering Pixie Bladder
e.pioneering-pixie-bladder.effects:
A Sprite's Searching (Bladder): 11% chance to proc 200 Magic damage; +600 damage per Pioneering Pixie set item worn; +1.75% Crit Rate; +8% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Pioneering Pixie Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1% Crit Rate and +15% Crit Damage
 7+: +1% Evasion
 8+: +0.5% Crit Rate and +0.5% Evasion
e.pioneering-pixie-bladder.description: Your initial thoughts verged on mockery of this 'weapon', but when Rarsik provided some creative suggestions for what it could be filled with, your thoughts went to some wicked places.

e.phermitic-battlegarb-blade.name: Phermitic Battlegarb Blade
e.phermitic-battlegarb-blade.effects:
The Wisdom in War (Blade): 5% chance to proc 450 Physical damage; +350 damage per Phermitic Battlegarb set item worn; +2% Crit Rate; +35% Crit Damage; +0.5% Evasion
Sanctified
Set Bonus (Phermitic Battlegarb Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +15% Crit Damage
 8+: +2% Crit Rate and +2 Tiers of 'Prolonged Battle'
e.phermitic-battlegarb-blade.description: I. Thiadoran lore tells of a beautiful young woman, hailing from the north, who was unparalleled in her artistic weavings and designs. Ankyabu possessed talents some claimed surpassed that threshold of humanity.

c.boltstone.name: Boltstone
c.boltstone.description: A rare and valuable stone, said to possess the power of the storm within its shell.

c.yellow-dragonslayer-gem.name: Yellow Dragonslayer Gem
c.yellow-dragonslayer-gem.description: This fine, magical, yellow gem resonates in proximity to the Blade of Mestari. What could the connection be between these two artifacts?

e.urvogel-beak.name: Urvogel Beak
e.urvogel-beak.effects:
Primitive Plumage (Sickles): 8% chance to proc 950 Physical damage; +6250 damage vs Guild Raids; +100 damage per Urvogel set item worn
Set Bonus (Urvogel Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +25% Crit Damage
e.urvogel-beak.description: XVII. The sunny afternoon turned to shadowy evening, followed by a dark, moonless night, as Ceta wandered the woods. As hunger began to set in, she called out for any of her animal companions to aid her, but fear gripped her heart when she realized that the area was entirely devoid of animal life. She pressed forward, knowing she did not have a viable means to safely return in this trip, until she reached a small clearing with a strange, rocky formation.

u.script-of-fire-bolt.name: Script of Fire Bolt
u.script-of-fire-bolt.description: "Fly forth and ignite your rage! Fire Bolt!"

cp.sentinel-starter-pack-ii.name: Sentinel Starter Pack II
cp.sentinel-starter-pack-ii.description: A pack providing the necessary tools for every budding sentinel.

e.baneful-lures-bow.name: Baneful Lure's Bow
e.baneful-lures-bow.effects: Poisoned Projectile: 12% chance to proc 400 Poison damage; +1% Crit Rate; +20% Crit Damage
e.baneful-lures-bow.description: Drenched in the toxins of the swamp, you hope that the arrows get as much of it as your hands seem to.

c.violet-dragon-claw.name: Violet Dragon Claw
c.violet-dragon-claw.description: The claws of the dragon appear dyed from their victims.

c.heavy-gipantan-ingot.name: Heavy Gipantan Ingot
c.heavy-gipantan-ingot.description: Ores and metals mined in the mountains are brought to the larger Thiadoran cities to be smelted down into ingots. Apparently these metal bricks hold important economical value.

u.greater-draught-of-grit.name: Greater Draught of Grit
u.greater-draught-of-grit.description: This viscous, dark liquid seems to stick to every corner of your mouth as you try to drink it, and the ensuing feeling of choking as it slowly passes down your gullet doesn't make it any more pleasant. Perhaps it works so well because it dissuades people from wanting to drink any more of it!
u.greater-draught-of-grit.effects: Increases today's daily raid limit by 10

u.tankard-of-mass-curing.name: Tankard of Mass Curing
u.tankard-of-mass-curing.description: When the battle runs long, sometimes your Commanders need an extra pick-me-up.

e.mortiday-darts.name: Mortiday Darts
e.mortiday-darts.effects:
Mortiday Celebration (Darts): 25% chance to proc 200 Dark damage; +100 damage per Mortiday set item worn; +625 damage vs Human raids
Set Bonus (Mortiday Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +20% Crit Damage
 8+: Reduces incoming damage from Human raids to the Player by 30%
 9+: +2.5% Crit Rate and +10% Crit Damage
e.mortiday-darts.description: You've little doubt that these were not originally intended for combat, which makes it all the more worrisome that children were playing with these as part of the festivities.

e.capricious-falcon.name: Capricious Falcon
e.capricious-falcon.effects:
Conducive Conductivity (Falcon): 4% chance to proc 3,450 Lightning damage; +1,600 damage per Capricious Conducer set item worn; 20% chance to proc 450 Physical damage and add +20% Evasion on that proc; +100 damage per Capricious Conducer set item worn; +10% Lightning Resistance
Set Bonus (Capricious Conducer Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1% Evasion
 6: +1.5% Crit Rate and +15% Crit Damage
 7+: Additional Bonuses depending on Shield equipped
 8+: 2% chance to proc 10,000 Lightning damage and give +50% Evasion on that proc
 9+: Additional Bonuses depending on Shield equipped
e.capricious-falcon.description: When wearing electrically charged attire and begging further bolts of lightning to strike, you're surprised that these capricious individuals would opt to take to the air in combat. You considered asking about it, but suspected you'd get some catchphrase response like 'quick as lightning' or something similar.

e.vyldas-supplicant-bloodfeeder.name: Vylda's Supplicant Bloodfeeder
e.vyldas-supplicant-bloodfeeder.effects:
Glorious Bloodfeast (Bloodfeeder): 4% chance to proc 1,600 Dark damage, turning Dark Resistance into Weakness for this proc, and adding +20% Crit Damage and reducing incoming damage to the Player by 10%; +2450 damage per Vylda's Supplicant set item worn; 1% chance to proc 550 Dark damage and heal the Player 1.5 HP; +1,350 damage per Vylda's Supplicant set item worn
Set Bonus (Vylda's Supplicant Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1% Crit Rate and +10% Crit Damage
 6+: +3 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Dark' and +2,000 Magic
 7+: 1% chance to deal 25,000 Dark damage; +15% Crit Damage
 8+: +1.5% Crit Rate, and 1% chance of healing the Player +13 HP alongside -75% Formation Bonus on proc
e.vyldas-supplicant-bloodfeeder.description: You've had the... pleasure... of mounting a number of flying creatures. Several of which were known to feast in midair. While it's lovely that this beast doesn't do that, it would be nice if it wasn't spraying pieces of its most recent meal into the air as it continues ingesting it.

e.semliki-spear.name: Semliki Spear
e.semliki-spear.description:
"This kind spear, you no throw. Stab, hard. Fast. No let go."
-Dekoo Harpooner

e.valley-verdure-pants.name: Valley Verdure Pants
e.valley-verdure-pants.effects:
Verdant Volley (Pants): 8% chance to proc 1,000 Nature damage; +800 damage per Valley Verdure set item worn; +50 Magic; +2% All Resistances
Set Bonus (Valley Verdure Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +500 Magic
 6+: +2% Crit Rate and +10% Crit Damage
e.valley-verdure-pants.description:
"It'd be awfully silly to go adventuring about without pants."
-Murrlix

u.green-vintners-satchel.name: Green Vintner's Satchel
u.green-vintners-satchel.description: A satchel clearly cared for by a busy vintner, containing a mystery potion.
u.green-vintners-satchel.effects: Open to obtain its contents (three of the chance drops)

e.heroic-dusk-helm.name: Heroic Dusk Helm
e.heroic-dusk-helm.effects:
Evil's Dimday (Helm): 20% chance to proc 800 Physical damage; +300 Physical damage per Heroic Dusk set item worn; +10% Crit Damage; +1% Evasion; +25 HP
Set Bonus (Heroic Dusk Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +3% Crit Rate and +25% Crit Damage
 8+: 4% chance to heal the Player 2 HP
 9+: +15% Formation Bonus and 10% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 30%
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.heroic-dusk-helm.description:
"Protecting the head is akin to ensuring the safety of the commander. Really, we ought best ensure you stay safe during these dark times."
-Sir Tybalt

c.red-repelling-rod.name: Red Repelling Rod
c.red-repelling-rod.description: A rod, blessed by the Church of Laetrie to repel undead and demonic beings.

c.red-ripe-thiadoran-olives.name: Red Ripe Thiadoran Olives
c.red-ripe-thiadoran-olives.description: You've seen fruits of varying sizes and colours in your years, but these multi-coloured olives apparently originate from different regions of the country, and are used to create some famous oils and spreads.

u.silver-third-eye-tonic.name: Silver Third Eye Tonic
u.silver-third-eye-tonic.description: It is said that all perception starts not with the eyes on your face, but by the concentration of energy forming your innate third eye. Whether the Gods would agree with such a self-serving explanation or not remains to be seen, but you do enjoy the prospect of noticing those minute details of the world around you.
u.silver-third-eye-tonic.effects: Increases Attentive Perception and Eye for Beauty tiers by +2 for 4 hours

e.crusherclaw-helm.name: Crusherclaw Helm
e.crusherclaw-helm.effects:
Pressure Crush (Helm): 5% chance to proc 2200 Physical damage; +30000 damage vs Guild Raids; +700 damage per Crusherclaw set item worn
Set Bonus (Crusherclaw Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +0.5 Formation Protection Value
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.crusherclaw-helm.description: III(a). The Hero of Hammerclaw, contrary to the image many hold in their minds when picturing a hero, carried an unwieldy warhammer, alongside an enormous shield, but despite this was able to move deftly in combat. That combat agility was fully utilized to rain devastating blows upon his target, however, as it was well known that he would never attempt to intentionally avoid an attack.

e.psionic-screener-boots.name: Psionic Screener Boots
e.psionic-screener-boots.effects:
Psyshroom Stopper (Boots): 13% chance to proc 100 Psychic damage; +100 damage per Psionic Screener set item worn
Set Bonus (Psionic Screener Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: 20% chance to proc 100 Psychic damage, and protects you and your armies from the backlash of Volatile or Volatile Spores
e.psionic-screener-boots.description: Tread carefully, so you don't set off any of those psionic blasts.

c.violet-mirgoda-leavings.name: Violet Mirgoda Leavings
c.violet-mirgoda-leavings.description: It is unclear what the creature must have consumed to have leavings of this strange colour, but you have little desire to find out.

a.nereus.name: Nereus
a.nereus.description: You've learned that, for all their flamboyant colours and fantastic appearances, Merfolk tend to be a reserved, stoic race. Nereus, on the other hand, throws that notion for a loop, being beyond simple theatrics as he manages the Guild Arena like his own stage.
a.nereus.effects: Finflair: 40% chance to proc 2000 Physical damage vs Small raids

c.robust-brew-of-toxins.name: Robust Brew of Toxins
c.robust-brew-of-toxins.description: The air atop freshly disturbed ground, and a stone angel shines down upon the grave, which drinks deep of its final, everlasting peace.

e.diamond-gauntlets.name: Diamond Gauntlets
e.diamond-gauntlets.effects:
Diamond Punch: 4% chance to proc 750 Physical damage; 0.5% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 50%
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.diamond-gauntlets.description: They seem to have a simple design, though the clouded gemstones in these gauntlets still seem to magically absorb incoming attacks.

ba.master-guardian-banner.name: Master Guardian Banner
ba.master-guardian-banner.description: Obtained with the Master Guardian Class

u.blue-swiftness-tonic.name: Blue Swiftness Tonic
u.blue-swiftness-tonic.description:
An old legend tells of two colleagues exploring a dense forest, before happening upon a bear. When the bear gives chase, they both flee as swiftly as their feet will carry them. One of the colleagues pauses to quaff a draught from a small glass beaker. "You'll never be able to evade the bear forever, so why waste time with a last drink?!" His partner questioned incredulously.

"I need not escape the bear forever, ol' chum! I need only dodge its advances longer than you!"
u.blue-swiftness-tonic.effects: Increases Evasion equivalent to +12,500 Agility for 6 hours

e.frostwarden-pants.name: Frostwarden Pants
e.frostwarden-pants.effects:
Arctic Aegis (Pants): 10% chance to proc 560 Ice damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 14%; +80 Ice damage per Frostwarden set item worn
Set Bonus (Frostwarden Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: 20% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 25%
e.frostwarden-pants.description:
"When you're surveying wide swathes of land, it's imperative that you have well-worn pants that sit comfortably. We ensure extra warding goes into them, for obvious reasons!"
-Aisi Tushar

c.violet-tromos-jewel.name: Violet Tromos Jewel
c.violet-tromos-jewel.description: A rare jewel from the gorge, it has been flooded with demonic energies for so long that it holds the answer to how to stop these demonic entities.

e.vibrant-drake.name: Vibrant Drake
e.vibrant-drake.effects:
+0.5% Evasion; +0.5% Crit Rate; +10% Crit Damage; +50 Magic
Set Bonus (Vibrant Victors Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +5 Vitality, +5 Energy, +5 Honor and additional bonuses (depending on Main-Hand/Off-Hand equipped)
e.vibrant-drake.description: You were initially impressed with the brilliant scales on this wondrous creature, but the moment you saw it take flight, and the light reflecting off of it in a thousand scintillating colours, you were awestruck.

c.green-eggsac.name: Green Eggsac
c.green-eggsac.description: You'd appreciate the rarity of finding intact eggs if they weren't still pulsating.... and wet....

a.machla.name: Machla
a.machla.description:
"Madness is often a cunning and most feline thing; when you think it gone, it may have merely transfigured into some still subtler form."
-Machla
a.machla.effects: Madness of Man: 40% chance to proc 300 Dark damage vs Aquatic raids

e.millennium-island-staff.name: Millennium Island Staff
e.millennium-island-staff.effects:
Last Everlasting (Staff): 30% chance to proc 200 Nature damage; +150 damage per Millennium Island set item worn; +30 HP; +50 Offence
Set Bonus (Millennium Island Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +100 HP, +1 Tiers of 'Immoveable Object' and +1 Tiers of 'Hearty Constitution'
e.millennium-island-staff.description: A thick staff, which would seem equally useful for clubbing foes over the head as wielding potent magics if not for your ability to detect numerous magical currents streaming within it.

e.veedsamin-trainees-boots.name: Veedsamin Trainee's Boots
e.veedsamin-trainees-boots.effects:
Trainee Hunter (Boots): 25% chance to proc 115 Physical damage; +75 damage per Veedsamin Trainee's set item worn; +14 HP; +1% All Resistances
Set Bonus (Veedsamin Trainee's Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 8+: Additional Bonuses depending on Main-Hand/Off-Hand equipped
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.veedsamin-trainees-boots.description:
"One skill the trainees need to have confidence in would be their ability to run. Running is the first step to a trainee staying alive, at least in the field. Only by running can they learn what they can't outrun!"
-Leera Hillvale

a.panee-morassma.name: Panee Morassma
a.panee-morassma.description:
"Nothing better to solve a problem than a blast of acid. Rampaging orc? Acid. Annoying coworker? Acid. Hole in your gut? More acid."
-Panee Morassma

His partner questioned incredulously.

"I need not escape the bear forever, ol' chum! I need only dodge its advances longer than you!"

c.violet-xaphegorgh-claws.name: Violet Xaphegorgh Claws
c.violet-xaphegorgh-claws.description: You can almost feel the evil of the commander within its harvested claws, and the essences of the lives it had taken. Hopefully you can use this to find a way to stop this demonic incursion.

e.naitour-patrol-mail.name: Naitour Patrol Mail
e.naitour-patrol-mail.effects:
Persevering Patrol (Mail): 10% chance to proc 800 Physical damage; +50 damage per Naitour Patrol set item worn; +300 damage vs Human raids; +20 Max HP
Set Bonus (Naitour Patrol Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +2 Tiers of 'Prolonged Battle'
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.naitour-patrol-mail.description:
"It seems you're no stranger to wearing heavy armor, though you'll probably find this a little easier to maneuver in than what you've previously worn. The Patrol has to be capable of traveling long distances during their lengthy shifts, even if the trade-off comes in thinner mail."
-Clyburn Softshadow

e.red-dragonhunters-helm.name: Red Dragonhunter's Helm
e.red-dragonhunters-helm.effects: Red Drake Stalker (Helm): 16% chance to proc 200 Ice damage; +340 damage vs Dragon raids; +60 damage per Red Dragonhunter set item worn
e.red-dragonhunters-helm.description: III. The sudden start of the great beast shook the ground fiercely, overturning the kettle and forcing Qusasper to tactically retreat.

u.legendary-glorious-elixir.name: Legendary Glorious Elixir
u.legendary-glorious-elixir.description: An elixir bestowed to only the most glorious of legendary figures, possessing enormous potential when consumed by a worthy individual.
u.legendary-glorious-elixir.effects: Open to obtain its contents (five of the chance drops)

c.void-token.name: Void Token
c.void-token.description: A token empowered by the energies of fallen denizens of the void. No doubt this will illustrate your commitment to beating back the Void to your guildmates.

c.forgiving-feather.name: Forgiving Feather
c.forgiving-feather.description: A special feather, having never touched the ground, and said to bring true forgiveness to the heart of its holder.

u.green-mihrish-troop-draft-poster.name: Green Mihrish Troop Draft Poster
u.green-mihrish-troop-draft-poster.description: Used to draft Troops to your cause.
u.green-mihrish-troop-draft-poster.effects: Open to obtain its contents (three of the following)

e.hammerclaw-claws.name: Hammerclaw Claws
e.hammerclaw-claws.effects:
Hammer Pressure (Claws): 5% chance to proc 600 Physical damage; +10000 damage vs Guild Raids; +150 damage per Hammerclaw set item worn
Set Bonus (Hammerclaw Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +0.5 Formation Protection Value
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.hammerclaw-claws.description: XII. The following morning, when their father returned home, the boys stood precariously, overlooked by their mother, as they recited the tale to the weary man. His tired eyes widened in shock as they described the story, and he slowly walked to his room, shutting the door slowly, before a devastated wail resounded across the coast.

e.swiftblades-buckler.name: Swiftblade's Buckler
e.swiftblades-buckler.description: VII(b). After initially clashing, the two managed to see something of themselves in the other, and soon identified a common goal. Both of the agile, young warriors were able to make their way to the heart of the bandit encampment, watching eachothers' backs as they did so, and struck several vital blows to the group, effectively gutting its command structure. Garrett chose not to return to Volevar with Tessa when all was said and done, but the two remained friends for many years thereafter.

c.yellow-irus-fibula.name: Yellow Irus' Fibula
c.yellow-irus-fibula.description: A colourful brooch, showing reverence and homage to the God of the Moon, whom the Thiadorans believe protects them while they sleep, loves them while they wake, and has an unmitigated disdain for all things demonic.

e.heroic-dusk-wand.name: Heroic Dusk Wand
e.heroic-dusk-wand.effects:
Evil's Dimday (Wand): 5% chance to proc 3,000 Physical damage; +1,500 Physical damage per Heroic Dusk set item worn; +1.5% Crit Rate; +20% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Heroic Dusk Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +3% Crit Rate and +25% Crit Damage
 8+: 4% chance to heal the Player 2 HP
 9+: +15% Formation Bonus and 10% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 30%
e.heroic-dusk-wand.description:
"Where the swordsmen fell and fend off foes, and Strikers deliver death at range, the Mages control the ebb and flow of combat using their potent and honed magics."
-Sir Tybalt

ba.esteemed-major-banner.name: Esteemed Major Banner
ba.esteemed-major-banner.description: Obtained with the Esteemed Major Class

c.blue-jagar-scale.name: Blue Jagar Scale
c.blue-jagar-scale.description: Jagar may have appeared red, but his underlying scales came in a variety of shades.

ru.algigebo-rune-2.name: Algigebo Rune (ZG) Lv. 2
ru.algigebo-rune-2.effects:
Can provide one of the following boosts:
-+10-12 Defence (40%)
-+5-6 Offence (35%)
-+9-10 Max HP (25%)

e.fanghunters-cowl.name: Fanghunter's Cowl
e.fanghunters-cowl.effects:
Poison Pursuit (Cowl): +0.2% Crit Rate
Set Bonus (Fanghunter's Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: 10% chance to proc 1350 Magic damage and protect the Player from the Venomous Raid Ability
e.fanghunters-cowl.description:
"We once pursued a large insect in the Khenmond Mountains, which had claimed the lives of dozens from Khendal and Khengrim. Its enormous stinger could both extend and retract, and its venom completely paralyzed its target within moments of delivery."
-Morna Fangsheath

e.lumina-flash-gloves.name: Lumina Flash Gloves
e.lumina-flash-gloves.effects:
By the Light (Gloves): 12% chance to proc 1,000 Lightning damage; +125 damage per Lumina Flash set item worn; +1% Evasion; +2% Lightning Resistance
Set Bonus (Lumina Flash Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +2% Evasion and +1 Tiers of 'Advanced Evasive Maneuvers'
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.lumina-flash-gloves.description: Every movement you make scintillates when wearing these gloves. While they may not offer the greatest protection, their capability to distract and divert attention is likely unparalleled.

u.soulless-slaughter-potion.name: Soulless Slaughter Potion
u.soulless-slaughter-potion.description: Undeath to undeserving underworldly undone undying.
u.soulless-slaughter-potion.effects: +6,000 Offence vs Undead Raids for 4 hours

e.stormshapers-stormrider.name: Stormshapers' Stormrider
e.stormshapers-stormrider.effects:
Stormfury (Stormrider): 5% chance to proc 4,000 Lightning damage; +1,000 damage per Stormshapers' set item worn; +2% Evasion
Set Bonus (Stormshapers' Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: 50% chance to proc 120 Lightning damage, +5 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Lightning' and +20% Lightning Resistance
e.stormshapers-stormrider.description: You are unsure as to what seems crazier: Flying about during a raging thunderstorm, or the wild creature willing to carry you in order to accomplish such a task. At least it isn't lacking for style.

e.shudder-sailors-cutlass.name: Shudder Sailor's Cutlass
e.shudder-sailors-cutlass.effects:
Clooney's Consent (Cutlass): 20% chance to proc 125 Physical damage; +25 damage per Shudder Sailor's set item worn; +20% Crit Damage; +2% Evasion
Set Bonus (Shudder Sailor's Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: 20% chance to proc 500 Physical damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 20%
e.shudder-sailors-cutlass.description:
"Alas, it was true love, the likes of which certainly don't happen every day!"

"Judging by your history, Captain, it certainly seems to happen at least once a week..."
-Conversations with the crew of the Vengeance

e.medzeh-bow.name: Medzeh Bow
e.medzeh-bow.effects:
Jackal Watcher (Bow): 20% chance to proc 1,000 Physical damage; 4% chance to proc 4,000 Holy damage; +1.25% Crit Rate; +25% Crit Damage; +5% Dark Resistance
Sanctified
Set Bonus (Medzeh Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +2% Crit Rate and +25% Crit Damage
 8+: +4% Evasion
e.medzeh-bow.description:
"The Medzeh have lost many artifacts over the generations, either in the heat of combatting the Suneater, or when lineages simply die off."
-Apui

e.vyldas-supplicant-coercion.name: Vylda's Supplicant Coercion
e.vyldas-supplicant-coercion.effects:
Glorious Bloodfeast (Coercion): 6% chance to proc 900 Dark damage, turning Dark Resistance into Weakness for this proc; +1,300 damage per Vylda's Supplicant set item worn; +8% Holy Resistance; +67 HP; +2 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Dark'
Set Bonus (Vylda's Supplicant Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1% Crit Rate and +10% Crit Damage
 6+: +3 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Dark' and +2,000 Magic
 7+: 1% chance to deal 25,000 Dark damage; +15% Crit Damage
 8+: +1.5% Crit Rate, and 1% chance of healing the Player +13 HP alongside -75% Formation Bonus on proc
e.vyldas-supplicant-coercion.description: The sharp edges on this ring slice your finger open as you don it. However, you notice that the blood doesn't seem to flow down your finger... Where could it be going?

u.parchment-of-clutch-of-darkness.name: Parchment of Clutch of Darkness
u.parchment-of-clutch-of-darkness.description: A scroll that sends shivers down your spine alongside the feeling of claws grasping your heart.

m.chandlers-light.name: Chandler's Light
m.chandlers-light.description:
"What do you mean 'darkness'? The light of Laetrie dispels all darkness. Anything you may be seeing must simply be a reflection of the darkness that dwells within you. Perhaps we should look into purging it...?"
-Raurous Fourfury
m.chandlers-light.effects: Chandler's Light: 18% chance to proc [up-to-35]% Dark damage; Bonus [up-to-60]% damage vs Undead raids; 0.2% chance to proc 500 Dark damage and heal the Player 4 HP

e.tedupevair-hammer.name: Tedupevair Hammer
e.tedupevair-hammer.effects:
Fabled Visions (Hammer): 16% chance to proc 250 Physical damage; +250 Physical damage per Tedupevair set item worn; 5% chance to proc 1,500 Physical damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 25%
Set Bonus (Tedupevair Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +1 Tiers of 'Eye for Beauty'
 7+: 10% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 25%
 8+: +1 Tiers of 'Attentive Perception'
e.tedupevair-hammer.description: Why worry about relocating large objects to scour beneath them when you can simply smash them to pieces?

u.script-of-death-grip.name: Script of Death Grip
u.script-of-death-grip.description: "Carress the heart of darkness and bring the shroud of night! Death Grip!"

e.yelte-demonslayer-yellow.name: Yelte Demonslayer - Yellow
e.yelte-demonslayer-yellow.effects: Divine Yellow Donation: 40% chance to proc 400 Holy damage; +500 damage vs Demon raids; +3% Crit Rate; +40% Crit Damage
e.yelte-demonslayer-yellow.description: Infusing the legendary bow with the mythical Dragonslayer gem was one piece of the puzzle, but something felt incomplete. It was only after you infused the radiant shards into it that the true purpose of the bow became clear, and its potential to strike down demonkind shone through.

a.broff-keghaul.name: Broff Keghaul
a.broff-keghaul.description: A brawny dockworker, Broff commands several crews of dockhands during daylight hours. He was already hard at work when the demons attacked, and despite his best efforts to stave them off he knew that the fight was impossible. He didn't have far to go when he saw your group making its way to the edge of the city, in order to join his crews to your flight.
a.broff-keghaul.effects: Barrel Hauler: 16% chance to proc 2,750 Physical damage; Adds +4 Attack and +0.2 Defence to each Gipantan Dockhand in the Formation

e.rusted-leoegan-greaves.name: Rusted Leoegan Greaves
e.rusted-leoegan-greaves.effects:
Rusty Jawlocking (Greaves): 5% chance to proc 400 Physical damage
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.rusted-leoegan-greaves.description: IV. Despite many years of vagueries, by the time Paython was near-manhood his mother relented and shared the truth of his parentage with him. Paython was overjoyed, until he realized that he had no way of confirming the tale to those who had previously mocked him.

cp.scout-starter-pack-iii.name: Scout Starter Pack III
cp.scout-starter-pack-iii.description: A pack providing the necessary equipment for every budding scout.

c.blue-milkweed.name: Blue Milkweed
c.blue-milkweed.description: This colourful bush - you refuse to call it a flower - seems to grow relatively plentifully on the slopes of this valley, and also seems to attract a number of flying insects.

u.script-of-dark-toll.name: Script of Dark Toll
u.script-of-dark-toll.description: "Clasp your tendrils and extract your price! Dark Toll!"

a.bellas-inahice.name: Bellas Inahice
a.bellas-inahice.description: Despite his claims of being unaffected by the unseasonably chilly weather, you've caught Bellas eyeing the warm cloaks and furs worn by others in the army on a few different occasions.
a.bellas-inahice.effects: Freezeweather Fighter: 5% chance to proc 14,000 Fire damage; +500 damage per Goblin Frigidara Defender, Dwarven Frigidara Defender, Gnomish Frigidara Defender, Orcish Frigidara Defender and Elven Frigidara Defender in the active Formation; Adds +1 Attack and +0.3 Defence to each Goblin Frigidara Defender, Dwarven Frigidara Defender, Gnomish Frigidara Defender, Orcish Frigidara Defender and Elven Frigidara Defender in the Formation

p.stats.name: Stat Points
p.stats.description: Stat Points for increasing your Player Stats

e.psyguard-bulwark-hammer.name: Psyguard Bulwark Hammer
e.psyguard-bulwark-hammer.effects:
Guardian's Mind (Hammer): 17% chance to proc 800 Psychic damage; +400 damage per Psyguard Bulwark set item worn; 2% chance to proc 400 Psychic damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 10% on that proc; +200 damage per Psyguard Bulwark set item worn; +1% Crit Rate; +15% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Psyguard Bulwark Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +10 Max HP on all Commanders and +10 Reserve Cap on all Troops
6: +1% Crit Rate and +15% Crit Damage
 7+: +10 Reserve Cap on all Troops and +1,000 Defence
 8+: 10% chance to reduce damage to your Armies by 50%
 9+: +1 Formation Protection Value
e.psyguard-bulwark-hammer.description:
"The hammer can be used to assail, or to protect. Knowing which occasion is which is the real challenge."
-Alaion Torris

c.blue-seared-stone.name: Blue Seared Stone
c.blue-seared-stone.description: Strangely colourful stones, you expect they could be used to help practice new maneuvers with your armies.

u.red-swiftness-tonic.name: Red Swiftness Tonic
u.red-swiftness-tonic.description:
An old legend tells of two colleagues exploring a dense forest, before happening upon a bear. When the bear gives chase, they both flee as swiftly as their feet will carry them. One of the colleagues pauses to quaff a draught from a small glass beaker. "You'll never be able to evade the bear forever, so why waste time with a last drink?!" His partner questioned incredulously.

"I need not escape the bear forever, ol' chum! I need only dodge its advances longer than you!"
u.red-swiftness-tonic.effects: Increases Evasion equivalent to +200 Agility for 4 hours

e.claws-of-justice-feet.name: Claws of Justice Feet
e.claws-of-justice-feet.effects:
Hooked Hearing (Feet): 10% chance to proc 600 Holy damage; +300 damage per Claws of Justice set item worn; +2% Formation Bonus; +2% Holy Resistance
Set Bonus (Claws of Justice Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +25% Formation Bonus and +1 Tiers of 'Experienced Leader'
e.claws-of-justice-feet.description: You intend to lead by the front, and will walk proudly knowing your troops follow closely behind you.

c.violet-seared-stone.name: Violet Seared Stone
c.violet-seared-stone.description: Strangely colourful stones, you expect they could be used to help practice new maneuvers with your armies.

c.wreath-of-divine-favour.name: Wreath of Divine Favour
