c.wreath-of-divine-favour.description: The Thiadoran pantheon seems to be far more involved with their devotees than any other deities you've head of. It seems some have even bestowed wreaths to those who have earned their favour.

k.coin-collector.name: Coin Collector
k.coin-collector.effects: For your next x attacks, you have a y% chance of finding z Crowns on each attack.

ba.master-musketeer-banner.name: Master Musketeer Banner
ba.master-musketeer-banner.description: Obtained with the Master Musketeer Class

e.dumvan-furs-fur.name: Dumvan Furs Fur
e.dumvan-furs-fur.effects:
Brisk Buffer (Fur): 17% chance to proc 60 Physical damage; +100 damage per Dumvan Furs set item worn; +340 damage vs Beast raids; +3% Ice Resistance; +10 HP
Set Bonus (Dumvan Furs Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +10% Ice Resistance
 7+: +80 HP
e.dumvan-furs-fur.description:
"In the cold season, keeping warm is a matter of life or death. It'll be the cold season, soon enough."
-Shem

c.blue-glowstone.name: Blue Glowstone
c.blue-glowstone.description: This magical stone illuminates the darkness in a strange, colourful light.

k.mounts-potential-prance.name: Mount's Potential: Prance
k.mounts-potential-prance.effects: While riding a Steed, you distract the Raid with an eloquent prance, protecting your Armies from regular damage for the next 3 attacks. During that time your Formation Power increases by +x%, but you take a bonus y% damage from the Raid.

e.byramaster-crafter-pants.name: Byramaster Crafter Pants
e.byramaster-crafter-pants.effects:
Legendary Lager (Pants): 24% chance to proc 450 Nature damage; +100 damage per Byramaster Crafter set item worn; +30 HP; 2% chance to proc 2,000 Nature damage and add +5% Evasion and +2.5% Crit Rate to that attack
Set Bonus (Byramaster Crafter Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +50 HP
 7+: 4% chance to proc 5,000 Nature damage and add +10% Evasion and add +10% Crit Rate
 9+: +15% Nature Resistance and +15% Psychic Resistance
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.byramaster-crafter-pants.description: Whoever it was that invented pockets deserves more recognition than they receive.

s.scroll-rock-grubs.name: Rock Grubs Scroll
s.scroll-rock-grubs.description: These burrowing bugs wreak havoc upon the terrain of wherever they nest. It's time to get exterminating.

c.blue-gardening-shears.name: Blue Gardening Shears
c.blue-gardening-shears.description: Pruning overgrown shrubbery has never been quite so.... flamboyant!

e.repentant-dusk-sherkang.name: Repentant Dusk Sherkang
e.repentant-dusk-sherkang.effects:
Wicked's Winter (Sherkang): 30% chance to proc 500 Ice damage with +6% Crit Rate on that hit; +375 damage per Repentant Dusk set item worn; 6% chance to proc 500 Ice damage with +10% damage from any Ice damage on that proc; +1,500 damage per Repentant Dusk set item worn; +5% All Resistances; +10% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Repentant Dusk Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +2.5% Crit Rate and +30% Crit Damage
 6+: 2.4% chance to heal the Player 2.5 HP
 7+: +1.5% Crit Rate and +5 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Ice'
 8+: 10% chance to proc 100 Ice damage and change your base damage type to Ice
 9+: +25% Formation Bonus and +0.5 Formation Protection Value
e.repentant-dusk-sherkang.description: Where the Heroic Dusk ride smaller drakes, these creatures were rumoured to have come to Qina while she was developing her icy magics and repentful devotions upon snow-covered mountains. Bred to thrive in the cold, they bring down icy defeat upon any whom their riders target.

e.griphornis-feathers.name: Griphornis Feathers
e.griphornis-feathers.effects:
Pennaceous Plumage (Feathers): 8% chance to proc 2900 Physical damage; +18750 damage vs Guild Raids; +450 damage per Griphornis set item worn
Set Bonus (Griphornis Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +70% Crit Damage
e.griphornis-feathers.description: IV(b). Briskly strutting in the street, Helmo grabbed his wide-brimmed hat hanging halfway down his back and raised it to his head. Cursing under his breath, he flipped a coin to a nearby vendor as he grabbed an apple, and bit into it as he kept his stride. Realizing that his coin-purse was running low, Helmo knew he would need to find a game of dice to replenish it, before diving into a higher stakes gamble to make up the funds he owed.

c.blue-mihr-lantern.name: Blue Mihr Lantern
c.blue-mihr-lantern.description: The lanterns of Mihr are carried by the Citywatch to keep the city bright and safe.

c.thinned-brew-of-magics.name: Thinned Brew of Magics
c.thinned-brew-of-magics.description: There is no time to spread your roots, for the time to depart has arrived in spite of drinking to our health a thousand times over.

u.indigo-guild-kit-iii.name: Indigo Guild Kit III
u.indigo-guild-kit-iii.description: A small, tidy sack, purporting to carry goods from the same source Slygse gets her alchemical wares.
u.indigo-guild-kit-iii.effects: Open to obtain its contents (three of the chance drops)

e.pentwater-sabatons.name: Pentwater Sabatons
e.pentwater-sabatons.effects:
Blessed Boulder-Be (Sabatons): 8% chance to proc 120 Holy damage; +25 damage per Pentwater set item worn
Sanctified
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.pentwater-sabatons.description: VII. Despite Malaclaven's selfless acts to save his people, many dwarves refuse to acknowledge his deeds, owing largely to what they feel was his blasphemous roots and worshipping a Goddess that they deem to be human, and not of dwarven origin. Because of this, it is virtually anathema to suggest any dwarf should follow Chaunath.

u.sinah-vitality-spirit.name: Sinah Vitality Spirit
u.sinah-vitality-spirit.description: You cannot deny the style and class in the bottle's design, but you do wish it did a better job of keeping the orange liquid stoppered inside.

u.greater-healing-potion.name: Greater Healing Potion
u.greater-healing-potion.description: You can't seem to explain it, but despite being stored in a saddlebag all day, the bottle containing this potion is still distinctly warm to the touch.

e.vibrant-band.name: Vibrant Band
e.vibrant-band.effects:
Colours of Creation (Band): 24% chance to proc 180 Magic damage; +20 Magic damage per Vibrant Victors set item worn; 2% chance to proc 800 Physical damage; +200 Physical damage per Vibrant Victors set item worn
Set Bonus (Vibrant Victors Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +5 Vitality, +5 Energy, +5 Honor and additional bonuses (depending on Main-Hand/Off-Hand equipped)
e.vibrant-band.description: You can't help but notice how the colours on this ring seem to shift as you turn it over on your finger. You catch Peleg watching you as you do so, a knowing look on his face.

c.blue-naitour-helm.name: Blue Naitour Helm
c.blue-naitour-helm.description: A helm worn by the fallen defenders of Fort Naitour.

e.blazen-swiftslicer-turtle.name: Blazen Swiftslicer Turtle
e.blazen-swiftslicer-turtle.effects:
Glorious Flaming Blades (Turtle): 3% chance to proc 8,000 Physical damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 30%; +1,500 Physical damage per Blazen Swiftslicer set item worn
Set Bonus (Blazen Swiftslicer Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +0.25% Evasion
 9+: +1.75% Evasion
e.blazen-swiftslicer-turtle.description: You were pleasantly surprised at how swiftly the earlier turtle had moved, and wonder if the new 'heated seats' offered on this upgraded model will make your experience all the more invigorating.

c.tainted-arrow.name: Tainted Arrow
c.tainted-arrow.description: A lead-tipped arrow that appears to drive its receiver mad with rage.

ba.heroic-chevalier-banner.name: Heroic Chevalier Banner
ba.heroic-chevalier-banner.description: Obtained with the Heroic Chevalier Class

u.perch-filet.name: Perch Filet
u.perch-filet.description: As soon as you started preparing this for lunch, Alanis started into a lecture on the benefits of various oils and nutrients. You opted to hand it over to Fagli to prepare, and hoped for the best.

preReqs.name: resource
preReqs.errorMsg: Your health and vitality are full already.

e.gipantan-dockhand-club.name: Gipantan Dockhand Club
e.gipantan-dockhand-club.effects:
Barrel Hoister (Club): 15% chance to proc 100 Dark damage; +100 damage per Gipantan Dockhand set item worn; +300 damage vs Aquatic raids; +15 Energy
Set Bonus (Gipantan Dockhand Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +10 Energy
 8+: +20 Energy
e.gipantan-dockhand-club.description:
"We keep clubs handy for protection, especially after dark. I end up using mine more often to knock on the sides of ships coming in at bad angles."
-Broff Keghaul

e.scolfields-bodice.name: Scolfield's Bodice
e.scolfields-bodice.effects:
+30 Vitality; +30 Energy; +30 Honor
Set Bonus (Scolfield Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1 Tiers of 'Discerning Vision', 'Astute Observation' and 'Precise Inspection'
 9+: +1 Tiers of 'Discerning Vision', 'Astute Observation' and 'Precise Inspection'
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.scolfields-bodice.description:
"Her decision to become the patron of such a slipshod group as those Cumberworld folk is hers alone, strange though it may seem... I'm certain it comes with appropriate benefits and privileges worthy of her station, for my Lady is certainly no fool!"
-Scolfield Retainer

ba.glorious-archdruid-banner.name: Glorious Archdruid Banner
ba.glorious-archdruid-banner.description: Obtained with the Glorious Archdruid Class

e.vildmand-platefur-axes.name: Vildmand Platefur Axes
e.vildmand-platefur-axes.effects:
Armored And Algid (Axes): 20% chance to proc 525 Physical damage; +250 damage per Vildmand Platefur set item worn; +1% Crit Rate; +25% Crit Damage; 15% chance to proc 300 Physical damage and add +30% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Vildmand Platefur Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1.5% Crit Rate and +10% Crit Damage
 6+: +10% Ice Resistance
 7+: +100 HP and +2,000 Defence
 8+: 5% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 20%
 9+: +30% Crit Damage and 75% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 5%
e.vildmand-platefur-axes.description: You've heard plenty of stories of folks who can accurately throw axes at targets, evening while moving. You had not figured that such blades would weigh so much that you almost need two hands to wield them, though.

e.psyguard-bulwark-sabatons.name: Psyguard Bulwark Sabatons
e.psyguard-bulwark-sabatons.effects:
Guardian's Mind (Sabatons): 12% chance to proc 1,000 Psychic damage; +500 damage per Psyguard Bulwark set item worn; +25 HP; +40 Magic
Set Bonus (Psyguard Bulwark Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +10 Max HP on all Commanders and +10 Reserve Cap on all Troops
6: +1% Crit Rate and +15% Crit Damage
 7+: +10 Reserve Cap on all Troops and +1,000 Defence
 8+: 10% chance to reduce damage to your Armies by 50%
 9+: +1 Formation Protection Value
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.psyguard-bulwark-sabatons.description:
"Once you are more experienced with these powers, distance becomes irrelevant and your need to wander about afoot will significantly decrease. However, at the pace you're developing... You'd best hope that those boots are comfortable."
-Morah Psyguard

e.blazebrand-bastion.name: Blazebrand Bastion
e.blazebrand-bastion.effects:
Justice by any Flames Necessary (Bastion): 14% chance to proc 800 Fire damage; +275 damage per Blazebrand set item worn; 4% chance to proc 1,175 Fire damage; +650 damage per Blazebrand set item worn; +4% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Blazebrand Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 8+: +2.5% Crit Rate
 9+: 40% chance to proc 250 Fire damage, +8 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Fire' and +1 Tiers of 'Insurmountable Offence'
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.blazebrand-bastion.description:
"Looking through the fire, you can watch what is being rendered to ash, and predict what can rise from the flames."
-Urzul Shamn

e.byhew-gloves.name: Byhew Gloves
e.byhew-gloves.effects:
Springtime Renewal (Gloves): 7% chance to proc 700 Nature damage; +1,500 damage vs Winter raids
Set Bonus (Byhew Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 8+: +3% Crit Rate and +30% Crit Damage
e.byhew-gloves.description: While honoured during the season of renewal, the Byhew customs tend to take place in the autumn months.

e.phermitic-battlegarb-greaves.name: Phermitic Battlegarb Greaves
e.phermitic-battlegarb-greaves.effects:
The Wisdom in War (Greaves): 12% chance to proc 140 Physical damage; +80 damage per Phermitic Battlegarb set item worn; +0.25% Evasion
Sanctified
Set Bonus (Phermitic Battlegarb Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +15% Crit Damage
 8+: +2% Crit Rate and +2 Tiers of 'Prolonged Battle'
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.phermitic-battlegarb-greaves.description: VII. Cynical Ankyabu scoffed before presenting her piece, which also laid out the Gods but in much less flattering lights. Skirfmir creating strange, misshapen stone creations, Eptiades sabotaging Derzis' attempt to calm a storm, and Amera destroying entire cities in a furious rage. The images almost seemed alive within Ankyabu's weavings, and the quality she had produced was certainly no less fine than Phermis' own.

e.alchemical-artisan-head.name: Alchemical Artisan Head
e.alchemical-artisan-head.effects:
Explosive Eccentricities (Head): 8% chance to proc 500 Nature damage; +250 damage per Alchemical Artisan set item worn; 12% chance to proc 500 Fire damage; +125 damage per Alchemical Artisan set item worn; +3% Dark Resistance; +3% Ice Resistance
Set Bonus (Alchemical Artisan Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1% Crit Rate and +20% Crit Damage
 7+: 2% chance to proc 25,000 Acid damage
 8+: +2 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Nature' and 'Elemental Expertise - Fire'
 9+: +5% Dark Resistance, +5% Ice Resistance and +2% Crit Rate
e.alchemical-artisan-head.description: V. One adventure began, much like many before, with a rumour of a magical stone that would grant immense wealth to any who found it. While the story tickled something in the back of her mind Nahla insisted on joining her party on the quest, which only became all-the-more real when they uncovered a map that was said to lead to its location. Something stirred within Nahla, and she was overcome with an intense longing to possess the stone, but she refused to share these desires with her comrades.

a.focused-guild-servant.name: Focused Guild Servant
a.focused-guild-servant.description: After some hard-earned concentration, these servants have regained their focus.

c.orange-frigidara-defence-banner.name: Orange Frigidara Defence Banner
c.orange-frigidara-defence-banner.description: A banner intended to both rally troops to stave off Frigidara’s invasion, and to announce details about her horde’s locations. Aegyr truly seems to have thought of everything in this never-ending watch of his.

a.vozotl-latris.name: Vozotl Latris
a.vozotl-latris.description: Some gifted acolytes of the temple of Vozotl train almost exclusively in healing and defensive arts. You are persistently astounded at fire being used for either, but you can't argue with results.
a.vozotl-latris.effects: Adds +0.4 Defence to Kornere Warmbelt and Hiereus Rillie in the active Formation

e.chiffon-cap.name: Chiffon Cap
e.chiffon-cap.effects:
Downy Delight (Cap): 40% chance to proc 255 Holy damage; +3750 damage vs Guild Raids; +90 damage per Chiffon set item worn
Set Bonus (Chiffon Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +4% All Resistances; 1% chance to heal the Player 3 HP
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.chiffon-cap.description: III(b). After considerable persuading, Helci convinced her husband to relocate them to an old, abandoned cabin, where she began her communion with the land. She would spend most of her days deep in the heart of the forest, but in return would find she could easily locate berries, fruit and other edible material, which she was able to provide to her family as fare. The work was draining, however, and her home relationships began to suffer.

c.chicken-thigh.name: Chicken Thigh
c.chicken-thigh.description: There's no debating that the classics are culinary staples for a reason. However, after Fagli was heard asking for some of these, you began to question both the origin, and the name, of the meat...

c.blue-squidlet.name: Blue Squidlet
c.blue-squidlet.description: As cute as this colourful creature may seem, Alanis has assured you that the bright tones are indicative of highly potent venom.

u.herb-heroic-hewing-potion.name: Herb Heroic Hewing Potion
u.herb-heroic-hewing-potion.effects: +1% Crit Rate and +10% Offence vs Flora Raids for 4 hours

a.mero-naghezn.name: Mero Naghezn
a.mero-naghezn.description: While he describes himself as a lover as opposed to a fighter, Mero also claims he has spent most of his life as an outcast from the realms of both Elf and Man, leading to him forming the mercenary band infamously known as the Band of Two-Sons. He commands an unparalleled degree of respect from his men, and his forces are rumoured to be capable of defeating forces five times their number, while sustaining negligible losses.
a.mero-naghezn.effects: Twice as Bright: 5% chance to proc 250 Physical damage

u.red-brewmasters-mental-mixture.name: Red Brewmaster's Mental Mixture
u.red-brewmasters-mental-mixture.description:
"I've aimed to improve sharpness of mind... though sharpness in taste may have been a side-effect..."
-Nphireo

m.boiling-deluge.name: Boiling Deluge
m.boiling-deluge.description: Sometimes straightforward tactics, like blasting a foe with flame or knocking them back with a burst of water, are insufficient to stop a powerful threat. In these cases, combining your skills may prove most effective.
m.boiling-deluge.effects: Boiling Deluge: 40% chance to proc [up-to-20]% Nature damage, plus 500 Fire damage

u.cruel-devils-chest.name: Cruel Devil's Chest
u.cruel-devils-chest.description: A demonstration of your prowess in staving off the self-proclaimed General of Cruelty, you have earned the right to claim the source of his power.

cp.tank-starter-pack-ii.name: Tank Starter Pack II
cp.tank-starter-pack-ii.description: A pack providing the necessary tools for every budding tank.

e.darkveil-guide.name: Darkveil Guide
e.darkveil-guide.effects: Shadow in the Tunnel: 4% chance to proc 4875 Dark damage vs Undead raids; +1% Crit Rate; +24% Crit Damage
e.darkveil-guide.description:
"The path through the Darkveil is frought with peril, and it takes a willing guide to truly overcome those obstacles."
-Vittamar

e.blazebrand-kindler.name: Blazebrand Kindler
e.blazebrand-kindler.effects:
Justice by any Flames Necessary (Kindler): 40% chance to proc 225 Fire damage; +50 damage per Blazebrand set item worn; 5% chance to proc 2,200 Fire damage; +1,100 damage per Blazebrand set item worn; +2.5% Crit Rate; +12% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Blazebrand Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 8+: +2.5% Crit Rate
 9+: 40% chance to proc 250 Fire damage, +8 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Fire' and +1 Tiers of 'Insurmountable Offence'
e.blazebrand-kindler.description:
"Stoke the fire... Make more, and make bigger."
-Plyzz

m.thrust.name: Thrust
m.thrust.description: A staple to every magician's arsenal is the means to keep their targets at a distance. It sure would be nice if this would do more than knock them a few feet back, but sometimes 'quick and easy' gets the job done.
m.thrust.effects: Thrust: 10% chance to proc [up-to-70]% Magic damage

u.violet-swiftness-tonic.name: Violet Swiftness Tonic
u.violet-swiftness-tonic.description:
An old legend tells of two colleagues exploring a dense forest, before happening upon a bear. When the bear gives chase, they both flee as swiftly as their feet will carry them. One of the colleagues pauses to quaff a draught from a small glass beaker. "You'll never be able to evade the bear forever, so why waste time with a last drink?!" His partner questioned incredulously.

"I need not escape the bear forever, ol' chum! I need only dodge its advances longer than you!"
u.violet-swiftness-tonic.effects: Increases Evasion equivalent to +30,000 Agility for 6 hours

cp.tank-starter-pack-iv.name: Tank Starter Pack IV
cp.tank-starter-pack-iv.description: A pack providing the necessary materials for every budding tank.

e.embersin-plate.name: Embersin Plate
e.embersin-plate.effects:
+6% Fire Resistance; +20 HP
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.embersin-plate.description: II. Legend describes Saijeor's first slaying of a dragon when he was still a boy, cutting the throat of a wicked youngling that had forayed into his village and had already slain several men in its hunger. Some of the tales describe the battle as fierce, with Saijeor suffering permanent, scarring injuries, while others claim he suffered not a scratch. In either case, Saijeor's name and reputation quickly spread after the event.

e.onishaygu-tendril-javelin.name: Onishaygu Tendril Javelin
e.onishaygu-tendril-javelin.effects:
Wild Sprout (Javelin): 10% chance to proc 700 Nature damage; +350 damage per Onishaygu Tendril set item worn; +0.75% Crit Rate; +30 Vitality
Set Bonus (Onishaygu Tendril Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +50 HP
 7+: +2 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Nature'
 8+: +40 Vitality and +40 Honour
 9+: +200 Energy
e.onishaygu-tendril-javelin.description:
"Nobody has ever said you need to approach a threat to put it down, so why start now?"
-Alagbato

u.energy-potion-concentrate.name: Energy Potion Concentrate
u.energy-potion-concentrate.description:
"Side effects may include a racing heart, faintness of breath, dizziness, flushed face, migraines and death.... And you're saying the energy granted by this elixir is still worth the risk?!"
-Conversation with Nphireo

e.colossal-crusherclaw-helm.name: Colossal Crusherclaw Helm
e.colossal-crusherclaw-helm.effects:
Colossal Pressure Crush (Helm): 5% chance to proc 3000 Physical damage; +50000 damage vs Guild Raids; +1100 damage per Colossal Crusherclaw set item worn; 25% chance to proc 400 Nature damage; +400 damage per Colossal Crusherclaw set item worn
Set Bonus (Colossal Crusherclaw Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +1 Formation Protection Value
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion

e.kitchen-apron.name: Kitchen Apron
e.kitchen-apron.effects:
+4 HP; +5% Poison Resistance
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.kitchen-apron.description: A simple apron worn by a hearty people, it shouldn't be too surprising that it can double as armor in the face of a sudden raiding party.

e.claws-of-justice-band.name: Claws of Justice Band
e.claws-of-justice-band.effects:
Hooked Hearing (Band): 10% chance to proc 600 Holy damage; +300 damage per Claws of Justice set item worn; +2% Formation Bonus; +0.5% Evasion
Set Bonus (Claws of Justice Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +25% Formation Bonus and +1 Tiers of 'Experienced Leader'
e.claws-of-justice-band.description:
"Wearing that ring means you pledge to pursue justice and bravely lead your followers. Are you up to these tasks?"
-Janagud

c.hatched-egg.name: Hatched Egg
c.hatched-egg.description: Your feelings are mixed in collecting the remains of this egg; on one hand, the properties of the egg could be valuable in stopping such beasts in the future. On the other hand, it is a testament to your failing to prevent it from hatching in the first place.

c.green-dragonslayer-gem.name: Green Dragonslayer Gem
c.green-dragonslayer-gem.description: This fine, magical, green gem resonates in proximity to the Blade of Mestari. What could the connection be between these two artifacts?

a.vanduin-leafveil.name: Vanduin Leafveil
a.vanduin-leafveil.description:
"If you ever require the best price available on any ware I can get my hands on, just let me know! In the meantime, how would you care to assist me in getting my goods to their next locale?"
-Vanduin Leafveil
a.vanduin-leafveil.effects: Adds +1 Attack and +2 Defence to any Merchant's Aid and Elven Bodyguard Troops in the Formation

e.consecrated-leoegan-akontia.name: Consecrated Leoegan Akontia
e.consecrated-leoegan-akontia.effectName: At the Please of the Gods (Akontia)
e.consecrated-leoegan-akontia.effects:
At the Please of the Gods (Akontia): 14% chance to proc 750 Holy damage; +250 damage per Consecrated Leoegan set item worn; +1% Crit Rate; +40 HP
Consecrated
e.consecrated-leoegan-akontia.description: XVIII. Taken aback by the sight, it took Paython several moments to realize that this was Amera's golden chariot, with which She pulled the sun across the sky each day. Never would Paython have imagined he'd lay eyes upon such a wonder, though he looked around questioningly for Amera, Herself, but realized he was alone, save for the steeds.

c.blue-devils-artifact.name: Blue Devil's Artifact
c.blue-devils-artifact.description: A powerful artifact from the belt of one of Skliros' followers, clearly demonstrating your capability and courage.

a.heroic-dusk-striker.name: Heroic Dusk Striker
a.heroic-dusk-striker.description:
"Evil seeks to hide in the shadows, and it can take force to drive it back. I mean to make it fear the dark, for it is the dark that comes for it."
-Sir Tybalt
a.heroic-dusk-striker.effects: Adds +8 Attack to Sir Tybalt of the Heroic Dusk in the active Formation

e.picaroons-cutlass.name: Picaroon's Cutlass
e.picaroons-cutlass.effects:
Swabby Sealover (Cutlass): 12% chance to proc 200 Physical damage; +50 damage per Picaroon's Raiments set item worn; +300 damage vs Human raids; +1% Crit Rate; +5% Crit Damage; Deals 100 Physical damage on Crits
Set Bonus (Picaroon's Raiment Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +2% Crit Rate
 7+: +25% Crit Damage
e.picaroons-cutlass.description:
"Arrr, now surrender or face me steel, you landlu- Wait, where are you going?"
-Conversations with an Alanis who appears to be walking away and pretending not to know you.

e.reodai-arcana.name: Reodai Arcana
e.reodai-arcana.effects:
Sixth Sensibilities (Arcana): 10% chance to proc 700 Magic damage; +350 damage per Reodai set item worn; +2% Crit Rate; +20% Crit Damage; +250 Magic
Set Bonus (Reodai Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: Additional Bonuses depending on Mount equipped
e.reodai-arcana.description: Unlike the quarterstaff, this staff seems much more lopsided and difficult to handle. Alanis said something about how its mystical energies were amazingly balanced, but you suspect she was just making fun of you, again.

u.greater-poison-resilience-potion.name: Greater Poison Resilience Potion
u.greater-poison-resilience-potion.description: A frothy, mesmerizing potion that smells of the ideal seasoning of fennel.

u.large-healing-potion.name: Large Healing Potion
u.large-healing-potion.description:
"Is there anything more to this than simply the volume of potion you're expecting me to drink?"

"Of coooourse there is.... now bottom's up!"
-Conversations with Nphireo

c.nepyren-tumblerstone.name: Nepyren Tumblerstone
c.nepyren-tumblerstone.description: A piece of rare, mountain stone that is prevalently used in the fashioning of secure locking mechanisms. You’re sure you could use this to help seal something away.

u.copper-codex-of-wisdom.name: Copper Codex of Wisdom
u.copper-codex-of-wisdom.description: Every now and again a rare gem among literature appears, conveying experience beyond its ken, capable of both inspiring future generations to greatness and reminding them of the lessons of history. The wisdom delivered by such works is invaluable, and should never be taken for granted.

c.tromos-ink-cap.name: Tromos Ink Cap
c.tromos-ink-cap.description: A rare fungus, it is known for producing a dark ink used by assassins due to its innocuous nature yet deadly application. In small doses, it can apparently be used to help treat acute pain. More amusingly, the ink apparently glows in the dark, making it useful in caves and tunnels.

c.elven-leather.name: Elven Leather
c.elven-leather.description: Cured by the finest leather-workers, this leather seems unparalleled in design.

a.sollemnia-verus.name: Sollemnia Verus
a.sollemnia-verus.description:
"Have you considered routine worship of Vozotl as part of your daily regiment? He bestows gifts upon his most sincere followers, and they are hardly trifling in nature."
-Sollemnia Verus
a.sollemnia-verus.effects: Vozotl's Gift: 0.1% chance to proc 300,000 Fire damage and heal the Player 3 HP; Adds +1 Defence to each Mastru Infantry, Mastru Defender and Vozotl Votary in the Formation

m.burning-rain.name: Burning Rain
m.burning-rain.description: They say it rains upon the just and the unjust alike... That being said, the wise may choose to cover themselves when flaming rocks hail down from the sky, while the unwise stare and wonder at this terrifying anomaly of nature.
m.burning-rain.effects: Burning Rain: 35% chance to proc [up-to-18]% Fire damage, plus 50 Fire damage

a.weeg.name: Weeg
a.weeg.description: Surprisingly robust, both for a self-proclaimed researcher and for a goblin, Weeg certainly seems prepared to scale these terrifying rock faces in order to find the subject of his studies, and he appears equally ready to drop all kinds of unpleasantness upon those happening to be below him.
a.weeg.effects: Impish Investigator: 12% chance to proc 2,450 Dark damage; Adds +5 Attack to each Achedimia Assistant in the Formation

a.warpriest-emmus.name: Warpriest Emmus
a.warpriest-emmus.description: While he wears the armor of his deity well, Emmus seems far more proficient as a healer than as a defender. You suppose the two can go hand in hand, but as you watch him deftly weave between his units, restoring their vitality and relieving their fatigue, you certainly aren't going to complain.
a.warpriest-emmus.effects: Shield of the Weak: 4% chance to proc 62,500 Holy damage; 3% chance on 20x attacks to heal each active Troop +2 Reserves

c.blue-dragonslayer-gem.name: Blue Dragonslayer Gem
c.blue-dragonslayer-gem.description: This fine, magical, blue gem resonates in proximity to the Blade of Mestari. What could the connection be between these two artifacts?

e.mirays-lance.name: Miray's Lance
e.mirays-lance.description: I. The scent of dust and dried blood woke Miray as it had a thousand thousand times before, and she squinted as a ray of bright light shone through the small, barred window of her room. There was nothing remarkable about this day, and yet Miray knew it was to be the most remarkable day of her existence thus far. Sitting up and dropping her legs off of the stone slab, Miray yawned, her mind slowly recognizing the gravity that rested upon this day as she wiped the sleep from her eyes. She heard the metallic clangs from the practice yard, and knew that it would soon be her time to warm her muscles… only it would be for the last time.

e.blazen-swiftslicer-head.name: Blazen Swiftslicer Head
e.blazen-swiftslicer-head.effects:
Glorious Flaming Blades (Head): 24% chance to proc 900 Fire damage vs Winter raids; +200 Fire damage per Blazen Swiftslicer set item worn; +1.2% Evasion
Set Bonus (Blazen Swiftslicer Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +0.25% Evasion
 9+: +1.75% Evasion
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.blazen-swiftslicer-head.description: After having been knocked around while wearing the earlier version of this, you've come to recognize the value in the protective headwear. Hopefully this upgrade serves you as well.

e.baron-aureus-pants.name: Baron Aureus' Pants
e.baron-aureus-pants.effects:
Golden Noble (Pants): 5% chance to proc 1,800 Physical damage; +1,275 damage per Baron Aureus' set item worn; +25 Magic; +20 HP
Set Bonus (Baron Aureus' Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +175 HP and +25% Crit Damage
 6+: +1.5% Crit Rate
 7+: +5% All Resistances
 8+: +1 Tiers of 'Keen Eyes'
 9+: Additional Bonuses depending on Mount equipped
e.baron-aureus-pants.description:
"If ye' can't keep yer bits safe, yer line'll only be useful until ye drop."
-Ramor Metalborn

c.red-mihr-lantern.name: Red Mihr Lantern
c.red-mihr-lantern.description: The lanterns of Mihr are carried by the Citywatch to keep the city bright and safe.

c.red-blasting-stinger.name: Red Blasting Stinger
c.red-blasting-stinger.description: It remains unclear what the greater challenge was: Bringing down the original owner of this stinger, or removing it while keeping all of your fingers.

a.arun-iarlynn.name: Arun Iarlynn
a.arun-iarlynn.description: Flanked by an unruly number of retainers, this young elf hails from a noble house in the northern forests, where he has received some of the best training and education his people could offer. Despite his relatively-sheltered upbringing, Arun was enamored by tales of combat, and particularly the tactics and strategies used by the great commanders. You are a mildly concerned that his enthusiasm for war - which clearly demonstrates a lack of experience in the heat of real combat on the field - may lead to him putting himself in unnecessary danger, but his numerous retainers seem ready to keep their young master safe, alongside his unusually capable manner of both receiving and predicting direction given to him.
a.arun-iarlynn.effects: Nosatra Veneration: 25% chance to proc 3,200 Nature damage; +80 damage per distinct Commander owned; 8% chance to proc 5,800 Physical damage; +135 damage per distinct Commander owned; Adds +12 Attack to every Commander in the active Formation; Adds +10 Attack and +0.5 Defence to every Troop in the active Formation; Adds +15% Formation Bonus; Gains +0.75 Attack per distinct Commander owned; Gains +0.05 Defence per distinct Commander owned

u.marinara-potion.name: Marinara Potion
u.marinara-potion.description:
"Alchemists put a lot more effort into their concoctions than merely 'raiding their cabinets', Farmer. I'd wager the freshest ingredients went into this brew, and not some leftovers from a rack."
-Conversations with Alanis, within eyeshot of an exasperated Fagli
u.marinara-potion.effects: +2% Crit Rate and +10% Offence vs Tunnanu for 12 hours

e.millennium-island-ring.name: Millennium Island Ring
e.millennium-island-ring.effects:
Last Everlasting (Ring): 30% chance to proc 200 Nature damage; +150 damage per Millennium Island set item worn; +25 HP; +3% All Resistances
Set Bonus (Millennium Island Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +100 HP, +1 Tiers of 'Immoveable Object' and +1 Tiers of 'Hearty Constitution'
e.millennium-island-ring.description: The first time you saw the Seafarer approaching, shell breaching the waters, you didn't think too much of it. Then it continued approaching, and you began to wonder if your sense of scale was askew. Only after it kept approaching for almost another minute did the true scope of the creature become clear.

c.blue-devils-horn.name: Blue Devil's Horn
c.blue-devils-horn.description: The mark of a fallen demon is supposedly both a blessing and a curse; no mere mortal is intended to lay eyes upon such a thing.

c.violet-undamaged-retina.name: Violet Undamaged Retina
c.violet-undamaged-retina.description: Removing this thin membrane from the Watcher, undamaged, was terribly exacting. You can only hope it pays off.

u.greater-potion-of-tenacity.name: Greater Potion of Tenacity
u.greater-potion-of-tenacity.description: IV. It was pure happenstance that caused his path to cross with a young Paladin-in-training, and it was after hearing about this Orc's stubborn refusals to give up, despite his unyielding terror, that a solution illuminated for Shou Royce.
u.greater-potion-of-tenacity.effects: +25,000 Defence vs Guild Raids for 12 hours

a.gipantan-groom.name: Gipantan Groom
a.gipantan-groom.description: An animal handler from Gipanta, you are quickly corrected when you refer to them as a 'stableboy', and notice that these handlers seem to get along with your various mounts, and your naga companions, better than you.
a.gipantan-groom.effects: Adds +4 Attack and +0.2 Defence to Shana Copperfox in the active Formation

u.valto-grapes.name: Valto Grapes
u.valto-grapes.description: Bursting with sweet, juicy flavour, these make for great snacks to eat while adventuring.

preReqs.name: resource
preReqs.errorMsg: Your health and energy are full already.

a.magestalker-knight.name: Magestalker Knight
a.magestalker-knight.description: Almost as devoted to seeking out stray magicians as Avtan, these living kits of armor certainly seem well suited to the task.

c.red-seared-stone.name: Red Seared Stone
c.red-seared-stone.description: Strangely colourful stones, you expect they could be used to help practice new maneuvers with your armies.

e.chaunaths-warpriests-sign.name: Chaunath's Warpriests Sign
e.chaunaths-warpriests-sign.effects:
Shield of Deities (Sign): 15% chance to proc 1,240 Magic damage; +470 damage per Chaunath's Warpriests set item worn; +40 HP; 10% chance to reduce incoming damage to your Armies by 10%
Sanctified
Set Bonus (Chaunath's Warpriests Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: 5% chance on 20x attacks to heal each active Troop +1 Reserve
 6+: +2% Crit Rate and +15% Crit Damage
 7+: 4% chance on 20x attacks to heal each active Commander +2 HP
 8+: +15% Formation Bonus and 10% chance to reduce incoming damage to your armies by 30%
 9+: 4% chance on 20x attacks to heal each active Troop +3 Reserves and proc 8% of your Leadership stat in Holy damage
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.chaunaths-warpriests-sign.description:
"Her shield is Her word, and you carry both whenever you stand firm against those who would prey upon the helpless."
-Warpriest Orghash

ba.zen-master-banner.name: Zen Master Banner
ba.zen-master-banner.description: Obtained with the Zen Master Class

m.glaciate.name: Glaciate
m.glaciate.description:
"After all your talk about creating ice shields and defences, I would have thought your magics would be a little more... defensive."

"Evidently you listen as well as Glaciver. Our warding magics are imbued into things, while our potent frost magics were crafted to deal with those foes we've left struggling in frosty futility."
-Conversations with Aisi Tushar
m.glaciate.effects: Glaciate: 4% chance to proc [up-to-225]% Ice damage

e.thunderbirds-moccasins.name: Thunderbird's Moccasins
e.thunderbirds-moccasins.effects:
Graced by Thunder (Moccasins): 24% chance to proc 500 Lightning damage; +25 damage per Thunderbird set item worn; +0.5% Evasion
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.thunderbirds-moccasins.description: "These moccasins are a traditional footwear, worn by those who have lived under, served, hunted and loved the Thunderbird for generations. Your initial skepticism aside, they seem both comfortable and practical, so you've little to complain about."

u.rogues-elixir.name: Rogue's Elixir
u.rogues-elixir.description: The essence of the rogue, distilled and purified, empowers this elixir. You can only imagine the power it is able to bestow.
u.rogues-elixir.effects: Open to obtain its contents (two of the chance drops)

c.giant-nepyren-acanthosaur-egg.name: Giant Nepyren Acanthosaur Egg
c.giant-nepyren-acanthosaur-egg.description: It takes a rare creature to lay this rarer-still egg, but the nutritional properties contained within would do wonders for any numbers of soldiers.

c.training-arms.name: Training Arms
c.training-arms.description:
"Can't have new recruits training with real weapons just yet... they're more like to hurt themselves than their enemies!"

You aren't entirely sure what Hamond intended with his warning, but in either case you know well to heed his advice.

a.veteran-gnomish-frigidara-defender.name: Veteran Gnomish Frigidara Defender
a.veteran-gnomish-frigidara-defender.description:
"I've heard some of you suggest that revenge is best served cold. What kind of primitives must you be to prefer your food cold?"
-Bellas Inahice
a.veteran-gnomish-frigidara-defender.effects: Adds +5 Attack to Aegyr Snowbound, Bellas Inahice and Burz in the active Formation

e.cultists-runic-boots.name: Cultists' Runic Boots
e.cultists-runic-boots.effects:
Dark Runic Ritual (Boots): 16% chance to proc 66 Dark damage; +20 damage per Cultist's Runic set item worn; +54 damage vs Human raids
Set Bonus (Cultist's Runic Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +1 Tiers of 'Arcane Defence - Venom'
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.cultists-runic-boots.description: V. "It ssstill doesss not make sssenssse... To have enough power to raissse a fallen dragon like thisss... that was power assscribed to Thotssaken herssself! Perhapsss that ssshadowed figure had sssomething to do with thisss..."

e.smugglers-bullwhip.name: Smuggler's Bullwhip
e.smugglers-bullwhip.effects:
River's Bounty (Bullwhip): 16% chance to proc 200 Physical damage; +25 damage per Smuggler's set item worn; +12% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Smuggler's Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +2 Tiers of 'Evasive Maneuvers'
e.smugglers-bullwhip.description:
"When you're part of my crew, you learn fast: I'll tell ya' once, and only once."
-Pael Habre

u.mercenarys-elixir.name: Mercenary's Elixir
u.mercenarys-elixir.description: An elixir possessing the prowess of the brawniest mercenaries, capable of expanding your mind to new horizons.

a.eloko-wingless.name: Eloko Wingless
a.eloko-wingless.description: This strange being can't help but draw your stares, and while he may seem pleased with the extra attention, after you witnessed him rip a naga's throat almost clear out of its body with his teeth, you suspect that his pleasant smile may not mean quite what you think it does...
a.eloko-wingless.effects: Faerie Fulah: 6% chance to proc 20,000 Magic damage; Adds +5 Attack and +0.1 Defence to each Fae Commander in the active Formation

c.nobilitys-gratitude.name: Nobility's Gratitude
c.nobilitys-gratitude.description: The gratitude of the upper classes is only shown to those whose deeds have circulated amongst the entire realm, and whose virtues are unbesmirched.

e.irus-shroud-crusade-shield.name: Irus' Shroud Crusade Shield
e.irus-shroud-crusade-shield.effects:
Forward Irus' Light (Shield): 20% chance to proc 400 Holy damage; +300 damage per Irus' Shroud Crusade set item worn; +1,200 damage vs Demon raids; +5% All Resistances; +80 HP
Consecrated
Set Bonus (Irus' Shroud Crusade Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1.5% Crit Rate and +15% Crit Damage
 6+: +4 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Holy'
 7+: +10% Formation Bonus
 8+: +5% All Resistances
 9+: +15% Crit Damage and +10% Formation Bonus
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.irus-shroud-crusade-shield.description:
"It's important to have a tool that you can use to protect yourself from the unworthy beings plaguing the land. Alternatively, you can hit them with it."
-Umhilda Strongshield

c.orange-cloak.name: Orange Cloak
c.orange-cloak.description: A cloak made of fine materials and brilliantly coloured threads... You wonder what led to that creature possessing it.

u.lancer-starter-pack-ii.name: Lancer Starter Pack II
u.lancer-starter-pack-ii.description: A pack providing the necessary tools for every budding lancer.

c.widowmaker-shroom.name: Widowmaker Shroom
c.widowmaker-shroom.description: While unusually small and not much to look at, the flavour that exploded in your mouth upon biting down on this was amazing. Strangely, you have no idea how it got its na-

a.grave-replugger.name: Grave Replugger
a.grave-replugger.description: While it is quite common to see employ for digging graves, finding someone who is paid to fill-in recently-vacated graves is much less likely.

e.urvogel-sickles.name: Urvogel Sickles
e.urvogel-sickles.effects:
Primitive Plumage (Sickles): 8% chance to proc 950 Physical damage; +6,250 damage vs Guild Raids; +100 damage per Urvogel set item worn; +1% Crit Rate
Set Bonus (Urvogel Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +25% Crit Damage
e.urvogel-sickles.description: XVI. As Ceta began spending more time outside the bandit hideout, she began feeling an indescribable yearning to travel to the depths of the nearby mountain forest, and though she staved off these feelings, the pull of the woods continued to weigh on her. They eventually overcame her good sense, and she spuriously set out to find whatever was driving these strange sensations.

a.repentant-dusk-cover.name: Repentant Dusk Cover
a.repentant-dusk-cover.description:
"A small number of the Heroic Dusk followed me when I left, but this Order primarily came about as a result of our shared values, faith and pursuits. We do not apologize for the founding of our Order, though we do seek repentance for each of our perceived misdeeds, and in doing so strengthen both our resolves and our powers."
-Sar Qina
a.repentant-dusk-cover.effects: Adds +0.8 Defence to Sar Qina of the Repentant Dusk in the active Formation

k.taunt.name: Taunt
k.taunt.effects: You Taunt the Raid, reducing the chance of it targeting your Armies by x% for the next y attacks. You take a bonus 50% damage from the Raid during that time.

u.robust-skill-elixir.name: Robust Skill Elixir
u.robust-skill-elixir.description: Distilled to its essence, this enhanced elixir can awaken your senses to previously-unseen heights.

e.vildmand-platefur-helmet.name: Vildmand Platefur Helmet
e.vildmand-platefur-helmet.effects:
Armored And Algid (Helmet): 10% chance to proc 300 Physical damage; +400 damage per Vildmand Platefur set item worn; +4% Ice Resistance; 5% chance to proc 400 Physical damage and add +2,000 Defence
Set Bonus (Vildmand Platefur Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1.5% Crit Rate and +10% Crit Damage
 6+: +10% Ice Resistance
 7+: +100 HP and +2,000 Defence
 8+: 5% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 20%
 9+: +30% Crit Damage and 75% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 5%
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.vildmand-platefur-helmet.description: You were inspecting how the horns were mounted on this helmet, until you realized that they came through from the inside. Which shouldn't make any sense, considering their size...

ba.eldritch-warrior-banner.name: Eldritch Warrior Banner
ba.eldritch-warrior-banner.description: Obtained with the Eldritch Warrior Class

a.orcish-dispeller.name: Orcish Dispeller
a.orcish-dispeller.description: Walking a contrary path to their summoner bretheren, these arcane adherents focus their arts on sending back those who have inappropriately come to this plane using the mystic arts.
a.orcish-dispeller.effects: Adds +1 Attack to Glasha Brunbruk in the active Formation

e.psyguard-bulwark-rhino.name: Psyguard Bulwark Rhino
e.psyguard-bulwark-rhino.effects:
Guardian's Mind (Rhino): 10% chance to proc 1,400 Physical damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 10% on that proc; +450 damage per Psyguard Bulwark set item worn; 8% chance to proc 950 Psychic damage and reduce incoming damage to your Armies by 25% on that proc; +350 damage per Psyguard Bulwark set item worn; +100 HP
Set Bonus (Psyguard Bulwark Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +10 Max HP on all Commanders and +10 Reserve Cap on all Troops
6: +1% Crit Rate and +15% Crit Damage
 7+: +10 Reserve Cap on all Troops and +1,000 Defence
 8+: 10% chance to reduce damage to your Armies by 50%
 9+: +1 Formation Protection Value
e.psyguard-bulwark-rhino.description: Perhaps the most naturally-armored creature you've had the pleasure of riding, it was only when you saw it levitating some grass and leaves to eat that you realized that there was much remaining that was unseen.

e.hammerclaw-helm.name: Hammerclaw Helm
e.hammerclaw-helm.effects:
Hammer Pressure (Helm): 5% chance to proc 600 Physical damage; +10000 damage vs Guild Raids; +150 damage per Hammerclaw set item worn
Set Bonus (Hammerclaw Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +0.5 Formation Protection Value
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.hammerclaw-helm.description: X. The boys concocted a story, describing a colossal, tentacled beast that attacked the shoreline, dragging their poor brother to his demise, and after hashing out some key details they reluctantly agreed that this would be the tale they told. However, that seed of doubt would soon spread its diseased roots, and far further than either boy could have imagined.

c.green-fae-candle.name: Green Fae Candle
c.green-fae-candle.description: The flame from this candle seems to dance in unnatural ways... Almost as unnatural as the hues of the flame, itself.

e.scaled-hood.name: Scaled Hood
e.scaled-hood.effects:
Cobra Gaze (Hood): 6% chance to proc 120 Poison damage; +2 Magic
Set Bonus (Scaled Robes Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +30 Magic
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.scaled-hood.description: I. In aeons past, in the depths of the lands now known as the Dark Realms, legends tell of a violent struggle between Ssarfraxss and Rhacel.

u.script-of-spiral-hail.name: Script of Spiral Hail
u.script-of-spiral-hail.description: "Shape the world in snow and freeze it still in ice! Spiral Hail!"
u.script-of-spiral-hail.effects: Deals 750,000 Ice damage vs Guild Raids

u.mastru-river-swigger.name: Mastru River Swigger
u.mastru-river-swigger.description: You've seen one of these on most every fishing boat on the river; it is apparently as traditional as nets and rods for the local fisherfolk.

preReqs.name: resource
preReqs.errorMsg: Your health and honor are full already.

e.shudder-sailors-bandana.name: Shudder Sailor's Bandana
e.shudder-sailors-bandana.effects:
Clooney's Consent (Bandana): 20% chance to proc 125 Dark damage; +25 damage per Shudder Sailor's set item worn; +7% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Shudder Sailor's Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: 20% chance to proc 500 Physical damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 20%
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.shudder-sailors-bandana.description:
"The beauty of Princess Penelope was beyond anything else in that city! How could her family chase me off like that!"

"Captain, you do realize that the wealthy nobility are the only ones able to afford such luxuries as beauty, right? And why should they want a pirate courting their maiden daughters..."

-Conversations with the crew of the Vengeance

e.dumvan-furs-fur-pants.name: Dumvan Furs Fur Pants
e.dumvan-furs-fur-pants.effects:
Brisk Buffer (Fur Pants): 17% chance to proc 60 Physical damage; +100 damage per Dumvan Furs set item worn; +340 damage vs Beast raids; +3% Ice Resistance; +10 HP
Set Bonus (Dumvan Furs Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +10% Ice Resistance
 7+: +80 HP
e.dumvan-furs-fur-pants.description:
"When you slip and fall, it's nice to have something to keep your backside covered."
-Shem

u.script-of-venom-burst.name: Script of Venom Burst
u.script-of-venom-burst.description: "Mark your pace and flow forth in time! Venom Burst!"
u.script-of-venom-burst.effects: Deals 1,850,000 Poison damage vs Guild Raids

e.entwood-shortbow.name: Entwood Shortbow
e.entwood-shortbow.effects: Root Strike (Shortbow): 5% chance to proc 500 Nature damage; +1% Crit Rate; +15% Crit Damage
e.entwood-shortbow.description: You were surprised to find a bow made from such stiff, unyielding wood, though you suspect that is why it was not crafted into a longbow. That said, despite your most vigorous uses of the weapon the wood refuses to splinter or twist, so perhaps the magic inherent in the wood has been put to good use.

e.nyxifur-whip.name: Nyxifur Whip
e.nyxifur-whip.effects:
Slowly Unsteady (Whip): 6% chance to proc 600 Nature damage; +425 damage per Nyxifur set item worn; +1% Crit Rate; +20% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Nyxifur Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +30% Crit Damage
 7+: +2% Crit Rate
 9+: +140 HP
e.nyxifur-whip.description:
"What do you mean it looks odd? It looks like a regular whip to me."
-Bai Juanmahee

a.brawler-simalia.name: Brawler Simalia
a.brawler-simalia.description: These brutish beings put the Risaldar you previously faced to shame. You're certainly appreciative that they seem to be on your side.... at least for the time being.

e.morassma-pants.name: Morassma Pants
e.morassma-pants.effects:
Soiled Toil (Pants): 12% chance to proc 800 Poison damage; +150 damage per Morassma set item worn; 10% chance to proc 400 Acid damage; +175 Acid damage per Morassma set item worn
Set Bonus (Morassma Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +15% Poison Resistance and +15% Acid Resistance
 7+: 4% chance to proc 2,000 Acid damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 60%
 9+: +0.2 Formation Protection Value to the active Formation and protects your Armies from the effects of Venomous and both your Armies and yourself from Volatile
e.morassma-pants.description:
"Plenty of things are happy to sting you in the tender bits. We'd best ensure that this is not an easy opening for them."
-Aguil Morassma

e.rokubi-flail.name: Rokubi Flail
e.rokubi-flail.effects: Six-tailed Corrosive Slap: 40% chance to proc 250 Acid damage
e.rokubi-flail.description: While the handle is firm in your grip, the tendril-like tails of this flail look distastefully squishy, and ooze a caustic, slime-like substance.

u.dark-resilience-potion.name: Dark Resilience Potion
u.dark-resilience-potion.description: A thick, viscous brew, which leaves a distinct aftertaste of anise.

u.silver-entrancement-tonic.name: Silver Entrancement Tonic
u.silver-entrancement-tonic.description:
"It'll feel like you're in a trance, and you'll-"

"Trance? Aye, what good is a potion if it knocks you out on the battlefield for drinking it?!"

"Err, no, you'll retain full control of your faculties, and your aptitude for magic should increase several fol-"

"Maybe we can hurl'm at the enemy, and see if we can knock them all into trances!"
-A conversation between Nphireo and Rarsik

e.blazebrand-sabatons.name: Blazebrand Sabatons
e.blazebrand-sabatons.effects:
Justice by any Flames Necessary (Sabatons): 14% chance to proc 800 Fire damage; +275 damage per Blazebrand set item worn; 4% chance to proc 1,175 Fire damage; +650 damage per Blazebrand set item worn; +4% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Blazebrand Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 8+: +2.5% Crit Rate
 9+: 40% chance to proc 250 Fire damage, +8 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Fire' and +1 Tiers of 'Insurmountable Offence'
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.blazebrand-sabatons.description:
"Righteous are those who walk through the flames. Do not fear: If your cause is good, the flames will envelop and shelter you in their warmth."
-Urzul Shamn

e.chaosoldiers-castoff-helm.name: Chaosoldier's Castoff Helm
e.chaosoldiers-castoff-helm.effects:
Infernal Soldier (Helm): 5% chance to proc 210 Fire damage; +90 damage per Chaosoldier's Castoff set item worn; +4% Fire Resistance; +3% Dark Resistance
Set Bonus (Chaosoldier's Castoff Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +1 Tiers of 'Fire Resistance' and +1 Tiers of 'Dark Resistance
 8: +1 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Fire' and +1 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Dark'
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.chaosoldiers-castoff-helm.description: You feel a lust for blood and violence as you slip this helm over your head.

e.capricious-conducer-gloves.name: Capricious Conducer Gloves
e.capricious-conducer-gloves.effects:
Conducive Conductivity (Gloves): 5% chance to proc 3,500 Lightning damage; +1,000 damage per Capricious Conducer set item worn; +1% Evasion; +2% Lightning Resistance
Set Bonus (Capricious Conducer Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1% Evasion
 6: +1.5% Crit Rate and +15% Crit Damage
 7+: Additional Bonuses depending on Shield equipped
 8+: 2% chance to proc 10,000 Lightning damage and give +50% Evasion on that proc
 9+: Additional Bonuses depending on Shield equipped
e.capricious-conducer-gloves.description: Well protected on the wrists, but allowing a surprising degree of freedom and mobility in the fingers. You can see why Knimbag seems keen to wear such gloves, particularly after you tried touching one of his creations without them and were met with a shocking telling-off.

e.arachnean-jerkins.name: Arachnean Jerkins
e.arachnean-jerkins.effects:
Compounding Distortion (Jerkins): 5% chance to proc 750 Psychic damage; +140 damage per Arachnean set item worn; +10% Crit Damage
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.arachnean-jerkins.description: You have heard stories of the woes caused in the name of Rhacel, and can barely wonder what kind of people could bring themselves to follow such a being. That said, Malbog has haunted the dreams of many-a-disrespectful-child, so maybe it's not that far of a stretch...

e.veedsamin-warriors-glaive.name: Veedsamin Warrior's Glaive
e.veedsamin-warriors-glaive.effects:
Warrior's Thrust: 20% chance to proc 225 Fire damage; +75 damage per Veedsamin Trainee's set item worn; 16% chance to proc 275 Dark damage; +50 damage per Veedsamin Trainee's set item worn; +14% Fire Resistance; +8% Dark Resistance; +35% Crit Damage; +100 Magic
Set Bonus (Veedsamin Trainee's Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 8+: +14% Fire Resistance; +8% Dark Resistance; +3 Tiers of 'Arcane Defence - Flamebreath' and +2 Tiers of 'Inspirational Command - Horrifying'
e.veedsamin-warriors-glaive.description:
"The Veedsamin Warriors are the first to the fight, and lead the charge against monstrous foes. Their prowess serves as an inspiration for all of those following, and their enchanted standard offers them additional protections during their rally."
-Tietha Holyrood

e.cumberworld-benefactors-bodice.name: Cumberworld Benefactor's Bodice
e.cumberworld-benefactors-bodice.effects:
+45 Vitality; +45 Energy; +45 Honor
Set Bonus (Cumberworld Benefactor Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1 Tiers of 'Discerning Vision', 'Astute Observation' and 'Precise Inspection'
 7+: +1 Tiers of 'Keen Eyes'
 8+: +100 Energy
 9+: +1 Tiers of 'Discerning Vision', 'Astute Observation' and 'Precise Inspection'
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.cumberworld-benefactors-bodice.description:
"If my Lady catches you gawking at her bodice once more, we will have no choice but to take... appropriate measures."
-Scolfield Retainer

a.mirtel.name: Mirtel
a.mirtel.description:
"If you should happen to perish, I'd be happy to share my haunted chamberpot with you."
-Mirtel
a.mirtel.effects: Wailing Whine: 14% chance to proc 100 Lightning damage; +400 damage vs Beast raids; Restores 3 Health daily

a.psyguard-magician.name: Psyguard Magician
a.psyguard-magician.description:
"Magic can be used to enhance our defences and protect ourselves, and is not only good for flinging around fireballs and chunks of ice."
-Alaion Torris
a.psyguard-magician.effects: Adds +2 Attack and +0.7 Defence to Alaion Torris and Morah Psyguard in the active Formation

u.script-of-toxic-fountain.name: Script of Toxic Fountain
u.script-of-toxic-fountain.description: "Rise up and spill forth the bounties of this land! Toxic Fountain!"

a.alchemical-tenderfoot.name: Alchemical Tenderfoot
a.alchemical-tenderfoot.description: Trainees in mixing dangerously volatile concoctions, they still appear to have far more expertise than you, and you are happy to leave such mixtures in their webbed hands.
a.alchemical-tenderfoot.effects: Adds +2 Attack and +0.5 Defence to Mairaja Bluebrew in the active Formation

c.blue-mirgoda-fur.name: Blue Mirgoda Fur
c.blue-mirgoda-fur.description: A tuft of fur from this rare, deadly beast is bound to be worthwhile for those looking to create warm, if smelly, outerwear.

c.red-leftover-claw.name: Red Leftover Claw
c.red-leftover-claw.description: The meat from these claws is said to be quite the delicacy, but you aren't sure you can get over its coruscating colours!

a.naven-rodentcatcher.name: Naven Rodentcatcher
a.naven-rodentcatcher.description:
"It may not be exciting work, but it's honourable work. Got'sta keep the rodents out o' the larders and provisions, and they've got a fair bit o' meat on'm, though ya' gots to get a bunch to fill up a belly."

You pause and wish you had a more detailed recollection of last night's dinner...

e.alchemical-artisan-gloves.name: Alchemical Artisan Gloves
e.alchemical-artisan-gloves.effects:
Explosive Eccentricities (Gloves): 8% chance to proc 500 Nature damage; +250 damage per Alchemical Artisan set item worn; 12% chance to proc 500 Fire damage; +125 damage per Alchemical Artisan set item worn; +3% Dark Resistance; +3% Ice Resistance
Set Bonus (Alchemical Artisan Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1% Crit Rate and +20% Crit Damage
 7+: 2% chance to proc 25,000 Acid damage
 8+: +2 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Nature' and 'Elemental Expertise - Fire'
 9+: +5% Dark Resistance, +5% Ice Resistance and +2% Crit Rate
e.alchemical-artisan-gloves.description: VII. In the years that followed Nahla did little of note, drowning her sorrows in various drinks and substances and putting effort only into driving away anyone who might want to get close to her. Sleep was worse for her, as nightmares persisted, unmitigated by the intoxication, and though she would catch herself staring blankly at the world, fury and frustration rose violently within her whenever she found herself watching too closely, her hatred and resentment for the natural order of things bubbling over as she steeled herself with further drinks.

a.elven-bodyguard.name: Elven Bodyguard
a.elven-bodyguard.description: Contrary to the aids these bodyguards protect, these Elves seem to have permanent glowers painted on their faces, and refuse to speak with you altogether.

e.song-of-radiance-helm.name: Song of Radiance Helm
e.song-of-radiance-helm.effects:
Brilliant Song (Helm): 24% chance to proc 400 Magic damage; +75 damage per Song of Radiance set item worn; +40 Magic; +2% Magic Resistance
Set Bonus (Song of Radiance Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +1500 Magic and +1 Tiers of 'Arcane Unveiling'
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.song-of-radiance-helm.description: The thin metal of this helm is unexpectedly light. You figured it would be hard to move while wearing a full helm, but this actually appears to weigh less than many caps you've worn. What's more, the metal helm seems to hum melodically as you don it.

cp.diplomat-starter-pack-iii.name: Diplomat Starter Pack III
cp.diplomat-starter-pack-iii.description: A pack providing the necessary equipment for every budding diplomat.

c.blue-blasting-stinger.name: Blue Blasting Stinger
c.blue-blasting-stinger.description: It remains unclear what the greater challenge was: Bringing down the original owner of this stinger, or removing it while keeping all of your fingers.

e.veedsamin-trainees-armor.name: Veedsamin Trainee's Armor
e.veedsamin-trainees-armor.effects:
Trainee Hunter (Armor): 25% chance to proc 115 Physical damage; +75 damage per Veedsamin Trainee's set item worn; +14 HP; +1% All Resistances
Set Bonus (Veedsamin Trainee's Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 8+: Additional Bonuses depending on Main-Hand/Off-Hand equipped
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.veedsamin-trainees-armor.description:
"We need to ensure our investments into the next generation is properly guarded, but they won't learn anything if they are swaddled in overly protective equipment."
-Tietha Holyrood

e.vozotlnaos-blessing-kopis.name: Vozotlnaos Blessing Kopis
e.vozotlnaos-blessing-kopis.effects:
Firetouched and Blessed by Fire (Kopis): 15% chance to proc 600 Fire damage; +300 damage per Vozotlnaos Blessing set item worn; +2% Crit Rate; +15% Crit Damage; +10% Dark Resistance
Consecrated
Set Bonus (Vozotlnaos Blessing Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +15% Formation Bonus and +1% Crit Rate
 8+: +2 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Fire'
 9+: 1% chance to heal the Player 2 HP
e.vozotlnaos-blessing-kopis.description:
"I see you are not familiar with a blade such as this. Here, let me teach you, alongside our morning hymns."
-Hiereus Rillie

c.violet-cracked-hammer.name: Violet Cracked Hammer
c.violet-cracked-hammer.description: Years of use have cracked the head of this hammer... you have no idea what has led to the colouration, however.

e.sunbringers-staff.name: Sunbringer's Staff
e.sunbringers-staff.description: VII. After the fourteenth such attempt, Elderune thought he had finally covered every hole in his prior plans, and was confident that this would be the attempt that would lead him to freedom. The sun was just peaking out over the horizon when the groundskeeper returned, Elderune's ear firmly gripped between his thumb and forefinger, and it was this image that led to his Elderune earning his infamous nickname from his peers: Sunbringer.

e.tasharen-bow.name: Tasharen Bow
e.tasharen-bow.effects:
Season's Shooting: 20% chance to proc 1,000 Nature damage; +750 damage vs Insect raids; +1.5% Crit Rate; +30% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Byhew Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 8+: +3% Crit Rate and +30% Crit Damage
e.tasharen-bow.description: Regional archers all attend the festival in order to exorcise the demons that plague them, using these inviolable bows.

a.vozotl-amphipolis.name: Vozotl Amphipolis
a.vozotl-amphipolis.description: Some of the more fanatical adherents will claim that the only true devotion to Vozotl comes in the form of spreading His flames against His foes. This has led to some thinking that this is the primary focus of the temple.
a.vozotl-amphipolis.effects: Adds +4 Attack to Kornere Warmbelt and Hiereus Rillie in the active Formation

ba.esteemed-noble-banner.name: Esteemed Noble Banner
ba.esteemed-noble-banner.description: Obtained with the Esteemed Noble Class

e.byramaster-crafter-apron.name: Byramaster Crafter Apron
e.byramaster-crafter-apron.effects:
Legendary Lager (Apron): 24% chance to proc 450 Nature damage; +100 damage per Byramaster Crafter set item worn; +30 HP; 2% chance to proc 2,000 Nature damage and add +5% Evasion and +2.5% Crit Rate to that attack
Set Bonus (Byramaster Crafter Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +50 HP
 7+: 4% chance to proc 5,000 Nature damage and add +10% Evasion and add +10% Crit Rate
 9+: +15% Nature Resistance and +15% Psychic Resistance
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.byramaster-crafter-apron.description: Something to keep any messes off of you, while allowing you the flexibility of carrying various tools and ingredients at all times, you would not have figured brewers to have thought this far ahead.

e.phermitic-battlegarb-crossbow.name: Phermitic Battlegarb Crossbow
e.phermitic-battlegarb-crossbow.effects:
The Wisdom in War (Crossbow): 5% chance to proc 450 Physical damage; +350 damage per Phermitic Battlegarb set item worn; +2% Crit Rate; +35% Crit Damage; +0.5% Evasion
Sanctified
Set Bonus (Phermitic Battlegarb Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +15% Crit Damage
 8+: +2% Crit Rate and +2 Tiers of 'Prolonged Battle'
e.phermitic-battlegarb-crossbow.description: II. Ankyabu took pride in her work, and people from all manner of surrounding lands would come to partake in her patterns. It wasn't uncommon for some to whisper how she was more talented than even the most creative of the Gods, Phermis, and before long Ankyabu would echo the same.

m.firey-frostfinisher.name: Firey Frostfinisher
m.firey-frostfinisher.description: Combining the icy powers that birthed the Blizzarding Horde along with the swiftburn flames that rend them in twain, these dichotomous elements have been fused together through the power of the Frostflame Token in order to bring down the target, whether in fire, frost or both.
m.firey-frostfinisher.effects: Firey Frostfinisher: 10% chance to proc [up-to-48]% Ice damage; +2% Ice damage for each distinct Snowdrake Slaughterer set item owned; 4% chance to proc [up-to-72]% Fire damage; +6% Fire damage for each distinct Blazen Swiftslicer set item owned

k.sustained-spell.name: Sustained Spell
k.sustained-spell.effects: You deal an idle attack every 25 seconds for 25 minutes. Each attack deals xx Magic damage.

c.red-rattler.name: Red Rattler
c.red-rattler.description: You didn't realize that the tail of a snake would stay in one piece, even after death. Plus, it makes such a fun sound!

u.daily-purchase-bag-i.name: Daily Purchase Bag I
u.daily-purchase-bag-i.description: An exotic, novelty good that is only available for a limited time.

u.parchment-of-bloodcurdle.name: Parchment of Bloodcurdle
u.parchment-of-bloodcurdle.description: A tattered scroll, with damp spots that may have been licked clean!

u.ranger-starter-pack-iii.name: Ranger Starter Pack III
u.ranger-starter-pack-iii.description: A pack providing the necessary equipment for every budding ranger.

c.red-mihrish-poster.name: Red Mihrish Poster
c.red-mihrish-poster.description: You had heard of posters to depict images of wanted criminals, but were unaware that businesses may be so overworked that they would publicly canvas for hirees.

c.green-adventuring-clothes.name: Green Adventuring Clothes
c.green-adventuring-clothes.description: These simple, green clothes would suit any new adventurer heading off into the world... Or, if nothing else, into the woods.

e.swiftslicer-staff.name: Swiftslicer Staff
e.swiftslicer-staff.effects:
Glorious Blades (Staff): 16% chance to proc 400 Fire damage vs Winter raids; +15% Crit Damage; +0.5% Evasion; +200 damage per Swiftslicer set item worn
Set Bonus (Swiftslicer Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +1.5% Evasion
e.swiftslicer-staff.description: Shaking your head, you have to wonder whether things have already gone awry if the blade adorning this staff has come into contact with the icy ground.

c.guild-formation-cover-i.name: Guild Formation Cover I
c.guild-formation-cover-i.description: Passively increases Formation Protection Value by +0.2

a.dumvan-thatcher.name: Dumvan Thatcher
a.dumvan-thatcher.description: Hopping around on slanted rooftops is bad enough, but doing so amongst snow and ice seems downright mad. The fact that these thatchers can do so with such nimbleness impresses even Yathane.
a.dumvan-thatcher.effects: Adds +3 Attack and +0.3 Defence to Shem in the active Formation

m.caustic-viscosity.name: Caustic Viscosity
m.caustic-viscosity.description:
"Prized possession? This is one of my greatest failures. What good is a chemical agent that merely destroys everything it touches. Besides, if I need something disposed of, I'd just ask Adjudhas to do it."
-Aelric Thorne
m.caustic-viscosity.effects: Caustic Viscosity: 6% chance to proc [up-to-140]% Acid damage; +15% Acid damage for each distinct Viscous Viscount Set Mount owned

e.entwood-staff.name: Entwood Staff
e.entwood-staff.effects: Root Strike (Staff): 15% chance to proc 200 Nature damage; +5 Magic
e.entwood-staff.description: The same magics that imbued the docile Ents with life course through this staff, and they speak to the land as readily as they ever have. You can feel it coursing through the wood as you hold it, distinctly similar to that of your own pulse.

e.hatuumin-sprig.name: Hatuumin Sprig
e.hatuumin-sprig.effects:
Sight of the Eye (Sprig): 8% chance to proc 600 Psychic damage; +175 damage per Hatuumin set item worn; +0.25% Crit Rate
Set Bonus (Hatuumin Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +2% Crit Rate
e.hatuumin-sprig.description: I(b). Sennie sighed, putting his hand on the large, bound book on his table for the dozenth time, before removing it. All his years of study had culminated in this latest expedition, and the prize of his efforts had been this dark tome... That he was thrice-damned for taking, and equally so for fearing to use. He considered calling in his assistant, if he could be considered such, and as his summoning spell was coalescing he decided against it, and let it drop. He had to be decisive, and all of his work, all of his ambition would be for nothing if he couldn't confirm his research. He grabbed the book once more, and opened it in one swift motion.

a.frostmanes-herdcult.name: Frostmane's Herdcult
a.frostmanes-herdcult.description: Myksor may seem a little rough around the edges, but that is nothing compared to his dedicated following. You aren't quite sure what to make of them.
a.frostmanes-herdcult.effects: Adds +5 Attack to Myksor Frostmane in the active Formation

e.blessed-gastonia-helm.name: Blessed Gastonia Helm
e.blessed-gastonia-helm.effects:
Sacred Scutum (Helm): 20% chance to proc 1200 Physical damage; +12500 damage vs Guild Raids; +350 damage per Blessed Gastonia set item worn; 25% chance to proc 400 Holy damage; +150 damage per Blessed Gastonia set item worn
Set Bonus (Blessed Gastonia Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +100 Honor, +75 Energy and +75 Vitality

u.gold-third-eye-tonic.name: Gold Third Eye Tonic
u.gold-third-eye-tonic.description: It is said that all perception starts not with the eyes on your face, but by the concentration of energy forming your innate third eye. Whether the Gods would agree with such a self-serving explanation or not remains to be seen, but you do enjoy the prospect of noticing those minute details of the world around you.
u.gold-third-eye-tonic.effects: Increases Attentive Perception and Eye for Beauty tiers by +3 for 1 hour

a.viscous-alchemist.name: Viscous Alchemist
a.viscous-alchemist.description:
"Ah, you're here to help, are you? Oh, I'll put you to work. Start with that beaker over there, and heat it up on that burner there. No, not THAT burner, you foo-"
-Aelric Thorne
a.viscous-alchemist.effects: Adds +5 Attack to Adjudhas in the active Formation; Adds +0.4 Defence to Aelric Thorne in the active Formation

e.irus-shroud-crusade-breastplate.name: Irus' Shroud Crusade Breastplate
e.irus-shroud-crusade-breastplate.effects:
Forward Irus' Light (Breastplate): 16% chance to proc 600 Holy damage; +425 damage per Irus' Shroud Crusade set item worn; +2,250 damage vs Demon raids; +25 HP; +3% Fire Resistance; +3% Dark Resistance
Consecrated
Set Bonus (Irus' Shroud Crusade Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1.5% Crit Rate and +15% Crit Damage
 6+: +4 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Holy'
 7+: +10% Formation Bonus
 8+: +5% All Resistances
 9+: +15% Crit Damage and +10% Formation Bonus
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.irus-shroud-crusade-breastplate.description:
"I see you've been forgetting to polish your armor. See that gets taken care of before we set out again. We can't have you looking a mess and disparaging Irus' good name."
-Umhilda Strongshield

u.daily-purchase-bag-ii.name: Daily Purchase Bag II
u.daily-purchase-bag-ii.description: An exotic, novelty good that is only available for a limited time.

a.bonaguido.name: Bonaguido
a.bonaguido.description: The master of ceremony for the Cumberworld Carnival, and self-proclaimed "Verasect" of the Carnival, you can only hope the actual church doesn't take offence to the provocation while he is in your company. Besides that, he seems to be the most animated individual you've ever met, and certainly lives up to his title as a showman.
a.bonaguido.effects: Pious Pie: 16% chance to proc 300 Dark damage; Adds +15 to Player Energy; Adds +10 to Player Vitality

c.watchers-tendril.name: Watcher's Tendril
c.watchers-tendril.description: This tendril continues to squirm and wriggle in your hands... what kind of foul magics must be causing such an aberration?

ba.glorious-grand-shaman-banner.name: Glorious Grand Shaman Banner
ba.glorious-grand-shaman-banner.description: Obtained with the Glorious Grand Shaman Class

e.ignition-ward.name: Ignition Ward
e.ignition-ward.effects: Compressing Force: 30% chance to proc 200 Dark damage; +1 Tiers of Arcane Defence - Volatile
e.ignition-ward.description: The thick, black band seems to spark when shaken quickly in the air, but when exposed to another source of ignition it appear to shrink the blast down considerably!

u.red-entrancement-tonic.name: Red Entrancement Tonic
u.red-entrancement-tonic.description:
"It'll feel like you're in a trance, and you'll-"

"Trance? Aye, what good is a potion if it knocks you out on the battlefield for drinking it?!"

"Err, no, you'll retain full control of your faculties, and your aptitude for magic should increase several fol-"

"Maybe we can hurl'm at the enemy, and see if we can knock them all into trances!"
-A conversation between Nphireo and Rarsik

e.songbird-of-radiance.name: Songbird of Radiance
e.songbird-of-radiance.effects:
Brilliant Song (Songbird): 24% chance to proc 300 Magic damage; +150 damage per Song of Radiance set item worn; +200 Magic
Set Bonus (Song of Radiance Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +1500 Magic and +1 Tiers of 'Arcane Unveiling'
e.songbird-of-radiance.description:
"The stories surrounding the songs of this great creature range from claiming it can stop fires, cure the blind or even bring back the dead. You'd best treat it right, else it will stop singing for you, entirely!"
-Janagud

ru.ingudagaz-rune-4.name: Ingudagaz (inD) Rune Lv. 4
ru.ingudagaz-rune-4.effects:
Can provide one of the following boosts:
-+3-5 Energy (80%)
-+1% Evasion (15%)
-25% chance to heal 4 Health on 20x attacks (5%)

e.snowdrake-slaughterer-knife.name: Snowdrake Slaughterer Knife
e.snowdrake-slaughterer-knife.effects:
Wandering in a Winter Wasteland (Knife): 8% chance to proc 1,000 Physical damage; +200 damage per Snowdrake Slaughterer set item worn; +2,500 damage vs Winter raids; +2,000 damage vs Dragon raids; +1% Crit Rate
Set Bonus (Snowdrake Slaughterer Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +2% Crit Rate and +30% Crit Damage
 9+: +10% Ice Resistance
e.snowdrake-slaughterer-knife.description: Every time you throw one of these knives it makes a strange, high pitched sound, as though it is simultaneously freezing and then cutting through the air.

c.violet-stone-claws.name: Violet Stone Claws
c.violet-stone-claws.description: It's said the gargouille's claws are permanently dyed by the flesh of its first kill; you are inclined to believe it after seeing these.

c.blue-fen-seedpod.name: Blue Fen Seedpod
c.blue-fen-seedpod.description: It is said that Fen Lure plants only produce seeds in the dead of night. You can't say whether this is true, but this is a rare find, indeed!

e.morassma-proof.name: Morassma Proof
e.morassma-proof.effects:
Soiled Toil (Proof): 12% chance to proc 700 Poison damage; +100 damage per Morassma set item worn; 12% chance to proc 700 Acid damage; +100 damage per Morassma set item worn; +1 Tiers of 'Arcane Defence - Volatile'; +1 Tiers of 'Arcane Defence - Venom'
Set Bonus (Morassma Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
