 5+: +15% Poison Resistance and +15% Acid Resistance
 7+: 4% chance to proc 2,000 Acid damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 60%
 9+: +0.2 Formation Protection Value to the active Formation and protects your Armies from the effects of Venomous and both your Armies and yourself from Volatile
e.morassma-proof.description: Proof of induction into the Order of Morassma comes in the form of this lumpy, acid-etched band. You are humbled to be awarded one as an honourary member, though after your conversations with Panee, you suspect you may not be that interested in following in the same footsteps.

e.scolfields-gloves.name: Scolfield's Gloves
e.scolfields-gloves.effects:
+30 Vitality; +30 Energy; +30 Honor
Set Bonus (Scolfield Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1 Tiers of 'Discerning Vision', 'Astute Observation' and 'Precise Inspection'
 9+: +1 Tiers of 'Discerning Vision', 'Astute Observation' and 'Precise Inspection'
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.scolfields-gloves.description:
"But of course these are fresh gloves; no-one in their right mind would wear yesterday's pair of gloves for a second day in a row, would they?"
-Lady Josian Scolfield

u.mortiday-calverita.name: Mortiday Calverita
u.mortiday-calverita.description:
"It's important to give small tokens of appreciation on this day. This is ours to you."
-Araceli Strongtoe
u.mortiday-calverita.effects: Open to obtain its contents (two of the chance drops)

u.script-of-soul-burst.name: Script of Soul Burst
u.script-of-soul-burst.description: "Light of mercy, hide us from your rage! Soul Burst!"

e.byramaster-crafter-proof.name: Byramaster Crafter Proof
e.byramaster-crafter-proof.effects:
+4 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Nature'; +60 HP
Set Bonus (Byramaster Crafter Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +50 HP
 7+: 4% chance to proc 5,000 Nature damage and add +10% Evasion and add +10% Crit Rate
 9+: +15% Nature Resistance and +15% Psychic Resistance
e.byramaster-crafter-proof.description: You would not have expected those producing ales to need to identify themselves, but it seems to convey to them some special privileges.

e.smugglers-trousers.name: Smuggler's Trousers
e.smugglers-trousers.effects:
River's Bounty (Trousers): 8% chance to proc 100 Physical damage; +75 damage per Smuggler's set item worn
Set Bonus (Smuggler's Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +2 Tiers of 'Evasive Maneuvers'
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.smugglers-trousers.description: When you spend time on the river, and oftentimes 'working hard' in the dark, you can expect to get wet, and need pants that will accommodate this.

e.cumberworld-benefactors-gloves.name: Cumberworld Benefactor's Gloves
e.cumberworld-benefactors-gloves.effects:
+45 Vitality; +45 Energy; +45 Honor
Set Bonus (Cumberworld Benefactor Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1 Tiers of 'Discerning Vision', 'Astute Observation' and 'Precise Inspection'
 7+: +1 Tiers of 'Keen Eyes'
 8+: +100 Energy
 9+: +1 Tiers of 'Discerning Vision', 'Astute Observation' and 'Precise Inspection'
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.cumberworld-benefactors-gloves.description:
"My Lady was ever one to take a 'hands-on' approach to her pet projects. Who knows how far this will go, now that she has opted for a more involved role in its functioning."
-Scolfield Retainer

c.cracked-goblet.name: Cracked Goblet
c.cracked-goblet.description: A custom originating in your homeland, an apprentice artisan would be given a goblet as a symbol of the completion of their training, and mark their capabilities as competent. The quality of the goblet tended to vary, however, and even moreso as other lands started to adopt this tradition.

a.ramor-metalborn.name: Ramor Metalborn
a.ramor-metalborn.description: As cantankerous a dwarf as any, Ramor seems unquestioningly devoted to Audia, and has apparently previously worked alongside both her father and grandfather before her. He seems quite capable, though he had some sharp words when he caught you forgetting to address the Baron's daughter with her title.
a.ramor-metalborn.effects: Invaluable Ingots: 8% chance to proc 40,000 Magic damage; Adds +0.8 Defence to each Baron Aureus' Footman or Baron Aureus' Medic in the Formation; Adds +1.5 Defence to Honourable Audia Stone in the active Formation

a.shudder-sailor-cutlass.name: Shudder Sailor Cutlass
a.shudder-sailor-cutlass.description:
"They say not even death can stop true love, merely delay it for a short while."

"... Really, Captain? This again? How'd that work out for those smugglers we 'merely delayed' last month?"
-Conversations with the crew of the Vengeance
a.shudder-sailor-cutlass.effects: Adds +0.2 Defence to Clammer Bund in the active Formation

e.griphornis-wings.name: Griphornis Wings
e.griphornis-wings.effects:
Pennaceous Plumage (Wings): 8% chance to proc 2900 Physical damage; +18750 damage vs Guild Raids; +450 damage per Griphornis set item worn
Set Bonus (Griphornis Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +70% Crit Damage
e.griphornis-wings.description: V(b). Hearing the familiar sound of dice at a nearby tavern, Helmo stepped in, ordering himself a single drink before sitting down to game with the patrons, there. He knew his luck was good enough to keep him ahead, but he also knew better than to overplay it, lest he need to leave his winnings behind or depart with an extra knife or two in his possession... After an hour, he walked out of the establishment, his coin-purse much fuller than it had been when he entered.

e.vibrant-cuisses.name: Vibrant Cuisses
e.vibrant-cuisses.effects:
Colours of Creation (Cuisses): 24% chance to proc 90 Magic damage; +20 Magic damage per Vibrant Victors set item worn; 2% chance to proc 400 Physical damage; +200 Physical damage per Vibrant Victors set item worn
Set Bonus (Vibrant Victors Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +5 Vitality, +5 Energy, +5 Honor and additional bonuses (depending on Main-Hand/Off-Hand equipped)
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.vibrant-cuisses.description:
"What good are pantaloons if you can't merrily dance in them? For what is a battle but a dance between two sides, and what is victory but a glorious reminder that you are still alive?"
-Cyran Jokalyn

m.sawgrass.name: Sawgrass
m.sawgrass.description: Your earliest memories of crabgrass were less than pleasant, by themselves, so these whirling blades make your mouth go dry and your back stiffen. Whether your target stiffens up or not is of little concern to the flora, as it doesn't seem to discriminate either way.
m.sawgrass.effects: Sawgrass: 16% chance to proc [up-to-44]% Nature damage

e.phermitic-battlegarb-rod.name: Phermitic Battlegarb Rod
e.phermitic-battlegarb-rod.effects:
The Wisdom in War (Rod): 5% chance to proc 450 Physical damage; +350 damage per Phermitic Battlegarb set item worn; +2% Crit Rate; +35% Crit Damage; +0.5% Evasion
Sanctified
Set Bonus (Phermitic Battlegarb Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +15% Crit Damage
 8+: +2% Crit Rate and +2 Tiers of 'Prolonged Battle'
e.phermitic-battlegarb-rod.description: III. It was this boasting that finally caught the ears of the Gods, and one deity in particular was gravely displeased. Phermis took it upon Herself to pay Ankyabu a visit. The Goddess weaved a magical disguise, and sought out Ankyabu to canvass her skills.

e.urvogel-talons.name: Urvogel Talons
e.urvogel-talons.effects:
Primitive Plumage (Talons): 8% chance to proc 950 Physical damage; +6250 damage vs Guild Raids; +100 damage per Urvogel set item worn
Set Bonus (Urvogel Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +25% Crit Damage
e.urvogel-talons.description: XXI. Watching the Orcs burn the countryside and lay waste as they passed, Ceta heard the anguish and outrage from both the creatures and the land itself, and when she could bear it no longer she took a stand, drawing upon the primal forces of nature to strike out with a mystical fury at the approaching horde. With great creatures, sporting fangs, claws and horns, to defend her, Ceta mercilessly decimated line after line of invading Orcs.

e.blazen-swiftslicer-blade.name: Blazen Swiftslicer Blade
e.blazen-swiftslicer-blade.effects:
Glorious Flaming Blades (Blade): 16% chance to proc 800 Fire damage vs Winter raids; +400 damage per Blazen Swiftslicer set item worn; +15% Crit Damage; +0.75% Evasion
Set Bonus (Blazen Swiftslicer Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +0.25% Evasion
 9+: +1.75% Evasion
e.blazen-swiftslicer-blade.description: You are aware that swords have to be heated to be forged, and you are hoping that this heat doesn't throw off the... balance? Sharpness? Well, that it doesn't harm the effectiveness of the blades.

e.enjeweled-diadem.name: Enjeweled Diadem
e.enjeweled-diadem.effects:
Sparkling And Shiny: 10% chance to proc 250 Psychic damage; +10% Crit Damage; +2 Tiers of 'Spare Change'
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.enjeweled-diadem.description: The sparkling jewels laden within this headpiece are a sight to behold. However, you remain unconvinced that it is appropriate attire for combat.

e.bhaishew-ring.name: Bhaishew Ring
e.bhaishew-ring.effects:
Season's Safeguarding: 10% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 15%; +30% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Byhew Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 8+: +3% Crit Rate and +30% Crit Damage
e.bhaishew-ring.description: "May good fortune guide you, and beautiful men and women adorn your path."

u.makari-ladoo.name: Makari Ladoo
u.makari-ladoo.description: The seeds on the outside of the sweet and chewy treat seem to bring this energy-replenishing delight’s exotic tastes together.
u.makari-ladoo.effects: Restores 30% of your max Energy and 200 HP

preReqs.name: resource
preReqs.errorMsg: Your health and energy are full already.

e.pioneering-pixie-blade.name: Pioneering Pixie Blade
e.pioneering-pixie-blade.effects:
A Sprite's Searching (Blade): 11% chance to proc 200 Magic damage; +600 damage per Pioneering Pixie set item worn; +1.75% Crit Rate; +8% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Pioneering Pixie Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1% Crit Rate and +15% Crit Damage
 7+: +1% Evasion
 8+: +0.5% Crit Rate and +0.5% Evasion
e.pioneering-pixie-blade.description: Tiny as this blade may be, it would likely be wielded as a longblade for an adventurous fae.

e.conquerors-sabatons.name: Conqueror's Sabatons
e.conquerors-sabatons.effects:
Temujin's Mercy (Sabatons): 4% chance to proc 3000 Physical damage; +800 damage per Conqueror's set item worn; +5% Passive Formation Bonus (Max 1)
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.conquerors-sabatons.description: To this day, it is suggested that better than one-in-twenty of your countrymen share some blood connection with Temujin, though no records remain that would ever substantiate this. The continent mostly existing as a two large countries certainly owes a great debt to Temujin, who unified a swathe of the continent through bloody conquest, in order to bring his desired peace to all peoples he deemed his own.

k.open-wounds.name: Open Wounds
k.open-wounds.effects: You deal an idle attack every 30 seconds for 30 minutes. Each attack deals xx Physical damage.

e.nyxifur-ring.name: Nyxifur Ring
e.nyxifur-ring.effects:
+60 HP; +1% Evasion; +30% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Nyxifur Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +30% Crit Damage
 7+: +2% Crit Rate
 9+: +140 HP
e.nyxifur-ring.description: The look Corros gives you as you don this ring, with its purple hue seeming to resonate in his eyes, takes his perpetually-unsettling demeanour to the next level.

u.blue-entrancement-tonic.name: Blue Entrancement Tonic
u.blue-entrancement-tonic.description:
"It'll feel like you're in a trance, and you'll-"

"Trance? Aye, what good is a potion if it knocks you out on the battlefield for drinking it?!"

"Err, no, you'll retain full control of your faculties, and your aptitude for magic should increase several fol-"

"Maybe we can hurl'm at the enemy, and see if we can knock them all into trances!"
-A conversation between Nphireo and Rarsik

u.large-potion-of-valour.name: Large Potion of Valour
u.large-potion-of-valour.description: III. Seeking any kind of method to improve his lot, Guraldo turned to the holy arts, deciding that if he strove to become a noble Paladin that he would be rewarded by the Gods for his devout service. Unfortunately, despite his choice of specialization, his fears went unabated.
u.large-potion-of-valour.effects: +15,000 Offence vs Guild Raids for 8 hours

e.kanitsume-boots.name: Kanitsume Boots
e.kanitsume-boots.effects:
Squeeze and Slice (Boots): 4% chance to proc 750 Physical damage; +12500 damage vs Guild Raids; +125 damage per Kanitsume set item worn; 40% chance to proc 40 Physical damage; +20 damage per Kanitsume set item worn
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.kanitsume-boots.description: XXI. However, almost as if arising from the ocean itself, on the back of an enormous crustacean, the newcomer sprung into action, assailing the massive beast, shattering one of its beaks with his hammer and driving the creature back to the sea.

c.green-oseberg-trekkers.name: Green Oseberg Trekkers
c.green-oseberg-trekkers.description: If you are to have any hope of surviving this long journey, you need comfortable footwear that can weather any environment. A magical enchantment or two couldn't hurt, either.

cp.wizard-starter-pack-iv.name: Wizard Starter Pack IV
cp.wizard-starter-pack-iv.description: A pack providing the necessary materials for every budding wizard.

c.gipantan-ail-all-tincture.name: Gipantan Ail-All Tincture
c.gipantan-ail-all-tincture.description: You are not certain whether this is some snake-oil, or derives from the seemingly-advanced societal benefits within Gipanta, but you're happy to have come across the tincture all the same.

u.green-third-eye-tonic.name: Green Third Eye Tonic
u.green-third-eye-tonic.description: It is said that all perception starts not with the eyes on your face, but by the concentration of energy forming your innate third eye. Whether the Gods would agree with such a self-serving explanation or not remains to be seen, but you do enjoy the prospect of noticing those minute details of the world around you.
u.green-third-eye-tonic.effects: Increases Attentive Perception and Eye for Beauty tiers by +1 for 2 hours

c.gipantan-timekeeper.name: Gipantan Timekeeper
c.gipantan-timekeeper.description: In a society as well-organized and structured as Thiador, it is essential to keep close tabs on the passing of time, whether for economical purposes, recreation, or even just to send the children off to their lessons.

s.scroll-naga-risaldar.name: Naga Risaldar Scroll
s.scroll-naga-risaldar.description: This serpentine being was once a junior officer in the ranks of the denizens of the void, begging a question be put to the test: Does an officer really need its head?

c.spring-omens.name: Spring Omens
c.spring-omens.description: Despite the mayhem with the insect hordes, you wish for good omens to come with the new season.

u.oceanic-obliteration-potion.name: Oceanic Obliteration Potion
u.oceanic-obliteration-potion.description: Save the oceans by killing the things within the oceans.
u.oceanic-obliteration-potion.effects: +6,000 Offence vs Aquatic Raids for 4 hours

u.thiadoran-energy-cask.name: Thiadoran Energy Cask
u.thiadoran-energy-cask.description: A small container with a few bottles of fine, Thiadoran vintage. Surely no-one could botch up what is supposed to go in here, right?
u.thiadoran-energy-cask.effects: Open to obtain its contents (three of the chance drops)

e.byramaster-crafter-hat.name: Byramaster Crafter Hat
e.byramaster-crafter-hat.effects:
Legendary Lager (Hat): 24% chance to proc 450 Nature damage; +100 damage per Byramaster Crafter set item worn; +30 HP; 2% chance to proc 2,000 Nature damage and add +5% Evasion and +2.5% Crit Rate to that attack
Set Bonus (Byramaster Crafter Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +50 HP
 7+: 4% chance to proc 5,000 Nature damage and add +10% Evasion and add +10% Crit Rate
 9+: +15% Nature Resistance and +15% Psychic Resistance
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.byramaster-crafter-hat.description: Not a particularly fancy cap, but it keeps your hair out of the way while working around enormous vats.

e.vyldas-supplicant-pants.name: Vylda's Supplicant Pants
e.vyldas-supplicant-pants.effects:
Glorious Bloodfeast (Pants): 12% chance to proc 520 Dark damage, turning Dark Resistance into Weakness for this proc; +765 damage per Vylda's Supplicant set item worn; +100 Magic; +0.2% Crit Rate

Set Bonus (Vylda's Supplicant Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1% Crit Rate and +10% Crit Damage
 6+: +3 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Dark' and +2,000 Magic
 7+: 1% chance to deal 25,000 Dark damage; +15% Crit Damage
 8+: +1.5% Crit Rate, and 1% chance of healing the Player +13 HP alongside -75% Formation Bonus on proc
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.vyldas-supplicant-pants.description:
"Oh, it seems that you spilled some blood from that last beastie you struck. Would you mind terribly saving it for me, until the fight is done?"
-Illiana Bloodletter

e.mirgoda-fur-staff.name: Mirgoda Fur Hand Staff
e.mirgoda-fur-staff.effects:
Fetid Furs (Staff): 12% chance to proc 1,000 Physical damage; +375 damage per Mirgoda Fur set item worn; +1% Crit Rate; +20% Crit Damage; 10% chance to proc 400 Physical damage and add +15% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Mirgoda Fur Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +2% Crit Rate
 6+: +5% All Resistances
 8+: +80 HP and +10% Ice Resistance
 9+: +5% All Resistances and -10% Formation Bonus
e.mirgoda-fur-staff.description: As macabre a staff as you've ever held, while you aren't going to be sneaking up on anybody with this staff, the chilling magics you can control using it impress even Glaciver.

e.griphornis-talons.name: Griphornis Talons
e.griphornis-talons.effects:
Pennaceous Plumage (Talons): 8% chance to proc 2900 Physical damage; +18750 damage vs Guild Raids; +450 damage per Griphornis set item worn
Set Bonus (Griphornis Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +70% Crit Damage
e.griphornis-talons.description: VII(b). Expectedly, Helmo won his first game, easily guessing the bead's location. On the second, Helmo won again, despite it being mildly more challenging. As a blond-haired fellow with slightly-elongated ears sat down, Helmo made a show of being convinced by the vendor to wager more, and placed his whole coin-purse on the table. After the vendor counted-and-matched the value and started a fresh round, Helmo surreptitiously kept his finger underneath the table, waiting for the moment he felt the vendor strike it with his palm, before counter-striking it with his own; this was much more a game of reflexes than of perception, at the end of the day!

c.thunderstruck-frog.name: Thunderstruck Frog
c.thunderstruck-frog.description: Your queries about whether this was lightning-struck or thunder-struck were met with flat looks. It quickly became apparent: You'd never find the remains of a lightning-struck frog.

a.naga-broodmother.name: Naga Broodmother
a.naga-broodmother.description: You were surprised, and perhaps a little sickened, to learn that the Naga broods hatch in massive numbers, resulting in dozens of vulnerable young. It would make sense, you figure, for designated members of the colony to watch over, and rear up the next generation... You almost wretch at that final thought.

e.morassma-flyer.name: Morassma Flyer
e.morassma-flyer.effects:
Soiled Toil (Flyer): 5% chance to proc 1,600 Acid damage; +800 damage per Morassma set item worn; 15% chance to proc 400 Acid damage; +75 damage per Morassma set item worn
Set Bonus (Morassma Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +15% Poison Resistance and +15% Acid Resistance
 7+: 4% chance to proc 2,000 Acid damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 60%
 9+: +0.2 Formation Protection Value to the active Formation and protects your Armies from the effects of Venomous and both your Armies and yourself from Volatile
e.morassma-flyer.description:
"These throwing knives are best handled in a very specific manner. You wouldn't want to try that fancy 'holding it by the edge' grip with these."
-Aguil Morassma

e.onishaygu-tendril-ring.name: Onishaygu Tendril Ring
e.onishaygu-tendril-ring.effects:
+30 HP; +40 Energy; +20 Vitality; +20 Honor
Set Bonus (Onishaygu Tendril Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +50 HP
 7+: +2 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Nature'
 8+: +40 Vitality and +40 Honour
 9+: +200 Energy
e.onishaygu-tendril-ring.description:
"With thisss you are bound to the earth, and ssshe isss bound to asssissst you."
-Aaja Orisha

cp.wizard-starter-pack-ii.name: Wizard Starter Pack II
cp.wizard-starter-pack-ii.description: A pack providing the necessary tools for every budding wizard.

a.ursinus-hardhammer.name: Ursinus Hardhammer
a.ursinus-hardhammer.description: Ursinus has been taking steps to avoid direct contact with you, but Rarsik has chatted him up on a few occasions. It seems he spent many years working forges, but for the past decade has bought up a number of ships and now works to export his weapons around the world. Well, that was until an unruly batch of demons came and torched most of his ships. Ursinus had been in the process of trying to purchase one of the ships you departed Gipanta upon, so he joined your venture, but you are uncertain of where his current loyalties now lie.
a.ursinus-hardhammer.effects: Forgesmasher: 10% chance to proc 5,000 Physical damage; +500 damage per Thiadoran Smithy in the active Formation; Adds +0.6 Defence to each Thiadoran Smithy in the Formation

e.aragnes-guard.name: Aragnes' Guard
e.aragnes-guard.effects: Spindleslam: 32% chance to proc 320 Poison damage; +20% Poison Resistance
e.aragnes-guard.description: Said to have been wielded by the most devout acolyte of Rhacel, Aragnes was not content with merely defending her patroness' name, but only in spreading Her potent venoms would She be satisfied.

e.vozotlnaos-blessing-pelta.name: Vozotlnaos Blessing Pelta
e.vozotlnaos-blessing-pelta.effects:
Firetouched and Blessed by Fire (Pelta): 25% chance to proc 160 Fire damage; +100 damage per Vozotlnaos Blessing set item worn; +30 HP; +1.5% Evasion
Consecrated
Set Bonus (Vozotlnaos Blessing Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +15% Formation Bonus and +1% Crit Rate
 8+: +2 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Fire'
 9+: 1% chance to heal the Player 2 HP
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.vozotlnaos-blessing-pelta.description:
"While His blessings are always capable of protecting and healing His adherents, it is never wise to invite unmerited wounds. Better to protect yourself when you can."
-Hiereus Rillie

e.crestaceo-pants.name: Crestaceo Pants
e.crestaceo-pants.effects:
Carapace Crush (Pants): 16% chance to proc 50 Physical damage; +1250 damage vs Guild Raids; +25 damage per Crestaceo set item worn
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.crestaceo-pants.description: II. The brothers' names are equally likely to change depending upon the version of the story, but what remains with every telling is how the three boys would play along the seaside cliffs, picking up sticks to strike at one another, or to parry another's own stick, and picking up strands of kelp to whip at eachothers' bare skin. The three were close, even amongst brothers, and spent much of their free time exploring the beaches and cliff-sides.

a.har-hut.name: Har-Hut
a.har-hut.description:
"Keep your hands where we can see'm. Har.... It's just a joke. We can still see'm, even in your pockets."
-Har-Hut
a.har-hut.effects: Psionic Brute: 12% chance to proc 10,000 Physical damage; 4% chance to proc 15,000 Psychic damage; Adds +2 Attack to each Hatuumin Buster in the Formation; Adds +0.5 Defence to each Hatuumin Psionic in the Formation

e.lances-spear.name: Lance's Spear
e.lances-spear.effects: Tip of the Day: +1% Crit Rate; +2% Crit Damage
e.lances-spear.description: You wouldn't have thought much of this particular spear, except for a nigh-illegible scribble on the side of the shaft reading as "Propurtee uv lants".

c.indigo-thick-fur.name: Indigo Thick Fur
c.indigo-thick-fur.description: There is no doubting that this fur would keep you warm, even during a night out-of-doors, but you aren't convinced the colour would reduce your likelihood of being spotted.

c.green-broken-gipantan-amphora.name: Green Broken Gipantan Amphora
c.green-broken-gipantan-amphora.description: A once-beautiful construct, likely intended to contain delicious beverage, seems to have been damaged in the chaos.

ba.illustrious-thaumaturgist-banner.name: Illustrious Thaumaturgist Banner
ba.illustrious-thaumaturgist-banner.description: Obtained with the Illustrious Thaumaturgist Class

e.nibi-flail.name: Nibi Flail
e.nibi-flail.effects: Two-tailed Ethereal Flame: 16% chance to proc 200 Magic damage
e.nibi-flail.description: The two lashes of this almost-ethereal flail burn with an uncanny blue light. The magical energies blasting from it cast an eerie, flaming light.

u.greater-acid-resilience-potion.name: Greater Acid Resilience Potion
u.greater-acid-resilience-potion.description: A frothy, mesmerizing potion that smells of the ideal seasoning of turmeric.

e.vozotlnaos-blessing-paravdos.name: Vozotlnaos Blessing Paravdos
e.vozotlnaos-blessing-paravdos.effects:
Firetouched and Blessed by Fire (Paravdos): 15% chance to proc 600 Fire damage; +300 damage per Vozotlnaos Blessing set item worn; +2% Crit Rate; +15% Crit Damage; +10% Dark Resistance
Consecrated

 7+: +15% Formation Bonus and +1% Crit Rate
 8+: +2 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Fire'
 9+: 1% chance to heal the Player 2 HP
e.vozotlnaos-blessing-paravdos.description:
"Mastering fire is not the same as capturing His blessings through His flames. I can show you the difference while we recite our verses."
-Kornere Warmbelt

e.psionic-screener-chest.name: Psionic Screener Chest
e.psionic-screener-chest.effects:
Psyshroom Stopper (Chest): 13% chance to proc 100 Psychic damage; +100 damage per Psionic Screener set item worn
Set Bonus (Psionic Screener Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: 20% chance to proc 100 Psychic damage, and protects you and your armies from the backlash of Volatile or Volatile Spores
e.psionic-screener-chest.description: The ability to keep non-physical blasts from harming you is important, but those concussive spore blasts seem to warrant protection, too.

e.wapiti-pants.name: Wapiti Pants
e.wapiti-pants.effects:
White Rump Roar (Pants): 25% chance to proc 200 Magic damage; +2000 damage vs Guild Raids; +25 damage per Wapiti set item worn; 6% chance to proc 600 Nature damage; +50 damage per Wapiti set item worn
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.wapiti-pants.description: XIII. Brath's father began to notice a trend in Brath's difficulties with his literary studies, and in spending this greater amount of time with his son, who did silently appear to appreciate the patience and courtesy his father displayed, he was able to work out a slight alteration in writing to help Brath succeed. Somehow,

u.autumnberries.name: Autumnberries
u.autumnberries.description: According to Dondomra, these elusive and rare berries only mature late in the year, and are able to keep a man fit to work for a full day.
u.autumnberries.effects: Restores 30% of your max Vitality, Energy and Honor

preReqs.name: resource
preReqs.errorMsg: Your energy and honor and vitality are full already.

c.violet-horsewhistle.name: Violet Horsewhistle
c.violet-horsewhistle.description: Would a whistle of this colour call a specific horse, or a specific colour of horse?

u.red-brewmasters-dextrous-draft.name: Red Brewmaster's Dextrous Draft
u.red-brewmasters-dextrous-draft.description:
"It seems you may need to swallow this as swiftly as the potion's effects make you feel, to avoid retching..."
-Nphireo

u.lancer-starter-pack-iv.name: Lancer Starter Pack IV
u.lancer-starter-pack-iv.description: A pack providing the necessary material for every budding lancer.

u.mystery-brewers-satchel.name: Mystery Brewer's Satchel
u.mystery-brewers-satchel.description: A satchel said to come from a talented brewer, though you'd have to inspect it more closely to confirm the details of that.

e.chaosoldiers-castoff-claws.name: Chaosoldier's Castoff Claws
e.chaosoldiers-castoff-claws.effects:
Infernal Soldier (Claws): 4% chance to proc 200 Fire damage; +150 damage per Chaosoldier's Castoff set item worn; +5% Fire Resistance; +2% Crit Rate
Set Bonus (Chaosoldier's Castoff Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +1 Tiers of 'Fire Resistance' and +1 Tiers of 'Dark Resistance
 8: +1 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Fire' and +1 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Dark'
e.chaosoldiers-castoff-claws.description: Flared and pointed, you expect these claws are capable both of raking the flesh of their victims, and ensuring their dark, firey energies are delivered deep into the poor souls.

a.sepulcher-seeker-orc.name: Sepulcher Seeker Orc
a.sepulcher-seeker-orc.description:
"Well, I can't say everyone's been keen on sharing their spoils, but attitudes tend to change once we bring in our 'negotiators'."
-Maansik Khudon
a.sepulcher-seeker-orc.effects: Adds +3 Attack to Maansik Khudon and Banefre Sadu in the active Formation

e.irus-shroud-crusade-mace.name: Irus' Shroud Crusade Mace
e.irus-shroud-crusade-mace.effects:
Forward Irus' Light (Mace): 20% chance to proc 240 Holy damage; +220 damage per Irus' Shroud Crusade set item worn; +2,400 damage vs Demon raids; 16% chance to proc 160 Holy damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 15%; +230 damage per Irus' Shroud Crusade set item worn; +1% Crit Rate; +15% Crit Damage
Consecrated
Set Bonus (Irus' Shroud Crusade Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1.5% Crit Rate and +15% Crit Damage
 6+: +4 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Holy'
 7+: +10% Formation Bonus
 8+: +5% All Resistances
 9+: +15% Crit Damage and +10% Formation Bonus
e.irus-shroud-crusade-mace.description:
"When evil refuses to depart the shroud Irus casts, it must be forcibly removed. Whether its skull remains intact is a separate question."
-Wilben Shroudbearer

e.gipantan-dockhand-mark.name: Gipantan Dockhand Mark
e.gipantan-dockhand-mark.effects:
+1% Evasion; +15 Energy
Set Bonus (Gipantan Dockhand Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +10 Energy
 8+: +20 Energy
e.gipantan-dockhand-mark.description: The mark of employ at the Gipantan docks, even merchants tread carefully when cargo is being unloaded, for anyone caught lurking without this mark is liable to be brained by a merciless cudgel.

u.foaming-honor-bundle-bag-i.name: Foaming Honor Bundle Bag I
u.foaming-honor-bundle-bag-i.description: A pack, filled to the brim with foaming potions!

c.mark-of-the-troll.name: Mark of the Troll
c.mark-of-the-troll.description: A nuisance they may be, but an unyielding reality of the hills are these.

c.red-dragonslayer-gem.name: Red Dragonslayer Gem
c.red-dragonslayer-gem.description: This fine, magical, red gem resonates in proximity to the Blade of Mestari. What could the connection be between these two artifacts?

a.wharf-duty-collector.name: Wharf Duty Collector
a.wharf-duty-collector.description: Deceptively strong, these Elves patrol the docks in an effort to curb smuggling and violence. They seem undaunted by the weight of their armor, despite being more prone to rely upon potent magics than brute force to break up fights.

e.mohagan-vessel.name: Mohagan Vessel
e.mohagan-vessel.effects: Harpoon Ballistas: 18% chance to proc 1400 Physical damage vs Aquatic raids
e.mohagan-vessel.description: This portly vessel comes manned with an equally portly crew, which while certainly coming in handy for sailing it on rough waters, is even more needed when trying to travel on land.

e.mestari-dragonslayer-green.name: Mestari Dragonslayer - Green
e.mestari-dragonslayer-green.effects: Divine Green Empowerment: 40% chance to proc 350 Holy damage; +550 Holy damage vs Dragon raids; +10% Crit Damage
e.mestari-dragonslayer-green.description: The divine radiance of this blade glows even more brilliantly after you had that Dragonslayer gem forged into it. While it still feels somehow incomplete, it somehow still leaves you feeling… whole.

c.violet-ghoul-jaw.name: Violet Ghoul Jaw
c.violet-ghoul-jaw.description: Depending upon the magics used to animate it, and the decay of the body, the discarded bits of the undead can be quite colourful.

c.sinah-mark.name: Sinah Mark
c.sinah-mark.description: A mark commonly shared amongst the nomads of the Sinah Desert, you were surprised to learn that it isn't used like a traditional currency, but rather in a sort of ritualistic drinking game.

c.violet-fallen-headstone.name: Violet Fallen Headstone
c.violet-fallen-headstone.description: It's unclear whether the headstone was originally this colour when it fell, or something turned it after the fact. Either way, you would prefer something a little more... plain.

a.nereus-water-nymph.name: Nereus' Water Nymph
a.nereus-water-nymph.description:
"Where would we be if not for the beauties of the Arena?! Sure, you can flit about, and pretend to be all heroic and adventurous, but what is braver than taking the stage next to a beauty like m-... that!"
-Nereus
a.nereus-water-nymph.effects: Nereus' Nymph's Protection: 2% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 20%; Adds +1 Attack and +0.5 Defence to Nereus, Arena Trainer in the active Formation

u.sahayuk-patang.name: Sahayuk Patang
u.sahayuk-patang.description: The creativity behind these festivals always amazes you. Who would have thought you could have sweet treats delivered by flying object?
u.sahayuk-patang.effects: Open to obtain its contents (two of the chance drops)

e.conquerors-cuisses.name: Conqueror's Cuisses
e.conquerors-cuisses.effects:
Temujin's Mercy (Cuisses): 4% chance to proc 2000 Physical damage; +800 damage per Conqueror's set item worn; +5% Passive Formation Bonus (Max 1)
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.conquerors-cuisses.description: Conquering lands one after another, it seemed Temujin could not be stopped, as even his sparse defeats were quickly turned around. In only thirty years Temujin had united over forty lands under his banner, and had taken almost as many lovers in the process.

e.granite-blessers-visor.name: Granite-Blesser's Visor
e.granite-blessers-visor.effects:
Granite's Greatness (Visor): 15% chance to proc 200 Holy damage; +50 damage per Granite-Blesser's set item worn
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.granite-blessers-visor.description: III. Each of the circles that devote themselves to Orimneni are led by a cleric who bears the title of 'first disciple'. This lead cleric will attend a gathering, at least once a decade, with the other first disciples, presided over by the 'First Speaker', in order to confirm their circles' deeds and reaffirm their faith in Orimneni.

u.red-guild-kit-ii.name: Red Guild Kit II
u.red-guild-kit-ii.description: A small, tidy sack, purporting to carry goods from the same source Slygse gets her alchemical wares.

e.leyshen-ring.name: Leyshen Ring
e.leyshen-ring.effects:
Season's Soothsaying: 5% chance to proc 5,600 Nature damage; +120 Magic
Set Bonus (Byhew Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 8+: +3% Crit Rate and +30% Crit Damage
e.leyshen-ring.description: "Correct your faults with fierceness, like that of thunder."

e.dented-wakizashi.name: Dented Wakizashi
e.dented-wakizashi.description: A peculiar blade, notwithstanding its distinctive -and obviously unintended- dents, you feel more at-ease wielding this blade in your off-hand for some reason.

e.naitour-patrol-shield.name: Naitour Patrol Shield
e.naitour-patrol-shield.effects:
Persevering Patrol (Shield): 5% chance to proc 200 Physical damage; +500 damage vs Human raids; +200 damage per Naitour Patrol set item worn; +40 HP
Set Bonus (Naitour Patrol Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +2 Tiers of 'Prolonged Battle'
e.naitour-patrol-shield.description: The heraldry on this shield was initially foreign to you, but Alanis volunteered that it was an emblem commonly found in the Acherales Republic (or, as she likes to keep reminding you, just 'The Republic' to many). You remain unsure how this speaks to this Territory's apparently lesser-involvement with the remainder of the nation.

e.moswas-orb.name: Moswa's Orb
e.moswas-orb.effects: Palmate Overpower (Orb): 25% chance to proc 480 Magic damage; +6,00 damage vs Guild Raids; +120 damage per Moswa set item worn; 6% chance to proc 2400 Nature damage; +200 damage per Moswa set item worn; +140 Magic
e.moswas-orb.description: II(a). It was at an early age that Cenius realized that he had numerous advantages over his peers, and that he could exploit these in order to establish his own superiority over them, whether it was in physical contests or in academia. Cenius enjoyed standing atop his proverbial mountain, never needing to truly work for anything, until the day he encountered the street hag.

e.millennium-island-armor.name: Millennium Island Armor
e.millennium-island-armor.effects:
Last Everlasting (Armor): 30% chance to proc 200 Nature damage; +150 damage per Millennium Island set item worn; +20 HP; +2% All Resistances
Set Bonus (Millennium Island Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +100 HP, +1 Tiers of 'Immoveable Object' and +1 Tiers of 'Hearty Constitution'
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.millennium-island-armor.description: This heavy armor set is certain to hinder your mobility, but will undoubtedly assist in your own longevity.

e.mountain-trekkers-trekkers.name: Mountain Trekkers Trekkers
e.mountain-trekkers-trekkers.effects:
Uphill Undertakings (Trekkers): 16% chance to proc 60 Nature damage; +20 damage per Mountain Trekkers set item worn; +250 damage vs Winter raids; +2% Ice Resistance
Set Bonus (Mountain Trekkers Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +5% Ice Resistance
 7+: +20 Vitality
 8+: +5 Raid Cap
e.mountain-trekkers-trekkers.description:
"Don't think the snow will hinder my ability to track you. I already know your footprints, and you won't evade me easily."
-Melaphin Suncomber

c.morcant-boost-ii.name: Morcant Boost II
c.morcant-boost-ii.description: The delicacies seem to only improve, year after year, in spite of these repeated disruptions to the fishing festivities. Passively boosts Morcant's Attack by +15 and Defence by +0.25 (Max 2).

u.red-guild-kit-iv.name: Red Guild Kit IV
u.red-guild-kit-iv.description: A small, tidy sack, purporting to carry goods from the same source Slygse gets her alchemical wares.

e.wand-of-fire-blast.name: Wand of Fire Blast
e.wand-of-fire-blast.effects: Explosive Expectation: 2% chance to proc 3600 Fire damage; +10 Magic
e.wand-of-fire-blast.description:
"Not every magical artifact possesses a wide array of magical properties. Some can simply enhance the wielder's latent powers, while others may only cast one single spell - though likely to great effectiveness."
-Alanis

e.skliros-inflicter.name: Skliros' Inflicter
e.skliros-inflicter.effects: Cruel Infliction: 12% chance to proc 1000 Dark damage; 4% chance to proc 2000 Magic damage; +3% Crit Rate
e.skliros-inflicter.description:
"The General of Cruelty is fully capable in the mystic arts, though he prefers more direct means when it comes to combat. From what I've heard, he is entirely willing to use magic as a tortuous tool to inflict pain"
-Glasha Brunbruk

e.mephitic-chiffon-cap.name: Mephitic Chiffon Cap
e.mephitic-chiffon-cap.effects:
Downy Destruction (Cap): 40% chance to proc 375 Holy damage; +6250 damage vs Guild Raids; +125 damage per Mephitic Chiffon set item worn; 25% chance to proc 400 Poison damage; +150 damage per Mephitic Chiffon set item worn
Set Bonus (Mephitic Chiffon Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +6% All Resistances; 1% chance to heal the Player 5 HP
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.mephitic-chiffon-cap.description:
X. Recognizing the urgency of the situation, Brath knew he would have to forgo watching and take action, and he did so by weaving a powerful spell of hypnotic visions. Wordlessly thanking the natural elements that were donating the last of their essences for this action - and their sacrifices would not be in vain! - Brath directed it at the four cultists he saw before him, attempting to lull them into a daze such that they could be bound without sounding any alarm. Somewhat to Brath's surprise the spell worked with an unseemly effectiveness, causing all three to stop their chanting and instead produce a drawled groaning sound, but of a similar pitch to the chant. Brath rushed forward and grabbed each, one at a time, dragging them back to the brush and ensnaring each in roots, before stepping out to search for his next target.

"Well, that went more smoothly than expected, didn't it?"

Brath was startled as he heard a feminine voice from an unseen source, and realized that came from above him. Cursing his luck and bounding forward, Brath took note that the tree behind him was already dead, which is presumably why he had been unable to detect the presence of anyone within it. As he moved into the open, however, Brath felt hands grab at his arms and head, forcing him down and driving his shoulder into the ground.

e.medzeh-boots.name: Medzeh Boots
e.medzeh-boots.effects:
Jackal Watcher (Boots): 25% chance to proc 400 Holy damage; +50 damage per Medzeh set item worn; +2% Dark Resistance
Sanctified
Set Bonus (Medzeh Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +2% Crit Rate and +25% Crit Damage
 8+: Additional Bonuses depending on Main-Hand equipped
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.medzeh-boots.description:
"Of course these are boots, though I can understand your confusion. With all the fine sand in the Sinah desert, you wouldn't want to be wearing something that traps sand against your foot, would you?"
-Apui

e.kanitsume-helm.name: Kanitsume Helm
e.kanitsume-helm.effects:
Squeeze and Slice (Helm): 4% chance to proc 750 Physical damage; +12500 damage vs Guild Raids; +125 damage per Kanitsume set item worn; 40% chance to proc 40 Physical damage; +20 damage per Kanitsume set item worn
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.kanitsume-helm.description: XVII. When the boys next ventured out, some days later, they were dour and displeased about the outcome of the previous incident, especially given how their mother had clearly disbelieved them. As if summoned by their frustrations, a hooked tentacle crept from the water, and grasped onto the ankle of the younger brother, dragging him to the sea below.

c.red-cannoneers-treasure-map.name: Red Cannoneer's Treasure Map
c.red-cannoneers-treasure-map.description: A map indicating buried treasure at a specific location. Maybe it's time for a detour in your adventuring path?

u.greater-fire-resilience-potion.name: Greater Fire Resilience Potion
u.greater-fire-resilience-potion.description: A frothy, mesmerizing potion that smells of the ideal seasoning of cayenne.

u.ooleviash-health-deoch.name: Ooleviash Health Deoch
u.ooleviash-health-deoch.description: This red potion is sweet, and has an interesting crunch to it as it goes down.

u.blue-guild-kit-iii.name: Blue Guild Kit III
u.blue-guild-kit-iii.description: A small, tidy sack, purporting to carry goods from the same source Slygse gets her alchemical wares.
u.blue-guild-kit-iii.effects: Open to obtain its contents (three of the chance drops)

u.soulless-striking-slaughter-potion.name: Soulless Striking Slaughter Potion
u.soulless-striking-slaughter-potion.effects: +1% Crit Rate and +10% Offence vs Undead Raids for 4 hours

a.river-skimmer.name: River Skimmer
a.river-skimmer.description: It is exceedingly rare for Merfolk to leave their oceanic homes for long, but these river-hoppers seem perfectly content to create mischief around inland river systems.

e.gravekeepers-oath.name: Gravekeeper's Oath
e.gravekeepers-oath.description:
"The hours are long, and the work grueling, but there is a certain honour to those who keep watch over the departed. At least until they are called upon, once more."
-Vittamar

c.robust-brew-of-bolts.name: Robust Brew of Bolts
c.robust-brew-of-bolts.description: My mind was racing and I wondered what could be done. I knew that there would be no help coming from you. The heartbeat, sounding like drums, ripped me apart.

e.chandlers-gauntlets.name: Chandler's Gauntlets
e.chandlers-gauntlets.effects:
Purified Paraffin (Gauntlets): 40% chance to proc 155 Holy damage; +15 damage per Chandler's set item worn; +15 HP
Sanctified
Set Bonus (Chandler's Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: 2% chance to proc 2000 Dark damage and heal the Player 10 HP
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.chandlers-gauntlets.description:
"Kruger, you ask? No, he's not affiliated with us Chandlers, but I did meet the fellow, once. He's quite a keen one, and seems to have come to similar conclusions as The Brightest One by his own means... Clearly that means we're in the right, eh?"
-Gagran Blightsbane

u.mystery-troop-draft-poster-iii.name: Mystery Troop Draft Poster III
u.mystery-troop-draft-poster-iii.description: Used to draft Troops to your cause.

e.chandlers-guard.name: Chandler's Guard
e.chandlers-guard.effects:
Purified Paraffin (Guard): 20% chance to proc 300 Holy damage; +25 damage per Chandler's set item worn; +350 Magic
Sanctified
Set Bonus (Chandler's Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: 2% chance to proc 2000 Dark damage and heal the Player 10 HP
e.chandlers-guard.description:
"Despite some of their... less admirable remarks about some of us, there are plenty of tales of the Chandlers rightly saving the downtrodden and facing off against injustice. At least, injustice as they see it. Their airs may be unpalatable, but they certainly seem to be a legitimate force for good."
-Dondomra Grimfeet

cp.samurai-starter-pack-iii.name: Samurai Starter Pack III
cp.samurai-starter-pack-iii.description: A pack providing the necessary equipment for every budding samurai.

a.elven-ranger-scout.name: Elven Ranger Scout
a.elven-ranger-scout.description: These elves are experienced in various terrains, and virtually silent as they range ahead. If you see one of them, you've already missed spotting the other nine.

a.siren-boatswain.name: Siren Boatswain
a.siren-boatswain.description:
"Ye' can't have a ship ready to sail into rough waters without a hardy crew, and ye' can't control a crew and maintain the vessel without reliable bos'ns!"
-Three-Teeth Farnham

e.song-of-radiance-wand.name: Song of Radiance Wand
e.song-of-radiance-wand.effects:
Brilliant Song (Wand): 24% chance to proc 400 Magic damage; +75 damage per Song of Radiance set item worn; +100 Magic
Set Bonus (Song of Radiance Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +1500 Magic and +1 Tiers of 'Arcane Unveiling'
e.song-of-radiance-wand.description: This wand appears to release scintillating motes as you wave it around, and hums in the air as well. You'll have to refrain from turning this weapon into a plaything.

u.farmers-bandage-cloths.name: Farmer's Bandage Cloths
u.farmers-bandage-cloths.description: Some simple cloths, sterilized and capable of treating wounds from a long day on the farmstead.

a.adroits-fusion-guardian.name: Adroit's Fusion Guardian
a.adroits-fusion-guardian.description:
"Harnessing the most volatile powers in nature may seem odd, in the hands of one intended to protect those around them, which is why it is a task well suited for mechanized, fleshless creations."
-Adroit
a.adroits-fusion-guardian.effects: Adds +1 Attack and +0.1 Defence to Adroit, Guardian Command in the active Formation

e.firedrakes-shirt.name: Firedrake's Shirt
e.firedrakes-shirt.effects:
Drake's Embers (Shirt): 12% chance to proc 100 Fire damage; +10 damage per Firedrake set item worn
Set Bonus (Firedrake's Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +5% Fire Resistance
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.firedrakes-shirt.description: V. The experiences she gained in her travels provided the wisdom and insight Nura needed in order to develop creative magics for her imbuing arts, and it was only after several years of study that she stumbled upon perhaps her greatest muse: the dragons.

e.reodai-hand-crossbow.name: Reodai Hand Crossbow
e.reodai-hand-crossbow.effects:
Sixth Sensibilities (Hand Crossbow): 10% chance to proc 700 Magic damage; +350 damage per Reodai set item worn; +2% Crit Rate; +20% Crit Damage; +250 Magic
Set Bonus (Reodai Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: Additional Bonuses depending on Mount equipped
e.reodai-hand-crossbow.description: For all their talk of balance, the Reodai folk seem perfectly inclined to take the easy route when it comes to their crossbows. You've learned a lot about how important balancing these tools can be, and yet this wrist-mounted devices take all the expertise out of it!

c.rock-grub-husk.name: Rock Grub Husk
c.rock-grub-husk.description: The discarded husk of these great insects may be worth a pretty penny to some, but comes unavoidably attached to an awful stench in the meantime.

e.friskfingers-cowl.name: Friskfingers Cowl
e.friskfingers-cowl.effects:
Rapid Robbery (Cowl): 4% chance to proc 2,000 Physical damage; +1,250 damage per Friskfingers set item worn; +0.2% Evasion; +25 Vitality; +10 Honor
Set Bonus (Friskfingers Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1.5% Crit Rate, +30 Honor and +2 Tiers of 'Spare Change'
 6+: +3 Tiers of 'Spare Change' and +60 Vitality
 7+: +10% Crit Damage and +1 Tiers of 'Keen Eyes'
 8+: +50 Vitality, +3 Tiers of 'Vulnerability Spotter - Pursuer' and +3 Tiers of 'Vulnerability Spotter - Elusive'
 9+: +50 Vitality, +1 Tiers of 'Keen Eyes' and +5 Tiers of 'Spare Change'
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.friskfingers-cowl.description: It's important both to keep your head protected, and to keep from being noticed. Why not serve two functions with one cowl?

a.capricious-carter.name: Capricious Carter
a.capricious-carter.description: You've seen any number of pack-muled individuals during your campaign, but none have been as careful with their material as these carters. You might see if you could recruit some to carry your personal belongings, knowing that it'd be quite safe and cared-for.
a.capricious-carter.effects: Adds +4 Attack to Dhiva and Yagnatz in the active Formation; Adds +6 Attack and +0.8 Defence to Knimbag Glasser in the active Formation; Restores 6 Reserves daily

u.green-gipantan-troop-draft-poster.name: Green Gipantan Troop Draft Poster
u.green-gipantan-troop-draft-poster.description: Used to draft Troops to your cause.
u.green-gipantan-troop-draft-poster.effects: Open to obtain its contents (three of the following)

u.parchment-of-branded-blaze.name: Parchment of Branded Blaze
u.parchment-of-branded-blaze.description: A thin scroll that burns your fingers when you first touch it. You hope the scars don’t last too long!

a.speckled-shroom-chef.name: Speckled Shroom Chef
a.speckled-shroom-chef.description: Genius can come in many forms, whether from inherent talent or years of hard work. This talented chef has undoubtedly worked hard to best capture the essence of flavour, particularly when it comes to... poisonous mushrooms? Wait just a minute...
a.speckled-shroom-chef.effects: Adds +3 Attack and +0.5 Defence to Shana Copperfox in the active Formation

e.jida-of-sovereign-hope.name: Jida of Sovereign Hope
e.jida-of-sovereign-hope.effects: Another Man's Villain: 12% chance to proc 800 Holy damage; +200 damage if Saber of Bloody Freedom is worn; +100 damage per Conqueror's set item worn
e.jida-of-sovereign-hope.description: Like a plague they spread across the Dolmtaalian continent, conquering through unrelenting bloodshed and terror. Only upon this massacre could the now-bloodsoaked land fertilize new hope, and that hope grew more vigourously than ever imagined. All of this, courtesy the military efforts of the Warlord Temujin.

c.robust-brew-of-caustics.name: Robust Brew of Caustics
c.robust-brew-of-caustics.description: Carriages bearing news line the shore, waiting to depart with you. You can climb into the back of one, your thoughts high in the clouds, and you are gone.

e.sung-wooden-boomerang.name: Sung Wooden Boomerang
e.sung-wooden-boomerang.effects: Sungwood Symphony (Boomerang): 10% chance to proc 230 Physical damage; 5% chance to proc 200 Physical damage; +50 damage [each] per Sung Leather set item worn
e.sung-wooden-boomerang.description: I. The history behind Singing material long predates even the oldest living elves. It is said that there was a race of forest people, whose name has been lost to time, who first discovered the art while Singing to their trees.

e.tromos-latria-offering.name: Tromos Latria Offering
e.tromos-latria-offering.effects:
Returning the Damners (Offering): 7% chance to proc 400 Dark damage; +700 damage per Tromos Latria set item worn; +2% Crit Rate; +10% Crit Damage; +250 Magic
Set Bonus (Tromos Latria Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +5% Crit Damage, +500 Magic and -5% Formation Bonus
 7+: +1 Tiers of 'Magic Meditation' and -5% Formation Bonus
 8+: +1 Tiers of 'Protective Guardian' and -10% Formation Bonus
 9+: +3% Crit Rate and -10% Formation Bonus
e.tromos-latria-offering.description: Gaining power like what would have been required to shatter ancient magics comes with significant costs.

c.jingse-ward.name: Jingse Ward
c.jingse-ward.description: These sticks produce a warding smoke that is said to stave off the swarms, while remembering the year that has passed.

e.watchers-gloves.name: Watcher's Gloves
e.watchers-gloves.effects:
All-Seeing Blindness (Gloves): 5% chance to proc 300 Dark damage; +30 damage per Watcher's set item worn
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.watchers-gloves.description:
"What, exactly, do you mean to do with that foul-smelling, thick ooze you collected?"

"It's unlikely you'd understand even the most basic principles of mystic research. However, toss me those gloves.... I'd like to try something out."
-Conversations with Alanis

ru.inguthurisaz-rune-10.name: Inguthurisaz (inth) Rune Lv. 10
ru.inguthurisaz-rune-10.effects:
Can provide one of the following boosts:
-+54-56 Energy (70%)
-+2% All Resistances (20%)
-+1 to Eye for Beauty and +1 to Attentive Perception (10%)

e.morassma-dagger.name: Morassma Dagger
e.morassma-dagger.effects:
Soiled Toil (Dagger): 14% chance to proc 400 Acid damage; +200 damage per Morassma set item worn; 4% chance to proc 650 Acid damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 10%; +450 damage per Morassma set item worn
Set Bonus (Morassma Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +15% Poison Resistance and +15% Acid Resistance
 7+: 4% chance to proc 2,000 Acid damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 60%
 9+: +0.2 Formation Protection Value to the active Formation and protects your Armies from the effects of Venomous and both your Armies and yourself from Volatile
e.morassma-dagger.description:
"There's nothing more salubrious than a dose of acid in the morning. You should share your wealth with your opponent, too!"
-Panee Morassma

e.tedupevair-squawker.name: Tedupevair Squawker
e.tedupevair-squawker.effects:
Fabled Visions (Squawker): 10% chance to proc 4,000 Physical damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 10%; +1 Tiers of 'Attentive Perception'
Set Bonus (Tedupevair Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +1 Tiers of 'Eye for Beauty'
 7+: 10% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 25%
 8+: +1 Tiers of 'Attentive Perception'
e.tedupevair-squawker.description: Your disgust - and early-onset deafness - was only moderately mitigated when you watched this overgrown feather-duster locate a particularly shiny stone, unprompted. While there may be value in such a creature, you remain unconvinced that it outweighs the noise accompanying it.

e.smugglers-boots.name: Smuggler's Boots
e.smugglers-boots.effects:
River's Bounty (Boots): 8% chance to proc 100 Physical damage; +75 damage per Smuggler's set item worn
Set Bonus (Smuggler's Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +2 Tiers of 'Evasive Maneuvers'
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.smugglers-boots.description: Boots that both allow you to move swiftly, and avoid you getting stuck upon muddy shores, are invaluable in this line of work.

c.violet-cave-mushroom.name: Violet Cave Mushroom
c.violet-cave-mushroom.description: Certainly the strangest form of mushroom you have ever seen, both Fagli and Vinqa assure you it is safe for consumption.

e.duty-collectors-plate.name: Duty Collector's Plate
e.duty-collectors-plate.effects:
Duties Owed (Plate): 19% chance to proc 180 Psychic damage; +36 Psychic damage per Duty Collector's set item worn; +30 Magic
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.duty-collectors-plate.description:
"So, wearing heavy armor doesn't make working at the harbour dangerous for you? You must be terrific swimmers!"

"If you believe mere baubles such as this would impact our abilities to stay afloat, you're even more foolish than I had previously believed."
-Conversations with a Wharf Duty Collector

a.pael-habre.name: Pael Habre
a.pael-habre.description: The diligent and seemingly-adored captain of Serpent's Tooth, Pael is capable of inspiring a significant degree of confidence amongst his crew. He doesn't seem ready to warm up to you just yet, though.
a.pael-habre.effects: Captain's Quarry: 14% chance to proc 500 Dark damage; Adds +1 Defence to each River Smuggler and River Windbringer in the Formation

e.demonsbanes-armor.name: Demonsbane's Armor
e.demonsbanes-armor.effects:
Dark Deterrence (Armor): 6% chance to proc 1300 Physical damage; +0.75% Crit Rate vs Demon raids
Set Bonus (Demonsbane's Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +80% Crit Damage
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.demonsbanes-armor.description: It is unclear where Ciri took her initial vows, but tales of her heroism as she ranged across both the Empire and the Republic were once upon every lip, and it was clear that she was a potent force for her order. She was merciful towards the needy, but merciless to the cruel and unjust.

e.mirror-shield.name: Mirror Shield
e.mirror-shield.effects:
Divine Reflection: 5% chance to proc 300 Holy damage vs Beast raids
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.mirror-shield.description: As beneficial as this reflective service may be in particular instances - including preening over your overborn, ugly visage, according to Alanis - you are exceedingly concerned about using it to turn a blow from a sword, or mace.

e.conquerors-lamellar-cuirass.name: Conqueror's Lamellar Cuirass
e.conquerors-lamellar-cuirass.effects:
Temujin's Mercy (Lamellar Cuirass): 4% chance to proc 2000 Physical damage; +800 damage per Conqueror's set item worn; +5% Passive Formation Bonus (Max 1)
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.conquerors-lamellar-cuirass.description: As a young man, Temujin was nimble but strong, and trained incessantly in whatever homemade crafts he could find, killing his first blood-foe before his sixteenth year. When his village was attacked he rallied the small forces there to route the invaders, slaying many of them and capturing the remainder. When offered the choice to suffer only a few lashes or to serve Temujin, they unwaveringly agreed to follow the young man who had demonstrated such innate skill in battle.

c.keyrics-examination.name: Keyric's Examination
c.keyrics-examination.description: "Study would not be possible without acknowledging the work already done, nor would it be bloodless. In reaching out to Vora Keyric, Nebekinessur had to turn down offers to assist in her newfound order of Veedsamin, all while taking advantage of their increasing expertise on the menacing creatures that roamed the lands."

m.irus-shrouded-crusaders.name: Irus' Shrouded Crusaders
m.irus-shrouded-crusaders.description: Irus' love may be unconditional, but His loathing for all things demonic is swift, striking and merciless.
m.irus-shrouded-crusaders.effects: Irus' Shrouded Crusaders: 16% chance to proc [up-to-48]% Holy damage; Bonus [up-to-40]% damage vs Demon raids

e.arachnean-leg-segments.name: Arachnean Leg Segments
e.arachnean-leg-segments.effects: Compounding Distortion (Leg Segments): 4% chance to proc 1245 Psychic damage; +165 damage per Arachnean set item worn
e.arachnean-leg-segments.description: The ideals of Rhacel may seem perverse to many, but there is no questioning the efficacy of their methodology. They often lead to destruction and terror, but through the path requiring the least effort.

e.thunderbird-fledgeling.name: Thunderbird Fledgeling
e.thunderbird-fledgeling.effects: Graced by Thunder (Fledgeling): 12% chance to proc 1250 Lightning damage; +75 damage per Thunderbird set item worn
e.thunderbird-fledgeling.description:
"The only safe way to consider mounting a Thunderbird is to raise it yourself. It is fortuitous that the fledgelings are as fond of elderberries as the adults."
-Janagud

c.red-gardening-shears.name: Red Gardening Shears
c.red-gardening-shears.description: Pruning overgrown shrubbery has never been quite so.... flamboyant!

u.violet-entrancement-tonic.name: Violet Entrancement Tonic
u.violet-entrancement-tonic.description:
"It'll feel like you're in a trance, and you'll-"

"Trance? Aye, what good is a potion if it knocks you out on the battlefield for drinking it?!"

"Err, no, you'll retain full control of your faculties, and your aptitude for magic should increase several fol-"

"Maybe we can hurl'm at the enemy, and see if we can knock them all into trances!"
-A conversation between Nphireo and Rarsik

e.ooleviash-ring.name: Ooleviash Ring
e.ooleviash-ring.effects:
+200 Magic; +1% Evasion; +15% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Ooleviash Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +40% Crit Damage
 7+: +500 Magic
e.ooleviash-ring.description: This ring thrums with energies as you don it, but you feel nothing when simply holding it in your hand. It also appears to be made of a non-metallic substance, though you cannot get a clear answer as to why this is.

c.whelpling-collar.name: Whelpling Collar
c.whelpling-collar.description: You've little issue with collaring livestock and domestic animals when necessary, but these devices lack any of the typical safety measures found in typical collars and effectively amount to torture devices. No wonder those poor Whelplings acted out as they did...

c.orange-oseberg-trekkers.name: Orange Oseberg Trekkers
c.orange-oseberg-trekkers.description: If you are to have any hope of surviving this long journey, you need comfortable footwear that can weather any environment. A magical enchantment or two couldn't hurt, either.

c.thinned-brew-of-caustics.name: Thinned Brew of Caustics
c.thinned-brew-of-caustics.description: Following her to a bridge near a fountain, where rocking people consume strange pies and everyone is smiling as you pass the tall flowers.

e.zaratan-hatchling.name: Zaratan Hatchling
e.zaratan-hatchling.effects: Debris Volley (Hatchling): 8% chance to proc 1875 Nature damage; +113 damage per Zaratan set item worn
e.zaratan-hatchling.description:
"I'm curious as to what benefit you seek in riding one of those majestic creatures. While it is unlikely to ever be impeded from reaching its destination, at least after maturing some more, it is certainly not getting you there with any haste."
-Janagud

e.fiddler-claws.name: Fiddler Claws
e.fiddler-claws.effects:
Squeeze and Sliver (Claws): 4% chance to proc 2800 Physical damage; +37500 damage vs Guild Raids; +400 damage per Fiddler set item worn; 40% chance to proc 150 Physical damage; +75 damage per Fiddler set item worn
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.fiddler-claws.description: V(b). One undeniable fact followed the Fiddler Knight wherever he went, and that being that he would never back away from a fight once it had begun. Beyond obvious braggadocio, none could identify a battle that the first Fiddler Knight had ever lost, be it against man or beast. Some touted his successes to him being blessed by the Gods, while others described him as being a demon in human form, for what else could describe such ferocity and skill?

c.ulunsuti-bejeweled-eye.name: Ulunsuti Bejeweled Eye
c.ulunsuti-bejeweled-eye.description: An eye from the rare creature, you marvel at your reflection shimmering in a thousand different ways as you peer into its depths.

a.aegyr-snowbound.name: Aegyr Snowbound
a.aegyr-snowbound.description: A permanent fixture in the northern wastes, Aegyr stands guard against the return of the Blizzarding Hordes, ready to summon legions to defend against them and their queen.
a.aegyr-snowbound.effects: Wintered Watcher: 8% chance to proc 8,750 Fire damage; +300 damage per Goblin Frigidara Defender, Dwarven Frigidara Defender, Gnomish Frigidara Defender, Orcish Frigidara Defender and Elven Frigidara Defender in the active Formation; Adds +1 Defence to each Goblin Frigidara Defender, Dwarven Frigidara Defender, Gnomish Frigidara Defender, Orcish Frigidara Defender and Elven Frigidara Defender in the Formation

e.crestaceo-hammer.name: Crestaceo Hammer
e.crestaceo-hammer.effects: Carapace Crush (Hammer): 16% chance to proc 50 Physical damage; +1,250 damage vs Guild Raids; +25 damage per Crestaceo set item worn
e.crestaceo-hammer.description: VII. The long days of carefree play and jovial attitudes would come to an end, however, on one fateful day. That day, often told as being a late, summer day at dusk, was when the youngest brother was knocked off a cliff-face and plummeted to the rocky shores below.

e.valley-verdure-gloves.name: Valley Verdure Gloves
e.valley-verdure-gloves.effects:
Verdant Volley (Gloves): 8% chance to proc 1,000 Nature damage; +800 damage per Valley Verdure set item worn; +50 Magic; +2% All Resistances
Set Bonus (Valley Verdure Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +500 Magic
 6+: +2% Crit Rate and +10% Crit Damage
e.valley-verdure-gloves.description:
"What better way to make sure your walking stick doesn't give you splinter?"
-Murrlix

c.green-map-fragment.name: Green Map Fragment
c.green-map-fragment.description: From even this small portion of the map you know it leads to a substantive prize... You cannot seem to puzzle out how the map's colours factor into the route, though.

e.vildmand-platefur-band.name: Vildmand Platefur Band
e.vildmand-platefur-band.effects:
+100 HP; +5 Tiers of 'Defensive Posture'; +2 Tiers of 'Arcane Defence - Venom'; +2 Tiers of 'Arcane Defence - Volatile'

 9+: +30% Crit Damage and 75% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 5%
e.vildmand-platefur-band.description: You cannot quite tell if this band is made of stone or bone, but it is solid enough that you can squeeze it in your hand and it comes away unscathed... Unlike your torn-up palm.

e.picaroons-boots.name: Picaroon's Boots
e.picaroons-boots.effects:
Swabby Sealover (Boots): 8% chance to proc 200 Physical damage; +50 damage per Picaroon's Raiments set item worn; +400 damage vs Human raids; +0.25% Crit Rate
Set Bonus (Picaroon's Raiment Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:

u.blue-indigo-repentant-dusk-chest.name: Blue-Indigo Repentant Dusk Chest
u.blue-indigo-repentant-dusk-chest.description: Dusk’s chill falls upon all foes caught in its shadows.

ba.daring-zen-master-banner.name: Daring Zen Master Banner
ba.daring-zen-master-banner.description: Obtained with the Daring Zen Master Class

e.hatuumin-mace-axe.name: Hatuumin Mace-Axe
e.hatuumin-mace-axe.effects:
Sight of the Eye (Mace-Axe): 16% chance to proc 500 Psychic damage; +125 damage per Hatuumin set item worn; +0.5% Crit Rate
Set Bonus (Hatuumin Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +40% Crit Damage, +400 Magic and +1 Tiers of 'Discerning Vision'
e.hatuumin-mace-axe.description: XI(a). As the last of the enchantments faded from Sinyu's weapons, he lunged forward, kicking the nearest creature back, knowing that he could not stop them any longer. He regretted losing sight of Kontar, and hoped that he would be okay, and he muttered a silent prayer for his wife and son, wishing he could have said goodbye. Sinyu stood up, looking the nearest creature in its eyes as it lumbered towards him, and bowed his head, accepting his fate. He had driven these men to their demise, and it was only fitting that they bring about his own. Sinyu closed his eyes, waiting for the final blows to reign upon him... Except they didn't. Looking up in bewilderment, Sinyu could only gape when he saw the creatures kneeling before him in supplication. Somehow, Sinyu knew that they had forgiven him whatever guilt he felt he owed them, and as he saw the portal open up before him, he knew he had accomplished what he could, here.

k.coax-attack.name: Coax Attack
k.coax-attack.effects: You automatically evade the next xx attacks from this Raid.

u.thiadoran-vitality-vintage.name: Thiadoran Vitality Vintage
u.thiadoran-vitality-vintage.description: A fine vintage from the Thiadoran vineyards, with a uniquely cultivated flavour that refreshes both your palate and your spirits.
u.thiadoran-vitality-vintage.effects: Restores 25% of your max Vitality and 200 HP

preReqs.name: resource
preReqs.errorMsg: Your health and vitality are full already.

e.oresnatchs-great-rainbow-ring.name: Oresnatch's Great Rainbow Ring
e.oresnatchs-great-rainbow-ring.effects: Vazz's Wonder: 100% chance to proc 750 Magic damage and give +250 Offence, +350 Defence, 400 Magic, +1% Crit Rate, +15% Crit Damage and +1% Evasion on that proc
e.oresnatchs-great-rainbow-ring.description: A masterpiece of a ring, if ever you've seen one, the brilliance of the coloured stones radiate light in the darkness, and shimmer nigh-blindingly in the sunlight. The magical powers contained within seem to swirl about you as you don this legendary band.

c.mortiday-ornament.name: Mortiday Ornament
c.mortiday-ornament.description: A fancy ornament left behind by a fleeing festival-goer, it appears to hold some sentimental value.

k.medical-guidance.name: Medical Guidance
k.medical-guidance.effects: Heals all of your injured Commanders for x Health, but not exceeding their Max Health.

u.script-of-mindstorm.name: Script of Mindstorm
u.script-of-mindstorm.description: "Shower the world and unleash the tempest! Mindstorm!"

c.violet-watchers-humor.name: Violet Watcher's Humor
c.violet-watchers-humor.description: This colourful concoction contains certain cryptic characteristics!

e.moss-covered-meganyxi.name: Moss-Covered Meganyxi
e.moss-covered-meganyxi.effects:
Slowly Unsteady (Moss-Covered Meganyxi): 10% chance to proc 1000 Nature damage; +350 damage per Nyxifur set item worn; 1% chance to proc 120,000 Physical damage; +40 HP; 1% chance to Heal the Player 2 HP when wearing the full 9-piece Nyxifur set

e.moss-covered-meganyxi.description: It was not the most servile creature when left to its own devices, but when offered a delicious snack it suddenly seemed much more apt to take direction. Now you just need to ensure it eats more of the food than it wears...

a.dwarf-fae-thrall.name: Dwarf Fae Thrall
a.dwarf-fae-thrall.description: "Aie, I cannot believe what those blasted winged beasties made me do for them! I'll never live down the shame those horrible, beautiful, wondrous creatures put me through!"

e.skliros-devilled-punisher.name: Skliros' Devilled Punisher
e.skliros-devilled-punisher.effects: Crueler Punishment: 12% chance to proc 1,600 Dark damage; 4% chance to proc 3,000 Physical damage; +1.5% Crit Rate; +25% Crit Damage
e.skliros-devilled-punisher.description:
"The General of Cruelty has redoubled his efforts to punish those whom he deems to have wronged him. Stray not too close to him, lest you taste his fury."
-Glasha Brunbruk

u.ooleviash-vitality-deoch.name: Ooleviash Vitality Deoch
u.ooleviash-vitality-deoch.description: This orange potion is sweet, and has an interesting crunch to it as it goes down.

e.yotinpekew-knife.name: Yotinpekew Knife
e.yotinpekew-knife.effects:
