Set Bonus (Yotinpekew Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +1.5% Crit Rate
 8+: +35% Crit Damage and +0.75% Crit Rate
 9+: +1 Tiers of 'Arcane Defence - Flamebreath'
e.yotinpekew-knife.description: Supposedly getting slashed and being struck by lightning are very similar feelings. In either case, you'd prefer to be on the giving end rather than the receiving.

ba.teutonic-knight-banner.name: Teutonic Knight Banner
ba.teutonic-knight-banner.description: Obtained with the Teutonic Knight Class

e.medzeh-chariot.name: Medzeh Chariot
e.medzeh-chariot.effects:
Jackal Watcher (Chariot): 8% chance to proc 3,450 Physical damage; +400 damage per Medzeh set item worn; 2% chance to proc 15,000 Physical damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 40% and give +30% Crit Rate for that attack
Set Bonus (Medzeh Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +2% Crit Rate and +25% Crit Damage
 8+: Additional Bonuses depending on Main-Hand equipped
e.medzeh-chariot.description:
"While many of the Medzeh will ride horseback, or in chariots drawn by steeds, we do still have a few of these enchanted chariots, usually reserved for the battle commanders. For the assistance you have rendered, may this aid in your journey."
-Apui

e.cave-cragsman-helm.name: Cave Cragsman Helm
e.cave-cragsman-helm.effects:
+18 Max HP
Set Bonus (Cave Cragsman Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +2 Tiers of 'Defensive Rider - Terrestrial' and +2 Tiers of 'Mount Proficiency - Terrestrial'
e.cave-cragsman-helm.description: This may not be the most practical headpiece to wear into battle, but it could certainly be handy to prevent jagged rocks from knocking you upside the head.

e.fiddler-helm.name: Fiddler Helm
e.fiddler-helm.effects:
Squeeze and Sliver (Helm): 4% chance to proc 2800 Physical damage; +37500 damage vs Guild Raids; +400 damage per Fiddler set item worn; 40% chance to proc 150 Physical damage; +75 damage per Fiddler set item worn
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.fiddler-helm.description: III(b). While the origination of the attire remains shrouded in mystery, the unmistakable appearance of the broad, shelled carapace and the long blade are trademarks, though the shield, helm and boots are certainly unique identifiers, when viewed in close proximity. What's more, the equipment was undeniably heavy, and made distinct sounds whenever the Fiddler Knight moved about while wearing it.

u.bottle-of-mystery-elixir.name: Bottle of Mystery Elixir
u.bottle-of-mystery-elixir.description:
"I can understand why you'd think that since the smaller quantity is safe and beneficial that the larger one would be even better. However, that is definitely not always the ca- Oh, I see you're drinking it, anyway."
-Nphireo
u.bottle-of-mystery-elixir.effects: Open to obtain its contents (two of the following)

c.violet-naitour-helm.name: Violet Naitour Helm
c.violet-naitour-helm.description: A helm worn by the fallen defenders of Fort Naitour.

u.venom-soaked-pack.name: Venom-Soaked Pack
u.venom-soaked-pack.description: Found amongst the webs and rubble in the Arachnean Tunnel, it seems its owner won't be needing it any further.

e.praetoran-ring.name: Praetoran Ring
e.praetoran-ring.effects:
+1.5% Crit Rate; +100 Magic; +1% Evasion
Set Bonus (Praetoran Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +40% Crit Damage and +1 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Fire'
e.praetoran-ring.description: You never expected the governing council of the town to reward you for your deeds, let alone with one of the rings worn by those council members.

e.laurentian-shoes.name: Laurentian Shoes
e.laurentian-shoes.effects: Powerless Prey (Boots): 45% chance to proc 120 Dark damage; +850 damage versus Human raids; +4% Psychic Resistance
e.laurentian-shoes.description:
"Why are you so set on personally seeing these vampires dead? Was your family killed off by them? Your childhood terrorized? A lover spurned you for one?"

"Three more and I get a free baker's-oven. Comeon, it's close."
-Conversation with Corovar

c.wyn-ilivaris-attack-boost-i.name: Wyn Ilivaris Attack Boost I
c.wyn-ilivaris-attack-boost-i.description: A badge of merit, awarded to Wyn for his exemplary skills as an offensive Commander. Passively boosts Wyn's Attack by +10 (Max 2).

u.legendary-daring-elixir.name: Legendary Daring Elixir
u.legendary-daring-elixir.description: An elixir bestowed to only the most daring of legendary figures, possessing enormous potential when consumed by a worthy individual.
u.legendary-daring-elixir.effects: Open to obtain its contents (five of the chance drops)

e.veedsamin-trainees-gloves.name: Veedsamin Trainee's Gloves
e.veedsamin-trainees-gloves.effects:
Trainee Hunter (Gloves): 25% chance to proc 115 Physical damage; +75 damage per Veedsamin Trainee's set item worn; +14 HP; +1% All Resistances
Set Bonus (Veedsamin Trainee's Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 8+: Additional Bonuses depending on Main-Hand/Off-Hand equipped
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.veedsamin-trainees-gloves.description: Despite all of their apparent shortcomings in safeguarding their trainees, you have to acknowledge that these gloves are still certainly finer than you would have expected, and more durable than you had seen even during your own training with the king's guard

c.alchemical-coals.name: Alchemical Coals
c.alchemical-coals.description: It isn't unusual for various craftspeople to keep quality coals they have used. It seems the Gipantan alchemists have developed coals that could be instantly heated, and their precise temperatures modified through runic inscriptions. Finding some of these valuable items, especially after the fall of the city, is quite lucky!

c.myksor-frostmane-boost-i.name: Myksor Frostmane Boost I
c.myksor-frostmane-boost-i.description: Those rare berries appear to be even more potent than described… Well, at least for some. Passively boosts Myksor Frostmane's Attack by +4 and Defence by +0.2 (Max 5).

e.chandlers-chausses.name: Chandler's Chausses
e.chandlers-chausses.effects:
Purified Paraffin (Chausses): 40% chance to proc 155 Holy damage; +15 damage per Chandler's set item worn; +15 HP
Sanctified
Set Bonus (Chandler's Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: 2% chance to proc 2000 Dark damage and heal the Player 10 HP
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.chandlers-chausses.description:
"You can see how they look down at us. I've no desire to start any political upset, but I think I'll be happier to be away from these... mad dogs."
-Yathane Shahara

s.scroll-naga-karamati.name: Naga Karamati Scroll
s.scroll-naga-karamati.description: It isn't common for Naga to inherit arcane talents, but when they do they are often terrifying. This Naga has corrupted the minds of Mihr's protectors, and needs to be stopped before it rains down more electrifying terror!

a.gourdwalker.name: Gourdwalker
a.gourdwalker.description: With strange, limb-like vines, this heavy-headed creature slinks along silently, just waiting to spook any unsuspecting individual as they turn to face it.
a.gourdwalker.effects: Adds +0.2 Defence to Fae Commanders and Fae Troops in the active Formation; Restores 1 Reserve daily

e.sinderklaz-boots.name: Sinderklaz Boots

 9+: +200 HP, +30% Magic Resistance and +25% Ice Resistance
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.sinderklaz-boots.description: Well, at least the boots are practical. Comfortable on the feet, warm and dry, you can't help but think they've got some kind of magical enchantment to make funny sounds when you walk, or some other dastardly piece of magic sewn into them.

e.song-of-radiance-hands.name: Song of Radiance Hands
e.song-of-radiance-hands.effects:
Brilliant Song (Hands): 24% chance to proc 400 Magic damage; +75 damage per Song of Radiance set item worn; +40 Magic; +2% Magic Resistance

 9+: +1500 Magic and +1 Tiers of 'Arcane Unveiling'
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.song-of-radiance-hands.description:
"One must take particular care when handling the Songbird of Radiance. Its delicate plumage is necessary for it to fly, so damaging any feathers would be devastating."
-Janagud

a.wisdoms-apprentice.name: Wisdom's Apprentice
a.wisdoms-apprentice.description: These girls are often hand-picked from a young age for their aptitude with herbs and healing tools. They are trained by the village Wisdom in order to minister to the sick, injured and infirm.

e.mortiday-charro.name: Mortiday Charro
e.mortiday-charro.effects:

 6+: +20% Crit Damage

Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.mortiday-charro.description:
"You certainly look like you're from around here, now. I suppose you might as well stay a while!"
-Araceli Strongtoe

c.stormstruck-seedpod.name: Stormstruck Seedpod
c.stormstruck-seedpod.description: An unusually large seed, said to only be produced during the summer storms.

e.yonbi-flail.name: Yonbi Flail
e.yonbi-flail.effects: Four-tailed Lava Slab: 5% chance to proc 800 Fire damage
e.yonbi-flail.description: The red tails of this flail seem to crack with unearthly volume when used. The flaming hunks of rock flung from it seem to elicit similar sounds from your target.

e.bolting-fiddler-pants.name: Bolting Fiddler Pants
e.bolting-fiddler-pants.effects:
Shock and Slice (Pants): 4% chance to proc 4900 Physical damage; +62500 damage vs Guild Raids; +950 damage per Bolting Fiddler set item worn; 40% chance to proc 625 Physical damage; +125 damage per Bolting Fiddler set item worn; 25% chance to proc 400 Lightning damage; +150 damage per Bolting Fiddler set item worn
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion

c.guild-coin.name: Guild Coin
c.guild-coin.description: This coin has no loyalty to any country you know of, but serves as a valuable currency with Slygse and the other merchants in your Guild.

c.metallic-mantid-claws.name: Metallic Mantid Claws
c.metallic-mantid-claws.description: It's unusual to find materials stronger than steel in nature, and even rarer when it comes from insects. Perhaps this can be used to empower your weapons?

c.red-overlord-assegai.name: Red Overlord Assegai
c.red-overlord-assegai.description: Surely there must be a collector of strange, demonic things - aside from your insatiable companion... - who would be willing to take these used-weapons in exchange for something you can utilize.

a.flummox-beast.name: Flummox Beast
a.flummox-beast.description: A terrifying creature to behold, though the sound its rattling bones make while it runs is a mixture between whimsical and ridiculous.
a.flummox-beast.effects: Adds +3 Attack to Tacito Flummox in the active Formation; Restores 2 Reserves daily

c.chipped-runic-remain.name: Chipped Runic Remain
c.chipped-runic-remain.description: A piece of one of the runes keeping the Tromos terrors locked away. Perhaps there would be some value to studying the dark energies leaking out of this stone?

e.cultists-runic-cowl.name: Cultists' Runic Cowl
e.cultists-runic-cowl.effects:
Dark Runic Ritual (Cowl): 16% chance to proc 66 Dark damage; +20 damage per Cultist's Runic set item worn; +54 damage vs Human raids
Set Bonus (Cultist's Runic Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +1 Tiers of 'Arcane Defence - Venom'
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.cultists-runic-cowl.description:
I. While seemingly foreign to you, Seksehsa's scaled face paled as he inspected the runes magically etched into this dark cowl, before uttering a single word:

"Thotssaken."

c.violet-fleshy-fen-tendril.name: Violet Fleshy Fen Tendril
c.violet-fleshy-fen-tendril.description: The base tendrils of fen foliage tend to be fleshy and moist... and unusually coloured!

a.goblin-frigidara-defender.name: Goblin Frigidara Defender
a.goblin-frigidara-defender.description:
"Little is known about what drives Frigidara back to this land, but one thing we know for certain is that she would drive her horde to freeze the entire continent, if left unstopped."
-Bellas Inahice
a.goblin-frigidara-defender.effects: Adds +5 Attack to Aegyr Snowbound, Bellas Inahice and Burz in the active Formation

a.veteran-orcish-frigidara-defender.name: Veteran Orcish Frigidara Defender
a.veteran-orcish-frigidara-defender.description:
"If you remain so slow to arrive, maybe we should leave you here to watch and wait with Aegyr."
-Burz
a.veteran-orcish-frigidara-defender.effects: Adds +4 Attack and +0.2 Defence to Aegyr Snowbound, Bellas Inahice and Burz in the active Formation

e.lumina-flash-hand-crossbow.name: Lumina Flash Hand-Crossbow
e.lumina-flash-hand-crossbow.effects:
By the Light (Hand-Crossbow): 12% chance to proc 1,000 Lightning damage; +125 damage per Lumina Flash set item worn; +0.5% Evasion; +1% Crit Rate
Set Bonus (Lumina Flash Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +2% Evasion and +1 Tiers of 'Advanced Evasive Maneuvers'
e.lumina-flash-hand-crossbow.description: This delicate weapon mounts easily on your hand, though you suspect the guard may be more decorative than functional, considering how thin it is.

c.rock-grub-mandibles.name: Rock Grub Mandibles
c.rock-grub-mandibles.description: While the insects' mandibles might not be especially sharp, they are incredibly dense and solid, even moreso than the dragons' teeth you've seen. Considering their impressive bite strength and need to burrow through rock, you suppose this makes sense.

c.jasper-dust.name: Jasper Dust
c.jasper-dust.description: Powdered jasper, seemingly from the core of the golem after it fell, this dust emanates a strange aura.

c.violet-thurlam-octopus.name: Violet Thurlam Octopus
c.violet-thurlam-octopus.description: Unlike similar creatures from the southern seas, these strangely-coloured octopods are apparently renowned for both their size, and their delicious flavour.

a.nereus-arena-trainer.name: Nereus, Arena Trainer
a.nereus-arena-trainer.description:
"Whooo-ooo! It sure was an trip getting to this point, wasn't it? But now that we're here, I think it's time to par-tay!! Ladies, drape the windows and break out the drinks, 'cause this is gonna be kuh-raaaa-aazey!"
-Nereus
a.nereus-arena-trainer.effects: Adoring Finflair: 40% chance to proc 20,000 Physical damage; +180,000 Physical damage vs Small raids; Adds +3 Attack and +1 Defence to Nereus' Water Kelpie troops in the active Formation; Adds +4 Attack to Nereus' Water Nymph troops in the active Formation

c.doctrine-of-derzis.name: Doctrine of Derzis
c.doctrine-of-derzis.description: 'Look to the skies, and marvel at the wonders sent His power, for His amusement, and for His people.'

cp.diplomat-starter-pack-iv.name: Diplomat Starter Pack IV
cp.diplomat-starter-pack-iv.description: A pack providing the necessary materials for every budding diplomat.

e.cumberworld-overalls.name: Cumberworld Overalls
e.cumberworld-overalls.effects:
+20 Vitality; +20 Energy
Set Bonus (Cumberworld Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1 Tiers of 'Discerning Vision' and 'Astute Observation'
 9+: +1 Tiers of 'Discerning Vision' and 'Astute Observation'
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.cumberworld-overalls.description:
"What good are pants if ye cannot dance? Or steal romance with a glance, or take a stance against chants and rants?"
-Bonaguido

u.orange-brewmasters-satchel.name: Orange Brewmaster's Satchel
u.orange-brewmasters-satchel.description: An incredibly well-stocked satchel, clearly belonging to a brewmaster, and containing a mystery potion.
u.orange-brewmasters-satchel.effects: Open to obtain its contents (two of the chance drops)

a.fanghunter-warden.name: Fanghunter Warden
a.fanghunter-warden.description:
"It takes years of training in the order to be granted the title Fanghunter, even more to attain the title of Fangskin, and more still to lead a battallion as a Fangsheath. I have met maybe three in the order whose ranks surpass that."
-Fanghunter Warden
a.fanghunter-warden.effects: Adds +0.1 Defence to Morna Fangsheath and Jadael Fangsheath in the active Formation

e.vyldas-supplicant-slippers.name: Vylda's Supplicant Slippers
e.vyldas-supplicant-slippers.effects:
Glorious Bloodfeast (Slippers): 12% chance to proc 520 Dark damage, turning Dark Resistance into Weakness for this proc; +765 damage per Vylda's Supplicant set item worn; +100 Magic; +0.2% Crit Rate

e.mordant-moswa-fur.description:
IV. Jolting awake, Brath Hartwood reeled forward at the recollection of this latest nightmare, realizing his face was covered in perspiration only as it began to drip onto the documents clumsily adorning his desk. He knew that a typical dream would never present him with new information, but the term 'Cenius' was clearly new to him. Brath rushed out of his small office and past the acolytes studying - well, most of them were goofing off more than studying - in the lounge, and headed for the Academy's senior library.

After several hours of review, Brath was left aghast and awestruck. The name Cenius was reported to have belonged to a dark Druid not 40 years past, whose rise to power was swift and terrible, but who disappeared without a trace for no apparent reason. The strange phrase he had heard, as best he could translate from some ancient Gak runes, translated to something akin to 'The void will be coming for you - or perhaps because of you -,' and 'your part is not done.' Brath didn't know what to make of that, but returned his attention to the Cenius character.

Approaching the final stretch, passing by a mountain crest alongside a ravine, Bevis lacked the motivation to do much besides stay beside the wagon... up until they heard the unearthly howls fill the evening air. Easily distinguishable from wolves, Bevis and his father exchanged looks at a distance before his father doubled the pace of the flock in order to hurry to open ground. However, whether catalyzed by the howls or the sudden movement, the mountain had decided to unload its contents and a rockslide began to fall towards the flock.

III. Sinyu was sweating in the daytime heat as he took a break from training the newest batch of recruits, and he was surprised to see Kontar running up to him. Sinyu's heart panged him whenever he saw the youth, and he wondered how his own child, and wife, were doing back in Agiz, but his new work training up the private militia groups, both physically and in tactics, kept him occupied.

Kontar was winded but brief: He had need to speak with Sinyu, and would do so this evening at a location they both knew. Sinyu sighed, suspecting he'd have to turn the boy down once again, but agreeing to meet up with him prior to returning to his duties.

Nahla's youngest sister, Rika, had been stricken by a terrible illness, and nothing that the healers were doing could offer anything more than a momentary reprieve from the pain. e.hatuumin-whip.description:
X(a). Sinyu paused and inadvertently allowed himself a moment to marvel at the strange landscape, adorned with colours and life, before turning back to the task at hand. Looking forward, he saw several more undead creatures rising from the ground. Glancing back to see how his support was looking, Sinyu cursed when he realized that both Kontar and Sennie were missing. He knew Kontar wouldn't have run off, and while it was possible that Sennie had pulled some strange stunt, his whip and mace still appeared to be enchanted, suggesting he hadn't been abandoned for dead. Sinyu leaped into the fray, realizing the enchantments were waning as combat dragged on, but the sad look in the eyes of these newer creatures tugged at him, even as he struck them down.

'I know this man!' Sinyu thought to himself, or at least he had known him, as he took an arm off another blighted creature. Peering about in a daze, Sinyu realized he was surrounded, but that each of the beings facing him were men he had led into combat, and who had perished under his command.

a.orcen-necromender.name: Orcen Necromender
a.orcen-necromender.description: You've little issue with being healed up using magic, when necessary.... but the idea of having strange flesh mounted onto your frame to accomplish this just doesn't sit well with you.
a.orcen-necromender.effects: Adds +0.4 Defence to Sar Tephania in the active Formation

a.guild-beasthandler.name: Guild Beasthandler
a.guild-beasthandler.description: Vranda's Beasthandlers are incredibly well trained, and capable of handling even the most raucous of beasties and creatures. Of course, they have to be at least that capable, or they'd become the Stadium monsters' next meal.

e.dark-piercer-shoes.name: Dark Piercer Shoes
e.dark-piercer-shoes.effects:
Piercing the Night (Shoes): 16% chance to proc 875 Dark damage; +125 damage per Dark Piercer set item worn; +0.8% Crit Rate; +2% Dark Resistance
Set Bonus (Dark Piercer Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +3% Crit Rate and +1 Tiers of 'Advanced Critical Gaze'
e.dark-piercer-shoes.description: While these shoes do seem relatively quiet, the spring they add to your step will help you cover the distance between you and your target.

c.green-ripe-thiadoran-olives.name: Green Ripe Thiadoran Olives
c.green-ripe-thiadoran-olives.description: You've seen fruits of varying sizes and colours in your years, but these multi-coloured olives apparently originate from different regions of the country, and are used to create some famous oils and spreads.

u.parchment-of-ameras-anger.name: Parchment of Amera's Anger
u.parchment-of-ameras-anger.description: A surprisingly warm scroll containing holy magics!

u.lesser-restoration-potion.name: Lesser Restoration Potion
u.lesser-restoration-potion.description:
"So, I suppose you've got a fancy explanation for why this particular potion is such a different colour than the others?"

"Of course I do, but I'm hardly going to share my secrets with you, what with that attitude of yours."
-Conversations with Nphireo

u.orange-guard-tonic.name: Orange Guard Tonic
u.orange-guard-tonic.description: Originally concocted to keep him safe during his forays into the forest, Nphireo was oblivious to his creation's market-potential until a friend saw an ogre break a club harmlessly over Nphireo's head.

a.highland-scout.name: Highland Scout
a.highland-scout.description: One has to be fast and able to keep low in order to scout the highlands. Fortunately, these scouts are both weathered and well-trained.
a.highland-scout.effects: Adds +3 Attack to Nhuman Dannu and Bantiloche in the active Formation

c.troll-club.name: Troll Club
c.troll-club.description: It isn't common for Hill Trolls to use tools, but those that do can accomplish considerable feats of cruelty.

ba.illustrious-archmage-banner.name: Illustrious Archmage Banner
ba.illustrious-archmage-banner.description: Obtained with the Illustrious Archmage Class

e.oresnatchs-red-ring.name: Oresnatch's Red Ring
e.oresnatchs-red-ring.effects: Vazz's Treasure: 100% chance to proc 250 Magic damage and give +2% Crit Rate on that proc
e.oresnatchs-red-ring.description: You've seen few rings anywhere near this fine, despite the simplicity in the band. The ring's red hue shines luminescently in the light.

e.mordant-moswa-antlers.name: Mordant Moswa Antlers
e.mordant-moswa-antlers.effects:
Acidic Antlers (Antlers): 25% chance to proc 2080 Magic damage; +10000 damage vs Guild Raids; +320 damage per Mordant Moswa set item worn; 6% chance to proc 6000 Nature damage; +1000 damage per Mordant Moswa set item worn; 25% chance to proc 400 Acid damage; +150 damage per Mordant Moswa set item worn
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.mordant-moswa-antlers.description: III. Brath rubbed his temples as he tried to nurse away a pending headache, and days' worth of fatigue from poor sleep. He was used to sleeping soundly, but in recent weeks his dreams had been haunted by strange visions and voices, of a visage that seemed fleetingly familiar drawing out the essence of the land, and flashings of an ethereal, skeletal hand cloaked in an endlessly dark shroud uttering words that, to the best he could figure, sounded of Naog Loga Rogag Dez Zoz Naog Arokak. The soothing motion of his fingers on his tired temples, coupled with the late-afternoon sun baring down on him in his chair, caused Brath's breathing to draw deeper, and in moments he was out... Until he saw the visions anew, coupled with a panic and fear that he had previously never experienced, and the clear utterance of a single word: Cenius.

c.red-pickaxe.name: Red Pickaxe
c.red-pickaxe.description: A remnant of when the Dwarves actively mined near the surface of Mihr, this axe has been creatively coloured in honour of the ancestral miners.

e.alchemical-artisans-conveyance.name: Alchemical Artisan's Conveyance
e.alchemical-artisans-conveyance.effects:
Explosive Eccentricities (Conveyance): 4% chance to proc 600 Fire damage; +800 damage per Alchemical Artisan set item worn; 50% chance to proc 40 Nature damage; +25 damage per Alchemical Artisan set item worn; 16% chance to proc 220 Poison damage; +160 damage per Alchemical Artisan set item worn; +2% Evasion; +10% Crit Damage

e.alchemical-artisans-conveyance.description: XI. Before long the elixir was complete, and Nahla carefully fed it to the sick child, helping her to swallow it all in spite of its foul taste. In a few hours the fever broke, and the child was sitting up and eating less than a week later. Only after this girl recovered did Nahla see the world anew, as though a veil of darkness, doubt and self-blame had been lifted from her vision, as she realized once more that she had much to offer the world, and the world had much for her. Nahla's love of studying the world around her returned, and she accumulated much wisdom in the ensuing decades, becoming one of the land's foremost experts in the effects the seas had on the sky and land, and how they, in turn, impacted her waters.

c.recruiting-posters.name: Recruiting Posters
c.recruiting-posters.description:
"When you're short on hands, it's always wise to get the word out that you're seeking able-bodied individuals, willing to join your cause."
-Hamond

c.violet-horde-battleaxe.name: Violet Horde Battleaxe
c.violet-horde-battleaxe.description: Not every axe used by the barbarian tribes is intended for combat. Some appear to denote rank. Others... Might be a cruel prank played on one another?

e.reodai-band.name: Reodai Band
e.reodai-band.effects:
+100 HP; +3% Evasion; +1% Crit Rate

e.reodai-band.description:
"Thisss ring sssignifiesss your commitment to the teachingsss of the Reodai. When you look inwardsss today, what you sssee isss ssstill-"
-Conversations with Lokakshi Coilbreaker... at least, as far as you could converse listening to the repeated hisses.

e.threofor-spikes.name: Threofor Spikes

e.threofor-spikes.description: XI. It wasn't long before Ceta began figuring out how to beckon several smaller creatures over to the building, using a variety of different whistles, calls and sounds, and she developed such proficiency in the technique that she could summon specific, individual beasts, whom she began identifying by name.

e.conquerors-sallet.name: Conqueror's Sallet
e.conquerors-sallet.effects:

Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.conquerors-sallet.description: Long ago, this nation was not one country, but dozens of individual ones that frequently quarreled and plotted for power between themselves, often-as-not falling prey to their neighbours while they enacted their own schemes. Temujin, born from humble beginnings, had no grandiose notions of changing that, rather simply wanting to improve the lot of him and his family.

ba.horizon-walker-banner.name: Horizon Walker Banner
ba.horizon-walker-banner.description: Obtained with the Horizon Walker Class

u.ice-resilience-potion.name: Ice Resilience Potion
u.ice-resilience-potion.description: A thick, viscous brew, which leaves a distinct aftertaste of coriander.

a.veteran-dwarven-demoguard.name: Veteran Dwarven Demoguard
a.veteran-dwarven-demoguard.description: Full of merit, yet having no patience for layabouts, these Demoguards are tried-and-tested and prepared to defend against any demonic incursion.
a.veteran-dwarven-demoguard.effects: Adds +4 Attack to Glasha Brunbruk in the active Formation

c.blue-thurlam-blowfish.name: Blue Thurlam Blowfish
c.blue-thurlam-blowfish.description: You are hesitant to touch such a prickly, soggy creature, until you see Mauritio put one to his mouth and blow hard, inflating it to comical proportions.

a.guild-beastmaster.name: Guild Beastmaster
a.guild-beastmaster.description: Having mastered the art of controlling virtually any kind of beast, this Beastmaster is the epitome of adept when it comes to handling the Stadium's populace.

She followed the shadow of the drake to a rocky outcropping, where she saw it feasting upon a tendril-like, sinewy creature, and recognizing her presence was already known she simply waited for the dragon to finish its meal and openly acknowledge her before venturing closer.

e.stormshapers-cuisses.name: Stormshapers' Cuisses
e.stormshapers-cuisses.effects:
Stormfury (Cuisses): 12% chance to proc 450 Lightning damage; +100 damage per Stormshapers' set item worn; 4% chance to proc 1,400 Lightning damage; +200 damage per Stormshapers' set item worn; +3% Lightning Resistance

 9+: 50% chance to proc 120 Lightning damage, +5 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Lightning' and +20% Lightning Resistance
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.stormshapers-cuisses.description: They aren't stylish. They aren't quiet. But they do seem to bring the whole ensemble together... In a crazed, storm-loving dwarf kind of way.

s.scroll-vildmand-horde.name: Vildmand Horde Scroll
s.scroll-vildmand-horde.description: A wild horde of savages are bearing down upon small villages! They happily attack you and your forces even before you decide to give aid.

e.wapiti-gloves.name: Wapiti Gloves
e.wapiti-gloves.effects:
White Rump Roar (Gloves): 25% chance to proc 200 Magic damage; +2000 damage vs Guild Raids; +25 damage per Wapiti set item worn; 6% chance to proc 600 Nature damage; +50 damage per Wapiti set item worn
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.wapiti-gloves.description: XII. Brath's mother spent considerable time at home, with Brath, while in the city, but that changed when they moved to the cottage, and his mother began spending much of her time in the forest, leaving Brath in the care of his father. Brath's

e.quilltips-shirt.effects:
Set Bonus (Quilltip's Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +40 Magic and +1 Tiers of 'Attentive Perception'
e.quilltips-shirt.description: II. "Be sure that the mason's guild gets their four percent commission. Scratch that, offer three percent, and if they balk we can counter with three and a half. Are you getting all of that?" Loric refrained from sighing for the dozenth time this morning, merely nodding and murmuring an 'mmhmm' to acknowledge his employer. Loric had already learned that she did not want him to actually speak, but she hated being ignored even more, so this seemed to be the best compromise to avoid another lashing. Loric scribbled furiously on his parchment, and continued following the young noblewoman down the lengthy hallway, taking down what he could while, unavoidably, taking in more than he wished.

e.repentant-dusk-cuisses.name: Repentant Dusk Cuisses
e.repentant-dusk-cuisses.effects:

Sanctified

e.repentant-dusk-cuisses.description: You were wondering if the armor came with extra padding in the knees, considering how 'repenting' and devout Qina seems to be. Unfortunately, it does not seem to be the case, but fortunately they seem to spend less time in prayer than you had expected.

a.vrandas-beastwhisperer.name: Vranda's Beastwhisperer
a.vrandas-beastwhisperer.description:
"The other ssside of the coin isss when one isss able to innately underssstand every type of beassst'sss inner thoughtsss and desssiresss; the casssual glanssse, the ssshift in posssture, the quiver of a lip... That isss all that isss needed to know presssisssely what a beassst isss thinking."
-Vranda
a.vrandas-beastwhisperer.effects: Soothing Whispers: 10% chance to proc 280 Magic damage vs Beast raids; Adds +0.5 Defence to Vranda, Stadium Manager in the active Formation

c.green-xaphegorgh-claws.name: Green Xaphegorgh Claws
c.green-xaphegorgh-claws.description: You can almost feel the evil of the commander within its harvested claws, and the essences of the lives it had taken. Hopefully you can use this to find a way to stop this demonic incursion.

u.grand-honor-potion.name: Grand Honor Potion
u.grand-honor-potion.description: Legends tell of a vile plot to shame the warrior-King Capranidas by secretly getting him to drink one of these potions on the eve before a duel. The King still agreed to the duel the following day, and honourably slew his opponent without hesitation.

ba.glorious-fortunist-banner.name: Glorious Fortunist Banner
ba.glorious-fortunist-banner.description: Obtained with the Glorious Fortunist Class

e.hachibi-flail.name: Hachibi Flail
e.hachibi-flail.effects: Eight-tailed Octo-Inking: 24% chance to proc 760 Dark damage
e.hachibi-flail.description: The eight violet tails appear almost as if they had come from a cephalopod. The ink they splatter everywhere only adds to this, and to the general mess.

e.thunderbirds-feather.name: Thunderbird's Feather
e.thunderbirds-feather.effects:
Graced by Thunder (Feather): 24% chance to proc 500 Lightning damage; +25 damage per Thunderbird set item worn; +0.5% Evasion
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.thunderbirds-feather.description: "Each feather of a Thunderbird is said to carry a rainbow within its folds, and after donning one of them you cannot believe these tales to be purely exaggeration."

e.oresnatchs-great-green-ring.name: Oresnatch's Great Green Ring
e.oresnatchs-great-green-ring.effects: Vazz's Pride and Joy: 100% chance to proc 500 Magic damage and give +1,500 Defence on that proc
e.oresnatchs-great-green-ring.description: Somehow, jewelers were able to take the magnificence in Vazz's green ring, and infuse it even more potently with more of his Rainbow Ore. It glows masterfully, and its magical powers gently settle upon you when you try it on.

e.reverent-titanslayer-kylie.name: Reverent Titanslayer Kylie
e.reverent-titanslayer-kylie.effects:

e.reverent-titanslayer-kylie.description: A foreign throwing device, you suspected it worked similarly to something you had fashioned from spider legs, but the wooden haft appears to return back to your hand... When you aim it properly, anyway.

e.notched-spear.name: Notched Spear
e.notched-spear.description: You've heard the saying 'Another notch in your belt', but never suspected that someone might actually take it literally.... with a spear....

e.lesser-ent-wood-boots.name: Lesser Ent Wood-Boots
e.lesser-ent-wood-boots.effects: Ent Smash (Boots): 10% chance to proc 125 Nature damage; +25 damage per Lesser Ent set item worn
e.lesser-ent-wood-boots.description: V. After having experienced the anger of the Ents, however, you have a deeper appreciation for the powers they possess, though you do question some of the wisdom the old tales told of... Fire seemed to be a great deal more helpful in dealing with them than wooden blades seemed to be!

c.exploding-bladder.name: Exploding Bladder
c.exploding-bladder.description: "Really?" ...... "No, really? Seriously? I jus-... I just can't...."

a.cilva.name: Cilva
a.cilva.description: Perhaps the least laid-back Gnome you've met to date, Cilva always seems to have several things on the go. Her peculiar thoughts regarding grooming habits don't particularly strike your fancy, however.

e.song-of-radiance-boots.name: Song of Radiance Boots
e.song-of-radiance-boots.effects:
Brilliant Song (Boots): 24% chance to proc 400 Magic damage; +75 damage per Song of Radiance set item worn; +40 Magic; +2% Magic Resistance

Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.song-of-radiance-boots.description: These boots were specially made for the stirrups designed for the Songbird of Radiance, and while they are not something you'd want to wear when walking a long distance, you believe they would keep both the bird, and Janagud, happy while you ride your new mount.

c.red-vildmand-runic-focus.name: Red Vildmand Runic Focus
c.red-vildmand-runic-focus.description: The barbarian tribes' casters focus their energies through various runes in order to deliver powerful, magical blasts. It is certainly different than what you've experienced from Alanis, Nico and the others, but it seems no less effective.

e.derzis-thunderclap-shoes.name: Derzis' Thunderclap Shoes
e.derzis-thunderclap-shoes.effects:

e.derzis-thunderclap-shoes.description:
"Perhaps we shall call you 'Lightning Dancer' and start your legendary tales, yes?"
-Nico Orbesco

e.sinderklaz-hat.description: The moment you don this hat, a feeling of cheer and mirth settles over you like a warm blanket. It is quickly dashed when you spot Alanis obviously failing to contain her pointed laughter.

u.green-guild-kit-iii.name: Green Guild Kit III
u.green-guild-kit-iii.description: A small, tidy sack, purporting to carry goods from the same source Slygse gets her alchemical wares.
u.green-guild-kit-iii.effects: Open to obtain its contents (two of the chance drops)

a.veedsamin-junior-ranger.name: Veedsamin Junior Ranger
a.veedsamin-junior-ranger.description:
"Some say that Elves make the best Rangers, but it is the training, and the desire to excel, that truly drives a person to excellence."
-Leera Hillvale
a.veedsamin-junior-ranger.effects: Adds +5 Attack to Leera Hillvale in the active Formation

a.thephis-stonegaze.name: Thephis Stonegaze
a.thephis-stonegaze.description: An enigmatic being, this lumbering fellow initially presented as apathetic and uncaring, though your perception of him soon changed when you noticed him slamming his club into the ground mere feet from you, lifting it to reveal a tiny scorpion crushed underneath.

e.baron-aureus-signet.description: As fancy a ring as you've ever seen, you figure the Baron must have spared no expense preparing this band for his daughter.

u.indigo-vintners-satchel.name: Indigo Vintner's Satchel
u.indigo-vintners-satchel.description: A satchel clearly cared for by a busy vintner, containing a mystery potion.
u.indigo-vintners-satchel.effects: Open to obtain its contents (four of the chance drops)

c.repentant-dusk-ice-boost.name: Repentant Dusk Ice Boost
c.repentant-dusk-ice-boost.description: It seems Sar Qina has continued to develop her icy skills, courtesy the resources you have been able to provide her. Now, how you use those skills will be up to you. Passively adds 50,000 Ice damage to the Repentant Dusk Set 8 proc. (Max 1)

e.swiftslicer-blade.effects:

u.parchment-of-whiplash.description: A well-folded scroll, with a single large tear down its center!

e.mikoko-mishigama.name: Mikoko Mishigama
e.mikoko-mishigama.effects:

e.conquerors-vambraces.description: Temujin’s early victories were arguably what won him the remainder of his campaign, as his tactical prowess seemed utterly unmatched and undefeatable. His eye for talent was equally gifted, and many of his closest advisors and war-generals were hand-picked from the ranks of his defeated enemies, and they served him faithfully throughout his operations.

e.velvet-hooves.name: Velvet Hooves
e.velvet-hooves.effects:
Downy Punishment (Hooves): 40% chance to proc 105 Holy damage; +1250 damage vs Guild Raids; +15 damage per Velvet set item worn

e.blade-of-mestari.name: Blade of Mestari
e.blade-of-mestari.effects: Divine Empowerment: 40% chance to proc 150 Holy damage
e.blade-of-mestari.description: Said to be a gift from the Gods themselves, this blade shimmers with divine radiance and feels unusually light in your hand. It was said to have been lost to time, but in reforging it you feel as though it has retained its holy essence.

c.bailing-pail.name: Bailing Pail
c.bailing-pail.description: Only a fool walks into a fight without a weapon, and the same can be said about one boarding a ship without proper protective equipment.

u.dilute-energy-potion.name: Dilute Energy Potion
u.dilute-energy-potion.description: Leaving a distinct, if faint, taste of mint in your mouth, you've often wondered if you'd be capable of brewing this on your own. Nphireo's look of astonishment and horror at the suggestion, however, suggested otherwise.

a.dwarven-sharpshooter.name: Dwarven Sharpshooter
a.dwarven-sharpshooter.description: You thought you'd seen it all when you came across these stout Dwarves sporting one-handed crossbows, but were quickly disabused of that notion when you lost sight of them, only to see the damage they could wreak on the field of battle.
a.dwarven-sharpshooter.effects: Adds +1 Player Energy per occupied Troop slot

e.veedsamin-trainees-helm.name: Veedsamin Trainee's Helm
e.veedsamin-trainees-helm.effects:
Trainee Hunter (Helm): 25% chance to proc 115 Physical damage; +75 damage per Veedsamin Trainee's set item worn; +14 HP; +1% All Resistances

 8+: Additional Bonuses depending on Main-Hand/Off-Hand equipped

"Our trainees will take more-than-a-few knocks to the noggin' during their training, and we have found that a decent helm goes a long way to reducing attrition rates."

s.scroll-seelie-host.name: Seelie Host Scroll
s.scroll-seelie-host.description: The shining court of the Seelie hosts some of the most brilliant of the Fae, but some of whom are not happy to see a Human in their midsts.

e.waveblessed-crossbow.name: Waveblessed Crossbow
e.waveblessed-crossbow.effects:
By the Waves (Crossbow): 24% chance to proc 250 Nature damage; +125 damage per Waveblessed set item worn; 24% chance to proc 250 Holy damage; +125 damage per Waveblessed set item worn; +500 Magic; +10% Crit Damage

 8+: +2% Crit Rate and +15% Crit Damage
 9+: +6% All Resistances and 5% chance to heal the Player 1.8 HP
e.waveblessed-crossbow.description:
"If you're going to be shooting at things, do your best to be precise. I'd appreciate less work on my end, needing to patch up the new holes you've made."
-Azalea Waveblessed

p.skill-endurance.name: Endurance Skill Point
p.skill-endurance.description: Skill Point for the Endurance Tech Tree

c.orange-dragonslayer-gem.name: Orange Dragonslayer Gem
c.orange-dragonslayer-gem.description: This fine, magical, orange gem resonates in proximity to the Blade of Mestari. What could the connection be between these two artifacts?

e.vibrant-darts.name: Vibrant Darts
e.vibrant-darts.effects:
Colours of Creation (Darts): 40% chance to proc 35 Poison damage; +5 Poison damage per Vibrant Victors set item worn; 2% chance to proc 1,500 Poison damage; +500 Poison damage per Vibrant Victors set item worn
Set Bonus (Vibrant Victors Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +60 Vitality, +5 Energy, +5 Honor, +35% Crit Damage and +150 Magic
e.vibrant-darts.description:
"I can appreciate your... fascination with the colours, but concocting a poison that turns its victims strange colours seems unnecessary..."
-Conversations with Cyran Jokalyn

a.tacito-flummox.name: Tacito Flummox
a.tacito-flummox.description: You don't know why it is that you seem to attract unspeaking, undead creatures to your ranks, but any defector from your enemy's ranks means one fewer thing you have to fight, and more allies to call upon.
a.tacito-flummox.effects: Caesura: 5% chance to proc 7,500 Physical damage; Adds +2 Attack and +1 Defence to each Flummox Soldier and Flummox Beast in the Formation; Restores 6 Health daily

e.swamp-nomad-shoes.name: Swamp Nomad Shoes
e.swamp-nomad-shoes.effects:
Swamp's Thing (Shoes): 4% chance to proc 1600 Nature damage; +200 damage per Swamp Nomad's set item worn; +30 Magic; +3% Nature Resistance; +3% Poison Resistance
Set Bonus (Swamp Nomad Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +1 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Nature'
e.swamp-nomad-shoes.description: You had hoped that the nomadic people of the swamp might have some enchantments on their footwear to help keep them out of the dense, muddy swamp water. Yet again, it seems your hopes are dashed.

e.copperhead-boots.name: Copperhead Boots
e.copperhead-boots.effects:
+4% Lightning Resistance
Set Bonus (Copperhead Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +5% Lightning Resistance
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion

This copper-skinned Naga attempted to broker a peaceful agreement with Thotssaken, but she rebuked his advances, resulting in an eventual conflict that fractured the Naga clans.

e.atlas-buubry.name: Atlas Buubry
e.atlas-buubry.effects: Fabled Fiord Flight: 40% chance to proc 2,500 Physical damage; 30% chance to proc 1,500 Magic damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 10%; 5% chance to proc 5,000 Magic damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 30%; 2% chance to proc 2,500 Physical damage and heal the Player 4 HP; +2% Evasion
e.atlas-buubry.description: The fabled power of the Buubry, when contained within mystical restraints and enhanced with mythical baubles, is said to multiply a dozen times over, awakening new energies within it that it wields within its subtle frame.

e.pegasus.name: Pegasus
e.pegasus.effects: Diving Gallop: 25% chance to proc 350 Holy damage
e.pegasus.description: Particularly cunning, these mounts are difficult to capture and even harder to train, resulting in exorbitant prices being paid by nobles to obtain them.

c.fortified-reel.name: Fortified Reel
c.fortified-reel.description: Unlike the spools you've seen on smaller rods, the marvel of technology appears to be significantly sturdier, as is likely needed for deep, ocean-dwelling creatures.

a.occult-student.name: Occult Student
a.occult-student.description: With the reappearance of the Void and magic becoming much more prevalent, the numbers of initiates flocking to study the mystic arts has surged. With focus, study and a bit of innate ability, who knows what these students will be able to accomplish?

a.geos-particular-servant.name: Geo's Particular Servant
a.geos-particular-servant.description:
"It is perfectly acceptable to hold high standards, and to expect those serving you to live up to them, however peculiar those standards may be."
-Geo Fray
a.geos-particular-servant.effects: Adds +4 Attack to Geo Fray, Head Servant in the active Formation

e.gipantan-recruit-cuirass.name: Gipantan Recruit Cuirass
e.gipantan-recruit-cuirass.effects:

 6+: +2 Tiers of 'Medium Armor Proficiency', +2 Tiers of 'Polearm Proficiency' and +2 Tiers of 'Crossbow Proficiency'
e.gipantan-recruit-cuirass.description:
"Oh, is'ot is'it? Better t'be hot and livin' than cool and poked full've arrows!"
-Lobaic Bronzefury

a.living-shadow.name: Living Shadow
a.living-shadow.description: Whether the rumours surrounding them are true and they hail from the bowels of the Dark Realms, or whether they are the creations of man, these stealthy beings are nearly impossible to pin down.

e.naitour-patrol-cuisses.name: Naitour Patrol Cuisses
e.naitour-patrol-cuisses.effects:
Persevering Patrol (Cuisses): 10% chance to proc 800 Physical damage; +50 damage per Naitour Patrol set item worn; +300 damage vs Undead raids; +20 Max HP
Set Bonus (Naitour Patrol Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +2 Tiers of 'Prolonged Battle'
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.naitour-patrol-cuisses.description:
"The Fort is an invaluable asset to the military and economic potential of Nepyres Territory. We have been entrusted with its safeguarding, and we in turn entrust you to stop whatever is plaguing the land."
-Avri Stidig

m.lesser-thrust.name: Lesser Thrust
m.lesser-thrust.description:
"Perhaps 'Slight Heave' would be a more apt name for this one. 'Sharp nudge'? 'Fervent poke'? 'Brief shove'? 'Light shove'?" 

"... Look, the next time I want to cast 'Annoying Thesaurus' I'll be in touch!"
m.lesser-thrust.effects: Lesser Thrust: 5% chance to proc [5-50]% Magic damage

u.violet-brewmasters-bulwark-brew.name: Violet Brewmaster's Bulwark Brew
u.violet-brewmasters-bulwark-brew.description:
"I seek only to aid your worthy efforts, adventurer, and I hope that this can keep you safe in your hour of need."
-Nphireo

c.spore-muncher-mite.name: Spore Muncher Mite
c.spore-muncher-mite.description: You've been unable to come up with any sustainable solutions to these problematic spores, until you found a small infestation of these bugs that seem to eat them out of the air. Well, it wouldn't be the strangest thing you've adorned yourself with...

e.crestaceo-elder.name: Crestaceo Elder

 9+: +0.5 Formation Protection Value

It remains unclear as to who the victor was in the ensuing conflict, where the fiercest blade clashed with the most fortified shield, but rumours suggest that the two opposing factions found their peace in light of the terrible conflict they had unleashed, while no stories of any substance tell of any deeds from either the Knight or Hero following the confrontation.

e.warmage-guardians-rod.name: Warmage Guardian's Rod
e.warmage-guardians-rod.effects:
Magic Shield (Rod): 14% chance to proc 200 Magic damage and add +300 Defence; +350 damage per Warmage Guardian's set item worn; +1% Crit Rate; +5% All Resistances
Set Bonus (Warmage Guardian's Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +1% Crit Rate
 7+: +500 Defence and +15% Crit Damage
 9+: +20% chance to proc 200 Magic damage with +6% damage from any Magic damage on that proc
e.warmage-guardians-rod.description: Alternatively, you could always seek to learn from your employer, providing they're willing to teach you.

e.snowdrake-slayer-frostwulf.name: Snowdrake Slayer Frostwulf
e.snowdrake-slayer-frostwulf.effects:
Walking in a Winter Wasteland (Frostwulf): 16% chance to proc 375 Physical damage; +1,500 damage vs Winter raids; +1,250 damage vs Dragon raids; +5% Ice Resistance; +125 damage per Snowdrake Slayer set item worn
Set Bonus (Snowdrake Slayer Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +2% Crit Rate and +30% Crit Damage
e.snowdrake-slayer-frostwulf.description: Arguably one of the least-friendly mounts you've had the pleasure of locating, you are hesitant to climb up on this furry creature's back, for fear of the inevitable time you need to dismount.

e.baron-aureus-frostchariot.name: Baron Aureus' Frostchariot
e.baron-aureus-frostchariot.effects:
Golden Noble (Frostchariot): 45% chance to proc 200 Ice damage and adding +15% Nature Resistance and +5% Ice Resistance and -10% Dark Resistance and -10% Fire Resistance on this proc; +175 damage per Baron Aureus' set item worn

 5+: +175 HP and +25% Crit Damage

e.baron-aureus-frostchariot.description: After a few moments of resting your hands along the rail, you feel your skin start to stick to it. You'll have to take extra caution not to let anything wet near this chariot while you're riding it.

e.hooded-veil-slicer.name: Hooded Veil Slicer
e.hooded-veil-slicer.effects: Fangs Alot (Slicer): 18% chance to proc 200 Poison damage; +25 damage per Hooded Veil set item worn; +6 Offence
e.hooded-veil-slicer.description:
II. "It iss ssaid that sshe wass immenssely powerful, but rather than jusst employing potent venomss sshe masstered various divine artss, though the namess of her patronss wass never sshared."
-Seksehsa

u.nakatotaw-bag.name: Nakatotaw Bag
u.nakatotaw-bag.description:
"The evil dwelling within is never truly beaten, only beaten back. But with this, we may find time to forgive, and grieve."
-Kitchi Wayguard
u.nakatotaw-bag.effects: Open to obtain its contents (two of the chance drops)

e.mephitic-chiffon-pants.name: Mephitic Chiffon Pants
e.mephitic-chiffon-pants.effects:
Downy Destruction (Pants): 40% chance to proc 375 Holy damage; +6250 damage vs Guild Raids; +125 damage per Mephitic Chiffon set item worn; 25% chance to proc 400 Poison damage; +150 damage per Mephitic Chiffon set item worn
Set Bonus (Mephitic Chiffon Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +6% All Resistances; 1% chance to heal the Player 5 HP
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.mephitic-chiffon-pants.description:
XIII. Brianag's confusion was palpable as Brath watched her face before unleashing a bolt of energy to propel her backwards. Brath didn't know how Cenius had communicated with her, or what exactly he had conveyed to her, but he had no intention of letting her see his plans through, and Brath quickly kneeled down to place both of his hands upon the ground. Gritting his teeth with the effort - Brath was still keenly aware that the energy required for his spells would have to come from his own reserves, given the strain the cult had placed upon the area with their rituals - Brath began chanting quickly, causing the ground to ebb upwards, before heaving down, starting a violent tremor that violently shook the area. The cultists that had still be standing were knocked prone, several of which suffering violent injury as they fell, and several of the nearby trees began to topple as the spell took effect. Offering a silent prayer for their sacrifice, Brath called forth the last reserves of those fallen trees - whose lives would otherwise pass needlessly - and summoned stone bindings for the cultists on the ground, sealing them tight to the earth.

"This is impossible! You were our sacrifice! He was going to share his power!" Brianag screamed in futility as she was bound against a tree opposite Brath, and he could only shrug... Until the pyre flared out entirely and the area went dark. Brath looked back at the remnants of the fire, then heard a series of moans; when Brath looked back, he could see a dark energy flowing out of Brianag's mouth as her back arched unnaturally, and then he could see similar from the other cultists. The energy all approached and coalesced over the fire, and Brath's heart sank when he saw a face in the dark cloud, one that he recognized from his nightmares. Cenius, in some form, appeared to have returned.

a.three-teeth-farnham.name: Three-Teeth Farnham
a.three-teeth-farnham.description:
"Aie, the song of the mermaid is said to be beautiful, farmer. If not for my own nigh-deafness, I'm sure I'd happily partake in Mistress Corrissa's melodies."
-Three-Teeth Farnham
a.three-teeth-farnham.effects: Mermaid Hunted: 4% chance to proc 2450 Physical damage; +40 Attack when in the Formation Sailors and Sirens I

e.picaroons-hook.name: Picaroon's Hook
e.picaroons-hook.effects:
Swabby Sealover (Hook): 15% chance to proc 60 Physical damage; +50 damage per Picaroon's Raiments set item worn; +200 damage vs Human raids; +0.5% Crit Rate; +10% Crit Damage; Deals 60 Physical damage on Crits
Set Bonus (Picaroon's Raiment Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +2% Crit Rate
 7+: +25% Crit Damage
e.picaroons-hook.description: Providing you can simply hold this blade in your off hand, and are not required to affix it to a stump, this could prove useful aboard a ship.

u.red-fury-tonic.name: Red Fury Tonic
u.red-fury-tonic.description: There is something soothingly simple about a potion that fires up your fervor and titillates your temper...

c.demonic-seals-heart.name: Demonic Seal's Heart
c.demonic-seals-heart.description: A small piece of the original seal, it seems to pulsate with dark energies. Alanis cannot make out if this being kept by the demonic warlord was adding to his power, or reducing it, but in either case you're glad it is no longer in its possession.

a.councillor-timnes.name: Councillor Timnes
a.councillor-timnes.description: It is entirely possible that this fellow was a fair politician - if such a thing even exists - during peacetimes. However, this invasion has demonstrated the extent of his cowardice, as he has been reduced to little more than a snivelling mess.
a.councillor-timnes.effects: Cowardly Counseling: 8% chance to proc 1,500 Dark damage

a.sinuous-shaman.name: Sinuous Shaman
a.sinuous-shaman.description: It seems Seksehsa was magnanimous in sharing his teachings, and while few of his students rose to the level of power he could display, in numbers they were still invaluable in the infirmary.

c.mark-of-the-fen.name: Mark of the Fen
c.mark-of-the-fen.description: A token reminder of the boggy wasteland you endured on your quest.

ru.jeralaguz-rune-3.name: Jeralaguz Rune (JL) Lv. 3
ru.jeralaguz-rune-3.effects:
Can provide one of the following boosts:
-+8-10 Formation Power (50%)
-+10-12 Magic (40%)
-50% chance to proc 16-20 Psychic damage on attacks (10%)

c.red-thick-fur.name: Red Thick Fur
c.red-thick-fur.description: There is no doubting that this fur would keep you warm, even during a night out-of-doors, but you aren't convinced the colour would reduce your likelihood of being spotted.

c.yellow-fae-candle.name: Yellow Fae Candle
c.yellow-fae-candle.description: The flame from this candle seems to dance in unnatural ways... Almost as unnatural as the hues of the flame, itself.

e.wisp-of-wills.name: Wisp-of-Wills
e.wisp-of-wills.effects: Spectralumination: 50% chance to proc 420 Magic damage and +50% Crit Damage on that hit and +500 Magic on that hit
e.wisp-of-wills.description: At first glance you'd not have thought there was any way to 'ride' such a being, but after being inexplicably propped into the air, guided by shining-and-shimmering lights beneath you, you've come to realize that the explanation isn't necessary if the method works.

ru.nagalansuz-rune-2.name: Nagalansuz Rune (HA) Lv. 2
ru.nagalansuz-rune-2.effects:
Can provide one of the following boosts:
-100% chance to proc 2-4 Holy damage on attacks (30%)
-100% chance to proc 2-4 Dark damage on attacks (30%)
-+1% Holy Resistance (20%)
-+1% Dark Resistance (20%)

e.vildmand-platefur-pants.name: Vildmand Platefur Pants
e.vildmand-platefur-pants.effects:
Armored And Algid (Pants): 10% chance to proc 300 Physical damage; +400 damage per Vildmand Platefur set item worn; +4% Ice Resistance; 5% chance to proc 400 Physical damage and add +2,000 Defence

 6+: +10% Ice Resistance

Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.vildmand-platefur-pants.description: You wish one of the barbarians was around to canvas what animal the fur hide comes from, as nobody around seems to be able to quite put their finger on it.

e.plain-leather-pants.name: Plain Leather Pants
e.plain-leather-pants.description: Despite the simplicity of it, you'll have to thank Edwin for ensuring these pants don't chafe.

u.cruel-devils-sack.name: Cruel Devil's Sack
u.cruel-devils-sack.description: Despite the dark energies that went into summoning this bag, alongside the sacrifice of all those artifacts, you are pleased with the results... at least, until your fingers feel something sticky, within.

a.guild-spy.name: Guild Spy
a.guild-spy.description: Sussing out information is hardly the job for a heroic adventurer, but it's essential that they have trusted allies nearby who are able to perform the task for them!

e.meftet-whelp.name: Meftet Whelp
e.meftet-whelp.effects: Capital Justice (Whelp): 15% chance to proc 1000 Dark damage; +60 damage per Meftet set item worn
e.meftet-whelp.description:
"This is the first time I've laid eyes upon a Meftet whelp this young. Who knows, perhaps you may be capable of successfully taming the beast, if you keep enough of those elderberries on hand."
-Janagud

c.champions-symbol-of-devotion.name: Champion's Symbol of Devotion
c.champions-symbol-of-devotion.description: The mark of a true Champion of your Guild, this honour is only bestowed to the most worthy of those who serve you and your Guildmates.

a.sar-qina-of-the-repentant-dusk.name: Sar Qina of the Repentant Dusk
a.sar-qina-of-the-repentant-dusk.description: Once a lieutenant in the Order of the Heroic Dusk, Qina left due to ideological differences and strove to develop both herself, and enhance her faith, in the mountains. Credited with exceptional skill in her ice magics, she has proven herself, being properly knighted within the Empire, and through her charity and good deeds has developed both a significant, and talented, following.
a.sar-qina-of-the-repentant-dusk.effects: Frost of the Repentant Dusk: 18% chance to proc 13,000 Ice damage; +800 damage per Repentant Dusk set item, Magic and Formation owned; Adds +8 Attack and +0.8 Defence to each Repentant Dusk Blade and Repentant Dusk Cover in the Formation; Gains +4 Attack and +0.1 Defence per distinct Repentant Dusk set item and Formation owned

a.vicynor-hammerleaf.name: Vicynor Hammerleaf
a.vicynor-hammerleaf.description: Despite pledging himself to the healing arts, you have a difficult time hiding your disdain for Vicynor, as he is perhaps the most vain individual you know. Your disgust appears to be shared by many others, and despite his well-built form he insists on keeping himself virtually unharmed in battle before considering the needs of his comrades. His argument that the healers have to be kept safe would mean a lot more if he actually bothered to heal anyone other than himself!
a.vicynor-hammerleaf.effects: 0.4% chance to heal self for 1 Health

e.nepyren-bone-gauntlets.name: Nepyren Bone Gauntlets
e.nepyren-bone-gauntlets.effects:
Dark Remains (Gauntlets): 12% chance to proc 780 Dark damage; +100 damage per Nepyren Bone set item worn
Set Bonus (Nepyren Bone Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 8+: +1 Tiers of 'Inspirational Command - Horrifying'
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.nepyren-bone-gauntlets.description: These gloves may not win you any favour with the local townsfolk, but you can't argue with the results of using them to strike an errant foe in combat.

e.sanctified-leoegan-helmet.name: Sanctified Leoegan Helmet
e.sanctified-leoegan-helmet.effects:
As the Gods Command (Helmet): 8% chance to proc 350 Holy damage; +100 damage per Sanctified Leoegan set item worn
Sanctified
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.sanctified-leoegan-helmet.description: XII. Arriving at the smaller temple, Paython as greeted by several acolytes who informed him that their worship was devoted to Derzis. Passing a thin figure with strange, electrical protrusions, Paython made his way to the altar of Derzis, and fell to his knees. Without warning a flash of lightning struck the altar, leaving Paython seeing only whiteness as every hair on his body stood erect.

s.scroll-fallen-naga-subedar.name: Fallen Naga Subedar Scroll
s.scroll-fallen-naga-subedar.description: This guard was raised to keep his kin in line. You can only wonder if he was acting of his own accord, or was forced against his undying will.

e.wapitis-wand.name: Wapiti's Wand
e.wapitis-wand.effects: White Rump Roar (Wand): 25% chance to proc 200 Magic damage; +2,000 damage vs Guild Raids; +25 damage per Wapiti set item worn; 6% chance to proc 600 Nature damage; +50 damage per Wapiti set item worn; +40 Magic
e.wapitis-wand.description: VIII. Brath dressed himself quickly and quietly, and followed after his mother, this time able to keep up a significant deal better with covered feet. He followed her to a clearing, where he was left speechless to see her enter a circle of large stones, where a sizable, many-pronged stag lay, seeming to await her arrival. Vauntingly,

c.saplings-roots.name: Sapling's Roots
c.saplings-roots.description: You've seen your fair share of roots by now, but supposedly these are useful in making a subtle, though flavourful tea.

u.script-of-dark-beam.name: Script of Dark Beam
u.script-of-dark-beam.description: "Light of life, vacate this host and leave this place! Dark Beam!"

e.keyrics-ring-of-levitation.name: Keyric's Ring of Levitation
e.keyrics-ring-of-levitation.effects: Fending by Floating: 20% chance to proc 2,500 Magic damage and add +20% Evasion on that attack; 10% chance to proc 8,000 Magic damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 50%; 5% chance to proc 25,000 Magic damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 20%; +6% Evasion; +100 Max HP
e.keyrics-ring-of-levitation.description: Vora Keyric was said to have studied a myriad of beasts in her lifetime, and while she respected how they lived in the wild, she also worked to protect the populace from them. After her founding of the Veedsamin, some say she lived out her remaining days in the north, seeking to continue her study and perfecting her research in as non-invasive a manner as possible. Perhaps this legendary band is a demonstration of that.

a.river-smuggler.name: River Smuggler
a.river-smuggler.description:
"Moving goods from place to place is essential for any land's economy. It's only fair that those taking the risks transporting the goods get appropriately compensated, right?"
-Pael Habre

e.vibrant-whip.name: Vibrant Whip
e.vibrant-whip.effects:
Colours of Creation (Whip): 25% chance to proc 120 Lightning damage; +20 Lightning damage per Vibrant Victors set item worn; 10% chance to proc 300 Lightning damage; +50 Lightning damage per Vibrant Victors set item worn

 9+: +5 Vitality, +60 Energy, +5 Honor and +4% Crit Rate

u.lesser-agliata-potion.name: Lesser Agliata Potion
u.lesser-agliata-potion.description:
"A swig of this is all a fine hero ever needs before setting off to vanquish the undead!"
-Corovar
u.lesser-agliata-potion.effects: +1% Crit Rate and +5% Offence vs Lord Kaspar for 12 hours

a.dwarven-demoguard.name: Dwarven Demoguard
a.dwarven-demoguard.description: A devout member of a nameless order dedicated to driving back any demons escaping the Dark Realms, these guards follow a variety of different faiths, all aligned by the same ultimate goal.
a.dwarven-demoguard.effects: Adds +1 Attack to Glasha Brunbruk in the active Formation

u.arthropod-absurd-annihilation-potion.name: Arthropod Absurd Annihilation Potion
u.arthropod-absurd-annihilation-potion.description: To better beat big bugs, bring bulk batches of bubblier brews.

e.mirays-gauntlets.name: Miray's Gauntlets
e.mirays-gauntlets.description: V. After a wait that seemed an eternity, Miray heard indistinct calls from the arena, and from the roars of the crowds knew that the battle was imminent even before the guard unlocked and opened the bars that would lead to the arena. Stepping out, Miray squinted at the bright sunlight and the weight of a thousand spectators assembled to witness this match bore down upon her. Only faintly hearing the proclamation of her arrival, she scanned across the stadium and her heart dropped when her eyes focused upon her foe: she could not recognize him under the plate breastpiece, but noted his pale skin tones behind his mail leggings, before returning to his staggering height. This fighter must be at least a head-and-shoulders taller than Miray, who was far-from-slight herself, and they must have been half-again as wide as she!

XI(c). Feeling a sense of urgency and panic, Kontar dashed forward, scaling the antiquated structures to get a better view of the landscape, but his fears only grew as the wider view remained equally empty. Climbing back to the ground, Kontar grasped at the sides of his head, his vision blurring and closing in as his breathing hastened. As he could hear his heart racing in his ears, Kontar's vision started to blacken and panic overwhelmed him.

'Is it truly so bad, son?'

Kontar looked up in disbelief, startled by the voice he vaguely recognized, and he saw a shimmering, golden man in fancy, if comfortable, dressings.

'It's been a while, so-'

'Father!'

Kontar rushed forward to embrace the man he now recognized as he father, tears flowing from his eyes.

XIII(a). Entering Agiz with no second glance from the guard, Sinyu breathed a silent sigh of relief as he quickly turned down a series of streets he recognized, barely noticing the changes to some of the building fronts from what his recollection recalled. Arriving at his intended goal, he paused, unsure whether to enter or knock on the door, and Sinyu finally decided to walk in and seek whatever fate awaited him.

"I'm home. At last."

Sinyu paused, before he heard a chopping knife cease, and saw a young woman come around the corner and gasp. He stepped forward, and she rushed to embrace him, and the moment was broken only by Sinyu noticing a boy, a few years younger than Kontar, peering around the wall to look up at him with uncertainty.

He was finally home, and he now knew that he would do whatever was necessary to protect that fact, right up to dealing with the threat still seated as Nomarch.

Paython was stunned as his vision began to clear, and he saw no-one else sharing the chamber with him.

e.veedsamin-rangers-crossbow.effects:

"It's a facade, dear. You hear me? I must separate the visionaries from the chaff somehow. Don't be too taken by that silly gem."

e.cart-lizard.description: Equipped with a terrific - if small-fitting - harness system, these lizards can navigate narrow, dark tunnels with ease, and even scale inclines that would be impossible for a horse.

Her eldest daughter, Hemrila, was an incredibly savvy entrepreneur, and had amassed a significant fortune for her husband and 3 children, and had even assisted her siblings when needed. She could certainly manage the varying financial needs of the clan, Vesta figured, but it was unclear if she could handle the emotional tolls of leadership.

c.derzis-canon.name: Derzis' Canon
c.derzis-canon.description:
"For it was He who brought forth the storms, not as an expression of His anger, but from His disappointment in that which plagued the land. Know that the skies remain His uncontested domain whensoever He chooses."
-Excerpts from Derzis' Canon

a.hobgoblin-captive.name: Hobgoblin Captive
a.hobgoblin-captive.description: One of the unfortunate fae that was being studied by Yamal Marduk, despite now being free this poor soul doesn't seem to have the will to properly flee.

e.fleshy-tendril-rod.name: Fleshy Tendril Rod
e.fleshy-tendril-rod.description: This rod is thick in your grip, clearly requiring two hands to properly handle. You can almost feel power pulsating through it, but it must be a trick of the mind, as it is clearly just plant-like tendrils.

cp.void-crystals-two-hundred.name: Void Crystals x1800
cp.void-crystals-two-hundred.description: An enormous pack containing the premium currency of the realms.

u.orange-third-eye-tonic.name: Orange Third Eye Tonic

Whether the Gods would agree with such a self-serving explanation or not remains to be seen, but you do enjoy the prospect of noticing those minute details of the world around you.

c.green-glowstone.name: Green Glowstone

ba.illustrious-warmage-banner.name: Illustrious Warmage Banner

u.potion-of-tenacity.description: II. Shou Royce didn't exactly have any issues with learning new things - he was rather gifted in that area - but when it came to the amount of knowledge required to start from the basics, there was no shortcut to the crazy amount of reading and studying required, and that required far more effort than Shou was willing to invest.
u.potion-of-tenacity.effects: +1,500 Defence vs Guild Raids for 6 hours

c.devils-mark.name: Devil's Mark
c.devils-mark.description: Proof of your victory in driving the Cruel General back to the hells.

Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.honorbounds-veil.description:
"The veil worn by the Honorbound is an essential part of their punishment, as until their tasks in service to the people are completed they are seen as 'forarauck'. These dead, or non-existing individuals keep their faces hidden from the world, until such time as they are ready to rejoin it, cleansed of their wrongdoings."
-Norsic Bittermail

k.mobilize-riot.name: Mobilize Riot

c.red-poisonous-tendril.name: Red Poisonous Tendril
c.red-poisonous-tendril.description: The upper tendrils of Fen Lure plants are thorny, and possess a potent, paralyzing toxin.

c.violet-cannoneers-treasure-map.description: A map indicating buried treasure at a specific location. Maybe it's time for a detour in your adventuring path?

c.robust-brew-of-divinity.description: I believe in the Kingdom of the afterlife, and that all colours meld into one, but that doesn't stop me from my path. You have shattered bonds and freed my restraints, then carried the cross bearing my shame.

"Why would this orb have this thin, slitted section to it?"

Alanis rolls her eyes, and then they widen as she turns to look at you.

"How about you watch where you're pointing that slit before you ask any more foolish questions?"

Noiselessly,

c.blue-mihrish-poster.description: You had heard of posters to depict images of wanted criminals, but were unaware that businesses may be so overworked that they would publicly canvas for hirees.

e.mirgoda-fur-spear.description: Crafted using the fur and bones of the felled beast, you have never before found such a lightweight, yet durable shaft to help stab at your foes.

c.risaldars-fang.name: Risaldar's Fang
c.risaldars-fang.description: The fang of the Officer is almost six-inches in length, and inordinately durable, with venom residue still dripping from its point.

e.wapiti-hooves.name: Wapiti Hooves

c.rotting-meat.description: You actually gagged when Alanis picked up this chunk of decaying flesh, as you were expecting to leave it behind for the carrion-eaters. When she brought it close to sniff, you could only turn away and retch.

e.barbed-rete.name: Barbed Rete
e.barbed-rete.effects: Heartless Hooks: 40% chance to proc 200 Dark damage vs Aquatic raids
e.barbed-rete.description:
"The barbs on this rete are far less forgiving than mere weights, but it takes considerably more skill to wield such a tool. It is far more punishing for a target to try to evade or remove than weights, as well!"
-Rokovok Harpooner

e.rusted-valto-aspis.name: Rusted Valto Aspis

e.rusted-valto-aspis.description: Apart from river fish and abundant wines, you were unaware of what Valto offered. It seems they have some creative - if not particularly well kept - legionnaire equipment, as well.

c.red-naitour-helm.name: Red Naitour Helm
c.red-naitour-helm.description: A helm worn by the fallen defenders of Fort Naitour.

u.yellow-green-heroic-dusk-chest.name: Yellow-Green Heroic Dusk Chest
u.yellow-green-heroic-dusk-chest.description: It is time for dusk to fall upon your foes.

e.hatuumin-rod.description:
XI(b). Sennie's despair began to overwhelm him once more, and his vision blurred as his mind raced regarding the possible tortuous fates his family had been subjected to... All in the name of his own ambitions and thirst for power. Sennie was aghast in his actions, and his past motivations, and fell to his knees, weeping. There was nothing he could do to make this right, and despite having come so far, he would never receive absolution...

There was NOTHING he could do to make this right, and yet, just maybe, he could avoid repeating this same mistake, in the future. That glimmer of hope shone through his vision like a blinding light, and as his tears dried, he looked up, seeing his wife holding their young daughter, smiling with understanding, seeming to send her love through that one, short look. In another moment, she was gone.

Wicked's Winter (Frostrod): 17% chance to proc 400 Ice damage; +200 damage per Repentant Dusk set item worn; 12% chance to proc 1,500 Ice damage; +500 damage per Repentant Dusk set item worn; +1.5% Crit Rate; +35% Crit Damage
Sanctified
Set Bonus (Repentant Dusk Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +2.5% Crit Rate and +30% Crit Damage
 6+: 2.4% chance to heal the Player 2.5 HP
 7+: +1.5% Crit Rate and +5 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Ice'
 8+: 10% chance to proc 100 Ice damage and change your base damage type to Ice
 9+: +25% Formation Bonus and +0.5 Formation Protection Value
e.repentant-dusk-frostrod.description: Designed to focus the frost for a more potent strike, Qina seems quite proud of her personalized creation, and her allowing you to use it is a mark of great trust.

u.fishers-celebratory-satchel.name: Fisher's Celebratory Satchel
u.fishers-celebratory-satchel.description: You'll never turn down a firm slap on the back for a job well done, but an extra bit of gratitude can sure go a long ways.
u.fishers-celebratory-satchel.effects: Open to obtain its contents (three of the chance drops)

k.mounts-potential-tackle.name: Mount's Potential: Tackle
k.mounts-potential-tackle.effects: While riding a Terrestrial Mount, you tackle the foe, dealing damage akin to a 35x hit, plus a bonus xx% Offence. For your next 3 attacks, your Defence is increased by +xx%.

e.hooded-veil-gloves.name: Hooded Veil Gloves
e.hooded-veil-gloves.effects: Fangs Alot (Gloves): 12% chance to proc 200 Poison damage; +25 damage per Hooded Veil set item worn; +4 Offence
e.hooded-veil-gloves.description:
V. "Ssome have gone sso far sso to compare the Priesstesss to Thotssaken, though it would be blassphemy to compare the two in the ssame ssentence. Both may have challenged the insstruction of Ssarfraxss, but the Priesstesss wass only interessted in improving the livess of her bretheren Naga."
-Seksehsa

c.blue-tattered-pelt.name: Blue Tattered Pelt
c.blue-tattered-pelt.description: It was quite challenging to obtain this piece of pelt, as every time its stinger blasted you lost another chunk of fur. Well, better to lose the fur than a finger, you figure.

u.orange-vintners-satchel.name: Orange Vintner's Satchel
u.orange-vintners-satchel.description: A satchel clearly cared for by a busy vintner, containing a mystery potion.
u.orange-vintners-satchel.effects: Open to obtain its contents (two of the chance drops)

e.vozotlnaos-blessing-crepida.name: Vozotlnaos Blessing Crepida
e.vozotlnaos-blessing-crepida.effects:
Firetouched and Blessed by Fire (Crepida): 16% chance to proc 250 Fire damage; +250 damage per Vozotlnaos Blessing set item worn; +12 HP; +5% Crit Damage; +1 Tiers of 'Fire Resistance'
Consecrated
Set Bonus (Vozotlnaos Blessing Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +15% Formation Bonus and +1% Crit Rate
 8+: +2 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Fire'
 9+: 1% chance to heal the Player 2 HP
e.vozotlnaos-blessing-crepida.description: As comfortable as these strange shoes are, you wonder why when these fanatics seem to spend more time on their knees than their feet.

c.enchanted-dropper.name: Enchanted Dropper
c.enchanted-dropper.description: You’ve seen similar tools used in kitchens, though you suspect this may be a little more capable than what is used to keep a bird moist.

e.chandlers-pantera.name: Chandler's Pantera
e.chandlers-pantera.effects:
Purified Paraffin (Pantera): 10% chance to proc 200 Holy damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 15%; +50 damage per Chandler's set item worn; +40% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Chandler's Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: 2% chance to proc 2000 Dark damage and heal the Player 10 HP
e.chandlers-pantera.description:
"Of course we'd need a mount capable of creeping into even the darkest crevices; how else could we bring Laetrie's light to every corner of the land?"
-Raurous Fourfury

a.ginny-seamint.name: Ginny Seamint
a.ginny-seamint.description: A strange sight to behold, even in a city as diverse as Mihr, this Pixie is exceedingly large for her race, but has still managed to keep her presence largely a secret, owing to her love of heights and her perchance for concealing her wings. She has opted to share her identity with you, however, and trusts you will be able to make use of her talents in the battles to come.
a.ginny-seamint.effects: Peak Pixie: 30% chance to proc 400 Magic damage

a.dwarven-frigidara-defender.name: Dwarven Frigidara Defender
a.dwarven-frigidara-defender.description:
