"The Blizzarding Horde once took decades to resurrect. Now, Frigidara's power grows, as do her minions."
-Aegyr Snowbound
a.dwarven-frigidara-defender.effects: Adds +0.3 Defence to Aegyr Snowbound, Bellas Inahice and Burz in the active Formation

s.scroll-niever-the-slayer.name: Niever the Slayer Scroll
s.scroll-niever-the-slayer.description: This terrifying drake has earned his title through the slaughter of countless innocents. It's time to put an end to his destructive ways.

e.zaratans-helm.name: Zaratan's Helm
e.zaratans-helm.effects:
Debris Volley (Helm): 15% chance to proc 800 Nature damage; +40 damage per Zaratan set item worn; +40 Health
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.zaratans-helm.description:
"The most common manner to be injured by a Zaratan is to suffer crush injuries from the debris it scatters as its enormous frame moves. I imagine this is usually unintended by the creature.... Usually, anyway."
-Janagud

e.frostwarden-boots.name: Frostwarden Boots
e.frostwarden-boots.effects:
Arctic Aegis (Boots): 10% chance to proc 560 Ice damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 14%; +80 Ice damage per Frostwarden set item worn
Set Bonus (Frostwarden Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: 20% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 25%
e.frostwarden-boots.description: While the Frostwardens may boast effective footwear for climates buried under ice and snow, and you cannot deny that they are reasonably snug on your feet, the lack of support makes you question how far you'd be able to range in them, in mild-weathered regions.

e.pentwater-mace.name: Pentwater Mace
e.pentwater-mace.effects:
Blessed Boulder-Be (Mace): 1% chance to proc 1000 Holy damage; +200 damage per Pentwater set item worn
Consecrated
e.pentwater-mace.description: I. Dwarven legend, passed down by word of mouth, tells of a terrible uprising that threatened to wipe the dwarves from existence. Countless hordes of demons, sent by Malbog, raged a violent war for the underbelly of the land as the Demon Lord sought to gain a foothold on this plane. One heroic dwarf is credited with ultimately staving off these forces and driving them back.

e.cumberworld-poppers.name: Cumberworld Poppers
e.cumberworld-poppers.effects:
+20 Vitality; +20 Energy
Set Bonus (Cumberworld Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1 Tiers of 'Discerning Vision' and 'Astute Observation'
 9+: +1 Tiers of 'Discerning Vision' and 'Astute Observation'
e.cumberworld-poppers.description:
"It's fun and games for all who came, and woe for the foe who decided to show!"
-Bonaguido

a.herbalist-taste-tester.name: Herbalist Taste-Tester
a.herbalist-taste-tester.description: Somewhat secretive, given both their profession and their origins, these herbalists are unusual even amongst their kin for honing their skills based upon the taste of the various flora, rather than simply sight or touch. You cannot help but wonder how they avoid the ill-effects associated with those plants, and you feel itchy just thinking about it.

e.saber-of-bloody-freedom.name: Saber of Bloody Freedom
e.saber-of-bloody-freedom.effects: One Man's Saviour: 8% chance to proc 900 Dark damage; +250 damage if Jida of Sovereign Hope is worn; +100 damage per Conqueror's set item worn
e.saber-of-bloody-freedom.description:
"My great grandfather often said, when he saw any of his kin hesitating, 'If you feel fear, refrain from action, but once taking action you have nothing to fear.'"
-Borjigin Kuyuk

e.blazebrand-cane.name: Blazebrand Cane
e.blazebrand-cane.effects:
Justice by any Flames Necessary (Cane): 30% chance to proc 300 Fire damage; +100 damage per Blazebrand set item worn; 4% chance to proc 2,000 Fire damage and reduce damage to your Armies by 40%; +750 damage per Blazebrand set item worn; +15% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Blazebrand Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 8+: +2.5% Crit Rate
 9+: 40% chance to proc 250 Fire damage, +8 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Fire' and +1 Tiers of 'Insurmountable Offence'
e.blazebrand-cane.description: You wonder if this tool is appropriately named, as the sigil at the end burns red-hot when you pick it up, bringing with it memories of the brands used to mark livestock in the pastures near your homestead.

e.yaomori-whip.name: Yaomori Whip
e.yaomori-whip.effects:
Working Chorafia (Whip): 8% chance to proc 170 Physical damage; +90 damage per Yaomori set item worn; 1% chance to proc 3,600 Physical damage; +12% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Yaomori Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +2 Raid Cap
 7+: +2 Raid Cap, +75 HP and +25 Vitality
e.yaomori-whip.description:
"If you want to try convincing the oxen to stop feeding and start pulling without a whip, you let me know how it goes."
-Tansy Croftfield

c.medzeh-trophy.name: Medzeh Trophy
c.medzeh-trophy.description: A strange trophy for a strange group, you just wish Alanis wasn't eyeing it up while looking for her tools...

a.murrlix.name: Murrlix
a.murrlix.description: Lured into the hidden valley by the magics emanating from it, Murrlix knows his kin has been taken, and has been unable to figure out what he ought to do.
a.murrlix.effects: Amazed but Adrift: 8% chance to proc 20,000 Magic damage; Adds +4 Attack to each Fae troop in the Formation

c.sollemnia-verus-boost-ii.name: Sollemnia Verus Boost II
c.sollemnia-verus-boost-ii.description: The delicacies seem to only improve, year after year, in spite of these repeated disruptions to the fishing festivities. Passively boosts Sollemnia Verus' Attack by +5 and Defence by +0.5 (Max 2).

c.frostflame-token.name: Frostflame Token
c.frostflame-token.description: A token revealing the duality of fire and ice, and unlocking the magical potential of interweaving the two opposing forces.

e.navenian-pavise.name: Navenian Pavise
e.navenian-pavise.description: No-one seems able to provide a clear explanation for why this Pavise was found in such a small village as Naven, but despite how run-down its heavy frame looks it seems capable of withstanding significant force.

c.recruits-rations.name: Recruit's Rations
c.recruits-rations.description:
"A simple meal with all the essentials a recruit needs to build a strong body!"

Hamond may be right about the essentials being in the food, but it'll only help if the recruits can keep it down!

c.blue-naaviks-scales.name: Blue Naavik's Scales
c.blue-naaviks-scales.description: Apparently sea creatures are less prone to shedding their scales than land-based beings: These colourful scales must be exceptionally rare, though you can only hope that rarity translates to value.

c.red-vedfollen-feather.name: Red Vedfollen Feather
c.red-vedfollen-feather.description: This strange feather is unfamiliar to you, but Mauritio practically falls over himself to see it as you tentatively hold it. Apparently, it comes from a mythical bird, long thought to have been merely a creature of legend, and known for its immense size. Some say that it was so large that its ability to fly was plainly impossible. You suspect that someone could find a use for such a feather.

c.pillarous-stone.name: Pillarous Stone
c.pillarous-stone.description: When typical metal bars cannot be used, lest you want to injure the mystical creature, you need to find a viable alternative to keep it safe and secure.

e.sinderklaz-rendier.name: Sinderklaz Rendier
e.sinderklaz-rendier.effects:
Sinderklaz Vrolik (Rendier): 30% chance to proc 40 Physical damage and and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 20%; +120 Physical damage per Sinderklaz set item worn
Set Bonus (Sinderklaz Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +200 HP, +30% Magic Resistance and +25% Ice Resistance
e.sinderklaz-rendier.description: As bushy and brawny as this creature is, you would never have expected it to take off with such a start. Your shock was redoubled once its gallop started heading in a vertical direction.

c.violet-oseberg-trekkers.name: Violet Oseberg Trekkers
c.violet-oseberg-trekkers.description: If you are to have any hope of surviving this long journey, you need comfortable footwear that can weather any environment. A magical enchantment or two couldn't hurt, either.

e.blessed-gastonia-pants.name: Blessed Gastonia Pants
e.blessed-gastonia-pants.effects:
Sacred Scutum (Pants): 20% chance to proc 1200 Physical damage; +12500 damage vs Guild Raids; +350 damage per Blessed Gastonia set item worn; 25% chance to proc 400 Holy damage; +150 damage per Blessed Gastonia set item worn
Set Bonus (Blessed Gastonia Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +100 Honor, +75 Energy and +75 Vitality

c.golem-boulders.name: Golem Boulders
c.golem-boulders.description: The body of the fallen golem is still alive with mystical energies... Best put the boulders to good use!

e.spiderskin-feet.name: Spiderskin Feet
e.spiderskin-feet.effects:
Poisonous Palpae (Feet): 6% chance to proc 40 Poison damage
Set Bonus (Spiderskin Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +5% Poison Resistance
e.spiderskin-feet.description: Does wearing footwear that came from an eight-legged creature count as you having.... ten feet?

a.veteran-goblin-frigidara-defender.name: Veteran Goblin Frigidara Defender
a.veteran-goblin-frigidara-defender.description:
"I said it get colder. It got colder. Where is your warm dress?"
-Burz
a.veteran-goblin-frigidara-defender.effects: Adds +6 Attack to Aegyr Snowbound, Bellas Inahice and Burz in the active Formation

e.baron-aureus-tenvilu.name: Baron Aureus' Tenvilu
e.baron-aureus-tenvilu.effects:
Golden Noble (Tenvilu): 45% chance to proc 200 Nature damage and adding +15% Ice Resistance and +5% Nature Resistance and +5% Poison Resistance and -10% Dark Resistance and -10% Fire Resistance and -10% Lightning Resistance on this proc; +175 damage per Baron Aureus' set item worn
Set Bonus (Baron Aureus' Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +175 HP and +25% Crit Damage
 6+: +1.5% Crit Rate
 7+: +5% All Resistances
 8+: +1 Tiers of 'Keen Eyes'
 9+: +20% Ice Resistance, +5% Poison Resistance, +5% Nature Resistance, -10% Dark Resistance, -35% Fire Resistance and -35% Lightning Resistance
e.baron-aureus-tenvilu.description: An exceptionally rare beast, and one clearly meant for a more tropical region than here, this Tenvilu seems perfectly capable of keeping back the cold without your assistance.

c.swiftburn-globe.name: Swiftburn Globe
c.swiftburn-globe.description: A strange globe that seems to generate its own source of heat when touched. Unfortunately it does not seem to radiate heat, which would make it incredibly useful as a portable tool while in these frigid, northern lands, but perhaps its essence can help empower other things which do rely upon physically contact.

u.script-of-greater-restoration.name: Script of Greater Restoration
u.script-of-greater-restoration.description: "Bless the unworthy with your love! Greater Restoration!"
u.script-of-greater-restoration.effects: Recovers 6 Fainted units from all active Troops

e.praetoran-boots.name: Praetoran Boots
e.praetoran-boots.effects:
Praetoran Modesty (Boots): 16% chance to proc 650 Nature damage; +50 damage per Praetoran set item worn
Set Bonus (Praetoran Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +40% Crit Damage and +1 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Fire'
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.praetoran-boots.description: There's little to be done about footwear getting soggy while on a boat, but at least these don't chafe while you move around in them.

c.surgical-aether.name: Surgical Aether
c.surgical-aether.description: Long gone are the days of wasting good liquor on someone in the midst of bleeding it all out. Now there are tools to properly anaesthetize the injured, before delving deep into their innards!

c.sacrosanct-scarf.name: Sacrosanct Scarf
c.sacrosanct-scarf.description: A scarf of unparalleled quality, and you know just who might want to wear it.

e.rara-shell-collection-hands.name: Rara Shell Collection Hands
e.rara-shell-collection-hands.effects:
Fabulous, Darling! (Hands): 16% chance to proc 180 Nature damage; +260 damage per Rara Shell Collection set item worn; +500 damage vs Aquatic raids; +0.25% Evasion
Set Bonus (Rara Shell Collection Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1% Evasion and +300 Magic
 6+: +5 Tiers of 'Nimble Defensive Training'
 7+: +4 Tiers of 'Evasive Maneuvers' and +1 Tier of 'Advanced Evasive Maneuvers'
 8+: +1% Evasion and 24% chance to proc 2,000 Nature damage vs Aquatic raids
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.rara-shell-collection-hands.description:
"No touching, darling. You cannot handle this genius."
-Luminarara

u.green-brewmasters-bulwark-brew.name: Green Brewmaster's Bulwark Brew
u.green-brewmasters-bulwark-brew.description:
"I believe I have condensed the essence of what drove heroes like Bevis into this concoction."
-Nphireo

k.youths-vitality.name: Youth's Vitality
k.youths-vitality.effects: Restores your current Vitality, up to your Vitality Cap. Recover xx Vitality.

e.blessed-gastonia-spikes.name: Blessed Gastonia Spikes
e.blessed-gastonia-spikes.effects:
Sacred Scutum (Spikes): 20% chance to proc 1200 Physical damage; +12500 damage vs Guild Raids; +350 damage per Blessed Gastonia set item worn; 25% chance to proc 400 Holy damage; +150 damage per Blessed Gastonia set item worn
Set Bonus (Blessed Gastonia Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +100 Honor, +75 Energy and +75 Vitality

e.viscous-viscount-psychal-buzzard.name: Viscous Viscount Psychal Buzzard
e.viscous-viscount-psychal-buzzard.effects:
Eccentric Ennoblement (Psychal Buzzard): 12% chance to proc 1,400 Psychic damage; +450 damage per Viscous Viscount set item worn; +8% Magic Resistance; +2.5% Evasion
Set Bonus (Viscous Viscount Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1.5% Crit Rate
 6+: +10% Crit Damage
 8+: +150 HP
 9+: +20% Magic Resistance, 33% chance to proc 800 Psychic damage with +30% Magic Resistance on that hit
e.viscous-viscount-psychal-buzzard.description: The stare from this great bird is particularly unnerving, and you find yourself unable to break away from its gaze. Only when it bellows an unearthly, menacing squawk do you find yourself blinking and wondering what just happened.

u.yellow-guild-kit-iv.name: Yellow Guild Kit IV
u.yellow-guild-kit-iv.description: A small, tidy sack, purporting to carry goods from the same source Slygse gets her alchemical wares.
u.yellow-guild-kit-iv.effects: Open to obtain its contents (two of the chance drops)

u.yellow-guild-kit-ii.name: Yellow Guild Kit II
u.yellow-guild-kit-ii.description: A small, tidy sack, purporting to carry goods from the same source Slygse gets her alchemical wares.
u.yellow-guild-kit-ii.effects: Open to obtain its contents (two of the chance drops)

a.honourable-gohlehm.name: Honourable Gohlehm
a.honourable-gohlehm.description: After spending some time with both, you have started wondering which is the quieter ally: Peleg, or the rocky constructs that follow him. Your next thoughts tread towards whom would win in a staring contest...
a.honourable-gohlehm.effects: Adds +1 Attack and +0.2 Defence to each Vitalic Goblin and Energizing Merman in the active Formation

p.stat-constitution.name: Constitution Stat Point
p.stat-constitution.description: Stat Point for the Constitution Stat

c.bottled-dragonfire.name: Bottled Dragonfire
c.bottled-dragonfire.description: The contents of this bottle are mesmerizing, and images seem to dance before your vision as you gaze into the flames...

e.yaomori-pants.name: Yaomori Pants
e.yaomori-pants.effects:
Working Chorafia (Pants): 15% chance to proc 60 Physical damage; +30 damage per Yaomori set item worn; +2 Vitality
Set Bonus (Yaomori Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +2 Raid Cap
 7+: +2 Raid Cap, +75 HP and +25 Vitality
e.yaomori-pants.description:
"No-one who has put in a solid day's work in the field would think that comfortable pants are more important than protective pants."
-Tansy Croftfield

c.violet-assorted-bone-fragments.name: Violet Assorted Bone Fragments
c.violet-assorted-bone-fragments.description: Whether these originate from victims of the giant serpent, or some unfortunate soul that fell into the gorge, an experienced researcher could certainly make use of these.

e.chaunaths-warpriests-steed.name: Chaunath's Warpriests Steed
e.chaunaths-warpriests-steed.effects:
Shield of Deities (Steed): 5% chance to proc 5,000 Magic damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 15%; +1,750 damage per Chaunath's Warpriests set item worn; +30 Vitality; +30 Honor
Set Bonus (Chaunath's Warpriests Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: 5% chance on 20x attacks to heal each active Troop +1 Reserve 
 6+: +2% Crit Rate and +15% Crit Damage
 7+: 4% chance on 20x attacks to heal each active Commander +2 HP
 8+: +15% Formation Bonus and 10% chance to reduce incoming damage to your armies by 30%
 9+: 4% chance on 20x attacks to heal each active Troop +3 Reserves and proc 8% of your Leadership stat in Holy damage
e.chaunaths-warpriests-steed.description: A marvelously raised specimen, this stallion pushes into your hand as you move to pet its fine fur. No doubt this aggressive and fearless nature will lead to it being front-and-center during battle.

e.rusted-leoegan-boots.name: Rusted Leoegan Boots
e.rusted-leoegan-boots.effects:
Rusty Jawlocking (Boots): 5% chance to proc 400 Physical damage
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.rusted-leoegan-boots.description: V. Paython knew that he had to find some way of confirming his heritage, such that it could be displayed to the world to showcase his greatness. His resolve stoked, he set off for the great Temple of Vozotl in what-would-eventually be Gipanta.

cp.ranger-starter-pack-i.name: Ranger Starter Pack I
cp.ranger-starter-pack-i.description: A pack providing the necessary goods for every budding ranger.

c.kyllis-best-vintage.name: Kylli's Best Vintage
c.kyllis-best-vintage.description: You once asked about the vintage hidden behind the casks, and were given a dirty look. Turns out it is the finest brew Kylli keeps on hand.

u.lesser-healing-potion.name: Lesser Healing Potion
u.lesser-healing-potion.description:
"Just a little swig of this, and you'll start feeling better in no time!"
-Nphireo the Alchemist

c.green-naaviks-scales.name: Green Naavik's Scales
c.green-naaviks-scales.description: Apparently sea creatures are less prone to shedding their scales than land-based beings: These colourful scales must be exceptionally rare, though you can only hope that rarity translates to value.

e.nyxifur-darts.name: Nyxifur Darts
e.nyxifur-darts.effects:
Slowly Unsteady (Darts): 6% chance to proc 600 Nature damage; +425 damage per Nyxifur set item worn; +1% Crit Rate; +20% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Nyxifur Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +30% Crit Damage
 7+: +2% Crit Rate
 9+: +140 HP
e.nyxifur-darts.description: You have to work to ignore the disturbing glimmer in Corros' eye as he sees you inspecting some of these darts.

e.mashed-shroom-boots.name: Mashed Shroom Boots
e.mashed-shroom-boots.effects:
Creamy Mash: 20% chance to proc 300 Physical damage vs Amanus Charmer
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.mashed-shroom-boots.description: There is something indescribably satisfying about stomping around on top of squishy mushrooms, creating a fleshy, squishing sound under your feet.

c.blue-cannoneers-treasure-map.name: Blue Cannoneer's Treasure Map
c.blue-cannoneers-treasure-map.description: A map indicating buried treasure at a specific location. Maybe it's time for a detour in your adventuring path?

dy.orange-dye-vial.name: Orange Dye Vial
dy.orange-dye-vial.description: A vial of colourful dye that can magically improve the appeal of your equipment!

k.energy-transfer.name: Energy Transfer
k.energy-transfer.effects: Restores your current Energy, up to your Energy Cap. Recover xx Energy.

e.stormshapers-boots.name: Stormshapers' Boots
e.stormshapers-boots.effects:
Stormfury (Boots): 12% chance to proc 450 Lightning damage; +100 damage per Stormshapers' set item worn; 4% chance to proc 1,400 Lightning damage; +200 damage per Stormshapers' set item worn; +3% Lightning Resistance
Set Bonus (Stormshapers' Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: 50% chance to proc 120 Lightning damage, +5 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Lightning' and +20% Lightning Resistance
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.stormshapers-boots.description:
"I imagine you're going to say that these boots are necessary to 'ride the storm'?"

"Whatever would make you think that? We control the lightning, not dance across it like a flighty pixie creature."
-Conversations with Thundreag Stormchest

e.natures-revolt-barrier.name: Nature's Revolt Barrier
e.natures-revolt-barrier.effects:
Scenic Uprising (Barrier): 6% chance to proc 2,600 Nature damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 15%; +6,500 damage vs Legendary raids; +1,675 damage per Nature's Revolt set item worn; +1.5% Evasion; +3% All Resistances
Set Bonus (Nature's Revolt Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +25% Crit Damage and +2% Crit Rate
 6+: 30% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 10%; +30% vs Easy Raids, and +1% Evasion; +3% Evasion vs Easy Raids
 7+: +5% All Resistances and +150 HP
 8+: 25% chance to reduce incoming damage to your Armies by 20%; +30% vs Legendary Raids, and +1% Crit Rate; +2% Crit Rate vs Legendary Raids
 9+: 3% chance to heal the Player 2 HP; +4 HP healed vs Hard Raids, and +15% Crit Damage; +25% Crit Damage vs Hard Raids
e.natures-revolt-barrier.description:
"You see, even enraged the land is willing to protect you. Will you do the same for it?"
-Brocck of the Revolt

a.glorimmeal-minegut.name: Glorimmeal Minegut
a.glorimmeal-minegut.description: Shockingly thin for a Dwarf, you almost mistook Glorimmeal for a Gnome when you first met him, though he quickly disabused that notion as soon as he began to speak. Particularly spry of step, he is often the first to reach the wounded on the battlefield, and his medical skills seem equally quick in aiding the recovery of his patients.
a.glorimmeal-minegut.effects: Emaciated Elixirist: 0.5% chance to heal the Player 2 HP

a.naga-pipestriker.name: Naga Pipestriker
a.naga-pipestriker.description: Between most naga not having flexible cheeks, and their larger teeth, you had not considered that any would be capable of using blowdarts. You are curious as to whether any of their natural venom leaks onto their darts.
a.naga-pipestriker.effects: Adds +1 Attack to all Ranged Commanders

e.blazen-swiftslicer-gloves.name: Blazen Swiftslicer Gloves
e.blazen-swiftslicer-gloves.effects:
Glorious Flaming Blades (Gloves): 24% chance to proc 900 Fire damage vs Winter raids; +200 Fire damage per Blazen Swiftslicer set item worn; +1.2% Evasion
Set Bonus (Blazen Swiftslicer Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +0.25% Evasion
 9+: +1.75% Evasion
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.blazen-swiftslicer-gloves.description: It had been some time since you had worn gloves like these, you had almost forgotten how much you had to avoid touching parts of your body while adorned with sharp blades.

e.rolling-snowball.name: Rolling Snowball
e.rolling-snowball.effects: Av' A Lanch: 24% chance to proc 585 Ice damage; 2% chance to proc 12,000 Ice damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 50%
e.rolling-snowball.description: A curious choice of a mount, though if used while in the mountain the lost snow is easily recovered on the next rotation. It does take a bit of work to stay on one side of it, though.

c.marduks-contemplation.name: Marduk's Contemplation
c.marduks-contemplation.description: "Towards the end of his life, Nebekinessur recognized that his important research was not yet complete. He found himself a young man, keen to learn and untainted with the biases so commonly seen in learned scholars and mages, and took him under his wing. In teaching Yamal Marduk, Nebekinessur saw his findings through fresh eyes, giving him greater clarity to help refine what he had learned, in preparation for the inevitable passing on."

e.viscous-viscount-shoes.name: Viscous Viscount Shoes
e.viscous-viscount-shoes.effects:
Eccentric Ennoblement (Shoes): 8% chance to proc 1,000 Acid damage; +500 damage per Viscous Viscount set item worn; 3% chance to proc 4,000 Acid damage; +125 damage per Viscous Viscount set item worn; +0.5% Evasion; +2% All Resistances
Set Bonus (Viscous Viscount Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1.5% Crit Rate
 6+: +10% Crit Damage
 8+: +150 HP
 9+: Additional Bonuses depending on Mount equipped
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.viscous-viscount-shoes.description:
"What, don't this fit properly? Why are you bothering me with such things. Adjudhas, get them to the cobbler so their complaints can be addressed, and they can be out of my laboratory."
-Aelric Thorne

a.leiptralf.name: Leiptralf
a.leiptralf.description: Hailing from the frigid north, these cerulean-skinned elves are particularly adept at surviving tundra temperatures, and seem to be equally cold-hearted when it comes to dispatching threats to their homes.

e.copper-legplates.name: Copper Legplates
e.copper-legplates.effects:
Rustproof Reflection (Legplates): 6% chance to proc 250 Nature damage; +50 Nature damage per Copper set item worn; +5% Acid Resistance
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.copper-legplates.description: As much as you'd expect metal plating rubbing together to be exceedingly noisy, these copper plates seem surprisingly quiet, all things considered. Sadly, that does nothing to help with it pinching when you try to move quickly...

u.parchment-of-distracting-charm.name: Parchment of Distracting Charm
u.parchment-of-distracting-charm.description: A tattered scroll, with strange, mystic inscriptions!

a.alice-the-redeemed.name: Alice the Redeemed
a.alice-the-redeemed.description: This eyepatched statue looks particularly fearsome, though she seems unwilling to discuss either what redemption she undertook or why she sought redemption. In either case, you're happy to have her along, though the prospect of shaking her hand, bladed-as-it-is, would leave you with bloody fingers.
a.alice-the-redeemed.effects: Bloody Fingers: 20% chance to proc 100 Magic damage

c.yelte-bowlimbs.name: Yelte Bowlimbs
c.yelte-bowlimbs.description: A strange set of bow limbs, apparently missing its string and possessing an unusual gem slot. It radiates an unusual, divine energy....

e.colossal-crusherclaw-boots.name: Colossal Crusherclaw Boots
e.colossal-crusherclaw-boots.effects:
Colossal Pressure Crush (Boots): 5% chance to proc 3000 Physical damage; +50000 damage vs Guild Raids; +1100 damage per Colossal Crusherclaw set item worn; 25% chance to proc 400 Nature damage; +400 damage per Colossal Crusherclaw set item worn
Set Bonus (Colossal Crusherclaw Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +1 Formation Protection Value
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion

e.dumvan-furs-fur-boots.name: Dumvan Furs Fur Boots
e.dumvan-furs-fur-boots.effects:
Brisk Buffer (Fur Boots): 17% chance to proc 60 Physical damage; +100 damage per Dumvan Furs set item worn; +340 damage vs Beast raids; +3% Ice Resistance; +10 HP
Set Bonus (Dumvan Furs Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +10% Ice Resistance
 7+: +80 HP
e.dumvan-furs-fur-boots.description:
"Sturdy enough to keep your feet safe, and rough enough to not slip off a pitched roof."
-Shem

e.psionic-shield-pants.name: Psionic Shield Pants
e.psionic-shield-pants.effects:
Psyshroom Shield (Pants): 13% chance to proc 150 Psychic damage; +150 damage per Psionic Shield set item worn
Set Bonus (Psionic Shield Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: 20% chance to proc 500 Psychic damage, protects you and your armies from the backlash of Volatile or Volatile Spores, and prevents the evasion loss from Volatile Spores
e.psionic-shield-pants.description: These are fancier than you would have expected, though letting mites this close to your fleshy bits still unsettles you.

e.onishaygu-seedling-helm.name: Onishaygu Seedling Helm
e.onishaygu-seedling-helm.effects:
Young Sprout (Helm): 12% chance to proc 100 Nature damage; +50 Nature damage per Onishaygu Seedling set item worn; +30 Energy; +10 HP
Set Bonus (Onishaygu Seedling Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 8+: +30 Vitality and +30 Honour
 9+: +50 Energy
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.onishaygu-seedling-helm.description:
"Every new growth starts as a seedling. It is our job to recognize the boundless potential of what may come."
-Alagbato

k.shield-bash.name: Shield Bash
k.shield-bash.effects: While equipping a Shield, you slam it into the foe, preventing them from retaliating against you and your armies on this attack, and your next. Deals xx% of your Offence as bonus damage.

a.thundrak.name: Thundrak
a.thundrak.description: You are unsure what kind of magics it would take to make this spiraling twister of stones as a singular entity, but by the way Alanis marvels at it, you suspect it is beyond your capabilities.
a.thundrak.effects: Pealing Pelt: 8% chance to proc 6,250 Nature damage; Adds +3 Attack and +0.5 Defence to each Gnomish Stormchaser in the Formation

ba.daring-master-ranger-banner.name: Daring Master Ranger Banner
ba.daring-master-ranger-banner.description: Obtained with the Daring Master Ranger Class

u.devils-energy-boost.name: Devil's Energy Boost
u.devils-energy-boost.description: This oddly coloured token emits a nauseating aura, along with a strange odour of evil... and wafer?

c.green-demon-bindings.name: Green Demon Bindings
c.green-demon-bindings.description: Once used to bind demonic armor to its owner, you've heard some notions that the local orcs may be able to make use of these.

e.waveblessed-gloves.name: Waveblessed Gloves
e.waveblessed-gloves.effects:
By the Waves (Gloves): 16% chance to proc 225 Nature damage; +175 damage per Waveblessed set item worn; 16% chance to proc 225 Holy damage; +175 damage per Waveblessed set item worn; +12 HP
Set Bonus (Waveblessed Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +400 Magic and 2% chance to heal the Player 0.6 HP
 7+: +30 HP and 4% chance to heal the Player 0.25 HP
 8+: +2% Crit Rate and +15% Crit Damage
 9+: +6% All Resistances and 5% chance to heal the Player 1.8 HP
e.waveblessed-gloves.description: As calloused as the hands of the Waveblessed shiphands' hands are, you'd have expected them to be doing everything entirely bare-handed. However, after grabbing onto one of the ropes when a gust of wind suddenly twisted a sail, you immediately understood the importance of proper protection.

c.troll-charms.name: Troll Charms
c.troll-charms.description: An assortment of rare charms kept by a Troll after its successful raids. Well, it was a formerly-successful Troll, now...

u.script-of-caustic-corrosion.name: Script of Caustic Corrosion
u.script-of-caustic-corrosion.description: "Melt the world away for its impurities! Caustic Corrosion!"

c.amytus-reflection.name: Amytus' Reflection
c.amytus-reflection.description: "When considering the natural forces of the world, it is easy to think of the wind, storms and waves. However, those forces seem intimately connected, and must be driven by something greater. The peoples of the sea would know this better than any other, and so Nebekinessur requested an audience with Nahla Amytus, in order to gauge her perspectives on his prospective work."

u.sinah-energy-spirit.name: Sinah Energy Spirit
u.sinah-energy-spirit.description: You cannot deny the style and class in the bottle's design, but you do wish it did a better job of keeping the green liquid stoppered inside.

e.swamp-nomad-band.name: Swamp Nomad Band
e.swamp-nomad-band.effects:
+1% Crit Rate; +1% Evasion
Set Bonus (Swamp Nomad Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +1 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Nature'
e.swamp-nomad-band.description: You can feel energies surrounding you as you don this ring, but they seem more attuned to your physical capabilities than any mystic arts.

e.viscous-viscount-knife.name: Viscous Viscount Knife
e.viscous-viscount-knife.effects:
Eccentric Ennoblement (Knife): 12% chance to proc 700 Acid damage; +350 damage per Viscous Viscount set item worn; 4% chance to proc 3,300 Acid damage; +400 damage per Viscous Viscount set item worn; +1% Crit Rate; +100 Magic
Set Bonus (Viscous Viscount Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1.5% Crit Rate
 6+: +10% Crit Damage
 8+: +150 HP
 9+: Additional Bonuses depending on Mount equipped
e.viscous-viscount-knife.description: Apparently this blade has seen more use in gathering reagents than in combat, but you can still admire its quality... and reactivity to acidic compounds...

u.greater-psychic-resilience-potion.name: Greater Psychic Resilience Potion
u.greater-psychic-resilience-potion.description: A frothy, mesmerizing potion that smells of the ideal seasoning of nutmeg.

e.phermitic-battlegarb-gauntlets.name: Phermitic Battlegarb Gauntlets
e.phermitic-battlegarb-gauntlets.effects:
The Wisdom in War (Gauntlets): 12% chance to proc 140 Physical damage; +80 damage per Phermitic Battlegarb set item worn; +0.25% Evasion
Sanctified
Set Bonus (Phermitic Battlegarb Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +15% Crit Damage
 8+: +2% Crit Rate and +2 Tiers of 'Prolonged Battle'
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.phermitic-battlegarb-gauntlets.description: VI. When Phermis was done, Her sheets were adorned with brilliant depictions of Her fellow Gods and Goddesses, with such depictions as Vozotl healing the sick with His flames, Chaunath staving off a many-headed beast with Her massive shield, Amera pulling the sun in Her chariot while Dhoesis greeted it at the new day and more. It was one of a kind, and nearly defied imagination.

c.sigil-of-irus-shroud.name: Sigil of Irus' Shroud
c.sigil-of-irus-shroud.description: While there are many depictions of Irus and His love, this unique sigil is used-and-recognized by those who spread His name in combat.

u.foaming-honor-potion.name: Foaming Honor Potion
u.foaming-honor-potion.description: After seeing the thick, foamy bubbles at the top of this potion you've half a mind to fashion a beard of them, in mockery of Rarsik. After quaffing some of the brew, however, you've decided against such a dishonourable act.

u.mystery-brewmasters-satchel.name: Mystery Brewmaster's Satchel
u.mystery-brewmasters-satchel.description: An incredibly well-stocked satchel, clearly belonging to a brewmaster, and possessing all the supplies you’d need to concoct something spectacular!

a.sinderklaz-arbeider.name: Sinderklaz Arbeider
a.sinderklaz-arbeider.description:
"Between their skills in construction and their ability to handle small parts, my workers are invaluable to my task!"
-Niek Mira
a.sinderklaz-arbeider.effects: Adds +0.5 Defence to Niek Mira in the active Formation; Restores 2 Reserves daily

a.nico-orbesco.name: Nico Orbesco
a.nico-orbesco.description: Nico has largely kept to himself, studying various forms of the occult and ancient magics he claims made the world what it is today. He has gathered a following in recent months, however, and with the reappearance of the void it is quite likely that these numbers will only grow.

e.pebble-ring.name: Pebble Ring
e.pebble-ring.effects: Stone's Memory: 4% chance to proc 160 Physical damage vs Underground raids; +5% Crit Damage
e.pebble-ring.description:
"It is unusual to find sacrosanct stones so far from Dwarven halls, but Orimneni has been known to be generous with her blessings."
-Dondomra Grimfeet

c.violet-cannoneers-tricorne.name: Violet Cannoneer's Tricorne
c.violet-cannoneers-tricorne.description: A hat capable of both conveying threat as it conveys comfort, at least the bright colours ensure it is easily visible the next time the winds sweep it off your head and over the sides of the deck.

u.script-of-aurora-assault.name: Script of Aurora Assault
u.script-of-aurora-assault.description: "Shimmer in beauty and shine in victory! Aurora Assault!"

e.cumberworld-benefactors-heels.name: Cumberworld Benefactor's Heels
e.cumberworld-benefactors-heels.effects:
+45 Vitality; +45 Energy; +45 Honor
Set Bonus (Cumberworld Benefactor Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1 Tiers of 'Discerning Vision', 'Astute Observation' and 'Precise Inspection'
 7+: +1 Tiers of 'Keen Eyes'
 8+: +100 Energy
 9+: +1 Tiers of 'Discerning Vision', 'Astute Observation' and 'Precise Inspection'
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.cumberworld-benefactors-heels.description: Somehow her footwear, despite being 'improved' by the carnival-folk to reflect her station as their benefactor, manages to further improve her airs of distinction.

c.sergeants-crops.name: Sergeant's Crops
c.sergeants-crops.description: Drilling new patterns and movements into the minds of your troops can require.... strict discipline, it seems.

e.nepyren-bone-cuisses.name: Nepyren Bone Cuisses
e.nepyren-bone-cuisses.effects:
Dark Remains (Cuisses): 12% chance to proc 780 Dark damage; +100 damage per Nepyren Bone set item worn
Set Bonus (Nepyren Bone Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 8+: +1 Tiers of 'Inspirational Command - Horrifying'
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.nepyren-bone-cuisses.description: These pants may work well for combat, but when it comes to warmth and modesty, they definitely leave you wanting.

a.vanhel-vanguard.name: Vanhel Vanguard
a.vanhel-vanguard.description: Many would consider the vanguard of the Vanhel order to be the weakest faction therein, but little could be further from the truth. While they may not have received the calling of a deity, or fling around impressive magics, they play an integral role in the functioning of the order.

k.brawny-attitude.name: Brawny Attitude
k.brawny-attitude.effects: Increases your Defence stat. Increases Defence by xx%.

c.red-elven-cap.name: Red Elven Cap
c.red-elven-cap.description: You never understood why ranging parties would wear such... spectacular adornments, but far be it from you to criticize!

c.doctrine-of-phermis.name: Doctrine of Phermis
c.doctrine-of-phermis.description: 'To seek out wisdom and hold it in high regards, and to use this wisdom to prepare the unavoidable wars ahead.'

c.sinah-scorpie-claw.name: Sinah Scorpie Claw
c.sinah-scorpie-claw.description: Claws from a local creature that causes the locals some significant distress. Apparently most parts of the creature are quite toxic... You fear you haven't seen the last, nor the worst, of them.

c.arendyl-greenleaf-attack-boost-i.name: Arendyl Greenleaf Attack Boost I
c.arendyl-greenleaf-attack-boost-i.description: A badge of merit, awarded to Arendyl for his exemplary skills as an offensive Commander. Passively boosts Arendyl's Attack by +15 (Max 3).

a.glorymuth-cleanup.name: Glorymuth Cleanup
a.glorymuth-cleanup.description: While they follow orders as readily as the Archers, their attitude is much less concerned, as though they know exactly what is, and what is-not, to come.
a.glorymuth-cleanup.effects: Adds +0.5 Defence to Corros Glorymuth and Bai Juanmahee in the active Formation

s.scroll-sentry-ghoul.name: Sentry Ghoul Scroll
s.scroll-sentry-ghoul.description: You've heard of the dead coming back to life, but this creature seems out of place for such a provincial setting...

e.hatuumin-bare-whip.name: Hatuumin Bare Whip
e.hatuumin-bare-whip.effects:
Sight of the Eye (Bare Whip): 16% chance to proc 400 Psychic damage; +75 damage per Hatuumin set item worn; +0.25% Crit Rate
Set Bonus (Hatuumin Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +30% Crit Damage and +200 Magic
e.hatuumin-bare-whip.description: I(a). Sinyu grimaced as dark clouds covered the sky, promising to bring severe winds that would surely lead to terrible sandstorms. He felt a tug at his hand, and he squeezed the young boy's hand in consolation as he led him down the back alley. This mission had been given to him by the Nomarch, himself, and this darkness would aid his escape to the north, bringing with him the Nomarch's only son. A job that could only be trusted to a strong, military-minded commander, he was told, though he feared that there was something else afoot.

c.freshlife-sapling.name: Freshlife Sapling
c.freshlife-sapling.description: A rare sprig of new life, you will have to guard this closely until the season in which it can survive arrives.

e.tromos-latria-blaute.name: Tromos Latria Blaute
e.tromos-latria-blaute.effects:
Returning the Damners (Blaute): 25% chance to proc 200 Dark damage; +100 damage per Tromos Latria set item worn; 2% chance to proc 650 Holy damage; +700 damage per Tromos Latria set item worn; +75 Magic; +3% Holy Resistance
Set Bonus (Tromos Latria Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +5% Crit Damage, +500 Magic and -5% Formation Bonus
 7+: +1 Tiers of 'Magic Meditation' and -5% Formation Bonus
 8+: +1 Tiers of 'Protective Guardian' and -10% Formation Bonus
 9+: +3% Crit Rate and -10% Formation Bonus
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.tromos-latria-blaute.description:
"Stink of evil. And of bad washing. Give to me so I can study."
-Weeg

c.spell-focus-fire.name: Spell Focus - Fire
c.spell-focus-fire.description: A heavy, polished piece of garnet, this stone can be used as a medium to focus your mind upon the element of Fire.

s.scroll-jagar-the-red.name: Jagar the Red Scroll
s.scroll-jagar-the-red.description: Seemingly bathed in fire, this monstrosity has revelled in being released from the Void, and would happily see the world burn if not stopped!

e.paresthisy-stone.name: Paresthisy Stone
e.paresthisy-stone.effects:
Existential Experiencing (Stone): 10% chance to proc 600 Psychic damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 20%; +400 damage per Paresthisy set item worn; +100 Magic
Set Bonus (Paresthisy Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +1 Tiers of 'Eye for Beauty'
 8+: +1 Tiers of 'Eye for Beauty'
e.paresthisy-stone.description: The longer you stare into this stone, the more certain you become that it is actually staring back at you...

e.acheralan-attire-satchel.name: Acheralan Attire Satchel
e.acheralan-attire-satchel.effects:
Set Bonus (Acheralan Attire Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +2 Tiers of 'Spare Change'
e.acheralan-attire-satchel.description:
"If you want something carryable that has some real sturdy straps, ask ones of the Republic folk about their bags."
-Valfan Whistleboots

c.red-tromos-jewel.name: Red Tromos Jewel
c.red-tromos-jewel.description: A rare jewel from the gorge, it has been flooded with demonic energies for so long that it holds the answer to how to stop these demonic entities.

k.greatshielders-barricade.name: Greatshielder's Barricade
k.greatshielders-barricade.effects: While equipping a Tower Shield, reduces incoming damage to you by 20%, and prevents Raid attack damage to your armies. Lasts for x Raid attacks.

cp.void-crystals-fifty.name: Void Crystals x400
cp.void-crystals-fifty.description: A large pack containing the premium currency of the realms.

c.spiderling-spinnerets.name: Spiderling Spinnerets
c.spiderling-spinnerets.description: The spinnerets from the giant spiderlings still seem capable of producing thread, even after being removed!

u.blue-third-eye-tonic.name: Blue Third Eye Tonic
u.blue-third-eye-tonic.description: It is said that all perception starts not with the eyes on your face, but by the concentration of energy forming your innate third eye. Whether the Gods would agree with such a self-serving explanation or not remains to be seen, but you do enjoy the prospect of noticing those minute details of the world around you.
u.blue-third-eye-tonic.effects: Increases Attentive Perception and Eye for Beauty tiers by +1 for 4 hours

a.cowering-guild-servant.name: Cowering Guild Servant
a.cowering-guild-servant.description: An apprentice servant to the Guild, who seems moderately overwhelmed by the job at hand.

e.swiftslicer-shuriken.name: Swiftslicer Shuriken
e.swiftslicer-shuriken.effects:
Glorious Blades (Shuriken): 16% chance to proc 400 Fire damage vs Winter raids; +15% Crit Damage; +0.5% Evasion; +200 damage per Swiftslicer set item worn
Set Bonus (Swiftslicer Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +1.5% Evasion
e.swiftslicer-shuriken.description: Your skepticism at needing to handle metal objects in these cold temperatures was abated when you felt the distinct metal lining the interior grips of these blades. Your curiousity has since shifted to whether they may better stick into your targets...

u.thiadoran-cheera.name: Thiadoran Cheera
u.thiadoran-cheera.description: You are told that this wine is a fine vintage, but you're still hesitant about imbibing to excess.

preReqs.name: resource
preReqs.errorMsg: Your health and honor are full already.

e.cave-cragsmans-knife.name: Cave Cragsman's Knife
e.cave-cragsmans-knife.effects:
Craggy Hold (Knife): 5% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 25% 
Set Bonus (Cave Cragsman Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +2 Tiers of 'Defensive Rider - Terrestrial' and +2 Tiers of 'Mount Proficiency - Terrestrial'
e.cave-cragsmans-knife.description:
"The most fundamental tool one will ever need while exploring a new cavern is their knife. Don't confuse it with any old blade, though, as this is specialized for a number of different tasks."
-Clyburn Softshadow

e.deathwatch-staff.name: Deathwatch Staff
e.deathwatch-staff.effects: Uneyed Viewer: 8% chance to proc 630 Dark damage vs Undead raids; +28 Magic
e.deathwatch-staff.description:
"I've heard many a novice cleric complain about how much mystical power is needed to keep their patients from passing... They have no appreciate for how much more it takes to bring them back after passing!"
-Vittamar

e.chaunaths-warpriests-sabatons.name: Chaunath's Warpriests Sabatons
e.chaunaths-warpriests-sabatons.effects:
Shield of Deities (Sabatons): 8% chance to proc 1,175 Magic damage; +1,025 damage per Chaunath's Warpriests set item worn; +2% Crit Damage; +100 Magic; 5% chance to reduce incoming damage to your Armies by 20%
Sanctified
Set Bonus (Chaunath's Warpriests Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: 5% chance on 20x attacks to heal each active Troop +1 Reserve
 6+: +2% Crit Rate and +15% Crit Damage
 7+: 4% chance on 20x attacks to heal each active Commander +2 HP
 8+: +15% Formation Bonus and 10% chance to reduce incoming damage to your armies by 30%
 9+: 4% chance on 20x attacks to heal each active Troop +3 Reserves and proc 8% of your Leadership stat in Holy damage
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.chaunaths-warpriests-sabatons.description: Fortunately, shielding those who follow you doesn't require you to move quickly.

c.red-acheralan-bracer.name: Red Acheralan Bracer
c.red-acheralan-bracer.description: A high quality bracer, demonstrating the finesse of the Naitour's military armourers, with durability matching that of their famed patrol.

e.swiftslicer-pants.name: Swiftslicer Pants
e.swiftslicer-pants.effects:
Glorious Blades (Pants): 24% chance to proc 450 Fire damage vs Winter raids; +100 Fire damage per Swiftslicer set item worn; +1.2% Evasion
Set Bonus (Swiftslicer Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +1.5% Evasion
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.swiftslicer-pants.description: Considerably more revealing than what you usually wear, the first time you slipped while wearing these resulted in your continued forward movement, courtesy of the additional blades. You could find some uses for ingenuity of this calibre.

k.tendon-strike.name: Tendon Strike
k.tendon-strike.effects: You deal an idle attack every 20 seconds for 20 minutes. Each attack deals xx Physical damage.

e.gipantan-recruit-pants.name: Gipantan Recruit Pants
e.gipantan-recruit-pants.effects:
Skleery Proponeezy (Pants): 12% chance to proc 75 Physical damage; +65 damage per Gipantan Recruit set item worn; +2% Crit Damage; +0.1% Evasion
Set Bonus (Gipantan Recruit Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +2 Tiers of 'Medium Armor Proficiency', +2 Tiers of 'Polearm Proficiency' and +2 Tiers of 'Crossbow Proficiency'
e.gipantan-recruit-pants.description:
"Chafen'? I'd be happy to shove some roughgrass down those pants t'show you real itch!"
-Lobaic Bronzefury

a.istovins-secret-informant.name: Istovin's Secret Informant
a.istovins-secret-informant.description:
"There is no pathway to a successful fortification such as this without controlling information."
-Istovin Telaer
a.istovins-secret-informant.effects: Adds +2 Attack to Istovin Telaer, Master of Whispers in the active Formation

u.lesser-potion-of-tenacity.name: Lesser Potion of Tenacity
u.lesser-potion-of-tenacity.description: I. Having experienced the exorbitant prices charged by the local Alchemist when his mother fell ill, Shou Royce had decided early in life that he would become a professional Alchemist... That was, however, until he realized just how much time, study and effort was required for such a profession.
u.lesser-potion-of-tenacity.effects: +250 Defence vs Guild Raids for 4 hours

e.griphornis-pants.name: Griphornis Pants
e.griphornis-pants.effects:
Pennaceous Plumage (Pants): 8% chance to proc 2900 Physical damage; +18750 damage vs Guild Raids; +450 damage per Griphornis set item worn
Set Bonus (Griphornis Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +70% Crit Damage
e.griphornis-pants.description: VI(b). Carrying on, Helmo was actively looking for an opportunity to make some big earnings, when he spied a makeshift stand at the end of an alley. "Bingo!" Helmo thought to himself, as he pocketed his half-eaten apple and headed down to the end of the path. Helmo watched the current player win his first round, before wagering again on the second and losing to the obvious-charlatan. Helmo waited patiently as the shell-game vendor canvased a wiry lad, who pulled his empty pockets, before gesturing to Helmo, who shrugged nonchalantly and put two coins on the table.

a.guild-beasttamer.name: Guild Beasttamer
a.guild-beasttamer.description: Some opt to control fauna with force and strength, while others seek to tame its essence and control it through understanding. This Beasttamer has all-but learned the language of the various monsters she handles, and has an uncanny connection with the population of the Stadium.

c.summoning-stone.name: Summoning Stone
c.summoning-stone.description: A strange stone from a distant land, according to Alanis it seems poised to draw energies from far away, along with who-knows-what-else?

u.grandfathers-tonic.name: Grandfather's Tonic
u.grandfathers-tonic.description: Your early memories recall your grandmother affectionately referring to these bottles as your grandfather's tonic, but in hindsight you only ever saw them in her possession.

preReqs.name: resource
preReqs.errorMsg: Your energy and vitality are full already.

a.psionic-guild-guardian.name: Psionic Guild Guardian
a.psionic-guild-guardian.description: Significantly more intelligent than its basic predecessors, this guardian can move much more efficiently through mystical means, and can emit low-level disturbances to any would-be attackers who get too close.

e.song-of-radiance-chest.name: Song of Radiance Chest
e.song-of-radiance-chest.effects:
Brilliant Song (Chest): 24% chance to proc 400 Magic damage; +75 damage per Song of Radiance set item worn; +40 Magic; +2% Magic Resistance
Set Bonus (Song of Radiance Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +1500 Magic and +1 Tiers of 'Arcane Unveiling'
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.song-of-radiance-chest.description:
"I believe the quality of the Elderberries you feed it affects the songs produced by the Songbird of Radiance."
-Janagud

e.ooleviash-steed.name: Ooleviash Steed
e.ooleviash-steed.effects:
Eire Eviction (Steed): 20% chance to proc 95 Physical damage; +215 damage per Ooleviash set item worn; +3,600 damage vs Fae raids; +1% Evasion
Set Bonus (Ooleviash Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +40% Crit Damage
 7+: +500 Magic
e.ooleviash-steed.description: A surprisingly large steed, clearly built for fieldwork more than combat and boasting the stamina for such a role.

u.yellow-brewers-satchel.name: Yellow Brewer's Satchel
u.yellow-brewers-satchel.description: A satchel from a talented brewer, containing a mystery potion.
u.yellow-brewers-satchel.effects: Open to obtain its contents (two of the chance drops)

a.slygses-werecanid-wight.name: Slygse's Werecanid Wight
a.slygses-werecanid-wight.description:
"Some of my best wares originate not from other vendors, but from scouring out the raw materials myself. This fellow, in particular, is quite talented at tracking down a variety of interesting things... well, he was, until his snout started dropping off..."
-Slygse
a.slygses-werecanid-wight.effects: Restores 1 Reserve daily; Adds +2 Attack to Slygse, Merchant Extraordinaire in the active Formation

a.brocck-of-the-revolt.name: Brocck of the Revolt
a.brocck-of-the-revolt.description: An unusually stoic gnome, Brocck moves with an air that makes clear he has spent much time away from society, though an aura of command clearly emanates from him - almost as much as his odour does. Brocck makes no bones about his general dislike for large settlements, and is even more prickly when the notion of deforestation comes up, but what really seems to set him off is unnatural magics, such as fire and ice, being turned on the nature he has chosen to protect.
a.brocck-of-the-revolt.effects: Return From This Land: 20% chance to proc 12,000 Nature damage; +5,000 damage vs Legendary raids; +830 damage per Nature's Revolt set item and Formation owned; Adds +9 Attack and +0.7 Defence to each Nature's Revenge and Nature's Frustration in the Formation; Gains +4 Attack and +0.2 Defence per distinct Nature's Revolt set item and Formation owned

cp.diplomat-starter-pack-i.name: Diplomat Starter Pack I
cp.diplomat-starter-pack-i.description: A pack providing the necessary goods for every budding diplomat.

c.mounting-blades.name: Mounting Blades
c.mounting-blades.description: Thick blades, well crafted and clearly intended to bear weight.

c.laurentian-cloak.name: Laurentian Cloak
c.laurentian-cloak.description:
"Not all of the undead are weak to fire, though they may disguise it by wearing such flammable attire as this."
-Vanhel Firetosser

e.warmage-guardians-legplates.name: Warmage Guardian's Legplates
e.warmage-guardians-legplates.effects:
Magic Shield (Legplates): 20% chance to proc 500 Physical damage and add +200 Defence; +175 damage per Warmage Guardian's set item worn; +6% Crit Damage; +10 HP
Set Bonus (Warmage Guardian's Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +1% Crit Rate
 7+: +500 Defence and +15% Crit Damage
 9+: +20% chance to proc 200 Magic damage with +6% damage from any Magic damage on that proc
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.warmage-guardians-legplates.description: You're sure you've had worse jobs than babysitting magical-types who seem completely incapable of caring for themselves. Nothing is immediately coming to mind, but you're still quite certain.

e.friskfingers-stiletto.name: Friskfingers Stiletto
e.friskfingers-stiletto.effects:
Rapid Robbery (Stiletto): 5% chance to proc 2,000 Physical damage; +1,250 damage per Friskfingers set item worn; +10 HP; +10% Crit Damage; +30 Honor
Set Bonus (Friskfingers Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1.5% Crit Rate, +30 Honor and +2 Tiers of 'Spare Change'
 6+: +3 Tiers of 'Spare Change' and +60 Vitality
 7+: +10% Crit Damage and +1 Tiers of 'Keen Eyes'
 8+: +50 Vitality, +3 Tiers of 'Vulnerability Spotter - Pursuer' and +3 Tiers of 'Vulnerability Spotter - Elusive'
 9+: +50 Vitality, +1 Tiers of 'Keen Eyes' and +5 Tiers of 'Spare Change'
e.friskfingers-stiletto.description: A fine and narrow blade, you would have originally assumed it was meant for stabbing one's foes... Until Alula revealed a series of them, all seemingly identical, and casually threw one into a nearby wall, pinning a large fly to the stone.

u.script-of-fireball.name: Script of Fire Ball
u.script-of-fireball.description: "Pin of light, expand and deliver your gift! Fireball!"

e.picaroons-shirt.name: Picaroon's Shirt
e.picaroons-shirt.effects:
Swabby Sealover (Shirt): 8% chance to proc 200 Physical damage; +50 damage per Picaroon's Raiments set item worn; +400 damage vs Human raids; +0.25% Crit Rate
Set Bonus (Picaroon's Raiment Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +2% Crit Rate
 7+: +25% Crit Damage
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.picaroons-shirt.description: A lightweight shirt that seems to function equally well whether dry or wet. You would be happy to wear this on a ship, though less so when in the mountains.

c.green-infernal-bracer.name: Green Infernal Bracer
c.green-infernal-bracer.description: As disgusted as you are to handle this ichor-encrusted piece, it serves as proof to the locals that you were able to clear their fields of the demons plaguing them.

a.phermis-engager.name: Phermis Engager
a.phermis-engager.description: For all Meropi's quick quips and comments, these ladies barely even look up from sharpening their blades when you draw near, and only to give you sour looks.
a.phermis-engager.effects: Adds +3 Attack to Meropi Demide in the active Formation

e.meftets-blade.name: Meftet's Blade
e.meftets-blade.effects: Capital Justice (Blade): 30% chance to proc 400 Dark damage; +20 damage per Meftet set item worn
e.meftets-blade.description:
"The blade you carry seems to be an homage to the myths surrounding the Meftet, suggesting they will guide the unwary to the underworld, or are beasts that dwell therein."
-Janagud

a.atas-the-purifier.name: Atas the Purifier
a.atas-the-purifier.description: A being of few words, Atas' mere presence seems to bring about a purified light when he passes, though it seems to drain him at the same time, as though he's leaving a portion of his own essence behind.
a.atas-the-purifier.effects: Springtime Purification: 0.4% chance to heal the Player 4 HP

u.violet-guard-tonic.name: Violet Guard Tonic
u.violet-guard-tonic.description: Originally concocted to keep him safe during his forays into the forest, Nphireo was oblivious to his creation's market-potential until a friend saw an ogre break a club harmlessly over Nphireo's head.

m.pellet-pelt.name: Pellet Pelt
m.pellet-pelt.description: It may not be as pretty as snow, but it certainly seems to hurt a lot more when you're hit by it. Perhaps someone can figure out how to convert this magic to keep your beverages cold, rather than smashing the glass to pieces?
m.pellet-pelt.effects: Pellet Pelt: 12% chance to proc [up-to-54]% Ice damage, plus 150 Ice damage

e.thiadoran-garments-knife.name: Thiadoran Garments Knife
e.thiadoran-garments-knife.effects:
Cathimeri Nijzoi (Knife): 20% chance to proc 55 Physical damage; +20 damage per Thiadoran Garments set item worn; +5% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Thiadoran Garments Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +40 HP
 7+: +2 Tiers of 'Spare Change'
e.thiadoran-garments-knife.description: A simple blade, more suited for daily living than combat, but it'll suffice in a pinch.

u.red-brewmasters-bulwark-brew.name: Red Brewmaster's Bulwark Brew
u.red-brewmasters-bulwark-brew.description:
"Despite how this may taste, I can assure you there is not a ground-down shield in this brew..."
-Nphireo

e.irus-shroud-crusade-chakram.name: Irus' Shroud Crusade Chakram
e.irus-shroud-crusade-chakram.effects:
Forward Irus' Light (Chakram): 20% chance to proc 240 Holy damage; +220 damage per Irus' Shroud Crusade set item worn; +2,400 damage vs Demon raids; 16% chance to proc 160 Holy damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 15%; +230 damage per Irus' Shroud Crusade set item worn; +1% Crit Rate; +15% Crit Damage
Consecrated
Set Bonus (Irus' Shroud Crusade Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1.5% Crit Rate and +15% Crit Damage
 6+: +4 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Holy'
 7+: +10% Formation Bonus
 8+: +5% All Resistances
 9+: +15% Crit Damage and +10% Formation Bonus
e.irus-shroud-crusade-chakram.description:
"While many prefer being up-close and personal when spreading Irus' love, we respect that some prefer to keep their distance, hence why we offer them viable tools to do just that."
-Wilben Shroudbearer

e.bevis-visor.name: Bevis' Visor
e.bevis-visor.effects:
Set Bonus (Bevis Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +40 Offence and +3% All Resistances
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.bevis-visor.description: I. Bevis Shepherdson, like many, came from humble beginnings. Unlike many, he was known as a hellion who would invest his energies into literally any possible task besides his daily chores, including watching his father's flocks.

m.soul-reap.name: Soul Reap
m.soul-reap.description:
Tearing shards of your target's soul out of their body sounds pretty violent, and you had figured the actual spell wouldn't be as gruesome as you feared.

You were correct: It was far more graphic than you could have ever expected. On the upside, it'll give Alanis some new material to study.
m.soul-reap.effects: Soul Reap: 35% chance to proc [up-to-170]% Dark damage

c.violet-rattler.name: Violet Rattler
c.violet-rattler.description: You didn't realize that the tail of a snake would stay in one piece, even after death. Plus, it makes such a fun sound!

k.holy-hacking.name: Holy Hacking
k.holy-hacking.description: Your experience staving off wave-after-wave of undead horrors in the Nepyres Mountains has honed your skills to new heights. Now, you can bring down holy righteousness to smite that which should-have-remained dead.
k.holy-hacking.effects: Deals a 20x Holy-type attack to the Raid. If the Raid is Undead, this deals a bonus 50% damage, plus (5x Strength) plus (100x Overwhelming Offence Tech Skill Level) damage.

a.bai-juanmahee.name: Bai Juanmahee
a.bai-juanmahee.description: You can't quite make out whatever it is that this being is composed of, but the way its form wriggles and seethes without end is almost as unsettling as Corros.
a.bai-juanmahee.effects: Many Times Better: 15% chance to proc 6,000 Physical damage; Adds +1.2 Defence to each Glorymuth Archer or Glorymuth Cleanup in the Formation

c.spell-focus-lightning.name: Spell Focus - Lightning
c.spell-focus-lightning.description: A heavy, polished piece of topaz, this stone can be used as a medium to focus your mind upon the element of Lightning.

e.tungsten-plate.name: Tungsten Plate
e.tungsten-plate.effects:
Rustproof Enhancement (Plate): 6% chance to proc 750 Nature damage; +150 Nature damage per Tungsten set item worn; +7% Acid Resistance
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.tungsten-plate.description: You started on your nightly routine of polishing your armor, before remembering that this material isn't supposed to wear or rust, regardless of care.

c.wyrm-geode.name: Wyrm Geode
c.wyrm-geode.description: What might look like a large, misshapen chunk of rock, this stone seems to be imbued with living energy of the earth.

c.violet-devils-horn.name: Violet Devil's Horn
c.violet-devils-horn.description: The mark of a fallen demon is supposedly both a blessing and a curse; no mere mortal is intended to lay eyes upon such a thing.

c.violet-thurlam-blowfish.name: Violet Thurlam Blowfish
c.violet-thurlam-blowfish.description: You are hesitant to touch such a prickly, soggy creature, until you see Mauritio put one to his mouth and blow hard, inflating it to comical proportions.

e.entwood-darts.name: Entwood Darts
e.entwood-darts.effects: Root Strike (Darts): 10% chance to proc 275 Nature damage; +5% Crit Damage
e.entwood-darts.description: While these darts appear solid and lacking any obvious opening, it is apparent from their weight that they must be hollow. Perhaps the insides contain the magical energies that occasionally cause roots to spring from the ground to lash out at their victims.

e.stormshapers-armor.name: Stormshapers' Armor
e.stormshapers-armor.effects:
Stormfury (Armor): 12% chance to proc 450 Lightning damage; +100 damage per Stormshapers' set item worn; 4% chance to proc 1,400 Lightning damage; +200 damage per Stormshapers' set item worn; +3% Lightning Resistance
Set Bonus (Stormshapers' Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: 50% chance to proc 120 Lightning damage, +5 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Lightning' and +20% Lightning Resistance
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.stormshapers-armor.description:
"The storm is shaped from the heart, and that must be prot- Wait, why are you laughing?"
-Thundreag Stormchest

e.psyguard-bulwark-visor.name: Psyguard Bulwark Visor
e.psyguard-bulwark-visor.effects:
Guardian's Mind (Visor): 12% chance to proc 1,000 Psychic damage; +500 damage per Psyguard Bulwark set item worn; +25 HP; +40 Magic
Set Bonus (Psyguard Bulwark Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +10 Max HP on all Commanders and +10 Reserve Cap on all Troops
6: +1% Crit Rate and +15% Crit Damage
 7+: +10 Reserve Cap on all Troops and +1,000 Defence
 8+: 10% chance to reduce damage to your Armies by 50%
 9+: +1 Formation Protection Value
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.psyguard-bulwark-visor.description:
"Since it is evident your psychic powers are underdeveloped, this helm should help you focus. Oh, no, I won't be needing to wear one, thank you very much."
-Morah Psyguard

c.incendiary-cocoon-silk.name: Incendiary Cocoon Silk
c.incendiary-cocoon-silk.description: Silk from a rare, magical insect, capable of enhancing the evolutionary capabilities of certain creatures, or being used to wrap about armor to improve its protective capabilities.

e.swamp-nomad-shorts.name: Swamp Nomad Shorts
e.swamp-nomad-shorts.effects:
Swamp's Thing (Shorts): 4% chance to proc 1600 Nature damage; +200 damage per Swamp Nomad's set item worn; +30 Magic; +3% Nature Resistance; +3% Poison Resistance
Set Bonus (Swamp Nomad Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +1 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Nature'
e.swamp-nomad-shorts.description: It seems you need not worry about getting your pant-legs dirty with swamp water when you have no pant-legs.

e.reverent-titanslayer-gauntlets.name: Reverent Titanslayer Gauntlets
e.reverent-titanslayer-gauntlets.effects:
Behemoth Bouldery Bash (Gauntlets): 12% chance to proc 900 Holy damage; +2,500 damage vs Legendary raids; +700 damage per Reverent Titanslayer set item worn; +0.75% Evasion; +1% All Resistances; +12% Crit Damage; +30 HP
Set Bonus (Reverent Titanslayer Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +2% Crit Rate and +25% Crit Damage
 6+: +100 HP and +6% All Resistances
 7+: 6% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 80%, and 4% chance to reduce damage to Armies by 75%
 8+: 8% chance to proc 2,400 Holy damage and protect the Player and their Armies from Breath of Death
 9+: +30% Formation Bonus
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.reverent-titanslayer-gauntlets.description: Sturdy enough to keep ahold of a saddle - as though your life depends upon it - while flexible enough to handily wield a heavy, stone weapon.

u.copper-third-eye-tonic.name: Copper Third Eye Tonic
u.copper-third-eye-tonic.description: It is said that all perception starts not with the eyes on your face, but by the concentration of energy forming your innate third eye. Whether the Gods would agree with such a self-serving explanation or not remains to be seen, but you do enjoy the prospect of noticing those minute details of the world around you.
u.copper-third-eye-tonic.effects: Increases Attentive Perception and Eye for Beauty tiers by +2 for 2 hours

a.dumvan-forager.name: Dumvan Forager
a.dumvan-forager.description: The mountains are not know for being plentiful in resources, at least not the kind you can eat. Having an experienced forager on hand, who knows where to find your closest meal, can be the difference between lean eating and starvation.

a.information-vendor.name: Information Vendor
a.information-vendor.description: It may take a big man to blackmail some of the most important officials in the region, but not necessarily a big one to find the information in the first place; if information truly is power, then these difficult-to-notice Goblins may be amongst the most powerful beings in the nation!

c.electro-venom-claws.name: Electro-venom Claws
c.electro-venom-claws.description: Dripping with venom and charged with electricity, this Naga's claws seem almost as deadly severed as they were while attached.

c.blue-undamaged-retina.name: Blue Undamaged Retina
c.blue-undamaged-retina.description: Removing this thin membrane from the Watcher, undamaged, was terribly exacting. You can only hope it pays off.

c.brew-of-physicality.name: Brew of Physicality
c.brew-of-physicality.description: Never relinquish your hold on the dreams you previously held, for you must fight in order to keep them alive.

c.blue-tromos-jewel.name: Blue Tromos Jewel
c.blue-tromos-jewel.description: A rare jewel from the gorge, it has been flooded with demonic energies for so long that it holds the answer to how to stop these demonic entities.

c.phermitic-warpipes.name: Phermitic Warpipes
c.phermitic-warpipes.description: Phermis may be the Goddess of war, but She demands strict adherence to pomp, regiment and tradition. Playing these warpipes as the signal of an advancing militia is considered to be in good form, and will incur Her blessings on the field of battle.

e.rangers-bycocket-cap.name: Ranger's Bycocket Cap
e.rangers-bycocket-cap.description: Unusual in its style, you cannot deny the snug retention this cap has on your head, nor the manner in which it keeps foliage from your eyes.

e.blazebrand-points.name: Blazebrand Points
e.blazebrand-points.effects:
Justice by any Flames Necessary (Points): 40% chance to proc 225 Fire damage; +50 damage per Blazebrand set item worn; 5% chance to proc 2,200 Fire damage; +1,100 damage per Blazebrand set item worn; +2.5% Crit Rate; +12% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Blazebrand Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 8+: +2.5% Crit Rate
 9+: 40% chance to proc 250 Fire damage, +8 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Fire' and +1 Tiers of 'Insurmountable Offence'
e.blazebrand-points.description: While these darts seem unusually light, flames immediately spread out from whatever is struck by one. You'll have to be careful not to carelessly drop one in your tent.

e.swiftslicer-ring.name: Swiftslicer Ring
e.swiftslicer-ring.effects:
+50 HP; +0.5% Crit Rate; +1 Tier of 'Elemental Expertise - Fire'
Set Bonus (Swiftslicer Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +1.5% Evasion
e.swiftslicer-ring.description: This ring seems oddly delicate for something so related to slicing. Once it adorns your finger, you realize you've suffered several serious cuts on your opposing hand while donning it.

u.devils-health-ooze.name: Devil's Health Ooze
u.devils-health-ooze.description: This oozing, red concoction was leaking out through the stopper before you could remove it from its bag; your fingers tingle where the sticky liquid touched them.

a.darkveil-retriever.name: Darkveil Retriever
a.darkveil-retriever.description: "The passage to the next life is rarely simple, and many become lost in the Darkveil. Occasionally, when one has departed too soon, it is up to us to retrieve their essence before it decides to depart further." - Darkveil Retriever

c.spell-focus-holy.name: Spell Focus - Holy
c.spell-focus-holy.description: A heavy, polished piece of pearl, this stone can be used as a medium to focus your mind upon the element of Holy.

e.nepyren-bone-shield.name: Nepyren Bone Shield
e.nepyren-bone-shield.effects:
Dark Remains (Shield): 6% chance to proc 1350 Dark damage; +250 damage per Nepyren Bone set item worn; +25% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Nepyren Bone Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 8+: +1 Tiers of 'Inspirational Command - Horrifying'
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.nepyren-bone-shield.description: You get an unsettling feeling every time you pick up this shield, despite it's obvious potential to protect you in combat. You also can't help but notice Vinqa giving you sidelong glances whenever you wear it.

e.reodai-embersteed.name: Reodai Embersteed
e.reodai-embersteed.effects:
Reodai's Anger: 6% chance to proc 4,000 Fire damage; +1,500 damage per Reodai set item worn; +50 HP; +2% Evasion; +2% Crit Rate
Set Bonus (Reodai Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +2.5% Crit Rate, +30% Crit Damage and 7% chance to proc 4,000 Fire damage with +120% Crit Damage on that hit
e.reodai-embersteed.description:
"Your anger isss clearly a continuing sssource of ssstruggle for you. I can sssenssse it even now, asss we ssspeak. Identify what it isss that troublesss you ssso, and acsssept that into yourssself in order to massster thisss sssteed."
-Lokakshi Coilbreaker

e.sunbringers-slippers.name: Sunbringer's Slippers
e.sunbringers-slippers.effects:
Set Bonus (Sunbringer Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +150 Magic
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.sunbringers-slippers.description: V. Elderune's first attempt was well thought out, as he avoided contact in the late evening and snuck out of the dormitory late at night. After disarming the mystic barriers, Elderune thought he was in the clear... save that he had failed to account for wards that continually checked the status of those barriers. Elderune was hauled back to the Academy at dawn, and administered a sharp punishment to drive the lesson home.

e.training-sword-three.name: 3Training Sword3
e.training-sword-three.description: A basic training sword, with a few notches and grooves from use.

e.blazen-swiftslicer-feet.name: Blazen Swiftslicer Feet
e.blazen-swiftslicer-feet.effects:
Glorious Flaming Blades (Feet): 24% chance to proc 900 Fire damage vs Winter raids; +200 Fire damage per Blazen Swiftslicer set item worn; +1.2% Evasion
Set Bonus (Blazen Swiftslicer Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +0.25% Evasion
 9+: +1.75% Evasion
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.blazen-swiftslicer-feet.description: You had already grown somewhat accustomed to the basic pair, and were glad to hear that these would even keep your feet warm while you wear them.

c.green-ghoul-jaw.name: Green Ghoul Jaw
c.green-ghoul-jaw.description: Depending upon the magics used to animate it, and the decay of the body, the discarded bits of the undead can be quite colourful.

e.mikoko-kikwi.name: Mikoko Kikwi
e.mikoko-kikwi.effects:
Land's Rest (Kikwi): 5% chance to proc 480 Magic damage; +3,600 damage vs Undead raids; +240 damage per Mikoko set item worn; +25 HP; +1 Tiers of 'Inspirational Command: Horrifying'
Set Bonus (Mikoko Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +25% Crit Damage
 7+: +2% Crit Rate
 8+: +10% Dark Resistance
 9+: +1 Tiers of 'Inspirational Command: Horrifying'
e.mikoko-kikwi.description: A simple band, though you feel overcome by a weight of sadness and grieving once you slip it onto your finger. You must work harder to right that which has been wronged, and will endeavour to do so.

u.indigo-swiftness-tonic.name: Indigo Swiftness Tonic
u.indigo-swiftness-tonic.description:
An old legend tells of two colleagues exploring a dense forest, before happening upon a bear. When the bear gives chase, they both flee as swiftly as their feet will carry them. One of the colleagues pauses to quaff a draught from a small glass beaker. "You'll never be able to evade the bear forever, so why waste time with a last drink?!" His partner questioned incredulously.

"I need not escape the bear forever, ol' chum! I need only dodge its advances longer than you!"
u.indigo-swiftness-tonic.effects: Increases Evasion equivalent to +22,000 Agility for 6 hours

p.stat-intellect.name: Intellect Stat Point
p.stat-intellect.description: Stat Point for the Intellect Stat

u.pork-offering.name: Pork Offering
u.pork-offering.description: An offering of the finest meat, there is clearly no benefit in letting it go to waste, now.

preReqs.name: resource
preReqs.errorMsg: Your health and vitality are full already.

e.red-dragonhunters-shield.name: Red Dragonhunter's Shield
e.red-dragonhunters-shield.effects: Red Drake Stalker (Shield): 20% chance to proc 150 Ice damage; +400 damage vs Dragon raids; +40 damage per Red Dragonhunter set item worn
e.red-dragonhunters-shield.description: II. While traveling abroad, Qusasper was said to have stopped on a hill for his afternoon tea, but the boiling waters wakened a great, red dragon that was slumbering nearby.

u.offensive-skill-elixir.name: Offensive Skill Elixir
u.offensive-skill-elixir.description: A rare and potent brew, this draught is capable of bringing out an adventurer's most offensive capabilities.

e.hooded-veil-pants.name: Hooded Veil Pants
e.hooded-veil-pants.effects: Fangs Alot (Pants): 12% chance to proc 200 Poison damage; +25 damage per Hooded Veil set item worn; +4 Offence
e.hooded-veil-pants.description:
VI. "Ultimately, the followerss of Ssarfraxss could not bear to allow her pressence to exisst, and the Priesstess wass confronted by sscoress of powerful Naga, both warrior and karamati alike. The Priesstess warned of what would happen to thosse who oppossed her, before calling down holy retribution upon her enemiess, sscorching them from the earthss."
-Seksehsa

e.sanbi-flail.name: Sanbi Flail
e.sanbi-flail.effects: Three-tailed Turtleshell: 10% chance to proc 360 Physical damage
e.sanbi-flail.description: The solid, hard-as-stone weights at the end of the three tails of this flail are made of a material you cannot place. The ephermeral mist surrounding them as they strike only adds to the mystery.

c.fractured-sword-blade.name: Fractured Sword Blade
c.fractured-sword-blade.description: A mysterious blade from an ancient blade, brimming with divine energies...

e.warmage-guardians-shield.name: Warmage Guardian's Shield
e.warmage-guardians-shield.effects:
Magic Shield (Shield): 10% chance to proc 300 Magic damage; +400 damage per Warmage Guardian's set item worn; +10% Crit Damage; +150 HP
Set Bonus (Warmage Guardian's Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +1% Crit Rate
 7+: +500 Defence and +15% Crit Damage
 9+: +20% chance to proc 200 Magic damage with +6% damage from any Magic damage on that proc
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
