e.warmage-guardians-shield.description: How can you protect anyone else if you don't keep yourself safe, first?

e.lesser-ent-wood-plate.name: Lesser Ent Wood-Plate
e.lesser-ent-wood-plate.effects: Ent Smash (Plate): 10% chance to proc 125 Nature damage; +25 damage per Lesser Ent set item worn
e.lesser-ent-wood-plate.description: II. The origin of the Ents was never well explained, but their gentle demeanour, along with their ability to bring forth new life using their magics was something that both rural and urban children could appreciate, and imagine with wonder.

u.script-of-cure-light-exhaustion.name: Script of Cure Light Exhaustion
u.script-of-cure-light-exhaustion.description: "Flow like water and warm like the sun! Cure Light Exhaustion!"
u.script-of-cure-light-exhaustion.effects: Recovers 1 Fainted unit from all active Troops

a.naga-smasher.name: Naga Smasher
a.naga-smasher.description: There is something strangely comforting about troops who run around smashing things. It becomes a little less settling when the running is replaced by slithering.
a.naga-smasher.effects: Adds +1 Attack to all Melee Commanders

m.static-sparks.name: Static Sparks
m.static-sparks.description: The danger of electricity is not just in the pretty bolts of lightning, but in the transfer of energy. Even the most meagre of sparks passes on a charge, and can prove incredibly effective when used in the ideal situation.
m.static-sparks.effects: Static Sparks: 5% chance to proc [up-to-80]% Lightning damage

e.vildmand-platefur-blade.name: Vildmand Platefur Blade
e.vildmand-platefur-blade.effects:
Armored And Algid (Blade): 2011 chance to proc 600 Physical damage; +425 damage per Vildmand Platefur set item worn; +25% Crit Damage; 8% chance to proc 1,000 Physical damage and protect the Player against the Venomous Raid Ability
Set Bonus (Vildmand Platefur Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1.5% Crit Rate and +10% Crit Damage
 6+: +10% Ice Resistance
 7+: +100 HP and +2,000 Defence
 8+: 5% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 20%
 9+: +30% Crit Damage and 75% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 5%
e.vildmand-platefur-blade.description: Perhaps the least-balanced sword you've ever handled, the bloodstains on this blade make clear that it still seems to function for its intended purpose.

e.deathwatch-minder.name: Deathwatch Minder
e.deathwatch-minder.description:
"It's an almost-comedic setup, really. Initiates of the Deathwatch must struggle to develop the energies and magical prowess required to perform their duties, but upon achieving an appropriate rank they are given tools that bolster those very capabilities."
-Vittamar

a.friskfingers-stickyfingers.name: Friskfingers Stickyfingers
a.friskfingers-stickyfingers.description:
"'Unwilling redistribution' is a difficult concept for many, but it's growing in popularity"
-Alula Friskfingers
a.friskfingers-stickyfingers.effects: Adds +3 Attack and +0.1 Defence to Alula Friskfingers and Heren Luckyboot in the active Formation

a.energizing-merman.name: Energizing Merman
a.energizing-merman.description:
"You can't judge a fellow somber by his expression, but only by his actions... Now, Peleg, let's have you and your disciples show our new friend just how you blow off steam!"
-Cyran Jokalyn
a.energizing-merman.effects: Adds +0.3 Defence to Cyran Jokalyn and Peleg in the active Formation

m.alanis-magefire.name: Alanis' Magefire
m.alanis-magefire.description: Enhanced by years of study, this inferno seems singularly capable of taking down a small, bark-covered creature.
m.alanis-magefire.effects: Alanis' Magefire: The Lesser Ent is ablaze! Now is your chance to strike!

e.nepyren-snakewhip.name: Nepyren Snakewhip
e.nepyren-snakewhip.effects: Trollashing: 40% chance to proc 150 Physical damage; +1% Crit Rate; +35% Crit Damage
e.nepyren-snakewhip.description: This blackened, coiled whip seems distinct from those you saw used on farms, and doesn't appear to have a viable handle. It will take some practice to learn how to use this effectively.

c.recursive-funnel.name: Recursive Funnel
c.recursive-funnel.description: Coated in some kind of material - presumably magic - even the stickiest of substances still flow smoothly down this.

c.guild-stone.name: Guild Stone
c.guild-stone.description: A mysterious stone, radiating a charismatic energy that draws people to it. Perhaps you can use this to found your base of operations...

e.naitour-patrol-blade.name: Naitour Patrol Blade
e.naitour-patrol-blade.effects:
Persevering Patrol (Blade): 20% chance to proc 400 Physical damage; +400 damage vs Undead raids; +50 damage per Naitour Patrol set item worn
Set Bonus (Naitour Patrol Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +2 Tiers of 'Prolonged Battle'
e.naitour-patrol-blade.description:
"You look like you've some experience with swords, but you'd still better be careful where you're swinging that thing. I doubt the balance of the blade is the same as your backwoods Erdrean-forged steel."
-Clyburn Softshadow

u.cruel-devils-loot.name: Cruel Devil's Loot
u.cruel-devils-loot.description: The dark ritual required to conjure this bag seems to only work proximal to a Devil's rift being open. You can't help but wonder if that unfortunate fact could be costing you a lucrative revenue source.
u.cruel-devils-loot.effects: Open to obtain its contents (two of the chance drops)

c.fen-lure-bud.name: Fen Lure Bud
c.fen-lure-bud.description: The flowers of the carnivorous plant are said to possess enough sustenance to feed a man for a day, and heal all that ails him at the same time. Not that it'll do much good after he's become fertilizer.

u.blue-gipantan-troop-draft-poster.name: Blue Gipantan Troop Draft Poster
u.blue-gipantan-troop-draft-poster.description: Used to draft Troops to your cause.
u.blue-gipantan-troop-draft-poster.effects: Open to obtain its contents (four of the following)

a.frostwarden-shieldformer.name: Frostwarden Shieldformer
a.frostwarden-shieldformer.description:
"I'd be lying to say we can't bring out the potential in any aspiring mage... At least, any worth training."
-Aisi Tushar
a.frostwarden-shieldformer.effects: Adds +2 Attack and +0.1 Defence to Aisi Tushar in the active Formation

e.servid-ring.name: Servid Ring
e.servid-ring.effects:
Kid's Gaze: 10% chance to proc 12,000 Magic damage; +60 Magic
Set Bonus (Velvet Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +3% All Resistances
e.servid-ring.description: XXII. Naivety was soon rewarded with sheer terror, as significantly larger, and much furrier creature barreled forth, pausing to stand between Brath and the smaller creature, its sharp teeth and large claws readily visible, and Brath was left aghast and stammering in fear, unable to form proper words as he so often was. Inaudibly,

c.blue-elven-cap.name: Blue Elven Cap
c.blue-elven-cap.description: You never understood why ranging parties would wear such... spectacular adornments, but far be it from you to criticize!

cp.void-crystals-one-hundred-special.name: Void Crystals x1100
cp.void-crystals-one-hundred-special.description: A special substantive pack containing the premium currency of the realms.

u.green-entrancement-tonic.name: Green Entrancement Tonic
u.green-entrancement-tonic.description:
"It'll feel like you're in a trance, and you'll-"

"Trance? Aye, what good is a potion if it knocks you out on the battlefield for drinking it?!"

"Err, no, you'll retain full control of your faculties, and your aptitude for magic should increase several fol-"

"Maybe we can hurl'm at the enemy, and see if we can knock them all into trances!"
-A conversation between Nphireo and Rarsik

e.hammerclaw-carapace.name: Hammerclaw Carapace
e.hammerclaw-carapace.effects:
Hammer Pressure (Helm): 5% chance to proc 600 Physical damage; +10000 damage vs Guild Raids; +150 damage per Hammerclaw set item worn
Set Bonus (Hammerclaw Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +0.5 Formation Protection Value
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.hammerclaw-carapace.description: XI. The two boys rushed home, almost falling over eachother to explain what had happened to their mother, who stared at them with an expressionless face. They weren't entirely sure how she was taking the news, until her face darkened.

e.vibrant-helm.name: Vibrant Helm
e.vibrant-helm.effects:
Colours of Creation (Helm): 24% chance to proc 90 Magic damage; +20 Magic damage per Vibrant Victors set item worn; 2% chance to proc 400 Physical damage; +200 Physical damage per Vibrant Victors set item worn
Set Bonus (Vibrant Victors Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +5 Vitality, +5 Energy, +5 Honor and additional bonuses (depending on Main-Hand/Off-Hand equipped)
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.vibrant-helm.description:
"What's the point of 'fitting in' if you can't be your truest self? Well, assuming that self enjoys keeping their head!"
-Cyran Jokalyn

c.red-map-fragment.name: Red Map Fragment
c.red-map-fragment.description: From even this small portion of the map you know it leads to a substantive prize... You cannot seem to puzzle out how the map's colours factor into the route, though.

ba.mythic-banner.name: Mythic Banner
ba.mythic-banner.description: Obtained with the purchase of a Mythic Supporter Pack

c.flaming-nest.name: Flaming Nest
c.flaming-nest.description: While the varied hues and colours are certainly enthralling, you're still left to wonder why this is better ablaze than not.

e.servid-fur.name: Servid Fur
e.servid-fur.effects:
Servid's Service (Fur): 32% chance to proc 45 Magic damage; +625 damage vs Guild Raids; +10 damage per Servid set item worn
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.servid-fur.description: IV. Brath's parents had a short discussion that night, after his mother returned home, followed by a lengthy argument. The raised voices and shouting stirred up uncontrollable emotions within Brath, who screeched and cried and pulled his pillow around his ears in an effort to block out the sound. Mysteriously,

c.spiderling-talisman.name: Spiderling Talisman
c.spiderling-talisman.description: A rare talisman, though whether it is important to the spiders you will never know.

e.oresnatchs-violet-ring.name: Oresnatch's Violet Ring
e.oresnatchs-violet-ring.effects: Vazz's Treasure: 100% chance to proc 250 Magic damage and give +800 Magic on that proc
e.oresnatchs-violet-ring.description: You've seen few rings anywhere near this fine, despite the simplicity in the band. The ring's violet hue shines luminescently in the light.

u.gold-tinged-apple.name: Gold-tinged Apple
u.gold-tinged-apple.description: A rare apple, dropped from the Fachin's sack. You can barely resist the temptation to sink your teeth into it immediately.

c.indigo-cloak.name: Indigo Cloak
c.indigo-cloak.description: A cloak made of fine materials and brilliantly coloured threads... You wonder what led to that creature possessing it.

a.aguil-morassma.name: Aguil Morassma
a.aguil-morassma.description:
"Fanghunters? Yes, we've come across them. I can't say we get along all that well, but I believe our goals still align... more or less."
-Aguil Morassma
a.aguil-morassma.effects: Morassma Venom: 20% chance to proc 3,750 Poison damage; +5,000 damage vs raids with Venomous; +1 tiers of 'Arcane Defence - Venom'; Adds +1 Attack and +0.5 Defence to each Morassma Spear and Morassma Thorn in the Formation; Adds +5% Poison Resistance to the Player

e.baron-aureus-armor.name: Baron Aureus' Armor
e.baron-aureus-armor.effects:
Golden Noble (Armor): 5% chance to proc 1,800 Physical damage; +1,275 damage per Baron Aureus' set item worn; +25 Magic; +20 HP
Set Bonus (Baron Aureus' Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +175 HP and +25% Crit Damage
 6+: +1.5% Crit Rate
 7+: +5% All Resistances
 8+: +1 Tiers of 'Keen Eyes'
 9+: Additional Bonuses depending on Mount equipped
e.baron-aureus-armor.description: A fine blend of embellishment and efficiency, you cannot find anything negative to say about this armor.

e.blazen-swiftslicer-chest.name: Blazen Swiftslicer Chest
e.blazen-swiftslicer-chest.effects:
Glorious Flaming Blades (Chest): 24% chance to proc 900 Fire damage vs Winter raids; +200 Fire damage per Blazen Swiftslicer set item worn; +1.2% Evasion
Set Bonus (Blazen Swiftslicer Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +0.25% Evasion
 9+: +1.75% Evasion
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.blazen-swiftslicer-chest.description: More blades, and now they are superheated. Nothing can go wrong with this combination, right?

e.dokumotsu-vest.name: Dokumotsu Vest
e.dokumotsu-vest.effects: Multipod Spray (Vest): 10% chance to proc 90 Acid damage; +30 damage per Dokumotsu set item worn; +0.5% Crit Rate
e.dokumotsu-vest.description:
"It's said that a hero with a hairy chest is a true hero, indeed.... but no-one said it had to be their own hair on that chest, did they?"
-Mauritio

e.viscous-viscount-algifidrake.name: Viscous Viscount Algifidrake
e.viscous-viscount-algifidrake.effects:
Eccentric Ennoblement (Algifidrake): 12% chance to proc 1,400 Ice damage; +450 damage per Viscous Viscount set item worn; +8% Fire Resistance; +2.5% Evasion
Set Bonus (Viscous Viscount Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1.5% Crit Rate
 6+: +10% Crit Damage
 8+: +150 HP
 9+: +20% Fire Resistance, 33% chance to proc 800 Ice damage with +30% Fire Resistance on that hit
e.viscous-viscount-algifidrake.description: You are ever-appreciative of the custom-made saddle for this large creature, as even accidentally touching its scales sends painful bursts of cold through your flesh.

e.natures-revolt-burgonet.name: Nature's Revolt Burgonet
e.natures-revolt-burgonet.effects:
Scenic Uprising (Burgonet): 19% chance to proc 800 Nature damage; +2,000 damage vs Legendary raids; +525 damage per Nature's Revolt set item worn; +0.5% Evasion; +1% All Resistances; +20% Crit Damage; +25 HP
Set Bonus (Nature's Revolt Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +25% Crit Damage and +2% Crit Rate
 6+: 30% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 10%; +30% vs Easy Raids, and +1% Evasion; +3% Evasion vs Easy Raids
 7+: +5% All Resistances and +150 HP
 8+: 25% chance to reduce incoming damage to your Armies by 20%; +30% vs Legendary Raids, and +1% Crit Rate; +2% Crit Rate vs Legendary Raids
 9+: 3% chance to heal the Player 2 HP; +4 HP healed vs Hard Raids, and +15% Crit Damage; +25% Crit Damage vs Hard Raids
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.natures-revolt-burgonet.description:
"This is one issue you cannot avert you gaze from. Look at the devastation for yourself and understand the outrage."
-Brocck of the Revolt

u.parchment-of-chandlers-light.name: Parchment of Chandler's Light
u.parchment-of-chandlers-light.description: A tattered scroll, describing intense, supernatural potential!

s.scroll-lesser-ent.name: Lesser Tree Ent Scroll
s.scroll-lesser-ent.description: The slow moving Tree Ent is perfect for a beginner to practice on.

c.blue-broken-gipantan-amphora.name: Blue Broken Gipantan Amphora
c.blue-broken-gipantan-amphora.description: A once-beautiful construct, likely intended to contain delicious beverage, seems to have been damaged in the chaos.

a.josian-scolfield.name: Josian Scolfield
a.josian-scolfield.description: An exceptionally wealthy noblewoman, Josian appears to have taken a liking to the Cumberworld folk, and has acted as its patron for some time, now. You are not certain what she stands to gain from it, but one glance at her makes clear that she is not in it as a money-making venture. That said, maybe she is just as crazy as the chicken in her family's sigil?
a.josian-scolfield.effects: Pecunious Hennery: 6% chance to proc 1500 Magic damage; Adds +1 to Eye for Beauty while in the active Formation; Adds +1 to Discerning Vision, Astute Observation and Precise Inspection while in the active Formation

c.red-naaviks-scales.name: Red Naavik's Scales
c.red-naaviks-scales.description: Apparently sea creatures are less prone to shedding their scales than land-based beings: These colourful scales must be exceptionally rare, though you can only hope that rarity translates to value.

e.tedupevair-boots.name: Tedupevair Boots
e.tedupevair-boots.effects:
Fabled Visions (Boots): 8% chance to proc 325 Physical damage; +400 damage per Tedupevair set item worn; 2% chance to proc 3,500 Physical damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 40%
Set Bonus (Tedupevair Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +1 Tiers of 'Eye for Beauty'
 7+: 10% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 25%
 8+: +1 Tiers of 'Attentive Perception'
e.tedupevair-boots.description: It can take some reliable footwear to take you to where the antiquities hide.

u.ill-omens.name: Ill Omens
u.ill-omens.description: The most unfortunate of omens can be the most fortuitous of circumstances, depending upon how you look at it.
u.ill-omens.effects: Increases today's daily raid limit by 4 and restores 50 HP

c.violet-mirgoda-fur.name: Violet Mirgoda Fur
c.violet-mirgoda-fur.description: A tuft of fur from this rare, deadly beast is bound to be worthwhile for those looking to create warm, if smelly, outerwear.

e.tedupevair-staff.name: Tedupevair Staff
e.tedupevair-staff.effects:
Fabled Visions (Staff): 16% chance to proc 250 Physical damage; +250 Physical damage per Tedupevair set item worn; 5% chance to proc 1,500 Physical damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 25%
Set Bonus (Tedupevair Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +1 Tiers of 'Eye for Beauty'
 7+: 10% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 25%
 8+: +1 Tiers of 'Attentive Perception'
e.tedupevair-staff.description: When searching doesn't produce results, you can always resort to summoning rarities to your side.

e.scolfields-regal-mare.name: Scolfield's Regal Mare
e.scolfields-regal-mare.effects:
+30 Vitality; +30 Energy; +30 Honor
Set Bonus (Scolfield Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1 Tiers of 'Discerning Vision', 'Astute Observation' and 'Precise Inspection'
 9+: +1 Tiers of 'Discerning Vision', 'Astute Observation' and 'Precise Inspection'
e.scolfields-regal-mare.description:
"Only the finest of steeds will suffice for our Lady, and she takes a considerable interest in both breaking them in and training them, herself."
-Scolfield Retainer

c.red-tincture.name: Red Tincture
c.red-tincture.description: Once thought to be capable of turning baser metals into gold, the actual properties of this tincture appear to be much more potent. At least, that's what Alanis' awestruck face seemed to suggest.

c.macoli-festival-mark.name: Macoli Festival Mark
c.macoli-festival-mark.description: A token, signifying repeated attendance - and survival! - at the Mortiday festival in Macoli, and worth a fortune to the right people.

u.green-brewmasters-mental-mixture.name: Green Brewmaster's Mental Mixture
u.green-brewmasters-mental-mixture.description:
"The key to creating this potion was found in some of the old writings of the great Blaiscal."
-Nphireo

e.leather-jarl-boots.name: Leather Jarl Boots
e.leather-jarl-boots.effects: Odownsyall!: 15% chance to proc 400 Dark damage; +600 Dark damage vs Dragon raids; +12% Ice Resistance
e.leather-jarl-boots.description: These splendidly crafted boots seem to be made of the finest leathers, fit perfectly upon your feet and keep them blessedly warm. They would be excellent for sneaking around in, until they start yelling in some foreign dialect... From the face Alanis made, you can only suspect the foulest of language is being used, at that.

e.consecrated-leoegan-linothorax.name: Consecrated Leoegan Linothorax
e.consecrated-leoegan-linothorax.effectName: At the Pleasure of the Gods (Linothorax)
e.consecrated-leoegan-linothorax.effects:
At the Pleasure of the Gods (Linothorax): 10% chance to proc 400 Holy damage; +200 damage per Consecrated Leoegan set item worn; 2% chance to proc 1,500 Holy damage
Consecrated
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.consecrated-leoegan-linothorax.description: XXI. Before long, however, Paython was feeling a deep chill, and found himself gasping for air. Looking around, even the great city was but a speck below him, but Paython knew he had to descend. Twisting on the reins to turn the steeds, the stallions turned back to the west, before diving down sharply.

ru.algimannaz-rune-10.name: Algimannaz (ZM) Rune Lv. 10
ru.algimannaz-rune-10.effects:
Can provide one of the following boosts:
-+1235-1237 Defence vs Guild Raids (60%)
-+423-425 Magic (35%)
-+3%-5% All Resistances (5%)

c.green-wooden-shackles.name: Green Wooden Shackles
c.green-wooden-shackles.description: These sturdy shackles were certainly built to keep prisoners from making foolish decisions... Though you suspect the bright colours were equally meant to provoke them in the meantime.

e.consecrated-leoegan-gloves.name: Consecrated Leoegan Gloves
e.consecrated-leoegan-gloves.effectName: At the Pleasure of the Gods (Gloves)
e.consecrated-leoegan-gloves.effects:
At the Pleasure of the Gods (Gloves): 10% chance to proc 400 Holy damage; +200 damage per Consecrated Leoegan set item worn; 2% chance to proc 1,500 Holy damage
Consecrated
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.consecrated-leoegan-gloves.description: XXII. As the ground rapidly approached, the stallions leveled out, but Paython realized something was amiss. He looked behind him, and was nearly blinded by a flaming sphere that was chasing after the chariot. 'Of course,' he thought to himself, 'this chariot pulls the sun... But this is far too low for such a power to be. What have I done?!' Paython could only bemoan the deep scars he was carving in the earth, leaving molten ruin in his wake.

c.elderberry-bushel.name: Elderberry Bushel
c.elderberry-bushel.description: An incredibly rare and oft-sought berry, you feel incredibly fortuitous to have come across this bushel. You expect it could make a terrific lure to find some unusual game.

e.mordant-moswas-orb.name: Mordant Moswa's Orb

For all of his experience and studies, and all of his talents in the arcane arts, Brath recognized that he was still unable to overcome a simple truth of the world: Basic economics. Protecting the arcane energies in those forests that still possessed them, and attempting to spread the potency of the earth was all well and good, but researching how to do so further, faster and more effectively took funding, and for that reason he had agreed to take on this teaching position at the Sunbringer Institute. e.mirays-signet-ring.description: VIII. Miray saw the looming figure approach, glaring down at her through his visored helm, amusement plain in his eyes as he drew back the trident to deliver the death blow. Miray struggled to get her feet under her, losing her grip on her club in the process, but she could not shake the weight of the net that had anchored itself atop her. Knowing her death was imminent, Miray pushed beyond anything she had previously known, and felt time slow as the trident came bearing down. She glanced to her sides and could see that the weights on the net were loosening from the dirt and realization dawned upon her as she simultaneously grabbed the rear head of her club, knowing what her only hope would be. Abruptly pushing herself to her feet, she felt the prongs of the spear strike down the side of her mail and gouge open her leg as it passed by her, while she shoved the handle of the club up, through the woven netting and into the slit of her opponent’s visor, until she heard a metallic clank.

Sinderklaz Vrolik (Pants): 25% chance to proc 400 Magic damage; +30 HP; +40 Energy; +100 Magic damage per Sinderklaz set item worn
Set Bonus (Sinderklaz Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +200 HP, +30% Magic Resistance and +25% Ice Resistance
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.sinderklaz-pants.description: Holding them up, you were certain these pants were far too large to fit around your waist. As you put them on your skepticism fades, as it appears that they are a perfect fit for you. After a few moments, you are somewhat unsettled, unsure if the pants shrunk to fit your frame, or if your frame grew to fit the pants...

c.shard-of-radiance.name: Shard of Radiance
c.shard-of-radiance.description:
"Demons? I can't say I've seen anything like that up in these parts. Maybe you're right and it has something to do with these shards... Oh, why didn't I point this out before? Maybe we were a little busy stopping an enormous ice dragon from devastating the continent?"
-Bellas Inahice

e.vyldas-supplicant-gugel.name: Vylda's Supplicant Gugel
e.vyldas-supplicant-gugel.effects:
Glorious Bloodfeast (Gugel): 12% chance to proc 520 Dark damage, turning Dark Resistance into Weakness for this proc; +765 damage per Vylda's Supplicant set item worn; +100 Magic; +0.2% Crit Rate

Set Bonus (Vylda's Supplicant Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1% Crit Rate and +10% Crit Damage
 6+: +3 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Dark' and +2,000 Magic
 7+: 1% chance to deal 25,000 Dark damage; +15% Crit Damage
 8+: +1.5% Crit Rate, and 1% chance of healing the Player +13 HP alongside -75% Formation Bonus on proc
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.vyldas-supplicant-gugel.description:
"She may not support your destruction of her kin, but she has less love for those spectral beings. My Lady has commanded us to work with you to see the common threat defeated."
-Illiana Bloodletter

a.maansik-khudon.name: Maansik Khudon
a.maansik-khudon.description:
"Well, it's not as though the current owners are making use of it. Besides, just think of what all those brainy academic-types will be able to do with what we find... and what we can charge'm for it!"
-Maansik Khudon
a.maansik-khudon.effects: Scrounger's Strike: 4% chance to proc 600 Dark damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 20%;  Adds +1 Defence to each Sepulcher Seeker Goblin, Sepulcher Seeker Orc and Sepulcher Seeker Dwarf in the Formation

e.tedupevair-bow.name: Tedupevair Bow
e.tedupevair-bow.effects:
Fabled Visions (Bow): 16% chance to proc 250 Physical damage; +250 Physical damage per Tedupevair set item worn; 5% chance to proc 1,500 Physical damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 25%
Set Bonus (Tedupevair Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +1 Tiers of 'Eye for Beauty'
 7+: 10% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 25%
 8+: +1 Tiers of 'Attentive Perception'
e.tedupevair-bow.description: What better way to showcase your pin-point, precise vision than to unerringly strike it from afar.

m.irus-love.name: Irus' Love
m.irus-love.description:
"It is said that Irus is the patron of unconditional love, and that only when His veil adorns the sky can your true feelings be known."

"Perhaps, but that love doesn't seem to extend to demonkind, does it?"

"Certainly not, for their existence is an affront to the love that He seeks to protect. That said, it seems someone may be waiting for you..."
-Conversations with Mauritio, gesturing to your companion a short distance away.
m.irus-love.effects: Irus' Love: 7% chance to proc [up-to-50]% Holy damage; Bonus [up-to-200]% damage vs Demon raids; Bonus [up-to-100]% damage vs Demon raids if Amera's Anger is also casted on the Raid

e.earthshaker-reflex-sabatons.name: Earthshaker Reflex Sabatons
e.earthshaker-reflex-sabatons.effects:
Crude Reflex (Sabatons): 5% chance to proc 2,000 Physical damage; +1,000 damage per Earthshaker Reflex set item worn; 2% chance to proc 20,000 Physical damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 50%
Set Bonus (Earthshaker Reflex Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: 10% chance to proc 2,500 Physical damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 15%, +1 Tiers of 'Insurmountable Offence' and +1 Tiers of 'Unyielding Defence'
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.earthshaker-reflex-sabatons.description:
"The padded feet of the Earthshaker are toughened from years of carrying its enormous weight. Interestingly, the pad of the foot is actually quite soft to the touch. Is the same true of those boots you're wearing?"
-Janagud

e.psyguard-bulwark-shield.name: Psyguard Bulwark Shield
e.psyguard-bulwark-shield.effects:
Guardian's Mind (Shield): 15% chance to proc 800 Psychic damage; +400 damage per Psyguard Bulwark set item worn; +75 HP; +5% All Resistances
Set Bonus (Psyguard Bulwark Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +10 Max HP on all Commanders and +10 Reserve Cap on all Troops
6: +1% Crit Rate and +15% Crit Damage
 7+: +10 Reserve Cap on all Troops and +1,000 Defence
 8+: 10% chance to reduce damage to your Armies by 50%
 9+: +1 Formation Protection Value
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.psyguard-bulwark-shield.description:
"It is the job of the leader to be the bulwark that protects their people. Too many have forgotten this, or worse: Have reversed it entirely."
-Alaion Torris

c.mark-of-the-skeletal-beast.name: Mark of the Skeletal Beast
c.mark-of-the-skeletal-beast.description: Death is no bar to those who can call back this terrifying beast.

e.nyxifur-cap.name: Nyxifur Cap
e.nyxifur-cap.effects:
Slowly Unsteady (Cap): 8% chance to proc 500 Nature damage; +250 damage per Nyxifur set item worn; +0.5% Evasion
Set Bonus (Nyxifur Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +30% Crit Damage
 7+: +2% Crit Rate
 9+: +140 HP
e.nyxifur-cap.description:
"Yes... that cap will do nicely."
-Conversations with Corros Glorymuth, before he begins a deep chuckle.

c.sickly-northern-twigs.name: Sickly Northern Twigs
c.sickly-northern-twigs.description: Strangely firm twigs, covered in sickly marks, it is unclear what manner of power - supernatural or otherwise - seems to keep them together.

e.cumberworld-benefactors-ruby.name: Cumberworld Benefactor's Ruby
e.cumberworld-benefactors-ruby.effects:
+45 Vitality; +45 Energy; +45 Honor
Set Bonus (Cumberworld Benefactor Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1 Tiers of 'Discerning Vision', 'Astute Observation' and 'Precise Inspection'
 7+: +1 Tiers of 'Keen Eyes'
 8+: +100 Energy
 9+: +1 Tiers of 'Discerning Vision', 'Astute Observation' and 'Precise Inspection'
e.cumberworld-benefactors-ruby.description:
"If it aids my beneficiaries, and keeps such a low quality piece off my fingers... Well, all the better."
-Lady Josian Scolfield

e.frostwarden-chest.name: Frostwarden Chest
e.frostwarden-chest.effects:
Arctic Aegis (Chest): 10% chance to proc 560 Ice damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 14%; +80 Ice damage per Frostwarden set item worn
Set Bonus (Frostwarden Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: 20% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 25%
e.frostwarden-chest.description: Amusingly, despite the exterior of this armor chilling your fingers as you started donning it, the interior is amongst the warmest and most comforting attire you've ever worn.

c.kyllis-retired-shield.name: Kylli's Retired Shield
c.kyllis-retired-shield.description: A simple and dated shield, you imagine it has seen more adventuring that you could ever expect to.

e.millennium-island-bascinet.name: Millennium Island Bascinet
e.millennium-island-bascinet.effects:
Last Everlasting (Bascinet): 30% chance to proc 200 Nature damage; +150 damage per Millennium Island set item worn; +20 HP; +2% All Resistances
Set Bonus (Millennium Island Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +100 HP, +1 Tiers of 'Immoveable Object' and +1 Tiers of 'Hearty Constitution'
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.millennium-island-bascinet.description: Arguably the thinnest eye-slit you've ever experienced in a helm, your appreciation for the protection this bascinet offers is attenuated by the impact it has upon your field of vision.

a.orc-packraider-lauder.name: Orc Packraider Lauder
a.orc-packraider-lauder.description: As strong as these Packraiders seem to be, it seems that it still doesn't hurt to cheer eachother on.
a.orc-packraider-lauder.effects: Adds +2 Attack to all Orc Commanders

u.lesser-fire-resilience-potion.name: Lesser Fire Resilience Potion
u.lesser-fire-resilience-potion.description: A thinly brewed potion that tastes faintly of cayenne...

u.thiadoran-energy-barrel.name: Thiadoran Energy Barrel
u.thiadoran-energy-barrel.description: A large barrel, containing several bottles'-worth of fine Thiadoran vintage. You only hope nothing got mixed up during packaging.
u.thiadoran-energy-barrel.effects: Open to obtain its contents (ten of the chance drops)

c.rune-adorned-golemstone.name: Rune-Adorned Golemstone
c.rune-adorned-golemstone.description: A large piece of the magic-infused stone used to create the golem, you can still feel energy pulsing off of the remaining runes.

s.scroll-xoggen.name: Xoggen Scroll
s.scroll-xoggen.description: It seems the demons' hellfire is not quenched even by the ocean's depths.

u.officials-elixir.name: Official's Elixir
u.officials-elixir.description: An elixir possessing the prowess of the most qualified officials, capable of expanding your mind to new horizons.

u.yellow-naven-troop-draft-poster.name: Yellow Naven Troop Draft Poster
u.yellow-naven-troop-draft-poster.description: Used to draft Troops to your cause.

k.arcane-concentration.name: Arcane Concentration
k.arcane-concentration.effects: Increases your Magic stat by +x% for y minutes.

u.restoration-potion.name: Restoration Potion
u.restoration-potion.description: This large potion seems uncharacteristically cool to the touch, but leave a pleasant tingle on your tongue as you drink it down. After you mention this to Alanis, her look of concern is quite troubling.

a.tralen-boldkind.name: Tralen Boldkind
a.tralen-boldkind.description: While he may not be the bulkiest of protectors, the nimbleness and boundless energy exerted by this heavily-plated gnome, particularly as he seems capable of dancing through the battle and protecting dozens of your people, make you quite happy that he is on your side.
a.tralen-boldkind.effects: Guardian Gnome: 40% chance to proc 1,500 Physical damage; 2% chance to proc 10,000 Physical damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 25%; Adds +5 Attack and +0.4 Defence to each Construct Troop in the Formation; Adds +0.2 Defence to every Commander in the active Formation

cp.bard-starter-pack-ii.name: Bard Starter Pack II
cp.bard-starter-pack-ii.description: A pack providing the necessary tools for every budding bard.

e.laurentian-pants.name: Laurentian Pants
e.laurentian-pants.effects: Powerless Prey (Pants): 45% chance to proc 120 Dark damage; +850 damage versus Human raids; +4% Psychic Resistance
e.laurentian-pants.description:
"Perhaps, in your condition, you might wish to consider not leaping into the middle of the fray...?"

"Right. Try to stay fray-adjacent. Got it."
-Conversation with Corovar

e.vibrant-corseque.name: Vibrant Corseque
e.vibrant-corseque.effects:
Colours of Creation (Corseque): 20% chance to proc 240 Fire damage; +20 Fire damage per Vibrant Victors set item worn; 3% chance to proc 800 Fire damage; +150 Fire damage per Vibrant Victors set item worn
Set Bonus (Vibrant Victors Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +5 Vitality, +60 Energy, +5 Honor and +4% Crit Rate
e.vibrant-corseque.description:
"Well, that's quite the hot rod you're packing!"
-Cyran Jokalyn

u.platinum-entrancement-tonic.name: Platinum Entrancement Tonic
u.platinum-entrancement-tonic.description:
"It'll feel like you're in a trance, and you'll-"

"Trance? Aye, what good is a potion if it knocks you out on the battlefield for drinking it?!"

"Err, no, you'll retain full control of your faculties, and your aptitude for magic should increase several fol-"

"Maybe we can hurl'm at the enemy, and see if we can knock them all into trances!"
-A conversation between Nphireo and Rarsik

e.quilltips-cap.name: Quilltip's Cap
e.quilltips-cap.effects:
Set Bonus (Quilltip's Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +40 Magic and +1 Tiers of 'Attentive Perception'
e.quilltips-cap.description: I. The life of an apprentice was rarely one of greatness, accolades or riches, but the life of a scribe... well, that was even less so. At least the apprentice had the opportunity to learn the master's skills and expand upon their own. Loric Quilltip had thought these depressing thoughts a dozen times over in the past few days, ever since being promoted from the lowly role of assistant to helping out with his new master's campaign. Worst of all, he was stuck in the presence of politicians, day in and day out.

a.tansy-croftfield.name: Tansy Croftfield
a.tansy-croftfield.description:
"We may not have those giant, sprawling fields you Edreans are known for, but that just means we've got to travel between the fields, carrying the hauls with us. It certainly doesn't help when we're set upon by flaming helldemons, or orcish bullies!"
-Tansy Croftfield
a.tansy-croftfield.effects: Farmer's Mother: 10% chance to proc 1,400 Physical damage

e.fanghunters-leather-pants.name: Fanghunter's Leather Pants
e.fanghunters-leather-pants.effects:
Poison Pursuit (Leather Pants): +0.2% Crit Rate
Set Bonus (Fanghunter's Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: 10% chance to proc 1350 Magic damage and protect the Player from the Venomous Raid Ability
e.fanghunters-leather-pants.description:
"My ascendance rites to the rank of Fangsheath involved tracking down and slaying a Hydra in the Celelfen Swamp. It was said to have been one of the most challenging trials in living memory. Did you know that, despite their appearances, Hydras are not actually dragons, but are more closely related to serpents?"
-Jadael Fangsheath

c.geristainian-bean.name: Geristainian Bean
c.geristainian-bean.description: Fancy beans for such a plain region, you've heard that some local traders may be looking for such a novelty.

e.reodai-disc.name: Reodai Disc
e.reodai-disc.effects:
Reodai's Seclusion: 6% chance to proc 4,000 Dark damage; +1,500 damage per Reodai set item worn; +50 HP; +2% Evasion; +2% Crit Rate
Set Bonus (Reodai Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +60% Crit Damage and 4% chance to proc 8,500 Dark damage with +60% Crit Rate and -30% Formation Bonus on that hit
e.reodai-disc.description:
"Dessspite your role amongssst your sssubordinatesss, you mussst not hold yourssself apart. Walking the path alone isss a sssurefire method to hinder your growth."
-Lokakshi Coilbreaker

cp.bard-starter-pack-iv.name: Bard Starter Pack IV
cp.bard-starter-pack-iv.description: A pack providing the necessary materials for every budding bard.

c.green-cracked-hammer.name: Green Cracked Hammer
c.green-cracked-hammer.description: Years of use have cracked the head of this hammer... you have no idea what has led to the colouration, however.

ru.algeihwaz-rune-1.name: Algeihwaz (Zei) Rune Lv. 1
ru.algeihwaz-rune-1.effects:
Can provide one of the following boosts:
-+5-6 Defence (50%)
-+3-4 Max HP (50%)

e.earthshaker-reflex-gloves.name: Earthshaker Reflex Gloves
e.earthshaker-reflex-gloves.effects:
Crude Reflex (Gloves): 5% chance to proc 2,000 Physical damage; +1,000 damage per Earthshaker Reflex set item worn; 2% chance to proc 20,000 Physical damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 50%
Set Bonus (Earthshaker Reflex Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: 10% chance to proc 2,500 Physical damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 15%, +1 Tiers of 'Insurmountable Offence' and +1 Tiers of 'Unyielding Defence'
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.earthshaker-reflex-gloves.description: Assuming you don't need to manipulate individual fingers, or hold small objects, the protection these gloves offer seems second-to-none.

e.yotinpekew-offshoot.name: Yotinpekew Offshoot
e.yotinpekew-offshoot.effects:
Storm Scalping (Offshoot): 15% chance to proc 200 Nature damage; +150 damage per Yotinpekew set item worn; +0.75% Crit Rate; +5% Nature Resistance
Set Bonus (Yotinpekew Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +1.5% Crit Rate
 8+: +35% Crit Damage and +0.75% Crit Rate
 9+: +1 Tiers of 'Arcane Defence - Flamebreath'
e.yotinpekew-offshoot.description: Some prefer to wait for the storm. Others make a storm of their own. Still, it's wiser to do so with a tool that isn't like to leave its wielder struck down by their own lightning.

u.warmage-starter-pack-i.name: Warmage Starter Pack I
u.warmage-starter-pack-i.description: A pack providing the necessary goods for every budding warmage.

c.orange-vedfollen-feather.name: Orange Vedfollen Feather
c.orange-vedfollen-feather.description: This strange feather is unfamiliar to you, but Mauritio practically falls over himself to see it as you tentatively hold it. Apparently, it comes from a mythical bird, long thought to have been merely a creature of legend, and known for its immense size. Some say that it was so large that its ability to fly was plainly impossible. You suspect that someone could find a use for such a feather.

c.military-guide-book.name: Military Guide Book
c.military-guide-book.description: There is little point to re-inventing the wheel, and learning from the experience of those military commanders who came before you just makes good sense.

e.smugglers-cap.name: Smuggler's Cap
e.smugglers-cap.effects:
River's Bounty (Cap): 8% chance to proc 100 Physical damage; +75 damage per Smuggler's set item worn
Set Bonus (Smuggler's Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +2 Tiers of 'Evasive Maneuvers'
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.smugglers-cap.description: It pays to be nondescript, but it also pays to keep the sun from beating down upon your head.

e.crestaceo-shield.name: Crestaceo Shield
e.crestaceo-shield.effects: Carapace Crush (Shield): 16% chance to proc 50 Physical damage; +1,250 damage vs Guild Raids; +25 damage per Crestaceo set item worn
e.crestaceo-shield.description: VI. The three boys would spend hours in play, pretending they were great warriors fighting imaginary wars, or valiant heroes staving off vicious monsters and protecting the innocents. The stories differ on the specific ages of the boys, but all were clear that it was frequently the youngest brother relocated to playing the role of the nefarious invaders, or the vicious beasts.

e.paresthisy-club.name: Paresthisy Club
e.paresthisy-club.effects:
Existential Experiencing (Club): 10% chance to proc 600 Psychic damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 20%; +400 damage per Paresthisy set item worn; +100 Magic
Set Bonus (Paresthisy Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +1 Tiers of 'Eye for Beauty'
 8+: +1 Tiers of 'Eye for Beauty'
e.paresthisy-club.description: A surprisingly simple club, or so you think until you feel a strange aura emanating from it. Perhaps the bright hues add something special to it?

a.bogwalker-orc.name: Bogwalker Orc
a.bogwalker-orc.description: You've dealt with tacit and stoic individuals, but the life seems to have drained from this poor soul. Perhaps the swamps take more than just one's stamina?
a.bogwalker-orc.effects: Adds +3 Attack and +0.2 Defence to Sharog in the active Formation

c.green-faecage.name: Green Faecage
c.green-faecage.description: This colourful cage may seem quite typical to you, but once your fingers get near the door and you feel an unseen pressure preventing you from unlatching it, you realize it was clearly made to keep things in, while keeping other things out.

cp.ranger-starter-pack-iii.name: Ranger Starter Pack III
cp.ranger-starter-pack-iii.description: A pack providing the necessary equipment for every budding ranger.

a.plasma-guild-guardian.name: Plasma Guild Guardian
a.plasma-guild-guardian.description: Further enhancing its capabilities with various elemental magics, this guardian emits an eerie, pulsating glow as it patrols its sector.

a.josian-scolfield-cumberworld-benefacto.name: Josian Scolfield, Cumberworld Benefactor
a.josian-scolfield-cumberworld-benefacto.description: Speaking from experience, you can't fault someone for doubling-down on an endeavour that is important to them. Still, you're curious what benefits this noble is getting to warrant being the official benefactor of this wandering festival.
a.josian-scolfield-cumberworld-benefacto.effects: Pecunious Pasture: 6% chance to proc 12,500 Magic damage; Adds +1 to Eye for Beauty and +1 to Attentive Perception while in the active Formation; Adds +1 to Discerning Vision, Astute Observation and Precise Inspection while in the active Formation

u.sentinel-starter-pack-iv.name: Sentinel Starter Pack IV
u.sentinel-starter-pack-iv.description: A pack providing the necessary material for every budding sentinel.

u.blue-guard-tonic.name: Blue Guard Tonic
u.blue-guard-tonic.description: Originally concocted to keep him safe during his forays into the forest, Nphireo was oblivious to his creation's market-potential until a friend saw an ogre break a club harmlessly over Nphireo's head.

e.heroic-dusk-darts.name: Heroic Dusk Darts
e.heroic-dusk-darts.effects:
Evil's Dimday (Darts): 5% chance to proc 3,000 Physical damage; +1,500 Physical damage per Heroic Dusk set item worn; +1.5% Crit Rate; +20% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Heroic Dusk Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +3% Crit Rate and +25% Crit Damage
 8+: 4% chance to heal the Player 2 HP
 9+: +15% Formation Bonus and 10% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 30%
e.heroic-dusk-darts.description:
"The capability to deliver precise strikes into the heart of the enemy's lines is instrumental in sowing the seeds of their inevitable defeat."
-Sir Tybalt

e.moswa-fur.name: Moswa Fur
e.moswa-fur.effects:
Palmate Overpower (Fur): 25% chance to proc 480 Magic damage; +6000 damage vs Guild Raids; +120 damage per Moswa set item worn; 6% chance to proc 2400 Nature damage; +200 damage per Moswa set item worn
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.moswa-fur.description: IV(a). Cenius' followers mocked the woman as she nearly fell, and Cenius reveled in the attention. His grin dropped, however, when he heard something, and realized the hag was muttering something, in a language that Cenius could not place. As Cenius leaned to attempt to better hear what she was saying, she turned and a blinding light flew from her hands, striking Cenius in the chest. When Cenius next awoke, he was in his own bed, seemingly in fair health - if weak - but adorned by a terrible, discoloured mark that spread up from the site of his wound, across his face.

u.yellow-codex-of-wisdom.name: Yellow Codex of Wisdom
u.yellow-codex-of-wisdom.description: Every now and again a rare gem among literature appears, conveying experience beyond its ken, capable of both inspiring future generations to greatness and reminding them of the lessons of history. The wisdom delivered by such works is invaluable, and should never be taken for granted.

c.avian-lure.name: Avian Lure
c.avian-lure.description: Something to whet the appetite of carnivorous fowl.

u.sentinel-starter-pack-ii.name: Sentinel Starter Pack II
u.sentinel-starter-pack-ii.description: A pack providing the necessary tools for every budding sentinel.

e.daduh-hyla.name: Daduh Hyla
e.daduh-hyla.effects:
Long Leapfrog: 30% chance to proc 675 Nature damage vs Insect raids; 3% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 50%
Set Bonus (Byhew Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 8+: +3% Crit Rate and +30% Crit Damage
e.daduh-hyla.description: After everything else you've encountered, you cannot claim surprise at seeing enormous frogs, large enough to be ridden. At least it seems hungry for giant insects.

u.psychic-resilience-potion.name: Psychic Resilience Potion
u.psychic-resilience-potion.description: A thick, viscous brew, which leaves a distinct aftertaste of nutmeg.

e.mordant-moswas-wand.name: Mordant Moswa's Wand
e.mordant-moswas-wand.effects: Acidic Antlers (Wand): 25% chance to proc 2,080 Magic damage; +10,000 damage vs Guild Raids; +320 damage per Mordant Moswa set item worn; 6% chance to proc 6000 Nature damage; +1000 damage per Mordant Moswa set item worn; 25% chance to proc 400 Acid damage; +150 damage per Mordant Moswa set item worn; +400 Magic
e.mordant-moswas-wand.description: I. "But even you can see how swapping the natural element for these reagents would improve the yield severalfold... Sir." Brath Hartwood closed his eyes and inhaled deeply, wondering why he had agreed to such an arrangement as teaching, of all things, and paused before turning to face the second-year acolyte. "The yield was never in question... the issue is, and always was, the byproducts of the reaction. Which, if you'd done the reading I had assigned, you'd know are exceedingly volatile. So, through your 'improved' efforts to enhance the capacity for sustainable agriculture in urban environments you'd be more like than not to level a city block/." Brath's calm tone did little to brace the student from the weight of his words, and Brath noticed one of the first-year acolytes in the corner - Luciani, he believed - chuckling quietly at the retort.

u.blue-guild-kit-v.name: Blue Guild Kit V
u.blue-guild-kit-v.description: A small, tidy sack, purporting to carry goods from the same source Slygse gets her alchemical wares.
u.blue-guild-kit-v.effects: Open to obtain its contents (three of the chance drops)

c.nebekinessurs-secret-tome.name: Nebekinessur's Secret Tome
c.nebekinessurs-secret-tome.description: The secret writings of Nebekinessur, detailing his most intricate and darkest research. You feel a sense of unease even holding such knowledge, and want to mentally prepare yourself before you consider flipping open its pages.

e.sunbringers-robes.name: Sunbringer's Robes
e.sunbringers-robes.effects:
Set Bonus (Sunbringer Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +150 Magic

"Sometimes the strongest defence is knowing how and where to strike back, to prevent any future conflict."
-Warpriest Orghash
a.chaunaths-warpriests-blitzer.effects: Adds +4 Attack and +0.2 Defence to Warpriest Orghash and Warpriest Emmus in the active Formation

e.veiled-griphornis-sickles.name: Veiled Griphornis Sickles
e.veiled-griphornis-sickles.effects:
Penumbra Plumage (Sickles): 8% chance to proc 5,500 Physical damage; +31,250 damage vs Guild Raids; +1000 damage per Veiled Griphornis set item worn; 25% chance to proc 400 Dark damage; +150 damage per Veiled Griphornis set item worn; +2% Crit Rate
Set Bonus (Veiled Griphornis Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +110% Crit Damage

e.claws-of-justice-feline.name: Claws of Justice Feline
e.claws-of-justice-feline.effects:
Hooked Hearing (Feline): 10% chance to proc 800 Holy damage; +450 damage per Claws of Justice set item worn; +5% Formation Bonus; +1% Crit Rate
Set Bonus (Claws of Justice Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +25% Formation Bonus and +1 Tiers of 'Experienced Leader'
e.claws-of-justice-feline.description:
"I wonder if, like many felines, this creature has a fickle sense of judgement. For all of its naming relating to justice, it might deem you unjust if you're late to feed it a midday meal?"
-Janagud

e.blazebrand-steamcart.name: Blazebrand Steamcart
e.blazebrand-steamcart.effects:
Justice by any Flames Necessary (Steamcart): 25% chance to proc 400 Fire damage with +22% Crit Damage on that hit; +350 damage per Blazebrand set item worn; 4% chance to proc 1,200 Fire damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 20%; +1,100 damage per Blazebrand set item worn; +18% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Blazebrand Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 8+: +2.5% Crit Rate
 9+: 40% chance to proc 250 Fire damage, +8 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Fire' and +1 Tiers of 'Insurmountable Offence'
e.blazebrand-steamcart.description: Unlike any other cart you've ever seen, this device is apparently capable of moving of its own volition, fueled by steam generated using the magical runes within. The armored exterior certainly seems promising, but you wonder if it could hinder your ability to view the field of battle.

e.warmage-guardians-band.name: Warmage Guardian's Band
e.warmage-guardians-band.effects:
+0.5% Evasion; +5% All Resistances; +5% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Warmage Guardian's Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +1% Crit Rate
 7+: +500 Defence and +15% Crit Damage
 9+: +20% chance to proc 200 Magic damage with +6% damage from any Magic damage on that proc
e.warmage-guardians-band.description: A little magical protection goes a long way. Especially when your patrons seem equally content blasting you alongside the things you're saving them from.

a.adroits-psychic-guardian.name: Adroit's Psychic Guardian
a.adroits-psychic-guardian.description:
"Who better to guard the Guild than one which is capable of knowing both your wishes, and the intentions of new arrivals, without needing to ask?"
-Adroit
a.adroits-psychic-guardian.effects: Adds +2 Attack to Adroit, Guardian Command in the active Formation

c.cured-leather-wrappings.name: Cured Leather Wrappings
c.cured-leather-wrappings.description: With the dark burns your forces are suffering, you need something stronger than cloth to bandage the wounded.

u.thiadoran-vitality-cask.name: Thiadoran Vitality Cask
u.thiadoran-vitality-cask.description: A small container with a few bottles of fine, Thiadoran vintage. Surely no-one could botch up what is supposed to go in here, right?
u.thiadoran-vitality-cask.effects: Open to obtain its contents (three of the chance drops)

a.alanis.name: Alanis
a.alanis.description: A trained - though inexperienced - mage, Alanis has become an invaluable travelling companion and asset in your fight against the Void. Her ego may well be a match for your own, but the knowledge she shares about the arcane and mystic forces at work has proven her worth a thousandfold over.
a.alanis.effects: Compatriot Magefire: 10% chance to proc 200 Fire damage

u.script-of-mass-heal.name: Script of Mass Heal
u.script-of-mass-heal.description: "Bless the prayer and deliver your graceful mercy! Mass Heal!"

c.soggy-boot.name: Soggy Boot
c.soggy-boot.description: You could feel the heat flushing your cheeks when you managed to reel in this sodden boot, but the fishermen assured you it was part of a special prize, and that you were actually a victor. Their smirks left you moderately unconvinced...

e.rusted-leoegan-helmet.name: Rusted Leoegan Helmet
e.rusted-leoegan-helmet.effects:
Rusty Jawlocking (Helmet): 5% chance to proc 400 Physical damage
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.rusted-leoegan-helmet.description: I. The Thiadoran tales of the various demons and villains plaguing their ancient lands are numerous and varied, though many seem to agree that the origination of the demons in the lands was the fault of Paython.

e.painted-fae-buckler.name: Painted Fae Buckler
e.painted-fae-buckler.effects:
Fairy D-Lights: 10% chance to proc 500 Dark damage; +8% Psychic Resistance
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.painted-fae-buckler.description:
"Small shield. Protects body some. Protects head some."
-Kurdan

a.arena-selkie.name: Arena Selkie
a.arena-selkie.description: These doe-eyed Fae are undeniably cute, between their whiskered faces and puffed noses. You aren't entirely sure what Nereus would have them doing in the Arena, but you know you have no desire to track him down to ask...

ba.eldritch-knight-banner.name: Eldritch Knight Banner
ba.eldritch-knight-banner.description: Obtained with the Eldritch Knight Class

e.bow-of-the-buried.name: Bow of the Buried
e.bow-of-the-buried.effects: Stayed Down: 1% chance to proc 38,000 Dark damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 100%; +2.5% Crit Rate
e.bow-of-the-buried.description: You are certainly less-than-thrilled at being made to feel like a paltry guard for Maansik and his crew of excavators, but any opportunity to ensure that what belongs in the ground stays in the ground can't be all bad.

u.script-of-sacred-embers.name: Script of Sacred Embers
u.script-of-sacred-embers.description: "Rain down your gentle radiance! Sacred Embers!"

e.snowdrake-slayer-helm.name: Snowdrake Slayer Helm
e.snowdrake-slayer-helm.effects:
Walking in a Winter Wasteland (Helm): 10% chance to proc 400 Physical damage; +1,250 damage vs Winter raids; +750 damage vs Dragon raids; +5% Ice Resistance; +75 damage per Snowdrake Slayer set item worn
Set Bonus (Snowdrake Slayer Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +2% Crit Rate and +30% Crit Damage
e.snowdrake-slayer-helm.description: You can appreciate that the protective plating on this helmet is carefully lined with cloth.

c.living-pillars.name: Living Pillars
c.living-pillars.description: What better structure to use in erecting a camp than one that moves of its own accord... right?

a.seathan-scurra.name: Seathan Scurra
a.seathan-scurra.description: Seathan's order is amongst the most devout you've ever seen, and his praise to Shonos is best likened to a battle-cry on the field. You cannot say you've ever seen a cleric so well-muscled, but you've seen his heals pack just as much of a wallop as his punches.
a.seathan-scurra.effects: Adds +5 Energy and +5 Vitality to the Player

e.song-of-radiance-orb.name: Song of Radiance Orb
e.song-of-radiance-orb.effects:
Brilliant Song (Orb): 24% chance to proc 400 Magic damage; +75 damage per Song of Radiance set item worn; +100 Magic
Set Bonus (Song of Radiance Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +1500 Magic and +1 Tiers of 'Arcane Unveiling'
e.song-of-radiance-orb.description:
"No, this does not come from... that... part of the Songbird. Don't you know the first thing about birds?"
-Janagud

a.half-ent-herbalist.name: Half-Ent Herbalist
a.half-ent-herbalist.description: Looking more Ent than human, apart from their size there are no obvious signs that these are not direct relatives of the Ents that you've faced. Their hard, bark-like skin seems to be harder to pierce than most armors, but their strength seems to lie in their capabilities in the healing arts.

e.chaunaths-warpriests-cuisses.name: Chaunath's Warpriests Cuisses
e.chaunaths-warpriests-cuisses.effects:
Shield of Deities (Cuisses): 8% chance to proc 1,175 Magic damage; +1,025 damage per Chaunath's Warpriests set item worn; +2% Crit Damage; +100 Magic; 5% chance to reduce incoming damage to your Armies by 20%
Sanctified
Set Bonus (Chaunath's Warpriests Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: 5% chance on 20x attacks to heal each active Troop +1 Reserve
 6+: +2% Crit Rate and +15% Crit Damage
 7+: 4% chance on 20x attacks to heal each active Commander +2 HP
 8+: +15% Formation Bonus and 10% chance to reduce incoming damage to your armies by 30%
 9+: 4% chance on 20x attacks to heal each active Troop +3 Reserves and proc 8% of your Leadership stat in Holy damage
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.chaunaths-warpriests-cuisses.description:
"Carry the weight of Chaunath's blessings as you press ahead, for when you finally meet Her you will want to do so with your head held high."
-Warprist Orghash

m.reodai-mikyou.name: Reodai Mikyou
m.reodai-mikyou.description:
"Inner peace is not about silencing the troubles within you, but rather about balancing the internal forces that are at-odds with eachother and accepting them as part of your being."
-Jinna Brightwhisper
m.reodai-mikyou.effects: Reodai Mikyou: 12% chance to proc [up-to-70]% Magic damage; +33% Magic damage for each Reodai set Mount equipped

e.picaroons-gloves.name: Picaroon's Gloves
e.picaroons-gloves.effects:
Swabby Sealover (Gloves): 8% chance to proc 200 Physical damage; +50 damage per Picaroon's Raiments set item worn; +400 damage vs Human raids; +0.25% Crit Rate
Set Bonus (Picaroon's Raiment Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +2% Crit Rate
 7+: +25% Crit Damage
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.picaroons-gloves.description: Anything to help prevent more rope-burn on your hands is appreciated.

e.mirays-embrace.name: Miray's Embrace
e.mirays-embrace.description: IV. Securing the final straps as they arrived at the waiting area, the guard nodded respectfully to Miray as he closed the bars to the small room. Miray wordlessly thanked the guard, for he had once again allowed her to retain her helm. Miray could hear the crowds out the opposing exit to the room, noting that even the masses sounded ripe with anticipation. She would typically follow a series of other bouts, which she could follow by the cheers and shouts of the crowds, but today was a special day, with only one publicized battle slated to take place.

e.morassma-feet.name: Morassma Feet
e.morassma-feet.effects:
Soiled Toil (Feet): 12% chance to proc 800 Poison damage; +150 damage per Morassma set item worn; 10% chance to proc 400 Acid damage; +175 Acid damage per Morassma set item worn
Set Bonus (Morassma Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +15% Poison Resistance and +15% Acid Resistance
 7+: 4% chance to proc 2,000 Acid damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 60%
 9+: +0.2 Formation Protection Value to the active Formation and protects your Armies from the effects of Venomous and both your Armies and yourself from Volatile
e.morassma-feet.description:
"We're in the business of dealing with exploding and poisonous things. Best be capable of moving quick. But also keep those feet safe, even if they only have five toes."
-Panee Morassma

e.reodai-dracolong.name: Reodai Dracolong
e.reodai-dracolong.effects:
Reodai's Dependence: 6% chance to proc 4,000 Holy damage; +1,500 damage per Reodai set item worn; +50 HP; +2% Evasion; +2% Crit Rate
Set Bonus (Reodai Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +2% Crit Rate, +5% Evasion and 10% chance to proc 1,400 Holy damage while reducing damage to Armies by 30% on that hit
e.reodai-dracolong.description:
"You command multitudes in your position, but you cannot rely entirely upon those around you. You have to take stock in your own strength and recognize your own capabilities, less you fall into the temptation of dependence."
-Jinna Brightwhisper

e.honorbounds-maul.name: Honorbound's Maul
e.honorbounds-maul.description:
"The weight of the hammer, while certainly more suitable a tool for most dwarves, reflects the weight of their transgressions against their people. That it is wielded in the weaker hand is seen as an insult, and adds to the shame the Honorbound must endure as a part of their penance."
-Norsic Bittermail

s.scroll-naga-naavik.name: Naga Naavik Scroll
s.scroll-naga-naavik.description: These seabound serpents have attacked the vessels full of survivors, and you must fend them off before the ships are destroyed.

a.elven-marksman.name: Elven Marksman
a.elven-marksman.description: While the scouts are experts at spotting prey at a distance, these marksmen, inaptly named though they may be, are the experts of taking down that prey from an even greater distance. With a sturdy longbow, they can easily take the eye of a fowl at 400 yards.

c.brew-of-concentration.name: Brew of Concentration
c.brew-of-concentration.description: For once you felt like you understood what Alanis was saying when she was describing the properties of this brew... Apparently it does work!

e.dokumotsu-helm.name: Dokumotsu Helm
e.dokumotsu-helm.effects: Multipod Spray (Helm): 10% chance to proc 90 Acid damage; +30 damage per Dokumotsu set item worn; +0.5% Crit Rate
e.dokumotsu-helm.description:
"While there are a number of creepy, crawling beasties, they are only called spiders if they have eight legs. And no, those horns don't count as more legs."
-Norsic Bittermail

a.yathane-shahara.name: Yathane Shahara
a.yathane-shahara.description: A veteran elven tracker, Yathane has earned her reputation both in the elven military and in training future officers. Her skills with the longbow are formidable, but she is virtually unparalled with a shortbow. She keeps a tight rein on her party, and you half suspect she intends to leash you in those same reins.
a.yathane-shahara.effects: Militia's Ranger: 30% chance to proc 100 Nature damage; Adds +20 Attack to Arendyl Greenleaf in the same Formation

u.indigo-fury-tonic.name: Indigo Fury Tonic
u.indigo-fury-tonic.description: There is something soothingly simple about a potion that fires up your fervor and titillates your temper...

u.scout-starter-pack-ii.name: Scout Starter Pack II
u.scout-starter-pack-ii.description: A pack providing the necessary tools for every budding scout.

a.igir.name: Igir
a.igir.description:
"Spill lots. Drench the earth, so that some of it flows down to Her."
-Igir
a.igir.effects: Eye for Blood: 4% chance to proc 80,000 Dark damage and add +10% Crit Rate on that attack; Adds +6 Attack to each Vylda's Bloody Supplicant in the Formation; Adds +20 Vitality to the Player

e.vildmand-platefur-bear.name: Vildmand Platefur Bear
e.vildmand-platefur-bear.effects:
Armored And Algid (Bear): 10% chance to proc 1,900 Physical damage and add +16% Crit Rate; 12% chance to proc 3,000 Physical damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 10%
Set Bonus (Vildmand Platefur Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1.5% Crit Rate and +10% Crit Damage
 6+: +10% Ice Resistance
 7+: +100 HP and +2,000 Defence
 8+: 5% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 20%
 9+: +30% Crit Damage and 75% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 5%
e.vildmand-platefur-bear.description: It's... well, it's a bear. And a big one, at that. And someone is expecting you to ride it. You are going to have to track down both Keylsa and Rarsik and find out who is playing a prank on you...

c.blue-faecage.name: Blue Faecage
c.blue-faecage.description: This colourful cage may seem quite typical to you, but once your fingers get near the door and you feel an unseen pressure preventing you from unlatching it, you realize it was clearly made to keep things in, while keeping other things out.

e.crusherclaw-tower-shield.name: Crusherclaw Tower Shield
e.crusherclaw-tower-shield.effects:
Pressure Crush (Tower Shield): 5% chance to proc 2,200 Physical damage; +30,000 damage vs Guild Raids; +700 damage per Crusherclaw set item worn; +200 HP
Set Bonus (Crusherclaw Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +0.5 Formation Protection Value
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.crusherclaw-tower-shield.description: II(a). Easily identified by his wide, crustacean-looking armor, the Hero of Hammerclaw was quick to anger, and would often strike out without asking any questions... Not that anyone could recall having heard him ever speak, that is.

c.fermenting-cheese.name: Fermenting Cheese
c.fermenting-cheese.description: The smell wafting from this product can clear a room in seconds, yet when properly prepared makes for a creamy addition to a meal, leaving a tangy 'zip' on your tongue.

c.kylli-defence-boost-i.name: Kylli Defence Boost I
c.kylli-defence-boost-i.description: Ninety nine times out of a hundred, pointing our Kylli's retired shield will get your ears boxed. You just have to aim for that hundredth time. Passively boosts Kylli Oakenbrew's Defence by +0.5 (Max 4).

u.parchment-of-reodai-mikyou.name: Parchment of Reodai Mikyou
u.parchment-of-reodai-mikyou.description: An old scroll that feels surprisingly balanced!

u.scout-starter-pack-iv.name: Scout Starter Pack IV
u.scout-starter-pack-iv.description: A pack providing the necessary material for every budding scout.

c.greater-caster-token.name: Greater Caster Token
c.greater-caster-token.description: Supposedly these tokens contain a portion of Malfisence's arcane powers, imbuing the holder with immense potency.

c.brew-of-caustics.name: Brew of Caustics
c.brew-of-caustics.description: Imagine yourself in a riverboat, with fruit trees and fruity skies, and when someone shouts for you, you are slow to react to the girl with the crystalline eyes.

u.greater-holy-resilience-potion.name: Greater Holy Resilience Potion
u.greater-holy-resilience-potion.description: A frothy, mesmerizing potion that smells of the ideal seasoning of cardamom.

e.medzeh-restraint.name: Medzeh Restraint
e.medzeh-restraint.effects:
Jackal Watcher (Restraint): 20% chance to proc 1,250 Physical damage; 4% chance to proc 5,000 Holy damage; +2% Crit Rate; +50% Crit Damage; +10% Dark Resistance
Consecrated
Set Bonus (Medzeh Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +2% Crit Rate and +25% Crit Damage
 8+: +4% Evasion and a 1% chance to heal the Player 2 HP
e.medzeh-restraint.description:
"Even raising the spirit of the fallen, if properly respected, can be performed with holy magics... That is completely different from what Bira Biuyom does."
-Apui

c.green-knotted-tendril.name: Green Knotted Tendril
c.green-knotted-tendril.description: This writhing tendril has tied itself in knots... perhaps that explains the strange hues?

c.moss-covered-bark.name: Moss-Covered Bark
c.moss-covered-bark.description: A significant amount of thick, slippery bark. You suppose it could be a handy training tool, or perhaps a yummy snack for that certain someone.

e.capricious-conducer-grounder.name: Capricious Conducer Grounder
e.capricious-conducer-grounder.effects:
Conducive Conductivity (Grounder): 8% chance to proc 2,100 Lightning damage; +1,050 damage per Capricious Conducer set item worn; +0.5% Evasion; +4% All Resistances; +100 HP
Set Bonus (Capricious Conducer Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1% Evasion
 6: +1.5% Crit Rate and +15% Crit Damage
 7+: +5% All Resistances and +1% Evasion
 8+: 2% chance to proc 10,000 Lightning damage and give +50% Evasion on that proc
 9+: +5% All Resistances, +1.5% Evasion and 10% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 50%
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.capricious-conducer-grounder.description: A distractingly heavy shield, even by Tower Shield standards, this mammoth protector is intended to be driven into the ground to absorb both the blunt, and the incoming energy, of incoming attacks.

e.rara-shell-collection-bottoms.name: Rara Shell Collection Bottoms
e.rara-shell-collection-bottoms.effects:
Fabulous, Darling! (Bottoms): 16% chance to proc 180 Nature damage; +260 damage per Rara Shell Collection set item worn; +500 damage vs Aquatic raids; +0.25% Evasion
Set Bonus (Rara Shell Collection Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1% Evasion and +300 Magic
 6+: +5 Tiers of 'Nimble Defensive Training'
 7+: +4 Tiers of 'Evasive Maneuvers' and +1 Tier of 'Advanced Evasive Maneuvers'
 8+: +1% Evasion and 24% chance to proc 2,000 Nature damage vs Aquatic raids
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.rara-shell-collection-bottoms.description:
"Take them off, darling, they're hideous on you. Scratch that, you're indecent with or without them."
-Luminarara

c.violet-runecarver.name: Violet Runecarver
c.violet-runecarver.description: Unlike a sharp tool that would merely cut into stone, this seems to leave a powerful, magic-infused etch behind on the rock. Part of you wants to try to draw some funny pictures, but between Alanis' scolding and the potentially explosive natural consequences, you decide against it.

u.platinum-codex-of-wisdom.name: Platinum Codex of Wisdom
u.platinum-codex-of-wisdom.description: Every now and again a rare gem among literature appears, conveying experience beyond its ken, capable of both inspiring future generations to greatness and reminding them of the lessons of history. The wisdom delivered by such works is invaluable, and should never be taken for granted.

u.ooleviash-honor-deoch.name: Ooleviash Honor Deoch
u.ooleviash-honor-deoch.description: This purple potion is sweet, and has an interesting crunch to it as it goes down.

e.sinderklaz-ring.name: Sinderklaz Ring
e.sinderklaz-ring.effects:
+50 HP; +60 Energy; +4% Evasion
Set Bonus (Sinderklaz Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +200 HP, +30% Magic Resistance and +25% Ice Resistance
e.sinderklaz-ring.description: While the stones on this ring feel cold and lifeless to the touch, the moment you don it you swear they feel alive and almost... plant-like?

u.green-brewmasters-dextrous-draft.name: Green Brewmaster's Dextrous Draft
u.green-brewmasters-dextrous-draft.description:
"I'd have been curious to see how Boltus could have fared after consuming my newest creation."
-Nphireo

c.greater-tank-token.name: Greater Tank Token
c.greater-tank-token.description: It is said that the disciples of Bevis the Bulwark were personally provided these tokens from their master.

c.green-frigidara-defence-banner.name: Green Frigidara Defence Banner
c.green-frigidara-defence-banner.description: A banner intended to both rally troops to stave off Frigidara’s invasion, and to announce details about her horde’s locations. Aegyr truly seems to have thought of everything in this never-ending watch of his.

e.demonsbanes-legs.name: Demonsbane's Legs
e.demonsbanes-legs.effects:
Dark Deterrence (Legs): 6% chance to proc 1300 Physical damage; +0.75% Crit Rate vs Demon raids
Set Bonus (Demonsbane's Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +80% Crit Damage
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.demonsbanes-legs.description: The most notable change in Ciri was in her demeanour. Where she was once patient and compassionate, she had become vindictive and cruel, deriding those who had once sought her aid and mocking those who sought to offer her aid. The more obvious change was in her attire, for she had spurned her gleaming cuirass for a darkened hue and horned helm.

u.thiadoran-nibblet.name: Thiadoran Nibblet
u.thiadoran-nibblet.description: An entirely portable snack for the road, you hope to sneak a few of them while they're still tender and juicy.

preReqs.name: resource
preReqs.errorMsg: Your health and energy are full already.

a.vazz-oresnatch.name: Vazz Oresnatch
a.vazz-oresnatch.description: A goblin with an unusual aura of command about him, Vazz's eyes keep darting around him in a manic frenzy, leaving you to wonder whether he is entirely right in the head. When you hear him cry out in success, however, you realize he is holding a rare ore in his hand. His strange fascinations do not end there, as he seems entirely fixated on jewelery, and rings in particular, and seems to believe that the power put into these bejeweled items can be enhanced far beyond their crafters' intent.
a.vazz-oresnatch.effects: One of The Rings: 22% chance to proc 3,250 Nature damage; +150 damage per distinct Ring owned; [Up-to-4%] chance to spawn a Rainbow Ore on 20x attacks, scaling based upon Leadership; Rainbow Ore spawn chances are doubled vs Legendary Raids; Adds +20 Attack to Goblin Commanders in the active Formation; Adds +10 Attack to Goblin Troops in the active Formation; Adds +5% Formation Bonus; 150% Magic-damage Mimic of any Ring damage procs; Gains +1.4 Attack per distinct Ring owned; Gains +0.01 Defence per distinct Ring owned

a.sinderklaz-dwerg.name: Sinderklaz Dwerg
a.sinderklaz-dwerg.description:
"My job is far too big to be accomplished without some help. That's where these helpers come in."
-Niek Mira
a.sinderklaz-dwerg.effects: Adds +4 Attack to Niek Mira in the active Formation; Restores 2 Reserves daily

e.tromos-latria-promise.name: Tromos Latria Promise
e.tromos-latria-promise.effects:
Returning the Damners (Promise): 24% chance to proc 200 Dark damage; +100 damage per Tromos Latria set item worn; +200 Magic; +20 HP; +5% Holy Resistance
Set Bonus (Tromos Latria Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +5% Crit Damage, +500 Magic and -5% Formation Bonus
 7+: +1 Tiers of 'Magic Meditation' and -5% Formation Bonus
 8+: +1 Tiers of 'Protective Guardian' and -10% Formation Bonus
 9+: +3% Crit Rate and -10% Formation Bonus
e.tromos-latria-promise.description: You feel soiled through to your soul when you don this ring, but the surge of power that comes with it seems sufficient to offset these feelings...

a.apui.name: Apui
a.apui.description:
"The Medzeh are an ancient order, created by the Nomarch over a thousand years ago, and they have secretly watched over the tombs. We will stop Bira Biuyom, and drive him back to the underworld."
-Apui
a.apui.effects: Medzeh Guardian: 30% chance to proc 1,500 Psychic damage; Adds +5 Attack to Half-Elf Commanders in the active Formation

e.firedrakes-boots.name: Firedrake's Boots
e.firedrakes-boots.effects:

XI. "Well, it seems the bait was finally taken," the woman's voice said overtop of Brath, as he was pulled up to his feet and his hands bound. The cowled figure lifted her hood, revealing a young woman's face adorned with a series of scars. "And it seems we were fortunate enough to bag one that had some talent for the arts, this time! This, my sisters and brothers, may be the final piece we need to call forth our namesake and partake of his power for our own!"

Brath was led through the brush to a small stone altar, somewhat bewildered until he heard several utterances of 'For Cenius' and 'Hail Ceniuspact!' as he passed.

Brath was startled when the apparent leader, whom he assumed to be Brianag, sliced open his palm with a small dagger, flicking the blood into the pyre before the altar before licking the other side of the blade.

"By Morgabick's wrath, how could this be? You aren't old enough to be them... and yet, it must be true! You had a hand in the thwarting of Cenius himself?! How could he fall to such a weakling as yourself!" Brianag uttered, and several of the cultists fell to their knees, gazing up in awe.

"No matter... this only works to our benefit, for you will certainly be the last sacrifice we require in order to bring forth our Dark Master's deepest powers!"

e.mephitic-chiffon-staff.description: VIII. Brath departed early the next day, deciding to forgo further information gathering in Rispa and head for the Lenha Woods. The trip was relatively smooth, though he had forgotten how much he disliked walking long distances, but while a sense of familiarity overcame him when, on the third day, the edge of the forest came into view, he felt a tinge of fear and worry alongside it. He had grown up not too far from here, near the Toisar Forest, but despite the similarities in terrain and flora Brath could sense an unsettled quiet in the land. Camping just inside the edge of the woods that eve, Brath took some time to meditate and commune with the land, feeling the energy of the land flow through him, drawing more in with every breath. The land was truly shaken, and suffering a sense of dire confusion that Brath could not clearly recognize, though he was certain of one thing: dark, druidic powers were being channeled here, and on an incredible scope.
