Presumably owing to the carnage her forces were facing, the Orc Chieftain took the front to challenge the powerful mage who was defending this small hill, and was both shocked-and-amused to find a young, Human girl, alongside a host of creatures, singularly responsible for the mayhem. e.mirays-greaves.name: Miray's Greaves
e.mirays-greaves.description: VII. As they squared off, Miray knew her defeat was close at hand, she vowed on all the Gods that she would not forfeit the match so long as she had breath left in her. Upon hearing the gong signaling the start of the fight her foe was upon her, stabbing forward with the trident with uncanny speed and agility, quickly demonstrating their formal training and expertise with the tool. It was all Miray could do to dodge to the side, taking the butt of the polearm to the side of her helm as she did so. The pair circled, with Miray unable to close the distance but her foe only able to land glancing blows… though as her wounds mounted, Miray knew that her stamina was not infinite, and eventually this dance would end. It was at this stray thought that her foe cast their net into her path, causing her to fall backwards, tangled and helpless.

c.coiled-plume.name: Coiled Plume
c.coiled-plume.description: Bearing a strange duality, this feather seems to have the properties of both a serpent's scales and a rooster's plumage. Alanis was aquiver when she felt the potent magical energies contained within it.

e.pioneering-pixie-gloves.name: Pioneering Pixie Gloves
e.pioneering-pixie-gloves.effects:
A Sprite's Searching (Gloves): 10% chance to proc 450 Magic damage and add +3% Evasion; +550 damage per Pioneering Pixie set item worn; +0.4% Crit Rate
Set Bonus (Pioneering Pixie Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1% Crit Rate and +15% Crit Damage
 7+: +1% Evasion
 8+: +0.5% Crit Rate and +0.5% Evasion
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.pioneering-pixie-gloves.description: Whoever figured you needed circulation in your fingers to adventure was clearly unfamiliar with these gloves.

e.copperhead-pants.name: Copperhead Pants
e.copperhead-pants.effects:
+4% Lightning Resistance
Set Bonus (Copperhead Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +5% Lightning Resistance
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.copperhead-pants.description: IV. Mastering these dark arts in secret, Thotssaken then sought out like-minded Naga channelers and, deceiving them about the origins of these powers, passed down her newfound knowledge, promising untold power and potential to her followers. In a few short months, she had amassed a cult-following who followed her every teaching without question.

u.wizard-starter-pack-iv.name: Wizard Starter Pack IV
u.wizard-starter-pack-iv.description: A pack providing the necessary material for every budding wizard.

e.laurentian-shirt.name: Laurentian Shirt
e.laurentian-shirt.effects: Powerless Prey (Shirt): 45% chance to proc 120 Dark damage; +850 damage versus Human raids; +4% Psychic Resistance
e.laurentian-shirt.description:
"Is there some reason that this vampire, especially, needs to be slain? He looks pretty open..."

"I've seen honest faces before. They usually come attached to liars."
-Conversation with Corovar

cp.ranger-starter-pack-iv.name: Ranger Starter Pack IV
cp.ranger-starter-pack-iv.description: A pack providing the necessary materials for every budding ranger.

s.scroll-superior-watcher.name: Superior Watcher Scroll
s.scroll-superior-watcher.description: Supposedly these creatures can see all... However, can it foresee its imminent demise?

e.mikoko-nodeek.name: Mikoko Nodeek
e.mikoko-nodeek.effects:
Land's Rest (Nodeek): 7% chance to proc 580 Magic damage; +1,900 damage vs Undead raids; +290 damage per Mikoko set item worn; +1.5% Crit Rate; +15% Crit Damage; +5% Dark Resistance
Set Bonus (Mikoko Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +25% Crit Damage
 7+: +2% Crit Rate
 8+: +10% Dark Resistance
 9+: +1 Tiers of 'Inspirational Command: Horrifying'
e.mikoko-nodeek.description: You've little desire to be up-close-and-personal with something when their innards are falling out and, potentially, on you.

a.shana-copperfox.name: Shana Copperfox
a.shana-copperfox.description: An entrepreneur of some renown, Shana had to abandon everything while fleeing the demon attack on Gipanta, leaving her hard-earned riches behind. Of course, this would not be the first time she has reached new shores with only the clothes on her back, and the way she is eyeing up some of the other refugees, particularly the grooms and chefs, suggests her next schemes are already underway.
a.shana-copperfox.effects: Self-Made Fox: 8% chance to proc 8,000 Dark damage; Adds +5 Attack and +0.5 Defence to each Oakenbrew Server in the Formation; Adds +15 to Player Vitality and Energy

a.chaunaths-warpriests-barricade.name: Chaunath's Warpriests Barricade
a.chaunaths-warpriests-barricade.description:
"It takes warriors of great skill to put themselves between the needy and danger."
-Warpriest Emmus
a.chaunaths-warpriests-barricade.effects: Adds +1 Attack and +0.6 Defence to Warpriest Orghash and Warpriest Emmus in the active Formation

c.brew-of-steadfastness.name: Brew of Steadfastness
c.brew-of-steadfastness.description: You're quite certain that Alanis could benefit from a small dose of this concoction, if only to steady her nerves and reduce her anxieties, but she seems wholly unappreciative when you attempted to pour it down her throat for her.

e.selinkas-knife.name: Selinka's Knife
e.selinkas-knife.effects: Silent Stabber: 17% chance to proc 82 Dark damage; +1.5% Crit Rate
e.selinkas-knife.description: VII(b). Selinka had not counted on being caught, for it had only happened twice before, and not for many years since. The woman who struck at her was startlingly strong, in spite of only wielding a wooden pole, yet Selinka's blades could only nick at it rather than smoothly running down its edge like a metal blade. Realizing that her position was compromised, Selinka struck out to disable the uncouth woman before fleeing, vowing to someday seek vengeance for this upset.

a.aisi-tushar.name: Aisi Tushar
a.aisi-tushar.description:
"Well, no point gawking when there's work to be done. We are here to preserve what we can and stave off everything else. If you have any wizards of acceptable power, we'll accept their assistance... No, I said acceptable power."
-Aisi Tushar
a.aisi-tushar.effects: Wintry Ward: 6% chance to proc 550 Ice damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 16%;  Adds +2 Attack and +1 Defence to each Frostwarden Shieldformer and Frostwarden Shieldwielder in the Formation

a.blazebrand-artificer.name: Blazebrand Artificer
a.blazebrand-artificer.description: Supposedly these gnomes are 'technological wizards', whatever that means. You're having a hard time sorting it out, what with all the screaming.
a.blazebrand-artificer.effects: Adds +4 Attack and +0.2 Defence to Urzul Shamn and Plyzz in the active Formation

e.stormshapers-helm.name: Stormshapers' Helm
e.stormshapers-helm.effects:
Stormfury (Helm): 12% chance to proc 450 Lightning damage; +100 damage per Stormshapers' set item worn; 4% chance to proc 1,400 Lightning damage; +200 damage per Stormshapers' set item worn; +3% Lightning Resistance
Set Bonus (Stormshapers' Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: 50% chance to proc 120 Lightning damage, +5 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Lightning' and +20% Lightning Resistance
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.stormshapers-helm.description: After inspecting this fine helm, you have opted not to speak with Thundreag about it. No doubt he'd say something about how it 'guards your mind to help form the storm' or something equally asinine.

e.oresnatchs-grand-yellow-ring.name: Oresnatch's Grand Yellow Ring
e.oresnatchs-grand-yellow-ring.effects: Vazz's Imagination: 100% chance to proc 1,200 Magic damage and give +75% Crit Damage on that proc
e.oresnatchs-grand-yellow-ring.description: Undoubtedly due to the wondrous base material they had to work with, but the jewelers seem to have figured out how to further force more Rainbow Ore power into Vazz's latest ring, improving its magical potential even further.

u.script-of-mind-thorn.name: Script of Mind Thorn
u.script-of-mind-thorn.description: "Drive forth and spread your seeds of confusion! Mind Thorn!"

e.quilltips-rod.name: Quilltip's Rod
e.quilltips-rod.effects: Spurious Scribing: 5% chance to proc 240 Dark damage; +2% Evasion; +10% Crit Damage
e.quilltips-rod.description: VI. The crowd seemed frozen for a moment as Loric finished speaking, before launching into a series of questions, which Loric was capable of deftly handling. Nobody seemed to question his qualifications or his right to speak, and as his mistress was beginning to rouse, Loric saw the defeated looks upon the faces of the Guild leaders, whose pathway to easy riches had been resoundingly blocked. Loric did not know it just yet, but in less than two years' time he would find his name submitted for electoral candidacy, and months later he would become the youngest ministerial head in Baystone's history, as he continued his newfound quest to seek fair resolutions, and peaceful diplomacy over violent rule, for the seafaring District of the Empire.

e.skliros-cleaver.name: Skliros' Cleaver
e.skliros-cleaver.effects: Cruel Cleavage: 12% chance to proc 1000 Dark damage; 4% chance to proc 2000 Fire damage; +20% Crit Damage
e.skliros-cleaver.description:
"The great cleaver of Skliros has brought many a foe to bear, and is the ultimate display of the General's cruel power."
-Glasha Brunbruk

e.mirgoda-fur-barrier.name: Mirgoda Fur Hand Barrier
e.mirgoda-fur-barrier.effects:
Fetid Furs (Barrier): 22% chance to proc 400 Physical damage; +200 damage per Mirgoda Fur set item worn; +5% Ice Resistance; +3 Tiers of 'Ice Resistance'
Set Bonus (Mirgoda Fur Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +2% Crit Rate
 6+: +5% All Resistances
 8+: +80 HP and +10% Ice Resistance
 9+: +5% All Resistances and -10% Formation Bonus
e.mirgoda-fur-barrier.description: While there is a little bit of give, owing to the freshly removed fur and flesh, this shield braces as well as any you've previously used, and could prove useful when trying to intimidate both barbarians and cityfolk.

u.red-brew-bag.name: Red Brew Bag
u.red-brew-bag.description: A tied-off bag, containing an unknown brew.

a.fallen-warmage.name: Fallen Warmage
a.fallen-warmage.description: Unlike many of the other raised beings, these heavily armed skeletons bring dark energies to bear on the battlefield, both offensively and defensively.
a.fallen-warmage.effects: Adds +1% Dark Resistance to the Player; Restores 5 Reserves daily

c.yathane-shahara-defence-boost-i.name: Yathane Shahara Defence Boost I
c.yathane-shahara-defence-boost-i.description: A badge of merit, awarded to Yathane for her exemplary skills as a defensive Commander. Passively boosts Yathane's Defence by +0.5 (Max 2).

e.chiffon-fur.name: Chiffon Fur
e.chiffon-fur.effects:
Downy Delight (Fur): 40% chance to proc 255 Holy damage; +3750 damage vs Guild Raids; +90 damage per Chiffon set item worn
Set Bonus (Chiffon Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +4% All Resistances; 1% chance to heal the Player 3 HP
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.chiffon-fur.description: IV(b). Helci learned the voice of the forest, of the land, and of the creatures, and was soon blessed by them sharing their secrets with her, granting her mystic access to a variety of natural arts and magics. As Helci's depth of knowledge grew, she became keenly aware of the spiritual beings that dwelt within the woodland, though she was disappointed that the pronged watcher chose to avoid her.

e.ranging-scouts-cap.name: Ranging Scout's Cap
e.ranging-scouts-cap.effects:
Scout's Honor (Cap): 12% chance to proc 90 Physical damage; +30 damage per Ranging Scout's set item worn
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.ranging-scouts-cap.description:
"It's vital you keep debris away from your eyes, including your own hair, human."

"The sounds fair. Could I try yours on, then?"

The Ranger looks at you as though you've grown horns. "Nosatra would disavow me if she caught me bare-headed!"

e.hooded-veil-tunic.name: Hooded Veil Tunic
e.hooded-veil-tunic.effects: Fangs Alot (Tunic): 12% chance to proc 200 Poison damage; +25 damage per Hooded Veil set item worn; +4 Offence
e.hooded-veil-tunic.description:
IV. "The Hooded Priesstess was dimunutive in ssize, but when angered would extend her veiled neck, calling down radiant energiess to sstrike down her foess.... or sso all would believe. In truth, sshe only wielded her holy powerss in the mosst dire of ssituationss."
-Seksehsa

e.blazen-swiftslicer-rod.name: Blazen Swiftslicer Rod
e.blazen-swiftslicer-rod.effects:
Glorious Flaming Blades (Rod): 30% chance to proc 800 Fire damage vs Winter raids; +200 damage per Blazen Swiftslicer set item worn; +10% Crit Damage; +1% Evasion
Set Bonus (Blazen Swiftslicer Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +0.25% Evasion
 9+: +1.75% Evasion
e.blazen-swiftslicer-rod.description: It's bladed, it's chilly, and it's superheated. Undoubtedly, this represents all the failings of magic.

u.foaming-energy-potion.name: Foaming Energy Potion
u.foaming-energy-potion.description: Driven near-to-madness by the growing demand by experienced adventurers, athletes and artisans, a cunning alchemist took to concocting a bubbling broth of a potion and claimed it would satisfy all their needs. Whether the foaming bubbles were truly necessary or not, they fizz pleasantly as they pass down your throat.

e.wyrmhide-feet.name: Wyrmhide Feet
e.wyrmhide-feet.effects:
Tremorsense (Feet): 15% chance to proc 80 Nature damage; +5 damage per Wyrmhide set item worn
Set Bonus (Wyrmhide Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1 Tiers of 'Eye for Beauty'
e.wyrmhide-feet.description: V. One dated document, however, describes wyrms as merely the larval stage of a far-more-frightening creature. According to the tattered scroll, after molting the wyrms would emerge with wings and an insatiable hunger, ravaging the world as nigh-unstoppable beasts, capable of even rivalling the Dragons of old. It is no surprise, of course, that these documents are often disregarded as the ravings of yet another mad philosopher.

e.marksmans-longbow.name: Marksman's Longbow
e.marksmans-longbow.effects: Ranger's Eye: 24% chance to proc 45 Physical damage; +1% Crit Rate; +5% Crit Damage
e.marksmans-longbow.description:
"The careful eye of a marksman - or a markswoman - is only the second most important feature they possess. Their steady frame and grip of their tools make a far greater difference, particularly when the most subtle of distances matter most."
-Yathana Shahara

c.thundrak-boost-i.name: Thundrak Boost I
c.thundrak-boost-i.description: It seems like Thundrak may have added some elements of the storm into his form. Passively boosts Thundrak's Attack by +15 and Defence by +0.3 (Max 2).

e.rolling-stone.name: Rolling Stone
e.rolling-stone.effects: Tempting and Alone: 24% chance to proc 375 Physical damage; 2% chance to proc 6,000 Physical damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 30%
e.rolling-stone.description: They say whenever you find a place to lay your hat, you can call it home, but once it keeps rolling on you may be left with nothing but loneliness.

e.red-dragonhunters-boots.name: Red Dragonhunter's Boots
e.red-dragonhunters-boots.effects: Red Drake Stalker (Boots): 16% chance to proc 200 Ice damage; +340 damage vs Dragon raids; +60 damage per Red Dragonhunter set item worn
e.red-dragonhunters-boots.description: VII. Unfortunately for the great red dragon, Qusasper had not succumbed to the dragonfyre and took the beast by the throat, drowning it in its own flames until both the flames, and its life, had been snuffed out.

e.selinkas-spinner.name: Selinka's Spinner
e.selinkas-spinner.effects: Silent Spinner: 30% chance to proc 50 Poison damage; +8% Crit Damage
e.selinkas-spinner.description: VI(b). Selinka, though only a small handful of people knew that name, had already been busy in the Hitsugi residence when she descended upon the future-lord's chambers. She had bankrupt several other houses over the past months, and knew she was amongst the best at her craft, but she equally knew how to take advantage of confusion as well; slaying the would-be lord of this great family would cause considerable upset, and many opportunities would open up for a woman with her particular skill set.

e.oresnatchs-grand-orange-ring.name: Oresnatch's Grand Orange Ring
e.oresnatchs-grand-orange-ring.effects: Vazz's Imagination: 100% chance to proc 1,200 Magic damage and give +2,500 Offence on that proc
e.oresnatchs-grand-orange-ring.description: Undoubtedly due to the wondrous base material they had to work with, but the jewelers seem to have figured out how to further force more Rainbow Ore power into Vazz's latest ring, improving its magical potential even further.

a.hatuumin-psionic.name: Hatuumin Psionic
a.hatuumin-psionic.description:
"Look at her fine wares, and never mind how they seem to look back at you, deep in your mind."
-Rankats
a.hatuumin-psionic.effects: Adds +4 Attack to Har-Hut and Rankats in the active Formation

c.blue-watchers-humor.name: Blue Watcher's Humor
c.blue-watchers-humor.description: This colourful concoction contains certain cryptic characteristics!

a.baron-aureus-footman.name: Baron Aureus' Footman
a.baron-aureus-footman.description: A well trained - and well attired - footman, dedicated to ensuring the protection and will of Honourable Stone.
a.baron-aureus-footman.effects: Adds +5 Attack and +0.2 Defence to Honourable Audia Stone and Ramor Metalborn in the active Formation

c.formation-diagrams.name: Formation Diagrams
c.formation-diagrams.description: Sometimes the more complex maneuvers are best practiced at the table before testing them in the field.

e.threofor-spiked-whip.name: Threofor Spiked Whip
e.threofor-spiked-whip.effects:
Stegoslam (Spiked Whip): 4% chance to proc 1500 Physical damage; +12,500 damage vs Guild Raids; +120 damage per Threofor set item worn; Reduces damage to Armies by 30% on Proc
Set Bonus (Threofor Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +25 Honor
e.threofor-spiked-whip.description: VIII. The bandits were, understandably, quite upset with this deception, and seized Ceta before returning to their mountain hideout. The group soon discovered that Ceta had no hand in the ploy, but the terrified child was beyond distraught when she overheard that her family appeared to have no intention in further negotiating with the bandits, leaving her to her own devices while in their custody.

c.igniter-stone.name: Igniter Stone
c.igniter-stone.description: These rocks are capable of producing scores of sparks by simply striking them against any hard surface.

u.wizard-starter-pack-i.name: Wizard Starter Pack I
u.wizard-starter-pack-i.description: A pack providing the necessary goods for every budding wizard.

c.brew-of-bolts.name: Brew of Bolts
c.brew-of-bolts.description: I was caught, in the midst of the trafficked path, and after looking around I knew that there would be no turning back.

c.training-cap.name: Training Cap
c.training-cap.description: It's important that your armies have proper protective equipment when running drills and learning new Formations.

c.takhi-wawetseka-boost-i.name: Takhi Wawetseka Boost I
c.takhi-wawetseka-boost-i.description: Giving a voice to those who have departed is the first step towards their accepting of what has transpired. Passively boosts Takhi Wawetseka's Attack by +20 (Max 2).

c.green-stained-snakescale.name: Green Stained Snakescale
c.green-stained-snakescale.description: This colourful scale was stained during your battle with the Naga.

e.yelte-demonslayer-indigo.name: Yelte Demonslayer - Indigo
e.yelte-demonslayer-indigo.effects:
Divine Indigo Donation: 40% chance to proc 600 Holy damage; +1,200 damage vs Demon raids; +4.5% Crit Rate; +55% Crit Damage
Sanctified
e.yelte-demonslayer-indigo.description: Infusing the legendary bow with the mythical Dragonslayer gem was one piece of the puzzle, but something felt incomplete. It was only after you infused the radiant shards into it that the true purpose of the bow became clear, and its potential to strike down demonkind shone through.

m.alanis-sigil-of-weakening.name: Alanis' Sigil of Weakening
m.alanis-sigil-of-weakening.description:
"What do you mean it didn't work?! How did it not work? Did you cast it or didn't you?!"

Alanis sniffs before responding "You presume to know more about magic than one who has studied it for years? Why not save your breath for more important questions, farmer?"

"... How many years of study, exactly...?"
m.alanis-sigil-of-weakening.effects: Alanis' Sigil of Weakening: The rune has taken effect on the Watcher, allowing you to penetrate its defences!

c.indigo-map-fragment.name: Indigo Map Fragment
c.indigo-map-fragment.description: From even this small portion of the map you know it leads to a substantive prize... You cannot seem to puzzle out how the map's colours factor into the route, though.

e.alchemical-artisan-rod.name: Alchemical Artisan Rod
e.alchemical-artisan-rod.effects:
Explosive Eccentricities (Rod): 13% chance to proc 600 Fire damage; +250 damage per Alchemical Artisan set item worn; +1,400 damage vs Demon raids; +40 HP; 6% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 20%
Set Bonus (Alchemical Artisan Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1% Crit Rate and +20% Crit Damage
 7+: 2% chance to proc 25,000 Acid damage
 8+: +2 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Nature' and 'Elemental Expertise - Fire'
 9+: +5% Dark Resistance, +5% Ice Resistance and +2% Crit Rate
e.alchemical-artisan-rod.description: III. In the years that followed, Nahla did not cope well with her sister's death, and did little to excel at her studies. She would occasionally find herself staring off into the distance, watching some natural phenomenon, only to be filled with resentment and anger and realizing she had no patience remaining for such things. Despite her not-inconsiderable aptitude for academics, Nahla insisted on seeking the quickest answer to virtually every problem, and would equally choose the easy route if given the option.

e.wyrmhide-hands.name: Wyrmhide Hands
e.wyrmhide-hands.effects:
Tremorsense (Hands): 15% chance to proc 80 Nature damage; +5 damage per Wyrmhide set item worn
Set Bonus (Wyrmhide Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1 Tiers of 'Eye for Beauty'
e.wyrmhide-hands.description: III. There has been significant debate as to whether wyrms are truly blind or simply rely more upon their other senses, they have "eyes", of a sort, but can detect vibrations through the ground, and are said to capable of reacting to a child's footstep more than ten kilometers away.

c.kylli-boost-ii.name: Kylli Boost II
c.kylli-boost-ii.description: True to her dwarven roots, a well-watered Kylli is a potent Kylli. Passively boosts Kylli Oakenbrew's Attack by +25 and Defence by +0.25 (Max 2).

e.spiderskin-chest.name: Spiderskin Chest
e.spiderskin-chest.effects:
Poisonous Palpae (Chest): 6% chance to proc 40 Poison damage
Set Bonus (Spiderskin Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +5% Poison Resistance
e.spiderskin-chest.description: The hairs on the back of your neck are tingling as you don this armor.... unfortunately, they aren't your hairs...

e.snowdrake-slayer-gloves.name: Snowdrake Slayer Gloves
e.snowdrake-slayer-gloves.effects:
Walking in a Winter Wasteland (Gloves): 10% chance to proc 400 Physical damage; +1,250 damage vs Winter raids; +750 damage vs Dragon raids; +5% Ice Resistance; +75 damage per Snowdrake Slayer set item worn
Set Bonus (Snowdrake Slayer Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +2% Crit Rate and +30% Crit Damage
e.snowdrake-slayer-gloves.description: You were worried you'd lose manual dexterity to keep your fingers from freezing, but these appear to have struck a fair balance.

c.green-blasting-stinger.name: Green Blasting Stinger
c.green-blasting-stinger.description: It remains unclear what the greater challenge was: Bringing down the original owner of this stinger, or removing it while keeping all of your fingers.

a.guild-relay.name: Guild Relay
a.guild-relay.description: Gathering information is only as good as the ability to share it, and this Relay is trained and ready to take any information the Lookouts have obtained and get them to Istovin without delay.

e.zaratans-mace.name: Zaratan's Mace
e.zaratans-mace.effects: Debris Volley (Mace): 15% chance to proc 800 Nature damage; +40 damage per Zaratan set item worn
e.zaratans-mace.description:
"The impact force of being struck by a Zaratan is perhaps one of the most devastating found in nature. However, in my experience, the beasts are incredibly gentle, and rarely prone to attack, even when provoked."
-Janagud

k.spirit-radar.name: Spirit Radar
k.spirit-radar.effects: For the next 20 Quest clicks, you have a x% chance to restore 2-6 Energy on each.

e.pentwater-helm.name: Pentwater Helm
e.pentwater-helm.effects:
Blessed Boulder-Be (Helm): 8% chance to proc 120 Holy damage; +25 damage per Pentwater set item worn
Sanctified
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.pentwater-helm.description: III. Malaclaven gathered a small following of devoted followers and forayed into the deepest parts of the dwarven homeland in order to slay Malbog's invading forces, seeking retribution in the name of his deity for his failings to have protected his people in the first place. His numerous courageous acts led to his name being spread far and wide.

e.thiadoran-garments-petasos.name: Thiadoran Garments Petasos
e.thiadoran-garments-petasos.effects:
Set Bonus (Thiadoran Garments Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +40 HP
 7+: +2 Tiers of 'Spare Change'
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.thiadoran-garments-petasos.description: You find this strange hat very awkward to wear, but you realize you're far more used to having a bare head in the fields, or wearing more protective combat protection.

u.red-third-eye-tonic.name: Red Third Eye Tonic
u.red-third-eye-tonic.description: It is said that all perception starts not with the eyes on your face, but by the concentration of energy forming your innate third eye. Whether the Gods would agree with such a self-serving explanation or not remains to be seen, but you do enjoy the prospect of noticing those minute details of the world around you.
u.red-third-eye-tonic.effects: Increases Attentive Perception and Eye for Beauty tiers by +1 for 10 minutes

e.dromaeon-chest.name: Dromaeon Chest
e.dromaeon-chest.effects: Prehistoric Pummelling (Chest): 10% chance to proc 200 Physical damage; +2000 damage vs Guild Raids; +25 damage per Dromaeon set item worn
e.dromaeon-chest.description: IV. Ceta's younger sister, though not notably bright, strong or wise, made obvious efforts to be endearing towards her tutours and her parents, but this was to the exclusion of anyone who wasn't in an obvious position of power. Other children, or people from poorer families, did little to hold the girl's interests, unless she was taking steps to be deliberately cruel towards them.

e.derzis-thunderclap-pants.name: Derzis' Thunderclap Pants
e.derzis-thunderclap-pants.effects:
Lightning Divine (Pants): 8% chance to proc 140 Lightning damage; +80 damage per Derzis' Thunderclap set item worn; 16% chance to proc 45 Lightning damage; +15 damage per Derzis' Thunderclap set item worn; +0.4% Evasion
Set Bonus (Derzis' Thunderclap Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +1 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Lightning
 8+: +1 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Lightning'
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.derzis-thunderclap-pants.description: Somewhat bulkier than what you were expecting, these seem to keep you warm, well covered and, perhaps most importantly, grounded!

a.dondomra-grimfeet.name: Dondomra Grimfeet
a.dondomra-grimfeet.description: One of the chosen voices of Orimneni, Dondomra has spent more time abroad than at home in the past decade, leading various missions to expand the teachings of her deity, and to assist those desperate to regain their honor. She continues to assert that Orimneni will protect all of those who assist in this war, but has been decidedly silent on the specifics...
a.dondomra-grimfeet.effects: Adds +1 Defence to Dwarf troops in the active Formation

u.guild-purse-iii.name: Guild Purse III
u.guild-purse-iii.description: A thick purse, containing some Guild goodies.

"Nimble isss good, but letting the attack ssslide off of you, like lightning over the rod, isss ever the better choissse."
-Dhiva

u.stormchasers-supplies.description: Some necessary supplies to help your storm-chasing pursuits. At least, that's what those Gnomes seem to suggest you need.

It looked furry and fuzzy, and Brath noticed little else as he approached it to touch it. His

u.script-of-acid-splash.name: Script of Acid Splash
u.script-of-acid-splash.description: "Splash forth and enshroud your foe! Acid Splash!"

c.blue-horde-battleaxe.name: Blue Horde Battleaxe
c.blue-horde-battleaxe.description: Not every axe used by the barbarian tribes is intended for combat. Some appear to denote rank. Others... Might be a cruel prank played on one another?

c.green-thurlam-octopus.name: Green Thurlam Octopus
c.green-thurlam-octopus.description: Unlike similar creatures from the southern seas, these strangely-coloured octopods are apparently renowned for both their size, and their delicious flavour.

a.mihrish-acolyte.name: Mihrish Acolyte
a.mihrish-acolyte.description: Even within the depths of Dwarven strongholds the essence of magic can be found. Drawing their arcane powers from the earth and stone, these acolytes have progressed well past the basics under the tutelage of their masters, and they can pack as much punch as their strong-armed brothers.

c.seal-shatterers-beads.name: Seal Shatterer's Beads
c.seal-shatterers-beads.description: These beads hold residual amounts of dark magics, having been the focus of one hell-bent on shattering the ancient seal.

c.lost-love.name: Lost Love
c.lost-love.description: What a crime it is, when love is lost to hatred's cold grasp.

e.thiadoran-sandals.name: Thiadoran Sandals
e.thiadoran-sandals.description: For purportedly plain sandals that would be worn by the commonfolk of Thiador, these seem surprisingly well made.

c.pristine-fletching.name: Pristine Fletching
c.pristine-fletching.description: These fletchings must have been meant for decoration, or for an arrow of exceeding accuracy.

u.yellow-fury-tonic.description: There is something soothingly simple about a potion that fires up your fervor and titillates your temper...

c.white-devils-artifact.name: White Devil's Artifact
c.white-devils-artifact.description: A powerful artifact from the belt of one of Skliros' followers, clearly demonstrating your capability and courage.

a.friskfingers-lookout.name: Friskfingers Lookout
a.friskfingers-lookout.description:
"The greatest danger doesn't come in the doing of the deed, but in being seen taking notice beforehand."
-Heren Luckyboot

a.hoverk.name: Hoverk
a.hoverk.description: Having come to your aid in the tunnels while facing the spiders, Hoverk's vocabulary seems limited to a small handful of words. His immense size and strength, however, belies his gentle, cautious nature, as he seems to enjoy spending more time letting children climb over him than lashing out in battle.
a.hoverk.effects: Keep on Rollin': 12% chance to proc 220 Nature damage

e.shudder-sailors-boarding-axe.name: Shudder Sailor's Boarding Axe
e.shudder-sailors-boarding-axe.effects:

 9+: 20% chance to proc 500 Physical damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 20%
e.shudder-sailors-boarding-axe.description:
"And then fair Marideth... it's so unfair that our passions were ripped asunder in such an untimely way."

"Well, Captain, if you'd stop deciding which ports to visit based upon rumours of the loveliness of their maidens..."

-Conversations with the crew of the Vengeance

u.parchment-of-brilliant-aura.name: Parchment of Brilliant Aura
u.parchment-of-brilliant-aura.description: A shining scroll, almost humming with divinity!

u.script-of-frost-cone.name: Script of Frost Cone
u.script-of-frost-cone.description: "Delight in the suffering chill of flesh! Frost Cone!"

e.threofor-pants.description: XIII. With limited interest in working alongside the bandits as they terrorized nearby villages, and with even less interest in returning home, Ceta set to work assisting the group in other ways, oftentimes seeking the assistance of the forest creatures she could call to her aid in order to do so. Whether it was having large birds remove debris from the roof, or valiant stags beat the laundry clean with their antlers, Ceta had decided she now needed to find her own purpose.

u.guild-purse-i.name: Guild Purse I

u.oceanic-overwhelming-obliteration-poti.description: Save the oceans by killing specific, harmful things within the oceans.

a.thundreag-stormchest.name: Thundreag Stormchest
a.thundreag-stormchest.description:
"When times are tough, adventurer, you have to seize the most challenging element by the throat and bend it to your will... And of course there is no element more challenging than that commanding the storm."
-Thundreag Stormchest
a.thundreag-stormchest.effects: Stormgrasper: 5% chance to proc 14,000 Lightning damage; Adds +3 Attack to each Stormshapers' Bolt and Stormshapers' Thunder in the Formation; Adds +0.5 Defence to Glyggle in the active Formation

cp.void-crystals-ten-special.description: An special adequate pack containing the premium currency of the realms.

c.desecrated-chains.name: Desecrated Chains
c.desecrated-chains.description: Chains that can bind the forces of the underworld to this plane of existence can be repurposed to seal in mystical powers to allow them to percolate.

"To think that you'd wear something that is clearly a mockery of the brilliance of the Thunderbeak... I'm disappointed to see it."
-Janagud

e.gipantan-recruit-pike.description:
"Ah, ye'd want to learn the sword instead? Sure, just give me two years t'train ye' t'not slice yer own foot off!"
-Lobaic Bronzefury

u.gold-codex-of-wisdom.name: Gold Codex of Wisdom
u.gold-codex-of-wisdom.description: Every now and again a rare gem among literature appears, conveying experience beyond its ken, capable of both inspiring future generations to greatness and reminding them of the lessons of history. The wisdom delivered by such works is invaluable, and should never be taken for granted.

e.dilays-dirk.name: Dilay's Dirk

e.dilays-dirk.description: This small blade appears nondescript at first glance, but a careful inspection of the hilt reveals the mechanism where stored poisons can be released onto the dirk.

e.friskfingers-rodent.description: It is unclear which thought arose first in your mind upon viewing this creature: Whether it would be as nimble and capable of finding its way virtually anywhere as its smaller counterparts, or the general disgust at such an oversized rat being presented to you.

u.script-of-holy-flame.description: "Divine love, glisten and provide to your children! Holy Flame!"

e.serpentine-stars.description:
"If a particularly nimble member of my tribe was able to sssneak passst the guard, it wasssn't uncommon to sssee them fall with metal disssks like thisss lodged in their backsss."
-Conversations with Seksehsa

c.philosophers-stone.name: Philosopher's Stone
c.philosophers-stone.description:
"With this, we could push past the existing limits of power and magic... Just think of the possibilities; we can synthesize the most potent of alchemical mixtures..."

"Wouldn't we simply be able to... I don't know... defeat death entirely?"

"Don't be a dolt.... Though, perhaps..."
-Conversations with Alanis

"May this adornment strike fear into the heart of demons, and drive back those who would cast darkness upon the world."
-Apui

c.fishbones.name: Fishbones
c.fishbones.description: You wouldn't have thought that some discarded bones would have much value, and you would largely be right. However, value must be in the eye of the beholder.

c.violet-mirgoda-leftovers.name: Violet Mirgoda Leftovers
c.violet-mirgoda-leftovers.description: Well, perhaps this answers the question of the colourful leavings?

u.mastru-river-barrel.name: Mastru River Barrel
u.mastru-river-barrel.description: It may be a simple gift from simple people, but you will treasure it as much as anything nobility might deign to give you.

a.arena-nymph.name: Arena Nymph
a.arena-nymph.description: Petite and sporting shimmering wings, this Nymph leaves a dusty residue in the air wherever she flies, and you've little doubt that Nereus makes use of this attribute. On a more productive front, you suspect it could distract your foes, and hope to put that theory to the test.
a.arena-nymph.effects: Nymph's Protection: 1% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 10%

e.medzeh-ring.effects:
+40 HP; +8% Dark Resistance; +100 Magic

 5+: +2% Crit Rate and +25% Crit Damage
 8+: Additional Bonuses depending on Main-Hand equipped
e.medzeh-ring.description:
"We Medzeh do not long for fancy baubles, but this simple piece may prove useful to you. Please, take it."
-Apui

c.violet-shed-snakeskin.name: Violet Shed Snakeskin
c.violet-shed-snakeskin.description: You don't know what colour of serpent would have shed this, but it is certainly a strange article to come across.

cp.wizard-starter-pack-i.description: A pack providing the necessary goods for every budding wizard.

c.green-xaphegorgh-horn.description: You could see how these wicked - and wickedly coloured - horns could assist in training exercises. Perhaps collecting a few could prove useful...

e.sung-leather-boots.description: VII. Today, the forest people are still spoken of with reverence by the Elves, and while their wordless Songs have been lost to time, the chants and hymns layered over the Songs by recent generations of Elves still seems capable of producing acceptable results.

c.blue-cloak.name: Blue Cloak
c.blue-cloak.description: A cloak made of fine materials and brilliantly coloured threads... You wonder what led to that creature possessing it.

e.psionic-shield-gloves.description: You almost wish you could grab a piece of that walking fungus to sample its flavour, now that your hands are protected from its spored attacks.

u.festivus-horn.name: Festivus Horn
u.festivus-horn.description: At Rarsik's behest, you raise your beverage and drink deeply, for tomorrow the adventuring continues.

u.script-of-radiant-light.name: Script of Radiant Light
u.script-of-radiant-light.description: "Star fall and sunbeams, shine forth upon us all! Radiant Light!"

u.gold-swiftness-tonic.name: Gold Swiftness Tonic
u.gold-swiftness-tonic.description:
An old legend tells of two colleagues exploring a dense forest, before happening upon a bear. When the bear gives chase, they both flee as swiftly as their feet will carry them. One of the colleagues pauses to quaff a draught from a small glass beaker. "You'll never be able to evade the bear forever, so why waste time with a last drink?!" His partner questioned incredulously.

"I need not escape the bear forever, ol' chum! I need only dodge its advances longer than you!"
u.gold-swiftness-tonic.effects: Increases Evasion equivalent to +215,000 Agility for 8 hours

c.heart-of-ice.name: Heart of Ice
c.heart-of-ice.description: The essence of one of the blizzarding horde creatures, miraculously intact despite the desperate fighting.

u.agliata-potion.name: Agliata Potion
u.agliata-potion.description:
"When the holy bulb blesses the tonic, you know that blessing will keep you safe from bloodsuckers."
-Corovar
u.agliata-potion.effects: +2% Crit Rate and +10% Offence vs Lord Kaspar for 12 hours

c.kylli-boost-i.name: Kylli Boost I
c.kylli-boost-i.description: It doesn't take much to get Kylli fired up, and sharing a drink with her is certainly on that list.. Passively boosts Kylli Oakenbrew's Attack by +3 (Max 15).

a.alagbato.name: Alagbato
a.alagbato.description:
"You surprise me, adventurer. To have studied cultivation, then to walk away from it, only to try your hand at it anew, followed by abandoning it once more... Now it seems the calling has reignited. Perhaps it is a sign of your true destiny?"
-Alagbato
a.alagbato.effects: Thriving Vines: 5% chance to proc 21,000 Nature damage; +500 damage per Onishaygu Lyowo or Uugun in the active Formation; Adds +30 Energy to the Player; Adds +3 Attack to each Onishaygu Lyowo or Uugun in the Formation

a.naven-hunter.name: Naven Hunter
a.naven-hunter.description: Rarely seen around town except when they are bringing game to the market, skilled hunters are often closely associated with the local Woodsmen, and are expertly efficient with a bow-and-arrow.

e.demonsbanes-cursed-mark.name: Demonsbane's Cursed Mark
e.demonsbanes-cursed-mark.effects:
Darker Deterrence (Mark): 14% chance to proc 1,200 Magic damage; +1.5% Crit Rate vs Demon raids
Set Bonus (Demonsbane's Cursed Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +100% Crit Damage
e.demonsbanes-cursed-mark.description: Some suggest that Ciri's powers were fueled by the life-force of those who's existences she had ended early, and stored that power in her Mark.

u.parchment-of-thrust.name: Parchment of Thrust
u.parchment-of-thrust.description: An ancient scroll, with strangely familiar markings!

c.green-bowstring.name: Green Bowstring
c.green-bowstring.description: The colour of string doesn't matter as much as its tension.

u.foaming-vitality-bundle-bag-i.name: Foaming Vitality Bundle Bag I
u.foaming-vitality-bundle-bag-i.description: A pack, filled to the brim with foaming potions!

e.duty-collectors-visor.name: Duty Collector's Visor
e.duty-collectors-visor.effects:
Duties Owed (Visor): 19% chance to proc 180 Psychic damage; +36 Psychic damage per Duty Collector's set item worn; +30 Magic
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.duty-collectors-visor.description:
"I mean, wouldn't wearing such a thick visor make it easier for smugglers and thieves to sneak by you, unnoticed?"

"I would not suggest attempting such a feat, Human, lest you fall victim to your own ignorance."
-Conversations with a Wharf Duty Collector

c.violet-squidlet.name: Violet Squidlet
c.violet-squidlet.description: As cute as this colourful creature may seem, Alanis has assured you that the bright tones are indicative of highly potent venom.

u.script-of-psychic-blast.name: Script of Psychic Blast
u.script-of-psychic-blast.description: "Awaken and overpower the senses with your embrace! Psychic Blast!"

e.picaroons-tricorne.name: Picaroon's Tricorne
e.picaroons-tricorne.effects:
Swabby Sealover (Tricorne): 8% chance to proc 200 Physical damage; +50 damage per Picaroon's Raiments set item worn; +400 damage vs Human raids; +0.25% Crit Rate
Set Bonus (Picaroon's Raiment Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +2% Crit Rate
 7+: +25% Crit Damage
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.picaroons-tricorne.description: There is something about donning this hat, one-handed, that harkens you back to childhood. You can't quite put your finger on it, but it leaves you grinning stupidly.

e.burnet-shoes.name: Burnet Shoes
e.burnet-shoes.effects:
Pixie Soot (Shoes): 24% chance to proc 400 Magic damage; +60 Magic
Set Bonus (Burnet Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +7% Evasion
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.burnet-shoes.description: Like many pixies, Burnets are very reluctant to relinquish that which they consider their own, and will fight to the fiery deaths in order to stave off any perceived attack on their property.

e.gastonia-pants.name: Gastonia Pants
e.gastonia-pants.effects:
Scutum Smash (Pants): 20% chance to proc 800 Physical damage; +7500 damage vs Guild Raids; +200 damage per Gastonia set item worn
Set Bonus (Gastonia Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +50 Honor, +30 Energy and +30 Vitality
e.gastonia-pants.description: VI(a). Leoben shook the dust out of his face and looked up as some surprisingly-well-dressed footmen loomed over him. "Not music lovers, I take it? No worries, I'm sure the lady will put in a good wor-" Leoben's sentence was cut off as one of the footmen took a swing at him, and he decided it was time to go. He didn't have to go far to lose the trio, before spotting a shell-game vendor down a popular alleyway.

ba.daring-general-banner.name: Daring General Banner
ba.daring-general-banner.description: Obtained with the Daring General Class

a.drunken-watchman.name: Drunken Watchman
a.drunken-watchman.description: Some would argue that its better to have someone guarding the gate than no-one, even if that someone is fairly inebriated. However, those people probably do not live in the outskirts of the village...

e.tiber-shortbow.name: Tiber Shortbow
e.tiber-shortbow.effects:
Paeknisar Prevention (Shortbow): 15% chance to proc 1,000 Nature damage; 3% chance to proc 5,000 Fire damage; +1.25% Crit Rate; +20% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Praetoran Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +40% Crit Damage and +1 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Fire'
e.tiber-shortbow.description: You were moderately skeptical that fisherfolk would have need for proficiency with bows, but after you watched a few claim some sizable river fish with them you couldn't help but nod in appreciation.

e.honorbounds-gloves.name: Honorbound's Gloves
e.honorbounds-gloves.effects:
Undermountain Redemption (Gloves): 4% chance to proc 175 Physical damage; +60 damage per Honorbound's set item worn
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.honorbounds-gloves.description:
"Cloth is not a material often worn by dwarves, as it offers little protection in the cavernous tunnels many call home. Most would prefer thick gloves that value function over form, or to wear none and display their calluses and scars with pride. The Honorbound are afforded neither of these options while atoning for their actions."
-Norsic Bittermail

c.jingse-offering.name: Jingse Offering
c.jingse-offering.description: An offering made to symbolize strength, and to seek good fortune in the year to come.

u.blue-brewmasters-mental-mixture.name: Blue Brewmaster's Mental Mixture
u.blue-brewmasters-mental-mixture.description:
"I've seen you getting chewed out by your female companion, but might I advise against using my potions simply to try winning an argument?"
-Nphireo

e.thunderbirds-swordbreaker.name: Thunderbird's Swordbreaker
e.thunderbirds-swordbreaker.effects: Graced by Thunder (Swordbreaker): 24% chance to proc 500 Lightning damage; +25 damage per Thunderbird set item worn
e.thunderbirds-swordbreaker.description:
"Graceful in flight, the Thunderbird is equally likely to evade a battle as to seek one out, and will elegantly feast upon the charred flesh of those it fells."
-Janagud

e.yotinpekew-storm-whip.name: Yotinpekew Storm Whip
e.yotinpekew-storm-whip.effects:
Storm Scalping (Storm Whip): 12% chance to proc 250 Lightning damage; +250 damage per Yotinpekew set item worn; +1.75% Crit Rate; +25% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Yotinpekew Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +1.5% Crit Rate
 8+: +35% Crit Damage and +0.75% Crit Rate
 9+: +1 Tiers of 'Arcane Defence - Flamebreath'
e.yotinpekew-storm-whip.description: An electrifying upgrade, you feel power surging within your hand as you hold this whip's thick handle.

u.silver-humanitarian-token.name: Silver Humanitarian Token
u.silver-humanitarian-token.description: The symbol of a humanitarian who has taken great efforts to help those in need. You feel deservedly respected and poised to carry on with good works.
u.silver-humanitarian-token.effects: Increases today's daily raid limit by 2

e.cumberworld-benefactors-skirts.name: Cumberworld Benefactor's Skirts
e.cumberworld-benefactors-skirts.effects:
+45 Vitality; +45 Energy; +45 Honor
Set Bonus (Cumberworld Benefactor Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1 Tiers of 'Discerning Vision', 'Astute Observation' and 'Precise Inspection'
 7+: +1 Tiers of 'Keen Eyes'
 8+: +100 Energy
 9+: +1 Tiers of 'Discerning Vision', 'Astute Observation' and 'Precise Inspection'
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.cumberworld-benefactors-skirts.description:
"You will never know the joy, or the challenge, of ensuring such finery is kept perfectly clean every night after my Lady has retired."
-Scolfield Retainer

a.gnome-abjurationist.name: Gnome Abjurationist
a.gnome-abjurationist.description: While you may wish that their magics applied to a broader group, the shielding and defensive magics these casters are able to offer are splendid, at worst.
a.gnome-abjurationist.effects: Adds +1 Player Honor per occupied Troop slot; Adds +0.1 Defence to Gnome Commanders in the active Formation

e.tungsten-sabatons.name: Tungsten Sabatons
e.tungsten-sabatons.effects:
Rustproof Enhancement (Sabatons): 6% chance to proc 750 Nature damage; +150 Nature damage per Tungsten set item worn; +7% Acid Resistance
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.tungsten-sabatons.description: It took you a period to realize, but you've identified that the sound made by these boots is distinct and different from the copper versions you used to wear.

u.loaf-of-dark-bread.name: Loaf of Dark Bread
u.loaf-of-dark-bread.description: Fine Dwarven-made bread, with some accompanying cheese. Your body warms and your stomach purrs as you eat it.

preReqs.name: resource
preReqs.errorMsg: Your health and energy are full already.

e.derzis-thunderclap-gloves.name: Derzis' Thunderclap Gloves
e.derzis-thunderclap-gloves.effects:
Lightning Divine (Gloves): 8% chance to proc 140 Lightning damage; +80 damage per Derzis' Thunderclap set item worn; 16% chance to proc 45 Lightning damage; +15 damage per Derzis' Thunderclap set item worn; +0.4% Evasion
Set Bonus (Derzis' Thunderclap Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +1 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Lightning
 8+: +1 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Lightning'
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.derzis-thunderclap-gloves.description: You were expecting gloves that protected you from lightning. Instead, you find yourself getting annoyingly shocked whenever you touch anyone, or most objects.

c.robust-brew-of-physicality.name: Robust Brew of Physicality
c.robust-brew-of-physicality.description: You've gone the distance, and now you're once more on your feet, standing as a person with naught more but their will to survive.

e.meftets-ring.name: Meftet's Ring
e.meftets-ring.effects: Capital Justice (Ring): 30% chance to proc 400 Dark damage; +20 damage per Meftet set item worn; +32 Offence
e.meftets-ring.description:
"The feral nature of the Meftet is matched only by its aversion to other creatures, even of its own kind. I suspect it is this reason that has led to it having such potent defences."
-Janagud

c.blue-nepyren-tulip.name: Blue Nepyren Tulip
c.blue-nepyren-tulip.description: A rare beauty, growing only on the lower slopes of the Nepyres Mountains, you can't help but wonder at the colourful petals.

c.blue-vildmand-champions-mark.name: Blue Vildmand Champion's Mark
c.blue-vildmand-champions-mark.description: While you initially thought these marks would be collected by the tribal leaders, it seems the champions of various battles or feats are distinctly honoured amongst these hill tribes.

e.demonsbanes-sabatons.name: Demonsbane's Sabatons
e.demonsbanes-sabatons.effects:
Dark Deterrence (Sabatons): 6% chance to proc 1300 Physical damage; +0.75% Crit Rate vs Demon raids
Set Bonus (Demonsbane's Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +80% Crit Damage
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.demonsbanes-sabatons.description: Rumours had even suggested that a village that Ciri Demonsbane once frequented made light of her changes, though this would be difficult to ever ascertain: Apparently the entire village vanished without a trace!

e.bountiful-byhew-chest.name: Bountiful Byhew Chest
e.bountiful-byhew-chest.effects:
Springtime Rejuvenation (Chest): 7% chance to proc 450 Nature damage; +250 damage per Bountiful Byhew set item worn; +2,800 damage vs Winter raids
Set Bonus (Bountiful Byhew Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +15% Nature Resistance and +15% Ice Resistance
 7+: +2 Tiers of 'Vulnerability Spotter - Swarm'
 8+: +3.5% Crit Rate and +40% Crit Damage
e.bountiful-byhew-chest.description: Courage may go a long ways, but proper armor helps you go even further.

u.lancer-starter-pack-iii.name: Lancer Starter Pack III
u.lancer-starter-pack-iii.description: A pack providing the necessary equipment for every budding lancer.

m.fallen-forgiveness.name: Fallen Forgiveness
m.fallen-forgiveness.description:
"The path for those who have departed, but have not yet departed, is not best walked with violence, but rather with forgiveness."
-Kitchi Wayguard
m.fallen-forgiveness.effects: Fallen Forgiveness: 15% chance to proc [up-to-13]% Nature damage; Bonus [up-to-60]% damage vs Undead raids

c.poison-slime-juice.name: Poison Slime Juice
c.poison-slime-juice.description: It's already viscous, thick and sticky, so why not add a tingle of poison for good measure?

p.stat-perception.name: Perception Stat Point
p.stat-perception.description: Stat Point for the Perception Stat

c.red-dragon-claw.name: Red Dragon Claw
c.red-dragon-claw.description: The claws of the dragon appear dyed from their victims.

c.snowdrake-snowflake.name: Snowdrake Snowflake
c.snowdrake-snowflake.description: A delicate yet masterful piece of glass and ice, it tickles the back of your mind that you've recently seen something of similar size and shape as this rare find.

c.frozen-heart.name: Frozen Heart
c.frozen-heart.description: It's strange enough carving out a fallen beast's heart whole, but when it is as cold and brittle as ice it is downright unnerving.

c.training-stipend.name: Training Stipend
c.training-stipend.description: A nominal allowance for nominal services provided; you only get what you pay for.

e.granite-blessers-boots.name: Granite-Blesser's Boots
e.granite-blessers-boots.effects:
Granite's Greatness (Boots): 15% chance to proc 200 Holy damage; +50 damage per Granite-Blesser's set item worn
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.granite-blessers-boots.description: VII. When a follower of Orimneni falls in battle, it is customary to return their body to the hearth of their own home, wrapped in thin cloths and with blessed stones placed upon their eyes and in their hands. Only after this has been accomplished will Orimneni be willing to invite her fallen children to her own hearth for the remainder of eternity.

c.violet-chaosoldier-hide.name: Violet Chaosoldier Hide
c.violet-chaosoldier-hide.description: Perhaps the hide of this foot-soldier will hold the key to learning how to deal with its fiery, demonic aura.

e.chandlers-sabatons.name: Chandler's Sabatons
e.chandlers-sabatons.effects:
Purified Paraffin (Sabatons): 40% chance to proc 155 Holy damage; +15 damage per Chandler's set item worn; +15 HP
Sanctified
Set Bonus (Chandler's Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: 2% chance to proc 2000 Dark damage and heal the Player 10 HP
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.chandlers-sabatons.description:
"You should come visit our garrison in Jouan, adventurer, and I'm sure that your experience would make for great stories to regale the troops with. It's uncommon to see these kinds of matters in the Acherales Republic."
-Chandler Deacon

e.hooded-veil-mask.name: Hooded Veil Mask
e.hooded-veil-mask.effects: Fangs Alot (Mask): 12% chance to proc 200 Poison damage; +25 damage per Hooded Veil set item worn; +4 Offence
e.hooded-veil-mask.description:
III. "While there have undoubtedly been otherss who have stood oppossed to Ssarfraxss, none before the Hooded Priesstesss had ssufficient power to ssurvive the onsslaught hiss followerss would inevitably bring."
-Seksehsa

e.gastonia-helm.name: Gastonia Helm
e.gastonia-helm.effects:
Scutum Smash (Helm): 20% chance to proc 800 Physical damage; +7500 damage vs Guild Raids; +200 damage per Gastonia set item worn
Set Bonus (Gastonia Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +50 Honor, +30 Energy and +30 Vitality
e.gastonia-helm.description: III(a). The ensuing maelstrom that erupted in the common room was impressive, and Leoben nimbly weaved to one side of the platform, and hopped over the first drunkard to rush towards him, throwing his lyre into the air before cartwheeling over a table, swinging a chair into an approaching patron, and retrieving the instrument as it fell while dashing out the door.

u.thiadoran-honor-barrel.name: Thiadoran Honor Barrel
u.thiadoran-honor-barrel.description: A large barrel, containing several bottles'-worth of fine Thiadoran vintage. You only hope nothing got mixed up during packaging.
u.thiadoran-honor-barrel.effects: Open to obtain its contents (ten of the chance drops)

e.earthshaker-reflex-helmet.name: Earthshaker Reflex Helmet
e.earthshaker-reflex-helmet.effects:
Crude Reflex (Helmet): 5% chance to proc 2,000 Physical damage; +1,000 damage per Earthshaker Reflex set item worn; 2% chance to proc 20,000 Physical damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 50%
Set Bonus (Earthshaker Reflex Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: 10% chance to proc 2,500 Physical damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 15%, +1 Tiers of 'Insurmountable Offence' and +1 Tiers of 'Unyielding Defence'
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.earthshaker-reflex-helmet.description: Being literally the heaviest thing to adorn your head to date, you are very much questioning whether the protection offered by this helm will be worth it. It does seem to muffle the complaints and lectures delivered by Alanis reasonably well, though.

k.brilliant-aura.name: Brilliant Aura
k.brilliant-aura.description: It's time to frighten those that delight in horrifying others.
k.brilliant-aura.effects: An attack designed to target terrifying creatures. Deals a 20x Holy-type attack to the Raid, but deals 4x the damage, and a bonus (7x Leadership) damage if the Raid has the Horrifying Raid Ability.

e.servid-gloves.name: Servid Gloves
e.servid-gloves.effects:
Servid's Service (Gloves): 32% chance to proc 45 Magic damage; +625 damage vs Guild Raids; +10 damage per Servid set item worn
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.servid-gloves.description: III. Brath was prohibited from reading a large selection of bounded, hard-covered books that belonged to his mother, and when he tried raising the matter with her (in what fashion he could) she was startlingly curt in her response. She continued providing her floral nourishment for the family, however, and it wasn't until the rise of the next full moon that Brath was once more wakened to his antler-clad mother sneaking out of the cottage. Uncharacteristically,

u.orange-guild-kit-iii.name: Orange Guild Kit III
u.orange-guild-kit-iii.description: A small, tidy sack, purporting to carry goods from the same source Slygse gets her alchemical wares.

e.skliros-devilled-cleaver.name: Skliros' Devilled Cleaver
e.skliros-devilled-cleaver.effects: Crueler Cleavage: 12% chance to proc 1,600 Dark damage; 4% chance to proc 3,000 Fire damage; +35% Crit Damage
e.skliros-devilled-cleaver.description:
"Be wary, adventurer, for it seems Skliros has reforged his cleaver, and is seeking an opportunity to test its prowess in combat."
-Glasha Brunbruk

c.blue-xaphegorgh-horn.name: Blue Xaphegorgh Horn
c.blue-xaphegorgh-horn.description: You could see how these wicked - and wickedly coloured - horns could assist in training exercises. Perhaps collecting a few could prove useful...

u.yellow-guild-kit-i.name: Yellow Guild Kit I
u.yellow-guild-kit-i.description: A small, tidy sack, purporting to carry goods from the same source Slygse gets her alchemical wares.
u.yellow-guild-kit-i.effects: Open to obtain its contents (two of the chance drops)

p.skill-acumen.name: Acumen Skill Point
p.skill-acumen.description: Skill Point for the Acumen Tech Tree

e.duty-collectors-orb.name: Duty Collector's Orb
e.duty-collectors-orb.effects: Duties Owed (Orb): 12% chance to proc 240 Psychic damage; +80 Psychic damage per Duty Collector's set item worn; +40 Magic
e.duty-collectors-orb.description:
"With a round orb like that, aren't you worried about dropping it, and it rolling into the sea?"

"If I was prone to dropping this orb, I would not have deserved to possess it in the first place."
-Conversations with a Wharf Duty Collector

e.embersin-helm.name: Embersin Helm
e.embersin-helm.effects:
+6% Fire Resistance; +20 HP
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.embersin-helm.description: I. The tales of Saijeor are not oft spoken of, but many rural folk share the stories to aid their children's passage to slumber. It is said that Saijeor was arguably the greatest dragon-hunter that has ever walked the lands, while other fables describe him as a cautionary tale, forewarning of the unintended consequences of even well-meaning acts.

e.yotinpekew-storm-thunderball.name: Yotinpekew Storm Thunderball
e.yotinpekew-storm-thunderball.effects:
Storm Scalping (Storm Thunderball): 12% chance to proc 250 Lightning damage; +250 damage per Yotinpekew set item worn; +1.75% Crit Rate; +25% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Yotinpekew Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +1.5% Crit Rate
 8+: +35% Crit Damage and +0.75% Crit Rate
 9+: +1 Tiers of 'Arcane Defence - Flamebreath'
e.yotinpekew-storm-thunderball.description: Why summon forth a little storm when a big one works twice as well?

u.noblemans-purse.name: Nobleman's Purse
u.noblemans-purse.description: A sizeable purse belonging to a nobleman.

s.scroll-xarbruutu.name: Xarbruutu Scroll
s.scroll-xarbruutu.description: You were led to believe that this could bring forth a pale imitation of the warlord who earned the title of Terror, but it may still be too much for you to handle alone.

e.pentwater-cuisses.name: Pentwater Cuisses
e.pentwater-cuisses.effects:
Blessed Boulder-Be (Cuisses): 8% chance to proc 120 Holy damage; +25 damage per Pentwater set item worn
Sanctified
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.pentwater-cuisses.description: VI. The House of Pentwater, raised by those closest to Malaclaven in honour of his name, went on to serve the dwarven realms, though it was often disregarded by the ruling class due to its lowborn beginnings. Few would recognize the legitimacy of the House today, and even fewer would claim any relation to it.

u.diplomat-starter-pack-i.name: Diplomat Starter Pack I
u.diplomat-starter-pack-i.description: A pack providing the necessary goods for every budding diplomat.

e.oresnatchs-great-orange-ring.name: Oresnatch's Great Orange Ring
e.oresnatchs-great-orange-ring.effects: Vazz's Pride and Joy: 100% chance to proc 500 Magic damage and give +1,000 Offence on that proc
e.oresnatchs-great-orange-ring.description: Somehow, jewelers were able to take the magnificence in Vazz's orange ring, and infuse it even more potently with more of his Rainbow Ore. It glows masterfully, and its magical powers gently settle upon you when you try it on.

c.snowdrakes-sleet-cinders.name: Snowdrake's Sleet Cinders
c.snowdrakes-sleet-cinders.description: Cinders from the incinerated body of an ancient snow dragon that was defeated, infusing this ashen material into your equipment is said to make it all-the-more effective against these creatures.

e.mikoko-miskwas.name: Mikoko Miskwas
e.mikoko-miskwas.effects:
Land's Rest (Miskwas): 7% chance to proc 580 Magic damage; +1,900 damage vs Undead raids; +290 damage per Mikoko set item worn; +1.5% Crit Rate; +15% Crit Damage; +5% Dark Resistance
Set Bonus (Mikoko Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +25% Crit Damage
 7+: +2% Crit Rate
 8+: +10% Dark Resistance
 9+: +1 Tiers of 'Inspirational Command: Horrifying'
e.mikoko-miskwas.description: Violence may not solve all of your problems, but when it is the solution it's best to be about it swiftly.

c.binding-cord.name: Binding Cord
c.binding-cord.description: It seems to take a lot of effort to restrain a magical being capable of altering their appearance and size, or of teleporting through reality at will. This enchanted cord will likely have a number of valuable uses for you.

e.vibrant-kunai.name: Vibrant Kunai
e.vibrant-kunai.effects:
Colours of Creation (Kunai): 30% chance to proc 120 Acid damage; +10 Acid damage per Vibrant Victors set item worn; 10% chance to proc 200 Acid damage; +75 Acid damage per Vibrant Victors set item worn
Set Bonus (Vibrant Victors Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +60 Vitality, +5 Energy, +5 Honor, +35% Crit Damage and +150 Magic
e.vibrant-kunai.description:
"Uh, I suspect you're unaware, but you're... dripping... a little."

"I know, already!"
-Conversations with Alanis, while Cyran Jokalyn cackles in the background.

e.meftets-cap.name: Meftet's Cap
e.meftets-cap.effects: Capital Justice (Cap): 30% chance to proc 400 Dark damage; +20 damage per Meftet set item worn; +16 Offence
e.meftets-cap.description:
"I've often looked at the beautiful coat of the Meftet in adoration, and wondered whether nature deserved such a beautiful design to exist. When you wear it like a crown, all I can think of is how much of an abomination it is."
-Janagud

e.moswa-hooves.name: Moswa Hooves
e.moswa-hooves.effects:
Palmate Overpower (Hooves): 25% chance to proc 480 Magic damage; +6000 damage vs Guild Raids; +120 damage per Moswa set item worn; 6% chance to proc 2400 Nature damage; +200 damage per Moswa set item worn
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.moswa-hooves.description: VII(a). As Cenius grew in power, spurred on by his endless, unsated rage, he paid little heed to the origin of a foreign voice that was reaching out to his mind, calling him to the nearby forests. Certain that this was either fate guiding him to his quarry, or at least to a new pathway to further power, Cenius ventured into the wilds, taming the entirety of nature as he went... Permanently.

c.blue-shield-of-amera.name: Blue Shield of Amera
c.blue-shield-of-amera.description:
"Amera's brother, Dhoesis, is often worshipped by healers for his powers of protection. Some say he needs them to keep us safe from his sister."
-Avri Stidig

c.blue-stone-claws.name: Blue Stone Claws
c.blue-stone-claws.description: It's said the gargouille's claws are permanently dyed by the flesh of its first kill; you are inclined to believe it after seeing these.

e.psyguard-bulwark-cuisses.name: Psyguard Bulwark Cuisses
e.psyguard-bulwark-cuisses.effects:
Guardian's Mind (Cuisses): 12% chance to proc 1,000 Psychic damage; +500 damage per Psyguard Bulwark set item worn; +25 HP; +40 Magic
Set Bonus (Psyguard Bulwark Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +10 Max HP on all Commanders and +10 Reserve Cap on all Troops
6: +1% Crit Rate and +15% Crit Damage
 7+: +10 Reserve Cap on all Troops and +1,000 Defence
 8+: 10% chance to reduce damage to your Armies by 50%
 9+: +1 Formation Protection Value
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.psyguard-bulwark-cuisses.description:
"They're pants. They protect your legs. What more were you expecting?"
-Alaion Torris

c.green-horde-battleaxe.name: Green Horde Battleaxe
c.green-horde-battleaxe.description: Not every axe used by the barbarian tribes is intended for combat. Some appear to denote rank. Others... Might be a cruel prank played on one another?

c.stonecrab-claw.name: Stonecrab Claw
c.stonecrab-claw.description: A separated claw from a deep-water crustacean, the pressure apparently hardens the shells of these creatures to obscene degrees, allowing them to grow to outlandish proportions. Unfortunately, the meat is apparently no good for consumption, otherwise this shell that outsizes your head would make for a spectacular prize.

c.green-shield-of-amera.name: Green Shield of Amera
c.green-shield-of-amera.description:
"When Amera feels spurned, whether by her followers or the other Gods, it isn't uncommon for years of droughts to follow."
-Avri Stidig

e.vildmand-platefur-staff.name: Vildmand Platefur Staff
e.vildmand-platefur-staff.effects:
Armored And Algid (Staff): 2011 chance to proc 600 Physical damage; +425 damage per Vildmand Platefur set item worn; +25% Crit Damage; 8% chance to proc 1,000 Physical damage and protect the Player against the Venomous Raid Ability
Set Bonus (Vildmand Platefur Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:

 6+: +10% Ice Resistance
 7+: +100 HP and +2,000 Defence
 8+: 5% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 20%
 9+: +30% Crit Damage and 75% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 5%
e.vildmand-platefur-staff.description: Tapping into strange, runic magics, this staff channels a fierce energy unlike any other you've wielded.

e.crusherclaw-pants.name: Crusherclaw Pants
e.crusherclaw-pants.effects:
Pressure Crush (Pants): 5% chance to proc 2200 Physical damage; +30000 damage vs Guild Raids; +700 damage per Crusherclaw set item worn
Set Bonus (Crusherclaw Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +0.5 Formation Protection Value
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.crusherclaw-pants.description: VI(a). It is said that the Hero of Hammerclaw spent an inordinate amount of time in the northern nations of the continent, and on one fateful trek across Ostaria he was begged by the local merchants, who funded much of the welfare in the nation, to protect their caravans from revolting locals. Despite his general judgement, the Hero of Hammerclaw took on the task, and put down a fair number of disgruntled peasants and farmers.

c.blue-polished-stone.name: Blue Polished Stone
c.blue-polished-stone.description: A brilliantly polished stone, sparkling with a rare hue.

a.baron-aureus-medic.name: Baron Aureus' Medic
a.baron-aureus-medic.description: In the unlikely event some unfortunate event befalls Honourable Stone, it pays to keep a contingent of medics handy to address any injuries.
a.baron-aureus-medic.effects: Adds +3 Attack and +0.5 Defence to Honourable Audia Stone and Ramor Metalborn in the active Formation

e.acheralan-colossal-condor.name: Acheralan Colossal Condor
e.acheralan-colossal-condor.effects: Nepyren Divebomb: 50% chance to proc 80 Physical damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 10%
e.acheralan-colossal-condor.description: Alanis mentioned that she had read about these great creatures in her studies, but that sport hunting and magic to enhance crop yields devastated their numbers. You don't know much about any of that, but you're sure you'd rather be riding on its back than in its talons.

c.violet-adventuring-clothes.name: Violet Adventuring Clothes
c.violet-adventuring-clothes.description: These regal, violet clothes appear similar to what you'd expect a magical acolyte to wear for their studies, or for an archmage's garb while devastating enemy forces. .

c.violet-fen-seedpod.name: Violet Fen Seedpod
c.violet-fen-seedpod.description: It is said that Fen Lure plants only produce seeds in the dead of night. You can't say whether this is true, but this is a rare find, indeed!

u.merchants-pouch.name: Merchant's Pouch
u.merchants-pouch.description: A small pouch belonging to a wealthy merchant.

e.mirgoda-fur-gloves.name: Mirgoda Fur Gloves
e.mirgoda-fur-gloves.effects:
Fetid Furs (Gloves): 25% chance to proc 200 Physical damage; +150 damage per Mirgoda Fur set item worn; +20 HP; +5% Crit Damage

 6+: +5% All Resistances
 8+: +80 HP and +10% Ice Resistance
 9+: +5% All Resistances and -10% Formation Bonus
e.mirgoda-fur-gloves.description: Fingers warm, check. Ability to handle your weapons, check. Ability to wipe the frozen snot from your nose without tickling yourself into sneezing-fits? Well, they almost checked all the boxes.

e.gipantan-dockhand-hat.name: Gipantan Dockhand Hat
e.gipantan-dockhand-hat.effects:
Barrel Hoister (Hat): 20% chance to proc 120 Dark damage; +40 damage per Gipantan Dockhand set item worn; +200 damage vs Aquatic raids; +5 Energy

 5+: +10 Energy
 8+: +20 Energy
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.gipantan-dockhand-hat.description:
"If you're going to spend much time in the sun, especially when folks are lobbing around heavy objects, you're going to want your head protected."
-Broff Keghaul

e.stevedores-cudgel.name: Stevedore's Cudgel
e.stevedores-cudgel.effects:
Wharf Walloping: 12% chance to proc 450 Physical damage
Set Bonus (Stevedore's Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +5% All Resistances
 8+: +5% All Resistances
e.stevedores-cudgel.description: You wouldn't have expected the seemingly-soft leather cudgels wielded by the stevedores to be particularly capable.... until you met a would-be thief with a jaw that clearly did not align properly.

e.training-sword.name: Training Sword
e.training-sword.description: A basic training sword, with a few notches and grooves from use.

s.scroll-unseelie-host.name: Unseelie Host Scroll
s.scroll-unseelie-host.description: The dark court of the Unseelie is varied in the company it keeps, but it still appears to be quite dangerous for interlopers to attend.

c.violet-vedfollen-feather.name: Violet Vedfollen Feather
c.violet-vedfollen-feather.description: This strange feather is unfamiliar to you, but Mauritio practically falls over himself to see it as you tentatively hold it. Apparently, it comes from a mythical bird, long thought to have been merely a creature of legend, and known for its immense size. Some say that it was so large that its ability to fly was plainly impossible. You suspect that someone could find a use for such a feather.

e.moswa-pants.name: Moswa Pants
e.moswa-pants.effects:
Palmate Overpower (Pants): 25% chance to proc 480 Magic damage; +6000 damage vs Guild Raids; +120 damage per Moswa set item worn; 6% chance to proc 2400 Nature damage; +200 damage per Moswa set item worn
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.moswa-pants.description: VI(a). Cenius learned how to siphon energy from living things, funneling them through himself as a conduit and then redirecting them outwards to accomplish his intended purpose. He started out drawing the living energies from household plants and the gardens, then moved on to small creatures, and finally onto one of the household servants. Cenius struck out, scouring the city for the hag, but without avail, and was left with his growing rage as he continued his search for her.

e.blazebrand-cocktail.name: Blazebrand Cocktail
e.blazebrand-cocktail.effects:
Justice by any Flames Necessary (Cocktail): 30% chance to proc 300 Fire damage; +100 damage per Blazebrand set item worn; 4% chance to proc 2,000 Fire damage and reduce damage to your Armies by 40%; +750 damage per Blazebrand set item worn; +15% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Blazebrand Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:

e.blazebrand-cocktail.description:
"If you keep throwing, I keep making more for you."
-Plyzz

e.pentwaters-stand.name: Pentwater's Stand
e.pentwaters-stand.effects:
Blessed Boulder-Be (Stand): 50% chance to proc 15 Holy damage; +4 damage per Pentwater set item worn
Sanctified
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.pentwaters-stand.description: II. The dwarven hero, Malaclaven Pentwater, was a devout individual, having traveled in his youth before studying under the tutelage of various scholars, ultimately dedicating himself to the teachings of Chaunath. He wielded a great shield, as was Her sigil, and bore down divine energies in massive bursts to strike out at his blasphemous foes.

u.fighter-starter-pack-iii.name: Fighter Starter Pack III
u.fighter-starter-pack-iii.description: A pack providing the necessary equipment for every budding fighter.

c.violet-mihrish-poster.name: Violet Mihrish Poster
c.violet-mihrish-poster.description: You had heard of posters to depict images of wanted criminals, but were unaware that businesses may be so overworked that they would publicly canvas for hirees.

c.green-fleshy-fen-tendril.name: Green Fleshy Fen Tendril
c.green-fleshy-fen-tendril.description: The base tendrils of fen foliage tend to be fleshy and moist... and unusually coloured!

e.yelte-demonslayer-blue.name: Yelte Demonslayer - Blue
e.yelte-demonslayer-blue.effects:
Divine Blue Donation: 40% chance to proc 500 Holy damage; +850 damage vs Demon raids; +4% Crit Rate; +50% Crit Damage
Sanctified
e.yelte-demonslayer-blue.description: Infusing the legendary bow with the mythical Dragonslayer gem was one piece of the puzzle, but something felt incomplete. It was only after you infused the radiant shards into it that the true purpose of the bow became clear, and its potential to strike down demonkind shone through.

e.nakanos-gloves.name: Nakano's Gloves
e.nakanos-gloves.effects:
Set Bonus (Nakano Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +75 Offence, +2% Evasion and +2% Crit Rate
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.nakanos-gloves.description: III. Nakano was no stranger to combat, either, as on the eve of her sixteenth birthday three of the other students ambushed her after training, intent on improving their own standing by destroying hers. Despite Nakano being initially unarmed, she was able to fend off the attackers, disarming them while arming herself, maiming one and killing another before the third fled.

u.script-of-magic-missile.name: Script of Magic Missile
u.script-of-magic-missile.description: "Strike at the darkness with unerring flight! Magic Missile!"

c.glasha-brunbruk-boost-i.name: Glasha Brunbruk Boost I
c.glasha-brunbruk-boost-i.description: Her skills as a demonologist have developed, and her training is certainly paying off. Passively boosts Glasha's Attack by +15 and Defence by +0.5 (Max 2).

e.reverent-titanslayer-band.name: Reverent Titanslayer Band
