e.reverent-titanslayer-band.description:
"Don' be gettin' the wrong idea. Yer not so bad-lookin', but yer far't'young fer me!"
-Krozana Titanslayer

a.shear-slysa.name: Shear Slysa
a.shear-slysa.description: Who better to command a horde of hedge-trimming statues than... Well, this terrifying being?
a.shear-slysa.effects: Slice-n-Dice: 30% chance to proc 3,000 Physical damage and add +2% Crit Rate; Adds +2 Attack and +1 Defence to each Shearing Statue in the Formation

c.fae-marked-tile.name: Fae-marked Tile
c.fae-marked-tile.description: Apparently it can take a fae to contain another fae. You suspect Marduk used tiles like this to keep his living specimens in check.

e.yelte-demonslayer-orange.name: Yelte Demonslayer - Orange
e.yelte-demonslayer-orange.effects: Divine Orange Donation: 40% chance to proc 350 Holy damage; +350 damage vs Demon raids; +3% Crit Rate; +30% Crit Damage
e.yelte-demonslayer-orange.description: Infusing the legendary bow with the mythical Dragonslayer gem was one piece of the puzzle, but something felt incomplete. It was only after you infused the radiant shards into it that the true purpose of the bow became clear, and its potential to strike down demonkind shone through.

c.practice-dummies.name: Practice Dummies
c.practice-dummies.description: Some straw-filled dummies make for obvious, if relatively safe, sparring partners.

a.three-hammers-doorman.name: Three-Hammers Doorman
a.three-hammers-doorman.description: The Three Hammers was arguably the most visited inn in the east-district of Mihr, at least until the invasion. Known for serving any-and-all races, this inclusivity drew a variety of different peoples, which in turn drew a varied degree of enmity. These doormen are well equipped to put a stop to any disputes that come to blows, and they may not be particularly forgiving to those that disturb the peace of the bar.

e.praetoran-hood.name: Praetoran Hood
e.praetoran-hood.effects:
Praetoran Modesty (Hood): 16% chance to proc 650 Nature damage; +50 damage per Praetoran set item worn

 7+: +40% Crit Damage and +1 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Fire'
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.praetoran-hood.description: A functional hood for spending long periods on a boat, you are pleasantly surprised to find out that it seems to keep the water off of you, though you cannot explain how.

e.pioneering-pixie-boots.name: Pioneering Pixie Boots
e.pioneering-pixie-boots.effects:
A Sprite's Searching (Boots): 10% chance to proc 450 Magic damage and add +3% Evasion; +550 damage per Pioneering Pixie set item worn; +0.4% Crit Rate
Set Bonus (Pioneering Pixie Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:

e.pioneering-pixie-boots.description:
No-one has ever complimented the size of your feet, so maybe these won't be so bad.

Nevermind, they are.

e.blazebrand-scourge.name: Blazebrand Scourge
e.blazebrand-scourge.effects:
Justice by any Flames Necessary (Scourge): 40% chance to proc 225 Fire damage; +50 damage per Blazebrand set item worn; 5% chance to proc 2,200 Fire damage; +1,100 damage per Blazebrand set item worn; +2.5% Crit Rate; +12% Crit Damage

e.blazebrand-scourge.description: The moment you hold the shaft, the runes flare to life, causing the tails of this vicious weapon to dance as flames.

c.blue-wooden-shackles.name: Blue Wooden Shackles
c.blue-wooden-shackles.description: These sturdy shackles were certainly built to keep prisoners from making foolish decisions... Though you suspect the bright colours were equally meant to provoke them in the meantime.

c.indigo-frigidara-defence-banner.name: Indigo Frigidara Defence Banner
c.indigo-frigidara-defence-banner.description: A banner intended to both rally troops to stave off Frigidara’s invasion, and to announce details about her horde’s locations. Aegyr truly seems to have thought of everything in this never-ending watch of his.

e.veiled-griphornis-pants.name: Veiled Griphornis Pants
e.veiled-griphornis-pants.effects:
Penumbra Plumage (Pants): 8% chance to proc 5500 Physical damage; +31250 damage vs Guild Raids; +1000 damage per Veiled Griphornis set item worn; 25% chance to proc 400 Dark damage; +150 damage per Veiled Griphornis set item worn
Set Bonus (Veiled Griphornis Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +110% Crit Damage

a.guild-guardian.name: Guild Guardian
a.guild-guardian.description: Constructed to assist the defence of the Guild, this guardian can follow simple commands delivered by any of its masters.

c.thinned-brew-of-divinity.name: Thinned Brew of Divinity
c.thinned-brew-of-divinity.description: Having kissed honeyed lips, and felt the healing power of her fingers, it burned like fire, coming from deep within her. I have adopted the angels' tongue, and walked alongside the devils, and despite the night being warm I was as cold as stone.

e.byhew-chest.name: Byhew Chest
e.byhew-chest.effects:
Springtime Renewal (Chest): 7% chance to proc 700 Nature damage; +1,500 damage vs Winter raids
Set Bonus (Byhew Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 8+: +3% Crit Rate and +30% Crit Damage
e.byhew-chest.description: It takes a courageous heart to fight in the name of Byhew, and equally gallant armor to protect that heart.

p.skill-fortitude.name: Fortitude Skill Point
p.skill-fortitude.description: Skill Point for the Fortitude Tech Tree

c.blue-map-fragment.name: Blue Map Fragment
c.blue-map-fragment.description: From even this small portion of the map you know it leads to a substantive prize... You cannot seem to puzzle out how the map's colours factor into the route, though.

c.green-repentant-dusk-mark.name: Green Repentant Dusk Mark
c.green-repentant-dusk-mark.description: A rare and chilling mark, symbolizing the sworn pledge offered by the Knights of the Repentant Dusk.

c.violet-demon-bindings.name: Violet Demon Bindings
c.violet-demon-bindings.description: Once used to bind demonic armor to its owner, you've heard some notions that the local orcs may be able to make use of these.

e.tungsten-legplates.name: Tungsten Legplates
e.tungsten-legplates.effects:
Rustproof Enhancement (Legplates): 6% chance to proc 750 Nature damage; +150 Nature damage per Tungsten set item worn; +7% Acid Resistance
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.tungsten-legplates.description: If you needed something to be pleased about, at least the inner lining of these leg-pieces seem to better protect you from being pinched when you move.

e.tromos-latria-cowl.name: Tromos Latria Cowl
e.tromos-latria-cowl.effects:
Returning the Damners (Cowl): 25% chance to proc 200 Dark damage; +100 damage per Tromos Latria set item worn; 2% chance to proc 650 Holy damage; +700 damage per Tromos Latria set item worn; +75 Magic; +3% Holy Resistance
Set Bonus (Tromos Latria Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:

 8+: +1 Tiers of 'Protective Guardian' and -10% Formation Bonus
 9+: +3% Crit Rate and -10% Formation Bonus
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.tromos-latria-cowl.description:
"Just because its a cowl doesn't automatically make it a death cult. Though that certainly seems to be the case, this time..."
-Alanis

c.green-mirgoda-leftovers.name: Green Mirgoda Leftovers
c.green-mirgoda-leftovers.description: Well, perhaps this answers the question of the colourful leavings?

e.friskfingers-gloves.name: Friskfingers Gloves
e.friskfingers-gloves.effects:

Set Bonus (Friskfingers Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1.5% Crit Rate, +30 Honor and +2 Tiers of 'Spare Change'
 6+: +3 Tiers of 'Spare Change' and +60 Vitality

 8+: +50 Vitality, +3 Tiers of 'Vulnerability Spotter - Pursuer' and +3 Tiers of 'Vulnerability Spotter - Elusive'
 9+: +50 Vitality, +1 Tiers of 'Keen Eyes' and +5 Tiers of 'Spare Change'
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.friskfingers-gloves.description: Considering the occupation, you half expected these gloves to be sticky to the touch. Thankfully, that does not appear to be the case.

e.hatuumin-boots.name: Hatuumin Boots
e.hatuumin-boots.effects:
Sight of the Eye (Boots): 8% chance to proc 825 Psychic damage; +225 damage per Hatuumin set item worn; 5% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 5%
Set Bonus (Hatuumin Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:

e.hatuumin-boots.description: VII. After that initial night, the remaining weeks of travel were banal, with the days scorching and the nights freezing, but Sinyu started recognizing the terrain as they grew closer to Agiz. Kontar took them off the path, towards a rocky outcropping, and after shifting some small stones he revealed a hidden switch that opened a small portal, with stairs leading downwards. Sinyu's amazement was cut short as two eyeless, bandage-wrapped beasts leaped out of the opening, and while his blows seemed capable of pushing them back, they were unable to damage the beasts. Luckily Sennie stepped in with his magic and was capable of dispatching the creatures, though not without exhaustive effort.

e.lumina-flash-shoes.name: Lumina Flash Shoes
e.lumina-flash-shoes.effects:
By the Light (Shoes): 12% chance to proc 1,000 Lightning damage; +125 damage per Lumina Flash set item worn; +1% Evasion; +2% Lightning Resistance
Set Bonus (Lumina Flash Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +2% Evasion and +1 Tiers of 'Advanced Evasive Maneuvers'
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.lumina-flash-shoes.description: Despite their metallic appearance, these shoes are soft-soled and surprisingly quiet when you move about.

c.violet-opal.name: Violet Opal
c.violet-opal.description: It's rare to find an opal of such a colour, but its capacity to store magics is what makes this rare stone truly exceptional.

e.byramaster-crafter-opener.name: Byramaster Crafter Opener
e.byramaster-crafter-opener.effects:
Legendary Lager (Opener): 40% chance to proc 250 Nature damage; +100 damage per Byramaster Crafter set item worn; +25 HP; +15% Crit Damage; 4% chance to proc 1,000 Physical damage and reduce incoming damage to your Armies by 50%

 7+: 4% chance to proc 5,000 Nature damage and add +10% Evasion and add +10% Crit Rate

e.byramaster-crafter-opener.description:
"Brewing the ale is half the battle. Ensuring you have access to it to taste it is another half."
-Varna Heartybrewer

a.precise-guild-servant.name: Precise Guild Servant
a.precise-guild-servant.description: Much more careful with his actions, this servant is the spitting image of dedicated servitude.

e.onishaygu-seedling-ring.name: Onishaygu Seedling Ring
e.onishaygu-seedling-ring.effects:
+20 HP; +30 Energy; +10 Vitality; +10 Honor

e.onishaygu-seedling-ring.description:
"Like a ssseed, sssometimesss sssomething ssso sssmall may ssseem insssignificant, but may hold potential beyond imaginassshun."
-Aaja Orisha

c.fractured-sword-hilt.name: Fractured Sword Hilt
c.fractured-sword-hilt.description: A mysterious hilt from an ancient blade, brimming with divine energies...

e.natures-revolt-chestplate.description:
"The land has hurt, it has wept, and now it is time for anger."
-Brocck of the Revolt

e.reodai-staff.name: Reodai Staff

c.lesser-support-token.name: Lesser Support Token
c.lesser-support-token.description: This diminutive token is given to those seeking to provide sound advice.

u.crispy-pear.name: Crispy Pear
u.crispy-pear.description: A crispy, spring pear, that seems infused with the energies of the season.

preReqs.errorMsg: Your health and energy are full already.

a.tunnel-hopping-miner.name: Tunnel-Hopping Miner
a.tunnel-hopping-miner.description: Mining into fresh earth requires a particular set of skills; bracing the tunnel against the the load, a method to safely extract rubble and the like. Digging from an existing, natural tunnel to another, is a different thing entirely.

c.arcane-clasps.name: Arcane Clasps
c.arcane-clasps.description: When studying strange and magical things, ordinary means of holding and collecting them will not suffice. These rune-laden clasps will let you safely pick up even the most delicate - or flighty - of specimens.

a.sishara.name: Sishara
a.sishara.description: A strange and capricious being, you've never met anything quite like this being. Half the time she seems to have no physical form, and the other half her form seems to be shifting. Unfortunately, she seems perfectly capable of mocking you during both of those halves.
a.sishara.effects: Fickle Fae: 20% chance to proc 950 Magic damage; Adds +15 Honor to the Player; Adds +1 Attack to each Fae Troop in the Formation

dy.wisteria-dye-tub.name: Wisteria Dye Tub
dy.wisteria-dye-tub.description: A tub of colourful dye that can magically improve the appeal of your equipment!

u.orange-naven-troop-draft-poster.name: Orange Naven Troop Draft Poster
u.orange-naven-troop-draft-poster.description: Used to draft Troops to your cause.

a.marble-golem.name: Marble Golem
a.marble-golem.description: You aren't entirely sure what led to the creation of these beings, or why so many were left in a seemingly-abandoned tunnel, but they seem perfectly amenable to following your command... at least, as best as you can figure, from their unmoving faces and tacit stares.

a.aelric-thorne.name: Aelric Thorne
a.aelric-thorne.description: A prudent and careful individual, Aelric was raised in an affluent environment with many privileges. It is unclear how his alchemical hobbies blossomed into his primary pursuits, though the bigger question is certainly how he hasn't managed to kill himself with his frantic, seemingly unhinged methodologies to his brewing.
a.aelric-thorne.effects: Voracious Viscosity: 32% chance to proc 400 Acid damage; 7% chance to proc 12,500 Acid damage and add +1,000 Defence to the Player; 2% chance to proc 30,000 Acid damage and add +10% Crit Rate to the Player; Adds +3 Attack and +1 Defence to each Viscous Alchemist or Viscous Herbalist in the Formation

u.beta-starter-pack-i.name: Beta Starter Pack I
u.beta-starter-pack-i.description: A Beta-exclusive Starter pack to aid you on your journey.

c.stormspike.name: Stormspike
c.stormspike.description: An invention of one of those Gnomish Stormchasers, supposedly this can redirect the electrical storm blasts.

m.ameras-anger.name: Amera's Anger
m.ameras-anger.description:
"While it isss true that many of our kind adhere to the teachingsss of Ssarfraxss, we recognissse the value in paying homage to Amera, too. There isss no better way to ssstart the day than by basssking in her warm, enveloping glow in the morning... That sssaid, if you intend to invoke her wrath, pleassse keep it fasssing the other direction."
-Conversation with Seksehsa, who is clearly backing away from you.
m.ameras-anger.effects: Amera's Anger: 12% chance to proc [up-to-20]% Fire damage; Bonus [up-to-65]% damage vs Undead raids; Bonus [up-to-90]% damage vs Undead raids if Irus' Love is also casted on the Raid

e.dark-piercer-chestpiece.name: Dark Piercer Chestpiece
e.dark-piercer-chestpiece.effects:

 9+: +3% Crit Rate and +1 Tiers of 'Advanced Critical Gaze'
e.dark-piercer-chestpiece.description:
"However, other tribes see the Feathuar as the natural counterpart to the Justice Feline, being a dark enforcer that deals with those pursuing unspeakable evils."
-Janagud

u.red-guard-tonic.name: Red Guard Tonic
u.red-guard-tonic.description: Originally concocted to keep him safe during his forays into the forest, Nphireo was oblivious to his creation's market-potential until a friend saw an ogre break a club harmlessly over Nphireo's head.

e.yotinpekew-sling.name: Yotinpekew Sling

 8+: +35% Crit Damage and +0.75% Crit Rate

e.yotinpekew-sling.description: Just as not every bolt of lightning is the same, not every storm's attack will mirror the previous. Striking consistently and true matters just as much as striking harshly.

c.leaf-talisman.name: Leaf Talisman
c.leaf-talisman.description: A rare talisman, deemed holy by the Elves; what was it doing here?

c.scriptures-of-arcane-memory.name: Scriptures of Arcane Memory
c.scriptures-of-arcane-memory.description: Alanis was absolutely beside herself when you fished these out of an assorted satchel you found during your journeys. Apparently they belonged to ancient, arcane scholars and are rumoured to possess the knowledge of how to 'best prepare yourself for any situation'.

c.fulgure-tooth.name: Fulgure Tooth
c.fulgure-tooth.description: A tooth from the storming beast itself, and you're coming to suspect that they can regrow them, considering how many you've been able to collect.

u.devils-honor-boost.name: Devil's Honor Boost
u.devils-honor-boost.description: This oddly coloured token emits a nauseating aura, along with a strange odour of evil... and wafer?

c.deluxe-hook.name: Deluxe Hook
c.deluxe-hook.description: It was quite a fight to drag this prize in, and while you were initially disappointed, the stark amazement that someone had found this prized, purportedly-enchanted hook that had long been lost assuaged your concerns. Apparently there was a handsome reward for its return.

e.mestari-dragonslayer-yellow.name: Mestari Dragonslayer - Yellow
e.mestari-dragonslayer-yellow.effects: Divine Yellow Empowerment: 40% chance to proc 300 Holy damage; +400 Holy damage vs Dragon raids; +10% Crit Damage
e.mestari-dragonslayer-yellow.description: The divine radiance of this blade glows even more brilliantly after you had that Dragonslayer gem forged into it. While it still feels somehow incomplete, it somehow still leaves you feeling… whole.

e.shudder-sailors-shoes.name: Shudder Sailor's Shoes
e.shudder-sailors-shoes.effects:

"It seems fate intends to make a liar out of me. As a man of action, lies do not become me!"

"I'm pretty sure all the looting, plundering and killing we've done counts like a lie or two..."

c.troll-axe.name: Troll Axe
c.troll-axe.description: A simple, primitive axe, though uncannily large by human standards. You're certainly glad this Hill Troll opted not to wield this when facing you.

-Durzub

c.jagars-red-wing.name: Jagar's Red Wing
c.jagars-red-wing.description: A section of wing from Jagar the Red, it seems to heat up if you hold it too long.

a.blazebrand-loader.name: Blazebrand Loader
a.blazebrand-loader.effects: Adds +0.6 Defence to Urzul Shamn and Plyzz in the active Formation

c.red-irus-fibula.name: Red Irus' Fibula
c.red-irus-fibula.description: A colourful brooch, showing reverence and homage to the God of the Moon, whom the Thiadorans believe protects them while they sleep, loves them while they wake, and has an unmitigated disdain for all things demonic.

ba.legendary-banner.name: Legendary Banner
ba.legendary-banner.description: Obtained with the purchase of a Legendary or Mythic Supporter Pack

u.mystery-guild-kit-i.name: Mystery Guild Kit I
u.mystery-guild-kit-i.description: A small sack, said to contain a variety of alchemical items.

e.jumbojay.description: You've no skepticism regarding the claims about these hunters being voracious, insect-devouring experts, but a fair amount regarding their capacity to transport you while doing so!

c.blue-repelling-rod.name: Blue Repelling Rod
c.blue-repelling-rod.description: A rod, blessed by the Church of Laetrie to repel undead and demonic beings.

a.jarvaskr.name: Jarvask'r
a.jarvaskr.description: Having earned a reputation as a wanderer, even amongst her native merfolk, Jarvask'r has not called any one area "home" in several decades. This has been particularly taxing on her body, however, and has left her looking unusually gaunt and enfeebled.
a.jarvaskr.effects: Sickly Submersible: 20% chance to proc 300 Dark damage

cp.warmage-starter-pack-iii.name: Warmage Starter Pack III
cp.warmage-starter-pack-iii.description: A pack providing the necessary equipment for every budding warmage.

u.mystery-guild-kit-v.name: Mystery Guild Kit V
u.mystery-guild-kit-v.description: A small sack, said to contain a variety of alchemical items.

Set Bonus (Threofor Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +25 Honor
e.threofor-helm.description: X. For the first while, observing the animals was just a method for Ceta to pass the time, in an attempt to forget her own misfortune. However, after some weeks Ceta began noticing various patterns and regularities in the behaviours of the creatures, and became entranced in their lives.

e.patriarch-servid.name: Patriarch Servid
e.patriarch-servid.effects:
Patriarch Trippant Gaze: 16% chance to proc 5435 Physical damage; +825 damage per Mephitic Chiffon or Mordant Moswa set item worn; 7% chance to proc 16000 Magic damage; +2400 damage per Mordant Moswa set item worn; 28% chance to proc 4995 Holy damage; +640 damage per Chiffon set item worn; +1000 Magic
Set Bonus (Mephitic Chiffon Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +6% All Resistances; 1% chance to heal the Player 5 HP
e.patriarch-servid.description:
XVI. With the adrenaline and fear seeping out of him, Brath collapsed to the ground, feeling the toll his body had taken during the combat wash over him. His shoulder aching, Brath struggled to breath deeply, and suspected he would want to visit a healer in Lenha before attempting to make the journey home. Brath dared not attempt to channel any mystic energies, for he knew that he was on his last vestiges of energy, and the nearby area was completely tapped dry... That is, until he saw a large deer step into view across the small glen. Brath stared at the strange creature, baffled by his failing to sense it before it stepped into view, until he heard a voice in his mind.

<We thank you for your assistance, Brath Kindspan, and offer our condolences for not assisting sooner>

Brath paused, before finding his voice.

"Wha-... who are you? What are you doing here? Are you sure you know who I am?" The rush of questions poured out of Brath before he could properly consider decorum while speaking with this clearly-mythical being.

<We are the guardians of these woods, though I'd have figured you would have remembered that. We could not approach that dark creature, lest We allow it to feed on our essences, which would enable it to wreak untold havoc and destruction. Finally, We are familiar with you; do you not remember Us?>

"To be frank, no, I would have thought I'd remember a talking, mythical deer... but my name is Hartwood, not Kindspan."

<Oh? That is peculiar. We were to believe that you inherited the names of your mothers>

Brath's breath caught in his throat.

"My mother...?"

e.oresnatchs-grand-red-ring.name: Oresnatch's Grand Red Ring
e.oresnatchs-grand-red-ring.effects: Vazz's Imagination: 100% chance to proc 1,200 Magic damage and give +7.5% Crit Rate on that proc
e.oresnatchs-grand-red-ring.description: Undoubtedly due to the wondrous base material they had to work with, but the jewelers seem to have figured out how to further force more Rainbow Ore power into Vazz's latest ring, improving its magical potential even further.

e.onishaygu-tendril-shield.name: Onishaygu Tendril Shield
e.onishaygu-tendril-shield.effects:

 9+: +200 Energy
e.onishaygu-tendril-shield.description:
"It is time for you to be the shield to the land, now that she has given you every opportunity to grow."
-Alagbato

a.alaion-torris.name: Alaion Torris
a.alaion-torris.description: A no-nonsense elf - not that you've met many that tolerate nonsense - you get a strange feeling when you gaze into Alaion's eyes, and don't care for the sense of pressure and tension it leaves behind.
a.alaion-torris.effects: Defender of the Followers: 5% chance to proc 52,000 Psychic damage and protect all Army Units from the effects of Flamebreath and Breath of Death on this proc; Adds +6 Attack to each Psyguard Magician and Psyguard Kinetic in the Formation

e.natures-revolt-band.effects:

 7+: +5% All Resistances and +150 HP

e.natures-revolt-band.description: This band seems to pulsate, as though it is alive. This would be fine, except that it seems to constrict tighter and tighter on your finger the longer you wear it.

e.embersin-legplates.name: Embersin Legplates
e.embersin-legplates.effects:
+6% Fire Resistance; +20 HP
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.embersin-legplates.description: IV. The specific deeds of Saijeor vary wildly after this, with most describing him as continuing to fight dragons in some capacity or another, and others claiming he settled down with his wife and lived out his days in comfort. Those describing his ongoing crusade against the dragons detail a variety of both heroic and dishonourable acts, ranging from saving villagers from being attacked, to locating dragon nests to destroy their brood before they even hatched.

u.indigo-entrancement-tonic.name: Indigo Entrancement Tonic
u.indigo-entrancement-tonic.description:
"It'll feel like you're in a trance, and you'll-"

"Trance? Aye, what good is a potion if it knocks you out on the battlefield for drinking it?!"

"Err, no, you'll retain full control of your faculties, and your aptitude for magic should increase several fol-"

"Maybe we can hurl'm at the enemy, and see if we can knock them all into trances!"
-A conversation between Nphireo and Rarsik

e.heroic-dusk-cuisses.name: Heroic Dusk Cuisses
e.heroic-dusk-cuisses.effects:
Evil's Dimday (Cuisses): 20% chance to proc 800 Physical damage; +300 Physical damage per Heroic Dusk set item worn; +10% Crit Damage; +1% Evasion; +25 HP
Set Bonus (Heroic Dusk Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +3% Crit Rate and +25% Crit Damage

 9+: +15% Formation Bonus and 10% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 30%
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.heroic-dusk-cuisses.description: Not dissimilar to the gauntlets, while these cuisses require some assistance to don, the restriction of movement you experience from them is amongst the lowest you've felt, compared to similarly heavy equipment.

c.red-cloak.name: Red Cloak
c.red-cloak.description: A cloak made of fine materials and brilliantly coloured threads... You wonder what led to that creature possessing it.

e.sung-leather-vest.name: Sung Leather Vest
e.sung-leather-vest.effects: Sungwood Symphony (Vest): 15% chance to proc 160 Physical damage; +50 damage per Sung Leather set item worn
e.sung-leather-vest.description: IV. With all hatred and conflict having fled from their hearts and minds, the Elves tacitly agreed to share their homes, hearths and hearts with the forest people, and a millennia-long harmony was born.

e.bevis-plate.name: Bevis' Plate
e.bevis-plate.effects:
Set Bonus (Bevis Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +40 Offence and +3% All Resistances
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.bevis-plate.description: II. It wasn't uncommon for Bevis' flock to lose several sheep per day to wolves and other wild animals, owing to their caretaker remaining absent. Of course, Bevis had little desire to stick around and fend off such terrifying beasts, though he would never admit as much!

a.guild-messenger.name: Guild Messenger
a.guild-messenger.description: Spreading newly obtained information, be it secretly obtained or simply a new public directive, is necessary for the proper working of any army.

e.honorbounds-shoes.name: Honorbound's Shoes
e.honorbounds-shoes.effects:
Undermountain Redemption (Shoes): 4% chance to proc 175 Physical damage; +60 damage per Honorbound's set item worn
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.honorbounds-shoes.description:
"Walking long stretches over jagged rocks necessitates tough footwear. The final garb-of-penance worn by the Honorbound offers no notable protection against the earth, as they are required to feel the contempt that Orimneni and her bretheren hold for their blasphemous actions."
- Norsic Bittermail

s.scroll-maroon-cannoneers.name: Maroon Cannoneers Scroll
s.scroll-maroon-cannoneers.description: A dastardly band of pirates roaming the waters, mercilessly preying upon hapless ships who stray too near the shoreline.

e.gipantan-dockhand-shirt.name: Gipantan Dockhand Shirt
e.gipantan-dockhand-shirt.effects:
Barrel Hoister (Shirt): 20% chance to proc 120 Dark damage; +40 damage per Gipantan Dockhand set item worn; +200 damage vs Aquatic raids; +5 Energy
Set Bonus (Gipantan Dockhand Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +10 Energy
 8+: +20 Energy
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.gipantan-dockhand-shirt.description: It may not be pretty, but for all the sweat it absorbs this shirt doesn't seem to smell particularly bad. You suspect Alanis may still disagree.

a.heren-luckyboot.name: Heren Luckyboot
a.heren-luckyboot.description: An incredibly non-descript individual, so much so that your eyes almost seem to roll off of him like a marble off an uneven table. Perhaps this is why he has seen such success as an unassuming lookout?
a.heren-luckyboot.effects: Friskfingers Spottings: 6% chance to proc 35,000 Dark damage; Adds +25 Attack to Alula Friskfingers in the active Formation; Adds +4 Attack to each Friskfingers Stickyfingers or Friskfingers Lookout in the Formation

a.mazoga-packraider.name: Mazoga Packraider
a.mazoga-packraider.description:
"You fared surprisingly well against that demon. It killed several of my raiders. If you plan to kill more of them, then I will follow you as pack-commander... for now."
-Mazoga Packraider
a.mazoga-packraider.effects: Raider's Oversight: 20% chance to proc 1,500 Physical damage; Adds +5 Attack and +0.2 Defence to each Orc Packraider Rusher and Orc Packraider Watcher in the Formation

u.mystery-guild-kit-iii.name: Mystery Guild Kit III
u.mystery-guild-kit-iii.description: A small sack, said to contain a variety of alchemical items.

e.oresnatchs-great-red-ring.name: Oresnatch's Great Red Ring
e.oresnatchs-great-red-ring.effects: Vazz's Pride and Joy: 100% chance to proc 500 Magic damage and give +5% Crit Rate on that proc
e.oresnatchs-great-red-ring.description: Somehow, jewelers were able to take the magnificence in Vazz's red ring, and infuse it even more potently with more of his Rainbow Ore. It glows masterfully, and its magical powers gently settle upon you when you try it on.

c.red-jolly-roger.name: Red Jolly Roger
c.red-jolly-roger.description: There is nothing jolly about this beacon-of-death, colourful though it may be.

a.elven-frigidara-defender.name: Elven Frigidara Defender
a.elven-frigidara-defender.description:
"If you plan to help, dress warm. Battle or not, it is only going to get colder from here on."
-Burz
a.elven-frigidara-defender.effects: Adds +2 Attack and +0.2 Defence to Aegyr Snowbound, Bellas Inahice and Burz in the active Formation

c.violet-tattered-pelt.name: Violet Tattered Pelt
c.violet-tattered-pelt.description: It was quite challenging to obtain this piece of pelt, as every time its stinger blasted you lost another chunk of fur. Well, better to lose the fur than a finger, you figure.

c.green-cannoneers-tricorne.name: Green Cannoneer's Tricorne
c.green-cannoneers-tricorne.description: A hat capable of both conveying threat as it conveys comfort, at least the bright colours ensure it is easily visible the next time the winds sweep it off your head and over the sides of the deck.

e.meftets-plumbatae.name: Meftet's Plumbatae
e.meftets-plumbatae.effects: Capital Justice (Plumbatae): 30% chance to proc 400 Dark damage; +20 damage per Meftet set item worn
e.meftets-plumbatae.description:
"The claws of the Meftet are said to be more akin to needles than knives, and are hidden until the moment they lash out with them. Those darts offer a fair comparison, I'd say."
-Janagud

c.nhuman-boost-i.name: Nhuman Boost I
c.nhuman-boost-i.description: The magic from in the Gold-tinged apples have permanently enhanced Nhuman. Passively boosts Nhuman's Attack by +20 (Max 2).

c.green-seared-stone.name: Green Seared Stone
c.green-seared-stone.description: Strangely colourful stones, you expect they could be used to help practice new maneuvers with your armies.

e.vildmand-platefur-wand.name: Vildmand Platefur Wand

 8+: 5% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 20%
 9+: +30% Crit Damage and 75% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 5%
e.vildmand-platefur-wand.description: Barbarism does not typically lend itself to the study of magic, and while their style of casting is different than what you've previously seen, you would never have expected to see mages amongst the ranks of the hordes.

a.merchants-aid.name: Merchant's Aid
a.merchants-aid.description: You feel surprisingly uneasy around these aids, despite their prim, proper and polite mannerisms. Perhaps it was when they abruptly corrected your speech when addressing Vanduin that rubbed you the wrong way.

c.kylli-attack-boost-i.name: Kylli Attack Boost I
c.kylli-attack-boost-i.description: A batch of Kylli's most expensive wine is hard to come by, but she may be willing to share it with you, under the circumstances. Passively boosts Kylli Oakenbrew's Attack by +15 (Max 5).

a.camellia.name: Camellia
a.camellia.description: A beautiful - if not particularly exotic - dancer, you can't help but stare when Camellia spins and contorts her body as she passes by you. Maybe it would be worthwhile to spend a little more time at the Carnival...
a.camellia.effects: Dance of Charms: 24% chance to proc 200 Psychic damage; Adds +1 to Eye for Beauty while in the active Formation; [Not yet implemented] If Bonaguido is in the active Formation, adds +1 to Attentive Perception while in the active Formation

e.moswa-gloves.name: Moswa Gloves
e.moswa-gloves.effects:
Palmate Overpower (Gloves): 25% chance to proc 480 Magic damage; +6000 damage vs Guild Raids; +120 damage per Moswa set item worn; 6% chance to proc 2400 Nature damage; +200 damage per Moswa set item worn
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.moswa-gloves.description: V(a). Furious at his own failing, and revolted by the abhorrent marking on his frame, Cenius began studying the mystic arts with a passion he had never previously displayed. He accumulated knowledge at a startling pace, tapping into arcane energies and learning how to direct them as he willed. However, perhaps spurred by his usual accelerated pacing, felt unsatisfied with how quickly he was developing in this area, and turned to darker magics in order to bridge his gaps all the faster.

e.dumvan-furs-polearm.name: Dumvan Furs Polearm
e.dumvan-furs-polearm.effects:
Brisk Buffer (Polearm): 19% chance to proc 300 Physical damage; +150 damage per Dumvan Furs set item worn; +800 damage vs Beast raids; +2% Crit Rate; +25% Crit Damage; 7% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 10%
Set Bonus (Dumvan Furs Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +10% Ice Resistance
 7+: +80 HP
e.dumvan-furs-polearm.description:
"Oh, you can clear a chimney quick with one of those. Just be careful not to trip with it."
-Shem

e.nakanos-waraji.name: Nakano's Waraji
e.nakanos-waraji.effects:
Set Bonus (Nakano Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +75 Offence, +2% Evasion and +2% Crit Rate
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.nakanos-waraji.description: V. One evening in the late spring, just as the cherry blossoms were beginning to fall, Nakano awoke unexpectedly, overcome by a terrible sense of unease. Unable to calm herself, she decided to take her practice blade to the yard and run through her training drills to settle her mind. As she passed by the door to her brother's rooms, however, she caught a glimpse of a shadow, and instinctively rushed to action.

u.medzehs-secrets.name: Medzeh's Secrets
u.medzehs-secrets.description: Some say the deepest secrets of the Medzeh are contained within this bag. Whether that is true or not, you graciously accept it, hoping it will be of use to you in the future.
u.medzehs-secrets.effects: Open to obtain its contents (four of the chance drops)

e.guardian-servid.name: Guardian Servid
e.guardian-servid.effects:
Guardian Trippant Gaze: 16% chance to proc 1435 Physical damage; +525 damage per Chiffon or Moswa set item worn; 7% chance to proc 10000 Magic damage; +1800 damage per Moswa set item worn; 28% chance to proc 2995 Holy damage; +340 damage per Chiffon set item worn; +400 Magic
Set Bonus (Chiffon Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +4% All Resistances; 1% chance to heal the Player 3 HP
e.guardian-servid.description: IX. Helci struck directly at the heart of Cenius, drawing upon an essence which had no life energies for him to siphon off: His own mortality. Having brought down the threat, and having opened herself up to these final stages of her studies, Helci's exhaustion was short-lived as she gazed upon the guardian of the forest watching her from a distance, its gazing eyes clearly accepting of her at last. However, rather than approach her, Helci saw it turn to depart, and a small figure near it, the form of which Helci almost thought she could make out, but then they were gone.

e.mountain-trekkers-shield.name: Mountain Trekkers Shield
e.mountain-trekkers-shield.effects:
Uphill Undertakings (Pointer): 10% chance to proc 150 Nature damage; +50 damage per Mountain Trekkers set item worn; +400 damage vs Winter raids; +5% Ice Resistance
Set Bonus (Mountain Trekkers Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +5% Ice Resistance
 7+: +20 Vitality
 8+: +5 Raid Cap
e.mountain-trekkers-shield.description:
"Take what precautions you need. We'll need you in tip top condition if those barbarians end up coming back!"
-Elian Greysky

e.oiled-leather-boots.name: Oiled Leather Boots
e.oiled-leather-boots.description: You've contemplated asking Alanis about which smells worse, the boots or your feet, but one knowing glance, followed by a glare of disapproval, dispelled that notion.

e.millennium-island-shield.name: Millennium Island Shield
e.millennium-island-shield.effects:
Last Everlasting (Shield): 30% chance to proc 200 Nature damage; +150 damage per Millennium Island set item worn; +15 HP; +3% All Resistances
Set Bonus (Millennium Island Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +100 HP, +1 Tiers of 'Immoveable Object' and +1 Tiers of 'Hearty Constitution'
e.millennium-island-shield.description:
"That shield looks like it was modeled after the shell of the great Seafarer. Despite my admonitions on some of your prior choices in equipment, I must acknowledge that the craftsmanship of this piece is adequate, if not inspiring."
-Janagud

e.waveblessed-shoes.name: Waveblessed Shoes
e.waveblessed-shoes.effects:
By the Waves (Shoes): 16% chance to proc 225 Nature damage; +175 damage per Waveblessed set item worn; 16% chance to proc 225 Holy damage; +175 damage per Waveblessed set item worn; +12 HP
Set Bonus (Waveblessed Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +400 Magic and 2% chance to heal the Player 0.6 HP
 7+: +30 HP and 4% chance to heal the Player 0.25 HP
 8+: +2% Crit Rate and +15% Crit Damage
 9+: +6% All Resistances and 5% chance to heal the Player 1.8 HP
e.waveblessed-shoes.description: Sturdy enough for a ship or adventuring across the continent, yet comfortable enough to not leave your feet blistered and raw.

a.woodsman.name: Woodsman
a.woodsman.description: Much more masterful at his craft than their apprentices, Woodsmen are known for their odd combination of brute strength, and silent grace, enabling them to provide not just for themselves, but also for the less-fortunate in the community.

u.red-brewmasters-strength-spirit.name: Red Brewmaster's Strength Spirit
u.red-brewmasters-strength-spirit.description:
"This should help you feel a bit stronger, though I can't vouch for the taste."
-Nphireo

ba.daring-assassin-banner.name: Daring Assassin Banner
ba.daring-assassin-banner.description: Obtained with the Daring Assassin Class

e.colossal-crusherclaw-pants.name: Colossal Crusherclaw Pants
e.colossal-crusherclaw-pants.effects:
Colossal Pressure Crush (Pants): 5% chance to proc 3000 Physical damage; +50000 damage vs Guild Raids; +1100 damage per Colossal Crusherclaw set item worn; 25% chance to proc 400 Nature damage; +400 damage per Colossal Crusherclaw set item worn
Set Bonus (Colossal Crusherclaw Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +1 Formation Protection Value
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion

c.redhead-shroom.name: Redhead Shroom
c.redhead-shroom.description: This bulbous mushroom has a distinct red cap, and a sharp, spicy taste to it. You suspect this is what Kurtis was talking about when he was discussing his love of 'red heads' over drinks.

ba.illustrious-oracle-banner.name: Illustrious Oracle Banner
ba.illustrious-oracle-banner.description: Obtained with the Illustrious Oracle Class

e.waveblessed-staff.name: Waveblessed Staff
e.waveblessed-staff.effects:
By the Waves (Staff): 10% chance to proc 500 Nature damage; +350 damage per Waveblessed set item worn; 10% chance to proc 500 Holy damage; +350 damage per Waveblessed set item worn; +1% Crit Rate; +4% All Resistances
Set Bonus (Waveblessed Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +400 Magic and 2% chance to heal the Player 0.6 HP
 7+: +30 HP and 4% chance to heal the Player 0.25 HP
 8+: +2% Crit Rate and +15% Crit Damage
 9+: +6% All Resistances and 5% chance to heal the Player 1.8 HP
e.waveblessed-staff.description:
"As you'll no doubt see, summoning one familiar can be quite challenging, and controlling it even more. You're leagues of training away from dealing with even a dozen."
-Caimie Seafoam

m.shockwave.name: Shockwave
m.shockwave.description:
"While it may seem like innate magics are the ultimate source of power, it can be far more useful to harness the energies bestowed by the Gods and direct them to our mutual bidding, yes?"

Nico Orbesco's eyes light up, though his mouth remains as stern as ever while he speaks.

"In this, let's us see what Derzis has to say about these winged beasties, yes?"
m.shockwave.effects: Shockwave: 30% chance to proc [up-to-15]% Lightning damage; Bonus [up-to-25]% damage vs Dragon raids

e.burnet-gloves.name: Burnet Gloves
e.burnet-gloves.effects:
Pixie Soot (Gloves): 24% chance to proc 400 Magic damage; +60 Magic
Set Bonus (Burnet Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +7% Evasion
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.burnet-gloves.description: Burnet Pixies are distinguished by their bright markings, strong affinity to fire (which is a rarity for most pixies), and their predilection to mischief of a most... destructive sort.

e.capranidan-lance.name: Capranidan Lance
e.capranidan-lance.effects: Honourable Passing: 15% chance to proc 100 Physical damage; +2% Crit Rate
e.capranidan-lance.description: VIII. Word of Bevis’ strength in this exploit soon reached the ears of the regional lords, and one knight, whose name has long been lost in retellings, took particular interest in the tale. The knight, apparently known for an honourable forfeit against an injured opponent in a tournament’s joust, spent months tracking down the path the story took, before finally locating Bevis and his father. While the stories are sparse on the details of the exchange, Bevis agreed to join the knight, though refused to become his squire, in order to begin a regimented training that would further enhance his already-impressive strength.

e.waveblessed-rod.name: Waveblessed Rod
e.waveblessed-rod.effects:
By the Waves (Rod): 4% chance to proc 700 Nature damage; +850 damage per Waveblessed set item worn; 4% chance to proc 700 Holy damage; +850 damage per Waveblessed set item worn; +35% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Waveblessed Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +400 Magic and 2% chance to heal the Player 0.6 HP
 7+: +30 HP and 4% chance to heal the Player 0.25 HP
 8+: +2% Crit Rate and +15% Crit Damage
 9+: +6% All Resistances and 5% chance to heal the Player 1.8 HP
e.waveblessed-rod.description:
"A magical conduit is as much a weapon as any blade or net. It is also the best way to seek the blessings of Eptiades in our quest."
-Azalea Waveblessed

u.grub-collectors-sack.name: Grub Collector's Sack
u.grub-collectors-sack.description: Offered by a hooded, shady stranger, you've no idea what they intend to do with all those mandibles...

e.picaroons-net.name: Picaroon's Net
e.picaroons-net.effects:
Swabby Sealover (Net): 12% chance to proc 200 Physical damage; +50 damage per Picaroon's Raiments set item worn; +300 damage vs Human raids; +1% Crit Rate; +5% Crit Damage; Deals 100 Physical damage on Crits
Set Bonus (Picaroon's Raiment Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +2% Crit Rate
 7+: +25% Crit Damage
e.picaroons-net.description: Not quite similar to what you might toss in Thiadoran combat, the secondary benefit of being able to catch your dinner is not easily overlooked.

a.experienced-guild-servant.name: Experienced Guild Servant
a.experienced-guild-servant.description: After having obtained more on-the-job experience, this servant's capabilities have improved even further.

e.horned-spangenhelm.name: Horned Spangenhelm
e.horned-spangenhelm.effects:
Thunderous Fury: 12% chance to proc 120 Lightning damage
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.horned-spangenhelm.description: Adorned equally by the fiercest of women warriors and by worshippers of Derzis, this horned headwear has extra padding on the sides which muffle sounds getting through. While this may be a hindrance when fighting on the battlefield, it will certainly save your ears from devastating claps of thunder.

u.script-of-tremor.name: Script of Tremor
u.script-of-tremor.description: "Rattle the air and shake the earth! Tremor!"
u.script-of-tremor.effects: Deals 9,000 Nature damage vs Guild Raids

e.nebekinessurs-hovering-chariot.name: Nebekinessur's Hovering Chariot
e.nebekinessurs-hovering-chariot.effects: Revealing the Path: 20% chance to proc 1,750 Magic damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 10%; 8% chance to proc 11,875 Magic damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 30%; 3% chance to proc 25,000 Magic damage, reducing damage to Armies by 20%, +20% Crit Rate and healing the Player +2 HP on proc
e.nebekinessurs-hovering-chariot.description: One of the most renowned magical scholars of the last centuries, Nebekinessur was known around the continent for his work that improved the quality of life for thousands of people, regardless of nationality or creed. It is said that he housed his sanctum away from prying eyes, potentially on another plane of existence entirely, and that it could only be reached by joining him, at his invitation, on a trip in his Hovering Chariot. You never expected such a thing to be real, let alone fall into your hands, and Alanis was positively awestruck when she realized what it was you had uncovered.

c.green-vedfollen-feather.name: Green Vedfollen Feather
c.green-vedfollen-feather.description: This strange feather is unfamiliar to you, but Mauritio practically falls over himself to see it as you tentatively hold it. Apparently, it comes from a mythical bird, long thought to have been merely a creature of legend, and known for its immense size. Some say that it was so large that its ability to fly was plainly impossible. You suspect that someone could find a use for such a feather.

a.gipantan-peltastai-recruit.name: Gipantan Peltastai Recruit
a.gipantan-peltastai-recruit.description: The stronger and more fortified recruits get trained on front-line combat, in the hopes that they will serve in the grand Gipantan legions when the need arises.
a.gipantan-peltastai-recruit.effects: Adds +4 Attack and +0.3 Defence to Lobaic Bronzefury in the active Formation

e.hatuumin-darts.name: Hatuumin Darts
e.hatuumin-darts.effects:
Sight of the Eye (Darts): 10% chance to proc 600 Psychic damage; +225 damage per Hatuumin set item worn; +0.5% Crit Rate
Set Bonus (Hatuumin Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +3% Evasion and +1 Tiers of 'Astute Observation'
e.hatuumin-darts.description:
X(c). Kontar stumbled forward, unprepared for the short drop in his step, before looking up and gaping with wonder. The world was scintillating and colourful, with all types of different plant and colour flooding his vision in every direction. Unable to help himself, he laughed aloud and rushed forward, taking in the sights, warmth and smells. This was a world completely foreign to him, and yet, so filled with... Where did Sinyu go?

The realization hit Kontar like a fist, and he noticed that he could not find either of his companions. Unperturbed, Kontar started looking around for them, certain he could find them sooner or later, and this land was certainly a marvel to explore in the meantime.

Into his third hour, however Kontar's anxiety was skyrocketing. Despite all the wonder of this realm, he was unable to find either Sennie or Sinyu, or ANYONE else, for that matter. For perhaps the first time in his life, he was truly alone.

e.dumvan-furs-staff.name: Dumvan Furs Staff
e.dumvan-furs-staff.effects:
Brisk Buffer (Staff): 19% chance to proc 300 Physical damage; +150 damage per Dumvan Furs set item worn; +800 damage vs Beast raids; +2% Crit Rate; +25% Crit Damage; 7% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 10%
Set Bonus (Dumvan Furs Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +10% Ice Resistance
 7+: +80 HP
e.dumvan-furs-staff.description:
"When I started using one of these as a walking stick, I got an earful from the village elder's wife..."
-Shem

u.blue-brewmasters-dextrous-draft.name: Blue Brewmaster's Dextrous Draft
u.blue-brewmasters-dextrous-draft.description:
"Please be wary, adventurer, of not straying too far ahead of your troops, and avoid forcing them to keep a pace they may not be able to follow at."
-Nphireo

e.pioneering-pixie-guard.name: Pioneering Pixie Guard
e.pioneering-pixie-guard.effects:
A Sprite's Searching (Guard): 17% chance to proc 180 Magic damage; +260 damage per Pioneering Pixie set item worn; +1.2% Evasion; +20 HP
Set Bonus (Pioneering Pixie Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1% Crit Rate and +15% Crit Damage
 7+: +1% Evasion
 8+: +0.5% Crit Rate and +0.5% Evasion
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.pioneering-pixie-guard.description: This laughably small shield won't likely protect you from much, but at least its light and sturdy enough to smack someone in the face with.

e.sanctified-leoegan-aspis.name: Sanctified Leoegan Aspis
e.sanctified-leoegan-aspis.effects:
As the Gods Command (Aspis): 6% chance to proc 1250 Holy damage
Sanctified
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.sanctified-leoegan-aspis.description: XI. Stunned by what had just happened, Paython noticed the burns were in a straight line from the bush, and glancing over his shoulder he saw that they seemed to point in the direction of yet another temple. Renewed hope welling up in his chest, Paython climbed to his feet and took off running.

a.sharog.name: Sharog
a.sharog.description: The burn marks and scars make clear that Sharog has had a tough life, but she seems undaunted in continuing her duties tending to the swamps.
a.sharog.effects: Bogwanderer: 8% chance to proc 10,000 Physical damage; Adds +3 Attack and +0.5 Defence to each Bogwalker Orc in the Formation; Adds +8% Acid Resistance to the Player

c.blue-vildmand-runic-focus.name: Blue Vildmand Runic Focus
c.blue-vildmand-runic-focus.description: The barbarian tribes' casters focus their energies through various runes in order to deliver powerful, magical blasts. It is certainly different than what you've experienced from Alanis, Nico and the others, but it seems no less effective.

a.benefactor-scolfield-footman.name: Benefactor Scolfield Footman
a.benefactor-scolfield-footman.description: While their titles may have changed, if modestly so, their duties to their mistress have not. You've still got a good mind not to cross them.
a.benefactor-scolfield-footman.effects: Adds +3 to Player Energy per occupied Troop slot

c.red-chaosoldier-hide.name: Red Chaosoldier Hide
c.red-chaosoldier-hide.description: Perhaps the hide of this foot-soldier will hold the key to learning how to deal with its fiery, demonic aura.

e.dromaeon-boots.name: Dromaeon Boots
e.dromaeon-boots.effects: Prehistoric Pummelling (Boots): 10% chance to proc 200 Physical damage; +2000 damage vs Guild Raids; +25 damage per Dromaeon set item worn
e.dromaeon-boots.description: I. Amongst the Orcs of the Roxterre Ridge, various stories are shared amongst the sub-clans, teaching the younger generation of various morals and lessons in order to encourage strength, growth, and camaraderie amongst their peers. While many of these tales are unique to each sub-clan, one of those that seem to be shared among each sub-clan describes the life and deeds of Ceta Heartcreek.

c.large-living-bait.name: Large Living Bait
c.large-living-bait.description: When simple bait can't get the job done, it is time to resort to bigger-and-better.

e.granite-blessers-guard.name: Granite-Blesser's Guard
e.granite-blessers-guard.effects:
Granite's Greatness (Guard): 14% chance to proc 225 Holy damage; +60 damage per Granite-Blesser's set item worn
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.granite-blessers-guard.description: II. Many aeons past, Orimneni took it upon herself to breath holy life into the rock, and the dwarves have striven to uncover and understand her work ever since. There are philosophical debates as to whether Orimneni was the one to construct the dwarven people and breathe life into them, or whether Skirfmir first constructed them and Orimneni gave them life, but fortunately these disagreements rarely lead to deadly confrontations, anymore.

a.avtan.name: Avtan
a.avtan.description: Despite his silent stares, you find it difficult to dislike Avtan. Apparently he was created by some mage who was warring with some other wizards, and has a keen disliking for arcane casters. Unsurprisingly, Alanis does not care much for him...
a.avtan.effects: Adds +5% Magic Resistance to the Player

e.vyldas-supplicant-zauberstab.name: Vylda's Supplicant Zauberstab
e.vyldas-supplicant-zauberstab.effects:
Glorious Bloodfeast (Zauberstab): 8% chance to proc 300 Dark damage, turning Dark Resistance into Weakness for this proc, and adding +1,000 Magic on that proc; +1,100 damage per Vylda's Supplicant set item worn; 5% chance to proc 150 Dark damage with +20% damage from any Dark damage on that proc; +550 damage per Vylda's Supplicant set item worn; +1.5% Crit Rate; +15% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Vylda's Supplicant Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1% Crit Rate and +10% Crit Damage
 6+: +3 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Dark' and +2,000 Magic
 7+: 1% chance to deal 25,000 Dark damage; +15% Crit Damage
 8+: +1.5% Crit Rate, and 1% chance of healing the Player +13 HP alongside -75% Formation Bonus on proc
e.vyldas-supplicant-zauberstab.description: A powerful staff, and while you feel your ability to channel magical energies flowing through it, the power seems to be enhanced even more than usual. Part of you worries about the source of this additional energy, but you're not about to look a gift horse in the mouth.

a.peleg.name: Peleg
a.peleg.description: You find it incredibly challenging to make out what Peleg's intentions are. You've never heard the man speak, but while his face remains stoic, his eyes illuminate whenever you catch him looking your way. He is an enigma, to be certain.
a.peleg.effects: Chromatic Covering: 12% chance to proc 200 Psychic damage and 200 Nature damage; 5% chance to proc 300 Acid damage and 300 Poison damage; Adds +25 Vitality to the Player; Adds +1 Attack to each Vitalic Goblin, Energizing Merman and Honourable Gohlehm in the Formation

c.demon-generals-tusk.name: Demon General's Tusk
c.demon-generals-tusk.description: An exceedingly large tusk from the demon general himself. You'd be awestruck if not for the pungent odour.

e.nyxifur-armor.name: Nyxifur Armor
e.nyxifur-armor.effects:
Slowly Unsteady (Armor): 8% chance to proc 500 Nature damage; +250 damage per Nyxifur set item worn; +0.5% Evasion
Set Bonus (Nyxifur Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +30% Crit Damage
 7+: +2% Crit Rate
 9+: +140 HP
e.nyxifur-armor.description: Stately enough to wear in meetings, protective enough to wear on the battlefield, and colourful enough to wear to the victory celebrations. What more could you ask for?

u.eastern-mastru-carp.name: Eastern Mastru Carp
u.eastern-mastru-carp.description: Not the juiciest of fish you've encountered, even from this region, but it is still surprisingly filling.

preReqs.name: resource
preReqs.errorMsg: Your health and vitality are full already.

c.red-xaphegorgh-horn.name: Red Xaphegorgh Horn
c.red-xaphegorgh-horn.description: You could see how these wicked - and wickedly coloured - horns could assist in training exercises. Perhaps collecting a few could prove useful...

c.blue-knotted-tendril.name: Blue Knotted Tendril
c.blue-knotted-tendril.description: This writhing tendril has tied itself in knots... perhaps that explains the strange hues?

ba.illustrious-spellbinder-banner.name: Illustrious Spellbinder Banner
ba.illustrious-spellbinder-banner.description: Obtained with the Illustrious Spellbinder Class

e.swamp-nomad-guard.name: Swamp Nomad Guard
e.swamp-nomad-guard.effects:
+20 HP; +2% Nature Resistance; +2% Poison Resistance
Set Bonus (Swamp Nomad Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +1 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Nature'
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.swamp-nomad-guard.description: A simple, vine-covered shield for a simple, vine-covered people.

u.greater-magic-resilience-potion.name: Greater Magic Resilience Potion
u.greater-magic-resilience-potion.description: A frothy, mesmerizing potion that smells of the ideal seasoning of ginger.

e.baron-aureus-exploderer.name: Baron Aureus' Exploderer
e.baron-aureus-exploderer.effects:
Golden Noble (Exploderer): 4% chance to proc 3,750 Magic damage; +1,875 damage per Baron Aureus' set item worn; +1% Crit Rate; +20% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Baron Aureus' Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +175 HP and +25% Crit Damage
 6+: +1.5% Crit Rate
 7+: +5% All Resistances
 8+: +1 Tiers of 'Keen Eyes'
 9+: Additional Bonuses depending on Mount equipped
e.baron-aureus-exploderer.description: Well, magical explosions are the same, regardless of the cost of the spell focus. At least, you once thought that, before noting to standing at last three paces further back in the future.

u.stor-vetrarbelgr.name: Stor Vetrarbelgr
u.stor-vetrarbelgr.description: A thick, wool-lined bag, filled with foreign, northern goodies.
u.stor-vetrarbelgr.effects: Open to obtain its contents (two of the chance drops)

e.kanitsume-carapace.name: Kanitsume Carapace
e.kanitsume-carapace.effects:
Squeeze and Slice (Carapace): 4% chance to proc 750 Physical damage; +12500 damage vs Guild Raids; +125 damage per Kanitsume set item worn; 40% chance to proc 40 Physical damage; +20 damage per Kanitsume set item worn
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.kanitsume-carapace.description: XVIII. Spurred into action by the sudden happening, the eldest brother rushed home to let his parents know what had transpired, but was met with overt disapproval and disbelief. V. Not a week later, Loric was raising his hand to shade his eyes as the sun beat down on him during a ministerial address his mistress was scheduled to make. The heads of several of the District's largest Guilds were present and awaiting a speech by the official, and were expected to make their own proclamations in response, which would set the stage for either quelling the fires of revolt, or setting ablaze the pyres of revolution. As his ashen-skinned mistress stepped forward to speak, she wobbled slightly, before catching herself and taking a deep breath. It seemed not to help, however, as by her third word she collapsed to the stone ground in a heap. Panic and commotion broke out in the crowd, and Loric saw the leaders of both the Forgemasters' and Masons' Guilds stepping forward, greed painted on their faces as they sought to seize an opportunity.

"What my lady was trying to say is that, after careful consultation with the officials in both Tahyrst and Haleah, we are prepared to meet with the Guild Chapters of each of these Districts in order to ensure an equitable redistribution of contracts. While it is undeniable that work relating to the shipyards has led to disproportionate compensation, the same cannot be said of other fields, such as forging."

Loric was unsure what had come over him, and had no recollection of when he had stepped up to the podium, but he took a breath before continuing.

"It is long past time that the Guild Chapters remain fragmented while being expected to work under the same contract conditions, and only by a willingness to bring everyone to the table for reasonable discussions and bargaining can positive change be effected."

As he listened, Sinyu's mind turned at the tale, which involved this Sennie fellow making use of a cursed book (yet another fault of foolish mages), and needing to seek absolution by... entering the land of the dead?!

Sinyu was about to immediately turn down an invitation for such a quest, until Kontar relayed that the secret entrance to this portal was in a tomb near to Agiz. Unsure how Kontar would know such a thing, the only thing Sinyu could think of was that this was his opportunity to finally go home.

e.mirays-legplates.description: VI. Shaking her head, Miray sought to break her train of thought, recalling any number of previous foes who had dwarfed her in stature but fallen all the same. She steadfastly strode forward, watching her opponent do the same as she kept an eye out for the caisson which would hold the arms the two fighters would choose from. As it came into view her heart sank anew, for what typically held a variety of weapons and shields now displayed only four items: a tri-pronged spear with rear-barbed tips and leather grips, a one-handed net with steel weights, a wooden buckler that was obviously incapable of surviving a stabbing strike, and a heavy wooden club. Of course, it would seem that Miray was not intended to emerge from this battle, as the challenger would select his weapons first, leaving Miray with little hope of keeping her pride, let alone her life, intact.

a.cumberworld-fool.name: Cumberworld Fool

a.schikitsuk.description: Hailing from a tribe far to the west, Schikitsuk was also deemed to have been touched by Ssarfraxss, though Schikitsuk apparently traces her lineage back to the Hooded Priestess herself. Where Seksehsa would glow brilliantly as he invoked his divine powers, Schikitsuk's energies flash instantaneously, leaving the world covered in floating spots as she restores life to all of those around her. In the face of the various types of destructive magics you've witnessed up until now, you are perhaps more impressed with the sheer power and utility employed by this naga, and are glad to have her amongst your party - providing she doesn't try to pronounce her name again!
