Set Bonus (Tedupevair Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +1 Tiers of 'Eye for Beauty'
 7+: 10% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 25%
 8+: +1 Tiers of 'Attentive Perception'
e.tedupevair-pants.description: You may have to venture far and wide to find rare articles. Best be comfortable while you do so.

u.dilute-honor-potion.name: Dilute Honor Potion
u.dilute-honor-potion.description: The idea that drinking this little potion would make you a more honourable person seems beyond disbelief. The vendor you shared this opinion with seemed less-than-pleased.

c.red-stained-snakescale.name: Red Stained Snakescale
c.red-stained-snakescale.description: This colourful scale was stained during your battle with the Naga.

e.dokumotsu-boots.name: Dokumotsu Boots
e.dokumotsu-boots.effects: Multipod Spray (Boots): 10% chance to proc 90 Acid damage; +30 damage per Dokumotsu set item worn; +0.5% Crit Rate
e.dokumotsu-boots.description:
"I've never heard of giant spiders before you mentioned them, but then again I've never heard of anyone traveling through the Đwergaz pass to get to Mihr before, either. I wonder what other mysteries the caverns might hold..."
-Hamond

u.ooleviash-energy-deoch.name: Ooleviash Energy Deoch
u.ooleviash-energy-deoch.description: This green potion is sweet, and has an interesting crunch to it as it goes down.

e.zircon-ring.name: Zircon Ring
e.zircon-ring.description: The metallic band doesn't impress any importance or value, but it still sends a surge of energy through you.

e.dumvan-furs-gloves.name: Dumvan Furs Gloves
e.dumvan-furs-gloves.effects:
Brisk Buffer (Gloves): 17% chance to proc 60 Physical damage; +100 damage per Dumvan Furs set item worn; +340 damage vs Beast raids; +3% Ice Resistance; +10 HP
Set Bonus (Dumvan Furs Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +10% Ice Resistance
 7+: +80 HP
e.dumvan-furs-gloves.description:
"Count your fingers, and check their colour. Be sure you end your day with the same counts."
-Shem

u.cask-of-taskberry-wine.name: Cask of Taskberry Wine
u.cask-of-taskberry-wine.description: For all you had heard about Dwarves loving their strong ales, this wine is surprisingly smooth, with a mildly tart aftertaste as it rejuvenates your body and spirit.

preReqs.name: resource
preReqs.errorMsg: Your health and vitality are full already.

a.river-windbringer.name: River Windbringer
a.river-windbringer.description: These quiet individuals seem to keep to themselves aboard the vessel, but you've some suspicions that their powers assist the ship in keeping its breakneck pace on the slower river bends.

c.green-shed-snakeskin.name: Green Shed Snakeskin
c.green-shed-snakeskin.description: You don't know what colour of serpent would have shed this, but it is certainly a strange article to come across.

s.scroll-galeohog.name: Galeohog Scroll
s.scroll-galeohog.description: You aren't sure if MegaArachnophobia would be a fear of large spiders, or a significant fear of spiders. In either case, the term is applicable here!

a.arendyl-greenleaf.name: Arendyl Greenleaf
a.arendyl-greenleaf.description: An ambitious elf, Arendyl walks a fine line between overt cognizance of his status as the third prince of the western elves, and his desire to prove his own worth beyond his name. As he will likely lead the elven forces one day, he has taken up training under the military veteran, Yathane, though his arrogance has been known to shine through on occasion.
a.arendyl-greenleaf.effects: Coached Captain: 20% chance to proc 180 Lightning damage

c.red-cracked-hammer.name: Red Cracked Hammer
c.red-cracked-hammer.description: Years of use have cracked the head of this hammer... you have no idea what has led to the colouration, however.

dy.garnet-dye-vial.name: Garnet Dye Vial
dy.garnet-dye-vial.description: A vial of colourful dye that can magically improve the appeal of your equipment!

a.slygses-werequill-wight.name: Slygse's Werequill Wight
a.slygses-werequill-wight.description:
"So, what do you say about a reverse sale for all my hard work?! What? You've never heard of a reverse sale before? It's where you pay extra for my goods and-or services!"
-Slygse
a.slygses-werequill-wight.effects: Restores 1 Reserve daily; Adds +1 Attack and +0.1 Defence to Slygse, Merchant Extraordinaire in the active Formation

e.firedrakes-wand.name: Firedrake's Wand
e.firedrakes-wand.effects:
Drake's Embers (Wand): 25% chance to proc 60 Fire damage; +8 damage per Firedrake set item worn
Set Bonus (Firedrake's Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +5% Fire Resistance
e.firedrakes-wand.description: I. Long before the first Dragon War, a young mage sought to make a name for herself, but while she had a keen sense for mystical engineering, she had a decidedly lacking sense of innovation and creativity.

e.psyguard-bulwark-rod.name: Psyguard Bulwark Rod
e.psyguard-bulwark-rod.effects:
Guardian's Mind (Rod): 17% chance to proc 800 Psychic damage; +400 damage per Psyguard Bulwark set item worn; 2% chance to proc 400 Psychic damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 10% on that proc; +200 damage per Psyguard Bulwark set item worn; +1% Crit Rate; +15% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Psyguard Bulwark Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +10 Max HP on all Commanders and +10 Reserve Cap on all Troops
6: +1% Crit Rate and +15% Crit Damage
 7+: +10 Reserve Cap on all Troops and +1,000 Defence
 8+: 10% chance to reduce damage to your Armies by 50%
 9+: +1 Formation Protection Value
e.psyguard-bulwark-rod.description:
"Surely you see the importance of protecting those who've sworn to follow you... Right?"
-Morah Psyguard

c.spiderling-legs.name: Spiderling Legs
c.spiderling-legs.description: Removing the legs from those spiderlings was a challenge, for they seemed to continue twitching even after death.

c.tuft-of-fae-coverings.name: Tuft of Fae Coverings
c.tuft-of-fae-coverings.description: A tuft of the Fachin's covering, though you're uncertain if it could be pieced back together into something you'd ever want to wear.

u.foaming-potion-of-tenacity.name: Foaming Potion of Tenacity
u.foaming-potion-of-tenacity.description: V. Distilling elixirs of his own modest courage, and of Guraldo's unshakable will, he was able to develop a draught to provide him the capability to buckle down and study, while assisting Guraldo in his own divine path.
u.foaming-potion-of-tenacity.effects: +20% Defence vs Guild Raids for 8 hours

e.rusted-hewing-axe.name: Rusted Hewing Axe
e.rusted-hewing-axe.description: While it is certainly preferable to keep your tools honed and well-cared for, occasionally these wisdoms go unheeded. Nevertheless, it seems well weighted, and still plenty sharp.

u.indigo-guild-kit-iv.name: Indigo Guild Kit IV
u.indigo-guild-kit-iv.description: A small, tidy sack, purporting to carry goods from the same source Slygse gets her alchemical wares.
u.indigo-guild-kit-iv.effects: Open to obtain its contents (three of the chance drops)

e.yaomori-bow.name: Yaomori Bow
e.yaomori-bow.effects:
Working Chorafia (Bow): 12% chance to proc 150 Physical damage; +100 damage per Yaomori set item worn; +2% Crit Rate; +30% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Yaomori Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +2 Raid Cap
 7+: +2 Raid Cap, +75 HP and +25 Vitality
e.yaomori-bow.description:
"Why would anyone carrying a bow be surprising? Would you want to get up and personal with a large beastie trying to clear your fields?"
-Tansy Croftfield

e.snowdrake-slaughterer-ring.name: Snowdrake Slaughterer Ring
e.snowdrake-slaughterer-ring.effects:
+1.5% Evasion; +600 Magic; +75 HP; +4% Ice Resistance
Set Bonus (Snowdrake Slaughterer Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +2% Crit Rate and +30% Crit Damage
 9+: +10% Ice Resistance
e.snowdrake-slaughterer-ring.description: The upside is that this version of the ring doesn't cause your hand to chill after you slip it over your finger. The downside is that you can't really feel your hand at all...

e.helm-of-longeares.name: Helm of Longeares
e.helm-of-longeares.description: These fluffy faux-ears may not actually enhance your hearing, but they do bring about a great deal of "oohs" and "awwws" from those around you as you pass by.

a.northern-brownie.name: Northern Brownie
a.northern-brownie.description: Industrious and hard working, you sometimes wish more of your armies could have work ethic like these individuals!
a.northern-brownie.effects: Adds +1 Attack to each Northern Brownie in the Formation

k.mounts-potential-flight.name: Mount's Potential: Flight
k.mounts-potential-flight.effects: While riding an Aerial Mount, you take to the skies, improving your combat abilities. For the next 4 attacks your Evasion increases by +x%, and your Crit Damage increases by +y%.

c.squirming-grub.name: Squirming Grub
c.squirming-grub.description: If you're going to be locking something up for a while, you'd best ensure it will be well fed!

e.wapiti-antlers.name: Wapiti Antlers
e.wapiti-antlers.effects:
White Rump Roar (Antlers): 25% chance to proc 200 Magic damage; +2000 damage vs Guild Raids; +25 damage per Wapiti set item worn; 6% chance to proc 600 Nature damage; +50 damage per Wapiti set item worn
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.wapiti-antlers.description: X. The clawed beast growled and mewled at the newcome creature, before nudging the smaller, fuzzy one with its nose and rushing back into the woods. Brath stared in awe at the new creature as it glanced sidelong at him, in all its majesty, and strode away into the forest. Kickingly,

e.heroic-dusk-gauntlets.name: Heroic Dusk Gauntlets
e.heroic-dusk-gauntlets.effects:
Evil's Dimday (Gauntlets): 20% chance to proc 800 Physical damage; +300 Physical damage per Heroic Dusk set item worn; +10% Crit Damage; +1% Evasion; +25 HP
Set Bonus (Heroic Dusk Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +3% Crit Rate and +25% Crit Damage
 8+: 4% chance to heal the Player 2 HP
 9+: +15% Formation Bonus and 10% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 30%
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.heroic-dusk-gauntlets.description: These thick gauntlets slide on surprisingly smoothly, and move with an uncanny degree of flexibility, in spite of the thick plates adorning them.

c.indigo-heroic-dusk-mark.name: Indigo Heroic Dusk Mark
c.indigo-heroic-dusk-mark.description: A rare and valuable mark, demonstrating your allegiance owed by the Knights of the Heroic Dusk.

e.rara-shell-collection-shells.name: Rara Shell Collection Shells
e.rara-shell-collection-shells.effects:
Fabulous, Darling! (Shells): 5% chance to proc 3,000 Nature damage; +1,000 damage per Rara Shell Collection set item worn; +1% Crit Rate; +15% Crit Damage; 20% chance to proc 200 Physical damage and add +5% Crit Rate
Set Bonus (Rara Shell Collection Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1% Evasion and +300 Magic
 6+: +5 Tiers of 'Nimble Defensive Training'
 7+: +4 Tiers of 'Evasive Maneuvers' and +1 Tier of 'Advanced Evasive Maneuvers'
 8+: +1% Evasion and 24% chance to proc 2,000 Nature damage vs Aquatic raids
e.rara-shell-collection-shells.description:
"Shells, darling! Fortified and protective on the outside, masking a vulnerable and personal inside. How marvelous."
-Luminarara

k.grapple.name: Grapple
k.grapple.effects: While equipping a Melee weapon, you grapple onto the foe in order to prevent it attacking your armies. For your next x attacks, your armies cannot be hit by regular Raid attacks, but you take 50% bonus damage from the Raid.

cp.wizard-starter-pack-iii.name: Wizard Starter Pack III
cp.wizard-starter-pack-iii.description: A pack providing the necessary equipment for every budding wizard.

c.violet-acheralan-bracer.name: Violet Acheralan Bracer
c.violet-acheralan-bracer.description: A high quality bracer, demonstrating the finesse of the Naitour's military armourers, with durability matching that of their famed patrol.

c.spell-focus-magic.name: Spell Focus - Magic
c.spell-focus-magic.description: A heavy, polished piece of ruby, this stone can be used as a medium to focus your mind upon the element of Magic.

c.violet-vildmand-runic-focus.name: Violet Vildmand Runic Focus
c.violet-vildmand-runic-focus.description: The barbarian tribes' casters focus their energies through various runes in order to deliver powerful, magical blasts. It is certainly different than what you've experienced from Alanis, Nico and the others, but it seems no less effective.

e.frostwarden-billy.name: Frostwarden Billy
e.frostwarden-billy.effects:
Arctic Aegis (Billy): 16% chance to proc 300 Ice damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 20%; +150 Ice damage per Frostwarden set item worn
Set Bonus (Frostwarden Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: 20% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 25%
e.frostwarden-billy.description: This large beast always appears to be chewing upon something, despite you never having witnessed it actually taking a bite of anything from the ground.

c.yelte-quiver.name: Yelte Quiver
c.yelte-quiver.description: A strange quiver, seemingly separated from its intended bow. It radiates an unusual, divine energy....

a.orcish-toiler.name: Orcish Toiler
a.orcish-toiler.description: In spite of their roving and reaving ways, many orcs choose to earn honest livings, and often take on manual labour professions. It certainly makes use of their great strength, along with continuing to develop it, and may assist in staving off some of the negative perceptions afforded to their whole race.
a.orcish-toiler.effects: Adds +2 Player Honor per occupied Troop slot; Adds +0.4 Defence to Orc Commanders in the active Formation; Adds +2 Attack to each Orcish Toiler in the Formation

u.fighter-starter-pack-ii.name: Fighter Starter Pack II
u.fighter-starter-pack-ii.description: A pack providing the necessary tools for every budding fighter.

c.mounted-antlers.name: Mounted Antlers
c.mounted-antlers.description: A glorified mounting of antlers, though you're told that they were not forcibly removed from the creatures.

e.bronzed-breastplate.name: Bronzed Breastplate
e.bronzed-breastplate.description: You had no idea that it would take so long, and so much assistance, just to don plated armors like this. You hope it'll be worth the effort.

c.red-glowstone.name: Red Glowstone
c.red-glowstone.description: This magical stone illuminates the darkness in a strange, colourful light.

a.willow-whispers.name: Willow Whispers
a.willow-whispers.description: You can't quite make out details of this wispy being, but it seems willing to follow your directions (more or less), as it flits about, leaving sparkling motes in its wake.
a.willow-whispers.effects: Forgotten Whispers: 4% chance to proc 6,250 Magic damage

u.tank-starter-pack-iv.name: Tank Starter Pack IV
u.tank-starter-pack-iv.description: A pack providing the necessary material for every budding tank.

e.viscous-viscount-pants.name: Viscous Viscount Pants
e.viscous-viscount-pants.effects:
Eccentric Ennoblement (Pants): 8% chance to proc 1,000 Acid damage; +500 damage per Viscous Viscount set item worn; 3% chance to proc 4,000 Acid damage; +125 damage per Viscous Viscount set item worn; +0.5% Evasion; +2% All Resistances
Set Bonus (Viscous Viscount Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1.5% Crit Rate
 6+: +10% Crit Damage
 8+: +150 HP
 9+: Additional Bonuses depending on Mount equipped
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.viscous-viscount-pants.description: You are curious as to how Viscount Thorne acquired his menagerie of beasts - You’ll have to thank Mauritio for that word - But you’re more worried about whether they are being treated well during his experiments.

e.nyxifur-shield.name: Nyxifur Shield
e.nyxifur-shield.effects:
Slowly Unsteady (Shield): 6% chance to proc 600 Nature damage; +425 damage per Nyxifur set item worn; +40 HP; +10% Nature Resistance
Set Bonus (Nyxifur Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +30% Crit Damage
 7+: +2% Crit Rate
 9+: +140 HP
e.nyxifur-shield.description: The grip of this shield is covered with a thick, soft fur. You almost want to keep using it for that fact, alone.

u.fighter-starter-pack-iv.name: Fighter Starter Pack IV
u.fighter-starter-pack-iv.description: A pack providing the necessary material for every budding fighter.

a.norsic-bittermail.name: Norsic Bittermail
a.norsic-bittermail.description: The designated overseer of the Honorbound, Norsic is serving under Dondomra on her religious mission and has tasked his Honorbound with the safety of her disciples and the Stoneworkers. Whether he knows the crimes committed by his troops or not, he does not seem to let on as he treats them all with a modicum of dignity, while working them hard in their daily tasks in order to ensure they regain their honour at a reasonable pace.
a.norsic-bittermail.effects: Defence of Stone: 13% chance to proc 150 Nature damage

c.violet-mystery-meat.name: Violet Mystery Meat
c.violet-mystery-meat.description: Despite Fagli literally drooling as Vinqa displays this from her stores, there is absolutely no chance that you could bring yourself to eat this. Knowingly, at least.

c.red-repentant-dusk-mark.name: Red Repentant Dusk Mark
c.red-repentant-dusk-mark.description: A rare and chilling mark, symbolizing the sworn pledge offered by the Knights of the Repentant Dusk.

c.yellow-thick-fur.name: Yellow Thick Fur
c.yellow-thick-fur.description: There is no doubting that this fur would keep you warm, even during a night out-of-doors, but you aren't convinced the colour would reduce your likelihood of being spotted.

c.ceremonial-dagger.name: Ceremonial Dagger
c.ceremonial-dagger.description: While it may not be the first thing you consider, Alanis has assured you that the magic focusing properties of this dagger will prove invaluable to the training of future casters.

u.tank-starter-pack-ii.name: Tank Starter Pack II
u.tank-starter-pack-ii.description: A pack providing the necessary tools for every budding tank.

e.viscous-viscount-occultopus.name: Viscous Viscount Occultopus
e.viscous-viscount-occultopus.effects:
Eccentric Ennoblement (Occultopus): 12% chance to proc 1,400 Magic damage; +450 damage per Viscous Viscount set item worn; +8% Psychic Resistance; +2.5% Evasion
Set Bonus (Viscous Viscount Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1.5% Crit Rate
 6+: +10% Crit Damage
 8+: +150 HP
 9+: +20% Psychic Resistance, 33% chance to proc 800 Magic damage with +30% Psychic Resistance on that hit
e.viscous-viscount-occultopus.description: A mesmerizing creature, its potent powers have apparently enhanced its magical capabilities. Though it never seems to stop moving, it also seems to never stop magically moving things around it, either!

e.watchers-mask.name: Watcher's Mask
e.watchers-mask.effects:
All-Seeing Blindness (Mask): 5% chance to proc 300 Dark damage; +30 damage per Watcher's set item worn
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.watchers-mask.description: You've wondered for some time why this mask was framed the way it is... Between it not being round, tentacled or only possessing a singular eye-hole, it seems inaptly named.

e.leoegan-boeotian-helm.name: Leoegan Boeotian Helm
e.leoegan-boeotian-helm.effects: Boeotian Bash: 2% chance to proc 3,250 Physical damage
e.leoegan-boeotian-helm.description: This rounded helmet certainly seems to differ from the items you've seen recruits from the capitol wearing. It almost looks like it has some similarities to what the Naitour patrol wears.

e.veedsamin-mages-staff.name: Veedsamin Mage's Staff
e.veedsamin-mages-staff.effects:
Mage's Casting: 20% chance to proc 225 Magic damage; +75 damage per Veedsamin Trainee's set item worn; 16% chance to proc 275 Holy damage; +50 damage per Veedsamin Trainee's set item worn; +14% Magic Resistance; +8% Holy Resistance; +35% Crit Damage; +100 Magic
Set Bonus (Veedsamin Trainee's Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 8+: +14% Magic Resistance; +8% Holy Resistance; +3 Tiers of 'Vulnerability Spotter - Sentinel' and +2 Tiers of 'Vulnerability Spotter - Elusive'
e.veedsamin-mages-staff.description:
"The Mages are not always bookish folks, nor are we seeking the next fiery death-balls or incurable poisons. In fact, that is often better left to the Alchemists."

You can't help but notice Alanis refusing to look your way.

-Conversations with Tietha Holyrood

e.onishaygu-tendril-pants.name: Onishaygu Tendril Pants
e.onishaygu-tendril-pants.effects:
Wild Sprout (Pants): 12% chance to proc 500 Nature damage; +250 Nature damage per Onishaygu Tendril set item worn; +30 Energy; +20 Vitality; +20 Honor; +30 HP
Set Bonus (Onishaygu Tendril Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +50 HP
 7+: +2 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Nature'
 8+: +40 Vitality and +40 Honour
 9+: +200 Energy
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.onishaygu-tendril-pants.description:
"Your growth has been impressive, to be sure, though I'd say you may have a fair amount more to do."
-Alagbato

e.yelte-bow.name: Yelte Bow
e.yelte-bow.effects: Divine Donation: 40% chance to proc 250 Holy damage; +3% Crit Rate; +30% Crit Damage
e.yelte-bow.description: A fabled bow of legend, Alanis proclaims that it should not exist while Yathane believed it only existed in stories. Said to be gifted to the elves by the Gods themselves, this unusually light bow shimmers with divine energies as you hold it, and it's draw feels supernaturally light.

e.scaled-boots.name: Scaled Boots
e.scaled-boots.effects:
Cobra Gaze (Boots): 6% chance to proc 120 Poison damage; +2 Magic
Set Bonus (Scaled Robes Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +30 Magic
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.scaled-boots.description: V. As a final counterstroke, Rhacel cursed the followers of Ssarfraxss, ensuring that they would be hated by all other mortals forever after. Or so the legends go…

c.green-assorted-bone-fragments.name: Green Assorted Bone Fragments
c.green-assorted-bone-fragments.description: Whether these originate from victims of the giant serpent, or some unfortunate soul that fell into the gorge, an experienced researcher could certainly make use of these.

u.red-guild-kit-iii.name: Red Guild Kit III
u.red-guild-kit-iii.description: A small, tidy sack, purporting to carry goods from the same source Slygse gets her alchemical wares.

c.sterling-bone-saw-kit.name: Sterling Bone Saw Kit
c.sterling-bone-saw-kit.description: The tools of modern medicine never cease to amaze... Not long ago, an injured soldier would face certain death on the battlefield, especially when a limb began to rot. Now, medics can shave away the dying flesh, so that the poor warrior can die at a later date!

s.scroll-burnet-pixies.name: Burnet Pixies Scroll
s.scroll-burnet-pixies.description: Many Fae are renowned for being clever, mischievous tricksters, but these are prone to cause wanton destruction with their carefree antics.

e.mortiday-steed.name: Mortiday Steed
e.mortiday-steed.effects:
Mortiday Celebration (Steed): 8% chance to proc 600 Dark damage; +300 damage per Mortiday set item worn; +5,000 damage vs Human raids
Set Bonus (Mortiday Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +20% Crit Damage
 8+: Reduces incoming damage from Human raids to the Player by 30%
 9+: +2.5% Crit Rate and +10% Crit Damage
e.mortiday-steed.description: For all the jubilant celebration and dancing you've witnessed, you wouldn't have expected the lumbering, plodding pace this steed seems intent traveling at.

c.apui-boost-i.name: Apui Boost I
c.apui-boost-i.description: The magical powers of the Timekeeper swirl and empower Apui, making him an even more formidable Medzeh. Passively boosts Apui's Attack by +20 (Max 2).

ba.heroic-templar-banner.name: Heroic Templar Banner
ba.heroic-templar-banner.description: Obtained with the Heroic Templar Class

u.red-daily-chest.name: Red Daily Chest
u.red-daily-chest.description: A reward for your continued efforts to push back the Void, awarded for logins 1-10 during the month.

cp.void-crystals-two-special.name: Void Crystals x15
cp.void-crystals-two-special.description: A special small pack containing the premium currency of the realms.

e.cave-cragsman-gloves.name: Cave Cragsman Gloves
e.cave-cragsman-gloves.effects:
+18 Max HP
Set Bonus (Cave Cragsman Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +2 Tiers of 'Defensive Rider - Terrestrial' and +2 Tiers of 'Mount Proficiency - Terrestrial'
e.cave-cragsman-gloves.description: The grips on these gloves are beyond anything you've experienced to date. You're sure to never let your weapon accidentally fall when wearing these!

a.seksehsa.name: Seksehsa
a.seksehsa.description: While he has been entirely forthcoming with you, and his worldly wisdom far surpasses your own, you remain hesitant about allowing a Naga to lay hands on you. Then again, you do tend to end up injured with some regularity, so having a dedicated healer on hand couldn't hurt.... right?
a.seksehsa.effects: Restorative Venoms: 13% chance to proc 277 Poison damage; 0.3% chance to heal the Player 5 HP

e.wapitis-orb.name: Wapiti's Orb
e.wapitis-orb.effects: White Rump Roar (Orb): 25% chance to proc 200 Magic damage; +2,000 damage vs Guild Raids; +25 damage per Wapiti set item worn; 6% chance to proc 600 Nature damage; +50 damage per Wapiti set item worn; +40 Magic
e.wapitis-orb.description: IX. Father was a strong man, and he had been the breadwinner in the family while in the city, but Brath never noticed any apparent upset or dissatisfaction at that change after the move. His father would not speak with Brath very much, which was all well and good, as Brath preferred not speaking much, anyway. Caringly,

a.oscar-the-drunk.name: Oscar the Drunk
a.oscar-the-drunk.description: Perhaps not the most charismatic of individuals, especially with his torn, stained shirt and pants that smell (of what you hope is spilled drink), Oscar has lived a hard life and seems as happy to indulge in the drink as to engage in a tavern brawl. Perhaps his skills can be pointed towards more worthy foes than villagers whom he feels have slighted him?
a.oscar-the-drunk.effects: Shirking Sobriety: 5% chance to proc 50 Physical damage

a.orcish-frigidara-defender.name: Orcish Frigidara Defender
a.orcish-frigidara-defender.description:
"When summoned, we come. Be grateful that Aegyr remains to watch over the frozen wastes."
-Burz
a.orcish-frigidara-defender.effects: Adds +3 Attack and +0.1 Defence to Aegyr Snowbound, Bellas Inahice and Burz in the active Formation

c.violet-faecage.name: Violet Faecage

a.goblin-slinger.name: Goblin Slinger
a.goblin-slinger.description: Proficient in a variety of arms, these Goblins were previously relegated to the lowest classes of Mihrish society prior the invasion, but were instrumental in fighting back the invading forces. Rather than return to obscurity, however, many have opted to join you in your quest to defeat the denizens of the Void, and bring their ranged-talents and accuracy along with them.

e.chaosoldiers-castoff-spikes.name: Chaosoldier's Castoff Spikes
e.chaosoldiers-castoff-spikes.effects:

Set Bonus (Chaosoldier's Castoff Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:

e.chaosoldiers-castoff-spikes.description: These strange darts flare with heat after striking their target, while also seeming to melt into its poor victim.

cp.void-crystals-five-special.name: Void Crystals x43
cp.void-crystals-five-special.description: A special modest pack containing the premium currency of the realms.

e.thiadoran-bireme.name: Thiadoran Bireme

e.thiadoran-bireme.description: A simple boat to help get you away from the fires, you have little desire to head out into choppy waters aboard this vessel.

e.sunbringers-wand.description: VI. Over the next few months Elderune's escape attempts grew more intricate and thorough as he learned from each failure as readily as he learned from every lesson he attended, regardless of whether he was capable of sitting comfortably in those lessons. Each and every time he returned, often at the hands of the groundskeeper, and administered fresh punishment before being delivered to the mess hall for breakfast.

c.yellow-cloak.name: Yellow Cloak
c.yellow-cloak.description: A cloak made of fine materials and brilliantly coloured threads... You wonder what led to that creature possessing it.

u.lesser-ice-resilience-potion.name: Lesser Ice Resilience Potion
u.lesser-ice-resilience-potion.description: A thinly brewed potion that tastes faintly of coriander...

c.blue-spiderpelt.name: Blue Spiderpelt
c.blue-spiderpelt.description: The hide of a giant spider, after proper curing, is as versatile as any leather.

"It'll feel like you're in a trance, and you'll-"

e.dromaeon-juvenile.description: XXIII. The stories vary wildly as to the details of the battle, some claiming Ceta took up arms and still defeated the Chieftain without drawing upon her magics, while others suggesting she struck the Orc Chieftain down in a single mystical stroke. Where the stories reconcile, however, is that Ceta ended up leading both the Orc Clan and the mountain bandits, and conferring upon both a strict adherence to balance and nature, passing down her magical experience to those with the potential to learn, and paving the way for a method of forging bonds between an Orc Clan and another group.

e.mephitic-chiffon-buckler-shield.description: IX. Listening to the earth, the air and the plants provided Brath with a relatively clear path to follow in order to identify the source of the corruption, despite the shadows of the trees reaching far as the evening sky darkened. It wasn't too long before the sounds Brath could hear shifted from the mystic and natural to that of voices, and Brath paused to listen. The chanting sounded to be an old dialect that Brath could not truly make out, but it sounded rehearsed rather than fluent, so that provided some small comfort. Brath crept forward, recognizing that he was far from skilled at stealth, but as he did he uttered a quiet chant to seek power from the nearby shrubs in order to further mask his approach. The spell worked, but Brath was aghast to realize that the shrubs he had sought assistance from died from the draw of power, small as it was; they were already being strained to their limit from the magics the cult was channeling, and had apparently been so for some time.

u.blue-indigo-heroic-dusk-chest.name: Blue-Indigo Heroic Dusk Chest

e.claws-of-justice-fingers.description:
"They say kings and leaders hold the lives of their subjects in their hands. Does the same hold true to battle commanders?"
-Janagud

a.gnomish-jeweler.name: Gnomish Jeweler
a.gnomish-jeweler.description: With a fine eye for detail, these jewelers are renowned across the region, even by the dwarves of Mihr (if begrudgingly). They are certainly cautious, but will prove invaluable in the face of enemy war-machines, or in identifying weaknesses in armor or battle-lines.

e.dromaeon-elder.name: Dromaeon Elder
e.dromaeon-elder.effects:
Elder Drepanoid Slash: 36% chance to proc 750 Physical damage; +500 damage per Gastonia or Griphornis set item worn; +2% Evasion; +2% Crit Rate
Set Bonus (Gastonia Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +50 Honor, +30 Energy and +30 Vitality
Set Bonus (Griphornis Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +70% Crit Damage
e.dromaeon-elder.description: IX. "You've a strange air, pal, but it's appreciated nonetheless." Helmo thanked the musician, his gratitude turning to awe as Leoben nodded and winked, before flipping a half-eaten apple into the air and taking a bite. Helmo grabbed at his now-empty pocket, before chuckling to himself. Leoben began to chuckle as well, before the newfound friends erupted into a raucous, full-bodied fit of laughter.

cp.void-crystals-ten.name: Void Crystals x75
cp.void-crystals-ten.description: An adequate pack containing the premium currency of the realms.

e.gong-longjoh-ring.name: Gong Longjoh Ring
e.gong-longjoh-ring.effects:
+120 HP; +3% Evasion
Set Bonus (Bountiful Byhew Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +15% Nature Resistance and +15% Ice Resistance
 7+: +2 Tiers of 'Vulnerability Spotter - Swarm'
 8+: +3.5% Crit Rate and +40% Crit Damage
e.gong-longjoh-ring.description: "Everlasting peace and safety year after year"

c.willow-whispers-attack-boost-i.name: Willow Whispers Attack Boost I
c.willow-whispers-attack-boost-i.description: You've never seen a nigh-ethereal being eat anything before, let alone these mystical apples. Passively boosts Willow Whispers' Attack by +10 (Max 1).

a.plyzz.name: Plyzz
a.plyzz.description: You've met your share of eccentric individuals by now - You refrain from glancing back at Mauritio as you contemplate that thought - But this strange goblin, with his incessant efforts to ignite virtually every flammable substance around him, may be one of the more volatile you've come across.
a.plyzz.effects: Blazebrand Incendiarism: 30% chance to proc 2,000 Fire damage; 4% chance to proc 30,000 Fire damage and add +30% Crit Damage to the Player; Adds +8 Attack to each Blazebrand Embersprite in the Formation; Adds +6 Attack to each Blazebrand Artificer or Blazebrand Loader in the Formation

e.frostwarden-guard.name: Frostwarden Guard
e.frostwarden-guard.effects:
Arctic Aegis (Guard): 8% chance to proc 400 Ice damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 18%; +75 Ice damage per Frostwarden set item worn
Set Bonus (Frostwarden Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: 20% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 25%
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.frostwarden-guard.description: You would have guessed that sturdier shields would have been more useful for the Frostwardens, but you fear querying Aisi and receiving another response celebrating the defensive powers of their magical wards.

e.baron-aureus-lobber.name: Baron Aureus' Lobber
e.baron-aureus-lobber.effects:
Golden Noble (Lobber): 4% chance to proc 3,750 Physical damage; +1,875 damage per Baron Aureus' set item worn; +1% Crit Rate; +20% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Baron Aureus' Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +175 HP and +25% Crit Damage
 6+: +1.5% Crit Rate
 7+: +5% All Resistances
 8+: +1 Tiers of 'Keen Eyes'
 9+: Additional Bonuses depending on Mount equipped
e.baron-aureus-lobber.description: It seems almost a shame to throw something this valuable at enemies on the battlefield, but if the alternative is letting them attack you, you'd gladly prefer this option.

u.yellow-brew-bag.name: Yellow Brew Bag
u.yellow-brew-bag.description: A tied-off bag, containing an unknown brew.
u.yellow-brew-bag.effects: Open to obtain its contents (two of the chance drops)

e.threofor-gloves.name: Threofor Gloves
e.threofor-gloves.effects:
Stegoslam (Gloves): 20% chance to proc 225 Physical damage; +2500 damage vs Guild Raids; +50 damage per Threofor set item worn
Set Bonus (Threofor Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +25 Honor
e.threofor-gloves.description: XII. More than a week after Ceta had started developing her kinship with these animals, the bandits were faced with a terrible encounter as a large feline-like creature stalked the bandit's leader to the residence. On the verge of being attacked at her doorstep, Ceta observed the encounter from her vantage point, before ushering over two large bears to rescue the robust woman, driving the creature away. That encounter ensured Ceta's freedom within the bandit hideout.

e.irus-shroud-crusade-armet.name: Irus' Shroud Crusade Armet
e.irus-shroud-crusade-armet.effects:
Forward Irus' Light (Armet): 16% chance to proc 600 Holy damage; +425 damage per Irus' Shroud Crusade set item worn; +2,250 damage vs Demon raids; +25 HP; +3% Fire Resistance; +3% Dark Resistance
Consecrated
Set Bonus (Irus' Shroud Crusade Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1.5% Crit Rate and +15% Crit Damage
 6+: +4 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Holy'
 7+: +10% Formation Bonus
 8+: +5% All Resistances
 9+: +15% Crit Damage and +10% Formation Bonus
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.irus-shroud-crusade-armet.description:
"Better to ensure that those who see us coming know it is us. That should bring comfort to those living under Irus' auspices, and fear to everyone else."
-Wilben Shroudbearer

e.stevedores-ring.name: Stevedore's Ring
e.stevedores-ring.effects:
+25 HP; +5% All Resistances
Set Bonus (Stevedore's Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +5% All Resistances
 8+: +5% All Resistances
e.stevedores-ring.description:
"You have to be prepared for virtually any kind of condition, and any kind of cargo when working here. Being swift of foot is certainly a prerequisite, but that alone can't protect against everything us workers are exposed to."
-Dockside Stevedore

e.dromaeon-tyrant.name: Dromaeon Tyrant
e.dromaeon-tyrant.effects:
Tyrant Drepanoid Slash: 36% chance to proc 4750 Physical damage; +1500 damage per Blessed Gastonia or Veiled Griphornis set item worn; +4% Evasion; +3% Crit Rate
Set Bonus (Blessed Gastonia Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +100 Honor, +75 Energy and +75 Vitality
Set Bonus (Veiled Griphornis Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +110% Crit Damage

e.veiled-griphornis-feathers.name: Veiled Griphornis Feathers
e.veiled-griphornis-feathers.effects:
Penumbra Plumage (Feathers): 8% chance to proc 5500 Physical damage; +31250 damage vs Guild Raids; +1000 damage per Veiled Griphornis set item worn; 25% chance to proc 400 Dark damage; +150 damage per Veiled Griphornis set item worn
Set Bonus (Veiled Griphornis Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +110% Crit Damage

e.hooded-veil-boots.name: Hooded Veil Boots
e.hooded-veil-boots.effects: Fangs Alot (Boots): 12% chance to proc 200 Poison damage; +25 damage per Hooded Veil set item worn; +4 Offence
e.hooded-veil-boots.description:
VII. "Ssome have ssaid that thiss wass the turning point that granted the Hooded Priesstesss immortal infamy amongsst her people, but otherss ssuggesst that thiss wass what ultimately led to her demisse. Little iss known, though I have heard sshe ssurvived many yearss passt thiss terrible incident."
-Seksehsa

c.fae-coin.name: Fae Coin
c.fae-coin.description: A mark of the local fae creatures, though used more readily by the local 'normal' folk as a currency.

c.green-nepyren-tulip.name: Green Nepyren Tulip
c.green-nepyren-tulip.description: A rare beauty, growing only on the lower slopes of the Nepyres Mountains, you can't help but wonder at the colourful petals.

u.cultists-remnants.name: Cultists' Remnants
u.cultists-remnants.description: A collection of remnants that appears to have been brought by - and left behind by - the cultists, presumably for their master. Maybe they really knew that their end was approaching...

u.sepulcher-strongbox.name: Sepulcher Strongbox
u.sepulcher-strongbox.description: An unusually heavy, dark chest, that seems to thrum with an unseen force as you approach it. It contains the most valuable secrets left behind by those who have long-since departed.

c.green-explosive-stinger.name: Green Explosive Stinger
c.green-explosive-stinger.description: Notwithstanding the size and colour of this appendage, the fact that it can deliver both venom and an explosive blast leaves you hesitant about handling it!

a.rarsik.name: Rarsik
a.rarsik.description: Rarsik Smeltbreaker may be the son of the gnomish mayor of Naven, but he has worked hard to develop his trade as a carpenter. His skills with the hammer are certainly mirrored with the axe, but don't appear to have transferred over to diplomacy...

e.fogcreeks-tunic.name: Fogcreek's Tunic
e.fogcreeks-tunic.effects:
Set Bonus (Fogcreek Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +100 Offence and +12% Crit Damage
e.fogcreeks-tunic.description: II. The woods offered a terrific escape, and after years of spending virtually all her free moments there she knew them better than she knew the scars on the backs of her hands. She could identify every tree and bush, not only by species but even individually from each other of its kind, and she was intimately familiar with the fauna of the forest as well.

c.red-runecarver.name: Red Runecarver
c.red-runecarver.description: Unlike a sharp tool that would merely cut into stone, this seems to leave a powerful, magic-infused etch behind on the rock. Part of you wants to try to draw some funny pictures, but between Alanis' scolding and the potentially explosive natural consequences, you decide against it.

e.capricious-conducer-ring.name: Capricious Conducer Ring
e.capricious-conducer-ring.effects:
Conducive Conductivity (Ring): 6% chance to proc 3,100 Lightning damage; +800 damage per Capricious Conducer set item worn; +25% Crit Damage; +2 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Lightning'
Set Bonus (Capricious Conducer Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1% Evasion
 6: +1.5% Crit Rate and +15% Crit Damage
 7+: Additional Bonuses depending on Shield equipped
 8+: 2% chance to proc 10,000 Lightning damage and give +50% Evasion on that proc
 9+: Additional Bonuses depending on Shield equipped
e.capricious-conducer-ring.description: You've grown accustomed to the hum and pulsating of magic, but the energy that seems to thrum within this ring seems an entirely different thing altogether.

e.upland-buubry.name: Upland Buubry
e.upland-buubry.effects: Loch Leap: 40% chance to proc 2,250 Physical damage; 30% chance to proc 1,300 Magic damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 10%; 5% chance to proc 4,000 Magic damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 25%; +1% Evasion
e.upland-buubry.description: According to Rhona, or at least as best as you can make out, this strange fowl is the thing of legends, and even spotting one is the tale of a lifetime for most. Alanis was speechless when she spotted you riding the creature, and Janagud seemed positively beside-herself with excitement.

c.redwinter-soapberry.name: Redwinter Soapberry
c.redwinter-soapberry.description: Supposedly a rare berry, you’d expect it to be easy to spot, considering the vibrant colours, but you are surprised to learn just how sparsely it grows around here. Myksor seems to hold it in high value, however.

a.waveblessed-shiphand.name: Waveblessed Shiphand
a.waveblessed-shiphand.description: They work hard, not because they are told to, but because of how strongly they believe in their cause.
a.waveblessed-shiphand.effects: Adds +5 Attack and +0.5 Defence to Azalea Waveblessed in the active Formation

e.reverent-titanslayer-warden.name: Reverent Titanslayer Warden
e.reverent-titanslayer-warden.effects:
Behemoth Bouldery Bash (Warden): 20% chance to proc 700 Holy damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 15%; +300 damage per Reverent Titanslayer set item worn; +50 HP; +3% All Resistances; +0.75% Evasion
Set Bonus (Reverent Titanslayer Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +2% Crit Rate and +25% Crit Damage
 6+: +100 HP and +6% All Resistances
 7+: 6% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 80%, and 4% chance to reduce damage to Armies by 75%
 8+: 8% chance to proc 2,400 Holy damage and protect the Player and their Armies from Breath of Death
 9+: +30% Formation Bonus
e.reverent-titanslayer-warden.description:
"Since ye' seem worried all the'time, ye' can carry one of these t'help make ye' feel better!"
-Krozana Titanslayer

e.gastonia-spikes.name: Gastonia Spikes
e.gastonia-spikes.effects:
Scutum Smash (Spikes): 20% chance to proc 800 Physical damage; +7500 damage vs Guild Raids; +200 damage per Gastonia set item worn
Set Bonus (Gastonia Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +50 Honor, +30 Energy and +30 Vitality
e.gastonia-spikes.description: IV(a). Once out the door, Leoben continued his flight on foot, dodging through merchant wagons and passing townsfolk as he went, though he did stop to scoop up a fruit from one of the vendors, to the obvious verbal dismay of that merchant. Leoben's luck ran out as he ran into the side of a small carriage, breaking through the door and landing... at the feet of a beautiful young woman in white, diaphanous, silken robes, hiding her face behind a painted fan.

c.indigo-fae-candle.name: Indigo Fae Candle
c.indigo-fae-candle.description: The flame from this candle seems to dance in unnatural ways... Almost as unnatural as the hues of the flame, itself.

e.colossal-crusherclaw-claws.name: Colossal Crusherclaw Claws
e.colossal-crusherclaw-claws.effects:
Colossal Pressure Crush (Claws): 5% chance to proc 3000 Physical damage; +50000 damage vs Guild Raids; +1100 damage per Colossal Crusherclaw set item worn; 25% chance to proc 400 Nature damage; +400 damage per Colossal Crusherclaw set item worn
Set Bonus (Colossal Crusherclaw Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +1 Formation Protection Value
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion

u.violet-antipoison-potion.name: Violet Antipoison Potion
u.violet-antipoison-potion.description: Drinking the bog slime and eating the fen bushes seems more appealing than downing this.

u.lesser-potion-of-valour.name: Lesser Potion of Valour
u.lesser-potion-of-valour.description: I. Guraldo the Orc knew he was destined for greatness, but could not overcome his crippling fear when faced with virtually any adversity, whether it was a foe in the practice yard or his overbearing mother.
u.lesser-potion-of-valour.effects: +500 Offence vs Guild Raids for 4 hours

e.warmage-guardians-sabatons.name: Warmage Guardian's Sabatons
e.warmage-guardians-sabatons.effects:
Magic Shield (Sabatons): 20% chance to proc 500 Physical damage and add +200 Defence; +175 damage per Warmage Guardian's set item worn; +6% Crit Damage; +10 HP
Set Bonus (Warmage Guardian's Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +1% Crit Rate
 7+: +500 Defence and +15% Crit Damage
 9+: +20% chance to proc 200 Magic damage with +6% damage from any Magic damage on that proc
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.warmage-guardians-sabatons.description: Comfort isn't particularly important, especially when this fussy mages don't seem to like walking far, or quickly, in the first place.

a.knimbag-glasser.name: Knimbag Glasser
a.knimbag-glasser.description: You have the utmost respect for anyone capable of working with glass, as rare and precious a commodity that it is, but Knimbag takes it to a whole new level. True, you've little understanding of the little glass things he is building, and even less understanding of what he is putting into them, but even Alanis was speechless while watching him work, and that alone was worth asking him to join your ranks.
a.knimbag-glasser.effects: Charge in a Bottle: 8% chance to proc 5,000 Lightning damage; Adds +10 Attack to Dhiva and Yagnatz in the active Formation

u.heros-confirmation.name: Hero's Confirmation
u.heros-confirmation.description: The true hero seeks not applause nor gratitude, but merely does whatever it takes to serve and aid those in need. An honest confirming of a hero’s existence comes not from their own proclamations, but from the whispers of those left better-off in their wake.

u.script-of-shocking-grasp.name: Script of Shocking Grasp
u.script-of-shocking-grasp.description: "Strip away flesh with glistening blades! Shocking Grasp!"

e.nakanos-gi.name: Nakano's Gi
e.nakanos-gi.effects:
Set Bonus (Nakano Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +75 Offence, +2% Evasion and +2% Crit Rate
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.nakanos-gi.description: II. Despite every effort by her parents to dissuade her, Nakano remained steadfast to her training, waking before the dawn to warm up for classes, and spending hours every day under the tutelage of many great samurai masters, often besting her male peers during the lessons.

u.gipantan-health-potion.name: Gipantan Health Potion
u.gipantan-health-potion.description: A healing potion refined in Thiador, you can’t help but wonder if the exorbitant cost is in support of the rebuilding efforts.

e.meftets-shoes.name: Meftet's Shoes
e.meftets-shoes.effects: Capital Justice (Shoes): 30% chance to proc 400 Dark damage; +20 damage per Meftet set item worn; +16 Offence
e.meftets-shoes.description:
"The soft pads on the feet of the Meftet allow them to prowl terrifyingly close to their prey, and strike silently. Unfortunately, it served little good when they were walking into a trap baited by elderberries."
-Janagud

c.green-tattered-pelt.name: Green Tattered Pelt
c.green-tattered-pelt.description: It was quite challenging to obtain this piece of pelt, as every time its stinger blasted you lost another chunk of fur. Well, better to lose the fur than a finger, you figure.

e.acheralan-shirt.name: Acheralan Shirt
e.acheralan-shirt.effects:
+0.1% Evasion
Set Bonus (Acheralan Attire Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +2 Tiers of 'Spare Change'
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.acheralan-shirt.description: It need not be fancy, but it shouldn't be rags, either. At least, that's how Alanis seemed to describe it... in many, many more words.

e.vozotlnaos-blessing-chitoniskos.name: Vozotlnaos Blessing Chitoniskos
e.vozotlnaos-blessing-chitoniskos.effects:
Firetouched and Blessed by Fire (Chitoniskos): 16% chance to proc 250 Fire damage; +250 damage per Vozotlnaos Blessing set item worn; +12 HP; +5% Crit Damage; +1 Tiers of 'Fire Resistance'
Consecrated
Set Bonus (Vozotlnaos Blessing Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +15% Formation Bonus and +1% Crit Rate
 8+: +2 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Fire'
 9+: 1% chance to heal the Player 2 HP
e.vozotlnaos-blessing-chitoniskos.description:
"Why would you assume that we would only wear robes and forgo armor entirely? You realize our Lord purifies all with His holy flames?"
-Hiereus Rillie

c.tincture-of-growth-and-wisdom.name: Tincture of Growth and Wisdom
c.tincture-of-growth-and-wisdom.description: A simple vial, but containing the distilled essence of wisdom mixed with the unbridled potential for growth. You're very interested to see how this would develop some of your most devoted mounts.

a.captain-neventon.name: Captain Neventon
a.captain-neventon.description: When you first found Neventon, shackled to a wall below deck on the Cannoneer's ship, he was gaunt and parched, and barely able to call out to you. He has recovered some, since then, though he still seems haunted by his time as their prisoner. Being a pirate is apparently a hard life, as this former-Captain knows well, and you wonder how many he has subjected to similar experiences...
a.captain-neventon.effects: Roving Seadogs: 14% chance to proc 3,000 Physical damage and add +5% Crit Rate to the Player; Adds +5 Attack and +0.3 Defence to each Seadogs Pirate in the Formation

u.script-of-solar-blade.name: Script of Solar Blade
u.script-of-solar-blade.description: "Giver of life, bane of dark, shred everything before you! Solar Blade!"

ba.heroic-dragoon-banner.name: Heroic Dragoon Banner
ba.heroic-dragoon-banner.description: Obtained with the Heroic Dragoon Class

a.manitaria-leafshade.name: Manitaria Leafshade
a.manitaria-leafshade.description:
"Whoa... you're being very... serious. Just let the harsh mellow out, and try one of these... Or maybe not that one. Maybe this one. And only a small piece, hah haaa-aa haa"
-Manitaria Leafshade, attempting to hand you a mushroom
a.manitaria-leafshade.effects: Fantastical Phantasm: 50% chance to proc 150 Nature damage; 4% chance to proc 3,500 Psychic damage; Adds +2 Defence to each Paresthisy Artistic and Paresthisy Sunbeam in the Formation

e.velvet-cap.name: Velvet Cap
e.velvet-cap.effects:
Downy Punishment (Cap): 40% chance to proc 105 Holy damage; +1250 damage vs Guild Raids; +15 damage per Velvet set item worn
Set Bonus (Velvet Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +3% All Resistances
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.velvet-cap.description: XVII. Brath was at a loss trying to explain what had happened to his father, having only a lengthy cut on his forearm to assist in his attempted communicating of the event. His father declared that Brath would need to spend less time in the woods and more time improving his literary skills, which felt like an undeserving punishment to Brath. Later,

u.lesser-dark-resilience-potion.name: Lesser Dark Resilience Potion
u.lesser-dark-resilience-potion.description: A thinly brewed potion that tastes faintly of anise...

a.guild-lookout.name: Guild Lookout
a.guild-lookout.description: In order to prepare for what's coming, it's vital that one detects incoming threats. This lookout is trained to do just that, and pairs stealth and speed in an impressive combination in order to both gather and safeguard information.

e.baron-aureus-floater.name: Baron Aureus' Floater
e.baron-aureus-floater.effects:
Golden Noble (Floater): 45% chance to proc 200 Acid damage and adding +15% Poison Resistance and +5% Acid Resistance and -10% Lightning Resistance and -10% Dark Resistance on this proc; +175 damage per Baron Aureus' set item worn
Set Bonus (Baron Aureus' Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +175 HP and +25% Crit Damage
 6+: +1.5% Crit Rate
 7+: +5% All Resistances
 8+: +1 Tiers of 'Keen Eyes'
 9+: +25% Poison Resistance, +10% Acid Resistance, -10% Lightning Resistance and -35% Dark Resistance
e.baron-aureus-floater.description: Providing you're in no rush to get... well, to get to any specific location, you must admit that this makes for a surprisingly comfortable ride.

c.violet-empty-clam.name: Violet Empty Clam
c.violet-empty-clam.description: You aren't entirely sure where the contents of this clam have gone, but you are quite certain you aren't interested in trying any!

c.blue-dragon-claw.name: Blue Dragon Claw
c.blue-dragon-claw.description: The claws of the dragon appear dyed from their victims.

c.fen-lure-radicle.name: Fen Lure Radicle
c.fen-lure-radicle.description: The first glimpses of life growing from this large seed brings mixed emotions. If only it didn't belong to one of those monstrous plants...

u.impromptu-provisions.name: Impromptu Provisions
u.impromptu-provisions.description: It may not be much, but it's all your people could throw together in short-order.
u.impromptu-provisions.effects: Open to obtain its contents (two of the chance drops)

u.script-of-malicious-massacre.name: Script of Malicious Massacre
u.script-of-malicious-massacre.description: "Toll the bell and bring forth the legions! Malicious Massacre!"

e.psionic-screener-helm.name: Psionic Screener Helm
e.psionic-screener-helm.effects:
Psyshroom Stopper (Helm): 13% chance to proc 100 Psychic damage; +100 damage per Psionic Screener set item worn
Set Bonus (Psionic Screener Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: 20% chance to proc 100 Psychic damage, and protects you and your armies from the backlash of Volatile or Volatile Spores
e.psionic-screener-helm.description: It's important to keep your head about you when you're facing off against psionic creatures. Or psionic plants, apparently, though Alanis rolls her eyes when you call it that.

u.sinah-honor-spirit.name: Sinah Honor Spirit
u.sinah-honor-spirit.description: You cannot deny the style and class in the bottle's design, but you do wish it did a better job of keeping the purple liquid stoppered inside.

c.indigo-wooden-shackles.name: Indigo Wooden Shackles
c.indigo-wooden-shackles.description: These sturdy shackles were certainly built to keep prisoners from making foolish decisions... Though you suspect the bright colours were equally meant to provoke them in the meantime.

e.reodai-aegis.name: Reodai Aegis
e.reodai-aegis.effects:
Sixth Sensibilities (Aegis): 6% chance to proc 1,200 Magic damage; +600 damage per Reodai set item worn; +50 HP; +20% Crit Damage; +10% Magic Resistance
Set Bonus (Reodai Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: Additional Bonuses depending on Mount equipped
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.reodai-aegis.description:
"Brace yourself, for the experiences you're about to face will hit harder than any foe you've encountered."
-Jinna Brightwhisper

c.red-vildmand-champions-mark.name: Red Vildmand Champion's Mark
c.red-vildmand-champions-mark.description: While you initially thought these marks would be collected by the tribal leaders, it seems the champions of various battles or feats are distinctly honoured amongst these hill tribes.

cp.tank-starter-pack-i.name: Tank Starter Pack I
cp.tank-starter-pack-i.description: A pack providing the necessary goods for every budding tank.

a.vozotl-votary.name: Vozotl Votary
a.vozotl-votary.description:
"We have convinced the village to pay homage to Vozotl but once a year, and the memory of his pleasure lives on until the following festival."
-Vozotl Votary
a.vozotl-votary.effects: Adds +0.4 Defence to Morcant and Sollemnia Verus in the active Formation

e.sung-leather-pants.name: Sung Leather Pants

e.mordant-moswa-pants.description:
VI. "Oh, you're looking into those recent disappearances, then?" Brath was utterly taken aback, both by the librarian - who had previously always remained silent in his presence - speaking up, and by the comment itself. 

"What do you mean? What disappearances?"

"Oh, I just assumed from that paper with the name Brianag, and given all the trouble surrounding her in recent months... My apologies if I disturbed your thoughts, professor."

Brath paused, before rushing over to the section housing the recent articles surrounding world events. It took some digging, but he was able to find several different sources citing issues in the Voysa Province, including a number of disappearances of semi-prominent figures, and a following seeming to arise around this Brianag individual. Brath could find little information detailing her history, beyond mention that she had been a budding scholar of the arcane, but this new information planted a seed of deep fear into Brath's mind: Brianag must be amassing a cult of followers for dark purposes.

e.hatuumin-sovereign-darts.description: XII(c). Kontar had only fragments of memories of his father speaking with him, almost a decade earlier, but as he sat on the stone, his father kneeling before him, he realized how much he valued this opportunity to share a conversation with the man. He could see that, despite having had access to everything the nation could offer, there was a deep loneliness within his father's eyes. In turn, his father shared his wisdom, including recognizing that these were valid feelings to have, but that he would never be entirely alone, for he had those who had come before him, and those who stood alongside him in support. Kontar was uncertain as to how long the two spoke, but once the conversation ended, Kontar wiped his cheeks, and walked back towards the now-visible portal, departing the blasted lands.

Fearing he had doomed himself, and his mission, on an unplanned whim, Paython was struck by wonder when the chariot, rather than plummeting towards the rocky waters, continued forward and upwards, taking off into the sky. e.dromaeon-link.description: XV. Feeling the strain in his limbs, Brath continued weaving, attempting to keep brush and foliage between him and Cenius whenever possible. Out of the corner of his eye, Brath saw the unconscious frame of Brianag wilt and sag, undoubtedly having had its life essence drawn out by the reborn apparition. 'So much for those promises of sharing power,' Brath wryly thought to himself. Brath kept moving, heading deeper into the woods and away from the cultists as he began to feel the attacks on his own energies being launched. Brath was well-versed in keeping magical barriers readied at all times - a talent he had unwittingly possessed ever since he was young, though it had apparently manifested in difficulty in both reading and communicating with others - but even with his prolific capabilities he had to strain to keep the beast from drawing his own life force away. Brath continued to evade the shadowed form, hurling the occasional magical counterstroke, until he had gained enough distance from the cultists to make a stand. Drawing energy out of the surrounding life, and feeling numerous plants and small animals perishing under the strain - for which he offered a silent apology - Brath flung the energies of the land, paired with his own, against the shade, watching it recoil and shudder slightly as he did so. The limited reaction was disheartening, but it yielded the effect Brath was hoping for: Cenius attempted to draw upon more power to assail Brath, but there was nothing nearby left to draw on! Brath could feel the creature's shock and panic, and he knew that such a newly-summoned creature would not have sufficient personal energy reserves to draw upon, and at that point it was only a matter of time before it was incapable of even sustaining itself. Brath encapsulated the smoke in a maw of earth - drawn from his own dwindling reserves of energy - before dragging it deep into the dead ground, where it could only dissipate harmlessly.

e.alchemical-artisan-pants.description: VIII. On an utterly non-descript day, Nahla was approached by a young merfolk, one who refused to leave her be as she waved them away. This fellow informed Nahla of a friend of theirs being deathly ill, and that they had been directed to seek Nahla for help. Nahla, enraged by such a request, violently threw her drinking shell at the fellow, who flinched as it shattered behind him before pointing out that the sick child was Cato's daughter. Pausing for a moment, for she had not heard that name in years, Nahla felt waves of emotions crash over her. She told the youngster that she would not be able to help, but that she would come with him to see the girl. She felt she owed Cato that much, at least.

e.servid-link.description: XV. Feeling the strain in his limbs, Brath continued weaving, attempting to keep brush and foliage between him and Cenius whenever possible. Out of the corner of his eye, Brath saw the unconscious frame of Brianag wilt and sag, undoubtedly having had its life essence drawn out by the reborn apparition. 'So much for those promises of sharing power,' Brath wryly thought to himself. Brath kept moving, heading deeper into the woods and away from the cultists as he began to feel the attacks on his own energies being launched. Brath was well-versed in keeping magical barriers readied at all times - a talent he had unwittingly possessed ever since he was young, though it had apparently manifested in difficulty in both reading and communicating with others - but even with his prolific capabilities he had to strain to keep the beast from drawing his own life force away. Brath continued to evade the shadowed form, hurling the occasional magical counterstroke, until he had gained enough distance from the cultists to make a stand. Drawing energy out of the surrounding life, and feeling numerous plants and small animals perishing under the strain - for which he offered a silent apology - Brath flung the energies of the land, paired with his own, against the shade, watching it recoil and shudder slightly as he did so. The limited reaction was disheartening, but it yielded the effect Brath was hoping for: Cenius attempted to draw upon more power to assail Brath, but there was nothing nearby left to draw on! Brath could feel the creature's shock and panic, and he knew that such a newly-summoned creature would not have sufficient personal energy reserves to draw upon, and at that point it was only a matter of time before it was incapable of even sustaining itself. Brath encapsulated the smoke in a maw of earth - drawn from his own dwindling reserves of energy - before dragging it deep into the dead ground, where it could only dissipate harmlessly.
