e.fogcreeks-crossbow.description: VI(a). Tessa Fogcreek became the unofficial warden of the Dartpar Woods for the remainder of her days, never asking for financial recompense for her work, but happily accepting the respect of the other villagers while teaching the next generation to respect the woods she called home.

ru.nagalisa-rune-1.name: Nagalisa (HI) Rune Lv. 1
ru.nagalisa-rune-1.effects:
Can provide one of the following boosts:
-100% chance to proc 1-2 Ice damage on attacks (25%)
-100% chance to proc 1-2 Fire damage on attacks (25%)
-100% chance to proc 1-2 Nature damage on attacks (25%)
-100% chance to proc 1-2 Lightning damage on attacks (25%)

e.chiffon-pants.name: Chiffon Pants
e.chiffon-pants.effects:
Downy Delight (Pants): 40% chance to proc 255 Holy damage; +3750 damage vs Guild Raids; +90 damage per Chiffon set item worn
Set Bonus (Chiffon Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +4% All Resistances; 1% chance to heal the Player 3 HP
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.chiffon-pants.description: VI(b). Helci was reluctant to pursue the darker teachings, which involved drawing upon the life energies of the land, plants and creatures, as the inevitable outcome of her doing so would lead to more death, which was something her Gnome heritage would never support. As such, she actively avoided furthering her knowledge of those particular arts.

e.lesser-ent-wood-legplate.name: Lesser Ent Wood-Legplate
e.lesser-ent-wood-legplate.effects: Ent Smash (Legplates): 10% chance to proc 125 Nature damage; +25 damage per Lesser Ent set item worn
e.lesser-ent-wood-legplate.description: IV. When asked whether there were any more Ents to be found, the tales describe how they were hunted into extinction at the Third Fall, along with most of the Fae, and that their potent magics were forever lost to the world. Other magics, such as those wielded by mages, soon followed suit.

u.caravan-mystery.name: Caravan Mystery
u.caravan-mystery.description: An unearthed mystery of unusual value, it's not common for the Caravan to have dealt away its wares before getting back to you, but you're happy to take the earnings.

c.orange-fae-candle.name: Orange Fae Candle
c.orange-fae-candle.description: The flame from this candle seems to dance in unnatural ways... Almost as unnatural as the hues of the flame, itself.

cp.lancer-starter-pack-iv.name: Lancer Starter Pack IV
cp.lancer-starter-pack-iv.description: A pack providing the necessary materials for every budding lancer.

u.bard-starter-pack-iii.name: Bard Starter Pack III
u.bard-starter-pack-iii.description: A pack providing the necessary equipment for every budding bard.

cp.lancer-starter-pack-ii.name: Lancer Starter Pack II
cp.lancer-starter-pack-ii.description: A pack providing the necessary tools for every budding lancer.

c.green-vildmand-runic-focus.name: Green Vildmand Runic Focus
c.green-vildmand-runic-focus.description: The barbarian tribes' casters focus their energies through various runes in order to deliver powerful, magical blasts. It is certainly different than what you've experienced from Alanis, Nico and the others, but it seems no less effective.

e.oresnatchs-great-blue-ring.name: Oresnatch's Great Blue Ring
e.oresnatchs-great-blue-ring.effects: Vazz's Pride and Joy: 100% chance to proc 500 Magic damage and give +5% Evasion on that proc
e.oresnatchs-great-blue-ring.description: Somehow, jewelers were able to take the magnificence in Vazz's blue ring, and infuse it even more potently with more of his Rainbow Ore. It glows masterfully, and its magical powers gently settle upon you when you try it on.

c.yellow-frigidara-defence-banner.name: Yellow Frigidara Defence Banner
c.yellow-frigidara-defence-banner.description: A banner intended to both rally troops to stave off Frigidara’s invasion, and to announce details about her horde’s locations. Aegyr truly seems to have thought of everything in this never-ending watch of his.

a.rokovok-harpooner.name: Rokovok Harpooner
a.rokovok-harpooner.description: This shambling individual has little capacity to converse (or, perhaps, it simply does not wish to speak with you), but its capacity to jettison a harpoon is uncouth, despite often losing some bits-and-pieces of itself in the process.

e.blazen-swiftslicer-shuriken.name: Blazen Swiftslicer Shuriken
e.blazen-swiftslicer-shuriken.effects:
Glorious Flaming Blades (Shuriken): 16% chance to proc 800 Fire damage vs Winter raids; +400 damage per Blazen Swiftslicer set item worn; +15% Crit Damage; +0.75% Evasion
Set Bonus (Blazen Swiftslicer Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +0.25% Evasion
 9+: +1.75% Evasion
e.blazen-swiftslicer-shuriken.description: At least the interior metal shouldn't burn your fingers, right?

u.beta-starter-pack-ii.name: Beta Starter Pack II
u.beta-starter-pack-ii.description: A Beta-exclusive Starter pack to aid you on your journey.

cp.warmage-starter-pack-iv.name: Warmage Starter Pack IV
cp.warmage-starter-pack-iv.description: A pack providing the necessary materials for every budding warmage.

e.sung-leather-gloves.name: Sung Leather Gloves
e.sung-leather-gloves.effects: Sungwood Symphony (Gloves): 15% chance to proc 160 Physical damage; +50 damage per Sung Leather set item worn
e.sung-leather-gloves.description: V. During this extended period of peace – at least between the forest people and the Elves – the forest people repaid the kindness shown by the Elves by teaching them how to Sing, breathing life into the inanimate in order to grant it new form and capability.

c.pinias-razorleaf.name: Pinias Razorleaf
c.pinias-razorleaf.description: Despite the sharp edges of this leaf, it supposedly possesses incredible healing properties. You hope they can be used to address the cuts now adorning your fingers...

e.hammerclaw-tower-shield.name: Hammerclaw Tower Shield
e.hammerclaw-tower-shield.effects:
Hammer Pressure (Tower Shield): 5% chance to proc 600 Physical damage; +10,000 damage vs Guild Raids; +150 damage per Hammerclaw set item worn; +50 HP
Set Bonus (Hammerclaw Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +0.5 Formation Protection Value
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.hammerclaw-tower-shield.description: IX. The insanity of the idea was slow to dawn upon the two boys, but the seed of doubt had been planted. At the very least, one of them, who had delivered the blow, would have every intention of not sharing that information liberally, and disguising the fact seemed the best available option.

cp.warmage-starter-pack-ii.name: Warmage Starter Pack II
cp.warmage-starter-pack-ii.description: A pack providing the necessary tools for every budding warmage.

e.yotinpekew-ring.name: Yotinpekew Ring
e.yotinpekew-ring.effects:
+1% Evasion; +1 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Lightning'; +1 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Nature'
Set Bonus (Yotinpekew Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +1.5% Crit Rate
 8+: +35% Crit Damage and +0.75% Crit Rate
 9+: +1 Tiers of 'Arcane Defence - Flamebreath'
e.yotinpekew-ring.description: Mastering the storm is not as simple as throwing around bolts of lightning, or summoning clouds. It takes multiple masteries, worked in tandem, to truly bring forth a storm.

c.fresh-clove.name: Fresh Clove
c.fresh-clove.description:
"Keep a set of these on you at all times when hunting vampires, for they could be the difference between life and undeath."
-Vanhel Vanguard

u.ladaku-patang.name: Ladaku Patang
u.ladaku-patang.description: The size of the flying bag has you questioning how well the tethered line can control it. Being struck by it would certainly leave a decent mark!
u.ladaku-patang.effects: Open to obtain its contents (four of the chance drops)

e.sloughed-naga-tail.name: Sloughed Naga Tail
e.sloughed-naga-tail.effects:
Residual Residue (Tail): 5% chance to proc 30 Poison damage; +5 damage per Sloughed Naga set item worn
Set Bonus (Sloughed Naga Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +2 Tiers of 'Critical Gaze'
e.sloughed-naga-tail.description: You figured walking normally was going to be a challenge in this guise, but you have never before hated being right quite so much.

e.snowdrake-slayer-knife.name: Snowdrake Slayer Knife
e.snowdrake-slayer-knife.effects:
Walking in a Winter Wasteland (Knife): 8% chance to proc 800 Physical damage; +1,250 damage vs Winter raids; +1,000 damage vs Dragon raids; +0.75% Crit Rate; +150 damage per Snowdrake Slayer set item worn
Set Bonus (Snowdrake Slayer Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +2% Crit Rate and +30% Crit Damage
e.snowdrake-slayer-knife.description: It may be cold to the touch, but you're sure it'll be even colder buried in the flesh of your target.

e.yotinpekew-raven.name: Yotinpekew Raven
e.yotinpekew-raven.effects:
Storm Scalping (Raven): 6% chance to proc 1,000 Nature damage; +1,000 damage per Yotinpekew set item worn; +1% Evasion; 1% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 100%; +5% Nature Resistance; +5% Lightning Resistance
Set Bonus (Yotinpekew Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +1.5% Crit Rate
 8+: +35% Crit Damage and +0.75% Crit Rate
 9+: +1 Tiers of 'Arcane Defence - Flamebreath'
e.yotinpekew-raven.description: You're more-than-mildly hesitant about flying around, what with all the storm and lightning bolts raining down, but the intelligent look in this creature's eyes gives you faith that it knows what it's about.

c.durzub-boost-i.name: Durzub Boost I
c.durzub-boost-i.description: Further experience from chasing the storm has further developed this tacit Orc's capabilities. Passively boosts Durzub's Attack by +10 and Defence by +0.5 (Max 2).

u.indigo-codex-of-wisdom.name: Indigo Codex of Wisdom
u.indigo-codex-of-wisdom.description: Every now and again a rare gem among literature appears, conveying experience beyond its ken, capable of both inspiring future generations to greatness and reminding them of the lessons of history. The wisdom delivered by such works is invaluable, and should never be taken for granted.

e.heroic-dusk-shield.name: Heroic Dusk Shield
e.heroic-dusk-shield.effects:
Evil's Dimday (Shield): 50% chance to proc 400 Physical damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 10%; +100 Physical damage per Heroic Dusk set item worn; +80 HP; +2% All Resistances
Set Bonus (Heroic Dusk Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +3% Crit Rate and +25% Crit Damage
 8+: 4% chance to heal the Player 2 HP
 9+: +15% Formation Bonus and 10% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 30%
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.heroic-dusk-shield.description:
"Wherever evil seeks to spread, we will shield the innocent from its advance."
-Sir Tybalt

u.orange-brewers-satchel.name: Orange Brewer's Satchel
u.orange-brewers-satchel.description: A satchel from a talented brewer, containing a mystery potion.
u.orange-brewers-satchel.effects: Open to obtain its contents (two of the chance drops)

e.shudder-sailors-shirt.name: Shudder Sailor's Shirt
e.shudder-sailors-shirt.effects:
Clooney's Consent (Shirt): 20% chance to proc 125 Dark damage; +25 damage per Shudder Sailor's set item worn; +7% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Shudder Sailor's Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: 20% chance to proc 500 Physical damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 20%
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.shudder-sailors-shirt.description:
"Fair Morgan and I only had that one night together; how tortuous it must be for her, now that I'm gone!"

"Gone, Captain? We got chased clear across the Thurlam Ocean because of that 'one night'!"

-Conversations with the crew of the Vengeance

c.brew-of-toxins.name: Brew of Toxins
c.brew-of-toxins.description: Rest, and dream of this angel's kiss-of-death, which utterly and totally brings with it your final bliss.

c.blue-opal.name: Blue Opal
c.blue-opal.description: It's rare to find an opal of such a colour, but its capacity to store magics is what makes this rare stone truly exceptional.

c.jingse-token.name: Jingse Token
c.jingse-token.description: A token highlighting your bravery in protecting the village from the spring swarms. Your bravery will not go unrewarded by the locals.

e.stormshapers-point.name: Stormshapers' Point
e.stormshapers-point.effects:
Stormfury (Point): 12% chance to proc 300 Lightning damage; +150 damage per Stormshapers' set item worn; 5% chance to proc 1,200 Lightning damage; +200 damage per Stormshapers' set item worn; +1% Crit Rate
Set Bonus (Stormshapers' Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: 50% chance to proc 120 Lightning damage, +5 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Lightning' and +20% Lightning Resistance
e.stormshapers-point.description: After spending a few minutes watching Glyggle play with one of these daggers, appearing to be entirely-absorbed in her own world as she played with the sparking tip of the dagger, left you feeling unsettled, and cautious of how you wield the blade.

c.blue-irus-fibula.name: Blue Irus' Fibula
c.blue-irus-fibula.description: A colourful brooch, showing reverence and homage to the God of the Moon, whom the Thiadorans believe protects them while they sleep, loves them while they wake, and has an unmitigated disdain for all things demonic.

a.adroit-guardian-command.name: Adroit, Guardian Command
a.adroit-guardian-command.description:
"The calculations are clear: If you make proper arrangements for the Guardians, they can manage your front lines, guard the Guild property, and see to the daily necessities."

"And then I can venture forth and drive back the Void?"

"Indeed, though I will be sufficient to accompany you to ensure your safety."
-Conversations with Adroit
a.adroit-guardian-command.effects: Recalculated Risk: 15% chance to proc 25,000 Physical damage; 15% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 50%; Adds +5 Attack to Adroit's Psychic Guardian troops in the active Formation; Adds +2 Attack and +1 Defence to Adroit's Fusion Guardian troops in the active Formation; Adds +2 Attack to Adroit's Divine Guardian troops in the active Formation

a.plink.name: Plink
a.plink.description: Pursuing new and exotic articles to cook up, Plink stumbled upon the magical tower and was beset upon by the Wardens. When he got too close to the tower, he was seriously injured by the protective golem, and he has been looking for aid to flee ever since.
a.plink.effects: Clandestine Cuisine: 5% chance to proc 28,000 Nature damage; Adds +15 to Player Vitality

e.ooleviash-suit.name: Ooleviash Suit
e.ooleviash-suit.effects:
Eire Eviction (Suit): 8% chance to proc 500 Physical damage; +250 damage per Ooleviash set item worn; +1,750 damage vs Fae raids; +150 Magic
Set Bonus (Ooleviash Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +40% Crit Damage
 7+: +500 Magic
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.ooleviash-suit.description: You have to admire the elegance and sophistication to this attire, though how you're supposed to fight, or apparently wrestle, while wearing it, defies your imagination.

c.green-horsebrush.name: Green Horsebrush
c.green-horsebrush.description: The fine handle and strong bristles on this brush are clearly intended for use with an equally fine stallion.

c.love-lilypad.name: Love Lilypad
c.love-lilypad.description: Apparently one of the rarest types of lilypads, finding one of these is supposed to signal that your true love is nearby.

u.red-gipantan-troop-draft-poster.name: Red Gipantan Troop Draft Poster
u.red-gipantan-troop-draft-poster.description: Used to draft Troops to your cause.
u.red-gipantan-troop-draft-poster.effects: Open to obtain its contents (two of the following)

e.yelte-demonslayer-red.name: Yelte Demonslayer - Red
e.yelte-demonslayer-red.effects: Divine Red Donation: 40% chance to proc 300 Holy damage; +300 damage vs Demon raids; +3% Crit Rate; +30% Crit Damage
e.yelte-demonslayer-red.description: Infusing the legendary bow with the mythical Dragonslayer gem was one piece of the puzzle, but something felt incomplete. It was only after you infused the radiant shards into it that the true purpose of the bow became clear, and its potential to strike down demonkind shone through.

u.green-swiftness-tonic.name: Green Swiftness Tonic
u.green-swiftness-tonic.description:
An old legend tells of two colleagues exploring a dense forest, before happening upon a bear. When the bear gives chase, they both flee as swiftly as their feet will carry them. One of the colleagues pauses to quaff a draught from a small glass beaker. "You'll never be able to evade the bear forever, so why waste time with a last drink?!" His partner questioned incredulously.

"I need not escape the bear forever, ol' chum! I need only dodge its advances longer than you!"
u.green-swiftness-tonic.effects: Increases Evasion equivalent to +6,400 Agility for 4 hours

e.ooleviash-horsebow.name: Ooleviash Horsebow
e.ooleviash-horsebow.effects:
Eire Eviction (Horsebow): 25% chance to proc 275 Physical damage; +75 damage per Ooleviash set item worn; +720 damage vs Fae raids; +1.5% Crit Rate; +25% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Ooleviash Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +40% Crit Damage
 7+: +500 Magic
e.ooleviash-horsebow.description: Apparently constructed specifically for use while on horseback, these bows may not offer the most range, but sure seem to pack a powerful punch.

e.onishaygu-tendril-ida.name: Onishaygu Tendril Ida
e.onishaygu-tendril-ida.effects:
Wild Sprout (Ida): 10% chance to proc 700 Nature damage; +350 Nature damage per Onishaygu Tendril set item worn; +0.75% Crit Rate; +30 Vitality
Set Bonus (Onishaygu Tendril Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +50 HP
 7+: +2 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Nature'
 8+: +40 Vitality and +40 Honour
 9+: +200 Energy
e.onishaygu-tendril-ida.description:
"The time for caussshun isss over. You ssshall go forth and defend all that you've helped grow."
-Aaja Orisha

c.violet-decorative-gloves.name: Violet Decorative Gloves
c.violet-decorative-gloves.description: You're not sure why someone would want to wear these colourful gloves, but there must be a use for them.

c.block-of-living-ice.name: Block of Living Ice
c.block-of-living-ice.description: Ice from one of the living horde creatures, it apparently holds significant value in circles that deal with magical artifacts.

dy.olive-green-dye-tub.name: Olive Green Dye Tub
dy.olive-green-dye-tub.description: A tub of colourful dye that can magically improve the appeal of your equipment!

e.blessed-gastonia-clubbed-whip.name: Blessed Gastonia Clubbed Whip
e.blessed-gastonia-clubbed-whip.effects:
Sacred Scutumn (Clubbed Whip): 4% chance to proc 6,750 Physical damage; +62,500 damage vs Guild Raids; +1500 damage per Blessed Gastonia set item worn; Reduces damage to Armies by 60% on Proc; 25% chance to proc 400 Holy damage; +150 damage per Blessed Gastonia set item worn
Set Bonus (Blessed Gastonia Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +100 Honor, +75 Energy and +75 Vitality

c.blue-stained-snakescale.name: Blue Stained Snakescale
c.blue-stained-snakescale.description: This colourful scale was stained during your battle with the Naga.

e.mephitic-chiffon-gloves.name: Mephitic Chiffon Gloves
e.mephitic-chiffon-gloves.effects:
Downy Destruction (Gloves): 40% chance to proc 375 Holy damage; +6250 damage vs Guild Raids; +125 damage per Mephitic Chiffon set item worn; 25% chance to proc 400 Poison damage; +150 damage per Mephitic Chiffon set item worn
Set Bonus (Mephitic Chiffon Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +6% All Resistances; 1% chance to heal the Player 5 HP
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.mephitic-chiffon-gloves.description:
XII. Brath watched wordlessly as fuel was added to the pyre before him, and the cultists congregated in the area in their final preparations. He could see bloodstains on the stone altar, feeling his hand sting as his own blood slowly dripped from it, and recognized a number of the other reagents visible around the fire, and could guess how they were using them to forcibly draw out the land's natural energy.

"What are you hoping to gain from all of this?" Brath asked one of the cultists as they drew close. Brianag wheeled around, seemingly dead-set upon being the one to respond.

"The Ceniuspact will gain and share the powers of the great Cenius, you dullard. I would have expected that much to be obvious, even to a layperson."

"And how is it you plan to harness and control those powers? You seem to be lacking a binding agent of any potency, at a glance..."

"Ah, so you aren't the dullard you let on, it seems. Cenius himself, transcending death to speak with me in visions, has provided me detailed instructions, and with the ongoing ritual magics we will be able to partake of his power willingly in gratitude for restoring the faith!"

Sighing in resignment, Brath uttered a short incantation - and taking care to draw upon his own energies rather than any fragile plant-life - loosening his bindings and standing up quickly, stretching his bruised shoulder as he rose.

c.blue-overlord-assegai.name: Blue Overlord Assegai
c.blue-overlord-assegai.description: Surely there must be a collector of strange, demonic things - aside from your insatiable companion... - who would be willing to take these used-weapons in exchange for something you can utilize.

e.red-dragonhunters-pants.name: Red Dragonhunter's Pants
e.red-dragonhunters-pants.effects: Red Drake Stalker (Pants): 16% chance to proc 200 Ice damage; +340 damage vs Dragon raids; +60 damage per Red Dragonhunter set item worn
e.red-dragonhunters-pants.description: VI. In a fit of rage, Qusasper struck out, slashing into the beast as it took flight in order to roast its prey alive. Qusasper was bathed in flame, and the beast descended to feast in its victory.

e.cooking-knife.name: Cooking Knife
e.cooking-knife.description: A simple knife that may have been intended for food preparation, but will serve you nonetheless.

u.devils-energy-ooze.name: Devil's Energy Ooze
u.devils-energy-ooze.description: This oozing, green concoction was leaking out through the stopper before you could remove it from its bag; your fingers tingle where the sticky liquid touched them.

c.knights-favour.name: Knight's Favour
c.knights-favour.description: The sworn honour of the knights-of-the-realm is rarely bestowed upon a commoner, but given your great feats and accomplishments they could think of no-one more worthy to pledge it to.

ba.heroic-chieftain-banner.name: Heroic Chieftain Banner
ba.heroic-chieftain-banner.description: Obtained with the Heroic Chieftain Class

e.nepyren-bone-ring.name: Nepyren Bone Ring
e.nepyren-bone-ring.effects:
Dark Remains (Ring) 4% chance to proc 1,750 Dark damage and protect the Player from the Breath of Death Raid Ability; +250 damage per Nepyren Bone set item worn
Set Bonus (Nepyren Bone Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 8+: +1 Tiers of 'Inspirational Command - Horrifying'
e.nepyren-bone-ring.description: The sharp teeth surrounding this ring are a stark reminder of its origins, but you can't help but suspect that its dark energies seem to be focused on... protecting you from meeting those same energies?

u.skill-elixir.name: Skill Elixir
u.skill-elixir.description: A powerful elixir capable of awakening innate instincts and abilities in heroic individuals.

a.corrissa-swiftfin.name: Corrissa Swiftfin
a.corrissa-swiftfin.description: Several groups of merfolk are renowned for their songs, capable of luring in sailors and land-dwellers alike. Corrissa certainly hails from such a clan, though hearing her sing reminded you of your childhood, when you heard the results of a stray cat that got caught under a mule's hoof.
a.corrissa-swiftfin.effects: Siren's Wail: 12% chance to proc 669 Dark damage vs Human raids; 0.2% chance to heal the Player 5 HP; Adds +1 Defence to Siren Boatswain troops in the active Formation

a.titanslayer-staffer.name: Titanslayer Staffer
a.titanslayer-staffer.description:
"If'n ye' be wanting some magical assistance, you can count on us. But don' be expectin' any fancy, newfangled gimmicky magics when the old stuff works just as'well!"
-Krozana Titanslayer
a.titanslayer-staffer.effects: Adds +0.8 Defence to Krozana Titanslayer in the active Formation

e.fanghunters-stake-sender.name: Fanghunter's Stake-Sender
e.fanghunters-stake-sender.effects:
Poison Pursuit (Stake-Sender): 30% chance to proc 100 Physical damage; +20 damage per Fanghunter's set item worn; +0.6% Crit Rate; +20% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Fanghunter's Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: 10% chance to proc 1350 Magic damage and protect the Player from the Venomous Raid Ability
e.fanghunters-stake-sender.description:
"Unlike conventional crossbows, we need to remain moving in order to combat the beasties we are hired to eliminate. These weapons need to be pre-loaded, so they only carry a fixed number of shots, but it is rare that this ever ends up being an issue."
-Jadael Fangsheath

c.green-mystery-meat.name: Green Mystery Meat
c.green-mystery-meat.description: Despite Fagli literally drooling as Vinqa displays this from her stores, there is absolutely no chance that you could bring yourself to eat this. Knowingly, at least.

e.stormshapers-focus.name: Stormshapers' Focus
e.stormshapers-focus.effects:
Stormfury (Focus): 12% chance to proc 300 Lightning damage; +150 damage per Stormshapers' set item worn; 5% chance to proc 1,200 Lightning damage; +200 damage per Stormshapers' set item worn; +1% Crit Rate
Set Bonus (Stormshapers' Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: 50% chance to proc 120 Lightning damage, +5 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Lightning' and +20% Lightning Resistance
e.stormshapers-focus.description:
"Not all of us are madmen like Thundreag. For the rest of us, it takes focus and a conduit to direct the stor...."
-Glyggle, trailing off.

e.mirays-bascinet.name: Miray's Bascinet
e.mirays-bascinet.description: III. The remainder of her practice hour passed uneventfully, and despite the multi-coloured bruises and assorted scars still adorning her frame she felt limber and warmed, her muscles beginning to itch with the anticipation for the bout to come. When the guard arrived to take her to the waiting area she handed him her sword and shield by rote, and she took the light mail chestpiece in return as he gestured for her to follow him. She slipped the mail over her head and fixed the clasps as they walked.

e.watchers-piercer.name: Watcher's Piercer
e.watchers-piercer.effects: All-Seeing Blindness (Piercer): 5% chance to proc 300 Dark damage; +30 damage per Watcher's set item worn
e.watchers-piercer.description: You swear Alanis nearly had a stroke when she saw you trying to fit this piercer into the Slitted Orb. Why else would they be shaped so perfectly if not to fit together?

c.violet-nepyren-tulip.description: A rare beauty, growing only on the lower slopes of the Nepyres Mountains, you can't help but wonder at the colourful petals.

e.mirays-champion-mare.name: Miray's Champion Mare
e.mirays-champion-mare.description: IX. Miray was unsure whether that moment of clarity and burst of strength had been a gift bestowed by the Gods, and if so which patron she needed to thank, but the collapse of her opponent was overpowered by the screams and shouts of the crowd, marking her victory in the arena yet again. The blur that ensued was only vaguely noticed as Miray was formally awarded the victory and, for the first time in the colosseum’s history, granted her freedom, along with a small parcel of land and servants to aid in adjusting to her new life. Miray could only imagine what a peaceful existence would be like, though she feared her experiences in battle, and perhaps the divine intervention in this final one, promised of a destiny yet-to-come.

Between the clawed 'fingers', the menacing 'teeth' and the acrid breath, you are happy to send it to the further areas of the battlefield.

c.green-overlord-helm.name: Green Overlord Helm
c.green-overlord-helm.description: A colourful facsimile of the helm worn by the demon warlord. It seems stories of the creature have continued being passed down through the years.

e.hatuumin-arcanym.description: XII(b). Climbing to his feet, Sennie looked around, noticing that the landscape seemed much more brilliantly coloured than he had recalled, and while the denizens of this place continued to pass, they didn't appear as menacing as they once had; even the smell seemed to be pleasantly improving. Sennie noted that he could see tendrils of magic flowing out from each of the undead beings, and from various structures and plants surrounding him, but he turned about without a second thought. The hunt for this type of power is what had driven him to desperation, and had already cost him too much: He would not be tempted by such power again. Seeing the portal appear behind him, Sennie stepped through, and departed the cavern, feeling a strange sense of satiation.

a.viana-dtang.name: Viana D'Tang
a.viana-dtang.description:
"I’m glad you’re in such high spirits; You’ve certainly no reason to be. There is so much to be done, and you clearly had no idea, did you? I’m sure you’re proud of this ragtag group you’ve assembled, between your mages and archers and those brawny fellows over there, it’s clear you’ve no idea how to properly use them. If you’re to have any chance in dealing with these wraiths and their plans, you’ll have need of me as a tactician. So, you can either give me control of your forces, or you can heed my advice - to the letter, I might add - going forward.
And no, I don’t have a sister. I don’t care how lonely you are, this question is strange and unsettling, so do not ask it again."
-Viana D’Tang
a.viana-dtang.effects: Tactician's Prowess: 14% chance to proc 5,200 Magic damage; +95 damage per distinct Formation owned; 6% chance to proc 7,500 Magic damage; +180 damage per distinct Formation owned; +25% Formation Bonus; +5% Formation Bonus for every 80 distinct Formations owned; Passive +35% Formation Bonus; Gains +1 Attack per distinct Formation owned; Gains +0.02 Defence per distinct Formation owned

c.salary-pact.name: Salary Pact
c.salary-pact.description: It seems that while good help can be hard to find, it becomes much more reasonably located when offered a regular salary.

u.daily-purchase-bag-iii.name: Daily Purchase Bag III
u.daily-purchase-bag-iii.description: An exotic, novelty good that is only available for a limited time.

e.paresthisy-stone-helm.name: Paresthisy Stone Helm
e.paresthisy-stone-helm.effects:
Existential Experiencing (Stone Helm): 16% chance to proc 475 Psychic damage, giving +10% Crit Damage on proc; +200 damage per Paresthisy set item worn; +10 HP; +4% Psychic Resistance
Set Bonus (Paresthisy Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +1 Tiers of 'Eye for Beauty'
 8+: +1 Tiers of 'Eye for Beauty'
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.paresthisy-stone-helm.description:
"Whoa… why did it get dark all of a sudden?"

"Ha… Your face is on backwards!"
-Conversations between a Paresthisy Sunbeam and Paresthisy Artistic

e.pember-corgo.name: Pember Corgo
e.pember-corgo.description: Only the goodest of boys are suitable to saddle and ride into battle. But clearly this specimen is amongst the goodest of boys. Yes he is. Yes he is.

e.baron-aureus-shield.name: Baron Aureus' Shield
e.baron-aureus-shield.effects:
Golden Noble (Shield): 8% chance to proc 2,400 Physical damage; +700 damage per Baron Aureus' set item worn; +3% All Resistances; +35 HP
Set Bonus (Baron Aureus' Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +175 HP and +25% Crit Damage
 6+: +1.5% Crit Rate
 7+: +5% All Resistances
 8+: +1 Tiers of 'Keen Eyes'
 9+: Additional Bonuses depending on Mount equipped
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.baron-aureus-shield.description: It feels a shame that such a fancy shield is going to be scuffed up by incoming blades, blasts and beasts, but you realize the magical enchantments surrounding it are likely as valuable as the materials, themselves.

e.cumberworld-benefactors-bergere.name: Cumberworld Benefactor's Bergère
e.cumberworld-benefactors-bergere.effects:
+45 Vitality; +45 Energy; +45 Honor
Set Bonus (Cumberworld Benefactor Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1 Tiers of 'Discerning Vision', 'Astute Observation' and 'Precise Inspection'
 7+: +1 Tiers of 'Keen Eyes'
 8+: +100 Energy
 9+: +1 Tiers of 'Discerning Vision', 'Astute Observation' and 'Precise Inspection'
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.cumberworld-benefactors-bergere.description:
"One cannot merely forego class and style, even when benefiting such a laudable endeavour."
-Lady Josian Scolfield

ba.esteemed-meitou-kenin-banner.name: Esteemed Meitou Kenin Banner
ba.esteemed-meitou-kenin-banner.description: Obtained with the Esteemed Meitou Kenin Class

u.vetrarbelgr.name: Vetrarbelgr
u.vetrarbelgr.description: A thick bag, clearly suited for the winter, with loot from the far north.

a.elven-nomad.name: Elven Nomad
a.elven-nomad.description: Most elves are known for residing in one of their forested lands, venturing out only on official business. A small number choose to be permanently nomadic, seeing no home as a place to forever remain, and staying only as long as their fancy strikes.
a.elven-nomad.effects: Adds +2 Player Energy per occupied Troop slot; Adds +0.4 Defence to Elf Commanders in the active Formation; Adds +2 Attack to each Elven Nomad in the Formation

e.ooleviash-claymore.name: Ooleviash Claymore
e.ooleviash-claymore.effects:
Eire Eviction (Claymore): 25% chance to proc 275 Physical damage; +75 damage per Ooleviash set item worn; +720 damage vs Fae raids; +1.5% Crit Rate; +25% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Ooleviash Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +40% Crit Damage
 7+: +500 Magic
e.ooleviash-claymore.description: This enormous blade is surprisingly light, considering its size. You could control a wide path around you while wielding such a blade.

c.red-naga-hide.name: Red Naga Hide
c.red-naga-hide.description: A thick and durable tanned hide from a fallen Naga, glimmering with an illustrious hue.

e.viscous-viscount-focus.name: Viscous Viscount Focus
e.viscous-viscount-focus.effects:
Eccentric Ennoblement (Focus): 12% chance to proc 700 Acid damage; +350 damage per Viscous Viscount set item worn; 4% chance to proc 3,300 Acid damage; +400 damage per Viscous Viscount set item worn; +1% Crit Rate; +100 Magic
Set Bonus (Viscous Viscount Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1.5% Crit Rate
 6+: +10% Crit Damage
 8+: +150 HP
 9+: Additional Bonuses depending on Mount equipped
e.viscous-viscount-focus.description: Apparently Viscount Thorne once met with a group of dignitaries in his laboratory, and his hands were unceremoniously unkempt when he attempted to shake hands. The ensuing nickname, the Viscous Viscount, has stuck ever since - almost as much as the residue on the dignitaries' hands!

c.elixir-of-skill-enhancement.name: Elixir of Skill Enhancement
c.elixir-of-skill-enhancement.description: A powerful elixir that, unlike most you've come across, seems to bolster the attribute you most desire.

e.onishaygu-seedling-javelin.name: Onishaygu Seedling Javelin
e.onishaygu-seedling-javelin.effects:
Young Sprout (Javelin): 10% chance to proc 150 Nature damage; +75 Nature damage per Onishaygu Seedling set item worn; +0.5% Crit Rate; +10 Vitality
Set Bonus (Onishaygu Seedling Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 8+: +30 Vitality and +30 Honour
 9+: +50 Energy
e.onishaygu-seedling-javelin.description:
"Violence is an unfortunate necessity, both in life and in combat. Where it cannot be avoided, it should be embraced."
-Alagbato

e.irus-shroud-crusade-oath.name: Irus' Shroud Crusade Oath
e.irus-shroud-crusade-oath.effects:
Forward Irus' Light (Oath): 19% chance to proc 400 Holy damage; +325 damage per Irus' Shroud Crusade set item worn; +2,000 damage vs Demon raids; +500 Magic; +30 HP; +2 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Holy'
Consecrated
Set Bonus (Irus' Shroud Crusade Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1.5% Crit Rate and +15% Crit Damage
 6+: +4 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Holy'
 7+: +10% Formation Bonus
 8+: +5% All Resistances
 9+: +15% Crit Damage and +10% Formation Bonus
e.irus-shroud-crusade-oath.description:
"You swear to spread His love and take all steps to cleanse the land of those He finds impure? Then take this as a sign of your covenant with Him."
-Umhilda Strongshield

e.vyldas-supplicant-beidhander.name: Vylda's Supplicant Beidhander
e.vyldas-supplicant-beidhander.effects:
Glorious Bloodfeast (Beidhander): 16% chance to proc 150 Dark damage, turning Dark Resistance into Weakness for this proc, and adding +1,000 Magic on that proc; +550 damage per Vylda's Supplicant set item worn; 20% chance to proc 55 Dark damage and add +30% Crit Damage; +135 damage per Vylda's Supplicant set item worn; +1.5% Crit Rate; +15% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Vylda's Supplicant Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1% Crit Rate and +10% Crit Damage
 6+: +3 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Dark' and +2,000 Magic
 7+: 1% chance to deal 25,000 Dark damage; +15% Crit Damage
 8+: +1.5% Crit Rate, and 1% chance of healing the Player +13 HP alongside -75% Formation Bonus on proc
e.vyldas-supplicant-beidhander.description: An impressive blade, though sharpened a bit more than you'd expect for something this heavy. You hope you don't end up needing a smith to repair it after every battle.

u.rogue-starter-pack-iii.name: Rogue Starter Pack III
u.rogue-starter-pack-iii.description: A pack providing the necessary equipment for every budding rogue.

k.inspiring-words.name: Inspiring Words
k.inspiring-words.effects: Increases your Formation Power by x% for the next y attacks.

e.rusted-leoegan-gloves.name: Rusted Leoegan Gloves
e.rusted-leoegan-gloves.effects:
Rusty Jawlocking (Gloves): 5% chance to proc 400 Physical damage
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.rusted-leoegan-gloves.description: III. Paython's upbringing was apparently quite typical, as the headstrong boy was as ready to scrap as he was to learn, but his mother cared deeply for him. The lingering absence of his father was a persisting thorn in the boy's side, however.

e.blazen-swiftslicer-dagger.name: Blazen Swiftslicer Dagger
e.blazen-swiftslicer-dagger.effects:
Glorious Flaming Blades (Dagger): 30% chance to proc 800 Fire damage vs Winter raids; +200 damage per Blazen Swiftslicer set item worn; +10% Crit Damage; +1% Evasion
Set Bonus (Blazen Swiftslicer Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +0.25% Evasion
 9+: +1.75% Evasion
e.blazen-swiftslicer-dagger.description: Well, at least it's just heating the existing blades rather than adding more of them.

e.gobi-flail.name: Gobi Flail
e.gobi-flail.effects: Five-tailed Steam Puncture: 20% chance to proc 320 Holy damage
e.gobi-flail.description: The five strands of this flail seem to flow with impossible grace, never snapping against eachother as they move in a rhythmic dance. The steam produced by these movements seems to add impossible amounts of power to their blows.

e.blessed-gastonia-gloves.name: Blessed Gastonia Gloves
e.blessed-gastonia-gloves.effects:
Sacred Scutum (Gloves): 20% chance to proc 1200 Physical damage; +12500 damage vs Guild Raids; +350 damage per Blessed Gastonia set item worn; 25% chance to proc 400 Holy damage; +150 damage per Blessed Gastonia set item worn
Set Bonus (Blessed Gastonia Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +100 Honor, +75 Energy and +75 Vitality

a.mauritio.name: Mauritio
a.mauritio.description: Perhaps the most eccentric individual you've ever met, Mauritio's skills at spinning a tale, accompanied by the music he is able to provide on several instruments at once, is second-to-none. You aren't entirely certain about his intentions in joining your forces, but between a deft hand at leading others and his ability to raise morale you are happy to have him along.
a.mauritio.effects: Adds +8 Energy to the Player; chance for additional Lore

a.varna-heartybrewer.name: Varna Heartybrewer
a.varna-heartybrewer.description: Slow to rouse, and equally slow to anger, Varna has worked as a master brewer longer than you have been alive, and knows that patience is the key to the best lagers and ales. She was one of the last to flee the burning Gipanta, and the fires in her eyes suggest that she has ever intention of settling the vendetta with those responsible for her losses, personally.
a.varna-heartybrewer.effects: Brilliant Brewery: 8% chance to proc 5,000 Nature damage; +3,000 damage vs Demon raids; Adds +3 Attack and +0.4 Defence to each Neophyte Brouwer in the Formation

u.farmers-homebrew.name: Farmer's Homebrew
u.farmers-homebrew.description: You were quite young when you'd see your grandfather take a swig of this home-drafted beverage from his characteristic flask, but you saw how much even that mouthful would revitalize his body and spirit. Having found a few bottles of it in the cellar, you've regularly kept one on you while tending to the farmstead.

preReqs.name: resource
preReqs.errorMsg: Your energy and vitality are full already.

e.alchemical-artisan-proof.name: Alchemical Artisan Proof
e.alchemical-artisan-proof.effects:
Explosive Eccentricities (Proof): 25% chance to proc 240 Nature damage; +150 damage per Alchemical Artisan set item worn; +5% Dark Resistance; +5% Ice Resistance; +3 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Ice'
Set Bonus (Alchemical Artisan Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1% Crit Rate and +20% Crit Damage
 7+: 2% chance to proc 25,000 Acid damage
 8+: +2 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Nature' and 'Elemental Expertise - Fire'
 9+: +5% Dark Resistance, +5% Ice Resistance and +2% Crit Rate
e.alchemical-artisan-proof.description: X. Nahla turned on the child and scolded him in her fury, chastising his desires to seek out shortcuts in order to see meaningful change. She had no desire to watch him wander off to his death, let alone taking his siblings with him, and she knew that Cato's daughter would never forgive herself for their deaths, even if by their own folly. After the initial shock wore off, Nahla wrote down a list of ingredients, including some locations and natural formations where they should look to find them, and sent them hurrying off to obtain them. Nahla retrieved a pestle and mortar and began grinding some items from the hut's pantry, and added more as the youngsters returned with the various herbs and substances needed for her tincture.

a.haleahn-cicerone.name: Haleahn Cicerone
a.haleahn-cicerone.description: While a guide is a good thing to have, a guide who brings along top-notch equipment and ensures yours is also at-hand is even better. The downside comes when they ask for payment...
a.haleahn-cicerone.effects: Adds +4 Attack and +0.4 Defence to Morth Longtrek in the active Formation

m.frisky-fingers.name: Frisky Fingers
m.frisky-fingers.description:
"The job of a lookout is not merely to be aware of what is going on around you, but to offer support against the mark. A little bit of subtle magic can go a long ways in this."
-Heren Luckyboot
m.frisky-fingers.effects: Frisky Fingers: 15% chance to proc [up-to-54]% Physical damage. 2% chance to pickpocket Crowns equal to your Attack Size; On 20x-Attacks, pickpocketed Crowns increase by 10 for every Tier of 'Spare Change', and 100 for every Tier of 'Skill: Pickpocket'.

c.greater-ranged-token.name: Greater Ranged Token
c.greater-ranged-token.description: Suton's legendary skills as an archer supposedly pass to any who bear this token.

e.arachnean-feet.name: Arachnean Feet
e.arachnean-feet.effects:
Compounding Distortion (Feet): 5% chance to proc 750 Psychic damage; +140 damage per Arachnean set item worn; +10% Crit Damage
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.arachnean-feet.description: The not-so-silent pitter-patter of spider legs still haunts your dreams, and you suspect the sound won't depart any time soon. However, these spider-skinned shoes seem to be much more quiet than what you'd expect, so perhaps some good came of it all.

e.giant-nepyren-acanthosaur.name: Giant Nepyren Acanthosaur
e.giant-nepyren-acanthosaur.effects: Leaping Lizards: 2% chance to proc 3,000 Nature damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 75%
e.giant-nepyren-acanthosaur.description: Beasts native throughout the Nepyres mountains, it seems that they don't fare quite as well in proximity to young - and decidedly hungry - naga parties. Them being more prevalent on the eastern side of the mountains makes sense, in light of this.

e.tiber-rod.name: Tiber Rod
e.tiber-rod.effects:
Paeknisar Prevention (Rod): 15% chance to proc 1,000 Nature damage; 3% chance to proc 5,000 Fire damage; +1.25% Crit Rate; +20% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Praetoran Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +40% Crit Damage and +1 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Fire'
e.tiber-rod.description: Part of you feels like there may be an element of unfairness when acolytes of the temple of Vozotl are using magics to collect fish... But, hey, it's not your festival, who are you to judge?

u.silver-swiftness-tonic.name: Silver Swiftness Tonic
u.silver-swiftness-tonic.description:
An old legend tells of two colleagues exploring a dense forest, before happening upon a bear. When the bear gives chase, they both flee as swiftly as their feet will carry them. One of the colleagues pauses to quaff a draught from a small glass beaker. "You'll never be able to evade the bear forever, so why waste time with a last drink?!" His partner questioned incredulously.

"I need not escape the bear forever, ol' chum! I need only dodge its advances longer than you!"
u.silver-swiftness-tonic.effects: Increases Evasion equivalent to +95,000 Agility for 8 hours

e.suppression-muffs.name: Suppression Muffs
e.suppression-muffs.effects: Mute Messages: 12% chance to proc 100 Psychic damage; +240 Psychic damage vs Construct raids; +12% Ice Resistance
e.suppression-muffs.description: There is something oddly comforting about wrapping your head - and specifically yours ears - in this warm, fur-lined helm. Perhaps it has something to do with how the screeches of blue, whelpling dragons are blocked out as readily as the disapproving tone of a lecturing mage...

e.urvogel-feathers.name: Urvogel Feathers
e.urvogel-feathers.effects:
Primitive Plumage (Feathers): 8% chance to proc 950 Physical damage; +6250 damage vs Guild Raids; +100 damage per Urvogel set item worn
Set Bonus (Urvogel Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +25% Crit Damage
e.urvogel-feathers.description: XVIII. It isn't entirely clear what transpired in that clearing on that dark night, but some say that the forest, itself, spoke to Ceta, and she couldn't help but listen to its immense will. Whatever did happen, Ceta awoke the next morning, protected by a small, wooden alcove, and she seemed to possess an innate knowledge of how to draw upon the powers of the earth to assist her.

c.red-opal.name: Red Opal
c.red-opal.description: It's rare to find an opal of such a colour, but its capacity to store magics is what makes this rare stone truly exceptional.

e.cave-cragsman-pants.name: Cave Cragsman Pants
e.cave-cragsman-pants.effects:
+18 Max HP
Set Bonus (Cave Cragsman Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +2 Tiers of 'Defensive Rider - Terrestrial' and +2 Tiers of 'Mount Proficiency - Terrestrial'
e.cave-cragsman-pants.description:
"There are some reasonably exotic caves near the Fort, and simple enough that even a novice could safely spelunk within them. Perhaps you would join us on our next trip there?"
-Clyburn Softshadow

a.dylsus.name: Dylsus
a.dylsus.description: The key to a good trap is to know how your quarry thinks, and despite being unusually reticent, even for a Goblin, Dylsus has made a name for himself in doing just that. Having studied a plethora of deceptive devices, Dylsus has quickly mastered them all, and will happily deploy dozens upon his intended victims, given an opportunity to set them up in safety.
a.dylsus.effects: Prepared Pitfall: 18% chance to proc 450 Acid damage

e.tasharen-blade.name: Tasharen Blade
e.tasharen-blade.effects:
Season's Stabbing: 6% chance to proc 2,000 Nature damage; +1,500 damage vs Insect raids; +2% Crit Rate; +20% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Byhew Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 8+: +3% Crit Rate and +30% Crit Damage
e.tasharen-blade.description: The locals pass these honoured blades to specially trained warriors, who use them to drive back the villainy that remains from the passing year.

c.pewter-goblet.name: Pewter Goblet
c.pewter-goblet.description: The gesture of awarding a goblet has, at least in Gipanta, evolved to one where the quality of the craftsperson is marked by the quality of the goblet. Only a true expert in their field - whether their field is animal handling, smithing, masonry, cooking or a variety of others - would possess a goblet of this quality.

e.spiderskin-gloves.name: Spiderskin Gloves
e.spiderskin-gloves.effects:
Poisonous Palpae (Gloves): 6% chance to proc 40 Poison damage
Set Bonus (Spiderskin Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +5% Poison Resistance
e.spiderskin-gloves.description: The final vestiges of the arachnid's potent venom seem to emanate from these gloves... or perhaps ooze is the better term.

c.yelte-source.name: Yelte Source
c.yelte-source.description: A strange gem, which appears to have originated from within an unknown weapon. It radiates an unusual, divine energy....

e.red-dragonhunters-lance.name: Red Dragonhunter's Lance
e.red-dragonhunters-lance.effects: Red Drake Stalker (Lance): 12% chance to proc 400 Ice damage; +800 damage vs Dragon raids; +40 damage per Red Dragonhunter set item worn
e.red-dragonhunters-lance.description: I. While the stories tell little of where he came from, they are plentiful about the hero Qusasper who, amongst many notable deeds, was said to have slain a dragon in its own fire.

cp.tank-starter-pack-iii.name: Tank Starter Pack III
cp.tank-starter-pack-iii.description: A pack providing the necessary equipment for every budding tank.

g.achievements.name: Achievement Points
g.achievements.description: A measure of how far you've come, aiding you in where you choose to next go.

e.tagwyren-blade.name: Tagwyren Blade
e.tagwyren-blade.effects:
Seasonal Stabbing: 6% chance to proc 850 Nature damage; +450 damage per Bountiful Byhew set item worn; +4,400 damage vs Insect raids; +2.5% Crit Rate; +30% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Bountiful Byhew Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +15% Nature Resistance and +15% Ice Resistance
 7+: +2 Tiers of 'Vulnerability Spotter - Swarm'
 8+: +3.5% Crit Rate and +40% Crit Damage
e.tagwyren-blade.description: Once the remaining villains of yesteryear have been dispatched, it is time to turn ones eyes - and blades - to looking ahead.

c.undigested-skeletal-remains.name: Undigested Skeletal Remains
c.undigested-skeletal-remains.description: The remains of some poor victim the Slime found first. You can only hope that they had perished in the swamp before the Slime got to them.

a.adjudhas.name: Adjudhas
a.adjudhas.description: One of Aelric's more successful experiments ensuring his trusted aid was able to continue assisting him with his experiments, even after death, has been a significant boon to the eccentric alchemist.
a.adjudhas.effects: Ambling Attendant: 4% chance to proc 60,000 Acid damage; Adds +25 Attack and +1 Defence to Aelric Thorne in the active Formation; Restores 45 Health daily

c.displaced-bones.name: Displaced Bones
c.displaced-bones.description: You can always use new obstacles for practicing different Formations, and a degree of realism never hurts...

e.nepyres-citrine-ring.name: Nepyres Citrine Ring
e.nepyres-citrine-ring.description: This brilliant, glowing-orange band fits comfortably around your finger, and seems to provide a dim illumination to ward off the darkness and any other things that may ail you.

c.lesser-melee-token.name: Lesser Melee Token
c.lesser-melee-token.description: Born from the symbol adorning Percy's helm, this token denotes a devotion to the melee arts.

u.creature-complete-crusher-potion.name: Creature Complete Crusher Potion
u.creature-complete-crusher-potion.description: Bravely beating back brutal, barbaric beasties.
u.creature-complete-crusher-potion.effects: +1% Crit Rate and +10% Offence vs Beast Raids for 4 hours

u.parchment-of-caustic-viscosity.name: Parchment of Caustic Viscosity
u.parchment-of-caustic-viscosity.description: A weathered scroll with a strange, slimy feel to it. Your fingers tingle as you read its contents.

ba.master-sage-banner.name: Master Sage Banner
ba.master-sage-banner.description: Obtained with the Master Sage Class

a.nymeara.name: Nymeara
a.nymeara.description: "Well of course you would think a war is won by burly men with weapons. Hmph. Your head is more full of cotton than I figured if you think your armies are going to keep standing without proper care and medical attention. Now, move aside, there is work to be done!" -- Nymeara, village Wisdom of Naven.
a.nymeara.effects: Heated Healer: 10% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 20%

a.clammer-bund.name: Clammer Bund
a.clammer-bund.description:
"Taming the vast, rolling oceans is child's play beside that of a woman's fickle heart."
-Clammer Bund
a.clammer-bund.effects: Somersaulting Sonnet: 25% chance to proc 300 Dark damage; Adds +1 Attack and +1 Defence to each Shudder Sailor Cutlass and Shudder Sailor Gunner in the Formation

u.parchment-of-boiling-deluge.name: Parchment of Boiling Deluge
u.parchment-of-boiling-deluge.description: A dampened scroll, that seems strangely warm to the touch!

e.watchers-pantaloons.name: Watcher's Pantaloons
e.watchers-pantaloons.effects:
All-Seeing Blindness (Pantaloons): 5% chance to proc 300 Dark damage; +30 damage per Watcher's set item worn
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.watchers-pantaloons.description: The notion of reusing parts of fallen prey is not a foreign one to you. However, pulling up a pair of modified tentacles, one leg at a time, still seems odd.

u.yellow-guard-tonic.name: Yellow Guard Tonic
u.yellow-guard-tonic.description: Originally concocted to keep him safe during his forays into the forest, Nphireo was oblivious to his creation's market-potential until a friend saw an ogre break a club harmlessly over Nphireo's head.

c.laurentian-bat-wing.name: Laurentian Bat Wing
c.laurentian-bat-wing.description:
"What? You actually thought that vampires could turn into bats? Not any kind of bloodsucker I've ever heard of, but now that you've helped take one down I'm sure you think it'd be simple to go pro, no, don't ya'?"
-Corovar

a.gnomish-frigidara-defender.name: Gnomish Frigidara Defender
a.gnomish-frigidara-defender.description:
"The cores of the strongest beasts of the Blizzard Horde can hold great value, to those with an eye for such baubles. Be alert for what you may find strewn about the battlefield."
-Bellas Inahice
a.gnomish-frigidara-defender.effects: Adds +4 Attack to Aegyr Snowbound, Bellas Inahice and Burz in the active Formation

e.vyldas-supplicant-frock.name: Vylda's Supplicant Frock
e.vyldas-supplicant-frock.effects:
Glorious Bloodfeast (Frock): 12% chance to proc 520 Dark damage, turning Dark Resistance into Weakness for this proc; +765 damage per Vylda's Supplicant set item worn; +100 Magic; +0.2% Crit Rate

Set Bonus (Vylda's Supplicant Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1% Crit Rate and +10% Crit Damage
 6+: +3 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Dark' and +2,000 Magic
 7+: 1% chance to deal 25,000 Dark damage; +15% Crit Damage
 8+: +1.5% Crit Rate, and 1% chance of healing the Player +13 HP alongside -75% Formation Bonus on proc
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.vyldas-supplicant-frock.description:
"Blood for the Lady. She feasts. We grow stronger."
-Igir

c.keylsa-boost-i.name: Keylsa Boost I
c.keylsa-boost-i.description: It's amazing what a good meal and a positive attitude can accomplish. Watching his improvements, you suspect there is more to this mapmaker than meets the eye. Passively boosts Keylsa's Attack by +15 and Defence by +0.5 (Max 4).

u.mortiday-candy.name: Mortiday Candy
u.mortiday-candy.description: A strange, hard piece of candy mounted upon a small stick. Your first attempt to bite into it fiercely hurt your teeth, but after observing small children licking away at it, you decided to follow their lead.

e.fiddler-pants.name: Fiddler Pants
e.fiddler-pants.effects:
Squeeze and Sliver (Pants): 4% chance to proc 2800 Physical damage; +37500 damage vs Guild Raids; +400 damage per Fiddler set item worn; 40% chance to proc 150 Physical damage; +75 damage per Fiddler set item worn
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.fiddler-pants.description: VI(b). Stories tell of the first Fiddler Knight traveling along the northeastern coast, and being sought out by the populace in some rural villages in Ostaria, who were being oppressed by the guardsmen commissioned by the wealthy merchants of the area. The Fiddler Knight was reluctant to take on such a controversial task, but ultimately recognized that these people needed his help, and consented.

ru.ingukano-rune-7.name: Ingukano (inK) Rune Lv. 7
ru.ingukano-rune-7.effects:
Can provide one of the following boosts:
-+14-16 Energy (80%)
-+1 to Attentive Perception (15%)
-+1-2 Daily Raid Cap (5%)

c.yelte-bowstring.name: Yelte Bowstring
c.yelte-bowstring.description: A strange bowstring, appearing to be missing from its bow. It radiates an unusual, divine energy....

e.fanghunters-gloves.name: Fanghunter's Gloves
e.fanghunters-gloves.effects:
Poison Pursuit (Gloves): +0.2% Crit Rate
Set Bonus (Fanghunter's Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: 10% chance to proc 1350 Magic damage and protect the Player from the Venomous Raid Ability
e.fanghunters-gloves.description:
"Many underestimate the importance of a good pair of gloves in this line of work. They have to be durable enough to avoid contaminating the wearer, but flexible enough to not slow down your weapon speed, too."
-Morna Fangsheath

c.pinias-crop.name: Pinias Crop
c.pinias-crop.description: A fine harvest of drop, with a number of potential uses in how to process it for wholesome food.

u.festivus-pudding.name: Festivus Pudding
u.festivus-pudding.description: Somewhat exotic and fruity, Yathane nods at you as you eat a bite and manage not to wince at the sharp taste.

a.hatuumin-buster.name: Hatuumin Buster
a.hatuumin-buster.description:
"Too many think too poorly of the Hatuumin. They must be guarded, and their guards must be amongst the best to get the job done."
-Har-Hut
a.hatuumin-buster.effects: Adds +0.4 Defence to Har-Hut and Rankats in the active Formation

e.mortiday-orb.name: Mortiday Orb
e.mortiday-orb.effects:

 6+: +20% Crit Damage
 8+: Reduces incoming damage from Human raids to the Player by 30%
 9+: +2.5% Crit Rate and +10% Crit Damage
e.mortiday-orb.description: The swirling mists within this orb appear to be occasionally parted by small objects that you can't quite make out.

a.shuyets-wight.name: Shuyet's Wight
a.shuyets-wight.description: You are unsure which disturbed you more: Watching Shuyet raise a fallen body as one of his wights, or the look-of-curiousity that painted Alanis' face as she watched.
a.shuyets-wight.effects: Adds +0.5 Defence to Undead Commanders in the active Formation; Restores 2 Reserves daily

e.snowdrake-slaughterer-helm.name: Snowdrake Slaughterer Helm
e.snowdrake-slaughterer-helm.effects:
Wandering in a Winter Wasteland (Helm): 10% chance to proc 600 Physical damage; +100 damage per Snowdrake Slaughterer set item worn; +2,000 damage vs Winter raids; +1,000 damage vs Dragon raids; +5% Ice Resistance
Set Bonus (Snowdrake Slaughterer Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +2% Crit Rate and +30% Crit Damage
 9+: +10% Ice Resistance
e.snowdrake-slaughterer-helm.description: The cloth remains a nice touch, though it's a pity it is frozen stiff and stings against your skin.

c.dysphorvartan.name: Dysphorvartan
c.dysphorvartan.description: A small sprig of this exceptionally rare plant can be provided to those who want their appearance to better match how they feel.

a.slygse.name: Slygse
a.slygse.description: Enormously buff, you initially mistook Slygse for an Orc, and while it seemed she may have taken the misunderstanding well, your first sample of her wares left you wondering if the mistake wasn't taken at least somewhat personally...
a.slygse.effects: Strong Stock: 20% chance to proc 750 Fire damage; +500 Fire damage vs Guild raids; 20% chance to proc 600 Acid damage; +400 Acid damage vs Guild raids

e.tagwyren-rod.name: Tagwyren Rod
e.tagwyren-rod.effects:
Seasonal Sorcery: 8% chance to proc 550 Nature damage; +350 damage per Bountiful Byhew set item worn; +3,250 damage vs Insect raids; +1,000 Magic; +2.5% Evasion
Set Bonus (Bountiful Byhew Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +15% Nature Resistance and +15% Ice Resistance
 7+: +2 Tiers of 'Vulnerability Spotter - Swarm'
 8+: +3.5% Crit Rate and +40% Crit Damage
e.tagwyren-rod.description: Perhaps 'beating' the effigies was inappropriate, but certainly beating the villains, themselves, is fair game, right?

e.fogcreeks-pants.name: Fogcreek's Pants
e.fogcreeks-pants.effects:
Set Bonus (Fogcreek Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +100 Offence and +12% Crit Damage
e.fogcreeks-pants.description: IV. When Tessa was in her 16th year, Volevar fell into considerable hardship when a large gathering of bandits took to the Dartpar Woods and began waylaying every merchant or supply cart that attempted to make it into or out of the small town. After two months of no new supplies making their ways into the village, several groups of villagers attempted to chase off the bandits, but only returned in pieces.

m.arc-lightning.name: Arc Lightning
m.arc-lightning.description:
"Why should we being constrained to one blast of the lightnings when we strike, hm? We do be far more efficient if we are to wrap our foe in energy and sizzle them within. I do be thinking Derzis would approve of such tactics, especially on the more powerful beasties, yes?"
-Nico Orbesco
m.arc-lightning.effects: Arc Lightning: 18% chance to proc [up-to-26]% Lightning damage; Bonus [up-to-40]% damage vs Hard raids

a.fanghunter-bloodletter.name: Fanghunter Bloodletter
a.fanghunter-bloodletter.description:
"Unlike standard medical means, we cannot simply allow poisons to run rampant in the body until they are neutralized. As such, this particular brand of wound care is essential when fighting venomous creatures. Now, hold still.... this is going to hurt."
-Fanghunter Bloodletter
a.fanghunter-bloodletter.effects: Adds +1 Attack to Morna Fangsheath and Jadael Fangsheath in the active Formation

e.gipantan-recruit-helmet.name: Gipantan Recruit Helmet
e.gipantan-recruit-helmet.effects:
Skleery Proponeezy (Helmet): 12% chance to proc 75 Physical damage; +65 damage per Gipantan Recruit set item worn; +2% Crit Damage; +0.1% Evasion
Set Bonus (Gipantan Recruit Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +2 Tiers of 'Medium Armor Proficiency', +2 Tiers of 'Polearm Proficiency' and +2 Tiers of 'Crossbow Proficiency'
e.gipantan-recruit-helmet.description:
"Oie! If'n yer not gonna wear that 'elm properly, there's no point wearin' it at'all!"
-Lobaic Bronzefury

c.violet-stained-snakescale.name: Violet Stained Snakescale
c.violet-stained-snakescale.description: This colourful scale was stained during your battle with the Naga.

e.crusherclaw-boots.name: Crusherclaw Boots
e.crusherclaw-boots.effects:
Pressure Crush (Boots): 5% chance to proc 2200 Physical damage; +30000 damage vs Guild Raids; +700 damage per Crusherclaw set item worn
Set Bonus (Crusherclaw Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +0.5 Formation Protection Value
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.crusherclaw-boots.description: VII(a). The task became more troublesome when the locals started getting mercenary groups involved, canvassing the aid of sell-swords and brigands in order to assist their cause. The Hero of Hammerclaw took on each challenge as it came, facing off with the various challengers sent to rob the merchant convoys, until he came across a particularly noteworthy, and well-armored, individual.

a.psychoid-guild-guardian.name: Psychoid Guild Guardian
a.psychoid-guild-guardian.description: Filled to brim with mystic forces, the psycho-kinetic energies wielded by this guardian has driven it the brink of sanity, rendering it capable of little more than all-out offence.

e.threofor-shield.name: Threofor Shield
e.threofor-shield.effects:
Stegoslam (Shield): 20% chance to proc 225 Physical damage; +2,500 damage vs Guild Raids; +50 damage per Threofor set item worn
Set Bonus (Threofor Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +25 Honor
e.threofor-shield.description: IX. For several weeks Ceta was cordoned off in a small room, only having interactions from the bandits when they would bring in a bowl of gruel or a bread roll, and barely being tall enough to glimpse out the small, singular window when standing on the lone crate in the room. It was from this vantage point that Ceta was able to watch the bandits departing and returning to their small hideout, but also where she was able to see the nearby forest's wildlife as it co-existed in close proximity to the bandits.

e.hammerclaw-boots.name: Hammerclaw Boots
e.hammerclaw-boots.effects:
Hammer Pressure (Boots): 5% chance to proc 600 Physical damage; +10000 damage vs Guild Raids; +150 damage per Hammerclaw set item worn
Set Bonus (Hammerclaw Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +0.5 Formation Protection Value
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.hammerclaw-boots.description: XIV. One of these outings were interrupted, almost a year-to-the-day from the earlier event, by one of the brothers dropping the stones he had been throwing into the water and staring out to sea. Looming up was a monstrous, partially-shelled creature, with enormous, writhing tentacles and a viciously-beaked mouth.

c.indigo-dragonslayer-gem.name: Indigo Dragonslayer Gem
c.indigo-dragonslayer-gem.description: This fine, magical, indigo gem resonates in proximity to the Blade of Mestari. What could the connection be between these two artifacts?

c.brew-of-undying.name: Brew of Undying
c.brew-of-undying.description: Able to push beyond death, though not without a separate set of limitations, you believe that enough of this brew would be able to resurrect even a gargantuan, mythic beast, and hopefully allow you to control its power.

c.mastru-sheephead.name: Mastru Sheephead
c.mastru-sheephead.description: A find that initially disgusts you, considering it is covered in a thick mucous, but the locals assure you that its innards are simply divine.

m.conducive-capriciousness.name: Conducive Capriciousness
m.conducive-capriciousness.description:
"No bother doing weird stuff like dancing with lightning. Just use it, let everything slide off you. Not like that."
-Yagnatz
m.conducive-capriciousness.effects: Conducive Capriciousness: 5% chance to proc [up-to-200]% Lightning damage, plus 20,000 Lightning damage on that attack; 5% chance for +13% Evasion

e.scolfields-skirts.name: Scolfield's Skirts
e.scolfields-skirts.effects:
+30 Vitality; +30 Energy; +30 Honor
Set Bonus (Scolfield Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1 Tiers of 'Discerning Vision', 'Astute Observation' and 'Precise Inspection'
 9+: +1 Tiers of 'Discerning Vision', 'Astute Observation' and 'Precise Inspection'
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.scolfields-skirts.description:
"If you are quite done gawking, it would please that you would avert your lecherous eyes from my skirts and bodice this instant. Ruffians and fools who call themselves heroes... what is the world coming to?"
-Lady Josian Scolfield

e.paresthisy-legplates.name: Paresthisy Legplates
e.paresthisy-legplates.effects:

e.paresthisy-legplates.description:
"I want to... wander. Come wander with me? But not too far. Isn't it.... wanderful?"
-Manitaria Leafshade, bursting into laughter

a.fagli.name: Fagli
a.fagli.description: While goblins are renowned for their ability to feed upon rotting food, Fagli was able to identify that fermentation seemed to serve the same ends. He has refined this process and is now fully versed in preparing dishes that can be enjoyed by any race. That being said, you remain unconvinced about trying a meat dish that may-or-may-not still have something crawling on it...

c.red-thurlam-blowfish.name: Red Thurlam Blowfish
c.red-thurlam-blowfish.description: You are hesitant to touch such a prickly, soggy creature, until you see Mauritio put one to his mouth and blow hard, inflating it to comical proportions.

u.indigo-third-eye-tonic.name: Indigo Third Eye Tonic
u.indigo-third-eye-tonic.description: It is said that all perception starts not with the eyes on your face, but by the concentration of energy forming your innate third eye. Whether the Gods would agree with such a self-serving explanation or not remains to be seen, but you do enjoy the prospect of noticing those minute details of the world around you.
u.indigo-third-eye-tonic.effects: Increases Attentive Perception and Eye for Beauty tiers by +2 for 30 minutes

c.red-tattered-pelt.name: Red Tattered Pelt
c.red-tattered-pelt.description: It was quite challenging to obtain this piece of pelt, as every time its stinger blasted you lost another chunk of fur. Well, better to lose the fur than a finger, you figure.

e.vildmand-platefur-stones.effects:

e.vildmand-platefur-stones.description: Well... For some reason, throwing large rocks had never really occurred to you, in terms of realistic weapons in combat. It's hard to argue with the results.

e.duty-collectors-gauntlets.effects:

Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.duty-collectors-gauntlets.description:
"Would wearing such thick gauntlets make collecting small coins more difficult?"

"What makes you think that the duties at this port are small?"
-Conversations with a Wharf Duty Collector

Poisonous Palpae (Cap): 6% chance to proc 40 Poison damage
Set Bonus (Spiderskin Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +5% Poison Resistance
e.spiderskin-cap.description: There is something to be said about reusing the leftover bits of your fallen foes, but you aren't keen on a spider's backside being attached to your head.

c.brew-of-flames.name: Brew of Flames
c.brew-of-flames.description: The battle rages and the fighting for the steel is hard; through the unending wastes the scattered souls feel the impending hell, their bodies strewn upon the shores.

u.festivus-miracle.name: Festivus Miracle
u.festivus-miracle.description:
Bellas, Burz and Aegyr nod to eachother, and a glow emanates from within Aegyr's plate as he reaches into his armor and pulls out a small package.

"With this, our pact is done. May we not need to call upon you, again." Bellas nods solemnly and while he and Burz prepare to head south, Aegyr slowly walks towards his post, awaiting the inevitable return of the Blizzarding Horde.
u.festivus-miracle.effects: Open to obtain its contents (three of the chance drops)

a.krozana-titanslayer.name: Krozana Titanslayer
a.krozana-titanslayer.description: Wild and seemingly unfearing, Krozana breaks the mould you've come to expect regarding dwarves by spending much of her time aloft upon her hippogryph, swinging her enormous stone 'axe'. You've little desire to follow her example in doing so without a proper saddle or harness, particularly after watching the daring, acrobatic maneuvers her mount perform.
a.krozana-titanslayer.effects: Strength in Stone: 20% chance to proc 6,000 Holy damage; +4,000 damage vs Legendary raids; +750 damage per Reverent Titanslayer set item and Formation owned; Adds +8 Attack and +0.5 Defence to each Titanslayer Tosser and Titanslayer Staffer in the Formation; Gains +4 Attack per distinct Reverent Titanslayer set item and Formation owned

e.demonsbanes-cursed-gauntlets.name: Demonsbane's Cursed Gauntlets
e.demonsbanes-cursed-gauntlets.effects:

 6+: +100% Crit Damage
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.demonsbanes-cursed-gauntlets.description: The extremism displayed by Ciri harkened many to avoid her gaze, or to avoid her entirely.

e.colossal-crusherclaw-warhammer.effects:

c.spell-focus-nature.name: Spell Focus - Nature
c.spell-focus-nature.description: A heavy, polished piece of jasper, this stone can be used as a medium to focus your mind upon the element of Nature.

c.robust-brew-of-flames.name: Robust Brew of Flames
c.robust-brew-of-flames.description: Standing here, with bloodstained hands, wondering if we can now understand after having fought so hard. If possible, I shall break the seal of this curse and free every man.

a.rainee-shroomcap.name: Rainee Shroomcap
a.rainee-shroomcap.description: A particularly mischievous faerie, Rainee has apparently spent many years playing tricks upon poor fools who stumble upon her hidden abode. Well, if you consider her definition of the word, which includes removing a soul from a body and placing it in a hard-shelled creature, an accurate description.
a.rainee-shroomcap.effects: Soulstealing Silliness: 4% chance to proc 30,000 Magic damage and add +40% Crit Damage; Adds +5 Attack and +0.1 Defence to each Ensouled Mudcrab or Ensouled King Crab in the Formation

e.medzeh-blade.name: Medzeh Blade
e.medzeh-blade.effects:
Jackal Watcher (Blade): 20% chance to proc 1,000 Physical damage; 4% chance to proc 4,000 Holy damage; +1.5% Crit Rate; +20% Crit Damage; +5% Dark Resistance
Sanctified

 5+: +2% Crit Rate and +25% Crit Damage
 8+: +4% Evasion
e.medzeh-blade.description:
"The last time the Suneater rose, I was a small child, and it was my father who led the Medzeh to push him back. It cost him his life, but the deed was done."
-Apui

e.alchemical-artisan-chest.name: Alchemical Artisan Chest
e.alchemical-artisan-chest.effects:
Explosive Eccentricities (Chest): 8% chance to proc 500 Nature damage; +250 damage per Alchemical Artisan set item worn; 12% chance to proc 500 Fire damage; +125 damage per Alchemical Artisan set item worn; +3% Dark Resistance; +3% Ice Resistance

e.alchemical-artisan-chest.description: VI. After some months of journey, and a number of close-calls, the party had narrowed down the location of their prize and were making their final expedition for it when they were set upon by an great, carapaced beast. The enormous creature struck at them with both claw and tentacles, and seemed to possess both speed and strength far outstripping what anything of its size could possible possess. Nahla watched as several of her friends were struck down, in some of the most violent manners she could have fathomed. She was about to be struck down, herself, when Cato interceded and was felled in a single blow. Despite her time as a healer, Nahla was infuriated that there was nothing she could do for any of her friends, though she fervently believed that if she had that stone she would have been able to save everyone. In the end, Nahla was forced to flee, along with a small remnant of the party, and she never made any efforts to return to searching for that stone.

e.granite-blessers-rod.name: Granite-Blesser's Rod
e.granite-blessers-rod.effects: Granite's Greatness (Rod): 14% chance to proc 225 Holy damage; +60 damage per Granite-Blesser's set item worn
e.granite-blessers-rod.description: I. The Granite-Blessers are one of the larger followings dedicated to Orimneni, but may well be the most well-known outside of purely dwarven circles. According to Dondomra, this is largely due to the missionary work accomplished by the group extending beyond the halls of the dwarves, and offering their services to a variety of people.

e.hatuumin-weighted-whip.name: Hatuumin Weighted Whip
e.hatuumin-weighted-whip.effects:
Sight of the Eye (Weighted Whip): 16% chance to proc 675 Psychic damage; +150 damage per Hatuumin set item worn; +1% Crit Rate
Set Bonus (Hatuumin Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +60% Crit Damage, +750 Magic, +1 Tiers of 'Discerning Vision' and 10% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 30%
e.hatuumin-weighted-whip.description: XII(a). Stepping through the portal, Sinyu was met with the dark, stone dais he had first seen the portal upon. Looking around him, Sinyu noted that there was no sign of any portal at the moment. Sinyu walked over to a stone wall and leaned against it, deciding whether he should wait for the others or not. After some time passed, however, during which Sinyu digested what had transpired, he stood and started heading up the spiraling stone stairwell. The others would certainly have to overcome challenges of their own, and it was unlikely he would be seeing them any time soon. Sinyu felt a pang of sadness, leaving Kontar behind, but he had faith that the boy would be alright, and hoped that their paths would cross once more. In the meantime, Sinyu knew he had someone to go see.

k.supernatural-recovery.name: Supernatural Recovery
k.supernatural-recovery.effects: Restores your current Health, up to your Health Cap. Recover xx HP.

e.tedupevair-ring.effects:
+0.5% Evasion; +1% Crit Rate; +1 Tiers of 'Eye for Beauty'

u.mages-elixir.name: Mage's Elixir
u.mages-elixir.description: The essence of the mage, distilled and purified, empowers this elixir. You can only imagine the power it is able to bestow.
u.mages-elixir.effects: Open to obtain its contents (two of the chance drops)

e.mikoko-nikway.name: Mikoko Nikway
e.mikoko-nikway.effects:
Land's Rest (Nikway): 8% chance to proc 450 Magic damage; +1,500 damage vs Undead raids; +225 damage per Mikoko set item worn; +3% Dark Resistance

e.mikoko-nikway.description: Apparently covering one's fingers is a sign of dishonesty, so these worn bracers are used in the stead of full gloves to protect one's arms and hands.

c.bottle-of-nog.name: Bottle of Nog
c.bottle-of-nog.description: A bottle of rich, creamy nog, left behind by whomever was last tasked with caring for these steeds. Well, waste-not, want-not!

e.giant-bat.name: Giant Bat
e.giant-bat.effects: Supersonic: 10% chance to proc 150 Physical damage
e.giant-bat.description: Apparently there are historical records of these beasts wearing contraptions allowing their riders to remain mounted underneath them; you would prefer to remain on its back.

e.friskfingers-stick.name: Friskfingers Stick
