e.friskfingers-stick.description:
"The only magic I need is in my fingers... But that doesn't mean I can't appreciate a bit of extra assistance, does it?"
-Alula Friskfingers

Brath attempted to follow his mother into the woods, but soon lost her trail, and found himself alone and lost in the dark woods, cold and confused and without anyone to help him. When he was verging on tears and muttering incoherently to himself, a rustling in the brush caught his ear, and Brath saw the hoofed beast standing tall, its branched horns appearing to carry the moon in their white frame. Over

u.silver-guard-tonic.name: Silver Guard Tonic
u.silver-guard-tonic.description: Originally concocted to keep him safe during his forays into the forest, Nphireo was oblivious to his creation's market-potential until a friend saw an ogre break a club harmlessly over Nphireo's head.

e.capricious-conducer-mask.name: Capricious Conducer Mask
e.capricious-conducer-mask.effects:
Conducive Conductivity (Mask): 5% chance to proc 3,500 Lightning damage; +1,000 damage per Capricious Conducer set item worn; +1% Evasion; +2% Lightning Resistance

e.capricious-conducer-mask.description: Perhaps not the most form-fitting of masks, it provides a significant degree of protection, both from enemy attacks, and from the bright, sparking bursts flowing out of the items in your hands.

e.bolting-fiddler-helm.name: Bolting Fiddler Helm
e.bolting-fiddler-helm.effects:
Shock and Slice (Helm): 4% chance to proc 4900 Physical damage; +62500 damage vs Guild Raids; +950 damage per Bolting Fiddler set item worn; 40% chance to proc 625 Physical damage; +125 damage per Bolting Fiddler set item worn; 25% chance to proc 400 Lightning damage; +150 damage per Bolting Fiddler set item worn
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion

e.naitour-patrol-helm.name: Naitour Patrol Helm
e.naitour-patrol-helm.effects:
Persevering Patrol (Helm): 10% chance to proc 800 Physical damage; +50 damage per Naitour Patrol set item worn; +300 damage vs Human raids; +20 Max HP

 6+: +2 Tiers of 'Prolonged Battle'
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.naitour-patrol-helm.description:
"If you insist on wearing one of our helms while within the Fort, I may well treat you like one of our new recruits, fresh from basic training."
-Avri Stidig

c.lesser-caster-token.name: Lesser Caster Token
c.lesser-caster-token.description: These tokens were made to honour Malfisence and her renowned abilities as a mage.

c.marduks-formation-protection-i.name: Marduk's Formation Protection I
c.marduks-formation-protection-i.description: Passively increases Formation Protection Value by +0.25

c.violet-milkweed.name: Violet Milkweed
c.violet-milkweed.description: This colourful bush - you refuse to call it a flower - seems to grow relatively plentifully on the slopes of this valley, and also seems to attract a number of flying insects.

e.irus-shroud-crusade-steed.name: Irus' Shroud Crusade Steed
e.irus-shroud-crusade-steed.effects:
Forward Irus' Light (Steed): 10% chance to proc 550 Holy damage; +900 damage per Irus' Shroud Crusade set item worn; +5,000 damage vs Demon raids; 4% chance to proc 500 Physical damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 25% and reduce army damage by 25% on that proc; +500 damage per Irus' Shroud Crusade set item worn; +50 HP

 5+: +1.5% Crit Rate and +15% Crit Damage
 6+: +4 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Holy'
 7+: +10% Formation Bonus
 8+: +5% All Resistances
 9+: +15% Crit Damage and +10% Formation Bonus
e.irus-shroud-crusade-steed.description:
"The Crusade will lead the charge into battle, and it is important that we are ready to do just that: Charge."
-Wilben Shroudbearer

e.chaosoldiers-castoff-band.name: Chaosoldier's Castoff Band
e.chaosoldiers-castoff-band.effects:
+5% Fire Resistance; +5% Dark Resistance; +10% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Chaosoldier's Castoff Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +1 Tiers of 'Fire Resistance' and +1 Tiers of 'Dark Resistance'
 8+: +1 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Fire' and +1 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Dark'
e.chaosoldiers-castoff-band.description: A powerful force enters your mind as you slip this ring over your finger. The colours of the world seem to slip away, leaving only a grey, pastel mockery of a scene before you. The force tugs at your senses, as though wanting you to do something...

u.knights-bounty.name: Knight's Bounty
u.knights-bounty.description: Impressing even the knighted fighters of the realm can result in chivalric rewards.

u.dwarven-rewards.name: Dwarven Rewards
u.dwarven-rewards.description: A reward from Dondomra Grimfeet for rescuing her band from the Ent, as negotiated by Rarsik.

a.arrosa.name: Arrosa
a.arrosa.description: The daughter of a master dwarven artisan, Arrosa grew up around various constructs and humanoid-creations, learning not only some of the secrets of how they work, but also how to stop them from working.
a.arrosa.effects: Earthen Key: 20% chance to proc 300 Nature damage vs Construct raids

e.cultists-runic-robes.name: Cultists' Runic Robes
e.cultists-runic-robes.effects:
Dark Runic Ritual (Robes): 16% chance to proc 66 Dark damage; +20 damage per Cultist's Runic set item worn; +54 damage vs Human raids
Set Bonus (Cultist's Runic Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +1 Tiers of 'Arcane Defence - Venom'
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.cultists-runic-robes.description: II. "You may have heard of the dark priessstesss, adventurer, but you have not lived in the ssshadow of her manevolenssse. Her followersss will ssstop at nothing to sssee her ambition through, even though ssshe is long gone."

u.green-brewmasters-satchel.name: Green Brewmaster's Satchel
u.green-brewmasters-satchel.description: An incredibly well-stocked satchel, clearly belonging to a brewmaster, and containing a mystery potion.
u.green-brewmasters-satchel.effects: Open to obtain its contents (three of the chance drops)

e.valley-verdure-staff.name: Valley Verdure Staff
e.valley-verdure-staff.effects:
Verdant Volley (Staff): 17% chance to proc 1,250 Nature damage and add +1,000 Magic; +750 damage per Valley Verdure set item worn; +2.5% Crit Rate; +10% Crit Damage; +3% All Resistances
Set Bonus (Valley Verdure Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +500 Magic
 6+: +2% Crit Rate and +10% Crit Damage
e.valley-verdure-staff.description:
"I mean, sure, you could use it as a weapon. I think it serves better as a walking stick, though..."
-Murrlix

e.praetoran-shorts.name: Praetoran Shorts
e.praetoran-shorts.effects:
Praetoran Modesty (Shorts): 16% chance to proc 650 Nature damage; +50 damage per Praetoran set item worn
Set Bonus (Praetoran Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +40% Crit Damage and +1 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Fire'
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.praetoran-shorts.description: You would not recommend wearing attire like this when plowing fields, but for those spending their time on the water, these seem entirely practical.

e.oresnatchs-grand-green-ring.name: Oresnatch's Grand Green Ring
e.oresnatchs-grand-green-ring.effects: Vazz's Imagination: 100% chance to proc 1,200 Magic damage and give +3,400 Defence on that proc
e.oresnatchs-grand-green-ring.description: Undoubtedly due to the wondrous base material they had to work with, but the jewelers seem to have figured out how to further force more Rainbow Ore power into Vazz's latest ring, improving its magical potential even further.

u.ranger-starter-pack-iv.name: Ranger Starter Pack IV
u.ranger-starter-pack-iv.description: A pack providing the necessary material for every budding ranger.

e.tungsten-gauntlets.name: Tungsten Gauntlets
e.tungsten-gauntlets.effects:
Rustproof Enhancement (Gauntlets): 6% chance to proc 750 Nature damage; +150 Nature damage per Tungsten set item worn; +7% Acid Resistance
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.tungsten-gauntlets.description: The copper gloves were much softer than you'd typically want in such a heavy metal, and though these are somewhat heavier, they leave a lot to be desired.

e.dokumotsu-gloves.name: Dokumotsu Gloves
e.dokumotsu-gloves.effects: Multipod Spray (Gloves): 10% chance to proc 90 Acid damage; +30 damage per Dokumotsu set item worn; +0.5% Crit Rate
e.dokumotsu-gloves.description:
"I suspect that the viscous ooze inside of these spiders is instrumental to how they move. Maybe you'll wrinkle your nose a little less when I uncover that secret and use it to animate other things, farmer!"
-Alanis

a.wereloxodon-zombie.name: Wereloxodon Zombie
a.wereloxodon-zombie.description: Enormous and intimidating, this powerful creature startles you every time you see it - or random chunks of it that have fallen off of its frame - but is still capable of assisting Slygse in pulling her wares to and from her shop.

k.pinpoint-accuracy.name: Pinpoint Accuracy
k.pinpoint-accuracy.effects: Increases your Crit Damage by +x% for the next y attacks.

a.irus-shroud-porter.name: Irus' Shroud Porter
a.irus-shroud-porter.description:
"There is no shortage of work to do in the crusade to fight back the demonic hordes. Fortunately, we have those with strong convictions - and strong backs - to help take on that load."
-Umhilda Strongshield
a.irus-shroud-porter.effects: Adds +3 Attack and +0.4 Defence to Wilben Shroudbearer and Umhilda Strongshield in the active Formation

a.ichneuman.name: Ichneuman
a.ichneuman.description: Claiming to be the natural predator of the Basiliscus, these feral-looking beings certainly seem to be capable of the task: Not requiring blindfolds to face off against the creature is a terrific advantage!

c.ornamental-egg.name: Ornamental Egg
c.ornamental-egg.description: A delicate, ornamental piece that is colourful beyond what one could accomplish with simple paints. It must be incredibly valuable to the right people.

c.varna-heartybrewer-boost-i.name: Varna Heartybrewer Boost I
c.varna-heartybrewer-boost-i.description: It seems Varna's capacity to develop rich and vibrant flavours only grows as she adds unique ingredients to her satchels. Passively boosts Varna's Attack by +10 and Defence by +0.75 (Max 3).

e.vildmand-platefur-gloves.name: Vildmand Platefur Gloves
e.vildmand-platefur-gloves.effects:
Armored And Algid (Gloves): 10% chance to proc 300 Physical damage; +400 damage per Vildmand Platefur set item worn; +4% Ice Resistance; 5% chance to proc 400 Physical damage and add +2,000 Defence
Set Bonus (Vildmand Platefur Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1.5% Crit Rate and +10% Crit Damage
 6+: +10% Ice Resistance
 7+: +100 HP and +2,000 Defence

 9+: +30% Crit Damage and 75% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 5%
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.vildmand-platefur-gloves.description: On the other hand, these gloves will certainly protect your hands, but you are not thrilled about your dexterity taking such a hit. Fortunately you don't require a lot of it to hold a big weapon.

e.waveblessed-pants.name: Waveblessed Pants
e.waveblessed-pants.effects:
By the Waves (Pants): 16% chance to proc 225 Nature damage; +175 damage per Waveblessed set item worn; 16% chance to proc 225 Holy damage; +175 damage per Waveblessed set item worn; +12 HP

 5+: +400 Magic and 2% chance to heal the Player 0.6 HP

 8+: +2% Crit Rate and +15% Crit Damage
 9+: +6% All Resistances and 5% chance to heal the Player 1.8 HP
e.waveblessed-pants.description: You typically prefer garments that cover more of your skin, especially when you're bound to be stuck in the sun for lengthy periods, but the opportunity to avoid being soggier than necessary is always appreciated.

u.sinah-desert-pack.name: Sinah Desert Pack
u.sinah-desert-pack.description: A small pack some of the nomadic Geristainians carry before traversing the wide Sinah desert.

e.nakanos-odachi.name: Nakano's Odachi
e.nakanos-odachi.description: VI(a). The cat burglar, already in her brother's chambers, struck with a nigh-impossible ferocity, and Nakano, armed only with a practice blade, was barely able to deflect the initial volley of spinning blades and knives. The combat was nearly silent as the two foes crossed blades again and again, but ultimately Nakano was able to drive the burglar back, though not before noticing the burglar's pack was laden with ill-gotten goods. Nakano's brother was unaware of the skirmish, though he was eminently thankful for Nakano's quick thinking, despite it costing her most of the mobility in her left arm thereafter.

a.warpriest-orghash.name: Warpriest Orghash
a.warpriest-orghash.description: It is unusual for orcs to worship any deity outside of the orcish pantheon, but it seems Orghash suffered significant losses amongst her tribe, including her raid chieftain. After deciding to take up his mantle and protect her people, Orghash was divinely inspired to follow the methods of Chaunath, and has been a devout disciple ever since.
a.warpriest-orghash.effects: Shield of the Meek: 5% chance to proc 55,000 Holy damage; Adds +4 Attack and +0.3 Defence to each Chaunath's Warpriests Barricade or Chaunath's Warpriests Blitzer in the Formation; 4% chance to reduce incoming damage to your armies by 10%

a.shota-kagebusa.name: Shota Kagebusa
a.shota-kagebusa.description: Particularly quiet about his origins, you've not been able to gather much detail about his story, or his reasons for wanting to join up with you. He seems entirely capable of finding obscure information, commanding an elite group of Living Shadows wordlessly, and he somehow manages to recouperate them better than any of your other healers. That said, you've little desire to want to be wrapped up in those wet cloths for such a recovery session.
a.shota-kagebusa.effects: Somber Embalming: 10% chance to proc 750 Dark damage; Adds +3 Defence to Living Shadow troops in the active Formation

a.steady-guild-servant.name: Steady Guild Servant
a.steady-guild-servant.description: Having resolved themself to do better, this servant is keen about working hard.

u.red-guild-kit-i.name: Red Guild Kit I
u.red-guild-kit-i.description: A small, tidy sack, purporting to carry goods from the same source Slygse gets her alchemical wares.

c.green-elven-cap.name: Green Elven Cap
c.green-elven-cap.description: You never understood why ranging parties would wear such... spectacular adornments, but far be it from you to criticize!

e.swiftslicer-darts.name: Swiftslicer Darts
e.swiftslicer-darts.effects:
Glorious Blades (Darts): 30% chance to proc 400 Fire damage vs Winter raids; +5% Crit Damage; +1% Evasion; +100 damage per Swiftslicer set item worn
Set Bonus (Swiftslicer Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +1.5% Evasion
e.swiftslicer-darts.description: You are always cautious when wielding your weapons, but these small blades beggar an additional degree of wariness.

c.citizens-faith.name: Citizens' Faith
c.citizens-faith.description: The loyalty of the citizenry means a great deal to you, despite you still feeling amongst their ranks more often than not.

s.scroll-sand-wyrm.name: Sand Wyrm Scroll
s.scroll-sand-wyrm.description: These natural predators inhabit a variety of regions, but there is still something unnerving about a giant, pulsating worm rising from the ground and towering over you...

c.kitchi-wayguard-boost-i.name: Kitchi Wayguard Boost I
c.kitchi-wayguard-boost-i.description: Sometimes facing what one has lost is the most difficult - yet empowering - task to face. Passively boosts Kitchi Wayguard's Attack by +15 and Defence by +0.5 (Max 2).

u.yellow-entrancement-tonic.name: Yellow Entrancement Tonic
u.yellow-entrancement-tonic.description:
"It'll feel like you're in a trance, and you'll-"

"Trance? Aye, what good is a potion if it knocks you out on the battlefield for drinking it?!"

"Err, no, you'll retain full control of your faculties, and your aptitude for magic should increase several fol-"

"Maybe we can hurl'm at the enemy, and see if we can knock them all into trances!"
-A conversation between Nphireo and Rarsik

e.waveblessed-hat.name: Waveblessed Hat
e.waveblessed-hat.effects:
By the Waves (Hat): 16% chance to proc 225 Nature damage; +175 damage per Waveblessed set item worn; 16% chance to proc 225 Holy damage; +175 damage per Waveblessed set item worn; +12 HP
Set Bonus (Waveblessed Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:

 7+: +30 HP and 4% chance to heal the Player 0.25 HP
 8+: +2% Crit Rate and +15% Crit Damage
 9+: +6% All Resistances and 5% chance to heal the Player 1.8 HP
e.waveblessed-hat.description: A sturdy hat, you're not quite sure how it's intended to stay atop a sailor's head while in strong winds. Somehow, the shiphands seem to manage.

u.ranger-starter-pack-ii.name: Ranger Starter Pack II
u.ranger-starter-pack-ii.description: A pack providing the necessary tools for every budding ranger.

e.griphornis-darts.name: Griphornis Darts
e.griphornis-darts.effects:
Pennaceous Plumage (Darts): 8% chance to proc 2,900 Physical damage; +18,750 damage vs Guild Raids; +450 damage per Griphornis set item worn; +2% Crit Rate
Set Bonus (Griphornis Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +70% Crit Damage
e.griphornis-darts.description: I(b). "Read'm and weep, boys." Helmo's cockiness was apparent as he laid down his cards upon the table. He paused for a brief moment as the remaining two players looked at eachother, and one tossed his own hand carelessly forward. As Helmo reached for the coins on the table, the last player cleared his throat, causing Helmo to look up, and then down at the cards being placed upon the table, revealing a nearly-perfect hand, and one that decidedly bested his own.

e.urvogel-wings.name: Urvogel Wings
e.urvogel-wings.effects:
Primitive Plumage (Wings): 8% chance to proc 950 Physical damage; +6250 damage vs Guild Raids; +100 damage per Urvogel set item worn
Set Bonus (Urvogel Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +25% Crit Damage
e.urvogel-wings.description: XIX. With the new day's sun to guide her, along with an inexplicable sense direction, Ceta departed the shrine, foraging for berries and sustenance along the way, before arriving back at the bandit hideout without a word. Over the coming days, she would return to the woods, developing her connection with the land, oftentimes surrounding by assorted woodland fauna as she honed her newfound skills.

u.red-guild-kit-v.name: Red Guild Kit V
u.red-guild-kit-v.description: A small, tidy sack, purporting to carry goods from the same source Slygse gets her alchemical wares.

e.field-rangers-gloves.name: Field Ranger's Gloves
e.field-rangers-gloves.description: Unusually light but undeniably well made, you feel as though you can complete twice the ranging today, wearing these fancy gloves.

c.odrean-dall-horns.name: Odrean Dall Horns
c.odrean-dall-horns.description: Firm - if odourous - horns from the local mountain fauna. Considering their quality, you imagine these might be worth quite a price to a collector.

e.gipantan-recruit-gloves.name: Gipantan Recruit Gloves
e.gipantan-recruit-gloves.effects:
Skleery Proponeezy (Gloves): 12% chance to proc 75 Physical damage; +65 damage per Gipantan Recruit set item worn; +2% Crit Damage; +0.1% Evasion
Set Bonus (Gipantan Recruit Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +2 Tiers of 'Medium Armor Proficiency', +2 Tiers of 'Polearm Proficiency' and +2 Tiers of 'Crossbow Proficiency'
e.gipantan-recruit-gloves.description:
"O'course ye've gotta learn t'wield yer weapons in the gloves! What use are they otherwise?! Useless!"
-Lobaic Bronzefury

a.gaudann.name: Gaudann
a.gaudann.description:
"Was built. Must build. Make better. Stronger. Faster. Harder."
-Gaudann
a.gaudann.effects: Creative Construction: 12% chance to proc 1,250 Nature damage; Adds +15 Energy to the Player; Adds +1 Attack to each Construct Troop in the Formation

m.grasp-of-the-grave.name: Grasp of the Grave
m.grasp-of-the-grave.description:
The touch of the grave is well known for delivering many an unwary adventurer to its namesake, and those of poor constitution are taught to avoid it at all costs. A hearty and strong body may stave it off, though only at great personal peril.

When the grave gets serious, however...
m.grasp-of-the-grave.effects: Grasp of the Grave: 12% chance to proc [up-to-165]% Dark damage

e.mestari-dragonslayer-indigo.name: Mestari Dragonslayer - Indigo
e.mestari-dragonslayer-indigo.effects: Divine Indigo Empowerment: 40% chance to proc 450 Holy damage; +950 Holy damage vs Dragon raids; +20% Crit Damage; +0.75% Crit Rate
e.mestari-dragonslayer-indigo.description: The divine radiance of this blade glows even more brilliantly after you had that Dragonslayer gem forged into it. While it still feels somehow incomplete, it somehow still leaves you feeling… whole.

e.crestaceo-helm.name: Crestaceo Helm
e.crestaceo-helm.effects:
Carapace Crush (Helm): 16% chance to proc 50 Physical damage; +1250 damage vs Guild Raids; +25 damage per Crestaceo set item worn
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.crestaceo-helm.description: V. The countryside around the boys' home was relatively peaceful, and while there were often tales of skirmishes and battles in distant lands, there was nothing that would ever seem to touch the serene village. This was displeasing to energetic, growing boys, however, as it led to boredom, and aggrandisement of fables and stories, with none of the cautionary morals to accompany them.

e.mask-of-sporous-cleansing.name: Mask of Sporous Cleansing
e.mask-of-sporous-cleansing.effects:
Aerated Aspiration: 10% chance to proc 250 Physical damage; Protects both the Player and their Armies from the backlash damage of Volatile
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.mask-of-sporous-cleansing.description: The simple design belies the complex architecture that went into designing this mask, which seems capable of protecting you from the effects of various spores.

e.gipantan-dockhand-gloves.name: Gipantan Dockhand Gloves
e.gipantan-dockhand-gloves.effects:
Barrel Hoister (Gloves): 20% chance to proc 120 Dark damage; +40 damage per Gipantan Dockhand set item worn; +200 damage vs Aquatic raids; +5 Energy
Set Bonus (Gipantan Dockhand Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +10 Energy
 8+: +20 Energy
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.gipantan-dockhand-gloves.description:
"Oh, you'd best keep those on, with all the heavy, wet, wooden crates we handle. Splinters here cut deep."
-Broff Keghaul

e.oiled-leather-pants.name: Oiled Leather Pants
e.oiled-leather-pants.description: Despite these pants being made of tough leathers, they seem capable of quiet, stealthy movements as well.

c.glyph-of-demonic-warding.name: Glyph of Demonic Warding
c.glyph-of-demonic-warding.description: Many skilled mages made desperate, last-minute attempts to stop the Gipantan invasion by the demon hordes. While they may have failed, there is nothing suggesting that their work should go to waste.

u.lesser-magic-resilience-potion.name: Lesser Magic Resilience Potion
u.lesser-magic-resilience-potion.description: A thinly brewed potion that tastes faintly of ginger...

u.drake-distressing-destruction-potion.name: Drake Distressing Destruction Potion
u.drake-distressing-destruction-potion.description: Daily destruction of dastardly defiling drakes.
u.drake-distressing-destruction-potion.effects: +1% Crit Rate and +10% Offence vs Dragon Raids for 4 hours

s.scroll-frenzied-fae-flock.name: Frenzied Fae Flock Scroll
s.scroll-frenzied-fae-flock.description: Why capture and cage these poor creatures when you seem perfectly capable of summoning them to you at will?

m.azyus-wish.name: Azyu's Wish
m.azyus-wish.description:
"You see, fair adventurer... The storms most worthy of fear lie not over the harshest seas, but within our own hearts."

"Captain... why can't you just go and tell her how you feel?!"
-Conversations with the crew of the Vengeance
m.azyus-wish.effects: Azyu's Wish: 12% chance to proc [up-to-50]% Lightning damage; Bonus [up-to-35%] damage vs Aquatic raids; 6% chance to proc 100 Physical damage and +8% Crit Rate for that attack

e.lesser-ent-club.name: Lesser Ent Club
e.lesser-ent-club.effects: Ent Smash (Club): 10% chance to proc 50 Nature damage; +15 damage per Lesser Ent Wood set item worn
e.lesser-ent-club.description: While many weapons need to be refined and meticulously crafted, a large chunk of wood with a tapered side to function as a handle is largely what any good club needs. When it can come from magically-imbued, living wood as base material, then even better.

a.corovar.name: Corovar
a.corovar.description: From his gaunt face and sickly cough, you're quite skeptical about this fellow's ability to lead the hunt against undead beasties... until he pulls out a strange contraption, seemingly from nowhere, and begins launching impressive balls of flame at an even more-impressive rate!
a.corovar.effects: Vanhel Deliverance: 18% chance to proc 1500 Fire damage vs Undead raids

e.thiadoran-garments-sling.name: Thiadoran Garments Sling
e.thiadoran-garments-sling.effects:
Cathimeri Nijzoi (Sling): 20% chance to proc 55 Physical damage; +20 damage per Thiadoran Garments set item worn; +5% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Thiadoran Garments Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +40 HP
 7+: +2 Tiers of 'Spare Change'
e.thiadoran-garments-sling.description: While there doesn't seem to be stark wealth discrepancies in Thiador, you expect any rural resident would be willing and ready to add some extra protein to their diet.

a.gnome-fae-thrall.name: Gnome Fae Thrall
a.gnome-fae-thrall.description: "Those wretched vermin forced me into such degradation, mending petty tears and healing the most minor of matters. Never again will I stoop to such levels - Oh, it looks like your cuff's a bit long; do you need that hemmed?"

k.wingshot.name: Wingshot
k.wingshot.description: When a foe is being difficult and flittering about, aim for the wings.
k.wingshot.effects: An attack designed to target flying creatures. Deals a 100% accurate, 20x Dark-type attack to the Raid, but deals 4x the damage, and a bonus (5x Agility) damage if the Raid has the Airborne Raid Ability.

c.reindeer-token.name: Reindeer Token
c.reindeer-token.description: A small token given to those who care for these special beasts.

u.valto-nuts.name: Valto Nuts
u.valto-nuts.description: Once you realized you had to crack-and-discard the exterior to enjoy the deliciousness within, these became significantly more appealing.

preReqs.name: resource
preReqs.errorMsg: Your health and energy are full already.

a.wayguard-numees.name: Wayguard Numees
a.wayguard-numees.description:
"There are paths we must all walk, and paths one must walk alone. In both cases, there must be those to protect the travelers upon their paths."
-Kitchi Wayguard
a.wayguard-numees.effects: Adds +2 Attack and +0.6 Defence to Kitchi Wayguard and Takhi Wawetseka in the active Formation

a.vyldas-bloody-supplicant.name: Vylda's Bloody Supplicant
a.vyldas-bloody-supplicant.description:
"It is an honour to present blood for Her Ladyship to savour. Even better when it is my own."
-Bloody Supplicant
a.vyldas-bloody-supplicant.effects: Adds +8 Attack to Illiana Bloodletter and Igir in the active Formation

e.chaosoldiers-castoff-feet.name: Chaosoldier's Castoff Feet
e.chaosoldiers-castoff-feet.effects:
Infernal Soldier (Feet): 5% chance to proc 210 Fire damage; +90 damage per Chaosoldier's Castoff set item worn; +4% Fire Resistance; +3% Dark Resistance
Set Bonus (Chaosoldier's Castoff Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +1 Tiers of 'Fire Resistance' and +1 Tiers of 'Dark Resistance
 8: +1 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Fire' and +1 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Dark'
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.chaosoldiers-castoff-feet.description: It isn't common to find footwear that smells worse before you slip it onto your own feet...

u.violet-third-eye-tonic.name: Violet Third Eye Tonic
u.violet-third-eye-tonic.description: It is said that all perception starts not with the eyes on your face, but by the concentration of energy forming your innate third eye. Whether the Gods would agree with such a self-serving explanation or not remains to be seen, but you do enjoy the prospect of noticing those minute details of the world around you.
u.violet-third-eye-tonic.effects: Increases Attentive Perception and Eye for Beauty tiers by +2 for 1 hour

e.stevedores-vest.name: Stevedore's Vest
e.stevedores-vest.effects:
+20 HP
Set Bonus (Stevedore's Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +5% All Resistances
 8+: +5% All Resistances
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.stevedores-vest.description: A durable cloth for a hard-working individual, you feel a little more energetic while wearing it.

a.neophyte-brouwer.name: Neophyte Brouwer
a.neophyte-brouwer.description: You don't know what the greater loss is: This poor fellow losing his livelihood, or you losing your ability to ask for some free samples...
a.neophyte-brouwer.effects: Adds +1 Attack and +0.5 Defence to Varna Heartybrewer in the active Formation

a.jadael-fangsheath.name: Jadael Fangsheath
a.jadael-fangsheath.description:
"Defeating powerful, fanged creatures necessitates that you avoid getting poisoned, yourself. As much as the Elves might have you think that this can only be accomplished by dodging, it works even better to simply be too durable for those fangs to pierce."
-Jadael Fangsheath
a.jadael-fangsheath.effects: Deterring Defanging: 40% chance to proc 80 Physical damage; +170 damage vs raids with Venomous; Adds +2 Defence to each Fanghunter Bloodletter and Fanghunter Warden in the Formation

e.granite-blessers-cuisses.name: Granite-Blesser's Cuisses
e.granite-blessers-cuisses.effects:
Granite's Greatness (Cuisses): 15% chance to proc 200 Holy damage; +50 damage per Granite-Blesser's set item worn
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.granite-blessers-cuisses.description: VI. Apparently, while Orimneni is the Goddess of the Hearth amongst the dwarves, she is better known as being a defender of Justice, and requires those working in her name to protect the innocent and serve up punishment where necessary. To that end, it is not uncommon for them to work with the Honorbound, for their stiff punishment is as a direct result of dwarven justice being bestowed upon them.

e.yelte-demonslayer-green.name: Yelte Demonslayer - Green
e.yelte-demonslayer-green.effects:
Divine Green Donation: 40% chance to proc 450 Holy damage; +650 damage vs Demon raids; +3% Crit Rate; +40% Crit Damage
Sanctified
e.yelte-demonslayer-green.description: Infusing the legendary bow with the mythical Dragonslayer gem was one piece of the puzzle, but something felt incomplete. It was only after you infused the radiant shards into it that the true purpose of the bow became clear, and its potential to strike down demonkind shone through.

c.thinned-brew-of-bolts.name: Thinned Brew of Bolts
c.thinned-brew-of-bolts.description: Riding down the path, we arrived at the town and had some fun. We met some women, dancers who ensured a good time.

e.mastru-river-stinger.name: Mastru River Stinger
e.mastru-river-stinger.effects:
Nocuous Nematocysts: 6% chance to proc 2,500 Poison damage; +12,500 Poison damage vs Aquatic raids
Set Bonus (Praetoran Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +40% Crit Damage and +1 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Fire'
e.mastru-river-stinger.description: You are still cursing for allowing yourself to be talked into trying to ride this slowly-floating creature. Sure, the tentacles seem to be dangerously potent to anything caught within them, but you cannot figure any safe means to dismount!

a.slygse-merchant-extraordinaire.name: Slygse, Merchant Extraordinaire
a.slygse-merchant-extraordinaire.description:
"You've been great for business throughout the years, but I think it's time to showcase the best that your Crowns can buy!"
-Slygse
a.slygse-merchant-extraordinaire.effects: Stronger Stock: 20% chance to proc 75,000 Fire damage; +50,000 Fire damage vs Guild raids; 20% chance to proc 60,000 Acid damage; +40,000 Acid damage vs Guild raids; Adds +1 Defence to Slygse's Werecanid Wight troops in the active Formation; Adds +4 Attack to Slygse's Wereloxodon Wight troops in the active Formation; Adds +2 Attack and +1 Defence to Slygse's Werequill Wight troops in the active Formation

e.ranging-scouts-tunic.name: Ranging Scout's Tunic
e.ranging-scouts-tunic.effects:
Scout's Honor (Tunic): 12% chance to proc 90 Physical damage; +30 damage per Ranging Scout's set item worn
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.ranging-scouts-tunic.description: The key to stealthy movement lies not only in the material of the ranger's clothing, but the appearance as well. The dull, earthen hues of this tunic make for a rather deceptive look when standing amongst foliage.

u.scouts-elixir.name: Scout's Elixir
u.scouts-elixir.description: An elixir possessing the prowess of the most observant scouts, capable of expanding your mind to new horizons.

e.valley-verdure-crossbow.name: Valley Verdure Crossbow
e.valley-verdure-crossbow.effects:
Verdant Volley (Crossbow): 17% chance to proc 1,250 Nature damage and add +1,000 Magic; +750 damage per Valley Verdure set item worn; +2.5% Crit Rate; +10% Crit Damage; +3% All Resistances
Set Bonus (Valley Verdure Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +500 Magic
 6+: +2% Crit Rate and +10% Crit Damage
e.valley-verdure-crossbow.description:
"I would never imagine using this to fire upon any of the spectacular - if oversized - creatures here! Target practice is fun, though."
-Murrlix

a.alley-cutthroat.name: Alley Cutthroat
a.alley-cutthroat.description: The best skill any thief can possess is invisibility, and going unnoticed while in plain sight is what these cutthroats are best known for. You can only hope that their skills will work as well in battle as they do in back alleys!

e.leoegan-linothorax.name: Leoegan Linothorax
e.leoegan-linothorax.effects:
By the Gods (Linothorax): 6% chance to proc 500 Physical damage
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.leoegan-linothorax.description: VII. Paython took these insults to heart, and after realizing he had no means to support himself took to the streets. He spent several days begging before he was able to amass sufficient funds for a proper inn, where he could bathe and clean himself and return to the Temple a humbled - and better smelling - visitor.

c.violet-jolly-roger.name: Violet Jolly Roger
c.violet-jolly-roger.description: There is nothing jolly about this beacon-of-death, colourful though it may be.

a.paresthisy-sunbeam.name: Paresthisy Sunbeam
a.paresthisy-sunbeam.description: Wandering listlessly in the sunlight, it's a small wonder that these elves haven't wandered off a cliff face. Still, the fleeting moments of clarity demonstrate that they are not completely without skill.
a.paresthisy-sunbeam.effects: Adds +2 Attack and +0.1 Defence to Manitaria Leafshade in the active Formation

e.rapier-of-swift-cleaving.name: Rapier of Swift-Cleaving
e.rapier-of-swift-cleaving.effects: Beheading Blow: 10% chance to proc 700 Physical damage; +2% Crit Rate
e.rapier-of-swift-cleaving.description: While blades meant for adventuring or dueling are left thicker to avoid shattering, those intended for executions are honed to the keenest of edges. Being able to cleave the target's head from their body in a swift stroke is vital.

e.thiadoran-garments-perizoma.name: Thiadoran Garments Perizoma
e.thiadoran-garments-perizoma.effects:
Set Bonus (Thiadoran Garments Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +40 HP
 7+: +2 Tiers of 'Spare Change'
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.thiadoran-garments-perizoma.description: The clothing here seems far more... freeing... than what you're used to. However, nobody seems to bat an eye when you dress accordingly, so you can only hope this isn't part of some grand prank.

e.reodai-frostseal.name: Reodai Frostseal
e.reodai-frostseal.effects:
Reodai's Fear: 6% chance to proc 4,000 Ice damage; +1,500 damage per Reodai set item worn; +50 HP; +2% Evasion; +2% Crit Rate
Set Bonus (Reodai Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: Reduces incoming damage to the Player by 5%, +20% Crit Damage and 12% chance to proc 2,000 Ice damage with +60% Formation Bonus on that hit
e.reodai-frostseal.description:
"Fear isss easssy to confussse with anger, but isss not alwaysss originating from the sssame sssourssse. What isss it that you fear mossst, adventurer, asss that isss what will keep you from walking the blesssed path."
-Lokakshi Coilbreaker

u.parchment-of-brittlesight.name: Parchment of Brittlesight
u.parchment-of-brittlesight.description: A fragile scroll, almost ready to fall to pieces in your hands!

c.green-mihrish-poster.name: Green Mihrish Poster
c.green-mihrish-poster.description: You had heard of posters to depict images of wanted criminals, but were unaware that businesses may be so overworked that they would publicly canvas for hirees.

c.green-vildmand-champions-mark.name: Green Vildmand Champion's Mark
c.green-vildmand-champions-mark.description: While you initially thought these marks would be collected by the tribal leaders, it seems the champions of various battles or feats are distinctly honoured amongst these hill tribes.

e.dromaeon-whip.name: Dromaeon Whip
e.dromaeon-whip.effects: Prehistoric Pummelling (Whip): 10% chance to proc 200 Physical damage; +2,000 damage vs Guild Raids; +25 damage per Dromaeon set item worn
e.dromaeon-whip.description: VII. Two thin, masked men were awaiting Ceta at the meeting place, and she dropped the sacks on the ground as she had been instructed. She believed that her sister would be in the process of being returned at the secondary location at this same time. However, when the purses and pack were inspected by the men, they found them filled with stones and metal shavings, and not a single coin or object of value lay within.

e.dark-piercer-band.name: Dark Piercer Band
e.dark-piercer-band.effects:
Piercing the Night (Band): 16% chance to proc 875 Dark damage; +125 damage per Dark Piercer set item worn; +0.75% Crit Rate; +10% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Dark Piercer Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +3% Crit Rate and +1 Tiers of 'Advanced Critical Gaze'
e.dark-piercer-band.description:
"It may be wise to keep that ring hidden, depending upon whom you're meeting. It may suggest some... affiliations, you'd prefer not to be associated with."
-Janagud

a.gipantan-hellenist.name: Gipantan Hellenist
a.gipantan-hellenist.description: Contrary to how some of your family members were raised, there seems to be little issue with these folks following the teachings, and respecting the beliefs, of several different deities. After having witnessed all you've seen in the past few weeks, you can't say you disagree with this approach.
a.gipantan-hellenist.effects: Believer's Battering: 2% chance to proc 200 Holy damage

a.geos-seasoned-servant.name: Geo's Seasoned Servant
a.geos-seasoned-servant.description:
"True mastering of any art takes time, practice and experience, and that equally applies to servitude. Some of the best servants may not be the fastest or strongest, but those ripened with age to be best capable of serving the needs of their masters."
-Geo Fray
a.geos-seasoned-servant.effects: Adds +2 Attack and +0.2 Defence to Geo Fray, Head Servant in the active Formation

e.viscous-viscount-sigil.name: Viscous Viscount Sigil
e.viscous-viscount-sigil.effects:
Eccentric Ennoblement (Sigil): 5% chance to proc 1,600 Acid damage; +1,000 damage per Viscous Viscount set item worn; +30% Crit Damage; +40 Vitality
Set Bonus (Viscous Viscount Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1.5% Crit Rate
 6+: +10% Crit Damage
 8+: +150 HP
 9+: Additional Bonuses depending on Mount equipped
e.viscous-viscount-sigil.description: Modeled after the actual sigil of Aelric's house, you felt modestly disheartened at Aelric's condescension upon your suggesting a higher quality original might be in order.

e.jiyuu-daduh-hyla.name: Jiyuu Daduh Hyla
e.jiyuu-daduh-hyla.effects:
Longer Leapfrog: 30% chance to proc 5,000 Nature damage vs Insect raids; 5% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 50%
Set Bonus (Bountiful Byhew Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +15% Nature Resistance and +15% Ice Resistance
 7+: +2 Tiers of 'Vulnerability Spotter - Swarm'
 8+: +3.5% Crit Rate and +40% Crit Damage
e.jiyuu-daduh-hyla.description: The only thing stranger than the feeling of being atop one of these when it leaps high into the air is watching its eyes bulge out of its head as it consumes insects larger than you.

c.indigo-explosive-stinger.name: Indigo Explosive Stinger
c.indigo-explosive-stinger.description: Notwithstanding the size and colour of this appendage, the fact that it can deliver both venom and an explosive blast leaves you hesitant about handling it!

e.onishaygu-tendril-armor.name: Onishaygu Tendril Armor
e.onishaygu-tendril-armor.effects:
Wild Sprout (Armor): 12% chance to proc 500 Nature damage; +250 Nature damage per Onishaygu Tendril set item worn; +30 Energy; +20 Vitality; +20 Honor; +30 HP
Set Bonus (Onishaygu Tendril Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +50 HP
 7+: +2 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Nature'
 8+: +40 Vitality and +40 Honour
 9+: +200 Energy
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.onishaygu-tendril-armor.description:
"Your investment appears to have paid off, and your growth is apparent. Now it is time to put it to the test."
-Alagbato

e.paresthisy-knife.name: Paresthisy Knife
e.paresthisy-knife.effects:
Existential Experiencing (Knife): 25% chance to proc 145 Psychic damage, and +4% Crit Rate on proc; +185 damage per Paresthisy set item worn; +15% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Paresthisy Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +1 Tiers of 'Eye for Beauty'
 8+: +1 Tiers of 'Eye for Beauty'
e.paresthisy-knife.description:
"I can't find my brush... Could you borrow that knife for me?"
-Manitaria Leafshade

e.nepyres-chamois.name: Nepyres Chamois
e.nepyres-chamois.description: You were just as skeptical as Alanis when Clyburn described local creatures that could casually climb nearly-vertical mountainsides, but you'd never let on as you gleefully watch the aghast look cross her face upon seeing one.

e.sturdy-farmers-boots.name: Sturdy Farmer's Boots
e.sturdy-farmers-boots.description: An everyday-sort of boot, not to be confused with ones worn for walking distances, nor with those flowery, fancy ones worn at poncy parties.

e.hooded-veil-stabber.name: Hooded Veil Stabber
e.hooded-veil-stabber.effects: Fangs Alot (Stabber): 16% chance to proc 250 Poison damage; +25 damage per Hooded Veil set item worn; +6 Offence
e.hooded-veil-stabber.description:
I. "Long again, a priesstesss of our order rose up, not in honour of Ssarfraxss but in opposition to him, and while sshe wass unpopular amongsst many, sshe quickly gained a ssignificant following who ssought optionss beyond brute force and mayhem"
-Seksehsa

u.thiadoran-honor-vintage.name: Thiadoran Honor Vintage
u.thiadoran-honor-vintage.description: A fine vintage from the Thiadoran vineyards, with a uniquely cultivated flavour that refreshes both your palate and your spirits.
u.thiadoran-honor-vintage.effects: Restores 25% of your max Honor and 200 HP

preReqs.name: resource
preReqs.errorMsg: Your health and honor are full already.

ru.nagaleihwaz-rune-1.name: Nagaleihwaz (Hei) Rune Lv. 1
ru.nagaleihwaz-rune-1.effects:
Can provide one of the following boosts:
-100% chance to proc 1-2 Nature damage on attacks (35%)
-100% chance to proc 1-2 Psychic damage on attacks (35%)
-+1-2 Formation Power (30%)

c.red-mirgoda-leavings.name: Red Mirgoda Leavings
c.red-mirgoda-leavings.description: It is unclear what the creature must have consumed to have leavings of this strange colour, but you have little desire to find out.

a.frightened-dumvan.name: Frightened Dumvan
a.frightened-dumvan.description: You cannot tell which is causing this poor villager to shiver more: The cold or the fear of the invading barbarians.

u.creature-crusher-potion.name: Creature Crusher Potion
u.creature-crusher-potion.effects: +6,000 Offence vs Beast Raids for 4 hours

c.red-explosive-stinger.name: Red Explosive Stinger
c.red-explosive-stinger.description: Notwithstanding the size and colour of this appendage, the fact that it can deliver both venom and an explosive blast leaves you hesitant about handling it!

cp.void-crystals-one-hundred.name: Void Crystals x850
cp.void-crystals-one-hundred.description: A substantive pack containing the premium currency of the realms.

a.dommi-blokhed.name: Dommi Blokhed
a.dommi-blokhed.description: You're certain someone is playing a prank on you. Alanis seems conspicuously absent, but moving around a training dummy with magic and trying to convince you that it is a sentient creature is definitely something she would do.
a.dommi-blokhed.effects: Practice on Dommi: 4% chance to proc 23,750 Physical damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 10%; Adds +5 Attack and +0.4 Defence to each Construct Troop in the Formation; Adds +5 Attack and +0.2 Defence to each Construct Commander in the active Formation; Adds +5 Attack and +0.4 Defence to each Construct Troop in the active Formation

e.vozotlnaos-blessing-pants.name: Vozotlnaos Blessing Pants
e.vozotlnaos-blessing-pants.effects:
Firetouched and Blessed by Fire (Pants): 16% chance to proc 250 Fire damage; +250 damage per Vozotlnaos Blessing set item worn; +12 HP; +5% Crit Damage; +1 Tiers of 'Fire Resistance'
Consecrated
Set Bonus (Vozotlnaos Blessing Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +15% Formation Bonus and +1% Crit Rate
 8+: +2 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Fire'
 9+: 1% chance to heal the Player 2 HP
e.vozotlnaos-blessing-pants.description:
"You seem particularly curious about the knees of these pants. Might I ask why that may be?"
-Hiereus Rillie

e.lumina-flash-throwing-dagger.name: Lumina Flash Throwing Dagger
e.lumina-flash-throwing-dagger.effects:
By the Light (Hand-Crossbow): 12% chance to proc 1,000 Lightning damage; +125 damage per Lumina Flash set item worn; +1.5% Evasion
Set Bonus (Lumina Flash Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +2% Evasion and +1 Tiers of 'Advanced Evasive Maneuvers'
e.lumina-flash-throwing-dagger.description: These daggers are clearly designed using the Thunderbeak's feet as their base, they spark if you bring two of them in close proximity to eachother.

c.violet-knotted-tendril.name: Violet Knotted Tendril
c.violet-knotted-tendril.description: This writhing tendril has tied itself in knots... perhaps that explains the strange hues?

c.goblinseye.name: Goblinseye
c.goblinseye.description: You shudder at whatever had to occur for this plant to get its name, but even you recognize it immediately, and know of its value in a variety of tinctures and fancy meals.

u.parchment-of-polycapitation.name: Parchment of Polycapitation
u.parchment-of-polycapitation.description: A tattered scroll, holding dark and blood-soaked mysteries within!

e.derzis-thunderclap-cowl.name: Derzis' Thunderclap Cowl
e.derzis-thunderclap-cowl.effects:
Lightning Divine (Cowl): 8% chance to proc 140 Lightning damage; +80 damage per Derzis' Thunderclap set item worn; 16% chance to proc 45 Lightning damage; +15 damage per Derzis' Thunderclap set item worn; +0.4% Evasion
Set Bonus (Derzis' Thunderclap Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +1 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Lightning
 8+: +1 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Lightning'
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.derzis-thunderclap-cowl.description: You figured it was unusual to openly worship a sky Deity while covering your face like a common street tough. After watching a particularly brilliant storm one evening, you realized the benefits of keeping your vision shaded.

a.morcant.name: Morcant
a.morcant.description:
"I was not a supporter of this festival, as it depletes our declining resources, but it has certainly made for positive relations with the Thiadoran in this small village."
-Morcant
a.morcant.effects: Wrathful Riverbolt: 4% chance to proc 8,000 Lightning damage; Adds +2 Attack to each Mastru Infantry, Mastru Defender and Vozotl Votary in the Formation

a.kurtis.name: Kurtis
a.kurtis.description: You've heard several different tales about why Kurtis decided to stay in Naven, ranging from being on the run from old employers to having an illegitimate family, but whatever the true reason is you're certain his skills and history as a mercenary will come in handy.
a.kurtis.effects: Far-Travelled: 20% chance to proc 120 Physical damage

e.viscous-viscount-boltmule.name: Viscous Viscount Boltmule
e.viscous-viscount-boltmule.effects:
Eccentric Ennoblement (Boltmule): 12% chance to proc 1,400 Lightning damage; +450 damage per Viscous Viscount set item worn; +8% Nature Resistance; +2.5% Evasion
Set Bonus (Viscous Viscount Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1.5% Crit Rate
 6+: +10% Crit Damage
 8+: +150 HP
 9+: +20% Nature Resistance, 33% chance to proc 800 Lightning damage with +30% Nature Resistance on that hit
e.viscous-viscount-boltmule.description: A rare species of mule, apparently found amongst high mountaintops, Aelric's experiments have led to it having a perpetually upset stomach. You didn't think much of it until it launched a bolt of lightning out of its back end, before whinny-braying in relief.

u.ooleviash-sporran.name: Ooleviash Sporran
u.ooleviash-sporran.description: You've been told that these pouches are typically of a specific, relatively small size. However, given the stature of the Fachin, you can understand how so much can fit into this oversize purse.
u.ooleviash-sporran.effects: Open to obtain its contents (five of the chance drops)

a.tririana-cobblestomp.name: Tririana Cobblestomp
a.tririana-cobblestomp.description: "I'm normally perfectly qualified to deal with the usual insect swarms that the region sees every spring. This year, however, was well beyond my capabilities, alone."
a.tririana-cobblestomp.effects: Swarm Stomper: 30% chance to proc 900 Physical damage vs Insect raids; Adds +2 Defence to Atas the Purifier in the Formation

e.leikapon-longbow.name: Leikapon Longbow
e.leikapon-longbow.effects: Pahupu Severing 6% chance to proc 4,000 Nature damage; +2.5% Crit Rate; +40% Crit Damage; +5% Poison Resistance
e.leikapon-longbow.description: The strange design of this bow is utterly foreign to you, though you cannot complain about the overall craftsmanship.

u.honor-potion-concentrate.name: Honor Potion Concentrate
u.honor-potion-concentrate.description: Much stronger than the dilute version, you cannot quite place the aftertaste this particular brew leaves in your mouth. That said, you figure it might be dishonourable to complain to Nphireo about it.

u.sinah-health-spirit.name: Sinah Health Spirit
u.sinah-health-spirit.description: You cannot deny the style and class in the bottle's design, but you do wish it did a better job of keeping the red liquid stoppered inside.

u.script-of-lightning-bolt.name: Script of Lightning Bolt

Little is known about what may have happened to Saijeor during the Dragon Wars, but some have suggested that in his old age, worn and grizzled by the scars of his youth, he finally settled down, while others think it more likely he would have eventually lost his life in battle against the dragons. Unlike the dozens of champions who had gone before him, Saijeor did not immediately fall to the dragon's firey wrath and was able to emerge victorious, winning the hearts of the citizens and the hand of the princess in marriage.

e.hatuumin-baton.description: II(b). As light slowly crept into his blurred field of vision, Sennie struggled to pull himself to his feet. His study was in shambles... until he realized he was not in his study. He looked around, barely able to ascertain that he was in his kitchen, and having no concept of why he was - Aya! Sennie surged to his feet, using the walls to balance himself as he made his way to his bedroom, only to see his wife - or what was left of her - dismembered upon the ground, clutching the silent body of their daughter. He was unable to process what he was seeing, and it took several moments before he heard his name, and looked over to see his assistant, clutching him by the forearm, pulling him out of the small residence.

e.dokumotsu-crossbow.description:
"Cave spiders are not an unusual sight, and while most rely on intricate webs to ensnare their fare, it is often accompanied by potent venoms. Some have even described these excretions as caustic, capable burning through flesh and bone alike."
-Norsic Bittermail

e.snowdrake-slaughterer-gloves.name: Snowdrake Slaughterer Gloves
e.snowdrake-slaughterer-gloves.effects:
Wandering in a Winter Wasteland (Gloves): 10% chance to proc 600 Physical damage; +100 damage per Snowdrake Slaughterer set item worn; +2,000 damage vs Winter raids; +1,000 damage vs Dragon raids; +5% Ice Resistance
Set Bonus (Snowdrake Slaughterer Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +2% Crit Rate and +30% Crit Damage
 9+: +10% Ice Resistance
e.snowdrake-slaughterer-gloves.description: You've long since lost feeling in your fingers, gloves or no gloves. You suspect these gloves may be adding to that problem, but you've got bigger issues to deal with.

e.tungsten-ring.name: Tungsten Ring
e.tungsten-ring.effects: Poor Conduction: 10% chance to proc 50 Magic damage; +11% Acid Resistance
e.tungsten-ring.description: Despite Alanis' repeated descriptions about how 'poorly' the metal in this ring 'conducts energies', you are still amazed by how much it seems to make caustic substances burn less. She can claim it isn't magic all she likes, but what else could explain it?

cp.void-crystals-twenty.name: Void Crystals x155
cp.void-crystals-twenty.description: A satisfactory pack containing the premium currency of the realms.

e.medzeh-double-crown.name: Medzeh Double Crown
e.medzeh-double-crown.effects:
Jackal Watcher (Double Crown): 25% chance to proc 400 Holy damage; +50 damage per Medzeh set item worn; +2% Dark Resistance
Sanctified
Set Bonus (Medzeh Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +2% Crit Rate and +25% Crit Damage
 8+: Additional Bonuses depending on Main-Hand equipped
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.medzeh-double-crown.description:
"The double crown is reserved for leaders, be it the Nomarch or the head of the Medzeh. After fighting by your side, and seeing your skills as a battle leader, I would be honoured if it would also adorn your head."
-Apui

e.scolfields-lash.name: Scolfield's Lash
e.scolfields-lash.effects:
+30 Vitality; +30 Energy; +30 Honor
Set Bonus (Scolfield Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1 Tiers of 'Discerning Vision', 'Astute Observation' and 'Precise Inspection'
 9+: +1 Tiers of 'Discerning Vision', 'Astute Observation' and 'Precise Inspection'
e.scolfields-lash.description:
"Discipline is vital when serving the House Scolfield, and if it isn't inherent in her employees you can be certain they will be taught the true meaning of the word."
-Scolfield Retainer

u.script-of-ooze-blast.name: Script of Ooze Blast
u.script-of-ooze-blast.description: "Hated blood of vengeance, inject! Ooze Blast!"

e.gastonia-clubbed-whip.name: Gastonia Clubbed Whip
e.gastonia-clubbed-whip.effects:
Scutum Smash (Clubbed Whip): 4% chance to proc 3,600 Physical damage; +37,500 damage vs Guild Raids; +800 damage per Gastonia set item worn; Reduces damage to Armies by 50% on Proc
Set Bonus (Gastonia Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +50 Honor, +30 Energy and +30 Vitality
e.gastonia-clubbed-whip.description: I(a). "And verily they lived happily, until the days of yore!" The song finished with a few plucked notes, and a dulcet chord, as Leoben bowed and paused for acknowledge atop the rickety wooden platform. After a moment, he heard a single cough and looked up, noting that none of the sparse attendees at the small bar seemed to be paying him any mind whatsoever.

e.consecrated-leoegan-boots.name: Consecrated Leoegan Boots
e.consecrated-leoegan-boots.effectName: At the Pleasure of the Gods (Boots)
e.consecrated-leoegan-boots.effects:
At the Pleasure of the Gods (Boots): 10% chance to proc 400 Holy damage; +200 damage per Consecrated Leoegan set item worn; 2% chance to proc 1,500 Holy damage
Consecrated
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.consecrated-leoegan-boots.description: XXIV. As the stories go, Amera's steeds were able to find their way back to Her temple without any further issue, but the damage to the land was already done. Whether the land had been burned down to the Hells, or Paython had merely unearthed some trapped, subterranean denizens, demons spilled forth into the land from the maars, ushering in an age of despair and horrors for both the Thiadorans and Acherallans.

c.training-diagrams.name: Training Diagrams
c.training-diagrams.description: What you had initially dismissed as simplistic diagrams quickly caught Hamond's eye. His ensuing indignation at your poor treatment of them caught your ear equally fast.

a.decaying-carthand.name: Decaying Carthand
a.decaying-carthand.description: Barely able to keep itself together, this carthand follows Slygse's directions and helps load the new wares into the shop, while transporting the larger purchases out for her customers.

a.geo-fray-head-servant.name: Geo Fray, Head Servant
a.geo-fray-head-servant.description:
"I do say, the opportunity to have served you this long is one I have languish-.... err, relished, for quite some time. Let me provide you a demonstration of my discomfiture, first-hand."
-Geo Fray
a.geo-fray-head-servant.effects: Most Certainly!: 20% chance to proc 80,000 Dark damage; +80,000 Dark damage vs Guild raids; Adds +6 Attack to Geo's Particular Servant troops in the active Formation; Adds +2 Defence to Geo's Faithful Servant troops in the active Formation; Adds +2 Attack and +1 Defence to Geo's Seasoned Servant troop in the active Formation

e.chiffon-hooves.name: Chiffon Hooves
e.chiffon-hooves.effects:
Downy Delight (Hooves): 40% chance to proc 255 Holy damage; +3750 damage vs Guild Raids; +90 damage per Chiffon set item worn
Set Bonus (Chiffon Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +4% All Resistances; 1% chance to heal the Player 3 HP
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.chiffon-hooves.description: VII(b). Helci's frustration in her inability to commune with the forest's guardian entity grew, but those feelings were eclipsed by the worry of an impending presence making its way into the countryside. The forest went still and the creatures fell silent in its wake, and Helci was uncertain what she could do in the face of such an approaching darkness, though she couldn't help but feel that a violent conflict was imminent.

e.sloughed-naga-hands.name: Sloughed Naga Hands
e.sloughed-naga-hands.effects:
Residual Residue (Hands): 5% chance to proc 30 Poison damage; +5 damage per Sloughed Naga set item worn
Set Bonus (Sloughed Naga Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +2 Tiers of 'Critical Gaze'
e.sloughed-naga-hands.description: Well, it could be worse... They could be even more snake-like and not have hands at all, right?

e.acheralan-gloves.name: Acheralan Gloves
e.acheralan-gloves.effects:
+0.1% Evasion
Set Bonus (Acheralan Attire Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +2 Tiers of 'Spare Change'
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.acheralan-gloves.description:
"When you need to grab onto something and not 'let go', you better be sure you've got the right gloves for the job."
-Pael Habre

e.dokumotsu-pants.name: Dokumotsu Pants
e.dokumotsu-pants.effects: Multipod Spray (Pants): 10% chance to proc 90 Acid damage; +30 damage per Dokumotsu set item worn; +0.5% Crit Rate
e.dokumotsu-pants.description:
"Most spiders feast upon smaller beasties, like flies and beetles. Larger ones can even eat lizards, rodents and birds. I'd never seen spiders this large until recently, and I wish I did not know about their meal habits."
-Norsic Bittermail

e.firedrakes-charcoal-band.name: Firedrake's Charcoal Band
e.firedrakes-charcoal-band.effects:
Drake's Embers (Charcoal Band): 10% chance to proc 200 Fire damage; +10% Fire Resistance
Set Bonus (Firedrake's Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +5% Fire Resistance
e.firedrakes-charcoal-band.description: III. Having trained in the basics of various schools of magic, Nura knew enough to pass for skilled without being truly adept at most magics, allowing her to travel the lands with relative ease and little impediment.

e.reodai-gloves.name: Reodai Gloves
e.reodai-gloves.effects:
Sixth Sensibilities (Gloves): 16% chance to proc 400 Magic damage; +200 damage per Reodai set item worn; +5% Crit Damage; +0.75% Evasion
Set Bonus (Reodai Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: Additional Bonuses depending on Mount equipped
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.reodai-gloves.description:
"The ssstonesss in thessse glovesss will help ssshow what areasss are unbalansssed within you. Thisss ssshould help narrow down what you need to work on."
-Lokakshi Coilbreaker

e.urvogel-pants.name: Urvogel Pants
e.urvogel-pants.effects:
Primitive Plumage (Pants): 8% chance to proc 950 Physical damage; +6250 damage vs Guild Raids; +100 damage per Urvogel set item worn
Set Bonus (Urvogel Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +25% Crit Damage
e.urvogel-pants.description: XX. Some months later, as the seasons began to cool, a clan of Orcs from a nearby hillside decided to expand their territory, venturing closer to the lands of men. Whether through clever planning or happenstance, they started with the rural outskirts, and this inevitably brought them into conflict with the mountain bandits. The fierce Orcs were battle-hardened and yearned for war, and while the bandits had seen some combat they were no apparent match for these conquerors. Ceta, on the other hand, was having none of it.

e.cultists-runic-pants.name: Cultists' Runic Pants
e.cultists-runic-pants.effects:
Dark Runic Ritual (Pants): 16% chance to proc 66 Dark damage; +20 damage per Cultist's Runic set item worn; +54 damage vs Human raids
Set Bonus (Cultist's Runic Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +1 Tiers of 'Arcane Defence - Venom'
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.cultists-runic-pants.description: IV. "I have heard of humansss who have tried to replicate her teachingsss, though I thought they would be ssscorned by her true followersss. It ssseemsss thessse people were able to obtain the sssame power asss ssshe wasss sssaid to bessstow."

e.copper-plate.name: Copper Plate
e.copper-plate.effects:
Rustproof Reflection (Plate): 6% chance to proc 250 Nature damage; +50 Nature damage per Copper set item worn; +5% Acid Resistance
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.copper-plate.description: A simple plate, but despite its appearance it seems to be well made, and reasonably protective.

e.phermitic-battlegarb-gelding.name: Phermitic Battlegarb Gelding
e.phermitic-battlegarb-gelding.effects:
The Wisdom in War (Gelding): 10% chance to proc 225 Physical damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 10%; +125 damage per Phermitic Battlegarb set item worn; +0.75% Evasion
Set Bonus (Phermitic Battlegarb Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +15% Crit Damage
 8+: +2% Crit Rate and +2 Tiers of 'Prolonged Battle'
e.phermitic-battlegarb-gelding.description: X. The stories tell precious few details of what came of Ankyabu, though many have speculated that her descendants went on to become beings of demonic power, and that her progeny many have included both Rhacel and Alekdun.

a.galleymaid-mermaid.name: Galleymaid Mermaid
a.galleymaid-mermaid.description: Scantily clad, even by Merfolk standards, these ladies happily offer to relieve you of whatever ails your body.... Though their emphasis on 'relief' is somewhat unsettling.

c.elven-badge-of-distinction.name: Elven Badge of Distinction
c.elven-badge-of-distinction.description: A badge of distinction for distinguished performance during the Elven Training Drills. It is up to you to decide whose performance most merits this honour.

a.avri-stidig.name: Avri Stidig
a.avri-stidig.description: "It is clear that the will of Amera has shown itself, this day. While she rests this night, we will take up her cause and drive back these foul creatures who befoul her land. To arms! Defend the Fort!"
a.avri-stidig.effects: Adds +2 Attack and +1 Defence to each Naitour Patrol Officer in the Formation

u.violet-brewmasters-mental-mixture.name: Violet Brewmaster's Mental Mixture
u.violet-brewmasters-mental-mixture.description:
"Letting your enhanced abilities go to your head may be unwise, adventurer... though I suppose that this may be an inherent effect of this draught."
-Nphireo

e.rara-shell-collection-headwear.name: Rara Shell Collection Headwear
e.rara-shell-collection-headwear.effects:
Fabulous, Darling! (Headwear): 16% chance to proc 180 Nature damage; +260 damage per Rara Shell Collection set item worn; +500 damage vs Aquatic raids; +0.25% Evasion
Set Bonus (Rara Shell Collection Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1% Evasion and +300 Magic
 6+: +5 Tiers of 'Nimble Defensive Training'
 7+: +4 Tiers of 'Evasive Maneuvers' and +1 Tier of 'Advanced Evasive Maneuvers'
 8+: +1% Evasion and 24% chance to proc 2,000 Nature damage vs Aquatic raids
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.rara-shell-collection-headwear.description:
"Of course it's genius, darling. I came up with it."
-Luminarara

a.adroits-divine-guardian.name: Adroit's Divine Guardian
a.adroits-divine-guardian.description:
"What defensive line would this be if there was no means to replenish the life force of those injured in combat? I presume you intended no offence by suggesting such a thing, fleshy one."
-Adroit
a.adroits-divine-guardian.effects: Restores 2 Reserves daily; Adds +0.5 Defence to Adroit, Guardian Command in the active Formation

c.button.name: Button
c.button.description: Despite its size, you can feel an immense amount of mystic energy imbued into this small button. It's no wonder that these are so sought out!

e.ooleviash-hat.name: Ooleviash Hat
e.ooleviash-hat.effects:
Eire Eviction (Hat): 8% chance to proc 500 Physical damage; +250 damage per Ooleviash set item worn; +1,750 damage vs Fae raids; +150 Magic
Set Bonus (Ooleviash Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +40% Crit Damage
 7+: +500 Magic
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.ooleviash-hat.description: Classy, and not cumbersome. Who could ask for more?

u.devils-honor-ooze.name: Devil's Honor Ooze
u.devils-honor-ooze.description: This oozing, purple concoction was leaking out through the stopper before you could remove it from its bag; your fingers tingle where the sticky liquid touched them.

e.heroic-dusk-ring.name: Heroic Dusk Ring
e.heroic-dusk-ring.effects:
Evil's Dimday (Ring): 25% chance to proc 80 Physical damage; +140 Physical damage per Heroic Dusk set item worn; +100 HP; +1% Evasion; +3% All Resistances
Set Bonus (Heroic Dusk Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:

 8+: 4% chance to heal the Player 2 HP
 9+: +15% Formation Bonus and 10% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 30%
e.heroic-dusk-ring.description: The mark of the Order of the Heroic Dusk, recognized throughout many lands and known to be worn by those seeking to drive evil back and protect those in need. You feel humbled to be granted the opportunity to wear such a piece.

e.skliros-punisher.name: Skliros' Punisher
e.skliros-punisher.effects: Cruel Punishment: 12% chance to proc 1000 Dark damage; 4% chance to proc 2000 Physical damage; +1% Crit Rate; +15% Crit Damage
e.skliros-punisher.description:
"Skliros has little patience for those of his hordes who fail to carry out his instructions. Or for those who see failure, despite following the instructions. Or for pretty much anyone else..."
-Glasha Brunbruk

e.sinderklaz-spihlgode.name: Sinderklaz Spihlgode
e.sinderklaz-spihlgode.effects:
Sinderklaz Vrolik (Spihlgode): 16% chance to proc 2,000 Magic damage; +1% Crit Rate; +10% Crit Damage; +5% Magic Resistance; +5% Ice Resistance
Set Bonus (Sinderklaz Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +200 HP, +30% Magic Resistance and +25% Ice Resistance
e.sinderklaz-spihlgode.description:
"Why are you throwing those gifts around?! Clearly they're going to be damaged if you do that! This is definitely going on my list!"
-Niek Mira

e.mountain-trekkers-pants.name: Mountain Trekkers Pants
e.mountain-trekkers-pants.effects:
Uphill Undertakings (Pants): 16% chance to proc 60 Nature damage; +20 damage per Mountain Trekkers set item worn; +250 damage vs Winter raids; +2% Ice Resistance
Set Bonus (Mountain Trekkers Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +5% Ice Resistance
 7+: +20 Vitality
 8+: +5 Raid Cap
e.mountain-trekkers-pants.description:
"There is a lovely clearing just half a day's walk from here, with delicious berries and a great view. Maybe we'll visit there once things have cooled off."
-Elian Greysky

u.parchment-of-pellet-pelt.name: Parchment of Pellet Pelt
u.parchment-of-pellet-pelt.description: A frigid scroll containing chilling, potent magics!

Sanctified

e.repentant-dusk-helm.description:
"Best to keep that on if you’re gonna accompany us into combat. You can be as nimble as you like, but the arrow or fireball you never saw coming will be what gets ya’."
-Repentant Dusk Blade

u.mystery-troop-draft-poster-i.name: Mystery Troop Draft Poster I
u.mystery-troop-draft-poster-i.description: Used to draft Troops to your cause.

u.lesser-holy-resilience-potion.name: Lesser Holy Resilience Potion
u.lesser-holy-resilience-potion.description: A thinly brewed potion that tastes faintly of cardamom...

e.crusherclaw-claws.name: Crusherclaw Claws
e.crusherclaw-claws.effects:

Set Bonus (Crusherclaw Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +0.5 Formation Protection Value
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.crusherclaw-claws.description: V(a). While the Hero of Hammerclaw was never one to shy away from a fight, and often sought out combat with wanton disregard, he was reluctant to take on the work requested by local townsfolk, unless they involved dealing with rampaging, or unnatural creatures.

e.dark-piercer-gloves.name: Dark Piercer Gloves
e.dark-piercer-gloves.effects:
Piercing the Night (Gloves): 16% chance to proc 875 Dark damage; +125 damage per Dark Piercer set item worn; +0.8% Crit Rate; +2% Dark Resistance
Set Bonus (Dark Piercer Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +3% Crit Rate and +1 Tiers of 'Advanced Critical Gaze'
e.dark-piercer-gloves.description: These gloves are capable of safely handling incredibly sharp utensils, and in delivering deadly strikes with the hooked claws on the rear of each hand. You just have to be careful not to try wiping your eyes while wearing them.

c.brew-of-mysticism.name: Brew of Mysticism
c.brew-of-mysticism.description: The highest queen of the bees is flying in, dancing in abrupt, staggered steps, and speaking similarly.

c.weighted-anchor.name: Weighted Anchor
c.weighted-anchor.description: You've heard tell of sailors using buoys to hunt for meat by preventing their prey from diving. However, when the target can fight back, dropping them to the depths to drown is apparently the safer - if crueller - option.

e.nepyren-bone-plate.name: Nepyren Bone Plate
e.nepyren-bone-plate.effects:
Dark Remains (Plate): 12% chance to proc 780 Dark damage; +100 damage per Nepyren Bone set item worn
Set Bonus (Nepyren Bone Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 8+: +1 Tiers of 'Inspirational Command - Horrifying'
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.nepyren-bone-plate.description:
"You should have more respect for the dead, human. Wearing remains like that is rude."

"Weren't you just gnawing on the end of a bone from the same cave not five minutes ago?"

"Yes I was. Respectfully. It's entirely different."
-Conversations with Vinqa

a.renewal-gardiner.name: Renewal Gardiner
a.renewal-gardiner.description:
"I always thought that gardening involved putting new life into the ground to grow? At least that's what my grandfather taught me..."

"Sure, if you ignore the need to take out whatever is already in the ground that needs to be removed... But that aside, why do you ask?"

"Well, you call your followers gardeners, and they don't seem to-"

"No, no. Gard*I*ners. It's very different."
-Conversations with Tririana Cobblestomp
a.renewal-gardiner.effects: Adds +5 Attack to Tririana Cobblestomp in the active Formation

e.hearthkeepers-tower-shield.name: Hearthkeeper's Tower Shield
e.hearthkeepers-tower-shield.effects:
+5% Poison Resistance; +5% Nature Resistance; +10 Magic
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion

cp.scout-starter-pack-i.name: Scout Starter Pack I
cp.scout-starter-pack-i.description: A pack providing the necessary goods for every budding scout.

e.firedrakes-glass-eye.name: Firedrake's Glass Eye
e.firedrakes-glass-eye.effects:
Drake's Embers (Glass Eye): 50% chance to proc 28 Fire damage; +4 damage per Firedrake set item worn
Set Bonus (Firedrake's Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +5% Fire Resistance
e.firedrakes-glass-eye.description: II. Not particularly skilled in the elemental arts, Nura was gifted in imbuement, and capable of turning even the most mundane items into powerful artifacts, given the right materials.

e.byramaster-crafter-feet.name: Byramaster Crafter Feet
e.byramaster-crafter-feet.effects:
Legendary Lager (Feet): 24% chance to proc 450 Nature damage; +100 damage per Byramaster Crafter set item worn; +30 HP; 2% chance to proc 2,000 Nature damage and add +5% Evasion and +2.5% Crit Rate to that attack

 9+: +15% Nature Resistance and +15% Psychic Resistance
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.byramaster-crafter-feet.description:
"Please keep up. We work fast, here, even when we have to wait. Don't slow us down."
-Varna Heartybrewer

c.shuyet-boost-i.name: Shuyet Boost I
c.shuyet-boost-i.description: The powers of the Timekeeper infuse into Shuyet's darkness, which seems to pulse and grow... darker? Passively boosts Shuyet's Attack by +20 (Max 2).

u.parchment-of-sinderklaz-tovenaray.name: Parchment of Sinderklaz Tovenaray
u.parchment-of-sinderklaz-tovenaray.description: A thick scroll that feels cool to the touch, but warms your insides as you unfurl it!

a.geos-faithful-servant.name: Geo's Faithful Servant
a.geos-faithful-servant.description:
"We are not in the business of training fairweather servants, or those who would consider leaving their service. Only the best are capable of serving a Guild such as this one."
-Geo Fray
a.geos-faithful-servant.effects: Adds +0.5 Defence to Geo Fray, Head Servant in the active Formation

c.violet-blasting-stinger.name: Violet Blasting Stinger
c.violet-blasting-stinger.description: It remains unclear what the greater challenge was: Bringing down the original owner of this stinger, or removing it while keeping all of your fingers.

c.agiz-garnet.name: Agiz Garnet
c.agiz-garnet.description: A beautiful gem from the capital, you can only marvel at its beauty.

u.legendary-illustrious-elixir.name: Legendary Illustrious Elixir
u.legendary-illustrious-elixir.description: An elixir bestowed to only the most illustrious of legendary figures, possessing enormous potential when consumed by a worthy individual.
u.legendary-illustrious-elixir.effects: Open to obtain its contents (five of the chance drops)

c.violet-spiderpelt.name: Violet Spiderpelt
c.violet-spiderpelt.description: The hide of a giant spider, after proper curing, is as versatile as any leather.

c.blue-gargouille-horn.name: Blue Gargouille Horn
c.blue-gargouille-horn.description: You have several questions about the colouration of these horns, but no-one seems to have heard any good justification for it. Perhaps it's just as well, with the creature already being dispatched and all.

e.praetoran-shirt.name: Praetoran Shirt
e.praetoran-shirt.effects:
Praetoran Modesty (Shirt): 16% chance to proc 650 Nature damage; +50 damage per Praetoran set item worn
Set Bonus (Praetoran Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +40% Crit Damage and +1 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Fire'
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.praetoran-shirt.description: A light shirt, clearly intended for the hardworking fisherfolk, but it is surprisingly well made for such a simple design.

e.mikoko-howler.name: Mikoko Howler
e.mikoko-howler.effects:
Land's Rest (Howler): 5% chance to proc 1,800 Magic damage; +7,200 damage vs Undead raids; +800 damage per Mikoko set item worn; 3% chance to proc 1,400 Physical damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 30%; +200 damage per Mikoko set item worn
