 6+: +25% Crit Damage
 7+: +2% Crit Rate
 8+: +10% Dark Resistance
 9+: +1 Tiers of 'Inspirational Command: Horrifying'
e.mikoko-howler.description: The strange - and unsettling - barking this beast does seems to better describe the sound than 'howling', but it is quick and nimble, which is all you could ask for in the heat of combat.

c.blue-ghoul-jaw.name: Blue Ghoul Jaw
c.blue-ghoul-jaw.description: Depending upon the magics used to animate it, and the decay of the body, the discarded bits of the undead can be quite colourful.

u.blue-guild-kit-iv.name: Blue Guild Kit IV
u.blue-guild-kit-iv.description: A small, tidy sack, purporting to carry goods from the same source Slygse gets her alchemical wares.
u.blue-guild-kit-iv.effects: Open to obtain its contents (three of the chance drops)

u.samurai-starter-pack-ii.name: Samurai Starter Pack II
u.samurai-starter-pack-ii.description: A pack providing the necessary tools for every budding samurai.

e.wyrmhide-cap.name: Wyrmhide Cap
e.wyrmhide-cap.effects:
Tremorsense (Cap): 15% chance to proc 80 Nature damage; +5 damage per Wyrmhide set item worn
Set Bonus (Wyrmhide Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1 Tiers of 'Eye for Beauty'
e.wyrmhide-cap.description: I. The wyrms of the Mihrish Barrens are a mixture of myth and modern-day horror, and are said to have ranged the area since before the days that the Dwarves erected the foundation stones of Mihr. Burrowing with equal ease through the sand and stone, they are without natural predators, save for larger wyrms.

u.warmage-starter-pack-iii.name: Warmage Starter Pack III
u.warmage-starter-pack-iii.description: A pack providing the necessary equipment for every budding warmage.

u.violet-guild-kit-iv.name: Violet Guild Kit IV
u.violet-guild-kit-iv.description: A small, tidy sack, purporting to carry goods from the same source Slygse gets her alchemical wares.
u.violet-guild-kit-iv.effects: Open to obtain its contents (four of the chance drops)

u.bard-starter-pack-iv.name: Bard Starter Pack IV
u.bard-starter-pack-iv.description: A pack providing the necessary material for every budding bard.

s.scroll-niever-the-slain.name: Niever the Slain Scroll
s.scroll-niever-the-slain.description: The Slayer has been defeated, but it seems it was only a matter of time before he would be resurrected. Now you have to stop his undead rampage!

a.wandering-warden.name: Wandering Warden
a.wandering-warden.description: An automated being, sent to wander the hidden valley and to protect the magical research that has taken place within.
a.wandering-warden.effects: Adds +1 Attack to each Wandering Warden in the active Formation

a.agronomo.name: Agronomo
a.agronomo.description: A dedicated horticulturalist, don't let Agronomo's unkempt appearance colour your opinions of his meticulous skills, at least where his plants are involved. Somehow he has even managed to teach his plants how to retaliate against oppression, though you are somewhat afraid to ask about the details of that task...
a.agronomo.effects: Horticultural Hacker: Growth 6% chance to proc 300 Nature damage; Proc damage is doubled if your armies were damaged this attack

u.diminished-skill-elixir.name: Diminished Skill Elixir
u.diminished-skill-elixir.description: While the potency of this brew has clearly decreased with time, there is no arguing with the substantive benefits it still provides.

e.hearthkeepers-legplates.name: Hearthkeeper's Legplates
e.hearthkeepers-legplates.effects:
Set Bonus (Hearthkeeper Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +80 Magic and +45 Max HP
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.hearthkeepers-legplates.description: IV. Her next eldest, Koved, was a fighter through and through, though prone to anger and had been detained for barfights on several occasions. In the eyes of many he was considered a menace, but when a band of Drow had risen to claim the Stronghold for themselves Koved had been one of the greatest champions the clan could have asked for.

e.cumberworld-band.name: Cumberworld Band
e.cumberworld-band.effects:
+20 Vitality; +20 Energy
Set Bonus (Cumberworld Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1 Tiers of 'Discerning Vision' and 'Astute Observation'
 9+: +1 Tiers of 'Discerning Vision' and 'Astute Observation'
e.cumberworld-band.description:
"A ring is just the thing for those who fail to sing, for those under my wing, and those who think themselves king!"
-Bonaguido

e.oresnatchs-grand-blue-ring.name: Oresnatch's Grand Blue Ring
e.oresnatchs-grand-blue-ring.effects: Vazz's Imagination: 100% chance to proc 1,200 Magic damage and give +7.5% Evasion on that proc
e.oresnatchs-grand-blue-ring.description: Undoubtedly due to the wondrous base material they had to work with, but the jewelers seem to have figured out how to further force more Rainbow Ore power into Vazz's latest ring, improving its magical potential even further.

c.xaphegorgh-skeleton.name: Xaphegorgh Skeleton
c.xaphegorgh-skeleton.description: It is rare enough to come across one of these demonic commanders, rarer still to see one defeated, and even yet rarer to find most of it's skeleton still intact.

u.bard-starter-pack-ii.name: Bard Starter Pack II
u.bard-starter-pack-ii.description: A pack providing the necessary tools for every budding bard.

e.sinderklaz-bol.name: Sinderklaz Bol
e.sinderklaz-bol.effects:
Sinderklaz Vrolik (Bol): 16% chance to proc 2,000 Magic damage; +1% Crit Rate; +10% Crit Damage; +5% Magic Resistance; +5% Ice Resistance
Set Bonus (Sinderklaz Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +200 HP, +30% Magic Resistance and +25% Ice Resistance
e.sinderklaz-bol.description:
"There is little else more festive than a silent evening with friends and family, gazing into one of these orbs."
-Niek Mira

e.blazebrand-core.name: Blazebrand Core
e.blazebrand-core.effects:
Justice by any Flames Necessary (Core): 30% chance to proc 300 Fire damage; +100 damage per Blazebrand set item worn; 4% chance to proc 2,000 Fire damage and reduce damage to your Armies by 40%; +750 damage per Blazebrand set item worn; +15% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Blazebrand Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 8+: +2.5% Crit Rate
 9+: 40% chance to proc 250 Fire damage, +8 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Fire' and +1 Tiers of 'Insurmountable Offence'
e.blazebrand-core.description:
"The heart of the flame may burn the brightest, but it is not always the hottest. That core, however, definitely burns hottest."
-Urzul Shamn

ba.master-juggernaut-banner.name: Master Juggernaut Banner
ba.master-juggernaut-banner.description: Obtained with the Master Juggernaut Class

c.ulunsuti-stone-fangs.name: Ulunsuti Stone Fangs
c.ulunsuti-stone-fangs.description: Unlike the giant snakes and other creatures you've faced, the fangs of this mythical beast appear to be legitimately made of stone.

u.parchment-of-irus-love.name: Parchment of Irus' Love
u.parchment-of-irus-love.description: A scroll that tingles your fingers and eases your mind as you hold it.

s.scroll-xaphegorgh.name: Xaphegorgh Scroll
s.scroll-xaphegorgh.description: Practice against this demonic commander should be much simpler when you don't have to worry about denizens fleeing.

a.veteran-elven-frigidara-defender.name: Veteran Elven Frigidara Defender
a.veteran-elven-frigidara-defender.description:
"All three factions appreciate your aid. Come again if we call. Fight back the Horde."
-Aegyr Snowbound
a.veteran-elven-frigidara-defender.effects: Adds +3 Attack and +0.3 Defence to Aegyr Snowbound, Bellas Inahice and Burz in the active Formation

c.barbaric-seekerstone.name: Barbaric Seekerstone
c.barbaric-seekerstone.description: Navigating in snowy hills seems to bring significant challenges compared to what you're used to. Apparently these seekerstones are used by the barbarian tribes to figure out where they need to go.

e.valley-verdure-boots.name: Valley Verdure Boots
e.valley-verdure-boots.effects:
Verdant Volley (Boots): 8% chance to proc 1,000 Nature damage; +800 damage per Valley Verdure set item worn; +50 Magic; +2% All Resistances
Set Bonus (Valley Verdure Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +500 Magic
 6+: +2% Crit Rate and +10% Crit Damage
e.valley-verdure-boots.description:
"If you don't mind, try to mind those plants there. They're rare in these areas, and soooo pretty!"
-Murrlix

e.shudder-sailors-ring.name: Shudder Sailor's Ring
e.shudder-sailors-ring.effects:
Clooney's Consent (Ring): 20% chance to proc 125 Dark damage; +25 damage per Shudder Sailor's set item worn; +2% Crit Rate; +40 HP
Set Bonus (Shudder Sailor's Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: 20% chance to proc 500 Physical damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 20%
e.shudder-sailors-ring.description:
"And, one day not too far from now, I will bequeath this ring to my beloved, and we will never again be parted."

"Haven't you already handed out a dozen of those rings, Captain?"

-Conversations with the crew of the Vengeance

cp.warmage-starter-pack-i.name: Warmage Starter Pack I
cp.warmage-starter-pack-i.description: A pack providing the necessary goods for every budding warmage.

c.jingse-alms.name: Jingse Alms
c.jingse-alms.description: Rare alms, found amongst the rubble of the insect hordes... You recall hearing the local jeweler reminiscing about such a thing.

c.red-thurlam-octopus.name: Red Thurlam Octopus
c.red-thurlam-octopus.description: Unlike similar creatures from the southern seas, these strangely-coloured octopods are apparently renowned for both their size, and their delicious flavour.

c.brew-of-divinity.name: Brew of Divinity
c.brew-of-divinity.description: Having ascended the highest of mountains, I also ran through the fields, for the sole purpose of being with you. I have run, crawled, and climbed walls just to be with you.

u.script-of-venom-strike.name: Script of Venom Strike
u.script-of-venom-strike.description: "Mother's embrace, fly forth and present your kiss! Venom Strike!"

e.dromaeon-pants.name: Dromaeon Pants
e.dromaeon-pants.effects: Prehistoric Pummelling (Pants): 10% chance to proc 200 Physical damage; +2000 damage vs Guild Raids; +25 damage per Dromaeon set item worn
e.dromaeon-pants.description: II. Ceta was born to a relatively wealthy family in a large city, and blessed with the best education money could buy, and had all of her needs seen to without reservation. The one thing that her parents seemed incapable of providing for young Ceta, however, was companionship and love.

c.red-faecage.name: Red Faecage
c.red-faecage.description: This colourful cage may seem quite typical to you, but once your fingers get near the door and you feel an unseen pressure preventing you from unlatching it, you realize it was clearly made to keep things in, while keeping other things out.

u.rc-void-crystals-pack.name: RC Void Crystals Pack
u.rc-void-crystals-pack.description: A small, exclusive pouch filled with some Void Crystals, potions and other goodies.

e.tromos-latria-sealbreaker.name: Tromos Latria Sealbreaker
e.tromos-latria-sealbreaker.effects:
Returning the Damners (Sealbreaker): 14% chance to proc 100 Dark damage; +300 damage per Tromos Latria set item worn; +10% Crit Damage; +250 Magic; +50 HP
Set Bonus (Tromos Latria Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +5% Crit Damage, +500 Magic and -5% Formation Bonus
 7+: +1 Tiers of 'Magic Meditation' and -5% Formation Bonus
 8+: +1 Tiers of 'Protective Guardian' and -10% Formation Bonus
 9+: +3% Crit Rate and -10% Formation Bonus
e.tromos-latria-sealbreaker.description: Filled to the brim with dark energies, Alanis seems confident that this staff must have been instrumental in the destruction of the Tromos seal.

e.waveblessed-shirt.name: Waveblessed Shirt
e.waveblessed-shirt.effects:
By the Waves (Shirt): 16% chance to proc 225 Nature damage; +175 damage per Waveblessed set item worn; 16% chance to proc 225 Holy damage; +175 damage per Waveblessed set item worn; +12 HP
Set Bonus (Waveblessed Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +400 Magic and 2% chance to heal the Player 0.6 HP
 7+: +30 HP and 4% chance to heal the Player 0.25 HP
 8+: +2% Crit Rate and +15% Crit Damage
 9+: +6% All Resistances and 5% chance to heal the Player 1.8 HP
e.waveblessed-shirt.description: As much as helping others warms your soul, something to keep you warm while sailing during blustering storms is an absolute must.

c.stormstruck-ore.name: Stormstruck Ore
c.stormstruck-ore.description: Regular ore, charged and ionized after being struck by lightning. Well, it can't hurt to try some new marketing.

e.reodai-boltbuzzer.name: Reodai Boltbuzzer
e.reodai-boltbuzzer.effects:
Reodai's Impudence: 6% chance to proc 4,000 Lightning damage; +1,500 damage per Reodai set item worn; +50 HP; +2% Evasion; +2% Crit Rate
Set Bonus (Reodai Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +3% Evasion, +25% Crit Damage and 6% chance to proc 4,000 Lightning damage with +30% Crit Rate on that hit
e.reodai-boltbuzzer.description:
"It is clear you don't pay much heed to the higher powers. While you need not subscribe to one deity before any others, recognition of them will go a long way in overcoming your inner impudence."

"I think this one will need a lot more than religious understanding to overcome that particular character flaw..."

-Conversations between Jinna Brightwhisper and Alanis

u.foaming-honor-bundle-bag-ii.name: Foaming Honor Bundle Bag II
u.foaming-honor-bundle-bag-ii.description: A pack, filled to the brim with foaming potions!

a.rankats.name: Rankats
a.rankats.description:
"Hmmm... I think I have just the thing for you, adventurer. No, none of those paltry baubles, but something of real power that I'm certain you simply need."
-Rankats
a.rankats.effects: Psychic Sculpture: 5% chance to proc 18,000 Psychic damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 12%; Adds +1 Attack and +0.3 Defence to each Hatuumin Buster and Hatuumin Psionic in the Formation; Restores 5 Health daily

c.ghoul-wrappings.name: Ghoul Wrappings
c.ghoul-wrappings.description: Unlike other cloths, these wrappings seem to be imbued with a strange aura, and a deathly stench.

c.deep-sea-hook.name: Deep-Sea Hook
c.deep-sea-hook.description: Apparently the deepest-dwelling creatures are exceptionally strong, and the regular hooks you're accustomed to would not suffice to secure its prey. You can only wonder what one of those creatures would be like...

e.natures-lumbering-mosses.name: Nature's Lumbering Mosses
e.natures-lumbering-mosses.effects:
Scenic Uprising (Mosses): 30% chance to proc 1,260 Nature damage with +15% damage from any Nature damage, and +120% Crit Damage on that proc; +2,500 damage vs Legendary Raids; +780 damage per Nature's Revolt set item worn; +25% Formation Power; +4% All Resistances; 5% chance to reduce incoming damage to your Armies by 25%
Set Bonus (Nature's Revolt Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +25% Crit Damage and +2% Crit Rate
 6+: 30% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 10%; +30% vs Easy Raids, and +1% Evasion; +3% Evasion vs Easy Raids
 7+: +5% All Resistances and +150 HP
 8+: 25% chance to reduce incoming damage to your Armies by 20%; +30% vs Legendary Raids, and +1% Crit Rate; +2% Crit Rate vs Legendary Raids
 9+: 3% chance to heal the Player 2 HP; +4 HP healed vs Hard Raids, and +15% Crit Damage; +25% Crit Damage vs Hard Raids
e.natures-lumbering-mosses.description: You had figured Brocck was being figurative with all his talk of 'the land' feeling one way or another. However, this literal, rolling wave of earth, creeping vines and moss seems to have a mind of its own. Perhaps there is some more to his words...

e.blessed-gastonia-boots.name: Blessed Gastonia Boots
e.blessed-gastonia-boots.effects:
Sacred Scutum (Boots): 20% chance to proc 1200 Physical damage; +12500 damage vs Guild Raids; +350 damage per Blessed Gastonia set item worn; 25% chance to proc 400 Holy damage; +150 damage per Blessed Gastonia set item worn
Set Bonus (Blessed Gastonia Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +100 Honor, +75 Energy and +75 Vitality

u.platinum-swiftness-tonic.name: Platinum Swiftness Tonic
u.platinum-swiftness-tonic.description:
An old legend tells of two colleagues exploring a dense forest, before happening upon a bear. When the bear gives chase, they both flee as swiftly as their feet will carry them. One of the colleagues pauses to quaff a draught from a small glass beaker. "You'll never be able to evade the bear forever, so why waste time with a last drink?!" His partner questioned incredulously.

"I need not escape the bear forever, ol' chum! I need only dodge its advances longer than you!"
u.platinum-swiftness-tonic.effects: Increases Evasion equivalent to +450,000 Agility for 8 hours

u.navenian-provisions.name: Navenian Provisions
u.navenian-provisions.description: A gift from the citizenry of Naven, for protecting the village from the Naga and the other denizens of the Void.

u.healing-potion.name: Healing Potion
u.healing-potion.description:
"Is there a reason that this thick liquid is roughly the colour of blood?"

"Don't ask a question if you don't want to hear the answer."
-Conversations with Nphireo

e.hatuumin-eye.name: Hatuumin Eye
e.hatuumin-eye.effects:
Sight of the Eye (Eye): 50% chance to proc 240 Psychic damage; +80 HP; +1.5% Evasion; +10% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Hatuumin Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: Additional Bonuses depending on Main-Hand/Off-Hand equipped
e.hatuumin-eye.description:
VIII. Sennie wiped the sweat from his brow as the trio crept down another spiraling stairwell, and the exertion of combat had nearly depleted his magical reserves entirely. Three more times they had been beset by undead creatures, and while he had been able to enchant Sinyu's weapons to be capable of injuring the creatures, it still required a constant flow of magic from him or the enchantment would soon expire.

Sennie was on the verge of recommending they turn back, seeing as Kontar was bloodied and even Sinyu's seeming limitless endurance appeared taxed, when he saw a large pillar encircling a shimmering portal in the chamber before them.

They had made it, somehow... But was the hard part behind them, or before them?

c.torched-tome-of-failure.name: Torched Tome of Failure
c.torched-tome-of-failure.description: This burned book clearly has no decipherable knowledge left in it. It is utterly worthless to you. Why would you cast such valuable potential into the flames for such worthless fare?

u.blue-daily-chest.name: Blue Daily Chest
u.blue-daily-chest.description: A reward for your continued efforts to push back the Void, awarded for logins 21-25 during the month.

e.warmage-guardians-gauntlets.name: Warmage Guardian's Gauntlets
e.warmage-guardians-gauntlets.effects:
Magic Shield (Gauntlets): 20% chance to proc 500 Physical damage and add +200 Defence; +175 damage per Warmage Guardian's set item worn; +6% Crit Damage; +10 HP
Set Bonus (Warmage Guardian's Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +1% Crit Rate
 7+: +500 Defence and +15% Crit Damage
 9+: +20% chance to proc 200 Magic damage with +6% damage from any Magic damage on that proc
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.warmage-guardians-gauntlets.description: Of course you'd be 'happy' to carry the extra luggage and 'research materials' around for these mages. It's not like their safety rests upon your capacity to act quickly and defend them or anything...

c.enchanted-lockpicks.name: Enchanted Lockpicks
c.enchanted-lockpicks.description: You are not accustomed to needing to access things that are sealed away from you, but you certainly must admit that it is handy when you have access to these previously-kept secrets.

c.yellow-wooden-shackles.name: Yellow Wooden Shackles
c.yellow-wooden-shackles.description: These sturdy shackles were certainly built to keep prisoners from making foolish decisions... Though you suspect the bright colours were equally meant to provoke them in the meantime.

a.morassma-thorn.name: Morassma Thorn
a.morassma-thorn.description:
"You can always run around threatening folks to try to prevent a fight. Or you can invite it, and make the option as unappealing as possible."
-Aguil Morassma
a.morassma-thorn.effects: Adds +0.6 Defence to Panee Morassma and Aguil Morassma in the active Formation

c.green-cloak.name: Green Cloak
c.green-cloak.description: A cloak made of fine materials and brilliantly coloured threads... You wonder what led to that creature possessing it.

e.viscous-viscount-striker.name: Viscous Viscount Striker
e.viscous-viscount-striker.effects:
Eccentric Ennoblement (Striker): 12% chance to proc 700 Acid damage; +350 damage per Viscous Viscount set item worn; 4% chance to proc 3,300 Acid damage; +400 damage per Viscous Viscount set item worn; +1% Crit Rate; +100 Magic
Set Bonus (Viscous Viscount Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1.5% Crit Rate
 6+: +10% Crit Damage
 8+: +150 HP
 9+: Additional Bonuses depending on Mount equipped
e.viscous-viscount-striker.description: A marvel of modern technology, the ability to quickly strike out at a distance, without needing the training required for a bow or the strength and time of a crossbow... You can only wonder what else Viscount Thorne has had the privilege of acquiring that you could only have dreamed of.

u.samurai-starter-pack-iv.name: Samurai Starter Pack IV
u.samurai-starter-pack-iv.description: A pack providing the necessary material for every budding samurai.

c.thinned-brew-of-frost.name: Thinned Brew of Frost
c.thinned-brew-of-frost.description: It's amusing how looking from afar can make everything seem to minute, and the fears that controlled you cannot seem to follow.

e.scolfields-bergere.name: Scolfield's Bergère
e.scolfields-bergere.effects:
+30 Vitality; +30 Energy; +30 Honor
Set Bonus (Scolfield Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1 Tiers of 'Discerning Vision', 'Astute Observation' and 'Precise Inspection'
 9+: +1 Tiers of 'Discerning Vision', 'Astute Observation' and 'Precise Inspection'
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.scolfields-bergere.description:
"I couldn't say why my Lady has taken such an interest in this Cumberworld affair, nor would I spread her gossip even if I did know!"
-Scolfield Retainer

c.violet-naaviks-scales.name: Violet Naavik's Scales
c.violet-naaviks-scales.description: Apparently sea creatures are less prone to shedding their scales than land-based beings: These colourful scales must be exceptionally rare, though you can only hope that rarity translates to value.

u.lesser-draught-of-grit.name: Lesser Draught of Grit
u.lesser-draught-of-grit.description: Long ago it was believed that ample stamina was all that was necessary to push the adventuring body into battle. Now we know that a little bit of grit is what was missing from the equation.
u.lesser-draught-of-grit.effects: Increases today's daily raid limit by 2

a.clyburn-softshadow.name: Clyburn Softshadow
a.clyburn-softshadow.description:
"Clyburn may not be the best fighter we have available, but his organizational capabilities are exceptional for his rank. We figured he would gain some experience commanding some of the Patrol sorties, though it seems we got our wishes in spades."
-Avri Stidig
a.clyburn-softshadow.effects: Defence of Naitour: 5% chance to proc 240 Physical damage

e.consecrated-leoegan-dory.name: Consecrated Leoegan Dory
e.consecrated-leoegan-dory.effectName: At the Please of the Gods (Dory)
e.consecrated-leoegan-dory.effects:
At the Please of the Gods (Dory): 14% chance to proc 750 Holy damage; +250 damage per Consecrated Leoegan set item worn; +1% Crit Rate; +40 HP
Consecrated
e.consecrated-leoegan-dory.description: XVII. Nestled along the rear of the rock face was a small stone building, seemingly inconspicuous, but something gleamed within that drew Paython's attention. Unable to hold himself back Paython drew closer to the building - which appeared to be a type of stable - only to find a number of brilliant, firey stallions, still tethered up to a grand, golden chariot.

a.johayra-glynqen.name: Johayra Glynqen
a.johayra-glynqen.description: A powerful summoner, Johayra seems to always be accompanied by some small, elemental golem or another. Seeking to improve her powers, she has ventured to the tower constructed by Nebekinessur in order to access his mystical research.
a.johayra-glynqen.effects: Sensational Summonings: 7% chance to proc 2,000 Nature damage; 7% chance to proc 2,000 Fire damage; 7% chance to proc 2,000 Ice damage; 7% chance to proc 2,000 Lightning damage; Adds +15 to Player Energy

e.irus-shroud-crusade-gauntlets.name: Irus' Shroud Crusade Gauntlets
e.irus-shroud-crusade-gauntlets.effects:
Forward Irus' Light (Gauntlets): 16% chance to proc 600 Holy damage; +425 damage per Irus' Shroud Crusade set item worn; +2,250 damage vs Demon raids; +25 HP; +3% Fire Resistance; +3% Dark Resistance
Consecrated
Set Bonus (Irus' Shroud Crusade Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1.5% Crit Rate and +15% Crit Damage
 6+: +4 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Holy'
 7+: +10% Formation Bonus
 8+: +5% All Resistances
 9+: +15% Crit Damage and +10% Formation Bonus
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.irus-shroud-crusade-gauntlets.description:
"Some may say we employ heavy handed tactics to protect Irus' followers. I say that such tactics are necessary to do Irus' bidding."
-Wilben Shroudbearer

a.tedupevair-winger.name: Tedupevair Winger
a.tedupevair-winger.description: Perhaps the best way to spot hidden things is to put eyes-in-the-sky.
a.tedupevair-winger.effects: Adds +3 Attack to Thephis Stonegaze in the active Formation

e.mountain-trekkers-pointer.name: Mountain Trekkers Pointer
e.mountain-trekkers-pointer.effects:
Uphill Undertakings (Pointer): 10% chance to proc 150 Nature damage; +50 damage per Mountain Trekkers set item worn; +400 damage vs Winter raids; +0.5% Crit Rate
Set Bonus (Mountain Trekkers Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +5% Ice Resistance
 7+: +20 Vitality
 8+: +5 Raid Cap
e.mountain-trekkers-pointer.description:
"Here, don't get lost. I wouldn't want you wandering about without supervision."
-Melaphin Suncomber

e.gastonia-gloves.name: Gastonia Gloves
e.gastonia-gloves.effects:
Scutum Smash (Gloves): 20% chance to proc 800 Physical damage; +7500 damage vs Guild Raids; +200 damage per Gastonia set item worn
Set Bonus (Gastonia Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +50 Honor, +30 Energy and +30 Vitality
e.gastonia-gloves.description: V(a). Leoben donned his most charming smile, quickly getting onto one knee and pulling forth his lyre as he strummed out a few chords. u.rogue-starter-pack-i.name: Rogue Starter Pack I
u.rogue-starter-pack-i.description: A pack providing the necessary goods for every budding rogue.

e.leoegan-helmet.name: Leoegan Helmet
e.leoegan-helmet.effects:
By the Gods (Helmet): 6% chance to proc 500 Physical damage
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.leoegan-helmet.description: VI. After several days of travel, Paython rushed to the great Temple, only to be turned away by Vozotl's adherents. Someone as unclean, unkempt and uncouth as this youth was unsuitable and unready to give praise to Vozotl's greatness.

a.clay-golem.name: Clay Golem
a.clay-golem.description: Surprisingly powerful for their small stature, you've seen these golems take wicked claw attacks that would have dismembered you, only to reform uninjured.

c.northern-icejam-berry.name: Northern Icejam Berry
c.northern-icejam-berry.description: A berry renowned by northerners for making a delicious spread, they equally enjoy watching southerners attempt to bite into the raw berry, unaware that it is as hard as stone until it has been treated, rendering it soft enough to pound into a jam.

a.rookie-scholar.name: Rookie Scholar
a.rookie-scholar.description: Seeking knowledge from a variety of sources, scholars claim that they hold the keys to lost civilizations and empires, and only through their collective wisdom can a better road forward be paved. These acolytes are not quite as experienced as their seniors, but are learning more each and every day.

e.snowdrake-slaughterer-frostwulf.name: Snowdrake Slaughterer Frostwulf
e.snowdrake-slaughterer-frostwulf.effects:
Wandering in a Winter Wasteland (Frostwulf): 16% chance to proc 500 Physical damage; +200 damage per Snowdrake Slaughterer set item worn; +3,000 damage vs Winter raids; +2,000 damage vs Dragon raids; +5% Ice Resistance
Set Bonus (Snowdrake Slaughterer Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +2% Crit Rate and +30% Crit Damage
 9+: +10% Ice Resistance
e.snowdrake-slaughterer-frostwulf.description: You were just getting used to the unpleasant and growl-filled demeanour of the Frostwulf, but this new individual has a glimmer in its eye that you suspect is an understanding - and resentment - of you preparing to mount it.

u.script-of-poison-spray.name: Script of Poison Spray
u.script-of-poison-spray.description: "From the earth, spread your noxious fumes! Poison Spray!"

u.greater-ice-resilience-potion.name: Greater Ice Resilience Potion
u.greater-ice-resilience-potion.description: A frothy, mesmerizing potion that smells of the ideal seasoning of coriander.

a.reodai-apostle.name: Reodai Apostle
a.reodai-apostle.description:
"Six inner turmoils must be overcome to attain the Reodai. What steps have you taken to overcome your anger? Usurp your desire? Quiet your fear? Or perhaps we should start with the basics..."
-Jinna Brightwhisper
a.reodai-apostle.effects: Adds +2 Attack and +0.3 Defence to Jinna Brightwhisper and Lokakshi Coilbreaker in the active Formation

a.illiana-bloodletter.name: Illiana Bloodletter
a.illiana-bloodletter.description: She may seem mad, but there is a cunning gleam in her eyes that you cannot quite shake. You cannot bring yourself to agree with her methods, but she seems intent on facing off against the same enemies you pursue, so you'll accept her help for the time being.
a.illiana-bloodletter.effects: Spilling the Feast: 14% chance to proc 20,000 Dark damage and add +25% Crit Damage on that attack; Adds +4 Attack and +0.4 Defence to each Vylda's Bloody Supplicant in the Formation; Adds +20 Vitality to the Player

e.mephitic-chiffon-hooves.name: Mephitic Chiffon Hooves
e.mephitic-chiffon-hooves.effects:
Downy Destruction (Hooves): 40% chance to proc 375 Holy damage; +6250 damage vs Guild Raids; +125 damage per Mephitic Chiffon set item worn; 25% chance to proc 400 Poison damage; +150 damage per Mephitic Chiffon set item worn

e.mephitic-chiffon-hooves.description:
XIV. Before the shock of what had transpired had passed, Brath was besieged with a torrent of dark energy. The apparition cackled in an unearthly tone as it flung spell after spell at him. Brath nimbly dodged several blasts of energy, rebuffing several others with his own magic, and winced while he felt the last vestiges of energy drain from the nearby land as Cenius drew out their life essence with ease. Recognizing that he was not going to win by simply dodging, Brath drew up a spear of earth from below the smoky form, but as it pierced upwards it met with no resistance, and did nothing to stifle the cackling laughter from the apparition. Brath dodged another series of energy waves before being slammed forward by a vine, knocking him off balance. As he stumbled, Brath noticed the face of one of the cultists he had ensnared, appearing utterly dehydrated and mummified.

'Of course,' Brath thought to himself. 'He is drawing the life energy out of the cultists themselves!'

c.ensouled-crustacean-claw.name: Ensouled Crustacean Claw
c.ensouled-crustacean-claw.description: It feels immoral to keep the claws of those poor souls who have been, well, re-homed, but you can't do much about it without making use of this power.

ba.grand-shaman-banner.name: Grand Shaman Banner
ba.grand-shaman-banner.description: Obtained with the Grand Shaman Class

c.red-horsebrush.name: Red Horsebrush
c.red-horsebrush.description: The fine handle and strong bristles on this brush are clearly intended for use with an equally fine stallion.

However, Edwin has confirmed the quality of the shoes, and seemed to be nigh-besotted with their design, so you've little option but to give them a chance.

u.red-orange-repentant-dusk-chest.name: Red-Orange Repentant Dusk Chest
u.red-orange-repentant-dusk-chest.description: Dusk’s chill falls upon all foes caught in its shadows.

c.orange-thick-fur.description: There is no doubting that this fur would keep you warm, even during a night out-of-doors, but you aren't convinced the colour would reduce your likelihood of being spotted.

c.brew-of-magics.name: Brew of Magics
c.brew-of-magics.description: It is now time for me to leave, my path lit by the autumn moon. I can now smell the rain, and know the pain it brings is headed my way.

s.scroll-mirgoda.description: A reclusive beast, imbued with icy energies, it scavenges from local settlements, and can summon icy beings to assist in its attacks.

Little is known about the first Fiddler Knight, save that the stories say he had trained at the Swiftblade Academy in his youth, and was amazingly proficient at offensive, close-ranged combat with blades. u.script-of-volt-wave.name: Script of Volt Wave

e.mordant-moswa-hooves.description:
VII. Brath hastily made arrangements with the Headmaster to take a hopefully-brief sabbatical to the Voysa Province before planning his next steps. The majority of the recent events he had been able to find suggested issues in the capital of Rispa, but Brath had suspicions that the heart of the issue lay elsewhere... Though whether it was the Celelfen Swamp, the Vermond Mountains or the Lenha Woods was unclear. Brath decided to depart for Rispa and see what he could find there, as the new information would at least be fresh.

The journey was uneventful, though it did take him the better part of a month by wagon, and Brath could only hope that there nothing else untoward had transpired in that time. After arriving at the city, Brath decided to visit a recommended inn to gather his wits and prepare for the search the following day, and bedded early that eve. His sleep was haunted, however, by the visions that had befallen him while still at the Academy, only seemingly starker in contrast and far more vivid. Overlaid over the name Cenius, which always followed after the spectral, cloaked hands reached out for him, Brath saw a hooded shape, and a young woman pulled it back to reveal a scarred face while she stood before a fire in a dark forest. Brath woke in a panic, covered in perspiration, and barely slept a wink the remainder of the night.

e.dromaeon-loop.description: VIII. "Oh, so sorry my friend... it seems you're not quite on your game tod-" The shell-game vendor stopped mid-sentence when he finally raised the shell, and saw the bead still sitting on the table. Helmo smiled to himself, and quickly grabbed the two pouches on the table, tipping his hat until the vendor grabbed his forearm with one arm, brandishing a knife with the other. "Nobody is going to cheat me and walk away, friend!" The vendor growled, but Leoben strummed a quick trio of chords on his lyre before placing a small handful of coins on the table. "And the town guard wouldn't appreciate your game swindling the good people, either, so let bygones be." Leoben stood as the vendor released Helmo's arm, and turned Helmo about as the two began walking away at a brisk pace.

He could, for the most part, figure out his letters, but putting them together to form words made little sense. Worse still, stringing those words together to form phrases was utterly foreign to Brath, and this frustrated his parents. During

ru.eihalgiz-rune-2.name: Eihalgiz Rune (EiZ) Lv. 2
ru.eihalgiz-rune-2.effects:
Can provide one of the following boosts:
-+5-7 Max HP (50%)
-+8-12 Defence (50%)

e.peg-legged-buccaneers-pants.name: Peg-legged Buccaneer's Pants
e.peg-legged-buccaneers-pants.effects:
One Leg At A Time: 50% chance to proc 380 Physical damage; +1% Crit Rate'
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.peg-legged-buccaneers-pants.description: Clearly made with a particular physical quality in mind, you aren't entirely sure how best to approach putting these pants on.

c.mark-of-the-undead.name: Mark of the Undead
c.mark-of-the-undead.description: The undying hordes left their mark on the land, but also upon you.

u.script-of-sakura-blizzard.name: Script of Sakura Blizzard
u.script-of-sakura-blizzard.description: "Visions of beauty, share your glory in blood! Sakura Blizzard!"

a.voithos-erevnetis.name: Voithos Erevnetis
a.voithos-erevnetis.description: No stranger to the upper echelons of academia, these researchers are capable and adept, knowing what is required with little prompting. This is certainly to their advantage, as you've no doubt that Malon, in all their self-described importance, would otherwise gladly leave them behind.
a.voithos-erevnetis.effects: Adds +0.6 Defence to Malon Roris in the active Formation

c.sluagh-feather.name: Sluagh Feather
c.sluagh-feather.description: A rare feather from the rarer, nigh-ethereal beast itself.

e.bolting-fiddler-boots.name: Bolting Fiddler Boots
e.bolting-fiddler-boots.effects:
Shock and Slice (Boots): 4% chance to proc 4900 Physical damage; +62500 damage vs Guild Raids; +950 damage per Bolting Fiddler set item worn; 40% chance to proc 625 Physical damage; +125 damage per Bolting Fiddler set item worn; 25% chance to proc 400 Lightning damage; +150 damage per Bolting Fiddler set item worn
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion

c.arcane-view-finder.name: Arcane View-Finder
c.arcane-view-finder.description: You've seen a number of instances of glass being used to change the perspective of view, but this enchanted device seems capable of further magnifying what you're trying to view, almost at-will. What's more, the runes in the handle seem to understand what you're searching for, and provide subtle clues to help you locate it all the quicker.

e.onishaygu-tendril-wand.name: Onishaygu Tendril Wand
e.onishaygu-tendril-wand.effects:
Wild Sprout (Wand): 10% chance to proc 700 Nature damage; +350 damage per Onishaygu Tendril set item worn; +0.75% Crit Rate; +30 Vitality
Set Bonus (Onishaygu Tendril Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +50 HP
 7+: +2 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Nature'
 8+: +40 Vitality and +40 Honour
 9+: +200 Energy
e.onishaygu-tendril-wand.description:
"Ssshare your growth with the world, and help the world grow in turn."
-Aaja Orisha

e.bassinian-warder-hat.name: Bassinian Warder Hat
e.bassinian-warder-hat.effects:
Bassinian Honor (Hat): 7% chance to proc 75 Physical damage; +25 damage per Bassinian Warder set item worn; +15 Energy; +15 Vitality
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.bassinian-warder-hat.description: The odd design of this hat seems utterly and completely impractical, but Hamond has assured you that he has seen many nobles and aristocrats wearing very similar to some of the larger galas held in the city. The tight felt pressing against your scalp is almost maddening.

e.gipantan-dockhand-dockpants.name: Gipantan Dockhand Dockpants
e.gipantan-dockhand-dockpants.effects:
Barrel Hoister (Dockpants): 20% chance to proc 120 Dark damage; +40 damage per Gipantan Dockhand set item worn; +200 damage vs Aquatic raids; +5 Energy
Set Bonus (Gipantan Dockhand Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +10 Energy
 8+: +20 Energy
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.gipantan-dockhand-dockpants.description:
"Be sure you're keeping your pants on, even if they get wet. We get too many oddities at the docks without you adding to it."
-Broff Keghaul

a.vasieran-zapper.name: Vasieran Zapper
a.vasieran-zapper.description: Your first thoughts regarding merfolk and lightning are that these two things would not mix. As you watch one flick lightning between her fingers, you feel discouraged from raising the opinion.
a.vasieran-zapper.effects: Adds +1% Lightning Resistance to the Player

e.heavy-stompers.name: Heavy Stompers
e.heavy-stompers.effects:
Stomp Stomp: 5% chance to proc 500 Physical damage
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.heavy-stompers.description: You've grown accustomed to the various sounds made by the differing footwear you've started to accumulate, but you've never heard such a unique combination of 'clopping' and metal 'clunking' in a single, resonating step.

e.bogwalking-pants.name: Bogwalking Pants
e.bogwalking-pants.effects: Swampy Steps: 12% chance to proc 300 Nature damage; +4% Acid Resistance; +4% Poison Resistance
e.bogwalking-pants.description: Not that much different than the pants you'd wear to work the fields, but at least it gives some extra clearance above your boots.

e.morassma-darts.name: Morassma Darts
e.morassma-darts.effects:
Soiled Toil (Darts): 14% chance to proc 400 Poison damage; +200 damage per Morassma set item worn; 4% chance to proc 650 Poison damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 10%; +450 damage per Morassma set item worn
Set Bonus (Morassma Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +15% Poison Resistance and +15% Acid Resistance
 7+: 4% chance to proc 2,000 Acid damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 60%
 9+: +0.2 Formation Protection Value to the active Formation and protects your Armies from the effects of Venomous and both your Armies and yourself from Volatile
e.morassma-darts.description:
"When you can't get them with your acid, you have to slow them down with the poison, and then follow it up with the acid!"
-Panee Morassma

e.paresthisy-hallucination.name: Paresthisy Hallucination
e.paresthisy-hallucination.effects:
Existential Experiencing (Hallucination): 5% chance to proc 2,000 Psychic damage, reducing damage to Armies by 20% and giving +10% Evasion on proc; +1,000 damage per Paresthisy set item worn; +60 HP; +1 Tiers of 'Eye for Beauty'
Set Bonus (Paresthisy Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +1 Tiers of 'Eye for Beauty'
 8+: +1 Tiers of 'Eye for Beauty'
e.paresthisy-hallucination.description: A creature shimmering in enigmatic colours, you are certain you are equally unsure as the Paresthisy whether it is actually real, or merely a figment of your imagination.

e.friskfingers-boots.name: Friskfingers Boots
e.friskfingers-boots.effects:
Rapid Robbery (Boots): 4% chance to proc 2,000 Physical damage; +1,250 damage per Friskfingers set item worn; +0.2% Evasion; +25 Vitality; +10 Honor
Set Bonus (Friskfingers Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1.5% Crit Rate, +30 Honor and +2 Tiers of 'Spare Change'
 6+: +3 Tiers of 'Spare Change' and +60 Vitality
 7+: +10% Crit Damage and +1 Tiers of 'Keen Eyes'
 8+: +50 Vitality, +3 Tiers of 'Vulnerability Spotter - Pursuer' and +3 Tiers of 'Vulnerability Spotter - Elusive'
 9+: +50 Vitality, +1 Tiers of 'Keen Eyes' and +5 Tiers of 'Spare Change'
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.friskfingers-boots.description: Soft leather, with sturdy soles. You expected run-of-the-mill quality of boots, but are pleasantly surprised by what you received.

u.script-of-thunderclap.name: Script of Thunderclap
u.script-of-thunderclap.description: "Spin your wheel and deafen the world! Thunderclap!"
u.script-of-thunderclap.effects: Deals 325,000 Lightning damage vs Guild Raids

u.greater-dark-resilience-potion.name: Greater Dark Resilience Potion
u.greater-dark-resilience-potion.description: A frothy, mesmerizing potion that smells of the ideal seasoning of anise.

e.rod-of-enchanting-light.name: Rod of Enchanting Light
e.rod-of-enchanting-light.effects: Captivating Brilliance: 12% chance to proc 300 Psychic damage; +300 damage vs Human raids; +10% Crit Damage
e.rod-of-enchanting-light.description: Possibly the largest rod you've held to date, the scintillating brilliance shining from this beacon would certainly charm anyone who gazed upon it.

e.tromos-latria-perizoma.name: Tromos Latria Perizoma
e.tromos-latria-perizoma.effects:
Returning the Damners (Perizoma): 25% chance to proc 200 Dark damage; +100 damage per Tromos Latria set item worn; 2% chance to proc 650 Holy damage; +700 damage per Tromos Latria set item worn; +75 Magic; +3% Holy Resistance
Set Bonus (Tromos Latria Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +5% Crit Damage, +500 Magic and -5% Formation Bonus
 7+: +1 Tiers of 'Magic Meditation' and -5% Formation Bonus
 8+: +1 Tiers of 'Protective Guardian' and -10% Formation Bonus
 9+: +3% Crit Rate and -10% Formation Bonus
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.tromos-latria-perizoma.description: These bottoms make you feel incredibly unclean... In several different ways. They do seem to provide a strange warming sensation, though.

e.mortiday-shield.name: Mortiday Shield
e.mortiday-shield.effects:
Mortiday Celebration (Shield): 5% chance to proc 1,200 Dark damage; +300 damage per Mortiday set item worn
Set Bonus (Mortiday Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +20% Crit Damage
 8+: Reduces incoming damage from Human raids to the Player by 30%
 9+: +2.5% Crit Rate and +10% Crit Damage
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.mortiday-shield.description: It's almost a shame to use such an ornate and culturally painted piece in combat... But you suspect your foes may be less awestruck by the designs than you are.

e.kyuubi-flail.name: Kyuubi Flail
e.kyuubi-flail.effects: Nine-tailed Storm Blast: 33% chance to proc 800 Lightning damage
e.kyuubi-flail.description: The nine lashes on this flail seem incapable of ever remaining fully still, and generate problematic amounts of static even when not in use. The blasts they send forth in battle, however, bring to mind natural disasters.

c.blue-runecarver.name: Blue Runecarver
c.blue-runecarver.description: Unlike a sharp tool that would merely cut into stone, this seems to leave a powerful, magic-infused etch behind on the rock. Part of you wants to try to draw some funny pictures, but between Alanis' scolding and the potentially explosive natural consequences, you decide against it.

c.glowing-ulunsuti.name: Glowing Ulunsuti
c.glowing-ulunsuti.description: Whether the gem or the beast is properly named, you cannot deny the lure of this enormous crystal.

a.phermis-worshipper.name: Phermis Worshipper
a.phermis-worshipper.description:
"Only a fool would think that ranged combat is cowardly in war. Phermis, Herself, is known for Her proficiency both with the bow and the spear."
-Meropi Demide
a.phermis-worshipper.effects: Adds +0.3 Defence to Meropi Demide in the active Formation

c.violet-glowstone.name: Violet Glowstone
c.violet-glowstone.description: This magical stone illuminates the darkness in a strange, colourful light.

c.hearthkeepers-observation.name: Hearthkeeper's Observation
c.hearthkeepers-observation.description: "The study of the ground, itself, is a foreign subject to many humans, but is a fundamental basic to virtually all dwarves. However, merely honouring and respecting the stones beneath our feet was not enough for Nebekinessur. Instead, he sought out Vesta Hearthkeeper, who was known for her warmth and acceptance, along with her keen and discerning eye to make heads-and-tails of even the most unusual offerings."

c.mortiday-glow-cream.name: Mortiday Glow Cream
c.mortiday-glow-cream.description: You are unsure why Araceli was so excited to see you holding this, but beyond it apparently being excellent for the celebration, you cannot think of many good uses for it.

u.blizzarding-hordes-lesser-leavings.name: Blizzarding Horde's Lesser Leavings
u.blizzarding-hordes-lesser-leavings.description: The Defenders have brought along some interesting provisions to keep their strength up against the Blizzarding Horde. Though stingy with their goods, you may be able to convince some of them to trade small portions of them to keep you and your armies provisioned.

u.orange-gipantan-troop-draft-poster.name: Orange Gipantan Troop Draft Poster
u.orange-gipantan-troop-draft-poster.description: Used to draft Troops to your cause.
u.orange-gipantan-troop-draft-poster.effects: Open to obtain its contents (two of the following)

c.green-chaosoldier-hide.name: Green Chaosoldier Hide
c.green-chaosoldier-hide.description: Perhaps the hide of this foot-soldier will hold the key to learning how to deal with its fiery, demonic aura.

u.holy-resilience-potion.name: Holy Resilience Potion
u.holy-resilience-potion.description: A thick, viscous brew, which leaves a distinct aftertaste of cardamom.

e.orange-opal-ring.name: Orange Opal Ring
e.orange-opal-ring.description: An unusually coloured gem sits atop this simple ring, granting an equally unusual feeling of life and vitality.

e.mirgoda-fur-leathers.name: Mirgoda Fur Leathers
e.mirgoda-fur-leathers.effects:
Fetid Furs (Leathers): 25% chance to proc 200 Physical damage; +150 damage per Mirgoda Fur set item worn; +20 HP; +5% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Mirgoda Fur Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +2% Crit Rate
 6+: +5% All Resistances
 8+: +80 HP and +10% Ice Resistance
 9+: +5% All Resistances and -10% Formation Bonus
e.mirgoda-fur-leathers.description: The patchy armor won't serve you well in the company of many nobles, but you'd rather survive a fight, or a night in the mountains, than worry about the nuances of nobility.

e.mirgoda-fur-ring.name: Mirgoda Fur Ring
e.mirgoda-fur-ring.effects:
+3 Tiers of 'Identify Weakness'; +1.5% Evasion
Set Bonus (Mirgoda Fur Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +2% Crit Rate
 6+: +5% All Resistances
 8+: +80 HP and +10% Ice Resistance
 9+: +5% All Resistances and -10% Formation Bonus
e.mirgoda-fur-ring.description: You are not a fan of gaudy baubles, but this is simple enough to avoid attracting attention, while being loud enough to scream that you aren't to be crossed.

c.oozing-essence.name: Oozing Essence
c.oozing-essence.description: As much as Alanis seems to suggest there may be value in this ooze, you cannot bring yourself to touch it. Hopefully whatever stuck to the stick you found will suffice.

c.violet-overlord-assegai.name: Violet Overlord Assegai
c.violet-overlord-assegai.description: Surely there must be a collector of strange, demonic things - aside from your insatiable companion... - who would be willing to take these used-weapons in exchange for something you can utilize.

e.phermitic-battlegarb-cuirass.name: Phermitic Battlegarb Cuirass
e.phermitic-battlegarb-cuirass.effects:
The Wisdom in War (Cuirass): 12% chance to proc 140 Physical damage; +80 damage per Phermitic Battlegarb set item worn; +0.25% Evasion
Sanctified
Set Bonus (Phermitic Battlegarb Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +15% Crit Damage
 8+: +2% Crit Rate and +2 Tiers of 'Prolonged Battle'
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.phermitic-battlegarb-cuirass.description: V. With a magical flourish, Phermis revealed Her true form, accepting Ankyabu's challenge. Supplies were brought, and both started weaving brilliant and colourful tapestries.

a.cryogolem.name: Cryogolem
a.cryogolem.description:
"Ah, what a glorious creation, if I do say so myself! Maybe this will be less likely to drop my. Expensive. Artifacts."
-Glaciver Frost, glaring at some nearby novices
a.cryogolem.effects: Adds +1 Player Vitality per occupied Troop slot

a.morna-fangsheath.name: Morna Fangsheath
a.morna-fangsheath.description:
"Slaying the envenomers is not a task for the faint of heart; you must be as prepared to do whatever is necessary to accomplish your task as you are to take the brunt of the bite, itself."
-Morna Fangsheath
a.morna-fangsheath.effects: Combative Counteraction: 33% chance to proc 275 Physical damage; +425 damage vs raids with Venomous; Adds +2 Attack to each Fanghunter Bloodletter and Fanghunter Warden in the Formation

a.cyran-jokalyn.name: Cyran Jokalyn
a.cyran-jokalyn.description: After seeing how flamboyantly clad this fellow was, you felt obligated to inquire whether he was part of the 'Cumberworld' group you had heard whispers about. Cyran merely laughed heartily and clapped you on the back in response, chuckling as he continued past.
a.cyran-jokalyn.effects: Bathed in Colour: 10% chance to proc 220 Fire damage and 220 Lightning damage; 4% chance to proc 350 Dark damage and 350 Holy damage; Adds +25 Energy to the Player;  Adds +1 Attack to each Vitalic Goblin, Energizing Merman and Honourable Gohlehm in the Formation

e.nepyren-bone-shishpar.name: Nepyren Bone Shishpar
e.nepyren-bone-shishpar.effects:
Dark Remains (Shishpar): 15% chance to proc 400 Dark damage; +150 damage per Nepyren Bone set item worn; +1% Crit Rate
Set Bonus (Nepyren Bone Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 8+: +1 Tiers of 'Inspirational Command - Horrifying'
e.nepyren-bone-shishpar.description: You've never seen such a strange design for a weapon as this, even disregarding that it appears crafted from dragon bones, but you can't argue with the efficiency found in that design.

e.derzis-thunderclap-shirt.name: Derzis' Thunderclap Shirt
e.derzis-thunderclap-shirt.effects:
Lightning Divine (Shirt): 8% chance to proc 140 Lightning damage; +80 damage per Derzis' Thunderclap set item worn; 16% chance to proc 45 Lightning damage; +15 damage per Derzis' Thunderclap set item worn; +0.4% Evasion
Set Bonus (Derzis' Thunderclap Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +1 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Lightning
 8+: +1 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Lightning'
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.derzis-thunderclap-shirt.description: After spending some time with the Temple Acolytes, you finally felt prepared to meet Ghrighora. When you approached him, a blast of lightning arced from one of his strange protrusions, shocking your arm and ruining your near coat.

c.wyrm-spines.name: Wyrm Spines
c.wyrm-spines.description: The spines of a giant sand wyrm, capable of withstanding incredible underground pressures, are certainly worthwhile putting to good use.

e.millennium-island-cuisses.name: Millennium Island Cuisses
e.millennium-island-cuisses.effects:
Last Everlasting (Cuisses): 30% chance to proc 200 Nature damage; +150 damage per Millennium Island set item worn; +20 HP; +2% All Resistances
Set Bonus (Millennium Island Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +100 HP, +1 Tiers of 'Immoveable Object' and +1 Tiers of 'Hearty Constitution'
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.millennium-island-cuisses.description: Part of you wonders whether the Seafarer has difficulties traveling underwater if it is so heavily armored. Then you fear how strong the creature must be, to move to freely in spite of the extra mass.

u.script-of-distressing-shout.name: Script of Distressing Shout
u.script-of-distressing-shout.description: "Cry out in fear and spread your terror! Distressing Shout!"
u.script-of-distressing-shout.effects: Deals 40,000 Dark damage vs Guild Raids

e.oiled-leather-chest.name: Oiled Leather Chest
e.oiled-leather-chest.description: Leathers dipped in oil are of a significantly higher quality than the untreated variety, but it still remains leather.

a.kurdan.name: Kurdan
a.kurdan.description: Kurdan is an individual of precious few words, but from listening to the other thralls you believe he was once enslaved by the Fae. If only he was willing to share how he managed to free himself from their influence, it could prove an invaluable skill.
a.kurdan.effects: Fair-Folk Fatality: 24% chance to proc 600 Dark damage; +400 damage vs Fae raids; Adds +1 Attack to each Dwarf Fae Thrall and Gnome Fae Thrall in the Formation

p.skill-arcana.name: Arcana Skill Point
p.skill-arcana.description: Skill Point for the Arcana Tech Tree

c.basic-training-manuals.name: Basic Training Manuals
c.basic-training-manuals.description: Everything a new recruit needs to know about soldiering... Well, except for how to fight giant beasts, cast magics, wield exotic weapons...

c.river-delicacy.name: River Delicacy
c.river-delicacy.description: You are appreciative that you could track someone down to properly prepare the rare ingredients you found following your battle with the Paeknisar. Your mouth is watering at the prospect of the forthcoming meal.

e.blazebrand-plate.name: Blazebrand Plate
e.blazebrand-plate.effects:
Justice by any Flames Necessary (Plate): 14% chance to proc 800 Fire damage; +275 damage per Blazebrand set item worn; 4% chance to proc 1,175 Fire damage; +650 damage per Blazebrand set item worn; +4% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Blazebrand Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 8+: +2.5% Crit Rate
 9+: 40% chance to proc 250 Fire damage, +8 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Fire' and +1 Tiers of 'Insurmountable Offence'
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion

c.blue-shed-snakeskin.name: Blue Shed Snakeskin
c.blue-shed-snakeskin.description: You don't know what colour of serpent would have shed this, but it is certainly a strange article to come across.

c.violet-gardening-shears.name: Violet Gardening Shears
c.violet-gardening-shears.description: Pruning overgrown shrubbery has never been quite so.... flamboyant!

c.blue-explosive-stinger.name: Blue Explosive Stinger
c.blue-explosive-stinger.description: Notwithstanding the size and colour of this appendage, the fact that it can deliver both venom and an explosive blast leaves you hesitant about handling it!

e.lesser-ent-wood-helm.name: Lesser Ent Wood-Helm
e.lesser-ent-wood-helm.effects: Ent Smash (Helm): 10% chance to proc 125 Nature damage; +25 damage per Lesser Ent set item worn
e.lesser-ent-wood-helm.description: I. The old stories of Ents are told to virtually every child as bedtime tales, describing towering, lumbering beings who tended to their forests, are slow to anger but vicious when they attack.

c.grey-repenting-dusk-token.name: Grey Repenting Dusk Token
c.grey-repenting-dusk-token.description: This seems to be a part of a Repentant Dusk mark, or perhaps a precursor to one. Sar Qina suggests it may have value, but you'd need to accrue a few of them for their smiths to fashion them into anything of worth.

e.chiffon-gloves.name: Chiffon Gloves
e.chiffon-gloves.effects:
Downy Delight (Gloves): 40% chance to proc 255 Holy damage; +3750 damage vs Guild Raids; +90 damage per Chiffon set item worn
Set Bonus (Chiffon Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +4% All Resistances; 1% chance to heal the Player 3 HP
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.chiffon-gloves.description: V(b). As Helci's studies continued, her home life continued to deteriorate, and she found herself more and more at odds with her husband, and estranged from her son. As that side of her life grew more tempestuous, Helci found she was throwing herself deeper into her studies, though she was unable to keep her frustrations from her work. Helci began to notice shadows creeping in at the edges of her powers, and found herself both curious and terrified of them.

e.alchemical-artisan-boots.name: Alchemical Artisan Boots
e.alchemical-artisan-boots.effects:
Explosive Eccentricities (Boots): 8% chance to proc 500 Nature damage; +250 damage per Alchemical Artisan set item worn; 12% chance to proc 500 Fire damage; +125 damage per Alchemical Artisan set item worn; +3% Dark Resistance; +3% Ice Resistance
Set Bonus (Alchemical Artisan Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1% Crit Rate and +20% Crit Damage
 7+: 2% chance to proc 25,000 Acid damage
 8+: +2 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Nature' and 'Elemental Expertise - Fire'
 9+: +5% Dark Resistance, +5% Ice Resistance and +2% Crit Rate
e.alchemical-artisan-boots.description: IX. As she knelt by the girl in a small hut, Nahla took her hand and winced as the girl barely had the energy to recoil in pain from the contact. Nahla recognized the ailment from her travels, though she had not seen it in one so young. She knew that it was fully capable of taking the child's life, and Nahla was torn, feeling almost like she was losing Cato again, right in front of her. As she snapped back to reality, she heard some of the other merfolk - presumably the child's siblings - talking about a magical stone that acted as a cure-all, and making haphazard plans to seek it out in order to cure their sister. It wasn't until moments later, unsure of why her hand was hurting, that Nahla realized she had struck the child who had suggested the plan.

a.gipantan-dockhand.name: Gipantan Dockhand
a.gipantan-dockhand.description: A hard worker from the docks of the capitol, you can always make use of more labourers, particularly with your ever-growing entourage.
a.gipantan-dockhand.effects: Adds +4 Attack and +0.3 Defence to Broff Keghaul in the active Formation

e.honorbounds-shirt.name: Honorbound's Shirt
e.honorbounds-shirt.effects:
Undermountain Redemption (Shirt): 4% chance to proc 175 Physical damage; +60 damage per Honorbound's set item worn
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.honorbounds-shirt.description:
"The thin shirt given to the Honorbound conveys only the most meagre degree of protection while protecting an equally meager portion of dwarven dignity."
-Norsic Bittermail

u.lesser-acid-resilience-potion.name: Lesser Acid Resilience Potion
u.lesser-acid-resilience-potion.description: A thinly brewed potion that tastes faintly of turmeric...

u.naitour-patrols-provisions.name: Naitour Patrol's Provisions
u.naitour-patrols-provisions.description: This oversized meal pack is said to contain everything an officer of the Naitour Patrol needs for their lengthy shifts outside the walls of the fort. After a quick glance, you're moderately suspicious as to just how much patrolwork actually gets accomplished.

a.gravanguard-initiate.name: Gravanguard Initiate
a.gravanguard-initiate.description: The Gravanguard are a little-known and slowly-disappearing order dedicated to preventing the dead from returning to life. Given the state of the world following the emergence of the Void, you suspect interest in the group may be rekindled.
a.gravanguard-initiate.effects: Adds +5 Attack to Sar Tephania in the active Formation

a.uugun.name: Uugun
a.uugun.description:

e.mordant-moswa-gloves.description: V. The only references Brath could find regarding the name, at least in any meaningful academic sense, spoke of Cenius the Lifeswindler, but little was written about his end - or if he had even truly passed on. This Cenius character was apparently masterfully adept at drawing out life essence, even from utterly unwilling victims, and turning those energies back upon their original hosts and others. It seems some individuals had attempted to replicate that power, but none had proven anywhere near as successful as Cenius, himself, had been. There was a name that came up several times, however, which troubled Brath: Brianag. He was certain he had heard that name referenced before, but he could not quite remember from where. Scribbling fiercely, Brath returned his books, and only upon his turning to depart did the kindly librarian speak up.

e.hatuumin-dressings.description: VI. While the first day of travel was uneventful, the first night was not, as they were assailed by bandits under the veil of darkness. Sennie whipped up a fury, wielding his trusted whips and mace, but it wasn't long before he realized there were simply too many, and they would be overrun... That was, however, until he was ready to face the bite of a bandit's glaive, only to watch the bandit's eyes roll back and blood pour out, and only then realized that Sennie had struck him down. The trio staved off the bandits, Kontar wielding his darts and Sennie his magics, and Sinyu breathed a sigh of relief, knowing he'd live to fight another day.

e.mirays-aegis.description: II. Rising to her feet, Miray stretched briefly, her mind simultaneously shifting between focusing upon the imminent future and her prospective fate, until the clanging against the bars of her domicile alerted her that it was her chance to use the practice yard. Grabbing her rusted, bronzed helm, her notched short-sword and her dented buckler, she nodded to the guard as he unlocked her barred path. Squaring off against the weighted dummy, Miray went through her usual forms of striking and reassessing, and had to force herself to focus on the task at hand when all she wanted to do was imagine a future that was no longer a distant thought. Nor did she want to wear herself out, for today was to mark the match that would culminate in her one thousandth victory in the arena.
