 9+: +6% All Resistances and 5% chance to heal the Player 1.8 HP
e.waveblessed-blade.description:
"You'd be surprised how many still try to board a neutral healer's vessel unwanted. It's important that these undesirables can be repelled."
-Waveblessed Shiphand

u.silver-codex-of-wisdom.name: Silver Codex of Wisdom
u.silver-codex-of-wisdom.description: Every now and again a rare gem among literature appears, conveying experience beyond its ken, capable of both inspiring future generations to greatness and reminding them of the lessons of history. The wisdom delivered by such works is invaluable, and should never be taken for granted.

c.frostblossom-seed.name: Frostblossom Seed
c.frostblossom-seed.description:
"The frostblossom is incredibly rare to find in these southern lands, and only disperse one seed every four years. Much can be learned from studying such a wondrous artifact."
-Aisi Tushar

a.sar-tephania.name: Sar Tephania
a.sar-tephania.description: Anointed as a sworn knight before joining the Gravanguard, Tephania was called upon by Chaunath to serve the Gravanguard order and was anointed anew in that name. This conversion has earned her the moniker the 'Twice-sworn Paladin', though from her scowl you suspect she may not appreciate the reminder.
a.sar-tephania.effects: Gravanguard Smite: 14% chance to proc 600 Holy damage; +400 damage vs Undead raids

c.runepowder-dust.name: Runepowder Dust
c.runepowder-dust.description: Grinding stone down to a fine powder is challenging enough, but when that stone has been magically enhanced, and further fortified with mystical runes, the resulting dust is a potent ingredient.

e.mountain-trekkers-gloves.name: Mountain Trekkers Gloves
e.mountain-trekkers-gloves.effects:
Uphill Undertakings (Gloves): 16% chance to proc 60 Nature damage; +20 damage per Mountain Trekkers set item worn; +250 damage vs Winter raids; +2% Ice Resistance
Set Bonus (Mountain Trekkers Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +5% Ice Resistance
 7+: +20 Vitality
 8+: +5 Raid Cap
e.mountain-trekkers-gloves.description:
"Keep your grubby hands where I can see them. I don't know if you're here to rob us blind, or worse, but I've got my eyes on you."
-Melaphin Suncomber

e.swamp-nomad-hood.name: Swamp Nomad Hood
e.swamp-nomad-hood.effects:
Swamp's Thing (Hood): 4% chance to proc 1600 Nature damage; +200 damage per Swamp Nomad's set item worn; +30 Magic; +3% Nature Resistance; +3% Poison Resistance
Set Bonus (Swamp Nomad Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +1 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Nature'
e.swamp-nomad-hood.description: After spending some time in the Celelfen Swamp, surrounded by the swarms of incessant, stinging insects, you have the utmost respect for these modest hoods.

a.geo-fray.name: Geo Fray
a.geo-fray.description: Dignified and restrained Geo Fray is the epitome of refinement, and expects similar from the servants he trains. Even his speech is eloquent, even if you don't quite understand much of what he says...
a.geo-fray.effects: Most Certainly: 20% chance to proc 800 Dark damage; +800 Dark damage vs Guild raids

e.fanghunters-vespid.name: Fanghunter's Vespid
e.fanghunters-vespid.effects:
Poison Pursuit (Vespid): 30% chance to proc 600 Poison damage; +40 damage per Fanghunter's set item worn; +2% Evasion
Set Bonus (Fanghunter's Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: 10% chance to proc 1350 Magic damage and protect the Player from the Venomous Raid Ability
e.fanghunters-vespid.description:
"While it is true that we hunt many venomous creatures, the ultimate goal of the order is to protect the innocent. Taming a few of our quarries to work to our ends benefits everyone involved."
-Morna Fangsheath

e.reverent-titanslayer-armet.name: Reverent Titanslayer Armet
e.reverent-titanslayer-armet.effects:
Behemoth Bouldery Bash (Armet): 12% chance to proc 900 Holy damage; +2,500 damage vs Legendary raids; +700 damage per Reverent Titanslayer set item worn; +0.75% Evasion; +1% All Resistances; +12% Crit Damage; +30 HP
Set Bonus (Reverent Titanslayer Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +2% Crit Rate and +25% Crit Damage
 6+: +100 HP and +6% All Resistances
 7+: 6% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 80%, and 4% chance to reduce damage to Armies by 75%
 8+: 8% chance to proc 2,400 Holy damage and protect the Player and their Armies from Breath of Death
 9+: +30% Formation Bonus
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.reverent-titanslayer-armet.description: As much as you appreciate the protection from this thick helm, its hindrance to your visibility is made all-the-more worrisome when considering the aerial combat it was made for. At least you can unclasp the faceplate with relative ease.

u.arthropod-annihilation-potion.name: Arthropod Annihilation Potion
u.arthropod-annihilation-potion.description: To beat big bugs, bring batches of bubbly brews.
u.arthropod-annihilation-potion.effects: +6,000 Offence vs Insect Raids for 4 hours

c.glasha-brunbruk-boost-ii.name: Glasha Brunbruk Boost II
c.glasha-brunbruk-boost-ii.description: She has experienced the throngs of hell and lived to tell the tale. Passively boosts Glasha's Attack by +35 and Defence by 1 (Max 1).

a.mastru-infantry.name: Mastru Infantry
a.mastru-infantry.description: You did not have the opportunity to speak with the infantry commander, who fell during the encounter, but it is clear that his troops are well trained.
a.mastru-infantry.effects: Adds +2 Attack to Morcant and Sollemnia Verus in the active Formation

c.sigil-of-devoted-experience.name: Sigil of Devoted Experience
c.sigil-of-devoted-experience.description: "This sigil showcases the highest honour for your devoted service. May your light never dim, as your allegiance never wavered."

e.reverent-titanslayer-solleret.name: Reverent Titanslayer Solleret
e.reverent-titanslayer-solleret.effects:
Behemoth Bouldery Bash (Solleret): 12% chance to proc 900 Holy damage; +2,500 damage vs Legendary raids; +700 damage per Reverent Titanslayer set item worn; +0.75% Evasion; +1% All Resistances; +12% Crit Damage; +30 HP
Set Bonus (Reverent Titanslayer Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +2% Crit Rate and +25% Crit Damage
 6+: +100 HP and +6% All Resistances
 7+: 6% chance to reduce incoming damage to the Player by 80%, and 4% chance to reduce damage to Armies by 75%
 8+: 8% chance to proc 2,400 Holy damage and protect the Player and their Armies from Breath of Death
 9+: +30% Formation Bonus
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.reverent-titanslayer-solleret.description:
"Ye'll be needin' somethin' to keep yer feet protected more then comfy fer walkin'."
-Krozana Titanslayer

e.shale-recurve-bow.name: Shale Recurve Bow
e.shale-recurve-bow.effects: Shade of Tears: +2% Crit Rate; +20% Crit Damage
e.shale-recurve-bow.description: Given the short stature of this bow, and the petite frame of its previous wielder, you were incredibly startled by the difficulty required to draw it. No wonder the merchant's guards thought that they were under attack from ballistae!

cp.fighter-starter-pack-i.name: Fighter Starter Pack I
cp.fighter-starter-pack-i.description: A pack providing the necessary goods for every budding fighter.

e.mortiday-chinaco.name: Mortiday Chinaco
e.mortiday-chinaco.effects:
Mortiday Celebration (Chinaco): 16% chance to proc 400 Dark damage; +75 damage per Mortiday set item worn; +750 damage vs Human raids
Set Bonus (Mortiday Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +20% Crit Damage
 8+: Reduces incoming damage from Human raids to the Player by 30%
 9+: +2.5% Crit Rate and +10% Crit Damage
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.mortiday-chinaco.description:
"Ah, it seems those pants suit you just fine. Now let's see you move in them!"
-Araceli Strongtoe

p.stat-strength.name: Strength Stat Point
p.stat-strength.description: Stat Point for the Strength Stat

c.yathane-shahara-attack-boost-i.name: Yathane Shahara Attack Boost I
c.yathane-shahara-attack-boost-i.description: A badge of merit, awarded to Yathane for her exemplary skills as an offensive Commander. Passively boosts Yathane's Attack by +15 (Max 3).

u.mystery-vintners-satchel.name: Mystery Vintner's Satchel
u.mystery-vintners-satchel.description: A satchel obviously belonging to a successful vintner, begging to be rummaged through.

c.blue-decorative-gloves.name: Blue Decorative Gloves
c.blue-decorative-gloves.description: You're not sure why someone would want to wear these colourful gloves, but there must be a use for them.

u.acid-resilience-potion.name: Acid Resilience Potion
u.acid-resilience-potion.description: A thick, viscous brew, which leaves a distinct aftertaste of turmeric.

e.derzis-thunderclap-thunder.name: Derzis' Thunderclap Thunder
e.derzis-thunderclap-thunder.effects:
Lightning Divine (Thunder): 4% chance to proc 450 Lightning damage; +450 damage vs Dragon raids; +200 damage per Derzis' Thunderclap set item worn; +1% Crit Rate; +0.5% Evasion
Set Bonus (Derzis' Thunderclap Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +1 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Lightning
 8+: +1 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Lightning'
e.derzis-thunderclap-thunder.description:
"Ah, you would be using that to call His blessings down on any skywards foes, yes?"
-Nico Orbesco

e.nepyren-bone-helm.name: Nepyren Bone Helm
e.nepyren-bone-helm.effects:
Dark Remains (Helm): 12% chance to proc 780 Dark damage; +100 damage per Nepyren Bone set item worn
Set Bonus (Nepyren Bone Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 8+: +1 Tiers of 'Inspirational Command - Horrifying'
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.nepyren-bone-helm.description:
"Perhapsss you would prefer not to don that eyesssore... While we appresssiate what you've done for our bretheren, that isss ssstill unsssettling..."
-Seksehsa

a.shudder-sailor-gunner.name: Shudder Sailor Gunner
a.shudder-sailor-gunner.description:
"You want to hear why our latest voyage brought us here? Well, let me explain-"

"Actually, Captain, it's probably too much. Perhaps just sum it up?"
-Conversations with the crew of the Vengeance
a.shudder-sailor-gunner.effects: Adds +2 Attack to Clammer Bund in the active Formation

c.green-dragon-claw.name: Green Dragon Claw
c.green-dragon-claw.description: The claws of the dragon appear dyed from their victims.

e.claws-of-justice-chest.name: Claws of Justice Chest
e.claws-of-justice-chest.effects:
Hooked Hearing (Chest): 10% chance to proc 600 Holy damage; +300 damage per Claws of Justice set item worn; +2% Formation Bonus; +2% Holy Resistance
Set Bonus (Claws of Justice Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +25% Formation Bonus and +1 Tiers of 'Experienced Leader'
e.claws-of-justice-chest.description: You feel particularly inspiring while leading your armies. You just hope you can do right by them.

a.veteran-dwarven-frigidara-defender.name: Veteran Dwarven Frigidara Defender
a.veteran-dwarven-frigidara-defender.description:
"This return of Frigidara is quicker than ever before. If this accelerated rate continues, she may never need time to recouperate."
-Bellas Inahice
a.veteran-dwarven-frigidara-defender.effects: Adds +0.4 Defence to Aegyr Snowbound, Bellas Inahice and Burz in the active Formation

c.brass-bell.name: Brass Bell
c.brass-bell.description:
"These are arguably the most important tools you'll need for training new recruits. Nothing's more important than knowing when it's time for grub."
-Conversations with Hamond

a.drotning.name: Drotning
a.drotning.description: As Drotning gazes down on you, you can't help but admire her regal appearance... You also can't help but wonder whether she is considering stepping on you like any unwanted insect...
a.drotning.effects: Mammoth Monarch: 20% chance to proc 350 Dark damage vs Construct raids

c.nussegret-orebrew-boost-i.name: Nussegret Orebrew Boost I
c.nussegret-orebrew-boost-i.description: Her counter-summoning prowess has improved with repeated usage. Passively boosts Nussegret's Attack by +20 (Max 2).

c.blue-eggsac.name: Blue Eggsac
c.blue-eggsac.description: You'd appreciate the rarity of finding intact eggs if they weren't still pulsating.... and wet....

e.ooleviash-staff.name: Ooleviash Staff
e.ooleviash-staff.effects:
Eire Eviction (Staff): 25% chance to proc 275 Physical damage; +75 damage per Ooleviash set item worn; +720 damage vs Fae raids; +1.5% Crit Rate; +25% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Ooleviash Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +40% Crit Damage
 7+: +500 Magic
e.ooleviash-staff.description: The gnarled wood this staff was carved from offers magics akin to those wielded by the fae of this land. Perhaps you can bring them to bear using such a tool?

c.red-assorted-bone-fragments.name: Red Assorted Bone Fragments
c.red-assorted-bone-fragments.description: Whether these originate from victims of the giant serpent, or some unfortunate soul that fell into the gorge, an experienced researcher could certainly make use of these.

e.phermitic-battlegarb-boots.name: Phermitic Battlegarb Boots
e.phermitic-battlegarb-boots.effects:
The Wisdom in War (Boots): 12% chance to proc 140 Physical damage; +80 damage per Phermitic Battlegarb set item worn; +0.25% Evasion
Sanctified
Set Bonus (Phermitic Battlegarb Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +15% Crit Damage
 8+: +2% Crit Rate and +2 Tiers of 'Prolonged Battle'
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.phermitic-battlegarb-boots.description: VIII. Spurned and scorned, Phermis' fury overcame Her and She cursed Ankyabu, transforming her into a misshapen, many-legged creature. Phermis threatened that if she wished to spend her days weaving, she could now do so in perpetuity, though loved by none for her talents.

e.warmage-guardians-helmet.name: Warmage Guardian's Helmet
e.warmage-guardians-helmet.effects:
Magic Shield (Helmet): 20% chance to proc 500 Physical damage and add +200 Defence; +175 damage per Warmage Guardian's set item worn; +6% Crit Damage; +10 HP
Set Bonus (Warmage Guardian's Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +1% Crit Rate
 7+: +500 Defence and +15% Crit Damage
 9+: +20% chance to proc 200 Magic damage with +6% damage from any Magic damage on that proc
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.warmage-guardians-helmet.description: For all the times you've been called hard-headed when protecting various mages, you might as well live up to the title.

e.capricious-conducer-shirt.name: Capricious Conducer Shirt
e.capricious-conducer-shirt.effects:
Conducive Conductivity (Shirt): 5% chance to proc 3,500 Lightning damage; +1,000 damage per Capricious Conducer set item worn; +1% Evasion; +2% Lightning Resistance
Set Bonus (Capricious Conducer Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1% Evasion
 6: +1.5% Crit Rate and +15% Crit Damage
 7+: Additional Bonuses depending on Shield equipped
 8+: 2% chance to proc 10,000 Lightning damage and give +50% Evasion on that proc
 9+: Additional Bonuses depending on Shield equipped
e.capricious-conducer-shirt.description: While you're used to chestpieces that allow for comfort, the variety of places to store, or tie items to this shirt may pay off more in utility than protection.

c.violet-eggsac.name: Violet Eggsac
c.violet-eggsac.description: You'd appreciate the rarity of finding intact eggs if they weren't still pulsating.... and wet....

u.yellow-brewmasters-satchel.name: Yellow Brewmaster's Satchel
u.yellow-brewmasters-satchel.description: An incredibly well-stocked satchel, clearly belonging to a brewmaster, and containing a mystery potion.
u.yellow-brewmasters-satchel.effects: Open to obtain its contents (two of the chance drops)

c.mark-of-the-naga-jailer.name: Mark of the Naga Jailer
c.mark-of-the-naga-jailer.description: The guard to your own personal hell was instructed to keep it in check, yet you pressed forward.

a.ostarian-shiphand.name: Ostarian Shiphand
a.ostarian-shiphand.description: While not quite as brawny as some of the others on the ship - though with equally colourful language - these shiphands are exceptionally keen-eyed and quick with a bow.
a.ostarian-shiphand.effects: Adds +1 Attack to all Ranged Troops

e.baron-aureus-helm.name: Baron Aureus' Helm
e.baron-aureus-helm.effects:
Golden Noble (Helm): 5% chance to proc 1,800 Physical damage; +1,275 damage per Baron Aureus' set item worn; +25 Magic; +20 HP
Set Bonus (Baron Aureus' Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +175 HP and +25% Crit Damage
 6+: +1.5% Crit Rate
 7+: +5% All Resistances
 8+: +1 Tiers of 'Keen Eyes'
 9+: Additional Bonuses depending on Mount equipped
e.baron-aureus-helm.description:
"Take care not to scuff that helmet too much. It's worth more than you and most of your ragtag band."
-Honourable Audia Stone

c.blue-jolly-roger.name: Blue Jolly Roger
c.blue-jolly-roger.description: There is nothing jolly about this beacon-of-death, colourful though it may be.

e.vozotlnaos-blessing-omen.name: Vozotlnaos Blessing Omen
e.vozotlnaos-blessing-omen.effects:
Firetouched and Blessed by Fire (Omen): 10% chance to proc 300 Fire damage; +400 damage per Vozotlnaos Blessing set item worn; +20 HP; +10% Crit Damage
Consecrated
Set Bonus (Vozotlnaos Blessing Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +15% Formation Bonus and +1% Crit Rate
 8+: +2 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Fire'
 9+: 1% chance to heal the Player 2 HP
e.vozotlnaos-blessing-omen.description:
"Do not wear that Omen lightly. It represents the covenant between you and Vozotl, and your pledge to defend that which He stands for."
-Kornere Warmbelt

e.oresnatchs-great-violet-ring.name: Oresnatch's Great Violet Ring
e.oresnatchs-great-violet-ring.effects: Vazz's Pride and Joy: 100% chance to proc 500 Magic damage and give +2,000 Magic on that proc
e.oresnatchs-great-violet-ring.description: Somehow, jewelers were able to take the magnificence in Vazz's violet ring, and infuse it even more potently with more of his Rainbow Ore. It glows masterfully, and its magical powers gently settle upon you when you try it on.

u.enchanted-jar.name: Enchanted Jar
u.enchanted-jar.description: It seems you need something special to keep the essence of the Aufling. Fortunately, Corros had something on-hand....
u.enchanted-jar.effects: Open to obtain its contents (five of the chance drops)

c.orange-explosive-stinger.name: Orange Explosive Stinger
c.orange-explosive-stinger.description: Notwithstanding the size and colour of this appendage, the fact that it can deliver both venom and an explosive blast leaves you hesitant about handling it!

e.nepyren-bone-sabatons.name: Nepyren Bone Sabatons
e.nepyren-bone-sabatons.effects:
Dark Remains (Sabatons): 12% chance to proc 780 Dark damage; +100 damage per Nepyren Bone set item worn
Set Bonus (Nepyren Bone Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 8+: +1 Tiers of 'Inspirational Command - Horrifying'
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.nepyren-bone-sabatons.description:
"Ah, what a clever idea, adventurer. Now you can crush your enemies beneath your feet every step of your journey. Even Amera would be pleased with this."
-Avri Stidig

a.borjigin-kuyuk.name: Borjigin Kuyuk
a.borjigin-kuyuk.description: Claiming to be a direct descendant of Temujin the Conqueror, Borjigin and his followers insist that he was actually a liberator and hero, who freed and united much of the continent several centuries ago. Given his own age, you suppose there may be some legitimacy to his knowledge.... though his claims that you must have some of Temujin's blood in you strains credulity.
a.borjigin-kuyuk.effects: Conqueror's Freedom: 10% chance to proc 520 Dark damage; Adds +0.3 Defence to Commanders in the active Formation; Restores 42 Health daily

u.script-of-acid-arrow.name: Script of Acid Arrow
u.script-of-acid-arrow.description: "Fly true and burst your displeasure! Acid Arrow!"

e.moswa-antlers.name: Moswa Antlers
e.moswa-antlers.effects:
Palmate Overpower (Antlers): 25% chance to proc 480 Magic damage; +6000 damage vs Guild Raids; +120 damage per Moswa set item worn; 6% chance to proc 2400 Nature damage; +200 damage per Moswa set item worn
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.moswa-antlers.description: III(a). Cenius was aghast when the elderly crone bumped into him, knocking him over in the street in front of his cohorts, and was determined to take corrective action to recuperate lost face. Quickly rising to his feet, Cenius grabbed a nearby stone and threw it at the passing woman, striking her squarely in her upper back, causing her to stumble and stop dead in her tracks.

u.guild-purse-iv.name: Guild Purse IV
u.guild-purse-iv.description: A fat purse, containing some Guild goodies.

e.chaunaths-warpriests-gauntlets.name: Chaunath's Warpriests Gauntlets
e.chaunaths-warpriests-gauntlets.effects:
Shield of Deities (Gauntlets): 8% chance to proc 1,175 Magic damage; +1,025 damage per Chaunath's Warpriests set item worn; +2% Crit Damage; +100 Magic; 5% chance to reduce incoming damage to your Armies by 20%
Sanctified
Set Bonus (Chaunath's Warpriests Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: 5% chance on 20x attacks to heal each active Troop +1 Reserve
 6+: +2% Crit Rate and +15% Crit Damage
 7+: 4% chance on 20x attacks to heal each active Commander +2 HP
 8+: +15% Formation Bonus and 10% chance to reduce incoming damage to your armies by 30%
 9+: 4% chance on 20x attacks to heal each active Troop +3 Reserves and proc 8% of your Leadership stat in Holy damage
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.chaunaths-warpriests-gauntlets.description:
"Hold on tight to this feeling, for it is through Her blessed righteousness that you shall be able to protect everything you hold dear."
-Warpriest Emmus

c.red-xaphegorgh-wing.name: Red Xaphegorgh Wing
c.red-xaphegorgh-wing.description:
"Phermis demands an offering after a successful hunt, as our plates and bellies would be empty but for her wisdom and aid."
-Meropi Demide

e.thiadoran-garments-cheirides.name: Thiadoran Garments Cheirides
e.thiadoran-garments-cheirides.effects:
Set Bonus (Thiadoran Garments Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +40 HP
 7+: +2 Tiers of 'Spare Change'
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.thiadoran-garments-cheirides.description: Certainly made more for fashion than function, it is difficult to keep hold of your weapons with these gloves.

c.red-adventuring-clothes.name: Red Adventuring Clothes
c.red-adventuring-clothes.description: These fine, red clothes appear equally suited to riding a fair distance as they would be on the battlefield.

u.guild-purse-ii.name: Guild Purse II
u.guild-purse-ii.description: A sizable purse, containing some Guild goodies.

e.nyxifur-wand.name: Nyxifur Wand
e.nyxifur-wand.effects:
Slowly Unsteady (Wand): 6% chance to proc 600 Nature damage; +425 damage per Nyxifur set item worn; +1% Crit Rate; +20% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Nyxifur Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 6+: +30% Crit Damage
 7+: +2% Crit Rate
 9+: +140 HP
e.nyxifur-wand.description: One can only hope that the powers in this wand aren't as haphazard as its design suggests.

c.conducive-bottled-charge.name: Conducive Bottled Charge
c.conducive-bottled-charge.description: You can only imagine how Knimbag manages to capture the essence of lightning in such an object... Well, perhaps you're not even capable of imagining it...

e.swamp-nomad-stone.name: Swamp Nomad Stone
e.swamp-nomad-stone.effects:
Swamp's Thing (Stone): 25% chance to proc 360 Nature damage; +40 damage per Swamp Nomad's set item worn; +90 Magic
Set Bonus (Swamp Nomad Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 7+: +1 Tiers of 'Elemental Expertise - Nature'
e.swamp-nomad-stone.description: You can understand why some might mistake this 'stone' for a mere rock at a casual glance, but upon further inspection it is plainly evident that it is a potent source of arcane power. No wonder the nomads seem to collect these rare objects.

e.plain-farmers-tunic.name: Plain Farmer's Tunic
e.plain-farmers-tunic.description: Ordinary shirt for an ordinary day, speckled with ordinary mud and manure.

e.psyguard-bulwark-disc.name: Psyguard Bulwark Disc
e.psyguard-bulwark-disc.effects:
Guardian's Mind (Disc): 17% chance to proc 800 Psychic damage; +400 damage per Psyguard Bulwark set item worn; 2% chance to proc 400 Psychic damage and reduce incoming damage to the Player by 10% on that proc; +200 damage per Psyguard Bulwark set item worn; +1% Crit Rate; +15% Crit Damage
Set Bonus (Psyguard Bulwark Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +10 Max HP on all Commanders and +10 Reserve Cap on all Troops
6: +1% Crit Rate and +15% Crit Damage
 7+: +10 Reserve Cap on all Troops and +1,000 Defence
 8+: 10% chance to reduce damage to your Armies by 50%
 9+: +1 Formation Protection Value
e.psyguard-bulwark-disc.description: The curious design of this thrown tool led to to question Alaion as to whether it would return after use. You found the look he gave in response to be more-than-modestly rude.

c.violet-snakeweed.name: Violet Snakeweed
c.violet-snakeweed.description: In spite of Seksehsa's explanation that Naga can consume this to settle an uneasy stomach, the strange look of the eyes after consuming it, and the eagerness to chew on it, leaves room for suspicion.

c.flask-of-living-snow.name: Flask of Living Snow
c.flask-of-living-snow.description: A small sampling of the snow-turned-creature by the Mirgoda's power. If life can be imbued into something as simple as snow, perhaps that power can transfer to something else?

k.precise-shot.name: Precise Shot
k.precise-shot.effects: While equipping a Ranged weapon, you deal an incredible strike to the foe, dealing damage akin to a 40x hit, plus a bonus xx% Offence. The Raid deals an extra 25% damage to you during this attack.

u.foaming-energy-bundle-bag-ii.name: Foaming Energy Bundle Bag II
u.foaming-energy-bundle-bag-ii.description: A pack, filled to the brim with foaming potions!

u.green-camp-supplies.name: Green Camp Supplies
u.green-camp-supplies.description: A hefty pack, containing various goods to use at your Army Camp.
u.green-camp-supplies.effects: Open to obtain its contents (two of the following)

e.capon-cane.name: Capon Cane
e.capon-cane.effects: Cockerel's Crowing: 40% chance to proc 140 Psychic damage
e.capon-cane.description: Perhaps the shortest staff you have ever seen, the magical powers within this wooden stave cannot be discounted. Perhaps some mage appreciated the value in pairing practicality with the arcane.

e.vibrant-cuirass.name: Vibrant Cuirass
e.vibrant-cuirass.effects:
Colours of Creation (Cuirass): 24% chance to proc 90 Magic damage; +20 Magic damage per Vibrant Victors set item worn; 2% chance to proc 400 Physical damage; +200 Physical damage per Vibrant Victors set item worn
Set Bonus (Vibrant Victors Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 9+: +5 Vitality, +5 Energy, +5 Honor and additional bonuses (depending on Main-Hand/Off-Hand equipped)
Heavy Armor: -2% Evasion
e.vibrant-cuirass.description:
"Well, the next time you need to visit a dignitary straight away from the battlefield, you know you'll be readily dressed for both...?"
-Mauritio

c.thinned-brew-of-shadow.name: Thinned Brew of Shadow
c.thinned-brew-of-shadow.description: I've noticed a number of carriages, all painted black, similar to the flowers and love that shan't return. I've watched as people see me and quickly look away, similar to the birth of new life, it happens daily.

e.scaled-robes.name: Scaled Robes
e.scaled-robes.effects:
Cobra Gaze (Robes): 6% chance to proc 120 Poison damage; +2 Magic
Set Bonus (Scaled Robes Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +30 Magic
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.scaled-robes.description: II. Both demonic beings wielded powerful venoms and used all the powers at their disposals to overcome the other, but despite Ssarfraxss’ inherent strength he was evenly matched against Rhacel and her intricate schemes.

u.thiadoran-asparagus.name: Thiadoran Asparagus
u.thiadoran-asparagus.description: Supposedly a crunchy delicacy of the region, you were unsure why anyone would willingly eat this thick, fibrous vegetable, nor could you understand why Alanis snickered at your obvious dismay.

preReqs.name: resource
preReqs.errorMsg: Your health and honor are full already.

u.infernal-immolation-potion.name: Infernal Immolation Potion
u.infernal-immolation-potion.effects: +6,000 Offence vs Demon Raids for 4 hours

e.picaroons-axes.name: Picaroon's Axes
e.picaroons-axes.effects:
Swabby Sealover (Axes): 15% chance to proc 60 Physical damage; +50 damage per Picaroon's Raiments set item worn; +200 damage vs Human raids; +0.5% Crit Rate; +10% Crit Damage; Deals 60 Physical damage on Crits
Set Bonus (Picaroon's Raiment Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +2% Crit Rate
 7+: +25% Crit Damage
e.picaroons-axes.description: Unlike Rarsik's favourite axe, these are lightweight and clearly meant for lobbing at a foe. Well, perhaps less of a lob, but the target rarely notices the difference.

e.cumberworld-mask.name: Cumberworld Mask
e.cumberworld-mask.effects:
+20 Vitality; +20 Energy
Set Bonus (Cumberworld Set) for wearing the stated number of equipment pieces from this set:
 5+: +1 Tiers of 'Discerning Vision' and 'Astute Observation'
 9+: +1 Tiers of 'Discerning Vision' and 'Astute Observation'
Light Armor: +0.2% Evasion
e.cumberworld-mask.description:
"A hat wonnot care if ye's cat or rat, but if you're fat as a vat it'll be flat as a mat if ye don't watch where ye sat!"
-Bonaguido

c.vampiric-teeth.name: Vampiric Teeth
c.vampiric-teeth.description:
"Safely removing an entire set of teeth from a vampire is tricky business... if it's beaten too badly it simply disintegrates, but they don't tend to cooperate when given the option."
-Vanhel Cleric

c.green-fen-seedpod.name: Green Fen Seedpod
c.green-fen-seedpod.description: It is said that Fen Lure plants only produce seeds in the dead of night. You can't say whether this is true, but this is a rare find, indeed!

c.tromos-snakeroot-roots.name: Tromos Snakeroot Roots
c.tromos-snakeroot-roots.description: The roots of this oddly-named plant are unexpectedly hardy, and you find yourself being unable to tear them with your bare hands. The juices within are supposedly a potent styptic.

a.azalea-waveblessed.name: Azalea Waveblessed
a.azalea-waveblessed.description: Claiming to be a missive of Eptiades, Azalea leads her crew along the coasts offering healing and benevolence to any who ask it. Considering your current state of affairs, you wouldn't turn down the prospect of this kind of aid.
a.azalea-waveblessed.effects: Waves of the Blessed: 13% chance to proc 20,000 Nature damage; Adds +3 Attack and +1 Defence to each Waveblessed Shiphand in the Formation; Adds +1.2 Defence to Caimie Seafoam in the Formation

k.decisive-scrutiny.name: Decisive Scrutiny
k.decisive-scrutiny.effects: Your Crit Rate is doubled for your next xx Attacks.
